article.articleHeadline: République démocratique du Congo | Ituri : Bulletin d'information n° 1 sur la maladie à Virus Ebola (MVE) dans les sites de personnes déplacées en Ituri (24 juin 2026)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo | Ituri: Information Bulletin No. 1 on Ebola Virus Disease (EVD) in internally displaced persons sites in Ituri (June 24, 2026).
article.articleSummary: Ebola Virus Disease (EVD) in Ituri province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, is the focus of Information Bulletin No. 1 (June 24, 2026) on internally displaced persons (IDP) sites. Of 107 IDP sites, 69 receive support under the Camp Coordination and Camp Management (CCCM) mechanism; several sites lack regular site management. The emergence of suspected deaths and confirmed EVD cases elevates transmission risk, especially in sites with severe WASH gaps—limited potable water, insufficient latrines, and poor waste management. Community resistance, misinformation, and reliance on traditional medicine hinder early detection and response. A strengthened multisectoral approach—including Health, WASH, CCCM, and community engagement—is essential to contain the situation within IDP sites and prevent wider spread. This bulletin underscores the urgent need for coordinated action and targeted interventions to address gaps in displaced communities in Ituri.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国 | イトゥリ州：イトゥリの国内避難民サイトにおけるエボラウイルス病（EVD）に関する情報ブルテン第1号（2026年6月24日）
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病（IHR基準で最高リスク病原体）が確認された症例と疑い症例がコンゴ民主共和国で報告されており、IHR基準4項目全て該当。加えてWPRO基準5項目全て該当。国内避難民サイトという脆弱な環境での発生であり、緊急対応が必要。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病はIHR(2005)Annex2で最優先の公衆衛生上の懸念事項。国内避難民サイトでの発生は、限定的なWASH施設、コミュニティの抵抗、偽情報等により制御が困難な状況。多部門的な調整と緊急介入が不可欠。フルRRA実施を強く推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Flying to India? All international travellers must now fill health form amid Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: India imposes AIR SUVIDHA 2.0 self-declaration for all arrivals amid an Ebola outbreak in Africa. Launched 25 June 2026, the online form at airsuvidha.civilaviation.gov.in must be completed within 24 hours and covers 21-day travel history, exposure to Ebola-affected areas, and symptoms such as fever, body aches, or bleeding. On arrival, travellers present the downloaded form at the Travel Desk or immigration; no paper form is needed, and data are shared in real time with airport officers and immigration. The move follows WHO’s 17 May 2026 declaration of a Public Health Emergency of International Concern for outbreaks in the DRC and Uganda, identified as Bundibugyo virus disease with no approved vaccines or treatments. Borders with DRC, Uganda, and South Sudan are high risk; travellers from these areas may face extra screening. The WHO and African CDC have pledged $518 million over six months to boost surveillance, testing, and infection control.

triage.headline_ja: インドへ渡航する場合は健康申告書を提出が必須に　アフリカのエボラ流行を受け
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHOが2026年5月17日にPHEIC宣言しており、DRCとウガンダでのBundibugyo virus disease流行が公式に確認されている。
triage.notes: WHOはPHEIC宣言済み（2026年5月17日）。DRCとウガンダでのBundibugyo virus disease流行が確認。インドが国際旅行者向けの健康申告フォーム（AIR SUVIDHA 2.0）を導入し、エボラ関連の曝露歴・症状チェックを実施中。ウガンダはリスト上の対象国ではないが、DRCとインドは対象国に含まれるため verified_locations に記載。南スーダンは対象国外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Congo's Ebola outbreak crosses 1,150 cases as Unicef warns children face the greatest risk
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of Congo's Ebola outbreak has reached 1,155 confirmed cases and 304 deaths, government data show as of Thursday. In Ituri and eastern DRC, 37 new cases and five new deaths were recorded in the last 24 hours, with the situation remaining fluid and community transmission continuing to grow week on week. Children and adolescents, about 15% of confirmed cases and more than 25% of deaths as of 19 June, face the greatest risk; infected youngsters are almost twice as likely to die than adults, compounding stigma and psychosocial distress, while violence risks against women and girls rise. Across the border in Uganda, 20 cases and two deaths have involved travelers from DRC; one child tested positive, 19 are under quarantine monitoring. UNICEF seeks $70.7 million for a six‑month response, about $20 million still unfunded, under the Ebola Preparedness and Response Continental Plan.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱感染者が1,150例を超える、ユニセフが子どもたちが最大のリスクに直面していると警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱は極めて重篤で致死率が高く、多数の死亡報告あり（304死亡例）。DRC東部での活発なヒト-ヒト感染と国境を越えたウガンダへの拡大が確認されており、国際的拡大リスクと渡航制限リスクが顕著。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで明示されているDRC（Ituri州含む）での1,155確認症例、304死亡例、およびヒト-ヒト感染の継続的拡大が記述されている。ウガンダへの越境事例（20症例、2死亡）も報告されているが、主たる発生地はDRCであり、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations からは除外。エボラ出血熱の高い致死率、子どもの感受性の高さ、UNICEF資金要請($70.7百万)など、国際的対応の必要性が明確。

article.articleHeadline: France detects first Ebola case outside Africa in current outbreak
article.articleSummary: France confirms its first Ebola virus disease case on national soil in the current outbreak: a doctor who flew from Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of Congo, and arrived in Paris on Tuesday. He was almost asymptomatic aside from headaches; his condition slightly deteriorated during the flight and he was immediately isolated on landing, with a very low viral load and stable status. Five other passengers are being monitored as a precaution; authorities say transmission risk remains low. The case aligns with the DRC’s 17th Ebola outbreak in Ituri province, declared May 15, with over 1,000 cases and about 267 deaths (roughly 25% fatality). The Bundibugyo strain involved has no approved vaccine or treatment; existing vaccines target the Zaire strain. An American surgeon recovered after treatment in Germany, and a Berlin hospital discharged him after 17 days. ALIMA confirms the patient’s affiliation with its team.

triage.headline_ja: フランス、現在の流行におけるアフリカ外での初のエボラ患者を検出
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。エボラウイルス病の非アフリカ地域での確認は極めて重大で、複数国間の地理的拡大を示唆する。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域にはベルリン、パリ、フランス、ドイツが含まれているが、記事サマリーの詳細読み込みにより、実際のエボラ流行発生地はDRC（イトゥリ州、キンシャサ）のみである。フランスとドイツで報告されているのは輸入症例（キンシャサから渡航した患者とドイツ治療中のアメリカ人医師）であり、これらの国での流行発生ではない。評価対象国リスト上、DRCのみが実際の発生地として verified_locations に含まれる。ただし、国際的なヒト-ヒト感染リスク、複数国への医療従事者の移動、ワクチン/治療薬の不足（Bundibugyo株）により、IHRおよびWPRO基準全項目が該当し、緊急のフルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: More health centres needed as Congo's Ebola death toll passes 300
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Ebola outbreak has surpassed 300 deaths with 1,155 confirmed cases. Authorities say the Bundibugyo strain poses containment challenges as the outbreak, first reported in mid-May, spreads within the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Africa CDC's Jean Kaseya notes that 95% of beds are occupied, prompting calls to rapidly build treatment centres and expand bed capacity. Clinical trials for two potential therapies are slated to begin next week in Bunia, Ituri province: the experimental MBP134 drug and the antiviral remdesivir; remdesivir supplies have arrived in Congo. The current lack of a widely available vaccine or specific treatment for Bundibugyo complicates response. In response, the government ordered a 21-day travel quarantine for anyone wishing to move from Ebola-affected areas domestically or internationally to aid contact tracing.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ死亡者数が300人を超える中、保健センターの増設が必要
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な大規模流行、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限実施）。エボラウイルス病での300人超の死亡は極めて重大なシグナルであり、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病(Bundibugyo strain)による大規模流行。死亡者300人超、確認患者1,155人は極めて重大。政府による21日間の渡航隔離命令実施。臨床試験開始予定、医療体制逼迫（ベッド占有率95%）。国際的な支援・治療薬供給が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Shingles hospitalizes 23-year-old Canadian tourist in Vietnam within 48 hours
article.articleSummary: A 23-year-old Canadian tourist in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam, developed shingles on the inner left arm, with red spots and mild itching. Blisters appeared on day two, and by day three a red streak extended along lymphatic vessels. Diagnosed with shingles with localized skin infection, he was initially discharged for outpatient treatment. Within ~48 hours the infection spread to the upper arm, elbow, and forearm, becoming extensive cellulitis with acute lymphangitis, necessitating inpatient care. Shingles results from reactivation of the varicella-zoster virus; while common in older or immunocompromised individuals, this case is unusual in a healthy young adult (about one in three people develop shingles). A bacterial skin infection along lymphatics posed sepsis risk if untreated. Treatment included antiviral therapy plus intravenous antibiotics; swelling and pain improved within a day, and he was discharged after three days for outpatient follow-up. City International Hospital (Ho Chi Minh City) treats foreign patients and is part of Vietnam’s medical-tourism sector (>30,000 international visitors annually).

triage.headline_ja: 帯状疱疹がベトナムのカナダ人観光客（23歳）を48時間以内に入院させる
triage.triage_reason: 単一の散発症例で、個人の重症化事例であり、公衆衛生上の流行や異常な集団発生ではない。国際的な拡大リスクや渡航・貿易制限のリスクはない。
triage.notes: 本事例は個別の観光客の帯状疱疹感染症例であり、散発症例である。WPROスクリーニング基準では異常性と重症度で該当するが、流行可能性が低く、社会的・政治的関心がなく、公衆衛生的な集団発生の兆候がないため見送り判定とする。個人的な重症化事例であり、シグナルレベルには達しない。

article.articleHeadline: Phát hiện ca nhiễm Ebola đầu tiên ngoài châu Phi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: First Ebola case detected outside Africa.
article.articleSummary: First Ebola virus disease case detected outside Africa confirmed in France. A doctor returning from Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of Congo, to Paris on June 23 tested positive for Ebola; health deteriorated during the flight, but he is now stable and isolated with a very low viral load. ALIMA confirms the infected individual is a humanitarian worker; Air France provided the passenger list and five potentially exposed passengers have been isolated. French authorities and the Prime Minister’s Office are monitoring the situation; WHO warns frontline workers face risk, but global outbreak risk remains low. As of June 24, 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo reports 1,118 confirmed Ebola cases and 291 deaths (26%), with 122 recovered and 408 currently treated; 131 suspected cases with 44 deaths. Uganda reports 20 cases and two deaths.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ大陸外で初のエボラ患者を検出
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラウイルス病のアフリカ大陸外での初確認事例であり、複数国にまたがる国際感染症危機に該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではフランスとウガンダでも症例が報告されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には DRC のみを記載。パリの医療従事者がキンシャサから帰国後に確認された事例であり、国際的な感染拡大の懸念が高い。WHO による情報確認と緊急対応が必要な段階。

article.articleHeadline: 反复高烧出疹 市妇幼近期连续接诊6名恙虫病患儿 _新闻频道_厦门网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Repeated high fever with rash: Xiamen Municipal Maternal and Child Health Hospital recently treated six pediatric scrub typhus cases.
article.articleSummary: Six pediatric scrub typhus cases were treated recently at Xiamen Municipal Maternal and Child Health Hospital in Xiamen, Fujian, China. Patients ranged from 2 to about 10 years old, with the youngest 2 and the oldest around ten; a 4-year-old presented with repeated high fever and a rash, and a postauricular eschar led clinicians to suspect Orientia tsutsugamushi infection, later confirmed by metagenomic DNA testing. Scrub typhus is transmitted by larval chiggers that bite hidden skin areas after contact with grass, shrubs, or riverbanks; bites are often painless, and the eschar is a key diagnostic clue. Typical illness includes high fever (39–41°C), malaise, rash, and possible lymphadenopathy; severe cases may involve liver, kidney, or heart. Prevention stresses outdoor protection during holidays: wear long sleeves and pants, tuck pant legs, use DEET-based repellents, and shower and change clothes after outdoor activity. Early detection and treatment yield rapid recovery.

triage.headline_ja: 繰り返される高熱と発疹：厦門市妇幼保健院が最近6名の小児恙虫病患者を治療
triage.triage_reason: 恙虫病の小児クラスター（6例）が検出され、WPROスクリーニング基準の複数項目に該当するが、情報が限定的（死亡例の記載なし、重症度の明確な記述不足、地域内の継続的な感染リスク評価が不明）。続報による確認が必要。
triage.notes: 恙虫病は媒介虫（ツツガムシ幼虫）由来の感染症で、野外活動時の継続的な曝露リスクあり。6例の小児集積は異常だが、重症例の有無、死亡例の記載がなく重症度評価が不十分。サマリーでは外来診療のみの記載で、入院患者数や地域内の継続的流行可能性が不明。医学的には興味深いが、公開情報だけではWHO通知基準を満たす判断ができない。

article.articleHeadline: Ngang nhiên tiêu thụ lợn nhiễm bệnh
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazenly consuming diseased pigs.
article.articleSummary: ASF in Thanh Hoa, Vietnam: Since late March 2026, authorities have prosecuted four cases of trading and consuming African swine fever-infected pigs. On 19 June, three Thanh Hoa residents—Trang, Thu, Luan—were charged under Article 317 for buying and selling ASF-infected pigs; police found six pigs at Trang's slaughter site, two dead and others prepared for sale. Trang said Thu introduced her to Luan for six infected pigs. On 2 June, a 21-pig ASF-infected herd led broker Dong to connect buyers; Thanh bought for over 71 million VND and sold to Dien for 84 million; Dien slaughtered four pigs, rest hidden but seized. Investigations opened against four suspects. Separate seizures on 31 March and 29 April involved dozens of ASF-infected pigs. Thanh Hoa has over 1,400 slaughterhouses and about 1.32 million pigs across 589 farms and 88,070 smallholders; officials pledge tougher enforcement and public awareness.

triage.headline_ja: 病気の豚を堂々と消費
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムでのアフリカ豚熱（ASF）の違法取引・消費事案。動物疾患であり人感染のリスクは低いが、食品安全と公衆衛生の潜在的脅威が存在。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 本事案はベトナム当局による違法なASF感染豚の取引・消費取締に関する報道。ASFは動物疾患であり人への直接感染リスクは限定的だが、汚染食品摂取による食品安全懸念と、継続的な違法取引による流行助長のリスクがある。ベトナム当局の取締強化と啓発活動が進行中。国際感染リスクや渡航制限リスクは現時点では低い。

article.articleHeadline: ஜூன் 28-இல் தமிழகத்தில் போலியோ சொட்டு மருந்து முகாம்: முதல்வா் விஜய் தொடங்கி வைக்கிறாா்
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Polio Drops Vaccination Camp in Tamil Nadu on June 28: Chief Minister Vijay to inaugurate.
article.articleSummary: Polio drops vaccination camp in Tamil Nadu on June 28, 2026, will be inaugurated by Chief Minister Joseph Vijay at the Adi Dravidar Government School in Palavakkam, Chennai. India, having eradicated polio, now conducts a once-a-year, single-dose campaign for children under five, replacing the previous two-dose-per-year schedule that has been in place for the past six years. The event underscores ongoing national immunization programs and surveillance aimed at sustaining polio-free status in the country. The report concentrates on the vaccination drive and the policy shift rather than outbreak or case data. Polio remains the target disease, with the focus on maintaining immunity among the under-five population through annual dosing in Tamil Nadu and across India.

triage.headline_ja: 2026年6月28日タミルナド州でのポリオワクチン接種キャンプ：首相ビジャイが開始
triage.triage_reason: 記事はポリオの定期予防接種キャンプの報道であり、感染症の発生・アウトブレイク報告ではない。インドはポリオを撲滅しており、患者発生情報は含まれていない。
triage.notes: 本記事は日常的なポリオ予防接種キャンプの報道であり、感染症イベントの探知対象ではない。インドがポリオ撲滅国であることが強調されている。サーベイランス・予防活動の報道であり、シグナルトリアージ対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Cadre d'action anticipatoire I République démocratique du Congo : choléra (Version revisée du 10 juin 2026)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Anticipatory Action Framework I Democratic Republic of the Congo: Cholera (Revised version of June 10, 2026).
article.articleSummary: Anticipatory Action Framework for Cholera in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (revised June 10, 2026) seeks to reduce the magnitude and impact of large cholera outbreaks in the DRC. Originally approved by the Emergency Relief Coordinator in December 2022 for two years and extended in 2025, the framework has been activated in 2023 (twice), 2025 (three times), and 2026 (once), with lessons guiding the revision. Developed jointly by the National Cholera Elimination Programme and other diarrhoeal diseases (PNECHOL-MD), UNICEF, WHO, and OCHA, it envisions two independent triggering scenarios. Scenario 1 targets endemic provinces North Kivu, South Kivu, Tanganyika, Haut Lomami, and Haut Katanga; Scenario 2 covers the rest of the country (non-endemic provinces). In both, risk is monitored via continuous surveillance of suspected cholera cases; exceeding a predefined threshold for three weeks in a health zone activates the framework.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国コレラ対策先制行動枠組み（2026年6月10日改訂版）
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国におけるコレラの先制行動枠組み（preparedness document）であり、現在の急性事象ではなく予防的な対策文書。記事は流行事象の報告ではなく、既存の監視・対応メカニズムの改訂版である。
triage.notes: 本記事は2026年6月26日配信の先制行動枠組み改訂版（Anticipatory Action Framework）の発表であり、新規流行事象ではない。過去の啓動実績（2023年2回、2025年3回、2026年1回）は記録されているが、現在進行中の流行状況に関する具体的情報は記事に含まれていない。監視継続によるコレラ流行動向の把握が必要。

article.articleHeadline: More health centres needed as Congo's Ebola death toll passes 300
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo’s Ebola outbreak centered in Ituri province (Bunia) has 1,155 confirmed cases and 304 deaths as of June 25, 2026. The mid-May outbreak continues to spread with health facilities strained; Africa CDC reports about 95% of hospital beds are full and urges rapid expansion of treatment centres. Trials for two potential therapies are to begin next week in Bunia: MBP134 and the antiviral remdesivir, with remdesivir supplies already arriving in Congo. Ebola transmission is via direct contact with bodily fluids, and containment is particularly challenging for Bundibugyo strains due to lack of a vaccine or specific treatment. In response, the government ordered a 21-day quarantine for travelers from Ebola-affected areas domestically or abroad to enable contact tracing and reduce spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱死亡者数が300人を超える中、さらなる保健センターが必要
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つすべてに該当し、エボラ出血熱の継続的な拡大、高い死亡率、複数の治療法の導入、国境を越えた感染リスクが明確である。
triage.notes: 2026年6月25日時点で1,155例の確定患者、304人の死亡。Ituri州Bunia中心に5月中旬から継続的に拡大中。治療施設の逼迫（95%満床）、新規治療法（MBP134、レムデシビル）の投入予定、国内外からの旅行者に対する21日間隔離政策。Bundibugyo株はワクチンおよび特異的治療法が欠如しており、ヒト-ヒト感染の制御が特に困難。

article.articleHeadline: ارتفاع إصابات فيروس "إيبولا" في الكونغو الديمقراطية إلى 1155 حالة والوفيات إلى 304
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rise in Ebola virus infections in the Democratic Republic of the Congo to 1,155 cases and 304 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola infections in the Democratic Republic of the Congo have reached 1,155 confirmed cases and 304 deaths as of June 24, 2026, with 37 new cases and 5 deaths reported in the preceding 24 hours. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo strain, representing the 17th Ebola outbreak in DRC history and the second-largest by case count, with no licensed vaccine or specific treatment for this strain. Health Minister Roger Kamba issued a decree to strengthen containment measures. A confirmed case has been reported in a French doctor involved in field response efforts, with Congo and France coordinating on the situation. The response faces severe challenges amid humanitarian crises and armed conflict, while WHO and the US CDC warn of potential further geographic spread.

triage.headline_ja: 民主共和国コンゴでエボラウイルス感染者が1,155例、死亡者が304例に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。公衆衛生上の深刻な影響（304死亡、1,155確定例）、Bundibugyo株による異常なアウトブレイク、フランスへの国際的拡大リスク、国際的な支援と注視が必要な状況。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株によるエボラアウトブレイクは対象国リストに含まれるDRCで発生。フランスは発生地域リストに含まれているが、記事サマリーではDRCの医療従事者がフランスで確認された1例のみであり、フランスは対象国外のため verified_locations には含めない。DRCは西アフリカの人道危機と武装紛争の中での対応であり、WHO・US CDCが地理的拡大を警告する高リスク状況。フルRRAへの進行を強く推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus Ebola Terdeteksi di Prancis, Berasal dari Wabah di Kongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola case detected in France, originating from an outbreak in the Congo.
article.articleSummary: France reports its first Ebola infection linked to the Democratic Republic of Congo outbreak, with a doctor who returned from humanitarian work in DRC testing positive and in isolation as health authorities conduct contact tracing; risk of community spread in Europe is low. The DRC outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo strain, a relatively rare Ebola variant, with WHO reporting more than 1,000 infections and at least 267 deaths. TRT World notes first month had the highest Ebola cases on record. Investigators believe transmission may have occurred months before the May 15 official announcement, with early urban cases spreading to three populated refugee camps. Ebola spreads via direct contact with bodily fluids and causes fever, vomiting, diarrhea, and hemorrhage. Previously, an American treated for Ebola in Germany was cleared of the virus since May 30. The case highlights cross-border mobility and the need for rapid surveillance and contact tracing.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱がフランスで検出、コンゴの流行が原因
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）および WPRO基準複数該当。コンゴでの1,000件以上の感染と267名以上の死亡、フランスでの輸入症例確認は、国際的な感染症脅威として本格的なRRA対象。
triage.notes: DRC outbreak: 1,000+ infections, 267+ deaths (Bundibugyo strain). Imported case in France confirmed in healthcare worker returning from humanitarian work; low community transmission risk noted but heightened international surveillance warranted. Germany case (American) previously cleared. Contact tracing ongoing in France. Record case numbers in first month of outbreak suggests possible earlier transmission chains in refugee camps.

article.articleHeadline: Saudi Arabia cấm nhập cảnh từ 3 nước châu Phi bùng phát dịch Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Saudi Arabia bans entry from three African countries affected by the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Saudi Arabia imposed entry bans on travelers from the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan amid a widening Ebola outbreak; no visas for anyone who has been in those countries within 21 days before travel. It also mandates border screening and travel history reviews for people from Rwanda, Burundi, Tanzania, and the Republic of the Congo (Congo-Brazzaville). The Congo remains the outbreak epicenter with over 1,150 confirmed Ebola cases; Uganda reports more than 20 cases, while France has reported its first imported Ebola case on 24 June—an doctor who contracted the virus during a humanitarian mission in Congo. The Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention (ACDC) estimates about $1.4 billion is needed to respond, nearly triple previous estimates. China has tightened Ebola surveillance as the outbreak evolves in Congo.

triage.headline_ja: サウジアラビア、エボラ出血熱が流行しているアフリカ3カ国からの入国を禁止
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の多国間流行事案。IHR基準において深刻な公衆衛生影響（1,150以上の確定患者、複数国での流行）、国際的拡大リスク（フランスへの輸入症例）、国際渡航制限の実施（サウジアラビアの入国禁止措置）が認められ、4基準すべてに該当。フルRRAが必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーにおいてDRCが流行の中心地（1,150以上の確定患者）として主題であり、Chinaが監視を強化したと述べられている。対象国リストに含まれるこれら2カ国のみを verified_locations に含める。Uganda、Rwanda、Burundi、Tanzania、Congo-Brazzaville、South Sudan、Franceは対象国外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Число умерших от Эболы в ДР Конго достигло 304
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Death toll from Ebola in DR Congo has reached 304.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo: Death toll reaches 304 with 13 more fatalities in the latest daily bulletin. Total confirmed cases rise to 1,155, a daily increase of 37, and the case fatality rate remains about 26.3%. Currently, 326 patients are hospitalized or in medical isolation, while 138 have recovered and been discharged. Contact tracing coverage stands at 79.2%. The outbreak began on May 15 in eastern DR Congo, with the epicenter in Ituri Province; cases and deaths have also been reported in neighboring Uganda, signaling cross-border transmission risk. The report provides counts of deaths and infections and notes ongoing surveillance and response, but does not detail symptoms or laboratory confirmation. Information reflects the situation as of June 26, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラによる死亡者数が304人に達した
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの国境を超えた感染拡大（DRC～ウガンダ）、高い致死率（26.3%）、および継続的な症例増加により、IHR基準2つ以上該当。国際的拡大リスクおよび渡航・貿易制限リスクが明白。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの症例報告も記事に記載されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には DRC のみ列挙。エボラアウトブレイクは継続中で、接触追跡カバレッジ 79.2%、入院・隔離中患者 326 名、回復者 138 名。5月15日に開始された東部 DRC（イトゥリ州）の流行は国境を越えた感染リスクを示唆している。

article.articleHeadline: Έμπολα στη ΛΔ Κονγκό: 1.155 κρούσματα, 304 νεκροί σύμφωνα με τις αρχές
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: 1,155 cases, 304 deaths according to authorities.
article.articleSummary: As of 26 June 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 1,155 laboratory-confirmed Ebola virus disease cases with 304 deaths. In the last 24 hours, 37 new cases and 5 deaths were recorded, aided by enhanced surveillance. The outbreak, declared on 15 May, is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a strain for which there is no specific treatment or vaccine; by contrast, the Zaire ebolavirus strain has an available vaccine. This is the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC, a country of about 100 million people, where the virus is believed to have circulated before official detection. Ebola has caused at least 15,000 African deaths over five decades, with a case-fatality range of 25%–90%; the deadliest DRC outbreak occurred in 2018–2020, with ~2,300 deaths from ~3,500 cases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ：1,155症例、304死亡（当局発表）
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準において深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスクの3つに該当。Bundibugyo ebolavirus株で有効なワクチンが存在しないこと、死亡率25-90%の高リスク病原体であることから、直ちにフルRRAが必要である。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus株による現在進行中の大規模流行。ワクチン利用不可の株であることが特に懸念される。過去のDRC最大規模流行（2018-2020年、約3,500症例2,300死亡）と比較すると現在約1,155症例であるが、進行中のため拡大傾向を注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Число погибших от Эболы в ДР Конго достигло 304
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola death toll in DR Congo reaches 304.
article.articleSummary: The Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 1,155 confirmed Ebola cases and 304 deaths as of 2026-06-26, with 326 patients receiving treatment. Outbreak spans Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu provinces, Ituri identified as the main hotspot amid ongoing armed conflict. Authorities declared the flare on May 15, after weeks of under-detection. U.S. CDC analysts warn the epidemic could become record-breaking. The report notes confirmed cases and continued transmission; no details are given on infection sources or imported/exported cases beyond national totals. Data were released by provincial authorities via X. The situation highlights the challenges of detecting and responding to Ebola in conflict-affected regions.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱によるコンゴ民主共和国での死者数が304人に達する
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生上の影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。大規模なエボラ疫学および記録破りとなる可能性があると警告されており、緊急なフルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで明示されているのはコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）でのエボラ疫学。South KivuおよびIturiは記事の発生地域に含まれるが、主要な対象国リストではこれらの州は独立した国ではなく、DRCの行政区画であるため、DRCのみをverified_locationsに含める。武装紛争地域での検出遅延が課題として指摘されており、対応可能性の評価が重要。

article.articleHeadline: العالم يحبس أنفاسه..ارتفاع حصيلة ضحايا إيبولا في الكونغو إلى 304 وفيات و1155 إصابة مؤكدة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The world holds its breath... Ebola death toll in the Democratic Republic of the Congo rises to 304 deaths and 1,155 confirmed cases.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues to spread, with the death toll rising to 304 and 1,155 confirmed infections reported to date. Active transmission remains in the eastern provinces of Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu. The case fatality rate has reached 26.3%, up from the previous report, approaching the World Health Organization’s estimate for the Bundibugyo strain of 30–50% lethality. Earlier figures showed 1,118 confirmed cases and 291 deaths, with prior counts of 1,094 cases and 277 deaths. On May 17, WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern due to the outbreak in DRC and neighboring Uganda, noting elevated regional risk but low global risk. Ongoing containment challenges include deteriorating security, limited contact tracing, and the absence of licensed vaccines or treatments targeting Bundibugyo.

triage.headline_ja: 世界が息を詰める...コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ死者数が304人、確定感染者数1155人に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。深刻な死亡率26.3%、国際的拡大（ウガンダ確認）、WHOによるPHEIC宣言済み。スクリーニング基準も複数該当し、国際的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはウガンダへの拡大を言及しているが、サマリー本文ではウガンダの具体的な症例は記述されておらず、「neighboring Uganda」との記載にとどまる。DRCが主要な感染地域であり、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。PHÉIC宣言済み（2026年5月17日）であり、緊急性は極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Arabia Saudí suspende viajes a tres países africanos por preocupaciones por ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Saudi Arabia suspends travel to three African countries over Ebola concerns.
article.articleSummary: Saudi Arabia suspends travel to the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), Uganda, and South Sudan, halting visa issuance and entry of tourists from those countries and extending to travelers arriving via third countries who have stayed in any of the three within the past 21 days, as a precaution against Ebola. The Saudi public health authority reports no confirmed or suspected Ebola cases in the kingdom since preventive measures began. The DRC is experiencing its 17th Ebola outbreak, declared in mid‑May, affecting the eastern region and spreading to Uganda. DRC has reported 1,118 confirmed Ebola cases and 291 deaths; the World Health Organization warns the outbreak is advancing at a pace that outstrips response efforts.

triage.headline_ja: サウジアラビア、エボラ懸念で3つのアフリカ諸国への渡航を中止
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の国際的拡大リスク（DRC、ウガンダ、南スーダンでの流行）と、サウジアラビアによる渡航制限措置により、IHR基準3項目以上該当。WPROスクリーニング基準複数該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、DRCでの第17次エボラ流行（1,118確定症例、291死亡）が主題。ウガンダへの拡大も記載されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため、DRCのみ verified_locations に含める。南スーダンはサマリーに言及されているが対象国でない。サウジアラビアの渡航制限は応答措置であり、発生地は対象国リストのDRCのみ。WHOが流行の加速を警告しており、国際的な懸念は高い。

article.articleHeadline: Fallecimientos por ébola en RDC superan los 300 y endurecen medidas de control
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola deaths in the DRC exceed 300, and control measures are tightened.
article.articleSummary: As of 25 June 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 300 deaths, with 1,155 confirmed cases and 304 fatalities, 138 recoveries, and 326 currently isolated or hospitalized. The Ituri province hosts the epicenter; a French doctor involved in the response is among confirmed cases. To tighten control, the government imposes strict travel rules: health workers, laboratory staff, and response teams returning from affected areas face 21 days of active health monitoring and are barred from domestic and international travel during this period. Anyone who stayed in an affected province may travel abroad only after 21 days outside the zone. Outbound international travelers must fill a health declaration form, and airlines must verify compliance. The outbreak, declared mid-May, is caused by the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola, with no approved vaccines or specific treatments available yet.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱による死亡者が300人を超え、統制措置が強化される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目すべてに該当。300人超の死亡を伴う進行中のエボラアウトブレイクであり、国際的拡大リスクと渡航制限も明示されている。
triage.notes: 2026年6月25日時点で確認症例1,155件、死亡304人、回復138人、隔離・入院中326人。イツリ州がエピセンター。Bundibugyo株によるエボラで、ワクチンや特定治療法がまだ承認されていない。政府による21日間の積極的監視と渡航制限措置が実施されている。

article.articleHeadline: Tư vấn sức khỏe: Phòng ngừa bệnh lý viêm não, viêm màng não trong mùa hè
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health Advice: Preventing Encephalitis and Meningitis During the Summer.
article.articleSummary: Summer elevates the risk of encephalitis and meningitis in Vietnam, with recent deaths from Japanese encephalitis and meningococcal meningitis; illnesses such as influenza and pneumococcal disease can also trigger brain infections. To enhance prevention awareness, VNVC Vaccination System will host an online briefing on Friday, June 26, 2026 at 8:00 PM titled 'Japanese Encephalitis, Meningitis, and Brain Diseases in Summer.' The program features MD Le Thi Truc Phuong, Medical Specialist Nguyen Duc Bao Dat, and MD Nguyen Huu Bao Han from Tam Anh General Hospital, Ho Chi Minh City. It will stream on Thanh Nien, vnvc.vn, tamanhhospital.vn and related social media channels. Readers can call hotline 028 7102 6595 or visit vnvc.vn for guidance and vaccination scheduling.

triage.headline_ja: 健康相談：夏季における脳炎と髄膜炎の予防
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムにおける日本脳炎と髄膜菌性髄膜炎による最近の死亡例が言及されており、スクリーニング基準（重症度、流行しやすさ）に該当する可能性があるが、記事は主に予防啓発・教育的コンテンツであり、実際の流行規模や具体的な症例数が不明である。続報で流行状況の詳細が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は予防啓発イベントの告知が主体であり、流行規模、確定症例数、死亡数の具体値が不明。『最近の死亡例』の記述から重症度の基準に該当するが、詳細情報の確保後のフル評価が必要。日本脳炎、髄膜菌性髄膜炎、不明性脳炎、インフルエンザが複数併記されており、実際の優先度の特定が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Bất ngờ phát hiện mắc cùng lúc 4 bệnh
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Unexpectedly diagnosed with four diseases at the same time
article.articleSummary: In Ho Chi Minh City, a 36-year-old man presented with two months of cough, night sweats, and ~6 kg weight loss. CT showed bilateral cavitary and consolidative lesions with a tree-in-bud pattern in the right lung and left upper lobe, indicating active pulmonary tuberculosis with necrotizing pneumonia. Laboratory tests revealed type 2 diabetes with HbA1c 11.9% and fasting glucose >370 mg/dL, requiring insulin, plus high hepatitis B viral load and dyslipidemia. He has a long smoking history and regular alcohol use. Management includes standard anti-TB therapy, hepatitis B treatment, antibiotics for pneumonia, and strict glycemic control. After ~2 weeks, cough and fever resolved and respiratory status improved; discharge planning includes outpatient TB therapy for 6–12 months. Clinicians advise evaluation for persistent cough, weight loss, night sweats, and routine annual screening, especially for smokers and heavy drinkers.

triage.headline_ja: 4つの病気に同時に罹患していることが判明
triage.triage_reason: 個人の複数疾患併発事例であり、新規の公衆衛生上の危機や異常な集団発生を示していない。結核とB型肝炎は既知の地域流行疾患であり、単一症例報告は国際的な拡大リスクや渡航制限のリスクを示さない。
triage.notes: ホーチミン市での単一症例（36歳男性）の臨床報告。結核、B型肝炎、2型糖尿病、脂質異常症の併発であるが、集団発生の兆候がなく、地域流行の拡大を示すものではない。医学的には興味深い症例ですが、感染症危機管理の観点からはシグナルを構成しない。

article.articleHeadline: Oruam é diagnosticado com tuberculose, 'estado gravíssimo'
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Oruam is diagnosed with tuberculosis, in critical condition.
article.articleSummary: Pulmonary tuberculosis has been diagnosed in Brazilian rapper Mauro Davi dos Santos Nepomuceno, aka Oruam, in Rio de Janeiro. As of 26 June 2026, he exhibits lung lesions, a persistent cough, and a roughly 5 kg weight loss in the past month, with sarcopenia. His defense argues the health condition is gravíssimo and renewed efforts to overturn preventive detention. Judge Tula Corrêa de Mello rejected the request, noting he remains at large since the arrest warrant was issued, over 130 days ago. The judge ordered an official medical evaluation if located or surrendering to assess disease extent and feasible treatment options. Oruam is accused of attempted homicide against two civil police officers during a July 2025 operation in Rio; he has not appeared in court since February this year.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルのラッパー、オルアムが肺結核と診断され重篤な状態にある
triage.triage_reason: 個人症例報告であり、公衆衛生上の流行を示唆するものではない。報告対象国（ブラジル）内での異常事象ではあるが、IHR基準およびWPRO基準における集団的健康リスクの証拠が不十分。
triage.notes: 本件はブラジルのセレブリティ（ラッパー）の個人的な結核診断であり、刑事司法手続とも関連した報道。記事の主旨は医療上の個別事例報告であって、地域的流行やアウトブレイクを示唆していない。結核は公衆衛生上重要な疾病であるが、単一症例の報告は国内保健当局の対応を除き、IHRまたはWPRO基準の閾値を満たさない。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue control: How a naturally occurring bacteria can transform Asia's response | Daily FT
article.articleSummary: Dengue control through Wolbachia offers a self-sustaining, regional solution to a disease endemic in Asia-Pacific, Latin America, and Africa, with dengue cases rising from 2000–2024 to 14.6 million and an estimated 100–400 million infections annually by WHO; global health costs exceed $8.9 billion. In Asia, dengue remains highly endemic, including India and Indonesia, with Pacific outbreaks in Samoa, Fiji, Kiribati, and New Caledonia reporting no outbreaks since 2019. Wolbachia-infected Aedes aegypti reduce transmission; two deployment paths exist. Replacement releases both sexes to spread bacteria; suppression releases only males to reduce populations. Trials show substantial impact: Yogyakarta 77% reduction; Malaysia 62%; Australia 96%; Brazil/Colombia 63–97%; Singapore 70% dengue risk reduction and 80–90% fewer mosquitoes. Pacific pilots include Vanuatu, Fiji, Kiribati; Lao PDR aims nationwide by 2028; costs per capita range roughly $4–$15. Ownership, supply, and community engagement are critical for sustained financing and scale.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱対策：天然バクテリアがアジアの対応をどのように変革できるか | Daily FT
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の流行が大規模であり、アジア太平洋地域全体で風土病として蔓延している。Wolbachia技術による介入により、インドネシア（ヨグジャカルタ）での77％の減少など顕著な効果が報告されており、国際的な公衆衛生上の重要な取り組みを示唆している。
triage.notes: 記事はWolbachia技術によるデング熱対策の革新的アプローチに焦点を当てている。発生地域リストに多数の国が含まれているが、記事サマリーで具体的に言及されている対象国はインドネシア、インド、中国である。特にヨグジャカルタ（インドネシア）での試験結果（77%削減）と、2000-2024年の感染者数の急増（1460万件、WHO推定年間1億～4億件）が報告されており、公衆衛生上の重大性が確認される。パシフィック地域の試験（サモア、フィジー、キリバス、バヌアツ）も言及されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: 記取醫院登革熱群聚教訓
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Lessons from the hospital dengue fever cluster outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever cluster at Kaohsiung Municipal Minsheng Hospital, Taiwan, with local hospital-acquired transmission. An imported dengue case from Vietnam, while hospitalized, was bitten by vector mosquitoes and infected six neighboring inpatients, marking Taiwan’s first nosocomial dengue case. The CDC quickly deployed a mobile anti-epidemic team to assist Kaohsiung City in containment; at the time, no wider spread was detected. An investigation found multiple vector breeding sources in roof drainage gutters on the affected floor, indicating the hospital did not consistently clear mosquito habitats. The incident recalls an eight-year-ago workplace cluster at a central Taiwan hospital where landscape-pond water containers also yielded vector larvae. Authorities urge thorough environmental cleanups to eliminate breeding sites, even in areas deemed safe, to prevent dengue transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 病院の登革熱集団発生から得た教訓
triage.triage_reason: 台湾高雄で初の院内感染登革熱クラスターが発生し、ベトナムからの輸入症例が媒介蚊を介して6名の入院患者を感染させた。異常性、重症度、管理の複雑さが認められ、IHR基準2つ以上該当およびWPRO基準複数該当するとともに、当局の迅速対応と国際関心があるため、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIがVietnamを含める理由は輸入症例の由来地と思われるが、記事サマリーの主題はTaiwan高雄での院内クラスターであり、Vietnamでの発生報告ではないため、verified_locationsはTaiwanのみとした。ただしTaiwanは対象国リストに含まれていないため、本来は検証不可能な位置づけだが、リージョナルな重要性から記録した。

article.articleHeadline: Власти ДР Конго подтвердили свыше 300 летальных исходов после заболевания Эболой - Новости на Вести.ru
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Authorities in the Democratic Republic of the Congo confirmed over 300 deaths after contracting Ebola - News on Vesti.ru.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 1,155 confirmed cases and 304 deaths as of 26 June 2026, according to a daily bulletin from the Ministry of Communications and Media Affairs. The death toll rose by 13 in the past 24 hours, while cases increased by 37 from the previous day, yielding a case fatality rate of 26.3%. On 22 June, figures stood at 1,003 cases and 254 deaths (CFR ~25.3%). The bulletin presents cumulative counts and fatality rate; it does not specify infection sources, laboratory confirmation details, or imported/exported cases in this excerpt. The outbreak continues to be monitored and addressed by health authorities in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国当局、エボラ熱感染による300人以上の死亡を確認
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な高い致死率、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限の可能性）。エボラ出血熱は最優先監視対象疾患であり、300人以上の死亡と26.3%の高い致死率は即座のRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス感染症は国際保健規則(IHR2005)附表2における常時通知対象疾患。1,155確認症例、304死亡、26.3%の致死率は深刻な流行状況を示す。過去24時間で13人の死亡増加。DRCは地域内での公衆衛生対応能力の課題があり、国際支援の必要性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Επιδημία Έμπολα στη ΛΔ Κονγκό: 1.155 επιβεβαιωμένα κρούσματα, 304 θάνατοι
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola epidemic in DR Congo: 1,155 confirmed cases, 304 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DR Congo) reaches 1,155 laboratory-confirmed cases and 304 deaths. In the past 24 hours, health authorities confirmed 37 new cases and 5 new deaths. Declared on May 15, this outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo lineage, a rarer strain for which there is no specific treatment or vaccine, unlike earlier Zaire-strain episodes for which a vaccine exists. The increase in transmission is being documented amid improved epidemiological surveillance. DR Congo, a country of about 100 million people, records this as its 17th Ebola outbreak. The World Health Organization notes a fatality range of 25%–90% for Ebola. Authorities suspect the virus circulating undetected for some time before the outbreak was declared. The article cites historical context: the deadliest Congo outbreak (2018–2020) caused about 2,300 deaths out of 3,500 cases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行: 確認症例1,155件、死亡304人
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、異常・予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。Bundibugyo系統という稀な株による大規模流行で、有効なワクチン・治療法の不在が懸念される。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo系統のエボラウイルスによる大規模流行。Zaire系統と異なり、既知のワクチンが無効である点が特に懸念される。過去の2018-2020年コンゴ流行との比較により、潜在的な進展リスクが高い。WHO基準での致死率25-90%の高リスク。国民約1億人を抱えるDRC における17番目のエボラ流行。

article.articleHeadline: ΛΔ Κονγκό: Στους 304 οι θάνατοι από τον Έμπολα
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo: Ebola death toll reaches 304.
article.articleSummary: As of June 26, 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo reports 1,155 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases and 304 deaths. In the last 24 hours, authorities confirmed 37 new cases and 5 more fatalities. Health officials say improved epidemiological surveillance enabled earlier detection and confirm a continuing weekly rise in transmission. The current outbreak, declared May 15, is due to the Bundibugyo strain, a rarer form for which there is no specific treatment or vaccine. The virus appears to have circulated for some time before the outbreak was officially declared. Ebola has killed at least 15,000 people in Africa over five decades, with case fatality rates ranging from 25% to 90% per WHO. In DR Congo, the most deadly outbreak killed about 2,300 of 3,500 cases between 2018–2020.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：エボラウイルスの死亡者が304人に達する
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準において4項目すべてに該当。深刻な公衆衛生影響（304人死亡、1,155確定症例）、予想外の流行（Bundibugyo株、治療法なし）、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクが認識される。
triage.notes: コンゴ民主共和国におけるエボラ出血熱の進行中の大規模アウトブレイク。Bundibugyo株は治療法やワクチンがない希少型で、症例・死亡数が急速に増加中（直近24時間で37新規症例、5死亡）。公衆衛生的脅威は極めて高い。フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Oms, basso il rischio globale di epidemia da Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: low global risk of an Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: First confirmed Ebola case identified in France, imported from the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) by a physician collaborating with ALIMA; patient boarded a flight from Kinshasa, nearly asymptomatic aside from headache. Symptoms worsened during transit; upon arrival in Paris he was immediately isolated and treated. Condition is now stable with very low viral load; contact tracing is underway. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned against panic, noting global risk remains low, but the case highlights frontline exposure risks. In the DRC, the 17th Ebola outbreak was declared on May 15 in Ituri province amid armed conflict; official data report over 1,000 cases and 267 deaths (about 25% case fatality). WHO assesses public-health risk as very high in DRC, high in Uganda and neighboring countries, and low globally, urging safe deployment and evacuation planning where needed. No panic, but vigilance is essential.

triage.headline_ja: WHO：エボラ感染症のパンデミックの世界的リスクは低い
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。フランスでの初の確認症例、DRCからの輸入症例であり、国際的な懸念を示す事象。フルRRAに進める必要あり。
triage.notes: フランスでの症例は対象国外のため verified_locations に含めず。DRCでの流行は対象国リストに含まれるため記載。ウガンダも影響を受けているが、記事の主題はDRCの流行と輸出症例であるため、DRCのみを verified_locations に列挙。WHO による評価では全球的リスクは低いとされているが、医療従事者の曝露リスク、国際的な移動に伴う拡大可能性、DRCにおける高い致死率（25%）が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: संक्रामक रोग इन दो गंभीर बीमारियों का बढ़ा सकते हैं खतरा
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Infectious diseases can increase the risk of these two serious illnesses.
article.articleSummary: New Delhi — A Bonn University study published in Nature Communications suggests that certain infectious agents may increase the risk of neurodegenerative diseases, notably Alzheimer's and Parkinson's. Based on laboratory experiments, the work shows that infectious molecular entities can facilitate intercellular spread of misfolded protein aggregates, a hallmark of brain diseases. The researchers draw a parallel with Alzheimer’s and Parkinson’s, where irregular protein sequences arise, highlighting prion-type proteins capable of converting normal brain proteins into abnormal conformations. Neurodegenerative diseases occur in humans and animals. The findings illustrate a potential mechanism by which infections could influence disease progression via prion-like spread of protein aggregates, as observed in controlled lab settings.

triage.headline_ja: 感染症がこれら2つの重篤な疾患のリスクを増加させる可能性がある
triage.triage_reason: 記事の主題は感染症と神経変性疾患（アルツハイマー病・パーキンソン病）の関連性に関する基礎研究であり、実際のBSE感染症アウトブレイクの報告ではない。IHR基準およびWPRO基準のいずれにも該当しない。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域にはドイツとインドが含まれるが、記事サマリーは基礎研究論文（Bonn University発表）の紹介であり、実際のBSE感染症の発生を報告するものではない。記事は理論的メカニズムに関する論文紹介であるため、シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Sespa reforça estratégias de prevenção e combate às arboviroses durante oficina integrada em Santarém
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sespa reinforces prevention and control strategies for arboviral diseases during integrated workshop in Santarém.
article.articleSummary: Integrated Arboviruses Workshop held in Santarém, Pará (June 23–25, 2026) gathered health professionals from the 9th Regional Health Center area, promoted by Sespa. The objective was to strengthen surveillance, prevention, and response to arboviruses—dengue, Zika, and chikungunya—by integrating entomology, epidemiology, and vector control. Key topics included vector monitoring with entomological indicators, epidemiological data analysis, risk stratification, field action planning, and social mobilization, plus building a network of municipalities to develop integrated action plans tailored to local realities. Adriana Tapajós, Sespa Director of Endemic Disease Control, highlighted that cross-sector coordination enables faster, more effective responses to rising case numbers and outbreak risk by aligning entomological and epidemiological information for vector-control planning. The workshop included DCE/Sespa leadership, state arboviruses and entomology coordinations, UBV, Health Ministry technical support, and 9º CRS staff.

triage.headline_ja: セスパがサンタレンでの統合ワークショップ中に虫媒介ウイルス感染症の予防・対策戦略を強化
triage.triage_reason: ジカ熱を含む虫媒介ウイルス感染症の予防・対策に関する公式ワークショップの開催報告。現在の流行状況や新規症例数についての具体的情報がなく、詳細なリスク評価には追加情報が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はワークショップ開催の報告であり、新規発生や流行状況の報告ではない。ブラジルはアマゾン地域でのジカ熱の既知の流行地域。継続的な虫媒介ウイルス対策の重要性が強調されているが、差し迫った新しいリスク信号は含まれていない。スクリーニング基準2項目（prolonged_exposure、epidemic_prone）該当だが、記事の性質上、続報を注視する段階の評価。

article.articleHeadline: El número de muertos por ébola en la RDC supera los 300
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola death toll in the DRC surpasses 300.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: confirmed Ebola cases have risen to 1,155 with 304 deaths, as of Wednesday, June 24, 2026. A Reuters report notes 37 new infections and 5 new deaths in the previous 24 hours. Health authorities say intensified epidemiological and biological surveillance has enabled earlier detection, but community transmission continues to rise week over week. The figures reflect confirmed cases through the last Wednesday, underscoring ongoing outbreak dynamics in the affected regions as of the current date. The report provides no new details on infection sources or other measures beyond surveillance improvements, highlighting persistent public health challenges despite enhanced monitoring.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱によるコンゴ民主共和国での死者数が300人を超える
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全てに該当し、エボラ出血熱の大規模流行として国際的な公衆衛生上の重大な影響を示唆。確認例1,155件、死亡者304名の規模と継続的な市中感染により、フルリスク評価へ進める必要がある。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は極めて高い致死率を持つ指定感染症であり、304名の死亡者と週を追うごとに増加する市中感染は、WHOおよび国際社会における最重要警戒対象。記事は2026年6月26日配信だが、統計は6月24日時点。集約的なサーベイランス強化の報告がある一方、流行の本質的な抑制には至っていない点が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Phát hiện 5 mẫu tôm dương tính với ký sinh trùng gây bệnh
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Five shrimp samples test positive for a disease-causing parasite.
article.articleSummary: Five of twenty shrimp samples tested positive for Enterocytozoon hepatopenaei (EHP), an intracellular microsporidian parasite, in Ha Tinh Province, Vietnam, with positives in Thach Khe, Mai Phu, Ky Khang, and Cam Trung. EHP has no specific treatment; antibiotics are ineffective and may slow growth and promote resistance. Transmission occurs both vertically from broodstock to fry and horizontally via pond contact, contaminated water, live feed, and intermediate hosts such as crustaceans and polychaete worms. To limit spread, authorities urge strict health monitoring, minimize water changes in affected ponds, and segregate wastewater. Biosecurity measures include pond cleaning, lime treatment of bottoms, filtering intake water to remove intermediates, and disinfection with chlorine at 15–30 ppm for general water, and 30 ppm for 7 days before discharge in diseased ponds; collect and treat sludge separately. Farmers should use healthy, quarantined broodstock, avoid live feeds of unknown origin, restrict access, disinfect gear, and report abnormal mortality or slow growth around 25 days post-stocking.

triage.headline_ja: エビ5サンプルが病原性寄生虫に陽性反応
triage.triage_reason: 動物疾病（養殖エビの寄生虫感染）であり、人間の感染症イベントではない。公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的拡大リスク、国際渡航・貿易制限リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 本イベントは養殖エビ（Enterocytozoon hepatopenaei；EHP感染）の動物疾病であり、人間の感染症ではない。Bluedot APIの影響カテゴリが「animals」「environment」であることからも確認できる。IHR対象外。verified_locationsは空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: Deteksi dini, perisai perangi tuberkulosis (bagian 1)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Early detection, a shield in the fight against tuberculosis (Part 1)
article.articleSummary: Tuberculosis can affect anyone, with the piece highlighting early detection and prolonged treatment as key defenses. Survivors of lymph node TB (tuberculous lymphadenitis) and intestinal TB share successful experiences, emphasizing prompt diagnosis and months-long therapy and reinforcing the critical need for early screening and strict adherence to prescribed medications. The article, Part 1 of a series, portrays early detection as a protective shield against TB progression and transmission. It underscores the lengthy treatment, the discipline required to take medicines daily until completion, and the importance of recognizing symptoms early to seek care promptly.

triage.headline_ja: 早期発見、結核との戦いの盾（第1部）
triage.triage_reason: 結核の一般的な予防啓発記事であり、新たな感染症イベント・異常事態を報告するものではない。IHR基準およびWPRO基準のいずれも該当せず、緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 本記事はインドネシアからの配信であるが、内容は既知の結核患者の治療体験談や一般向け啓発であり、新規の流行事例、異常な発生パターン、または公衆衛生上の危機を示す具体的なデータを含まない。定期的な保健医療報道であると判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à RDC: à Bunia, les mesures pour lutter contre l'épidémie pèsent sur les commerçants
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: In Bunia, measures to combat the outbreak weigh on merchants.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak containment measures in Bunia, Democratic Republic of the Congo, are crippling local commerce. Bunia airport has been closed for weeks and neighboring Uganda has suspended cross-border trade and closed its frontier, halting the region’s main supply corridor. Markets show heavy disruption: stalls emptied, auto-parts stock depleted, and prices rising for goods routed through Uganda. Merchants report sharp revenue declines—one spice seller from about 200,000 to 50,000 Congolese francs daily—and fear that markets are perceived as Ebola risk, reducing foot traffic and deterring travelers and expatriates. Authorities promise a forthcoming reopening of Bunia airport, while cross-border exchanges with Uganda wait on Kampala’s decision. The measures aim to contain Ebola but weigh on the local economy, with ongoing trade disruptions and uncertainty for merchants as the outbreak persists.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ：ブニアでは、流行に対抗するための措置が商人に重くのしかかっている
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の発生であり、IHR基準で4項目全てに該当する可能性が高く、国際的影響が明白。また、WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数項目に該当し、国境を越えた対応が必要な状況。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはウガンダ（Kampala、Republic of Uganda）も含まれているが、記事サマリーでウガンダは主に国境封鎖を実施した対応国として記載されており、エボラの実際の発生地はDRCのブニアと明記されている。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には DRC のみを列挙。DRC内の複数の地点（Bunia, Kampala）が記載されているが、これらはいずれも DRC (203312) に包含される。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Alarm der WHO - warum es keine Impfung gibt und was Sie sonst noch wissen sollten
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Ebola alert: why there is no vaccine and what else you should know.
article.articleSummary: DRC's Kongo-Kinshasa and neighboring Uganda report an Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo virus. WHO confirmed the outbreak in May and has declared an international health emergency. More than 1,000 confirmed or suspected cases and over 250 deaths, with cases quadrupling in ten days. Bundibugyo virus has a case-fatality of around 30%, lower than Zaire ebolavirus (~66%). Other subtypes include Sudan and Taï Forest; Reston and Bombali have only been found in animals. Early symptoms include fever, malaise and muscle pain, progressing to abdominal pain, vomiting, diarrhea, bleeding, and organ failure. Transmission is via direct contact with body fluids or contaminated objects; semen can harbour the virus after recovery. Prevention relies on full PPE and hygiene. There is a vaccine for other Ebola subtypes but not Bundibugyo; no specific antivirals exist.

triage.headline_ja: WHO エボラ警報 - なぜワクチンがないのか、そしてあなたが他に知るべきこと
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョウイルス）の大規模アウトブレイク、1,000件以上の確認・疑い例、250人以上の死亡、10日で症例数が4倍増加。WHOが国際保健上の緊急事態を宣言。
triage.notes: ウガンダは記事サマリーで言及されていますが、実際の発生地はコンゴ民主共和国の Kongo-Kinshasa であり、ウガンダとの地理的近接性は述べられていますが主要な発生地ではありません。対象国リストにはDRCのみが含まれるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとします。ブンディブギョウイルスによるエボラアウトブレイク、ワクチンなし、WHO国際保健上の緊急事態宣言、高い死亡率という点で重大なシグナルです。

article.articleHeadline: El avance del ébola en África amenaza con llegar a Sudán del Sur
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Spread of Ebola in Africa Threatens to Reach South Sudan.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 1,000 cases in under three months, with 1,048 confirmed and 267 deaths by June 22. The virus has crossed into Uganda, reporting 20 cases and 2 deaths, including health workers; Uganda's response leverages prior outbreak experience, with isolation, contact tracing, and safe burials, as this strain causes severe hemorrhagic fever and has no vaccine. South Sudan is the main international concern, with Lancet Infectious Diseases models predicting a 69.3% chance of at least one case within 12 weeks. Projections range from 990 cases and 174 deaths by late June to 8,210 cases by September if transmission continues; worst-case >66,000 cases and 10,000 deaths if controls relax. Rwanda 8.6% and Burundi 2% risk exporters. France reports an imported case in a clinician who treated RDC patients; general population risk remains low.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカのエボラ出血熱の拡大がスーダン南部への到達を脅かしている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。コンゴ民主共和国で3ヶ月以内に1,000例を超えるブンディブギョエボラウイルス感染症が発生し、ウガンダへの越境感染（20例、2死亡）、フランスへの輸入症例が報告されており、スーダン南部への拡大リスクが高い。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョエボラウイルスはコンゴ民主共和国で発生しており、ウガンダ、ルワンダ、ブルンジ、スーダン南部への拡大リスクが高い。ワクチンが存在しない株で、数学的モデルではスーダン南部への12週間以内の症例出現確率は69.3%と推定されている。フランスの輸入症例は医療従事者で、一般人口への直接的なリスクは低い。対象国リストに基づき、実際の発生国はDRCのみが該当する。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à RDC: à Bunia, les mesures pour lutter contre l'épidémie pèsent sur les commerçants
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: in Bunia, the measures to combat the outbreak weigh on merchants.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Bunia, Democratic Republic of Congo, prompts market restrictions that dampen commerce as authorities plan a reopening. At Bunia's central market, traders report thinner stalls as border and transportation limits bite. Auto-parts dealer Paluku Kanzira says customers heading to Kinshasa are gone since the airport closure; goods moving through Uganda face higher costs, and stock of tires is depleted. Spice seller Henriette Kikuti notes revenue dropping from around 200,000 Congolese francs per day to about 50,000. Another merchant, Sifa, says daily takings have fallen from 500,000-1,000,000 francs to much less, with fewer tourists and expatriates returning to buy. Market fears persist that crowded spaces could spread Ebola, deterring shoppers. Congolese authorities indicate the Bunia airport will reopen soon, while cross-border exchanges with Uganda remain on hold pending Kampala's decision.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ：ブニアでの流行対策がトレーダーに重くのしかかる
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）、またWPRO基準で複数項目該当。DRC内でのエボラウイルス感染症の確認報告であり、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱はIHR(2005)の通知対象疾患。記事サマリーではブニア（DRC内）での流行が確認され、ウガンダとの国境制限、航空便閉鎖、市場規制など複数の公衆衛生対応が実施されている。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。社会経済的影響も記述されており、当局による対応が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Число жертв вспышки Эболы в ДР Конго превысило 300
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The death toll from the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has exceeded 300.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has 1,155 confirmed cases and 304 deaths as of 26 June 2026 (case fatality 26.3%). Currently, 326 patients are hospitalized or in medical isolation, with 79.2% contact tracing coverage and 138 recoveries discharged. The outbreak began on 15 May in eastern DRC, with the epicenter in Ituri Province. Cases and deaths have also been reported in neighboring Uganda, indicating cross-border transmission.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱の死者数が300人を超えた
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。エボラ出血熱は国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、隣国ウガンダへの越境感染が既に確認されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC（Ituri州を中心とした東部）での発生が主題であり、ウガンダへの越境感染も記載されている。ただし対象国リストにウガンダが含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。エボラは最重要病原体で、326名の入院患者、79.2%の接触者追跡カバレッジなど、継続的な医療管理が必要な状況が明確に示されている。

article.articleHeadline: Врач Чернышова сказала, как защититься от смертельного мелиоидоза
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dr. Chernysheva said how to protect yourself from deadly melioidosis.
article.articleSummary: Imported melioidosis case in Russia: a Russian woman who returned from Thailand is hospitalized in serious condition with melioidosis. In an exclusive interview, Dr. Nadezhda Chernysheva explains that the infection can be latent or present with minimal symptoms in healthy people. Major risk factors include diabetes, alcoholism, immunodeficiencies (including HIV), and kidney disease. Transmission is not person-to-person and not via contact with animals; infection occurs through soil and environmental exposure, such as visits to outdoor sites during travel (the patient toured various excursions in Thailand, including an elephant farm). Diagnosis can be challenging because symptoms resemble other infections. Russian authorities use diagnostic test systems by Rospotrebnadzor, and the border-control Perimeter system analyzes epidemiological risks online. Treatment is lengthy and intensive: 2–3 weeks of injections followed by 3–6 months of oral antibiotics. This is an imported case in Russia; no evidence of local transmission as of 26 June 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 医師チェルニシェワ氏が、致命的なメリオイドーシスから身を守る方法を説明
triage.triage_reason: 輸入症例であるが、致死性の高い新興感染症（メリオイドーシス）がロシアで初めて確認された可能性のある異常・予想外の事象。タイでの環境曝露が確認され、国際的に拡大するリスクがあり、診断の困難さと長期治療の必要性から対応管理の課題がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーが明確にタイでの環境曝露（象の農場訪問を含む各種野外サイト訪問）を確認症例の感染源として述べている。ロシアの患者はタイから帰国後に入院し、ロシア内での局所伝播の証拠はないとされているが、メリオイドーシスは土壌由来の環境感染であり、タイは疫学的な発生地点として verified_locations に含める。

article.articleHeadline: Deteksi dini, perisai perangi tuberkulosis (bagian 2)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Early Detection, a Shield to Fight Tuberculosis (Part 2)
article.articleSummary: TB is preventable and curable, yet more than 10 million people develop TB annually and over 1 million die globally. Among the eight countries with the highest TB burden, Indonesia ranks second after India, followed by the Philippines, China, Pakistan, Nigeria, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, and Bangladesh. The eight provinces with the highest TB caseload are DKI Jakarta, Banten, West Java, Central Java, East Java, North Sumatra, South Sulawesi, and East Nusa Tenggara. Stigma hampers early detection, complicating timely treatment. Early detection serves as a shield against TB. In Makassar, South Sulawesi, Ballaparang Community Health Center runs an early-detection and outreach program called Hantu Mesra (Hunting Tuberculosis) with door‑to‑door visits, through which TB-positive patients are detected and supported to begin treatment.

triage.headline_ja: 早期検診、結核撲滅の盾（第2部）
triage.triage_reason: 結核は既知の疾患で、記事は主に公衆衛生対策と早期検診プログラムの紹介。新規の異常なイベントや重症度の急激な変化は示唆されていない。ただしインドネシアが結核高負担国第2位として言及されており、継続的な監視が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事は既知の結核流行状況と地域的な対策プログラムの報道であり、新規の感染症シグナルとは判定しない。ただしインドネシアの高い結核負担状況と複数州での多数事例、社会的スティグマによる検診遅延は公衆衛生上の持続的課題。パキスタン、ナイジェリア、DRCはサマリー中に高負担国として言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations に入れていない。

article.articleHeadline: وفاة أكثر من 300 شخص بالإيبولا في جمهورية الكونغو الديمقراطية مع تشديد إجراءات مكافحة انتشاره
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 300 people have died from Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo as measures to curb its spread are tightened.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo's Ebola outbreak has surpassed 300 deaths as measures to curb spread tighten. As of June 25, 2026, the government reports 1,155 confirmed infections and 304 deaths, with 138 recovered and 326 currently undergoing treatment or isolation, centered in Ituri Province with Kinshasa reporting the numbers. A French doctor involved in response efforts contracted Ebola in Ituri. Authorities have imposed strict travel restrictions for returnees from affected areas. A ministerial decree requires 21-day strict quarantine for health workers, laboratory staff, and response teams returning from Ebola-affected zones, with mandatory travel bans both domestically and internationally during the period. Additionally, anyone previously residing in affected provinces cannot travel abroad for 21 days; international travelers must complete a health declaration form verified by airlines. The outbreak, announced mid-May, is linked to the Bundibugyo Ebola virus lineage, for which there is no licensed vaccine or specific treatment yet.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラにより300人以上が死亡、感染拡大防止措置が強化される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響：300人超の死亡、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限）。WPROスクリーニング基準も5つ全て該当。緊急対応が必要な国際的保健危機。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo Ebola virus系統であり、ワクチンおよび特異的治療法が未承認。フランス人医師を含む対応要員への感染も報告。国際的な支援要請が必要な状況。2026年6月25日時点で確定感染1,155例、死亡304例、回復138例、治療中326例。Ituri州を中心にKinshasa市でも報告。

article.articleHeadline: Pemkab Bengkayang percepat eliminasi TB lewat pelacakan kasus aktif
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bengkayang Regency Government Accelerates Tuberculosis Elimination Through Active Case Finding.
article.articleSummary: TB in Bengkayang Regency, Indonesia, is targeted for elimination by 2030 through active case finding and complete treatment. Rosalina Nungkat, Head of the Bengkayang Health, Population Control and Family Planning Office, emphasizes TB remains a priority due to impacts on health and livelihoods. Challenges include undetected and unreported cases, limited public awareness of TB symptoms, stigma, and insufficient treatment adherence. Household and close-contact tracing require strengthening to break transmission chains. In response, authorities will bolster TB services at all health centers and hospitals, expand case finding via contact investigations, improve digital recording and reporting, and broaden community health education. Bupati Sebastianus Darwis calls for a collective push, noting proactive case finding is essential and treatment completion prevents further spread and drug resistance. Community involvement—from families to PKK, religious and village leaders—will support patients throughout therapy.

triage.headline_ja: ベンカヤン県政府、能動的患者探索を通じた結核排除の加速
triage.triage_reason: 結核は既知の風土病であり、記事は地方自治体の2030年排除目標と対策強化に関する行政上のニュースである。異常な発生、重症度の急増、国際的拡大リスク、または管理不可能性の証拠がない。
triage.notes: 記事は既知の風土病（結核）における既存の対策強化と2030年排除目標の進捗報告である。新規の異常な発生事象ではなく、地方自治体レベルの行政プログラムニュースとして分類される。WPRO基準の「長期曝露」は該当するが、他の懸念基準は満たされず、シグナルとしてのピックアップ基準には達しない。

article.articleHeadline: السعودية تعلق السفر والدخول للقادمين من ثلاث إفريقية بسبب فيروس إيبولا - اليوم 24
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Saudi Arabia suspends travel and entry for arrivals from three African countries due to the Ebola virus - Today 24
article.articleSummary: Saudi Arabia imposes travel and entry suspensions for arrivals from the Republic of the Congo (Brazzaville), Uganda, and South Sudan due to Ebola virus concerns. Measures, extended from actions since July 2019 and tightened in May, include banning travel by Saudi citizens to these countries, halting all visa issuance, and prohibiting entry for anyone who has resided in these countries in the prior 21 days, even if arriving via other routes. The public health authority Weqaya reports enhanced screening and surveillance at entry points for travelers from neighboring outbreak zones such as Rwanda, Burundi, Tanzania, and Congo (Brazzaville). Authorities state no confirmed or suspected Ebola cases have been reported in Saudi Arabia since these procedures began, describing the move as precautionary with ongoing regional and global monitoring.

triage.headline_ja: サウジアラビア、エボラウイルスを理由に3つのアフリカ諸国からの到着者の渡航と入国を一時停止
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で異常/予想外性と国際的拡大リスクに該当（2つ以上）。エボラウイルスは国際通知対象疾患であり、複数アフリカ国での発生と国際的な渡航制限措置が報告されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは、サウジアラビアがコンゴ（ブラザビル）、ウガンダ、南スーダンからの入国を制限していると述べている。対象国リスト内ではDRC（民主コンゴ）のみが確認される感染症イベント発生地として該当。他のアフリカ国（スーダン、ルワンダ、ブルンジ、タンザニア、ウガンダ）は発生地域フィールドに含まれるが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。エボラウイルスは極度に危険な病原体であり、複数国での発生と国際的渡航制限の実施により、IHR基準4つすべてに該当。

article.articleHeadline: Deteksi dini, perisai perangi tuberkulosis (bagian 3)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Early detection: a shield to fight tuberculosis (Part 3)
article.articleSummary: Jakarta's Kampung Siaga TB program, launched by the provincial government in 2024, employs a territorial-based approach to TB elimination. Targeting residents at the neighborhood RW level, it empowers communities to prevent, detect, and manage tuberculosis cases actively within their surroundings. The initiative introduces data and case-finding innovations, notably TB Online Screening (TOS) for all residents with a cough lasting two weeks, followed by the Pojok Dahak (Sputum Corner) innovation in Jakarta. Community cadres are integral frontline players who directly engage with residents to support screening, reporting, and linkage to care. This effort emphasizes early detection as a shield against TB, leveraging local participation to strengthen TB surveillance and response across Jakarta.

triage.headline_ja: 早期発見、結核との戦いの盾（第3部）
triage.triage_reason: 結核は既知の慢性感染症であり、記事はジャカルタの公開衛生プログラム紹介であり新規アウトブレイクではない。IHR基準およびWPRO基準のいずれも該当せず、社会的関心も限定的。
triage.notes: この記事は結核の既知の流行に対するインドネシア政府の地域保健プログラム（Kampung Siaga TB）の取り組みを報告する教育的コンテンツであり、新規のアウトブレイク信号、異常な症例増加、または国際的なリスク上昇を示唆するものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Bhiwandi Civic Body Gives Food Businesses 8-Day Deadline To Submit Licences After Food Poisoning Incident
article.articleSummary: Bhiwandi, Maharashtra: BNCMC orders an eight-day deadline for all food business operators to submit valid licences after a food poisoning incident in which nearly 100 people fell ill and required hospitalization, linked to the Famous Shawarma outlet. Authorities note many establishments operate without mandatory licences or renewals, launching a special enforcement drive to enforce food safety and licensing norms. Within eight days, operators must provide FSSAI registration/licence, Municipal Trade Licence, Shops and Establishments Registration, Fire Department NOC (where applicable), Health Department permission, GST Registration (where applicable), and any other licences prescribed by state or municipal authorities. Section 381(B) of the Maharashtra Municipal Corporation Act, 1949 is cited to prohibit sale of edible items without a licence. Inspections will verify compliance; penalties may include fines, suspension/cancellation of licences, sealing, or closure. Aims are to safeguard public health and restore confidence amid wide regulatory scrutiny of hundreds of establishments.

triage.headline_ja: 食中毒事件後、ビワンディ市民団体が食品企業に8日間の営業許可証提出期限を通知
triage.triage_reason: 限定的な食中毒事件（約100人の患者、1食品販売店に関連）であり、現在進行中の局所的な規制対応段階。IHR基準や国際的拡大の証拠がなく、継続監視により事態の進展を確認する必要があるが、現段階ではフルRRA開始の閾値に達していない。
triage.notes: 食中毒は既に特定の食品施設に限定されており、当該施設への規制対応が進行中。患者数（約100人）は限定的で入院患者のみが報告されている。継続曝露の可能性は当該施設の営業許可/閉鎖によって短期間で解決される可能性が高い。今後、患者数の増加や複数施設への拡大が報告される場合はPICKUPへの昇格を検討。

article.articleHeadline: ΛΔ Κονγκό: 304 νεκροί από τον Έμπολα - Συναγερμός για το στέλεχος Μπουντιμπουγκιό
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo: 304 dead from Ebola - Alarm over Bundibugyo strain.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo is battling an Ebola outbreak caused by the Bundibugyo strain. Laboratory-confirmed cases have risen to 1,155, with 304 deaths. As of Wednesday, June 24, 2026, 37 new cases and 5 new deaths were recorded in the last 24 hours. The outbreak, declared May 15, 2026, remains ongoing. The Bundibugyo lineage is less common and currently has no specific treatment or vaccine, unlike Zaire-strain outbreaks where a vaccine exists. DR Congo, a central African nation of about 100 million people, has previously endured the deadliest Ebola outbreak (2018–2020) with roughly 2,300 deaths among ~3,500 cases. Health authorities say improved surveillance enabled earlier detection and confirms a continued weekly rise in transmission. Ebola has caused at least 15,000 deaths in Africa over 50 years, with fatality rates from 25% to 90%.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：エボラで304人死亡 - ブンディブギョ株で警報
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（ブンディブギョ株）によるコンゴ民主共和国での大規模アウトブレイク。IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、治療法・ワクチン不在の新規株で高い死亡率を示しており、国際的な懸念が高い。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ株はザイール株と異なり治療法・ワクチンが存在しないため、管理困難性が高い。1,155の確定症例と304人の死亡数、継続的な週間患者数増加トレンドが報告されており、リスクレベルは極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : le Président Tshisekedi ordonne de renforcer la police dans les foyers épidémiques - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: President Tshisekedi orders police reinforcement in epidemic hotspots - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (Bundibugyo strain) with over 1,100 cases and 277 deaths (case fatality 26%). President Félix Tshisekedi ordered reinforced deployment of the National Police and health workers to epidemic hotspots to regulate movements and intensify controls (temperature checks, hygiene, handwashing). Measures announced after a presidential session with the national Ebola Task Force include a mandatory 21-day observation for contacts and travel restrictions abroad for residents of affected zones. For humanitarian and infrastructure support, the Ministry of Social Affairs was instructed to coordinate aid at displacement sites and accelerate construction of nearby treatment centers. Kinshasa reports no cases in the capital.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：ツシセケディ大統領が流行地域での警察強化を命令 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（重篤な公衆衛生影響1,100人以上の患者・277人の死亡、異常・予想外、国際的拡大リスク、移動制限措置実施）。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当し、高致命率（26%）と大規模流行の管理に政府介入が必要。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株によるエボラウイルス病の流行。患者数1,100人以上、死亡277人（致命率26%）。大統領令による警察・保健人員の配置強化、接触者の21日間観察義務化、移動制限など政府による包括的対応が実施されている。東部での流行状況について継続的な監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: "Θερίζει" ο Έμπολα την ΛΔ Κονγκό: Σε 1.155 τα επιβεβαιωμένα κρούσματα και 304 οι νεκροί
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola ravages the Democratic Republic of the Congo: 1,155 confirmed cases and 304 deaths.
article.articleSummary: 1,155 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases and 304 deaths in the Democratic Republic of the Congo; latest bulletin reports 37 new cases and 5 new deaths within 24 hours. The outbreak, declared May 15, is caused by the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no specific treatment or vaccine, and it is the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC. Health authorities credit improved epidemiological surveillance for earlier case detection and note ongoing weekly transmission increases. The Bundibugyo strain is less common than the Zaïre (Zaire) strain, which has a vaccine, though most past central Africa outbreaks in the DRC were Zaïre. The virus is believed to have circulated undetected for some time before the outbreak declaration. Across Africa, Ebola has killed at least 15,000 over 50 years, with case-fatality rates ranging 25–90%; the 2018–2020 DRC outbreak caused about 3,500 cases and roughly 2,300 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがコンゴ民主共和国を襲う：1,155例の確認症例と304人の死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイク（1,155確認例、304死亡）で、高い致死率と継続的な伝播が確認されている。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病のアウトブレイクとしてはDRC内で17番目。今回のBundibugyo株はZaïre株と異なり、ワクチンがない。24時間以内に37例の新規症例と5例の死亡が報告されており、週単位での感染増加が続いている。過去の同国でのエボラアウトブレイク（2018-2020）と比較してもより詳細な情報が提供されている。WHOへの通知が強く推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: RDCongo.- RDC supera las 300 muertes por ébola con el 95% de camas...
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo surpasses 300 Ebola deaths with 95% bed occupancy.
article.articleSummary: DRC's Ebola outbreak in Ituri Province, centered in Bunia, has surpassed 304 deaths from 1,155 confirmed Ebola virus disease cases. The Africa CDC reports 95% bed occupancy nationwide, highlighting the urgent need to build treatment centers and expand hospital capacity. Trials for two potential therapeutics—MBP134 and remdesivir—are set to begin next week in Bunia, with remdesivir supplies already arriving in the DRC. The current outbreak, caused by the Bundibugyo strain, remains hard to contain due to limited vaccines or strain-specific treatments. Transmission occurs via close contact with infected bodily fluids. In response, the Congolese government has ordered a 21-day travel quarantine for anyone traveling from affected zones to other parts of the country or abroad to curb spread and enable contact tracing.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：エボラ出血熱による死亡者が300人を超え、ベッド占有率95%に達する
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の大規模流行（304人死亡、1,155人確認患者）で公衆衛生への深刻な影響があり、医療施設の収容能力危機、国家規模の旅行制限措置、国際的な治療試験展開が見られる。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo株）による現在進行中の大規模流行。医療従事者の負担急増（ベッド占有率95%）、治療法開発の緊急進展（MBP134、レムデシビルの臨床試験開始予定）、国家的な隔離・接触追跡措置の実施がすべて報告されている。全WPRO基準に該当し、フルRRAが必須。

article.articleHeadline: Ausbruch im Kongo: Schneller Anstieg von Ebola-Fällen besorgt Fachleute
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Outbreak in the Congo: Rapid rise in Ebola cases worries experts.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues to rise, with 1,155 confirmed cases and 304 deaths across Ituri, Nord-Kivu, and Sud-Kivu, notably Ituri in the northeast. In the last 24 hours, 37 new infections and 5 more deaths were reported. Authorities say surveillance is improving but transmission remains ongoing, as bed capacity is already 95% used, prompting calls to expand treatment centers. The outbreak involves Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which there is currently no vaccine or specific therapy. Promising steps include upcoming clinical procedures for medications in Bunia, with the antiviral Remdesivir (from the US and Egypt) arriving as post-exposure prophylaxis and MBP134 expected to arrive; several firms are pursuing vaccine candidates. In response to an infected doctor traveling to France, the DRC tightened travel controls, implementing a 21-day quarantine for travelers from affected provinces to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのアウトブレイク：エボラ症例の急速な増加が専門家を懸念させている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の大規模アウトブレイク（1,155確認例、304死亡）、異常性、国際的な拡大リスク（フランスへの感染者渡航）、渡航制限の実施が明記されている。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはSouth Kivu、Nord-Kivu、Ituri州が含まれ、いずれもDRCの同一地域。米国、フランス、エジプトは医療物資の供給国として言及されているが、アウトブレイク発生地ではないため除外。Bundibugyo ebolavirus（Bundibugyo株）であることが明記されている。感染医師のフランス渡航により国際的拡大のリスクが現実化している。

article.articleHeadline: Ngăn chặn dịch tả heo châu Phi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Preventing African swine fever
article.articleSummary: African swine fever (ASF) outbreaks have surged in Dong Nai City's eastern corridor, Vietnam, with 40 outbreaks and more than 13,500 pigs culled by June 12, 2026. The region's large-scale farms, near neighboring provinces, face elevated transmission risk. A notable case involves a contract farming farm owned by Truong Thi Thao in Tra Co 11, Tan Phu ward, housing 1,942 pigs; by June 16, 2026, 27 died and 355 showed disease signs, including hepatomegaly with hemorrhages, splenomegaly, and renal hemorrhage. Laboratory confirmation from the Central Veterinary Diagnostic and Testing Center No. 2 supported ASF, and the entire 1,942-head herd was culled. With total city pig numbers at 3.99 million by end-May 2026—up 2.4% year-on-year—authorities intensified disinfection (more than 14,400 liters of disinfectant), surveillance, and vaccination campaigns in early 2026. The outbreak is worsened by open housing and the rainy season, and there is no effective ASF vaccine.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ豚コレラの蔓延を防ぐ
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムで大規模なアフリカ豚コレラの多数の発生が確認され、13,500頭以上の豚が殺処分された。動物疾病としての公衆衛生影響、異常性、地域的な感染リスク、および国際的な家畜貿易への影響の可能性が認められる。
triage.notes: 記事はドンナイ市（ベトナムの東部地域）でのアフリカ豚コレラ（ASF）の急速な拡大を報じている。2026年6月12日までに40の発生が報告され、13,500頭以上の豚が殺処分された。大規模農場での感染、実験室による確認、および雨季による悪化がリスク要因として指摘されている。動物疾病ではあるが、食料安全保障および国際的な家畜貿易への影響が大きい。

article.articleHeadline: RDC supera las 300 muertes por ébola con el 95% de camas ocupadas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC surpasses 300 Ebola deaths with 95% of beds occupied.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo has recorded at least 304 Ebola deaths out of 1,155 confirmed cases, amid a 95% occupancy of hospital beds nationwide and rising urgency to expand treatment capacity. Africa CDC Director Jean Kaseya warns the outbreak is not yet at its peak and calls for building treatment centers and boosting hospital capacity as the most affected area Bunia in Ituri Province faces intense transmission. Next week, clinical trials will begin in Bunia for MBP134, an experimental Ebola drug, and remdesivir, an antiviral developed in the United States and Egypt, which has arrived in the DRC. The ongoing Bundibugyo strain lacks a vaccine or specific treatment, complicating containment. The government has imposed a 21-day travel quarantine for movement from affected zones to curb spread and enable contact tracing.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国がエボラで300人以上の死亡者を超過、病床占有率95%
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当し、エボラウイルス病の大規模流行。深刻な公衆衛生影響、高い死亡率（26.3%）、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限措置が既に発令されている。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo strain）の活発な流行。確定症例1,155件、死亡者304人（致死率26.3%）。医療体制が逼迫（病床占有率95%）、ワクチン・特異的治療なし。実験的治療薬（MBP134、レムデシビル）の臨床試験が開始予定。アフリカCDC所長が流行がピークに達していないと警告。コンゴ民主共和国政府が21日間の検疫措置を実施中。

article.articleHeadline: Rat fever cases triple in five years in Kerala; mortality rate hits 6%
article.articleSummary: Leptospirosis (rat fever) in Kerala, India, has become the state's most lethal infectious threat, with 1,455 deaths recorded from 2021 to 2025 and a mortality rate of 6%. Case volumes more than tripled over the period. As of June 23, 2026, Kerala reports 1,531 new cases and 56 deaths in the year to date. The 2018–2019 floods are cited as ecological triggers, with a post-lockdown re-emergence in 2022 followed by annual cases exceeding 5,000. Public health attention remains focused on dengue and localized shigellosis, leaving rat fever under-prioritized. The data come from the directorate of health services. No laboratory confirmation details are provided in the summary. Infection source linked to rodent-borne leptospires in flood-prone settings; no imported/exported case details are given.

triage.headline_ja: ケーララ州でラット熱患者が5年間で3倍に増加、死亡率は6%に達する
triage.triage_reason: レプトスピラ症（ラット熱）がケーララ州で高い死亡率（6%）と急増傾向を示しており、IHR基準で「公衆衛生への影響が深刻」「異常/予想外」の2基準に該当。WPROスクリーニングでは重症度・流行傾向・管理可能性の複数基準が満たされ、シグナルとして識別される。
