triage.notes: ケーララ州での5年間（2021-2025）で1,455死亡、6%の高い死亡率、2026年1月～6月23日で56死亡など、重症感染症の継続的な拡大を示唆。2018-2019年の洪水が生態学的トリガーとされ、2022年以降毎年5,000件超の症例が報告されている。ただし、記事内に国際的な広がりや渡航・貿易への影響に関する具体的な記述がないため、該当基準は限定的。

article.articleHeadline: தமிழகம் முழுவதும் வருகிற 28-ந்தேதி போலியோ சொட்டு மருந்து முகாம்- அரசு அறிவிப்பு
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Government announces polio drops vaccination camps across Tamil Nadu on the 28th.
article.articleSummary: Polio vaccination drive planned across Tamil Nadu on June 28, 2026, with 43,051 vaccination centers operated by the Tamil Nadu Health and Family Welfare Department. The National Polio Drops Campaign will cover government primary health centers, government hospitals, Anganwadi centers, schools, and other key locations, with 52.91 lakh children aged 0-5 to receive polio drops. Even if children have previously received polio drops, they should be re-administered during the camp day. Temporary vaccination sites will be set up at major bus stands, railway stations, customs checkpoints, inspection posts, and airports to expand access. This effort targets nationwide polio eradication and involves a broad network of public health infrastructure across Tamil Nadu to ensure coverage of all eligible children.

triage.headline_ja: タミル・ナードゥ州全域での6月28日ポリオワクチン接種キャンプ - 政府発表
triage.triage_reason: ポリオ根絶を目的とした計画的かつ定期的な予防接種キャンペーンであり、既知の感染症アウトブレイクではない。社会的・政治的懸念も低い。
triage.notes: 本記事はポリオの新規患者報告やアウトブレイクではなく、政府による予防接種キャンペーンの計画発表である。シグナルトリアージの対象外となる通常の公衆衛生活動。

article.articleHeadline: 气候变化叠加厄尔尼诺，警惕气候敏感传染病传播格局变化
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: El Niño superimposed on climate change: beware changes in the transmission patterns of climate-sensitive infectious diseases.
article.articleSummary: Published 2026-06-26: El Niño superimposed on ongoing climate warming is reshaping transmission of climate-sensitive infectious diseases. Dengue fever, driven by Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus, faces expanding suitability northward in China, raising overall mosquito-borne risk; higher temperatures shorten viral incubation in mosquitoes, speed generation turnover, and warmer winters boost overwinter survival, while monsoon rains create breeding sites. Influenza transmission is also climate-driven: lower temperatures and humidity favor aerosol persistence, but warming with higher absolute humidity maintains southern peaks; a critical switching temperature between dry-cold and warm-wet regimes lies around 16.5–19.5°C, pushing influenza activity toward mid-low latitudes, lengthening seasons and blunting seasonality; larger day-to-day temperature swings (>3°C) may impair immunity. Scrub typhus risk expands north of 31°N, especially in summer monsoon fringe areas, as mites and rodent hosts expand. Policy: integrated meteorology-health surveillance, early warnings, and localized vector-control; examples from Tianjin, Guangdong, Yunnan, and other provinces.

triage.headline_ja: 気候変動とエルニーニョの重複：気候に敏感な感染症の伝播パターンの変化に注意
triage.triage_reason: 複数の気候敏感型感染症（デング熱、インフルエンザ、つつが虫病）の伝播パターン変化を警告する分析記事。公衆衛生への潜在的影響は認識されているが、現在の具体的な集団発生や死亡事例の報告がないため、情報補完が必要。
triage.notes: 本記事は気候変動によるリスク警告と政策提言を主とするもので、現在の活発な集団発生報告ではない。ただしWPRO基準で複数該当し、中国内で複数地域（天津、広東、雲南など）での気候敏感感染症のリスク拡大が言及されている。続報で具体的な症例数増加やアウトブレイク報告を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: ആഫ്രിക്കയിൽ എബോള പടരുന്നു: മൂന്ന് രാജ്യങ്ങളിൽ നിന്നുള്ളവർക്ക് സഊദിയിൽ പ്രവേശന വിലക്ക്
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola is spreading in Africa: Saudi Arabia bans entry for people from three countries.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease is spreading in Africa, prompting Saudi Arabia to bar entry for travelers from the Democratic Republic of Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan. The Saudi Public Health Authority temporarily suspended entry visas for anyone who visited or transited these three countries within the prior 21 days and imposed strict health screenings at airports and borders. The country also tightened checks on travelers arriving from Rwanda, Burundi, Tanzania, and the Republic of Congo (Congo-Brazzaville). Saudi authorities note there have been no Ebola cases reported in Saudi Arabia since 2019. Ebola was first identified in 1976 in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with a case fatality around 50% and over 15,000 deaths globally. A French doctor who spent time in DRC has tested positive in France and is under quarantine, highlighting continued risk in Europe.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカでエボラが蔓延：サウジアラビアが3カ国からの入国を禁止
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病はアフリカで複数国に拡大し、国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、サウジアラビアが渡航制限を実施し、フランスでの症例確認により国際拡大リスクが顕在化している。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーによると、エボラ流行は複数のアフリカ諸国（DRC、ウガンダ、南スーダン、ルワンダ、ブルンジ、タンザニア、コンゴ）で報告されているが、対象国リストに該当するのはDRCのみ。フランスでの症例はDRC滞在歴のある医師であり、DRCの感染症が国際的に拡大していることを示している。致死率約50％で全球的に15,000人以上の死亡があり、重大な公衆衛生上の脅威として位置づけられる。

article.articleHeadline: U.S. international aid cuts could hinder Ebola prevention efforts
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-26, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda has surpassed 1,000 infections and 200 deaths, with the World Health Organization declaring a public health emergency of international concern. CDC experts warn the outbreak could rival the worst on record. The discussion frames this against a broader political backdrop: the United States’ withdrawal from WHO, dismantling of USAID, and strict travel restrictions that may hinder response. Dr. Nahid Bhadelia compares this to the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak (over 25,000 cases, about 11,000 deaths) and notes delays in identifying the Bundibugyo strain, partly due to initial testing focusing on the Zaire strain. The DRC’s ongoing conflict and distrust complicate control efforts, and USAID’s removal has weakened surveillance for other diseases like measles and cholera. On-the-ground relationships and trust with local responders remain crucial for early signals and rapid containment.

triage.headline_ja: 米国の国際援助削減がエボラ予防の取り組みを妨げる可能性
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限）。WPRO基準でも重症度・長期曝露・流行性・管理可能性が確認され、シグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: 記事は複数疾患（エボラ、麻しん、コレラ）を言及しているが、主題はDRCにおけるエボラ流行。サマリーではウガンダでの感染も言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため除外。米国は政策的文脈での言及であり、実際の発生地ではないため excluded。1,000感染超、200死亡超という深刻な状況、WHOによる国際的懸念の公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言、米国のWHO脱退・USAID解体による国際的対応能力の低下など、複数の懸念要因が指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: 非洲疾控呼吁筹集14亿美元抗击埃博拉
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Africa CDC calls for raising $1.4 billion to combat Ebola.
article.articleSummary: As of 26 June 2026, Africa CDC calls for raising $1.4 billion to curb the Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), centered in Ituri Province where humanitarian crisis worsens control efforts. The outbreak has 1,118 cases and 291 deaths in the DRC; Uganda reports 20 cases in the first month, the highest monthly total on record. France confirms the first imported case of this round: a humanitarian worker physician who developed symptoms on a flight from Kinshasa and was diagnosed with Ebola on arrival. There is no approved vaccine or specific treatment. The DRC health minister mandates 21-day active health monitoring for contacts, travel bans within and out of affected areas, and health declaration requirements for international travelers; airlines must verify compliance. These measures aim to reduce cross-border transmission.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカCDCがエボラ対策に14億ドルの資金調達を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の急速な拡大、複数国への国際的広がり、渡航制限実施）。複数国での確認事例、死亡例、国際支援の明確な必要性があり、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: DRCでのBundibugyo ebolavirus感染症アウトブレイク（1,118例、291死亡）。ウガンダでの20例確認、フランスでの輸入例1例報告。アフリカCDCが14億ドルの緊急資金調達を呼びかけ。Ituri州での人道的危機。DRC保健相が21日間の能動的接触者管理、渡航制限、国際旅客の健康申告要件を実施。ワクチンや特異的治療法が不承認。国際的支援の必要性が明確で、複数国への拡散リスクが高い。

article.articleHeadline: India launches Air Suvidha 2.0 amid ongoing Ebola outbreak concerns - Connected to India News I Singapore l UAE l UK l USA l NRI
article.articleSummary: India launches Air Suvidha 2.0, a contactless Passenger Health Self-Declaration Portal to bolster entry surveillance amid the Bundibugyo virus disease (BVD) Ebola outbreak in the DRC and Uganda. The WHO declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17, 2026; bordering South Sudan is considered high risk. The portal requires a 21‑day travel history, exposure and symptom details and can be filled up to 24 hours before arrival, with real‑time data shared with Airport Health Officers, immigration, the IDSP, and state surveillance to identify at‑risk travelers. Access airsuvidha.civilaviation.gov.in and present the downloaded form on arrival. Ebola update: 1,094 confirmed cases and 277 deaths, with over 100 recoveries; the DRC outbreak is expanding, and Uganda reports 20 confirmed cases, including 2 deaths. Treatment capacity has grown to more than 500 beds across 19 centers, with labs conducting over 2,000 tests daily. Trials of MBP134 and remdesivir are set to begin in the DRC next week.

triage.headline_ja: インド、エボラ流行懸念の中でエア・スビダ2.0を立ち上げ
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo型）がDRCおよびウガンダで流行中であり、WHOが2026年5月17日にPHEIC宣言を行っているため、IHR基準2つ以上該当。インドが国境を接するスーダンへのリスク拡大が懸念され、国際的な公衆衛生上の重大な脅威となっている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは主にDRCおよびウガンダでのエボラ流行とインドの対応措置（エア・スビダ2.0ポータル導入）を報じている。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。スーダンについても対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。WHOによるPHEIC宣言、1,094確定患者277死亡、複数国への拡大リスク、臨床試験開始予定など、全スクリーニング基準を満たす高リスク事象。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus Ebola Pertama di Prancis Menurut WHO
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: First Ebola Case in France According to WHO.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-26, Ebola virus disease outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo exceed 1,000 confirmed cases, with healthcare workers bearing a notable share of infections. About 78 health professionals—including nurses and doctors—have contracted Ebola, and 18 of them have died. The National Institute of Public Health in DRC reports that all infected staff acquired the virus within local health facilities, not from facilities housing Ebola patients in the region. This pattern points to gaps in infection prevention and control and safety measures within health facilities, rather than patient-to-care facility exposure. The article emphasizes ongoing transmission linked to facility-based exposure, underscoring the need for improved protective practices and surveillance to protect frontline workers during the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: WHOによるフランスの最初のエボラ症例について
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおけるエボラウイルス疾患の大規模流行（1,000例超の確定症例）は、IHR基準の深刻な公衆衛生影響と異常性を明確に満たし、医療施設内での感染制御の欠陥と医療従事者への高い感染リスクを示唆している。国際的な支援と対策強化が必要とされる重大事象。
triage.notes: 見出しではフランスのエボラ症例に言及されているが、記事サマリーの実質的内容はDRC内での流行状況に焦点が当たっており、DRCが主要な発生地域。医療施設内での感染制御不備による医療従事者への感染拡大は、WPROスクリーニング基準全5項目に該当し、極めて高リスク。フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola cases in DR Congo rise to 1,155, death toll hits 304
article.articleSummary: DR Congo reported 1,155 confirmed Ebola cases and 304 deaths as of June 26, 2026, with government data noting new cases in the previous 24 hours in a continuing outbreak. The Democratic Republic of Congo remains the site of sustained transmission and fatalities. In parallel, France identified and isolated five people who may have been exposed to Ebola after flying with a doctor who tested positive; the exposed passengers were placed in hospital isolation for 21 days, the length of the incubation period. The report emphasizes formal case counts and fatalities while providing limited detail on laboratory confirmation or infection source. The incident illustrates ongoing cross-border risk linked to international travel from affected regions and the need for vigilant monitoring of travelers to and from Congo.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ患者数が1,155人に増加、死亡者は304人に達した
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準もすべてに該当。エボラウイルス病は国際的に懸念される重大な感染症であり、国際旅行に関連したセカンダリーケース（フランス）の報告があり、継続的な人間-ヒト感染が確認されている。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: フランスで二次的な曝露者が特定されたが、フランスは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCでのイベント主体で、国際旅行に関連した輸出入リスクが明確に示されている。死亡率は26.3%（304/1,155）で非常に高い。

article.articleHeadline: 中國大陸新冠陽性率連3周上升　疾管署：低於去年同期仍待觀察 - 健康新聞 - PChome Online 新聞
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mainland China’s COVID-19 positivity rate has risen for three consecutive weeks; Taiwan CDC says it remains below last year’s level and is under observation.
article.articleSummary: Mainland China’s COVID-19 positivity rate has risen for three consecutive weeks but remains far below last year’s level. From June 8–14, outpatient/ED positivity reached 5.1%. The dominant variant is NB.1.8.1 (about 48.6%), followed by XFG (17.3%) and JN.1 (15.9%). Year-to-date cases are roughly 17,000–26,000 per month; by May the cumulative total was 109,019 cases with 9 deaths, well below last year’s 761,239 cases and 28 deaths. Authorities warn last summer’s peak warrants continued observation. Taiwan’s CDC says last week’s COVID-19 outpatient/ED visits were 981, up slightly but overall at a low level, with no obvious rebound. Globally, positivity is rising in many regions besides Europe. Transmission is via droplets; indoor, poorly ventilated spaces and long exposure increase risk. Incubation 1–14 days (usually 5–6); infectious before symptom onset; symptoms include fever, dry cough, fatigue, dyspnea, myalgia, sore throat, diarrhea.

triage.headline_ja: 中国大陸の新型コロナ陽性率が連続3週間上昇、台湾感染症対策センター：昨年同期を下回り、引き続き観察中
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19は既知の疾患であり、中国の陽性率上昇は観察されているが、昨年同期比で大幅に低く、重症度や国際的リスクの具体的な証拠が不足。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事は中国大陸のCOVID-19陽性率上昇を報告しており、台湾CDCが言及されているが、実イベントは中国で発生している。COVID-19は既知の循環性疾患で、陽性率が昨年同期を下回っており、新興の懸念は限定的。スクリーニング基準は複数該当するが、重症度や国際的拡大の具体的証拠がないため、WATCH判定が適切。

article.articleHeadline: Ανησυχία για σπάνια στελέχη Εμπολα που μπορεί να εξαπλωθούν πέρα από τον Κονγκό " OnCamera.gr
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Concern over rare Ebola strains that could spread beyond Congo.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a rare Ebola strain, began spreading in eastern DRC from April 2026 and has now been confirmed in Uganda, with South Sudan flagged as at risk per a WHO study. Declared a Public Health Emergency of Concern on May 17, 2026, the outbreak reported 1,048 confirmed cases and 267 deaths in DRC health zones by June 22, 2026; 1,077 suspected cases on May 26 were later revised. Transmission started in April, with a six-week delay to confirmation amid conflict and limited healthcare access. No licensed vaccine exists for Bundibugyo ebolavirus; control relies on case isolation, contact tracing, and safe burials, especially with cross-border movement. Uganda has 20 confirmed cases and 2 deaths, including five health workers. Models project ~990 cases and ~174 deaths by end-June, up to 66,000 by September if controls fail. Uganda’s rapid response aids management; South Sudan is identified as the region with highest readiness.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴを超えて拡大する可能性のあるエボラの稀な株に対する懸念
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当（重篤な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外な株、国際的拡大とウガンダ/南スーダンへの確認・リスク、渡航・貿易制限の可能性）。また、WPROスクリーニング基準5つすべても該当し、WHOが2026年5月17日にPHEIC宣言済みで社会政治的関心も極めて高い。フルRRA進行が必須。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus（BDBV）は稀なエボラ株で、2026年4月にDRC東部で発生し、ウガンダで確認、南スーダンがリスク地域として特定された。DRCで1,048確定患者、267死亡；ウガンダで20確定患者、2死亡（うち医療従事者5人）。ワクチンが存在せず、隔離・接触追跡・安全埋葬による制御が必須。紛争と医療アクセスの限定が対応を複雑化させている。WHOは既にPHEIC宣言済み（2026年5月17日）。verified_locationsはDRCのみが記事で実際に発生確認されており、ウガンダはGeoNames対象国リストに含まれないため除外した。南スーダンは「リスク地域」として言及されているが未確認のため除外。DRCが対象国リスト（203312）に含まれるため記載。

article.articleHeadline: தமிழகம் முழுவதும் 28ம் தேதி தேசிய போலியோ சொட்டு மருந்து சிறப்பு முகாம்
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Special Camp Across Tamil Nadu on the 28th for National Polio Drops
article.articleSummary: Polio drop campaign across Tamil Nadu on 28 June 2026 (Sunday) will administer polio drops to 52.91 lakh children aged 0-5 years across 43,051 centres. The government press release notes that all government primary health centres, hospitals, Anganwadi centres, schools, and other key locations will participate. Despite prior polio doses under the National Immunization Schedule, children are to receive another dose on the campaign day. The initiative aims to bolster immunity in the 0-5 year age group and complements routine immunization efforts to ensure universal coverage of the 0-5 age group; no cases or outbreaks are cited in the article.

triage.headline_ja: タミル・ナードゥ州全域での6月28日の全国ポリオ予防接種キャンペーン
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はポリオ予防接種キャンペーンの告知であり、疾患の発生、集団発生、または異常な健康事象の報告ではない。ポリオ事例やアウトブレイクは記載されていない。
triage.notes: これは公衆衛生クライシスコミュニケーションではなく、定期的な予防接種キャンペーンの行政告知である。ポリオ患者数やアウトブレイクの報告はなく、シグナルトリアージの対象ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Vietnamese peacekeepers support Ebola prevention efforts in Abyei
article.articleSummary: Vietnam's Engineering Company Rotation 4, deployed with the United Nations Interim Security Force for Abyei (UNISFA), organized a community outreach programme to prevent Ebola spread amid a worsening outbreak in Africa. The Level-1 Field Hospital conducted infection prevention and control training for all personnel, covering symptom recognition, proper PPE use, and safe interaction with communities. The unit donated hundreds of essential protective items—face masks and hand sanitiser—to Abyei Hospital, local health facilities, schools, and religious institutions, easing shortages and strengthening cooperation between international peacekeepers and local health workers. Health education at Abyei Secondary School demonstrated WHO-recommended handwashing procedures and guidance to minimise close contact in crowded settings, boosting Ebola prevention awareness among youths. With the rainy season bringing heavy rainfall, flooding and contaminated water sources, frontline workers face increased infection risks; the initiative underscores proactive support to safeguard public health in Abyei.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムの平和維持活動要員がアビエイでのエボラ予防活動を支援
triage.triage_reason: アビエイでのエボラ発生は確認されるが、記事の主題はベトナム工兵部隊による予防支援活動であり、新規発生や急速な拡大の兆候は明示されていない。発生状況の詳細情報が不足しており、継続的な監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はスーダン（アビエイ）でのエボラ発生を背景としているが、対象国リストに含まれていない。ベトナムは平和維持活動国として言及されているのみで、感染症発生地ではない。WPROスクリーニング基準では長期曝露（雨季に伴う洪水と汚染水）と流行しやすさ（ヒト-ヒト感染可能なエボラ）に該当するが、IHR基準は満たさず、社会的関心度は不明のため、WATCH判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : mesures sanitaires, commerçants de Bunia étranglés
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: Health Measures, Bunia Traders Squeezed.
article.articleSummary: Ebola containment measures in the Democratic Republic of Congo trigger a regional economic shock in Bunia, Ituri. With Bunia airport closed for weeks and cross-border trade with Uganda suspended, commerce slows, shelves empty, and prices for many imported goods rise. Local vendors report sharp revenue declines—one spice seller’s daily takings drop from around 200,000 to 50,000 Congolese francs—while stockouts of essentials (e.g., tires) illustrate disrupted supply chains. Fear of Ebola reduces market footfall, driving away foreign customers and expatriates who previously supported trade. Uganda’s role as a key logistics corridor compounds the impact; closures and delays push prices higher. Government plans to reopen Bunia airport soon; reestablishing cross-border exchanges with Uganda depends on Kampala’s decisions, seen as vital to reviving activity.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ：衛生対策、ブニアの商人たちが打撃を受ける
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。エボラウイルスは最高リスク病原体であり、DRCでの発生は国際的な懸念事項。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIではUgandaも発生地域として検出されているが、記事サマリーはDRCのIturi州Bunia地域のエボラ対策による経済的影響に焦点を当てており、ウガンダはあくまで隣接国・物流中継地として言及されているのみ。したがってverified_locationsはDRCのみに限定。エボラは最高リスク病原体であり、全てのスクリーニング基準を満たしている。

article.articleHeadline: Chikungunya avança na Bahia e pode deixar sequelas articulares duradouras.
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chikungunya spreads in Bahia and could leave lasting joint sequelae.
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya cases surge in Bahia, with 3,191 probable cases from January to mid-June 2026, a 92% rise from the same period in 2025 (1,662). Across 141 municipalities including Salvador, health authorities warn of persistent joint pain after the acute phase, potentially lasting months to years and hindering daily activities. Dr. Viviane Machicado of Clínica IBIS notes that chikungunya uniquely affects joints, though symptoms overlap with dengue and Zika, all mainly transmitted by Aedes aegypti. Studies show 30–60% have persistent arthralgia after the initial phase; a 36-month study reported about 60% with episodic joint pain. Alarm signs include pain that does not improve or returns after fluctuation, swelling, morning stiffness, and difficulty moving joints or performing routine tasks. Higher risk includes more severe initial disease, female sex, age over 40, and preexisting rheumatologic conditions. Treatment is individualized, with analgesics/anti-inflammatories, rheumatology input, and physiotherapy; Clínica IBIS in Salvador specializes in autoimmune diseases.

triage.headline_ja: チクングニアがバイーア州で急増し、持続的な関節障害を残す可能性
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・バイーア州でチクングニア症例が92%増加（3,191件）し、持続的関節痛など重症度が懸念される。地域内で異常な増加傾向を示し、公衆衛生への深刻な影響が認識されており、IHR基準2つ以上に該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではブラジル（バイーア州）でのチクングニア症例の急増が主題。El Salvadorは発生地域フィールドに含まれているが、サマリー本文ではブラジルのみが言及されているため、verified_locationsはBrazilのみ。前年比92%の増加、30～60%の持続的関節痛、複数の危険因子（高年齢、女性、既存の関節リウマチ）により重症度が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Alerta por el aumento de casos de tuberculosis en Argentina: se registraron 6.482 casos en lo que va de 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Alert over the rise in tuberculosis cases in Argentina: 6,482 cases have been recorded so far in 2026.
article.articleSummary: Tuberculosis in Argentina rose in 2026, with 6,482 cases reported through epidemiological week 22, a 71.6% increase from 2020 (3,277) and 133 more than the same period in 2025. The surge is uneven: Centro, Northeast Argentino (NEA), and Cuyo show the largest gains, while the Southern region declined 22.3% (−35). NOA remained nearly stable (+0.3%). Provinces with notable increases include Misiones (+44.9%), Mendoza (+42.6%), Entre Ríos (+38.8%), Santiago del Estero (+34.3%), and Santa Fe (+32.9%). For 2025, 17,283 cases were confirmed (37.3 per 100,000), with 13,839 new, 475 relapses, and 2,045 with insufficient data. Most cases occur in adult men, particularly in Salta, Buenos Aires City, Buenos Aires Province, Jujuy, Formosa, and Chaco. About 85% of diagnoses are new, underscoring the importance of early detection and prompt treatment.

triage.headline_ja: アルゼンチンの結核患者数増加への警告：2026年1月～6月に6,482人が報告
triage.triage_reason: 結核は既知の地方病で、アルゼンチンは対象国ではない。ただし前年比71.6%の増加と顕著な上昇傾向が報告されており、公開衛生上の懸念がある。情報は限定的だが経過観察の価値がある。
triage.notes: 記事はアルゼンチンの結核危機を報道しており、IHR基準2つおよびWPRO基準4つに該当する。しかし評価対象国（CEPR東南アジア・アフリカ中心）にアルゼンチンは含まれないため、verified_locationsは空。また記事に含まれるフィリピン・台湾・イタリアはサマリー上でイベント発生地として言及されていない。WATCHとした理由は、対象国範囲外であるもリスク指標が高く、情報更新時に再評価の必要があるため。

article.articleHeadline: 中國大陸新冠陽性率連3周上升　疾管署：低於去年同期仍待觀察 | LIFE生活網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mainland China's COVID-19 positivity rate has risen for three consecutive weeks; Taiwan CDC says it remains under observation, though it is lower than the same period last year.
article.articleSummary: As of June 26, 2026, Mainland China’s COVID-19 positivity rate has risen for three consecutive weeks but total cases remain far lower than the previous year. Mainland China’s overall respiratory disease activity is low; COVID-19 outpatient/ER positivity from June 8–14 rose to 5.1%. This year’s monthly COVID-19 case counts are about 17,000–26,000, with 109,019 cases and 9 deaths reported through May, far below last year’s roughly 761,239 cases and 28 deaths. Globally, NB.1.8.1 remains the dominant variant (about 48.6%), followed by XFG (17.3%) and JN.1 (15.87%). Taiwan remains at a low epidemiological level, with 981 COVID-19–related outpatient visits last week, up slightly from the prior week. Transmission is primarily via droplets and aerosols, with higher risk in poorly ventilated indoor spaces; most infections are mild, but high-risk groups include diabetes, chronic liver disease, kidney failure, and cardiovascular disease. Seek prompt medical evaluation for suspected cases.

triage.headline_ja: 中国大陸の新型コロナウイルス陽性率が3週連続で上昇　台湾疾病管制署：昨年同期より低いが引き続き観察が必要
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19は既知の流行疾患であり、中国の陽性率上昇は昨年比で依然として低水準。台湾の疫学的レベルは低く、国際的な拡大リスク、深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性が認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は中国の新型コロナウイルス陽性率の上昇を報じているが、症例数は昨年同期と比較して大幅に低く、台湾の疫学的レベルは低いままである。既知の流行疾患の通常の変動として評価される。

article.articleHeadline: 上海专家与海外侨胞云端共话埃博拉疫情防控
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Shanghai experts and overseas compatriots discuss Ebola epidemic prevention and control online.
article.articleSummary: On 25–26 June 2026, Shanghai Overseas Chinese Federation and the Shanghai Municipal United Front Work Department organized an online salon titled 'Care Across Mountains and Seas—Supporting Overseas Chinese Against Ebola' to convey care from homeland to overseas Chinese and students. The session linked participants in Kenya, Tanzania, Rwanda, and Uganda, with representatives from the Kenyan and Tanzanian embassies, East African Chinese communities, and local enterprises, totaling nearly 100 attendees. National Infectious Disease Medical Center Director Zhang Wenhong provided guidance on Ebola prevention, detailing transmission, daily protective measures, emergency procedures, and medical‑care considerations. East African participants—Kenya Shanghai Chamber of Commerce president Li Changhong, Tanzania Shanghai Chamber of Commerce president Ruan Lun, and East Africa Chinese Youth Federation vice president Wang Jiakun—outlined the current Ebola prevention status and local health infrastructure, and voiced overseas health needs. Shanghai’s diaspora offices pledged ongoing support to safeguard overseas compatriots’ safety and livelihoods.

triage.headline_ja: 上海専門家と海外同胞がエボラ疫情対策についてオンラインで議論
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は上海と東アフリカ地域の華人コミュニティ間のオンライン情報交換会であり、新規の感染症イベント（確定症例の発生、アウトブレークの報告）ではなく、既知のリスク地域での予防啓発活動を報道したものである。IHR基準およびWPRO基準いずれにも実質的には該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は上海で開催されたオンラインセミナーの報道であり、実際のエボラ発生地域は東アフリカ（ケニア、タンザニア、ルワンダ、ウガンダ）である。サマリーには新規の確定症例報告やアウトブレーク情報が含まれておらず、既知リスク地域への予防啓発が主題である。対象国リストにはDRC以外の東アフリカ諸国が含まれていないため、verified_locationsは空配列とした。中国内での発生報告もない。

article.articleHeadline: International pastors cancel Ugandan crusades over Ebola fears
article.articleSummary: Pastors Benny Hinn and Kenneth Copeland canceled their Uganda miracle-healing crusade over Ebola fears. The Miracle Centre Cathedral in Kampala, which would host Hinn, Copeland and Paul Enenche for the Global Conference on the Holy Spirit (June 27–29), postponed the event after consulting health experts and following CDC guidance. The Bundibugyo strain outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has killed about a dozen people, with some patients traveling to Uganda for treatment. Uganda has confirmed 20 Ebola cases since the outbreak, 15 imported from DRC, with two deaths and 14 recoveries. Organizers expect to reschedule for late September or October. The US government has temporarily restricted entry for travelers recently in Uganda, DRC and South Sudan, mandating 21 days of health monitoring; Uganda’s Ministry of Health warned that large gatherings may facilitate transmission in Kampala and beyond.

triage.headline_ja: 国際的な牧師がエボラ熱の恐れからウガンダの集会をキャンセル
triage.triage_reason: エボラ熱の確認症例（ウガンダで20例、DRCで約12例）が報告され、国際的な移動制限が発令されている。異常で予想外のイベント（大規模集会キャンセル）であり、国際的な懸念と拡大リスクが明確である。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの確認症例20例（うち15例はDRC由来）、DRCでの死亡約12例が報告されている。米国政府が旅行者に対する一時的な入国制限と21日間の健康監視を発令。大規模集会のキャンセルは社会的・政治的関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: La peste porcina alcanza a Grupo Jorge, el rey del cerdo: pierde 40 millones a pesar de ingresar 2.000
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Swine fever hits Grupo Jorge, the king of pork: loses 40 million despite bringing in 2,000.
article.articleSummary: African swine fever detected in Catalonia, Spain, in late 2025, intensifying market strain on Grupo Jorge, Spain’s pork leader. The Aragonese group posted 2025 operating loss of €39.7 million on revenue €2.015 billion, after a €61.2 million impairment to adjust livestock inventories; management expects the negative impact to persist in 2026. Live pig prices stayed above the ten-year average, but pork meat prices declined due to oversupply and weaker demand in international markets. China’s demand for Spanish pork fell ~14.5% in 2025, with prices to Chinese buyers below those of earlier years; exports to China reached €571 million in 2024 (31% of Spain’s pork exports). Grupo Jorge exports to over 100 countries, including China, Japan, Mexico, and New Zealand, and forecasts ~5% higher pork production in 2026 despite adverse conditions, supported by a positive working capital of €300 million.

triage.headline_ja: 豚熱がスペインの豚肉大手グルポ・ホルヘを直撃：40百万ユーロの損失、売上20億ユーロにもかかわらず
triage.triage_reason: アフリカ豚熱は対象国（中国）での確認がないため、IHR基準の国際的拡大リスク評価が困難。スペインは対象外だが、中国への輸出減少の経済的影響は記載されている。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事はスペイン（非対象国）でのアフリカ豚熱検出と経済的影響を報じている。対象国から中国のみが該当。スペインへの豚肉輸出減少が記載されているが、中国でのアフリカ豚熱発生は記事サマリーに明記されていない。アフリカ豚熱は既知の畜産疾患で異常性は低いが、国際貿易への影響（特に中国への輸出）は明らかである。IHR基準では2つ該当するが、WPROスクリーニング基準でも2つ該当するため、PICKUP相当の基準を満たしているが、対象国での直接的な発生確認がないため慎重に判定。

article.articleHeadline: Kissojen kantaman loisen vaikutuksia on voitu aliarvioida - tutkijoilta varoitus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The effects of cat-transmitted parasites may have been underestimated — researchers warn.
article.articleSummary: Toxoplasma gondii infection (toxoplasmosis) is urged for WHO to classify as a neglected tropical disease. Researchers from Flinders University (Australia) and the University of São Paulo (Brazil) argue it is undervalued, with about one-third of the population infected, though most cases are asymptomatic or mild. Transmission occurs through handling cat feces, undercooked meat, contaminated water, and unwashed produce. In pregnancy, fetal infection can cause miscarriage, neurological damage, or permanent vision loss from ocular toxoplasmosis. Symptoms, when present, typically emerge about two weeks after infection; the most common form is painless lymphadenopathy. Evidence for behavioral effects in humans is inconclusive. There is no vaccine or curative treatment. Prevention focuses on cooking meat thoroughly, washing produce, hand hygiene, safe drinking water, and careful cat-litter handling by pregnant women. The designation could accelerate vaccines, diagnostics, and new therapies and boost attention for tropical regions.

triage.headline_ja: 猫を介した寄生虫の影響が過小評価されている可能性がある - 研究者が警告
triage.triage_reason: トキソプラズマ症は感染率が高く公衆衛生的意義があるが、具体的な流行事例や緊急性を示す情報が記事に含まれていない。研究者による予防啓発・分類見直し提言という性質の報告であり、シグナル段階での急速な評価は難しい。
triage.notes: 記事は具体的なアウトブレイク報告ではなく、研究者による疫学研究に基づいた警告・提言の性質。トキソプラズマ症の世界的な感染分布と公衆衛生学的重要性は認識されているが、新規の地理的流行拡大や異常な事象の報告ではない。ブラジル（University of São Paulo）とオーストラリア（Flinders University）の研究者が関与しているが、実際の感染症イベントの発生地として検証可能なのはブラジル（研究機関の所在地）のみ。WHO慢性疾患分類への含入提言は長期的な施策課題であり、即時対応が必要な緊急事象ではない。

article.articleHeadline: 中國大陸新冠陽性率連3周上升　疾管署：低於去年同期仍待觀察 - 民視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mainland China’s COVID-19 positivity rate has risen for three consecutive weeks; Taiwan CDC says it remains below the same period last year and is still under observation.
article.articleSummary: Mainland China’s COVID-19 positivity rate has risen for three consecutive weeks, yet overall case numbers remain far below last year. For June 8–14, Mainland China’s outpatient/ED SARS-CoV-2 positivity was 5.1%, with year-to-May cumulative cases about 109,019 and 9 deaths, versus last year’s roughly 761,239 cases and 28 deaths. Globally, positivity is rising, led by NB.1.8.1 (~48.56%), with XFG (17.31%) and JN.1 (15.87%) also circulating. Taiwan’s weekly data show 981 outpatient/ED visits for COVID-19, up slightly from the previous week, but the outbreak remains at a low, fluctuating level. Clinical symptoms include fever, dry cough, fatigue, shortness of breath, myalgia, headache, sore throat, diarrhea, and possible anosmia/ageusia; incubation is 1–14 days (most 5–6), with infectiousness starting about 2 days before symptoms. High-risk groups include diabetes, chronic liver disease, kidney failure, and cardiovascular disease.

triage.headline_ja: 中国大陸の新型コロナウイルス陽性率が3週連続で上昇　台湾疾管署：昨年同期を下回っており引き続き観察中
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19の定期的なサーベイランスレポートであり、中国の陽性率上昇は検出されているが、絶対数は前年同期比で大幅に低い。国際的な拡大リスクや深刻な影響の明確な証拠が不足している。
triage.notes: COVID-19は既知の流行疾患であり、ルーチンなサーベイランス情報である。台湾疾管署によるモニタリングが行われており、政府の関心は存在するが、緊急的なフルRRA開始の必要性は低い。引き続き定期サーベイランスデータの推移を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: ആഫ്രിക്കയിൽ എബോള പടരുന്നു: മൂന്ന് രാജ്യങ്ങളിൽ നിന്നുള്ളവർക്ക് സഊദിയിൽ പ്രവേശന വിലക്ക്
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola spreading in Africa: Saudi Arabia bans entry for people from three countries.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Africa prompts Saudi Arabia to ban entry for travelers from the Democratic Republic of Congo, Uganda and South Sudan. The Saudi Public Health Authority suspended all entry visas for anyone who visited or transited these countries within 21 days and mandated strict border screenings. Saudi Arabia has reported no Ebola cases since 2019. Ebola, first identified in 1976 in the Democratic Republic of Congo, carries a historical case fatality of about 50% with roughly 15,000 deaths. Separately, a French doctor who had worked in the DRC tested positive for Ebola in France and is placed in quarantine. Enhanced surveillance also targets travelers from Rwanda, Burundi, Tanzania and Congo-Brazzaville.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカでエボラが拡大：サウジアラビアが3カ国からの入国を禁止
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の多国間での報告と国際的な渡航制限措置が講じられており、IHR基準3項目（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限）に該当。DRC での発生確認により対象国での実際のシグナル。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで明確に DRC（対象国）でのエボラ発生が述べられており、フランスでの症例報告も DRC での感染に由来。ウガンダ、南スーダン、ルワンダ、ブルンジ、タンザニア、コンゴ・ブラザヴィルは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。エボラウイルス病の致死率（約50%）と国際的な対応措置により、本件はシグナルとしてピックアップすべき。

article.articleHeadline: India Makes Air Suvidha 2.0 Mandatory For All International Arrivals Amid Ebola Alert
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization designated the ongoing Ebola outbreak in central Africa as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, prompting India to tighten entry health surveillance. The Ministry of Civil Aviation launched Air Suvidha 2.0 on 25 June, mandating a digital health declaration for all international arrivals. Every traveller, regardless of departure country, must complete the online self-declaration before boarding. The measure seeks to strengthen screening and surveillance amid the Ebola PHEIC. The article does not report case counts or local transmission details. This policy change reflects increased vigilance in response to the Ebola alert and the international health emergency designation.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ警報の中、インドがすべての国際到着者に対してAir Suvidha 2.0を義務化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。WHO公式PHEICデジグネーションに基づくインドの対応イベントであり、シグナルとして即座にフルRRA進行が必要。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域にAfricaとIndiaが含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題はインドの対応策（Air Suvidha 2.0義務化）であり、実際の流行地はアフリカ中部。インドは対応国であり、対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。WHOのPHEICデジグネーションが言及されており、公式な危機認知が確認される。

article.articleHeadline: Recce taps investors for $8m to power next phase of superbug fight | Stockhead
article.articleSummary: Recce Pharmaceuticals (ASX:RCE) is raising up to $8 million to advance its synthetic anti-infective portfolio targeting antibiotic-resistant infections. A $4 million placement at 40c per share and a concurrent up-to-$4 million Share Purchase Plan will lift pro forma cash to about $29.5 million. Allocations include $3.2 million to advance a commercial licensing deal for R327 Topical Gel to treat diabetic foot infections across the Middle East and North Africa, following a non-binding term sheet with a regional partner; $2 million for clinical trials in Indonesia and Australia addressing diabetic foot infections and a US government war-burn program; and $2 million to progress Investigational New Drug applications with the US FDA and Indonesian regulator. An EGM and prospectus will underpin attaching options, while the SPP closes on July 20 and new shares begin trading shortly after. Published 2026-06-26.

triage.headline_ja: Recceが超耐性菌対策の次段階を推進するため投資家から800万ドルを調達 | Stockhead
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は医薬品企業の資金調達および臨床試験計画に関するビジネスニュースであり、感染症の実際の発生・流行を報告するものではない。未知の疾患の流行を示すシグナルの証拠がない。
triage.notes: 本記事は感染症イベントの発生ではなく、抗菌薬耐性感染症に対応する医薬品開発企業の資金調達および臨床試験計画を報道している。感染症の流行・アウトブレイク、異常事象の報告は含まれていない。Bluedot APIが複数国を抽出しているが、これはR327の臨床試験地点（インドネシア、オーストラリア）と規制対応国（米国）の記載に基づくもので、感染症イベント自体は記事中にない。

article.articleHeadline: Cuiabá tem alta de 153% de casos de gripe e alerta para baixa vacinação
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cuiabá records a 153% increase in flu cases and warns of low vaccination rates.
article.articleSummary: Cuiabá, Brazil, records a 153.46% increase in influenza cases in 2026 compared with 2025, with 1,574 confirmed cases and 2,034 notifications through early June, including 828 in children aged 0–6. Vaccination coverage among priority groups stands at 33.45% as of June 3, far below the Ministry of Health’s 95% target. In response, the Municipal Health Secretariat is intensifying vaccination efforts by delivering home-based shots to patients who are bedbound or have severely reduced mobility. Seventy-two Family Health Units coordinate domiciliary vaccination; families request a visit, clinicians assess mobility and clinical eligibility, and vaccination is administered at home when criteria are met. The initiative complements ongoing vaccination and caregiver education, with influenza vaccine available at all 72 units. Influenza is a highly transmissible acute respiratory infection causing fever, cough, sore throat, body pains, fatigue, and potential severe outcomes, especially in children and older adults.

triage.headline_ja: クイアバで流感患者が153％増加し、ワクチン接種率の低さに警告
triage.triage_reason: インフルエンザの有意な増加（153%）と低いワクチン接種率（33.45% vs 目標95%）が報告されているが、重症度や死亡に関する具体的情報が不足しており、国際的拡大の直接的な兆候がない。情報補足と続報を待つべき段階。
triage.notes: ブラジルはWPRO対象外国のため、通常のWPRO基準適用とならない。ただしインフルエンザは高い伝播性、小児（0-6歳828人を含む1,574確定例）への明らかな影響、ワクチン接種率の著しい低さ（33.45%）があり、地域的な懸念がある。重症度（入院数、死亡数）に関する情報が記事に記載されていないため、フルRRA実施には追加情報が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Experts Warn of Rising Dengue Risks Due to El Nino
article.articleSummary: El Niño, projected to last until end-2026, accelerates dengue fever spread in Indonesia. Gadjah Mada University estimates over 2 million DF patients will require treatment nationwide in 2024, with numbers likely rising as temperatures rise. Aedes aegypti breeding habitat expands; DF now a year-round threat. DF fatalities in past seven years: 41% among children aged 5-14. Protective guidance: outdoors for children with long sleeves, bright colors; mosquito repellent used sparingly; 3M eradication approach; early symptom recognition; vaccination recommended by IDAI as part of childhood immunization. Adults with comorbidities at higher risk: PAPDI notes hypertensive patients 2-3x, diabetes 3-5x, kidney disease up to 7x, asthma/chronic lung 2-12x risk of complications. Takeda's Andreas Gutknecht emphasizes ongoing prevention and community education; dengue remains a serious, potentially life-threatening disease in Indonesia.

triage.headline_ja: エルニーニョによるデング熱リスク上昇を警告
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアにおけるデング熱の大規模流行予測（200万人超の患者発生推定）で公衆衛生への深刻な影響あり、気候変動に伴う異常な拡大が予想され、死亡率上昇（特に小児）が報告されているため、IHR基準2つ以上該当、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。
triage.notes: 記事で明確に述べられている：(1) 200万人超の患者治療が必要との推定、(2) エルニーニョに伴う気候変動が蚊の生息環境拡大を促進、(3) 過去7年間で小児（5-14歳）の死亡者が41%を占める、(4) 基礎疾患患者の合併症リスクが著増（高血圧患者2-3倍、糖尿病患者3-5倍など）。公開予防接種プログラムと住民教育の強化が必要とされており、政府レベルでの関心が高い。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Concerns voiced after Listeria found in chicken supplied to hospitals; recall initiated
article.articleSummary: Listeria monocytogenes detected in frozen chicken products imported from Brazil by Foodbridge EU and Foodbridge UK, supplied to NHS and other health settings. Listeria level is within legal limit (100 CFU/g), but products are labeled ready-to-eat after defrosting, heightening risk for vulnerable groups. Recall issued by Yearsley Food for eight frozen chicken products (various diced/strips options). On June 9 NHS was informed that a supplier had requested destruction or return of affected frozen cooked chicken following detection of low Listeria levels. The product is mainly supplied to catering services including NHS, where it may be further processed. No confirmed listeriosis cases yet; UKHSA awaiting L. monocytogenes isolates from contaminated chicken to be sequenced by FSAI to check for matches with reported cases. One NHS trust identified potentially exposed vulnerable patients; testing underway. Symptoms include fever, vomiting, muscle aches, headache; incubation up to 70 days; high-risk groups: pregnant women, elderly, immune-compromised.

triage.headline_ja: 病院に供給された鶏肉からリステリア検出、回収開始
triage.triage_reason: 食品媒介性リステリア汚染の検出と製品回収事例だが、現時点で確認されたリステリア症患者がなく、汚染レベルは法定基準以内。ただし脆弱層への潜在リスクと国際的な供給チェーン関連のため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: ブラジル産冷凍鶏肉製品のリステリア汚染。英国NHS供給。現在のところ確認患者なし。UK当局（UKHSA）が継続監視中。対象国はブラジルのみ（英国は対象国リスト外）。脆弱層への曝露リスク（高齢者、免疫不全者、妊婦）と潜在的な集団発生可能性が存在するため、WATCH判定。

article.articleHeadline: Mehr als 300 Tote durch Ebola im Kongo bestätigt
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 300 deaths from Ebola in the Congo confirmed.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) continues to intensify. As of Thursday, 1,155 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases have been reported in the DRC, with 304 deaths. In the latest 24-hour period, 37 new infections and five additional deaths were recorded. Health authorities report bed occupancy at about 95%, signaling a strained health system, with the peak of the outbreak not yet reached. Kinshasa-based briefings note intensified surveillance enabling earlier detection of infections. Authorities also indicate that foreign medications will be tested in response to the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラ感染による300人以上の死亡が確認
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当する致命的なエボラウイルス病の大規模流行。1,155例の確定症例と304人の死亡、継続する人的感染、医療体制の限界（ベッド使用率95%）、国際的な支援と医療対応が必要な状況。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）のキンシャサを中心としたエボラウイルス病の急速な拡大を報告。1,155件の確定症例、304人の死亡という深刻な状況。医療体制の逼迫（ベッド使用率95%）、ピークに達していない旨の当局コメント、新規医療対応（外国医薬品の試験）により、今後さらなる拡大の可能性がある。WPROおよびIHR基準により、フルリスク評価（RRA）への進行が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus Leptospirosis di Pati Melonjak Tajam, Dinkes Ingatkan Bahaya Penularan dari Urine Tikus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Leptospirosis cases in Pati surge sharply; Health Department warns of danger of transmission via rat urine
article.articleSummary: Leptospirosis in Pati Regency, Central Java, Indonesia, is rising sharply, prompting a warning from the Pati Health Department. The illness, caused by bacteria shed in rat urine, has shown a sustained upward trend: 7 cases in 2022, 22 in 2023, 61 in 2025, and 172 cases as of end-May 2026. Transmission occurs when bacteria in urine-contaminated water or soil enter the body via open wounds, and can also spread through contaminated food or drinks. Risk is highest during the early rainy season and among workers in wet environments, such as farmers, fishermen, and pond workers. The authorities cited a suspected case in Semarang linked to a beverage from a can previously exposed to rat urine and not cleaned. The report stresses ongoing transmission risk and the need for heightened vigilance during the wet season.

triage.headline_ja: パティ県のレプトスピラ症患者が急増、保健局がネズミ尿による感染の危険性を警告
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア（対象国）でレプトスピラ症が2022年の7件から2026年5月末時点で172件へと急速に増加しており、重症度が中程度以上で、ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性と長期曝露リスクが認められる。IHR基準・WPROスクリーニング基準に複数該当し、フルRRA実施の対象となる。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより、イベントの主たる発生地はインドネシア（パティ県、中部ジャワ州）であることが明確。過去4年間の急速な患者増加（7→22→61→172件）、季節的なパターン（雨季に高いリスク）、複数の職業層への曝露（農民、漁民、養殖業者）が認められる。セマランでの疑い例も報告されており、地域内での継続的な伝播が示唆される。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: More than 100 sick in European Salmonella outbreak
article.articleSummary: Salmonella Bovismorbificans outbreak across 11 European countries linked to alfalfa sprouted seeds from India. From January–May, 109 confirmed infections were reported in 10 EU countries and the UK; Finland led with 35, the UK had 30, and the Netherlands 17. Ages range 4–88; 77 females and 31 males; 18 hospitalizations; two deaths in Finland, both with underlying conditions. About 50 probable cases are under investigation in four EU countries. Alfalfa sprouts—possibly other sprouted seeds—are the primary vehicle; suspected seeds from Italy include alfalfa, clover, broccoli and radish. Ireland reported three related infections in April; later cases clustered with the Irish strain. Traceability identified a common Indian seed supplier; entry to Europe in Oct 2025 via two consignments. Control measures include withdrawal/recalls, halting production, and destruction of suspect products; further cases may occur until the source is controlled; sprouted seeds can be ready-to-eat.

triage.headline_ja: 欧州のサルモネラ食中毒アウトブレイク、100人以上が罹患
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的拡大、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。複数国での確認された感染者109名、死亡2名、ホスピタライゼーション18名、食品由来で予防可能。インド発信の污染種子との確認により、国際的な食品トレーサビリティと管理上の課題。
triage.notes: Bluedot API発生地域に欧州複数国（イタリア、オランダ、フィンランド、アイルランド、英国）が列挙されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。感染源であるインド発信アルファルファ種子が確認されたため、インドのみを記載。記事サマリーより、実際の感染者の大多数は欧州ですが、シグナルトリアージの対象国リスト外のため、本評価では verified_locations にインドのみ記載。公衆衛生学的には欧州での重大アウトブレイク状況であり、PICKUP判定は適切。

article.articleHeadline: Ramai Usulan Menkes soal Pasien Tuberkulosis Masuk Penerima MBG
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Many proposals by the Health Minister regarding TB patients being included as MBG recipients.
article.articleSummary: Indonesia's Health Minister Budi Gunadi Sadikin proposed including tuberculosis (TB) patients in the Nutritious Free Meals (MBG) program. Stop TB Partnership Indonesia (STPI) welcomed the idea but urged three foundations: prioritize MBG for TB patients from the most economically vulnerable groups at risk of malnutrition; tailor MBG nutrition standards to TB’s clinical needs—higher protein, calories, and micronutrients—rather than reusing existing MBG formulas; and integrate the program with health services, medication-adherence support, and social protection. Malnutrition and TB fuel each other; undernutrition weakens immunity and slows recovery, while TB worsens nutritional status. TB therapy lasts six to twelve months. Indonesia reports about 126,000 TB deaths per year (roughly two per five minutes). India and China’s experiences suggest structured nutritional support can improve TB cure rates.

triage.headline_ja: 保健大臣のTB患者をMBG受給者に含める提案が注目を集める
triage.triage_reason: 結核患者への栄養支援プログラムの政策提案に関する記事。新規感染症アウトブレイクや急増ではなく、既知の疾患に対する社会保障政策の議論であり、突発的な公衆衛生危機ではない。
triage.notes: 記事は結核患者向けの栄養支援政策提案に関するもので、新規アウトブレイク、感染数の急増、予期しない疾患パターンの出現などを示していない。インドネシア保健省による政策イニシアティブの報道であり、EBS対象のシグナルとは判定されない。India と China が記事に言及されているが、これらの国での新規イベント発生を述べているのではなく、政策参考としての言及のみである。

article.articleHeadline: Mùa hè gia tăng nguy cơ não mô cầu, chuyên gia khuyến cáo chủ động tiêm phòng cho trẻ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Summer increases the risk of meningococcal disease; experts advise proactive vaccination for children.
article.articleSummary: Neisseria meningitidis meningococcal disease poses a heightened summer risk in Vietnam, with mortality up to 50% if untreated and about 20% of survivors suffering severe sequelae (deafness, neurological damage, limb loss, or permanent scarring). Early symptoms are non-specific: high fever, headache, nausea, vomiting, and neck stiffness, with rapid progression to septic shock or multi-organ failure within 24 hours. Children under 5 are at highest risk due to immature immunity. Transmission occurs via direct contact with respiratory secretions; asymptomatic carriers can spread the bacteria. Long Châu Pharmacy and Vaccination System reports rising demand for vaccination, and a tetravalent meningococcal vaccine covering serogroups A, C, Y, and W is now given to children from 9 months, per physician instruction. WHO and local health authorities emphasize vaccination plus hygiene and healthy living to reduce incidence during peak travel and gatherings.

triage.headline_ja: 夏季は髄膜炎菌感染症のリスク増加、専門家は子どもへの能動的予防接種を推奨
triage.triage_reason: 髄膜炎菌感染症は重篤な疾患であり、ベトナムでの季節的リスク増加について報道されているが、IHR基準2つ以上の該当が確認できず、具体的な集団発生事例の報告がないため、現段階では情報不足と判断される。
triage.notes: 本記事は髄膜炎菌感染症の季節的リスク増加に関する予防啓発記事であり、具体的な患者数や集団発生の報告ではない。ベトナムでの感染症情報として重要性はあるが、集団発生や流行の具体的な証拠がないため、現段階ではWATCH判定とした。今後の患者数増加や集団発生の報告があれば、直ちにPICKUP判定へ引き上げる必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: В ДР Конго выявили 1155 случаев заболевания Эболой
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, 1,155 cases of Ebola virus disease were detected.
article.articleSummary: As of June 26, 2026, Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has 1,155 confirmed cases and 304 deaths, with 326 patients in treatment. The outbreak’s main hotspot remains Ituri Province, with transmission also reported in North Kivu and South Kivu. In mid-June, the United States deployed military specialists to Kenya to assist in building a temporary quarantine center for those infected with Ebola. The World Health Organization, which on May 17 declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, allocated $518 million to fight Ebola in the DRC and neighboring countries.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラウイルス病の1,155症例を検出
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響：1,155症例304死亡、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、国際支援と渡航制限のリスク）。WHOがPHEIC宣言済み。フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 2026年6月26日時点で1,155確定症例304死亡、326名が治療中。主要流行地はイトゥリ州、北キブ州・南キブ州でも感染報告。WHOは5月17日にPHEIC宣言。米国は6月中旬にケニアに軍事専門家を派遣し一時隔離センター設置支援中。対象国リストに該当するケニア（1562822）は支援地域であり発生地ではないため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: La epidemia de ébola en República Democrática del Congo se agrava entre desinformación, ataques a personal médico y fuga de pacientes sospechosos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola epidemic in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is worsening amid misinformation, attacks on medical personnel, and the escape of suspected patients.
article.articleSummary: Ebola epidemic in the Democratic Republic of the Congo worsens in Mongbwalu, Ituri, amid misinformation, violence against health teams, and the escape of suspected patients. As of June 6, 2026, Africa CDC reports 452 confirmed cases and 82 deaths, about three weeks after the outbreak began. The circulating variant is Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which there is no specific vaccine. Laboratory confirmation came from INRB in Kinshasa after initial misdiagnoses (malaria, typhoid, diarrhea). This outbreak is the 17th Ebola outbreak in DRC since 1976. Misinformation—rumors that coffins spread the virus and that humanitarian workers carry pathogens via vehicle antennas—has fueled community rejection and attacks on health facilities; Doctors Without Borders (MSF) tent was burned and staff withdrew. Additionally, 18 suspected cases escaped from the hospital, raising the risk of further transmission. Ongoing funding shortfalls further hinder the response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行が悪化 - 情報操作、医療従事者への攻撃、患者の逃亡の中で
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目すべてに該当する。452確認症例、82死亡、患者逃亡による感染拡大リスク、医療体制の崩壊が報告されており、緊急の国際支援が必要な重大シグナル。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus（ワクチンなし）による17番目のDRCエボラアウトブレーク。患者逃亡18名、MSF施設が焼き払われるなど医療体制への深刻な障害。情報操作による住民の医療施設拒否が感染制御を著しく阻害。資金不足も報告。フルRRA実施と即時国際支援が必須。

article.articleHeadline: കേരളത്തിൽ 2021 മുതൽ ജലജന്യരോഗങ്ങൾ വർധിക്കുന്നു; കാരണം മലിനപ്പെട്ട കുടിവെള്ളം
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Kerala, waterborne diseases have been increasing since 2021 due to contaminated drinking water.
article.articleSummary: Central Pollution Control Board (CPCB) findings show significant drinking-water contamination across Kerala, with 351 sites in 21 rivers affected and wells as primary sources; aging wells mix in pollutants. In Kottayam, health indicators rise while waterborne diseases surge; since 2021, typhoid, hepatitis A, cholera, and vomiting have increased as a result of contaminated drinking water. As of 2026, 387 malaria cases have been reported this year, with all but three among migrant workers or Malayalis returning from other states. The rising cases are aggravated by insufficient tracking of those arriving from other states. Previous outbreaks were concentrated in Odisha, Jharkhand, and Bihar. Kerala had around 2,000 malaria cases in 2010, decreasing to about 268 over the following decade due to control measures. Poor pre-monsoon sanitation and monitoring gaps among migrant workers contribute to ongoing transmission.

triage.headline_ja: ケーラ州では2021年以来、汚染された飲料水により水系伝染病が増加している
triage.triage_reason: インドのケーラ州において、複数の水系伝染病（チフス、A型肝炎、コレラ、マラリア）の同時発生が報告されており、IHR基準で深刻な公衆衛生影響と異常性を満たす。また、ケーラ州内の複数州での流行継続と国内移動に伴う拡大リスクがある。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年6月配信の将来的な日付となっており、シナリオ・予測記事の可能性がある。しかし、A型肝炎、コレラ、マラリア、チフスの4疾患の同時発生と飲料水汚染に基づく継続的な曝露リスクが報告されている。ケーラ州（Kottayam）、オディシャ州、ビハール州の複数地域で発生しており、国内移動労働者による拡大リスクが指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: DRC Ebola outbreak tops 1,000 cases; study warns of 70% risk of cross-border spread
article.articleSummary: DRC Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak reaches 1,048 laboratory-confirmed cases and 267 deaths in the Democratic Republic of Congo as of June 22, 2026, with the virus circulating undetected for about six weeks before WHO identified it. The outbreak has spread to Uganda, and a Lancet Infectious Diseases modelling study warns of a 69.3% probability of at least one case being imported into South Sudan within 12 weeks, highlighting a significant regional threat; Rwanda importation risk is 8.6% and Burundi 2%. No licensed vaccine exists for the Bundibugyo strain; WHO urges strengthened border surveillance, contact tracing, and safe burial practices. Projections under the most likely transmission scenario estimate ~990 cumulative confirmed cases by late June 2026 (≈174 deaths), rising to ~8,210 cases by September 2026 if transmission continues. CEPI has pledged up to $100 million to accelerate Bundibugyo vaccine development for DRC and Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: DRC エボラ出血熱アウトブレイク1,000例を超過；研究は70%の越境拡大リスクを警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の4項目すべてに該当し、深刻な公衆衛生上の影響、地域的な異常事象、明確な国際拡大リスク（南スーダンへの輸入リスク69.3%）、および多国間での拡大が認められる。WPROスクリーニング基準でも全5項目に該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーによる地域検証：DRCがアウトブレイクの主要な発生地。ウガンダでの拡大、南スーダン・ルワンダ・ブルンジへの越境リスク言及されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。Bundibugyo株は珍しく、既知のワクチンが存在しない点で異常。WHO・CEPI等の国際支援対応が進行中。死亡者267名、1,048例の確定例は重症度が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Concerns grow over accelerating spread of Ebola in Congo: 1,155 cases and 304 deaths - ProtoThema English
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 1,155 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases and 304 deaths in the current outbreak declared May 15, caused by the Bundibugyo strain (no approved vaccine or treatment for this form). In the last 24 hours, authorities confirmed 37 new cases and five additional deaths. Improvements in epidemiological and laboratory surveillance are speeding detection, but transmission is rising on a weekly basis. DR Congo, with about 100 million people, is experiencing its 17th Ebola outbreak; officials say the virus may have circulated undetected before declaration. World Health Organization notes Ebola fatality rates typically range from 25% to 90%. The country’s deadliest outbreak occurred in 2018–2020, with roughly 3,500 cases and nearly 2,300 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の急速な拡大に懸念：1,155症例と304死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、Bundibugyo株による大規模なエボラ出血熱の流行が進行中。死亡率が高く、国際的な関心と支援が必要とされている。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株は承認ワクチンまたは治療法がないという重要な懸念点。死亡率304/1155≈26.3%は高い。1週間単位で感染が上昇している。WHO通知基準を明確に満たすため、直ちにフルRRA実施が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Historic World Cup goal brings rare joy to DR Congo Ebola epicentre
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's 17th Ebola outbreak has infected more than 1,100 people and caused 279 deaths in the DRC and Uganda, per the World Health Organization. In Bunia, capital of Ituri province in the northeast, Congolese figures put 275 cases and 44 deaths, though testing capacity is limited. The outbreak underpins daily life in a volatile region where armed groups, including IS-linked rebels, influence security. Amid this, DR Congo secured a World Cup point when Yoane Wissa scored against Portugal in Houston, delivering rare national joy to fans in Bunia, where authorities had restricted gatherings to 50 people to curb transmission. Fans celebrated in bars and on motorbikes despite constraints. The mood contrasted with ongoing public health strain, and communities sought moments of happiness while grappling with the outbreak's realities.

triage.headline_ja: 歴史的なワールドカップゴールが、コンゴ民主共和国エボラ流行中心地に稀有な喜びをもたらす
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大）、WPROスクリーニング基準で5項目全て該当。DRC及びウガンダでエボラ感染が確認され、1,100名以上の感染と279名の死亡が報告されている。
triage.notes: 記事では DRC 及びウガンダでのエボラ流行が言及されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には DRC のみを記載。Houston（米国テキサス州）はワールドカップ試合開催地として言及されており、流行の実際の発生地ではない。Ituri州 Bunia市での局所的な流行制御状況も記載されている。

article.articleHeadline: Bereits über 300 Tote nach Ebola-Ausbruch in DR Kongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Already over 300 dead after Ebola outbreak in DR Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri region) continues to spread, with 1,155 confirmed cases and 304 deaths. In the last 24 hours, 37 new infections and five additional deaths were reported. Africa CDC says bed capacity is about 95% exhausted and the peak has not yet been reached. Bunia, capital of Ituri, will begin clinical procedures for medicines next week as authorities intensify surveillance. The outbreak is driven by Bundibugyo Ebola virus, for which there is no vaccine or specific therapy yet. A Remdesivir vaccine from the United States and Egypt has arrived and will be tested next week as post-exposure prophylaxis. The MBP134 vaccine candidate from the United States is also due to arrive soon, with several other candidates under development.

triage.headline_ja: DR コンゴのエボラ出血熱流行で既に300人以上の死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラ出血熱は国際的な重大な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、医療施設飽和（95%）、ワクチン不在、国際的医療支援必要性により、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo Ebola virus による流行で、ワクチン・特異的治療が未確立。医療施設逼迫（95%飽和）、感染者1,155名・死亡304名、ピークに達していない状況。米国・エジプトからのレムデシビル候補ワクチンと米国からのMBP134ワクチン候補が導入予定で、国際支援体制構築中。

article.articleHeadline: Congo Imposes Travel Quarantine After France Ebola Case
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak continues in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with 1,118 infections and 291 deaths as of June 24, 2026. France reports its first Ebola case detected within its borders, from a traveler who had recently been in Kinshasa; the patient boarded a commercial flight to Paris, arrived almost asymptomatic aside from headaches, then deteriorated slightly and was isolated with a very low viral load. In response, the DRC imposes a 21-day quarantine and active health monitoring for contacts of confirmed or suspected cases, barring travel domestically or internationally during the period unless authorized by health authorities. Health workers and response teams returning from affected areas must obtain prior approval before international travel. The measures aim to curb global spread while Uganda remains affected by the current outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴがフランスのエボラ患者確認後に渡航隔離措置を実施
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的異常事象、複数国での感染確認、渡航制限実施）。WPRO基準も4項目以上該当。エボラウイルス病は最重要病原体であり、国際的拡大リスクが実現している。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはフランスでの症例検出を言及していますが、サマリーの主題は DRC でのエボラ流行の継続と同国による国際的対応措置です。フランスは症例発症地ではなく、DRC からの入国者発症地として言及されているのみ。Uganda も影響国として言及されていますが、対象国リストに含まれていません。DRC が verified_locations の唯一の対象国です。エボラウイルス病の国際的拡大リスクは現実化しており、最優先でフルRRA実施が必要です。

article.articleHeadline: ไข้สูงช่วงหน้าฝน อย่าคิดว่าแค่หวัด! แพทย์เตือน 'ไข้หวัดใหญ่ในเด็ก' เสี่ยงลุกลามถึงปอดอักเสบ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fever spikes during the rainy season—don't think it's just a cold! Doctors warn that 'influenza in children' could progress to pneumonia.
article.articleSummary: During Thailand's rainy season, cooler, humid weather facilitates spread of respiratory viruses, especially influenza. Influenza is a major concern for children under 5, the elderly, pregnant women, and those with chronic diseases, as it can lead to pneumonia, respiratory failure, myocarditis, or encephalitis without timely care. Influenza A and B spread via droplets and contaminated surfaces; onset is 1–4 days post-infection with fever often 38°C+, chills, headache, myalgia, fatigue, cough, sore throat, and nasal discharge; children may have nausea or diarrhea. Distinguish influenza from a common cold: high fever, persistent symptoms, and rapid breathing signal the need for medical evaluation around days 3–5. Prevention includes masks, handwashing, and annual vaccination. In Thailand, injectable inactivated vaccines are standard for ages 6 months+, with an optional nasal spray vaccine for select groups (not suitable for pregnant women, immunocompromised, aspirin users, or poorly controlled asthma).

triage.headline_ja: 雨季の高熱—単なる風邪だと思うな！医師が警告『小児インフルエンザ』は肺炎への進展リスク
triage.triage_reason: タイにおけるインフルエンザの季節的流行に関する公衆衛生啓発記事。異常・予想外な事象ではなく、季節的リスク通知であり、重症度は潜在的だが確定症例数や流行規模の具体的情報がない。
triage.notes: 記事は季節的なインフルエンザのリスク啓発であり、新規のアウトブレイク報告ではない。具体的な症例数、死亡数、流行規模の情報がないため、重症度や社会的影響の詳細は不明。ただしタイの雨季におけるインフルエンザの流行易易性と長期曝露リスクが言及されている。続報で流行規模の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Kiểm soát, xử lý triệt để khu vực có nguy cơ gây dịch sốt xuất huyết
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Control and thorough handling of areas at risk of dengue fever outbreaks.
article.articleSummary: Two dengue fever outbreaks are underway in Ha Tinh Province, Vietnam, centered in Vũng Áng Ward's Hop Tien neighborhood (outbreak started April 3) and Hoành Sơn Ward's Liên Phú neighborhood (first cases on May 3). The Ha Tinh Center for Disease Control reports a total of 119 dengue cases linked to these clusters, with 97 cases in Vũng Áng and 22 in Hoành Sơn. To date, 96 patients have recovered and 23 are under treatment; Hoành Sơn has seen no new cases recently. Health authorities are intensifying control measures, including surveillance, outbreak containment, environmental sanitation, elimination of larval habitats (lăng quăng and bọ gậy), chemical spraying, and community risk communication. While initial response included vector control, some residents have not consistently disposed of water-holding containers or overturned items, prompting calls for stronger community cooperation, especially after rainfall, to curb mosquito breeding.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱の流行リスクがある地域の管理と対策の徹底
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム・ハティン省でデング熱の局地的な2つの集団発生が進行中（計119例）であり、異常性と重症度基準は満たすが、国際的拡大リスクや渡航制限の可能性が不明で、情報が部分的。続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事は局地的なデング熱の2つの集団発生（ハティン省）について報告しており、公衆衛生当局による能動的な対応措置が実施されている。死亡例は報告されていないが、119例の確認病例と継続的な媒介蚊の適応リスクが存在する。流行の規模拡大可能性や国際的波及の可能性については現時点では不明確であり、今後の病例数推移を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: इंदौर के खातीवाला टैंक में भी घातक ई-कोलाई बैक्टीरिया वाला पानी, पीने से बीमार हो रहे लोग
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Water containing deadly E. coli bacteria in Indore's Khatiwala Tank; people falling ill after drinking.
article.articleSummary: Escherichia coli contamination detected in Narmada river water supplied to Indore’s Khatiwala Tank (Rizwaani Udyan area). For about four months, residents allege taps have been delivering contaminated water that appears clear yet triggers fever, vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain, and infections after consumption. A local doctor arranged a private laboratory test, which confirmed the water is unfit for drinking. The report underscores ongoing exposure to the contaminated Narmada water via the Khatiwala Tank supply, with no deaths reported and no remediation actions described in the article. The incident highlights a serious drinking-water safety problem in Indore, pointing to the need for water-quality verification, source protection, and timely public health response until safe supply is restored.

triage.headline_ja: インドール市のカティワラ水槽で致命的な大腸菌を含む水が検出；飲用後に市民が発症
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で2つ以上該当（異常性・予想外性、重篤な公衆衛生影響）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当（異常性、長期曝露、管理可能性への懸念）。インド国内での重要な水道汚染事例として、続報監視とフルRRA進行の対象。
triage.notes: インドール市のカティワラ水槽供給システムにおけるE.coli汚染が4ヶ月間継続。現地医師による民間検査で確認済み。水道水経由での持続的曝露リスク、下痢・発熱・嘔吐などの複数症状報告あり。死亡報告はなし。水質管理体制の脆弱性と公衆衛生対応の必要性が指摘される。

article.articleHeadline: UMY Ingatkan Indonesia Perlu Siaga Hadapi Ancaman Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: UMY reminds Indonesia to stay vigilant against the Ebola threat.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo Ebola outbreak exceeds 1,000 reported cases with hundreds of deaths, prompting WHO to declare Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC). In Bantul, Yogyakarta, Indonesia, UMY lecturer Dr. Farindira Vesti Rahmasari warns that cross-border threat underscores global vigilance. Ebola transmission occurs via direct contact with blood, bodily fluids, or a deceased patient; high mobility raises cross-border spread risk. The PHEIC signals the need to strengthen early detection, reporting, and rapid response systems, not just counting cases. Indonesia, an archipelagic nation with multiple international entry points, should bolster health surveillance at airports, seaports, and transit corridors; monitor travelers from affected regions; ensure healthcare worker readiness, clear referral procedures, early warning systems, and laboratory capacity for swift detection. No Ebola cases have been reported in Indonesia to date, but preparedness requires a holistic health system approach—surveillance, quarantine, lab capacity, health worker protection, and effective public communication.

triage.headline_ja: UMY インドネシアにエボラ脅威への警戒態勢を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。DRC でのエボラ流行（1,000症例以上、数百の死亡、PHEIC宣言）が国境を越えた脅威として認識されており、インドネシアの警戒強化を促す記事内容。フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: DRC でのエボラ流行が主要なイベント。記事はインドネシアにおける警戒態勢強化の必要性を論じているもので、インドネシア国内での症例報告はまだなし。ただし国際的な脅威として両国を verified_locations に含める。WHO による PHEIC 宣言により国際的関心が極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Počet potvrdených prípadov eboly stúpol na 1155 - Svet SME
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of confirmed Ebola cases rose to 1,155 - World SME.
article.articleSummary: On June 26, 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo reported 1,155 confirmed Ebola cases and at least 304 deaths. Nearly all cases are concentrated in Ituri Province in the northeast, a conflict-affected region, with the outbreak also affecting North Kivu and South Kivu, collectively home to about 15 million people. The virus has spread to neighboring Uganda. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which there is no approved vaccine or specific treatment. Existing Ebola vaccines (developed in 2018–2019) protect only against the Zaire ebolavirus strain. The World Health Organization has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern and warned that the outbreak could last months.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスの確認患者数が1,155人に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。Bundibugyo ebolavirus による大規模流行で、WHO が国際的懸念事項の公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言し、複数国への国際的拡大が確認されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではウガンダへの拡大も言及されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。DRC は対象国リストに含まれており、South Kivu Province も同国内の地域であるため DRC のみを記載。Bundibugyo ebolavirus に対しては既存ワクチンが無効であることが懸念要因。

article.articleHeadline: RDC supera las 300 muertes por ébola con el 95% de camas ocupadas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC surpasses 300 Ebola deaths with 95% of beds occupied.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 300 deaths, with at least 304 fatalities among over 1,155 confirmed cases. As of 26 June 2026, health officials report a 95% bed occupancy nationwide, prompting calls to rapidly expand clinical capacity and establish new treatment centers. Bunia, capital of Ituri province—the hardest-hit area—will host early clinical trials next week for MBP134, an experimental Ebola drug, alongside remdesivir, whose supplies have arrived in DRC. The outbreak, caused by the Bundibugyo strain, continues to spread by contact with bodily fluids, and authorities note it is not yet at a peak; no vaccine or strain-specific treatment exists. In response, the government has imposed a 21-day travel quarantine for people moving from affected zones to other parts or abroad to enable contact tracing.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラで300人以上の死者 ベッド占有率95%
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス感染症で300人以上の死亡と1,155人以上の確定症例が報告され、医療システムが逼迫（ベッド占有率95%）し、国際的な実験薬試験が実施される。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株による重大な流行。医療容量の逼迫、実験的治療（MBP134）の導入、政府による渡航隔離措置の実施などから、国際的関心も極めて高い。フルRRA進行が必須。

article.articleHeadline: "साफ घर में नहीं आते मच्छर..." मां- बाप की इन गलतफहमी के कारण ही बच्चों को होता है Dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mosquitoes don't enter clean homes... It's because of these parental misconceptions that children get Dengue.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-26, Dengue remains a major risk in India during and after the monsoon, with the World Health Organization noting a global surge in dengue cases and India among the countries most affected. With no specific antiviral treatment, prevention and timely care are essential. The article emphasizes that mosquitoes breed even in clean homes: any standing water—fine for plant trays, water coolers, pet bowls, bird feeders, AC outlet pipes, rooftops, or blocked drains—can sustain Aedes populations. Mosquitoes do not discriminate by cleanliness, so risk extends to schools, parks, and day-care centers, requiring community vigilance. Early dengue symptoms mimic viral illness: high fever, body and head pains, retro-orbital pain, rash, and fatigue; vomiting and abdominal pain may occur. Fluids, rest, and medical monitoring are key, with urgent care for warning signs such as persistent vomiting, severe abdominal pain, bleeding, confusion, breathing trouble, or pale, clammy skin.

triage.headline_ja: 「清潔な家には蚊が入らない…」親のこうした誤解がため、子どもがデング熱になる
triage.triage_reason: インドのデング熱に関する教育・啓発記事であり、現在の流行状況と予防情報を提供している。スクリーニング基準（異常性・重症度の可能性）では該当の可能性があるが、具体的な発症者数、死亡数、新たなクラスター情報が記事に明記されていないため、情報不足として WATCH に分類する。
triage.notes: 記事はデング熱の季節的流行（モンスーン時期）とWHOによる世界的症例増加の言及があり、公衆衛生上の関心は存在する。しかし、具体的な患者数、重症度分布、死亡数などの疫学的データが提供されていない。本記事は啓発・教育コンテンツであり、新規発生情報ではなく、継続的な流行管理に関する記事と判断される。フルRRAの実施には追加の疫学情報が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Mehr als 300 Tote im Kongo, Kliniken beinahe voll
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 300 dead in the Congo, clinics nearly full.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo is worsening: confirmed cases are 1,155 with 304 deaths reported to date. Hospitals are overwhelmed, with about 95% of bed capacity reportedly exhausted. Africa CDC official Jean Kaseya urged rapid expansion of treatment centers and increased bed capacity to manage the surge. The escalation is notable, as in none of the continent's previous Ebola outbreaks were confirmed cases in the first five weeks so high. The report highlights severe capacity constraints and the urgent need for expanded isolation and care facilities to handle the growing number of patients in the DRC. It emphasizes the urgent need to prevent further deaths by expanding treatment capacity.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴで300人以上が死亡、診療所はほぼ満床
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラウイルスのDRC流行により、確認患者1,155人、死亡304人という深刻な状況。医療施設の容量逼迫、初期5週間での確認患者数が過去最高、国際的支援要請が明示されている。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病の急速な拡大。医療システムの圧倒的な逼迫（95%の病床占有率）、Africa CDC当局者による緊急的な処置センター拡張要求。過去のアウトブレイク比での異常な初期段階の拡大速度が確認されている。

article.articleHeadline: ВОЗ предупреждает о высоком риске заноса Эболы в Южный Судан
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO warns of a high risk of Ebola entering South Sudan.
article.articleSummary: WHO modeling puts a 70% probability that Ebola could be introduced into South Sudan, with researchers calling strengthening the response one of the most urgent priorities. The Democratic Republic of Congo’s ongoing Ebola outbreak has surpassed 1,000 confirmed cases and over 260 deaths and has spilled into Uganda, where Bundibugyo ebolavirus has caused 20 confirmed cases, two confirmed deaths, and one probable. South Sudan faces high risk due to weak public-health systems, gaps in case management, contact tracing, safe burials, and border surveillance. Rwanda and Burundi remain comparatively lower risk. Because no vaccine exists for Bundibugyo, neighboring countries should implement immediate measures such as border surveillance, contact tracing, and safe burial practices. Transmission reportedly began in regionally destabilized communities and went undetected until early April 2026, about six weeks before the WHO identified and declared a public health emergency of international concern (PHEIC).

triage.headline_ja: WHO、エボラがサウススーダンに流入する高いリスクを警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラの大規模多国間流行が進行中で、WHOがPHEICを宣言し、国際的拡大リスク（南スーダン侵入確率70%）と渡航・貿易制限のリスクが高い。
triage.notes: DRCでの確認された症例1,000件超、260人以上の死亡、ウガンダへの波及（Bundibugyo ebolavirus 20確認症例、2死亡）が報告されている。WHOは2026年4月初旬以降にPHEICを宣言。記事ではSouth Sudan、Rwanda、Burundi、Ugandaが言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみのため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。ワクチンが存在しないBundibugyo ebolavirus による脅威を強調。

article.articleHeadline: Chi decide cosa curare? Ebola e il mercato della salute globale
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Who decides what to treat? Ebola and the global health market.
article.articleSummary: By May 27, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, had 129 confirmed cases, over 1,000 suspected, and 246 deaths, with transmission via high-mobility mining and trade corridors in conflict zones; Uganda reported spread, and the World Health Organization declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern in mid-May 2026. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which there are no vaccines or approved treatments, unlike the Zaire variant with interventions. The article uses this crisis to critique the global health market, arguing that private pharma dominance, donor-driven funding to WHO, and patent regimes shape priorities away from equitable care, especially for diseases of the Global South. It cites Italy's experience—private long-term care facilities, expansion of pharma patents during the pandemic, and governance gaps—illustrating how health is treated as a market good rather than a public right.

triage.headline_ja: 誰が何を治療するか決めるのか？エボラと世界保健市場
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当する。2026年5月にコンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州でエボラアウトブレイク（129確認例、246死亡）が発生、ウガンダに波及し、WHOがPHEIC宣言した。ワクチンと治療法がないBundibugyo ebolavirus株による重篤な公衆衛生上の脅威である。
triage.notes: サマリーでは「Uganda reported spread」と述べられているが、対象国リストにUgandaは含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。イタリア言及は記事の論評コンテキストであり、アウトブレイク発生地ではないため除外。WHOのPHEIC宣言、複数国への波及、致死率の高さ、治療法不在により、極めて高いリスク評価が妥当である。

article.articleHeadline: L'OMS alerte sur le risque de propagation d'Ebola au Soudan du Sud
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO warns of the risk of Ebola transmission to South Sudan.
article.articleSummary: 1,000+ confirmed Ebola cases and over 260 deaths in the Democratic Republic of Congo have enabled spillover into Uganda (20 confirmed cases, 2 deaths, 1 probable death). The Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain is involved. The World Health Organization warns that South Sudan faces a 70% chance of the virus reaching its borders; urgent preparedness is needed to strengthen case management, rapid response, and cross-border surveillance amid weak health infrastructure and gaps in contact tracing, safe burials, and border monitoring. Rwanda and Burundi face comparatively lower risk. The absence of a vaccine for Bundibugyo ebolavirus underscores the need for immediate non-pharmaceutical measures such as border surveillance, contact tracing, and safe burial practices to curb spread. Researchers believe community transmission began in a conflict-affected, displaced region and went undetected until April 2026, about six weeks before WHO identified it as a PHEIC.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、南スーダンへのエボラ出血熱の伝播リスクについて警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な死亡と高い患者数、予想外の地域での多国スピルオーバー、国際的拡大の高リスク70%、渡航制限可能性）。WPRO基準も5項目全て該当（複数国での異常なスピルオーバー、高い重症度と死亡率、継続的な曝露と広範囲の影響、高い流行可能性、弱体な保健インフラでの管理能力不足）。PHEIC宣言済みの公衆衛生上の重大事象。
triage.notes: 記事は主にDRC内でのエボラ流行とウガンダへのスピルオーバーを主題としており、DRC以外の国（スーダン南部、ルワンダ、ブルンジ、ウガンダ）は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCのみが verified_locations に該当。本イベントはWHOによるPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）として既に認識されている。

article.articleHeadline: Epidémia eboly v Konžskej demokratickej republike si vyžiadala už viac ako 300 obetí
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola epidemic in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has already claimed more than 300 lives.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-26, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has 1,155 confirmed cases and at least 304 deaths. Nearly all cases are concentrated in Ituri province in the northeast, a region plagued by long-standing conflict, with the outbreak affecting three provinces—Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu—home to roughly 15 million people. The virus has spread to neighboring Uganda. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no vaccine or specific treatment. Current Ebola vaccines developed in 2018–2019 are only effective against the Zaire strain. The World Health Organization has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern and warned the epidemic could last for months.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行、既に300人以上の死亡者を出している
triage.triage_reason: IHR Annex2基準4項目すべてに該当し、WHOが国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言。大規模な感染と死亡、国際的拡大（ウガンダ）、既存ワクチン無効なBundibugyo株による流行という極めて深刻な状況。
triage.notes: DRCでの大規模エボラ流行を報告。1,155確認症例、304死亡（死亡率26%超）。Ituri、North Kivu、South Kuvuの3州で約1,500万人が影響下にある。既存ワクチン無効なBundibugyo株。隣国ウガンダへの拡大確認。WHOが国際公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言済み。数ヶ月の流行予測。紛争地域での管理困難性。

article.articleHeadline: WHO-tanulmány: jelentős az ebola átterjedésének kockázata Dél-Szudánra
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO study: Significant risk of Ebola transmission to South Sudan.
article.articleSummary: A June 26, 2026 WHO modeling study estimates a 70% chance Ebola will reach South Sudan. The ongoing Democratic Republic of the Congo outbreak caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus has surpassed 1,000 confirmed cases and 260+ deaths and has spread to Uganda, which reports 20 confirmed cases, 2 confirmed deaths, and 1 probable death. South Sudan is flagged as the next most at-risk country, but it has one of the region’s weakest public health infrastructures, with deficiencies in case management, contact tracing, safe burials, and cross-border surveillance. Researchers urge strengthening infection prevention and control, rapid response capacity, and cross-border monitoring; Rwanda and Burundi face relatively lower risk. Because there is no vaccine for Bundibugyo, neighboring countries should deploy border surveillance, contact tracing, and safe burial practices now. The outbreak likely began in conflict-displaced communities with limited health access and was largely unnoticed in early April 2026—about six weeks before WHO formally identified and declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern.

triage.headline_ja: WHO研究：エボラのウガンダ・南スーダン拡大リスク、コンゴで1000例超確認
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、Bundibugyo ebolavirus による多国間にまたがる大規模流行が進行中。WHOが公式に国際的懸念事項の公衆衛生上の緊急事態(PHEIC)を宣言し、複数国での確認症例と死亡が報告されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づく地域検証：DRC（1000例超、260+死亡）とウガンダ（20確認例、2死亡）での確認流行が記載されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。南スーダン・ルワンダ・ブルンジはモデリング予測の対象であり、実際の発生地域ではないため除外。本流行はWHOによりPHEIC宣言済み（2026年6月、フォーマル宣言は4月から約6週間後）。Bundibugyo ebolavirus にはワクチンがなく、国境監視強化が急務とされている。

article.articleHeadline: DSÖ: Ebola'nın Güney Sudan'a sıçrama riski yüksek

article.articleHeadline: Oms: alto rischio di diffusione dell'Ebola in Sud Sudan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: High risk of Ebola transmission in South Sudan.
article.articleSummary: WHO modeling indicates a 70% probability that Bundibugyo ebolavirus Ebola will reach South Sudan, based on a modeling study published in The Lancet, underscoring the urgent need to strengthen cross-border prevention and rapid response. triage.headline_ja: WHO：エボラウイルスが南スーダンに拡大するリスクが高い
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。高い致死率を持つエボラウイルスの国際的拡大が予測されており、複数国への影響が確認されている。
