article.articleHeadline: WHO warnt vor hoher Ebola-Gefahr für Südsudan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO warns of high Ebola risk for South Sudan.

The DRC outbreak has surpassed 1,000 confirmed cases and 260 deaths and has spread to Uganda, where 20 infections, 2 confirmed deaths, and 1 probable death have been reported. Until a vaccine for Bundibugyo exists, measures such as border controls, contact tracing, and safe burial practices should be implemented. The outbreak began in conflict-affected regions with limited health access and remained undetected until April 2026, about six weeks before WHO identified it and declared an emergency.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、スーダン南部への高いエボラ危機を警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラウイルスの確定例1000件超、死亡260件超の大規模流行であり、複数国への既染拡大と追加拡大の予測があり、対象国DRCで実際の流行が発生している。

article.articleHeadline: La OMS alerta de alto riesgo de propagación del ébola a Sudán del Sur

triage.headline_ja: WHOがエボラ出血熱のスーダンへの拡大の高いリスクを警告

article.articleHeadline: Κονγκό: Ανησυχία για την επιτάχυνση της μετάδοσης του Έμπολα - 1.155 κρούσματα και 304 θάνατοι
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo: Concern over accelerating Ebola transmission - 1,155 cases and 304 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 37 new Ebola cases and 5 deaths within 24 hours as transmission accelerates under the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain. The current outbreak, declared May 15, is the 17th in the DRC, a country of about 100 million. Bundibugyo is rarer and has no specific treatment or vaccine, unlike most prior outbreaks caused by the Zaire strain for which a vaccine exists. Health authorities say improved epidemiological surveillance enabled earlier detection and confirm a sustained weekly rise in transmission. Ebola has killed at least 15,000 people in Africa over the past five decades, with a case-fatality rate ranging from 25% to 90% per WHO. In the 2018–2020 DRC outbreak, nearly 2,300 died among ~3,500 cases. Authorities suspect the virus circulated undetected before the outbreak was declared.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ：エボラ伝播の加速に懸念 - 1,155例と304死亡例
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラウイルス病は公衆衛生上の深刻な影響を持ち、Bundibugyo株による急速な感染拡大は異常かつ予想外。国際的拡大リスク及び渡航・貿易制限のリスクが高い。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus株による現在の流行は2026年5月15日に宣言されたDRC第17番目のエボラ流行。特定の治療法またはワクチンが存在しない株であることが特に懸念される。24時間以内に37例の新規患者と5死亡が報告され、感染が加速している状況。WHOによるEBOLAに関する定義では致死率25-90%であり、公衆衛生上の重大リスク。

article.articleHeadline: Leptospirosis cases up by 6%
article.articleSummary: Leptospirosis cases in the Philippines rose 6% in early 2026, with 2,177 cases reported Jan 1–Jun 6, up from 2,046 in the same period of 2025. The Department of Health notes a majority involve farmers and others who frequently wade in floodwater during the rainy season. Leptospirosis is a bacterial infection transmitted by animals, especially rodents, and their waste, through contaminated soil, floodwater, and vegetation. Prevention centers on avoiding swimming or wading in floodwaters and using boots and gloves. Symptoms include fever, muscle pain, headache, calf pain, reddish eyes, yellowish skin discoloration, dark-colored urine, pale stools, low urine output, and severe headache. Individuals with symptoms should seek early medical consultation and take antibiotics prescribed by a physician. The update reflects ongoing surveillance during the 2026 rainy season in the Philippines.

triage.headline_ja: レプトスピラ症の症例が6%増加
triage.triage_reason: フィリピンでのレプトスピラ症の症例増加（6%）が報告されており、WPRoスクリーニング基準（異常/予想外、長期曝露の可能性）で1つ以上該当するが、IHR基準は明確には2つ以上該当しない。情報がやや限定的であるため、経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: レプトスピラ症は風土病的性質が強く、フィリピンの雨季におけるルーチン監視の一環である。死亡や重症の記述がないため深刻度は低い。しかし、農民や水路労働者への継続的な曝露リスク、そして症例数の年間増加傾向が認識されている。フィリピン保健省による主動的な監視があることが確認される。

article.articleHeadline: Soudan du Sud : un risque élevé de propagation d'Ebola, selon une étude de l'OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: South Sudan: a high risk of Ebola transmission, according to a WHO study.
article.articleSummary: More than 1,000 confirmed Ebola cases and over 260 deaths have been reported in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with transmission reaching neighboring Uganda (about 20 confirmed cases, 2 deaths, 1 probable). A WHO modeling study published in The Lancet estimates it is highly probable the outbreak will reach South Sudan, which has some of the region's weakest public health infrastructures, citing gaps in case management, contact tracing, safe burials, and border surveillance. Rwanda and Burundi face comparatively lower risk. With no vaccine for Bundibugyo ebolavirus, authorities should implement immediate public health measures including border surveillance, contact tracing, and safe burial practices, and strengthen infection prevention, rapid response, and cross-border surveillance. The epidemic likely began spreading in conflict-affected communities with displacement and limited health access and remained undetected until early April 2026, about six weeks before WHO identified it and declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern.

triage.headline_ja: 南スーダン：WHOの研究によるとエボラ出血熱の高い伝播リスク
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱は国際的に極めて重大な感染症で、既に複数国での確認、死亡例報告、国際的拡大の高いリスク、対象国DRCが主要発生地で南スーダンへの拡大が懸念されている。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでの1,000件以上の確認例と260人以上の死亡を報告し、ウガンダへの拡大を明記。南スーダンは見出しと本文で高リスク地域として言及されているが、実際の発症例の報告はなく、WHOモデル予測に基づく警告である。DRCが確定した発生地域であり対象国リストに含まれるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。エボラ出血熱による複数国での確認例、死亡例、国際的拡大リスク、公開衛生インフラ整備の不足が報告されており、IHR基準すべて該当し、即座のフルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Έμπολα: 304 θάνατοι στη ΛΔ Κονγκό - Πάνω από χίλια τα επιβεβαιωμένα κρούσματα
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: 304 deaths in DR Congo - Over a thousand confirmed cases.
article.articleSummary: As of 26 June 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo reports 1,155 Ebola cases and 304 deaths, with 37 new cases and 5 new deaths in the last 24 hours. The outbreak, declared on 15 May, is driven by the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain—a rarer form for which there is no specific treatment or vaccine. Past DR Congo outbreaks largely involved the Zaïre (Zaire) strain for which a vaccine exists. Authorities say the virus likely circulated undetected for some time before detection, and improved epidemiological surveillance has enabled earlier case identification, though transmission continues to rise weekly. Ebola has killed at least 15,000 people in Africa over five decades, with case fatality rates between 25% and 90%; the most deadly DR Congo outbreak (2018–2020) caused about 2,300 deaths among ~3,500 cases.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：コンゴ民主共和国で304人の死亡 - 確認された症例は1000人以上
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全てに該当。エボラウイルスの大規模流行で1,155症例・304死亡。ワクチンがない希少なBundibugyo株による流行であり、国際的拡大リスク極めて高く、緊急のフルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus株はZaïre株（既存ワクチンあり）と異なる希少株。ワクチン・特異的治療なしという深刻な状況。過去の大規模流行（2018-2020）では約2,300死亡の実績がある。流行は5月15日に宣言されており、既に1か月以上経過。継続的な週単位の上昇傾向が報告されており、早急な介入が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 'ഡെങ്കിപ്പനിയായിരുന്നു, ബജറ്റായതിനാൽ സഭയിലെത്തി'; ചർച്ചയ്ക്കിടെ ഉറങ്ങിയോ?: മറുപടിയുമായി എംഎൽഎ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 'It was dengue, he attended the Assembly due to the budget'; Did he fall asleep during the discussion?: MLA's response.
article.articleSummary: Kerala MLA C.K. Hareendran of Parassala states he was treated for dengue fever for a week at Neyyattinkara Hospital and nonetheless attended the Kerala Legislative Assembly for budget discussions. A short video from the assembly circulating on social media allegedly shows him sleeping during proceedings; Hareendran dismisses it as a selective, politically motivated clip and says he participated in budget debates and raised Parassala-related issues despite illness. He emphasizes that public duties compelled his attendance and that physical fatigue from dengue is real, but health should not be weaponized for politics. He thanks supporters and colleagues, pledging to continue serving the public with the same dedication while condemning attempts to misuse his health status for political attacks.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱だった、予算審議のため議会に出席；討論中に眠ったのか？：MLA（州議会議員）の反論
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は個別の政治家の健康問題と議会出席に関する政治的論争であり、感染症のアウトブレイク、多数の患者発生、公衆衛生対策の必要性を示す公式なイベント情報ではない。デング熱そのものへの言及は、事例報告ではなく個人の病歴説明に過ぎず、シグナルとしての疫学的根拠を欠いている。
triage.notes: 記事はケーララ州の議員個人がデング熱から回復して議会に出席したことに関する政治的論争であり、感染症イベント監視の対象外。デング熱の流行状況、患者数、公衆衛生対応に関する実質的な情報はなく、個人の健康問題が政治的に利用されているという内容である。Bluedot APIが記事を「デング」キーワードで拾った可能性があるが、疫学的シグナルではない。

article.articleHeadline: Vietnamese peacekeepers support Ebola prevention efforts in Abyei
article.articleSummary: Vietnam's Engineering Company Rotation 4, serving with the United Nations Interim Security Force for Abyei (UNISFA), organized a community outreach program to prevent the spread of Ebola in Abyei, providing medical supplies and health education to local residents amid a worsening Ebola outbreak in Africa. The effort, conducted in close coordination with local health authorities, aims to establish emergency preventive measures to safeguard residents of Abyei. With the June start of Abyei’s rainy season, prolonged heavy rainfall has caused flooding and contamination of water sources, creating conditions favorable to infectious disease spread. Children and older people are particularly vulnerable, while poor transport infrastructure has disrupted supplies of medical equipment and personal protective gear, increasing infection risks for frontline health workers. No specific Ebola case counts are provided in the report.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナム平和維持軍がアビエイのエボラ予防活動を支援
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病は国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、複数のWPRO基準に該当する可能性がある。ただし、記事はアフリカでの発生状況を背景としており、実際の確定患者数や直接的な感染拡大の証拠が記載されていないため、情報不足の状態で保留。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域フィールドにVietnamが含まれているが、記事サマリーはアフリカ（スーダン・アビエイ）でのエボラ発生とベトナム平和維持軍による支援活動についてのみ述べており、ベトナムでの感染症イベント発生は記載されていない。したがって verified_locations は空配列とした。対象国リストにはスーダンが含まれていないため、地域検証ルールに従い含めない。IHR基準2つ以上該当するため本来的にはPICKUP対象の基準を満たすが、記事の主題が対象国外での発生であり、確定患者数も不明である点から、追加情報の確認まで WATCH 判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: Франція визнала та підтвердила перший випадок зараження вірусом Еболи
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: France acknowledged and confirmed the first case of infection with the Ebola virus.
article.articleSummary: As of 26 June 2026, France confirmed its first Ebola virus infection case in a doctor who returned from a humanitarian mission in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). The diagnosis was made on mainland France. The patient is in isolation and health authorities are tracing contacts to curb potential transmission. The French Ministry of Health described the overall risk to the European population as low. The World Health Organization had, in May, raised the outbreak risk in the DRC to very high at the national level. By contrast, neighboring Uganda reported that measures in place were effective in limiting the spread of the virus.

triage.headline_ja: フランスがエボラウイルス感染の最初の症例を認定・確認
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（重篤な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラウイルスの国際的流出事例であり、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: フランスで確認された症例はDRCからの帰国者であり、本シグナルは対象国リストに含まれるDRCが疫学的震源地である。ウガンダも発生地域に含まれるが、記事サマリーではウガンダの対策有効性が述べられているのみで、新規患者報告なし。したがってverified_locationsはDRCのみ。エボラは致死性が高く、国際的拡大リスクが著しく、即座にフルRRA着手を推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Limitações críticas ameaçam ampliar propagação do ebola conforme casos ultrapassam 1.000
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Critical Limitations Threaten to Widen the Spread of Ebola as Cases Surpass 1,000
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri province) and Uganda surpasses 1,000 cases, with DRC reporting 1,094 cases and 277 deaths and Uganda 20 cases with 2 deaths; 387 patients in isolation or treatment, 115 recovered. Ituri remains the epicenter with over 90% of cases. The spread is worsened by insecurity, mass displacement (over 900,000 displaced/refugees), cross-border movement, and attacks on health facilities. No licensed vaccine or therapy exists for the Bundibugyo strain; ring vaccination is not feasible, so containment relies on classic public health measures: early detection, rapid isolation, contact tracing (only ~12% of contacts actively followed), safe burials, infection prevention, community engagement, and coordination. Testing capacity has improved to ~24-hour results (from 5–8 days). Eleven other African countries are at high risk; there is an urgent need for intra-African and global solidarity and resources to scale response.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ感染症の感染者が1,000人を超える中、重大な制限が感染拡大を広げる脅威となっている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つすべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の大規模流行、国際的な越境拡大リスク、渡航制限のリスク）。WPRO基準でも5つすべて該当。社会的・政治的関心も極めて高い。フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴ民主共和国（Ituri州）とウガンダでの越境流行を述べているが、対象国リストはコンゴのみ。1,000人超の確定症例、277死亡（DRC）、保健施設への攻撃、90万人以上の避難民・難民、Bundibugyo株に対するワクチン/治療薬なし、接触者追跡率約12%、11他国への高リスク等、極めて深刻な状況。緊急の国際支援が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : 21 jours de quarantaine imposés après un cas importé en France chez un médecin d'Ituri
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: 21-day quarantine imposed after an imported case in France under the care of a doctor from Ituri.
article.articleSummary: A 21-day quarantine is imposed on anyone arriving from Ebola-affected zones after a health-care professional who had worked in Ituri, DRC, tested positive for Bundibugyo Ebola virus in France. The doctor, an ALIMA-recruited intensivist at Centre Médical Évangélique de Rwampara, worked May 22–June 19, 2026 in an Ebola treatment center before traveling via Kinshasa to France on June 23, 2026. The government notes that Ebola transmission requires direct contact and that an infected person is contagious only when symptomatic, underscoring rigorous epidemiological follow-up to identify and monitor contacts. Kinshasa and Paris are coordinating data sharing for contact tracing in both countries and enforcing 21-day exposure monitoring. Enhanced surveillance remains at major checkpoints, including Bunia and Kinshasa airports, with rapid isolation, sampling, and laboratory confirmation under International Health Regulations to prevent secondary transmission.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱、DRC：イトゥリ出身の医師がフランスで輸入症例を報告、21日間の隔離を実施
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo型）の国際的な確認症例であり、IHR基準3項目該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。重症度が高く、多国間での対応が進行中であるため、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCおよびフランスの地理情報を言及しているが、実際の感染症イベント発生地はDRCのイトゥリ地域であり、フランスは輸入症例（一次接触者）の発生地。対象国リストはDRCのみ該当。Bundibugyo Ebola virusは高致死率で、医療従事者の職業曝露および国際的な移動に伴う二次感染リスクが実証された。多国間調整（キンシャサ・パリ間）と強化サーベイランスが既に実施されている。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo's Historic World Cup Goal Sparks Hope Amid Ebola Crisis
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-26, DR Congo earned its first World Cup point after Yoane Wissa's equaliser against Portugal in Houston, claiming the country's first-ever World Cup goal. The moment brought rare joy to Bunia, capital of Ituri Province, amid the 17th Ebola outbreak that has infected more than 1,100 people and caused 279 deaths across DR Congo and Uganda, with Bunia accounting for a significant share. Despite public-health restrictions on large gatherings, fans packed bars and viewing centers, some disinfecting on return amid infection fears. Head coach Sébastien Desabre praised the team's prideful representation as the nation united, invoking memories of Zaire's 1974 campaign. Bunia continues to face Ebola transmission and armed-group violence in Ituri; initial screen failures delayed viewing, but celebrations prevailed.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のワールドカップ歴史的ゴール、エボラ危機の中で希望を生む
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の感在流行がDRC・ウガンダで確認され、1,100人以上の感染者、279人の死亡が報告されている。公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的な懸念があり、IHR基準およびWPRO基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事はワールドカップイベントを主題としているが、DRCとウガンダで進行中の17次エボラウイルス病流行の現状が報道されている。Ituri州Buniaは流行の中心地であり、相当数の感染者・死亡者が報告されている。ウガンダも流行に関連していると述べられているが、詳細が限定的であるため verified_locations にはDRCのみを含める。公開衛生上の制限にもかかわらず大規模集会が実施されており、感染拡大のリスクが懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus Leptospirosis di Pati Melonjak, Dinkes Minta Warga Waspada
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Leptospirosis cases in Pati surge; Health Office urges residents to be vigilant.
article.articleSummary: Leptospirosis cases in Pati Regency, Indonesia, have surged, prompting the Dinas Kesehatan to urge vigilance. The health office attributes the spike to environmental exposure in wet areas such as flood zones, rice fields, and drainage where rats contaminate water with infected urine. Transmission occurs when bacteria enter the body through open wounds, prolonged skin exposure to water, or mucous membranes. Recognize symptoms: sudden fever, headache, muscle aches (calves), red eyes, nausea, vomiting, and generalized weakness. Residents who develop symptoms after activities in wet environments should promptly seek care; early treatment is key to preventing deterioration. Preventive measures include wearing protective gear (boots, gloves), covering wounds, cleaning drains, securing food storage, proper trash disposal, and rodent control around homes. Do not delay medical evaluation for suspicious symptoms to prevent spread.

triage.headline_ja: パティ県のレプトスピラ症症例が急増、保健局が住民に警戒を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアでのレプトスピラ症の症例増加が報告されており、WPROスクリーニング基準（異常/予想外、長期曝露、流行しやすさ）で複数該当。ただし、死亡数や重症度、国際的拡大のリスク等の詳細情報が不足しているため、続報を注視する段階と判定。
triage.notes: パティ県での症例急増は異常事象として報告されている。環境曝露（洪水地域、水田、排水路）が原因とされており、長期的な曝露リスクと人人感染の可能性がある。ただし、総症例数、死亡数、重症度など定量的リスク指標が記事に記載されていないため、IHR基準の評価は限定的。続報で具体的な患者数や重症度が判明すればPICKUP対象となる可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: தமிழ்நாடு முழுவதும் நாளை மறுநாள் போலியோ சொட்டு மருந்து முகாம்
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Polio drops campaign across Tamil Nadu tomorrow and the day after.
article.articleSummary: Polio vaccination campaign across Tamil Nadu is scheduled for tomorrow and the day after, June 27–28, 2026. The Department of Medical Services and Public Health announced that polio drops will be administered at 43,051 centers across the state, including all government primary health centers, government hospitals, Anganwadi centers, schools, and other key locations. This government-led mass immunization drive leverages the public health infrastructure to reach children in both urban and rural areas. The initiative emphasizes wide access points within government facilities and educational institutions to maximize coverage during the two-day operation and seeks to ensure broad immunization against polio across Tamil Nadu.

triage.headline_ja: タミル・ナードゥ州全域でのポリオ経口ワクチン接種キャンペーン（明日と翌日）
triage.triage_reason: 本件は定期的な予防接種キャンペーンであり、ポリオの患者発生やアウトブレイクではない。公衆衛生上の異常事象ではなく、予定された公衆衛生施策であるため、IHR基準およびWPRO基準のいずれにも該当しない。
triage.notes: 本件はポリオ患者の発生報告ではなく、タミル・ナードゥ州で実施される定期的なポリオ予防接種キャンペーンの告知である。公衆衛生上の危機管理対象となるシグナルではなく、通常の予防接種プログラムである。

article.articleHeadline: Historic World Cup goal brings rare joy to DR Congo Ebola epicentre
article.articleSummary: DR Congo’s 17th Ebola virus disease outbreak, centered in Bunia, Ituri province, has infected over 1,100 people and caused 279 deaths in DRC and Uganda, according to the World Health Organization. In Bunia, Congolese figures report 275 cases and 44 deaths, though testing capacity remains limited. The outbreak shapes daily life in the northeast, where armed groups linked to Islamic State and local militias fuel insecurity. Authorities had restricted gatherings to 50 people at the end of May to curb transmission. Amid the gloom, a rare joy arrived when Yoane Wissa scored for DR Congo in a 2026 World Cup match against Portugal, giving the nation its first World Cup point and lifting spirits in Bunia, the Ebola epicentre. The scene highlights how sport intersects with public health crises in volatile regions.

triage.headline_ja: 歴史的なワールドカップゴールがDRコンゴのエボラウイルス中心地に稀な喜びをもたらす
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の17次流行で1,100人以上が感染、279人が死亡し、DRC・ウガンダでの国際的拡大も確認。重症疾患で高い公衆衛生インパクトと渡航制限リスクが存在。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年の仮想シナリオとして作成されたものと推察されるが、エボラ出血熱の医学的情報は現実的。DRCが主流行地であり、ウガンダへの国際的拡大も報告されている。武装勢力による不安定性が対策を複雑化させている。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。ポルトガルはスポーツコンテキストの言及のみで、実際の発生地ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: ارتفاع صادم في إصابات إيبولا بالكونغو إلى أكثر من ألف حالة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Shocking rise in Ebola cases in Congo to more than one thousand.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has risen to 1,155 laboratory-confirmed cases and 304 deaths, according to government data released on Thursday. Over the previous 24 hours up to Wednesday, 37 new infections and 5 additional deaths were reported, signaling ongoing transmission in the region. Health authorities attributed the trend to intensified epidemiological and biological surveillance, which they say has improved early detection of cases. Despite these efforts, the data indicate that transmission among the population is increasing on a weekly basis, and the overall situation remains dangerous. The report underscores the need for sustained control measures and active outbreak response to stem further spread within the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ患者数が衝撃的に増加、1000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス病は公衆衛生上の重大な影響を持ち、1,155確定患者・304死亡の発生は異常、国際的な拡大リスクが高く、渡航・貿易制限につながる可能性が高い。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病は指定感染症であり、1,155確定患者と304死亡という数字は深刻な状況を示している。過去24時間で37新規患者・5新規死亡が報告されており、継続的な伝播が示唆されている。DRC内での人口間の伝播が週ベースで増加しており、地域的な管理努力にもかかわらず状況は危険な状態にある。

article.articleHeadline: Concern Grows in Congo, 1,155 Confirmed Ebola Cases and More Than 300 Deaths
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of Congo, Ebola outbreaks continue with 1,155 confirmed cases and 304 deaths as of the latest bulletin. Over the past 24 hours, 37 new cases and 5 deaths were recorded, signaling ongoing spread. Declared May 15, the current outbreak is linked to the Budibugio strain, for which there is no specific treatment or vaccine. Unlike the Zaire variant, which has a vaccine, Budibugio is considered harder to control. Health authorities note that enhanced epidemiological surveillance has aided earlier detection, but transmission persists and may have circulated undetected before declaration, complicating contact tracing. Ebola remains among Africa's deadliest diseases, with a World Health Organization-estimated mortality range of 25% to 90%. The report underscores the need for strengthened public health measures to contain this outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでの懸念が高まる、エボラ患者1,155人確認、死者300人超
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。致死率の高いエボラ出血熱の活発な流行であり、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク、公衆衛生への重大な影響がある。
triage.notes: DRCで報告されているエボラは治療法やワクチンがないBudibugio株。過去24時間で37例の新規患者と5人の死亡が記録されており、継続的な拡大が確認されている。死亡率25～90%の致死的疾患であり、接触者追跡が複雑化している点も懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Qindra të vdekur nga Ebola në Kongo, alarm për versionin Budibugio
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hundreds dead from Ebola in Congo, alarm over Budibugio variant.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo continues, driven by the Budibugio variant. Laboratory-confirmed cases reach 1,155 with 304 deaths. In the last 24 hours, 37 new cases and 5 additional deaths were reported, signaling sustained transmission and ongoing escalation. The outbreak was officially declared on May 15 and currently lacks a specific treatment or vaccine for Budibugio; by contrast, most past epidemics were caused by the Zaire variant for which a vaccine exists. Health authorities acknowledge improved epidemiological surveillance has enabled earlier detection but also confirm continued weekly transmission. WHO notes Ebola has caused at least 15,000 deaths in Africa over five decades, with mortality rates ranging from 25% to 90% depending on variant and outbreak conditions. The worst DRC outbreak occurred 2018–2020 with about 3,500 cases and roughly 2,300 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラにより数百人が死亡、ブディブギオ型の懸念が高まる
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラ出血熱の確認患者1,155名・死亡304名（致死率26%）、新規治療法・ワクチンが存在しない新型亜種による大規模流行、継続的なヒト-ヒト感染、国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限リスク顕著。フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 新規亜種ブディブギオ型によるエボラ出血熱の大規模流行。既存ワクチン（ザイール型用）が効果不明。継続的な週間ベースでの感染報告。アフリカ地域への記載は地域的背景情報であり、主要なイベント発生国はDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Rusvai Miklós: ha Magyarországra is bekerül az ebola, az egyenesen Közép-Afrikából érkezik
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Miklós Rusvai: If Ebola were to reach Hungary, it would come straight from Central Africa.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-06-26, Hungarian virologist Miklós Rusvai notes Ebola spreading in Central Africa, with Congo recording over 1,000 infections and at least 260 deaths. Europe has identified the first infected person in France. For Hungary, importation would most likely come from the Central African region (Congo) via missionaries or healthcare workers returning home after treatment; family caregiving in Africa facilitates local spread. Transmission is through body fluids; a sneeze is unlikely to cause spread, especially with isolation, but close contact remains risk. Early symptoms are non-specific; fever can mimic malaria. Treatment is supportive—rehydration, bleeding control, pain relief—with no widely available antiviral for the current Bundibugyo lineage, though vaccines exist for a past outbreak strain and a current vaccine is under development. Mortality is under 10% in well-equipped European hospitals, versus 30–70% in Africa depending on conditions.

triage.headline_ja: ハンガリー国立獣医研究所のルスヴァイ・ミクロシュ博士: もしエボラがハンガリーに到達するとすれば、それは中央アフリカから直接もたらされるだろう
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの中央アフリカでの流行（コンゴで1,000感染以上、260死亡以上）が報告され、ヨーロッパでも最初の感染者がフランスで確認されている。IHR基準では国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクが認められ、WPROスクリーニング基準では重症度と管理可能性において懸念がある。
triage.notes: Bluedotが報告した発生地域にはハンガリーとフランスも含まれているが、記事サマリーではこれらの国での実際の流行発生を示さず、むしろ「伝播の可能性」についての専門家コメントである。したがってverified_locationsはコンゴのみに限定した。中央アフリカでの急速な流行拡大、ヨーロッパでの初確認患者、治療法の限定性、死亡率の高さなどの要因がフルRRA進行を正当化する。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Salmonella, focolaio in Europa legato ai germogli di erba medica: 109 casi e un decesso
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Salmonella outbreak in Europe linked to alfalfa sprouts: 109 cases and one death.
article.articleSummary: Salmonella Bovismorbificans linked to alfalfa sprouts caused a multinational outbreak from January–May 2026, with 109 confirmed cases across Austria, Belgium, Czech Republic, Denmark, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Luxembourg, Spain, the Netherlands and the United Kingdom. Eighteen people were hospitalized and one death occurred. Epidemiological and microbiological investigations traced the source to sprouted alfalfa seeds; the epidemic strain was detected in water used for sprout production in the Netherlands and Northern Ireland, with a Finnish producer also implicated. A common seed supplier was identified; the implicated seeds were imported from India, suggesting contamination before entering the European market. To contain the outbreak, authorities recalled sprout products, withdrew affected seed lots, and destroyed suspect batches, with case numbers subsequently declining. As of June, no new cases were reported; consumer risk is low-to-moderate, but continued surveillance and strict hygiene guidance are advised.

triage.headline_ja: ヨーロッパでのサルモネラ菌集団発生（アルファルファモヤシ関連）：109例と1死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当（深刻な健康影響：109例1死亡、予想外：多国間での食品関連集団発生、国際的拡大：11カ国、渡航・貿易制限のリスク：種子・食品リコール）。WPRO基準も複数該当し、社会的・政治的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づき、ヨーロッパ（オーストリア、ベルギー、チェコ、デンマーク、フィンランド、ドイツ、アイルランド、ルクセンブルク、スペイン、オランダ、イギリス）での集団発生が説明されているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはインドのみ。汚染された種子の供給元がインドであり、ヨーロッパでの産業化・増殖が発生地。109例・入院18例・死亡1例という重症度、インド発症種子による広域汚染の特性、複数国での同時流行という特異性から、シグナルとしてピックアップされるべき事象である。

article.articleHeadline: പിടിയിലൊതുങ്ങാതെ പകർച്ചവ്യാധികൾ; പുതുതായി 17 മലേറിയ, 25 എലിപ്പനി കേസുകൾ | Infectious diseases; 17 new malaria and 25 leptospirosis cases
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uncontained infectious diseases; 17 new malaria and 25 leptospirosis cases.
article.articleSummary: Kerala reports 17 new malaria and 25 leptospirosis cases yesterday, with 17 malaria infections imported from outside the state. This year Kerala has recorded 401 malaria cases, including 91 in the current month, and two malaria-related deaths. Idukki district accounts for the majority with 14 cases; other malaria cases include Kattappana (1), Palakkad Kadambazhipuram (2), Kasaragod Manjeshwaram (1). Leptospirosis cases were reported across several districts yesterday; districts noting cases include Thiruvananthapuram, Kollam, Pathanamthitta, Idukki, Kottayam, Alappuzha, Ernakulam, Kozhikode, and Kannur. Shigellosis declined to six cases today, for a state total of 248; cases reported in Neyyattinkara (Thiruvananthapuram), Chathannoor (Kollam), Thrikkunnupuzha (Alappuzha), and Chethalayam (Wayanad). Malaria is transmitted by Anopheles mosquitoes; five Plasmodium species cause it. Symptoms include fever, chills, vomiting, altered mental status; diagnosis by blood and CSF. Prevention emphasizes mosquito control, removing standing water, covering wells/tanks, bed nets, and indoor spraying.

triage.headline_ja: 抑制されない感染症。マラリア17件、ねずみ咬傷熱25件の新規患者報告
triage.triage_reason: インドのケーララ州で複数の感染症（マラリア、レプトスピラ症、シゲラ菌症）が同時に報告されており、WPROスクリーニング基準で異常性（複数疾患の同時発生）、重症度（死亡例あり）、流行しやすさ（蚊媒介感染症）の3基準を満たす。社会的・政治的関心も高く、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: ケーララ州における複数の感染症の同時発生。マラリア年間401件（死亡2件）、レプトスピラ症25件、シゲラ菌症248件累計との報告。蚊媒介感染症（マラリア）と環境汚染関連感染症（レプトスピラ症）が同時に複数地域に広がっており、公衆衛生上の懸念が高い。

article.articleHeadline: السعودية تعلق السفر والدخول للقادمين من ثلاث دول إفريقية ضمن إجراءات احترازية لمواجهة "إيبولا"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Saudi Arabia suspends travel and entry for arrivals from three African countries as part of precautionary measures to combat Ebola.
article.articleSummary: As of 26 June 2026, Saudi Arabia suspended travel and entry for arrivals from the Democratic Republic of Congo, Uganda, and the Republic of South Sudan as a precaution against Ebola virus disease (EVD). The ban extends to visa issuance of all types and entry for travelers from these countries, including those arriving via other nations who have stayed in one of these countries within the preceding 21 days. Health-risk monitoring and response systems are said to be continuously operating to protect public health domestically and globally. Officials report that the general health situation in the country is reassuring and that no confirmed or suspected Ebola cases have been recorded since the precautionary measures began. The move follows tightened measures for travelers from neighboring outbreak regions: Rwanda, Burundi, Tanzania, and the Republic of the Congo (Brazzaville).

triage.headline_ja: サウジアラビア、エボラウイルス病対策として3つのアフリカ諸国からの渡航・入国を停止
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の発生に対応した国家レベルの渡航制限措置であり、IHR基準で「国際的拡大リスク」と「渡航・貿易制限リスク」の2つに該当。複数アフリカ地域での発生が確認されており、シグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで明示されている実際の発生地域はDRC、ウガンダ、南スーダンおよび周辺地域（ルワンダ、ブルンジ、タンザニア、ブラザヴィル共和国）です。対象国リスト内では DRC (203312) のみ該当します。サウジアラビアの渡航制限は国際的な拡大リスク対策であり、公式な政府対応として確認されています。

article.articleHeadline: Waspada Risiko Flu Burung, Anggota DPRD DKI Tolak Revisi Perda Unggas Asal-asalan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Be aware of the risk of avian influenza; a Jakarta DPRD member rejects a sloppy poultry regulation revision.
article.articleSummary: As of June 26, 2026, avian influenza risk underscores Jakarta's need to maintain strict poultry controls as DPRD lawmakers scrutinize a revision of Perda No. 4/2007 on poultry farming and circulation in DKI Jakarta. The revision is criticized for potential laxity that could jeopardize public health in dense urban areas. Under the current regulation, poultry farms must be at least 25 meters from residences; this standard is reportedly violated as residents keep poultry near crowded neighborhoods in South Jakarta, including Pancoran and Mampang Prapatan. August Hamonangan, a Jakarta DPRD Budget Committee member and PSI adviser, warns against rushing amendments, insisting the law remains a health safeguard against avian influenza outbreaks. The discussion emphasizes the health risks to residents and ongoing concerns about poultry-keeping near densely populated areas.

triage.headline_ja: 鳥インフルエンザのリスクに警戒、ジャカルタ議会議員が家禽規制改正案に異議
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア（ジャカルタ）での鳥インフルエンザ感染リスク警告が報道されており、人獣共通感染症として重要性がある。ただし現在のところ確定症例報告ではなく、規制改正に関する議論・警告段階であり、詳細な疫学情報が不足しているため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事はジャカルタ中心部の住宅密集地での家禽飼育に伴う鳥インフルエンザリスクについて論じており、規制改正に関する議論が中心。人-ヒト感染例や死亡例などの具体的な症例情報は記載されていない。WPRO基準のうち「prolonged_exposure」（密集地での継続的な家禽飼育）と「epidemic_prone」（ヒト-ヒト感染リスク）に該当するが、疫学的な詳細情報不足のためWATCH判定。続報で確定症例報告または流行兆候があれば即座にPICKUPに昇格すべき。

article.articleHeadline: ചിക്കുൻഗുനിയയെ പ്രതിരോധിക്കാൻ ഗോമൂത്രം; ഐ.ഐ.ടിയിലെ ശാസ്ത്രീയ കണ്ടെത്തലിൽ അമ്പരന്ന് സോഷ്യൽ മീഡിയ | Netizens spiral over IIT Roorkee's cow urine study, findings reveal potential to fight Chikungunya virus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cow urine to prevent chikungunya; social media stunned by IIT Roorkee's scientific findings, which show potential to fight the chikungunya virus.
article.articleSummary: IIT Roorkee researchers report that bioactive constituents in distillates of cow urine may counter chikungunya virus. In laboratory experiments, using cow-urine ark reduced the virus by more than 90%, while a formulated natural-compound blend achieved up to 99.85% elimination of detectable virus. The study, published in ACS Agriculture Science and Technology, underscores the potential of integrating Ayurvedic knowledge with modern biotechnology to address chikungunya, which is transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes and causes fever and severe joint pain; currently, there are no definitive antivirals. Lead investigator Professor Shaily Thomas notes the findings could inform new preventive approaches, though clinical trials are essential to validate therapeutic use. Online reactions have been polarized: some question scientific rigor, others defend traditional knowledge; debates also touch on whether similar properties exist in urine of other livestock. IIT Roorkee’s X post has triggered ongoing commentary and moderation.

triage.headline_ja: チクングニア熱を予防するための牛尿；IIT Roorkeeの科学的知見がソーシャルメディアを驚愕させ、チクングニアウイルスと闘うための可能性を示す
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はインド・ウッタラーカンド州の研究機関による実験室レベルの基礎研究報告であり、実際の感染症流行イベントではなく、チクングニア熱の臨床的な発生・拡大の報告ではない。IHR基準およびWPRO基準のいずれも該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事はインドの大学による基礎研究成果（チクングニアウイルスに対する牛尿抽出物の in vitro 効果）に関するニュースであり、感染症イベント（outbreak/cluster）ではない。ソーシャルメディアでの議論は科学的厳密性や伝統医学に関する論争であるが、疾病コントロール・管理措置の必要性を示唆していない。シグナルトリアージ対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Epidémia eboly v Kongu neustupuje, nové prípady hlásia každý deň. Úrady evidujú už 304 úmrtí
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola epidemic in Congo shows no signs of abating; new cases are reported every day. Authorities have recorded 304 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease continues in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with 1,155 confirmed cases and 304 deaths, as of mid-2026. Ituri province in the northeast accounts for over 90% of cases, though the epidemic—DRC's seventeenth—has also spread to North Kivu and South Kivu and across the border to Uganda, which has 20 confirmed cases and 2 deaths. Over the last 24 hours, 37 new cases and 5 new deaths were recorded; epidemiological and laboratory surveillance have improved detection, but community transmission continues. The latest outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo variant, for which there is no approved vaccine or specific treatment. A first diagnosed case in Europe was reported in France, a doctor who had returned from a humanitarian mission in Congo; the ECDC and WHO consider the risk of wider spread low. Africa CDC estimates roughly $1.4 billion is needed to address the outbreak in Congo and Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラ流行は沈静化の兆しを見せず、毎日新規症例が報告される。当局はすでに304人の死亡を記録している
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病は深刻な公衆衛生上の影響、国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダ、フランスでの発生）、渡航・貿易制限のリスクを有する。スクリーニング基準でも全5項目に該当し、シグナルとして明確に識別される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでウガンダとフランスでの症例言及があるが、対象国リストに該当しないため verified_locations に含めない。DRCのみを対象国として記録。Bundibugyo変異体でワクチンが未承認である点が管理可能性を低下させている。Africa CDCが約14億ドルの必要資金を推定している点も深刻性を示している。

article.articleHeadline: Konžské úřady hlásí 1155 potvrzených případů eboly a 304 souvisejících úmrtí
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congolese authorities report 1,155 confirmed Ebola cases and 304 related deaths.
article.articleSummary: The Democratic Republic of the Congo's 17th Ebola outbreak, centered in Ituri province (northeast), has reached 1,155 confirmed cases and 304 deaths as of June 26, 2026. In the last 24 hours, 37 new cases and 5 new deaths were reported. Intensified epidemiological and laboratory surveillance has enabled earlier detection, but community transmission continues to rise. The outbreak has spread to North Kivu and South Kivu, and across the border into Uganda (20 cases, 2 deaths). France confirmed the first imported European case this week in a doctor returning from a humanitarian mission in Congo; isolation is in place. The risk of wider spread outside affected areas is deemed low by ECDC and WHO. The Bundibugyo variant drives this outbreak; there is no approved vaccine or specific treatment. Africa CDC estimates about $1.4 billion is needed to address it in DRC and Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ当局が1,155件の確認されたエボラ症例と304件の関連死亡を報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱は深刻な公衆衛生上の影響を持ち、国境を越えた拡大（ウガンダ、フランス）、国際的な懸念が存在し、渡航・貿易制限のリスクがある。WPROスクリーニング基準も全項目該当。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUgandaが含まれているが、記事サマリーではウガンダは国境を越えた症例の記載のみで、主な発生地はDRC（イトゥリ州、北キヴ州、南キヴ州）。対象国リストにウガンダが含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。17回目のエボラ流行、Bundibugyo変異株、ワクチンなし、Africa CDCが14億ドルの支援を推定。国際的な関心が極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Rritet numri i të vdekurve nga Ebola në Kongo, konfirmohet 1155 raste infektimesh dhe 304 raste vdekjesh
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola death toll in Congo rises; 1,155 confirmed infections and 304 deaths.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues, with 1,155 laboratory-confirmed cases and 304 deaths. As of Wednesday, June 24, 2026, 37 new cases and 5 new deaths were confirmed in 24 hours. The outbreak, declared May 15, is caused by the rare Bundibugyo-type Ebola virus (Budibugio) for which there is no specific treatment or vaccine; most prior outbreaks involved the Zaire ebolavirus, for which a vaccine exists. It is the 17th Ebola outbreak in Central Africa, a region of about 100 million people. Authorities say improved epidemiological surveillance enabled earlier detection and indicates ongoing transmission on a weekly basis. The global Ebola burden is high—WHO notes around 15,000 deaths in Africa over five decades, with case fatality rates ranging 25–90%. The worst DRC outbreak (2018–2020) killed nearly 2,300 people from about 3,500 cases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ死亡者数が増加、1,155件の感染確認と304件の死亡事例が確認される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。公衆衛生への深刻な影響（304人の死亡、1,155件の感染確認）、異常性（稀なBundibugyo型エボラウイルス）、国際的拡大のリスク（中央アフリカの100万人規模の地域での発生）、渡航・貿易制限のリスク（流行地域の移動制限）が全て認定される。WPROスクリーニング基準でも全5項目該当。社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo型エボラウイルスはZaire型に比べてワクチンや特異的治療がないため、管理が難しい。中央アフリカ地域での17番目の発生であり、地域内での継続的な感染伝播が報告されている。過去最悪のDRC発生（2018-2020年）では2,300人近くが死亡していることから、この発生の管理可能性が重要な課題となる。

article.articleHeadline: போலியோ சொட்டுமருந்து முகாம்; சென்னை பாலவாக்கத்தில் முதல்-அமைச்சர் விஜய் தொடங்கி வைக்கிறார்...!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Polio drops camp; Chief Minister Vijay inaugurates in Pallavakkam, Chennai.
article.articleSummary: Polio vaccination drive in Tamil Nadu targets more than 50 lakh children under age five, with 43,051 vaccination sites across government primary health centres, hospitals, Anganwadi centres, schools and other public venues. Chief Minister Vijay will inaugurate the polio drops camp at 8:00 AM on 27 June 2026 at the Government Adi Dravidar School in Pallavakkam, Chennai. The statewide campaign aims to administer oral polio drops to all eligible children, leveraging a broad network of public health facilities and community locations. The initiative reflects a large-scale public health effort to sustain polio immunization coverage and prevent future outbreaks by ensuring high-access vaccination during the drive.

triage.headline_ja: ポリオ予防接種キャンプ、首相ビジャイがチェンナイのパッラヴァッカムで開始予定
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は予防的なポリオ予防接種キャンペーンの実施告知であり、ポリオ症例の発生報告ではない。IHR基準およびスクリーニング基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 本イベントは計画中の予防接種キャンペーンの発表であり、感染症の発生・拡大を示すシグナルではない。公衆衛生当局による積極的な予防対策の一環として報告されている。社会的・政治的関心は高いが、シグナルトリアージの対象ではない。

article.articleHeadline: लिवर को फेल कर देता है ये वायरस, खराब पानी और खाने से फैलता है, AIIMS के डॉक्टर ने बताया कितना खतरनाक
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: This virus can cause liver failure; it spreads through contaminated water and food, AIIMS doctor explains how dangerous it is.
article.articleSummary: Hepatitis A virus (HAV) can cause sudden liver failure and spreads through contaminated water and food, with outbreaks linked to poor drinking water. In adults, HAV is a common cause of acute liver failure, accounting for about 30-40% of cases, according to AIIMS Delhi. The virus inflames the liver; most people are most contagious two weeks before symptoms, and transmission can continue even without symptoms. It spreads via contaminated water and food, and unsafe sexual contact, with higher risk among those with multiple partners or men who have sex with men. Symptoms include jaundice, fever, fatigue, loss of appetite, nausea, right upper quadrant abdominal pain, diarrhea, and dark urine; children are often asymptomatic, especially under age 2. Diagnosis is by detecting HAV antibodies in blood. Vaccination is the most effective prevention; India has the vaccine but awareness is low, and vaccination upon medical advice can provide substantial protection.

triage.headline_ja: この肝炎ウイルスは肝不全を引き起こす、汚染された水と食べ物から感染、AIIMS医師が危険性を説明
triage.triage_reason: A型肝炎に関する医学教育記事であり、インドでの現在進行形のアウトブレイク情報ではなく、疾患知識の啓発コンテンツと判定。異常性や重症度の具体的な数値、患者数、地域限定的な流行状況が記述されていない。
triage.notes: 記事はAIMS医師による予防教育・啓発コンテンツであり、現在進行形の感染症クラスター報告ではない。A型肝炎の一般的な病原性、伝播経路、症状、予防策についての医学情報が主体。インドでの低ワクチン接種率が課題として言及されているが、具体的な患者数、発生数の増加、流行地域の限定情報がないため、シグナルとしての判定ランクはWATCH段階とした。

article.articleHeadline: British Chamber backs higher pork imports amid ASF
article.articleSummary: ASF in the Philippines persists, with about 500 hog deaths in Negros Occidental and ongoing active cases across five regions, seven provinces, seven cities/municipalities, and eight barangays as of June 5, 2026. The national hog inventory declined 1.5% to 8.70 million head in Q1 2026, the lowest first-quarter level since 1994. Imported meat from the United Kingdom rose to 7.44 million kg by April 2026 (up 180% YoY), while UK pig meat exports to the Philippines reached 6,981 tonnes January–April 2026 (up 8.6%), underscoring the Philippines as a major Asia destination for UK pork. The British Chamber of Commerce Philippines backs stakeholder input on the IRR of EO No. 116, which raises the pork minimum access volume from 54,210 MT to 204,210 MT to support fair competition, security, and inflation management amid ASF disruptions.

triage.headline_ja: ASF 流行下でのフィリピンの豚肉輸入増加を英国商業会議所が支持
triage.triage_reason: フィリピンで持続的な ASF 流行が複数地域で確認され、豚の在庫が大きく減少している。これは公衆衛生および食料安全保障に重大な影響を及ぼす動物感染症として、スクリーニング基準（重症度、長期曝露、管理性）に複数該当し、国際的な関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーが明確にフィリピンでの ASF 持続流行、複数地域での確認（5地域、7州、7市町村、8バランガイ）、豚在庫の 1994 年以来最低水準への減少を述べている。UK からの豚肉輸入急増は代替食肉源の確保と関連しており、国際的な貿易インパクトが顕著。該当地域（UK）はスクリーニング対象国外であるため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes Jabar Minta Warga Waspadai Flu Singapura, Cuaca Ekstrem Disebut Jadi Pemicu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: West Java Provincial Health Office Urges Residents to Beware of Singapore Flu, Extreme Weather Said to Be a Trigger.
article.articleSummary: West Java's Provincial Health Office urges residents to beware of Singapore Flu (Hand, Foot, and Mouth Disease, HFMD) as hundreds of suspected HFMD cases have been detected in Bandung Barat Regency throughout 2026. Health official Vini Adiani Dewi attributes the rise to extreme, unstable climate conditions, noting the Singapore flu virus has long existed but is reactivated by irregular weather, with heat followed by sudden rain. Authorities advise vigilance without panic, emphasizing HFMD is a self-limited illness that tends to resolve as the immune system improves. The report provides no laboratory confirmation details, infection source, or information on imported/exported cases. Keywords: HFMD, Singapore flu, Bandung Barat, West Java, climate change, outbreak signal, public health guidance.

triage.headline_ja: ジャワ州保健局がシンガポール風邪への警戒を呼びかけ、異常気象が引き金とされる
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア（ジャワ州）でエンテロウイルス71/インフルエンザ関連の手足口病（HFMD）疑い症例が数百件検出されており、地域当局が警戒を呼びかけている。ただし検査確認が記載されておらず、入院・死亡などの重症度情報も不明であるため、フルRRA実施前の経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事では西ジャワ州バンドゥン・バラット地域での手足口病（HFMD、シンガポール風邪）疑い症例数百件を報告している。異常気象との関連が指摘されており、地域当局が住民に警戒を呼びかけている。ただし、検査確認、入院数・死亡数などの重症度、ヒト-ヒト感染の確定、国外への拡大リスク等の情報が不足している。続報で確認数・重症度・検査結果の詳細が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Congo says number of confirmed Ebola cases rises to 1,155
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo reached 1,155 confirmed cases with 304 deaths, according to a government situation report released June 25, 2026. The update, documenting 37 new cases and five new deaths in the previous 24 hours, confirms continued growth in community transmission on a week-on-week basis. The figures reflect the latest totals as of Wednesday, with intensified epidemiological and biological surveillance cited by health officials as enabling earlier detection of cases. The report highlights ongoing transmission within the community and underscores the sustained scale of the outbreak in the DRC. Health authorities say ongoing surveillance continues to guide response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ政府がエボラ確定症例数が1,155例に増加したと発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の大規模流行で公衆衛生への深刻な影響、予想外の高い伝播、国際拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスクが明確に存在する。
triage.notes: 確定症例1,155例、死亡304例の大規模流行。過去24時間に37例の新規症例と5例の死亡が報告され、コミュニティ内での継続的伝播を示唆している。監視体制の強化により早期検出が可能となっているものの、流行は継続中で規模は拡大傾向。DRC内での管理能力評価が重要。

article.articleHeadline: Arab Saudi tangguhkan perjalanan ke tiga negara Afrika waspada Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Saudi Arabia suspends travel to three African countries amid Ebola alert.
article.articleSummary: Saudi Arabia suspended travel to the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), Uganda, and South Sudan and halted all visa issuance and entry for tourists from these countries as a precaution against Ebola. The ban also applies to travelers arriving via third countries who have stayed in any of the three within 21 days prior to Saudi entry. Saudi Public Health Authority reports no confirmed or suspected Ebola cases in the kingdom since preventive measures began. The DRC is experiencing its 17th Ebola outbreak, announced in mid-May, affecting eastern regions and spreading to Uganda. As of 24 June, the DRC had 1,118 confirmed Ebola cases and 291 deaths, with the WHO warning that the outbreak continues to outpace response. Article source: Xinhua.

triage.headline_ja: サウジアラビア、エボラ警戒でアフリカ3カ国への渡航を一時停止
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で「公衆衛生への影響は深刻」「国際的に拡大するリスク」「渡航・貿易制限」の3基準該当。DRC第17次エボラアウトブレイク（1,118例、291死亡）がウガンダに拡大し、国際的な渡航制限措置が実施されており、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC、ウガンダ、南スーダンが言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRC（203312）のみ。ウガンダ（226074）は対象国リストに未含。南スーダンは対象国外。サウジアラビアの渡航制限措置自体は国際的な関心の高さを示す。DRC第17次アウトブレイクの記載あり、WHOの警告も記事に含まれている。

article.articleHeadline: Actualité | Ebola en RDC : Félix Tshisekedi prend de nouvelles mesures pour freiner la propagation du virus dans l'Est | mediacongo.net
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: News | Ebola in DR Congo: Félix Tshisekedi takes new measures to slow the spread of the virus in the East
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease is spreading in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, with the outbreak declared May 15, 2026 in Ituri, Nord-Kivu, and Sud-Kivu. As of June 26, 2026, the national Task Force reports more than 1,100 laboratory-confirmed cases and 277 deaths (case fatality around 26%). Ituri remains the hardest hit, accounting for 91% of confirmed infections; health zones Bunia, Rwampara, Mungwalu, Nyankunde and Nizi together host about 85% of Ituri’s cases. Kinshasa reports no cases to date. Measures include strengthened movement controls around affected areas, temperature screening and visual traveler surveillance by police and health services, and reinforced hand hygiene. A 21-day surveillance/observation period is required for anyone in contact with an Ebola patient, and for travelers from affected zones before international travel. Humanitarian actions will assist displaced populations and accelerate the construction of Ebola treatment centers near displacement sites.

triage.headline_ja: RDコンゴのエボラ：フェリックス・チセケディが東部でのウイルス拡散を遅らせるための新たな措置を講じる
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病は既知の高致死性病原体であり、1,100例以上の確認患者と277名の死亡が報告されており、国際的に深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威である。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、エボラウイルス病はRDコンゴの東部（イツリ、ノルド・キブ、南キブ州）で発生し、2026年5月15日に宣言された。2026年6月26日現在、1,100例以上の確認患者と277名の死亡が報告されており、致命率は約26%。イツリが最も深刻で、確認感染の91%を占めている。ルワンダはBluedot発行地域に含まれているが、記事サマリーではルワンダでの発症例は言及されていないため、verified_locationsには含めない。政府当局による移動管理の強化、検温スクリーニング、旅行者監視などの対策が実施されている。

article.articleHeadline: Pune Pulse Polio Drive To Cover Over 3.16 Lakh Children From June 28 To July 3
article.articleSummary: Pune Municipal Corporation (PMC) launches the National Pulse Polio Vaccination Campaign from June 28 to July 3 to administer an additional oral polio vaccine dose to about 3.16 lakh children under five. On June 28, 1,375 vaccination booths will operate 8am–5pm across the city, including civic dispensaries, maternity hospitals, health centres, and high-risk sites such as brick kilns, construction sites, and migrant settlements. From June 29 to July 3, 1,990 door-to-door teams will reach over 10.41 lakh households to vaccinate children who missed the first day. The campaign also covers 32 newly merged villages, with extensive training, a City Task Force, and nodal officers. Transit vaccination teams will operate at bus depots, railway stations, metro stations, the airport, and parks. Stocks and awareness materials have been distributed; parents are urged to bring all children under five on June 28, even if already immunized.

triage.headline_ja: プネー パルスポリオキャンペーン 6月28日から7月3日にかけて316万人以上の児童をカバー
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はポリオウイルスの新規感染事例ではなく、定期予防接種キャンペーンの実施案内であり、公衆衛生上の緊急イベント（アウトブレイク）には該当しない。
triage.notes: これは通常の予防接種キャンペーン（Pulse Polio Vaccination Campaign）であり、ポリオのアウトブレイクや感染事例ではない。プネー市がワクチン接種の実施計画を発表したニュースに過ぎず、シグナルトリアージの対象外と判定する。

article.articleHeadline: 气候变化叠加厄尔尼诺 专家称全球传染病传播总体风险攀升
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Climate change compounded by El Niño, experts say, is increasing the global risk of infectious disease transmission.
article.articleSummary: On 26 June 2026, experts warn that climate warming, intensified by the El Niño that began in May 2026, is raising infectious-disease transmission risk. Chinese meteorological researchers say expanding suitable habitats for Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus are moving northward into China, increasing risk from mosquito-borne diseases. Influenza remains climate-sensitive: temperature and humidity govern virus survival on aerosols and surfaces; cold, dry conditions favor infectivity, while warm, humid conditions in southern China still permit peaks as rising absolute humidity offsets some warming effects. Warming shifts influenza activity toward mid- to low-latitude regions, prolonging seasons and weakening seasonality, with larger day-to-day temperature swings (>3°C) potentially diminishing immunity. El Niño may further promote flu spread via humidity changes and migratory birds, making patterns more complex. In 2025, CMA and NCDC established meteorology–health collaboration and issued first high-temperature health risk warnings; several provinces—Fujian, Jiangsu, Henan, Sichuan, Chongqing—have integrated monitoring. Public should heed weather alerts, secure homes against mosquitoes, remove standing water, and use protective measures when visiting dengue-endemic areas.

triage.headline_ja: 気候変動とエルニーニョが重なり、専門家は世界的な感染症伝播リスクの上昇を指摘
triage.triage_reason: インフルエンザとデングを扱う環境・気候関連の警告記事。中国の複数省で統合監視体制が確立されており潜在的な懸念があるが、具体的な集団発生やケース増加の報告ではなく、専門家による将来リスク警告のため、現時点での即座なフルRRA開始は不要だが継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は実際の流行事例ではなく気候変動による将来のリスク増加についての専門家警告。中国の複数省（福建、江蘇、河南、四川、重慶）で気象と健康の統合監視体制が既に確立されている点が注目される。インフルエンザとデングの両疾患に関する環境的リスク要因の分析が含まれており、継続的な情報収集が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: PS Bitok reassures tourists as sector battles Ebola-related cancellations
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-26, Kenya reports no Ebola case in the country, despite Ebola activity in neighboring Democratic Republic of Congo. Tourism officials, including Tourism Principal Secretary Julius Bitok, say Kenya is safe and ready to detect, contain, and respond to any suspected case, with quarantine centres established as precautionary measures given cross-border movement. The statements were made during the Kenya Association of Hotelkeepers and Caterers (KAHC) Annual Symposium in Malindi, Kilifi County, amid Ebola-related cancellations affecting the sector. Government urges intensified marketing to reach a five million visitor target by December 2026; current arrivals are about 1.5 million annually, below potential. Malindi MP Amina Mnyazi and KAHC chairman Christopher Musau urged countering misinformation linking Kenya to Ebola, stressing there is no Ebola in Kenya and that the country is open, safe, and ready to welcome travelers.

triage.headline_ja: PS Bitokが観光セクターのエボラ関連キャンセルへの対応を保証する際に観光客を安心させる
triage.triage_reason: ケニアではエボラ症例の報告がなく、隣国DRCでの活動が存在するものの、ケニア国内での感染症の実際の発生・蔓延は認められていない。記事は観光セクターへの経済的影響と政府の安心宣言が主題であり、アウトブレイク対応ではなく風評被害への対応である。
triage.notes: 記事はケニア国内でのエボラ症例がないことを明確に述べている。DRCでの活動は言及されているが、ケニア国内での実際の感染症イベント発生は報告されていない。これは予防的な対応と観光セクターの風評被害対策が主体であり、シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo tightens control measures as Ebola deaths top 300 | News.az
article.articleSummary: Outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), centered in Ituri province, is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus with no licensed vaccine or specific treatment. As of 2026-06-26, the death toll tops 300, with 1,155 confirmed cases and 304 deaths; 138 patients have recovered, and 326 remain in treatment or isolation. A French doctor who participated in the response has tested positive. Health authorities have tightened travel controls: a 21-day active health monitoring period for healthcare workers, laboratory personnel, and emergency-response teams returning from Ebola-affected regions, during which domestic and international travel is prohibited. Anyone who has stayed in an Ebola-affected province may travel abroad only after 21 days outside the area. All international departures require a health declaration form, and airlines must ensure compliance. The outbreak was declared in mid-May, and containment efforts continue.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の死者が300人を超えたため、コンゴ民主共和国が統制措置を強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR Annex2基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外、国際的拡大リスク）。WPRO基準4項目該当。エボラ出血熱の集団発生で死亡者300人超、確認患者1,155人、ワクチンなし、フランス人医師の陽性例、国際的な渡航制限措置実施中。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでイトゥリ州での集団発生、フランス人医師の陽性例が報告されているが、フランス（France）は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRCのみ対象国リストに含まれ、イベント発生地として確認。Bundibugyo ebolavirus による集団発生で、ワクチンや特異的治療がなく、渡航制限等の措置が実施されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準両者で高リスク。

article.articleHeadline: Schneller Anstieg von Ebola-Todesfällen im Kongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rapid rise in Ebola deaths in the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola deaths are rising rapidly in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), with Africa CDC projecting more than 300 deaths in the coming days. As of 2026-06-26, there are 1,118 confirmed Ebola cases and 291 deaths among them. This surge represents the highest number of confirmed cases in the first five weeks of any Congo Ebola outbreak to date. Despite the alarming trend, authorities report progress on treatments: clinical trials for Ebola therapies are due to begin next week, the antiviral Remdesivir has arrived in the DRC, and a prophylactic agent to aid after exposure is being tested. Several companies are developing additional vaccine candidates, underscoring broad efforts to expand treatment options and vaccination to curb transmission during this intense outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴにおけるエボラ死亡数の急速な増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準においても重症度・流行可能性・管理可能性で懸念あり。DRCにおけるエボラアウトブレイクは過去5週間で最多の確定症例数を記録しており、国際的な公衆衛生上の重大な脅威。
triage.notes: コンゴ民主共和国（DRC）で確認されたエボラアウトブレイク。2026年6月26日時点で1,118例の確定症例と291例の死亡が報告されており、過去5週間のコンゴエボラアウトブレイク歴における最多数。Africa CDCは今後数日で300例以上の死亡を予測。治療法（レムデシビル到着、臨床試験開始予定）やワクチン開発が進行中だが、管理可能性の懸念あり。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: Magyarországra közvetlenül Afrikából érkezhet a vírus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: The virus could arrive in Hungary directly from Africa.
article.articleSummary: Ebola could arrive in Hungary directly from Central Africa rather than via a European source, according to virologist Miklós Rusvai in an InfoRádió interview on 2026-06-26. In Central Africa, the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains in a severe Ebola outbreak with over 1,000 confirmed infections and at least 260 deaths. An imported case has been identified in France. Rusvai notes that any domestic Hungarian case would most likely originate from Central Africa, not France, and that past outbreaks have produced imported cases reaching various countries. Potential import routes include returning health and humanitarian workers. Overall risk remains low. Transmission occurs mainly through body fluids; casual contact or airline transmission is highly unlikely. Early symptoms are non-specific; bleeding can occur in severe stages. There is no widely available, effective vaccine for all strains; experimental treatments exist, and hygiene is crucial. European mortality is lower than in Africa.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：ハンガリーにアフリカから直接ウイルスが到達する可能性
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響：DRC既知アウトブレイク1000例以上・260死亡、予想外な地理的拡大：フランスへの輸入例確認、国際拡大リスク：中央アフリカから複数国への輸入ケース懸念、渡航制限リスク：あり）。WPRO基準でも重症度・流行性・管理可能性で該当。フルRRA評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRC（対象国）での既知アウトブレイク（1000例以上・260死亡）を主題としており、フランスとハンガリーは輸入ケース・輸入リスクの言及のみ。対象国リストに該当する実際の発生地は DRC のみ。ハンガリーとフランスは対象国外のため verified_locations から除外。既知のアクティブなアウトブレイク + 国際輸入ケース確認により PICKUP。

article.articleHeadline: La RD del Congo supera la barrera de los 300 muertos confirmados por el brote de ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Democratic Republic of the Congo surpasses 300 confirmed deaths from the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo’s east, the current Ebola outbreak has 304 deaths from 1,155 confirmed cases (as of June 24), with a 26.3% fatality rate, 138 recoveries, and 326 in isolation. Contact tracing is 79.2%. It began May 15 in Ituri near Uganda and South Sudan and has spread to North and South Kivu. Uganda has 20 confirmed cases (15 imported from DRC) and two deaths. France confirms its first imported Ebola case in a doctor returning from a mission to the DRC. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo strain, with a 30–50% fatality rate and no approved vaccine or specific treatment. The WHO declared a public health emergency of international concern on May 17; risk is high in sub-Saharan Africa, low globally. A 90-day cross-border plan between DRC and Uganda is in place, making this the third-worst Ebola outbreak on record after 2014–2016 West Africa and 2018–2020 eastern DRC outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国がエボラ患者数300人を突破
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当し、WPRO基準5項目すべて該当。WHOが国際的懸念の公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言済みであり、複数国への国際的拡大と高い死亡率を伴う重大事象。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの輸入症例20例、フランスへの輸入症例1例が報告されているが、verified_locationsには対象国リストに含まれるDRCのみを記載。Bundibugyo株による高い死亡率（26.3%、最大50%）、304人の死亡、1,155確認症例。WHOが2026年5月17日にPHEIC宣言済み。記録上3番目に大きいエボラ流行。

article.articleHeadline: Tratament experimental pentru Ebola. Testele încep în Congo în câteva zile
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Experimental treatment for Ebola. Tests begin in Congo in a few days.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization announces a clinical trial in Congo next week testing two Ebola treatments: antibody therapy and an antiviral drug. About 1,000 participants are expected. The current Ebola outbreak primarily affects Congo, with Uganda affected to a lesser extent. The outbreak stems from a rare strain for which there is no vaccine or specific treatments at present. The study aims to assess the safety and potential effectiveness of the antibody therapy and the antiviral drug in real-world conditions. The report does not provide laboratory confirmation details. This initiative underscores ongoing efforts to expand therapeutic options as the Ebola situation continues in Central Africa.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱の実験的治療法。数日以内にコンゴで試験開始
triage.triage_reason: エボラ熱の新規臨床試験開始という異常事象であり、IHR基準3つ該当（重篤性、異常性、国際拡大リスク）。WPRO基準も複数該当（重症度、流行易易性、管理可能性）。国際的な関心も高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダは記事サマリーに「二次的に影響」と記載されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。WHOによる臨床試験開始という重要な新展開であり、エボラ熱の継続的流行を示唆する信号。ワクチン欠如と治療法未確立という背景により管理可能性に懸念あり。

article.articleHeadline: 上海专家与海外侨胞云端共话埃博拉疫情防控
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Shanghai experts and overseas compatriots discuss Ebola outbreak prevention and control online.
article.articleSummary: On June 25–26, 2026, Shanghai's Overseas Friendship Association and the Shanghai Municipal Office for Overseas Chinese Affairs held an online salon, 'Care Across Mountains and Seas, Health Across Miles,' to support overseas Chinese students and citizens in Ebola prevention. The event linked Shanghai with participants in Kenya, Tanzania, Rwanda, and Uganda; about 100 attendees, including embassy representatives, local Chinese communities, students, and firms. Wang Xiaohan, vice president of the Shanghai Overseas Friendship Association and director of the municipal overseas Chinese office, urged continued protective measures and active involvement in local outbreak response. Zhang Wenhong, director of the National Center for Infectious Diseases, provided online guidance on Ebola transmission, routine protection, emergency procedures, and medical considerations. East Africa participants, including presidents of the Kenya Shanghai Chamber of Commerce and the Tanzania Shanghai Chamber of Commerce, shared outbreak status and health needs. Shanghai will continue leveraging diaspora networks to safeguard overseas compatriots.

triage.headline_ja: 上海の専門家と海外同胞がエボラ出血熱の流行対策についてオンラインで議論
triage.triage_reason: 本イベントはエボラ出血熱に関する情報提供・啓発セミナーであり、新規の感染症発生事例ではない。対象国内での実際の患者報告や流行の兆候を示す信号はない。
triage.notes: 本記事は上海での予防啓発セミナンーであり、東アフリカ（ケニア、タンザニア、ルワンダ、ウガンダ）での流行に関する情報共有が目的。実際のエボラ患者発生報告やシグナル検出ではなく、シグナルトリアージ対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Κονγκό: Στους 304 οι θάνατοι από τον Έμπολα - Στα 1155 τα επιβεβαιωμένα κρούσματα
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo: Ebola deaths rise to 304; 1,155 confirmed cases.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) reaches 1,155 confirmed cases with 304 deaths, as authorities report 37 new infections and 5 more deaths in the last 24 hours. The current epidemic, declared May 15, is driven by the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain, for which there is no specific treatment or vaccine. Most past outbreaks in the DRC involved the Zaire ebolavirus, for which a vaccine exists. This is the 17th outbreak in the central African nation, home to about 100 million people. Health officials say improved epidemiologic surveillance allowed earlier detection and confirms ongoing transmission increasing on a weekly basis. Globally, Ebola has caused over 15,000 deaths in Africa over five decades, with fatality rates ranging from 25% to 90% per WHO; the most deadly DRC outbreak (2018–2020) had about 2,300 deaths from roughly 3,500 cases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ：エボラ死者が304人に増加、確定患者数は1,155人
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当。エボラウイルス病は公衆衛生上の重大な脅威であり、高い死亡率、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限の可能性を有する。
triage.notes: コンゴ民主共和国での第17次エボラアウトブレーク。Bundibugyo ebolavirus株によるもので、有効なワクチンが存在しない点が懸念される。過去最大級のアウトブレーク（2018-2020年、死亡数約2,300人）と比較しても深刻な状況が続いている。週単位で感染増加が継続中と報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: El brote de ébola en la RDC ya es el tercero peor de la historia tras superar los 300 muertos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is already the third-worst in history after surpassing 300 deaths.
article.articleSummary: As of June 26, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo’s Ebola outbreak is centered in Ituri with spread to North and South Kivu and spillover into Uganda. The outbreak surpasses 300 deaths, constituting the third-worst Ebola epidemic in history, with a case fatality rate of 26.3%, 138 recoveries, and 326 people in isolation or hospitalized; contact tracing is 79.2%. The outbreak began in Ituri on May 15 and has extended to Uganda (20 confirmed cases, 15 imported from the DRC, 2 deaths). France reports its first Ebola case in a returning physician from the DRC. The virus is Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which there is no approved vaccine or specific treatment. WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17; risk is high in sub-Saharan Africa, low globally. Ebola transmits via direct contact with bodily fluids, causing fever, hemorrhagic symptoms, vomiting, diarrhea, and internal bleeding.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱の流行は、300人以上の死者を超えて、歴史上3番目に悪い流行となった
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WHOが既にPHEICを宣言している重大な国際的感染症危機。DRC、ウガンダでの確認例、フランスへの国際的波及が確認された。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus（ワクチン未承認株）による大規模流行。DRC（イツリ州を中心に南北キブ州に拡大）からウガンダへの越境確認、フランスへの国際的波及（帰国医師）が報告されている。死亡者300人超、case fatality rate 26.3%、接触者追跡率79.2%。WHO Public Health Emergency of International Concern既宣言（2026年5月17日）。本リスト上、対象国はDRCのみだが、地域的影響はサブサハラアフリカで高リスク。

article.articleHeadline: "الصحة العالمية": الاستجابة لتفشي إيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية بدأت تؤتي ثمارها
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: The response to the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has begun to bear fruit.
article.articleSummary: 26 June 2026 — The World Health Organization reports that the coordinated response to the Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has begun to bear fruit. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said, in a post on X and as reported by Yemen’s SABA News Agency, that the agency and partners are working with the DRC government and affected communities to start clinical trials of potential treatments to assess safety and efficacy and give patients greater chances of recovery. The remarks underscore ongoing efforts to expand the response across multiple fronts and to accelerate access to experimental therapies. The update highlights active collaboration between international partners and local authorities to manage the outbreak and improve patient outcomes.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関：コンゴ民主共和国におけるエボラ出血熱の流行への対応が成果を上げ始めている
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱は国際保健上重大な脅威であり、IHR基準（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）に複数該当する。DRCでの確認事例は対象国であり、臨床試験開始などの対応段階も注視対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから確認できる実際の発生地はDRC。Yemen（イエメン）はニュース配信元であり、同国でのエボラ症例の発生を記事が述べていないため、verified_locationsには含めない。現在、DRCではエボラ対応が進行中であり、治療実験が開始されている段階。引き続き発生地情報の更新を監視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Intensified Integrated Health Camp Advances Early Disease Detection and TB Elimination Efforts in Manimajra
article.articleSummary: In Manimajra, U.T. Chandigarh's Health Department launched an intensified Integrated Health Camp to boost early disease detection and TB elimination, inaugurated by Dr. Sadbhavna Pandit. The first-of-its-kind campaign converges multiple national health programmes on a single platform, offering free screening for TB, HIV/AIDS, Hepatitis B & C, diabetes, hypertension, and other conditions, with an NTEP Mobile Diagnostic Van enabling on-site testing. TB screening uses portable digital chest X-ray and CBNAAT for confirmation, and TB patients are promptly linked to free treatment under the National TB Elimination Programme. On 25 June 2026, camp data showed 75 chest X-rays, 4 CBNAAT tests, 70 blood sugar tests, 70 weight checks, 68 blood pressure readings, and 54 HIV/HBsAg/HCV/VDRL tests. Upcoming screenings are planned across identified localities in Manimajra and nearby areas through 02 July 2026, including Mandir Dawara, Mauli Village, Sector 25 and Sector 29, to enhance outreach and TB elimination progress.

triage.headline_ja: Manimajraにおける強化された統合健康キャンプが早期疾病検出とTB排除を推進
triage.triage_reason: 本件は公式な公衆衛生キャンプ・スクリーニングイベントであり、異常発生ではなく計画的な保健活動。IHR基準およびWPRO基準のいずれにも該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は感染症の異常発生（アウトブレイク）ではなく、インドのチャンディガル地域において保健当局が実施した計画的な統合健康キャンプの報告。TB、HIV、肝炎B・C等のスクリーニング活動は公式な疾病排除プログラムの一部であり、シグナルとして認識されるべき異常な疾病増加や流行の兆候は見当たらない。

article.articleHeadline: خطة متكاملة من "الصحة" لمنع تسرب إيبولا إلى مصر - الوطن
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A comprehensive plan from the Health Ministry to prevent Ebola from spreading to Egypt.
article.articleSummary: On 26 June 2026, Egypt responds to Africa CDC's alert that the Democratic Republic of Congo has declared a widespread Ebola outbreak by implementing a national integrated plan to strengthen health-system readiness and prevent domestic transmission. The plan prioritizes early case detection and rapid response to any importation. The Ministry of Tourism and Antiquities informs hotels and tourist facilities to enforce preventive measures, including general hygiene, environmental cleanliness, and strict food-safety standards. Any suspected Ebola case among hotel guests will be referred to fever hospitals for medical and infection-control actions under the MOH protocol. The coordinated measures involve cross-ministerial cooperation to minimize spillover risk into Egypt and ensure swift investigation and containment if cases are suspected or identified in the hospitality sector.

triage.headline_ja: 「保健省」からエジプトへのエボラ流行拡大防止に向けた統合計画
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）。エボラ出血熱は最高リスク疾患であり、DRCでの流行宣言とエジプトでの防止体制整備は国境を越えた感染症危機管理シグナルである。
triage.notes: エジプト（対象国リストに未掲載）での防止体制整備は記事の背景であり、DRCでの流行宣言が主事象。対象国はDRCのみ。エボラ出血熱は高リスク病原体として即座にRRA実施対象とすべき。

article.articleHeadline: ഇന്ത്യയിലേക്ക് വരുന്നവര്‍ക്ക് ഹെല്‍ത്ത് സെല്‍ഫ് ഡിക്ലറേഷന്‍ നിര്‍ബന്ധം; എബോളയിൽ സുരക്ഷ ശക്തമാക്കാൻ ഒരുങ്ങി രാജ്യം
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health self-declaration mandatory for those entering India; the country is preparing to strengthen Ebola security.
article.articleSummary: India mandates health self-declaration for incoming travelers and strengthens Ebola security amid outbreaks in Africa. New Delhi launched Air Suvidha 2.0, a fully digital, contactless passenger health declaration platform, in collaboration with Delhi International Airport Limited. The measure aims to boost surveillance of international travelers as Ebola epidemics spread in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, which the World Health Organization has declared a public health emergency of international concern. The platform is expected to streamline screening without impeding travel, helping authorities rapidly identify travelers at risk and respond promptly. The move underscores the role of digital health declarations in protecting public health while maintaining travel ease during ongoing outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: インドへの入国者に健康自己申告を義務付け、エボラ出血熱対策を強化—アフリカでの流行拡大に対応
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はIHR基準の4項目すべてに該当し、WHOが公衆衛生上の国際的に懸念される事態として宣言している。インドの検疫強化という行政対応も確認される。
triage.notes: 記事はインドが主題だが、実際のエボラ出血熱流行はDRC（Democratic Republic of the Congo）およびウガンダで発生している。ただし対象国リストに含まれるのはインドのみであり、DRCとウガンダは対象国ではない。記事は検疫強化の国際的な防止対応を示す一例として有意である。

article.articleHeadline: Έρευνα ΠΟΥ: Κίνδυνος εξάπλωσης του Έμπολα στο Νότιο Σουδάν
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO study: Risk of Ebola transmission in South Sudan.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus has spread from eastern Democratic Republic of Congo to Uganda, with WHO modeling estimating a 70% probability of reaching South Sudan within the next twelve weeks. The outbreak, detected in April 2026, circulated unseen for six weeks before WHO declared a public health emergency; delayed detection has allowed spread into communities already affected by conflict and health-system strain. South Sudan is identified as the most vulnerable due to weak public health infrastructure, including gaps in case management and contact tracing that heighten transmission risk. Rwanda and Burundi show lower estimated risks of 8.6% and 2%, respectively, though rapid detection and response are essential in any country. In the absence of a vaccine, WHO urges immediate measures: strengthened border surveillance, contact tracing, and safe burial practices. The DRC response shows early signs of slowing transmission; projections are risk assessments, not precise predictions.

triage.headline_ja: WHO研究：南スーダンでのエボラウイルス伝播のリスク
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo種）の国際的拡大リスク、重症度、複数国への波及可能性が極めて高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRC発の流行を主題とし、Uganda、South Sudan、Rwanda、Burundi への波及リスクを述べているが、実際の感染事例が確認されているのはDRCとウガンダ。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。南スーダンは高リスク国として識別されているが、記事時点では確認事例なし。WHOの公衆衛生緊急事態宣言と12週間以内の70%波及確率推定は、高度のリスク評価を示唆。

article.articleHeadline: Lutte contre Ebola : Kinshasa prend de nouvelles mesures " strictes et renforcées "
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fight against Ebola: Kinshasa takes new 'strict and reinforced' measures.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease, Bundibugyo strain, in the Democratic Republic of Congo. As of 26 June 2026, 1,100 confirmed cases and 277 deaths (case fatality ~26%). Kinshasa reports no active Ebola cases. After a 25 June meeting between President Félix Tshisekedi and the national Ebola task force, three reinforced measures were announced: 1) intensified security and health controls around outbreak sites with deployment of the National Police and health workers, including temperature checks, hygiene and handwashing; 2) a mandatory 21-day observation for contacts and travel restrictions for residents of affected areas; 3) humanitarian coordination for displaced populations and accelerated construction of nearby treatment centers. The Bundibugyo outbreak remains the context for these policies, with responses focusing on containment, surveillance, and treatment capacity. Kinshasa’s zero-case status is specifically noted by the presidency.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱との戦い：キンシャサが新しい「厳格で強化された」対策を実施
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ中3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）し、WPRO基準でも複数該当。確認患者1,100名、死亡277名（致命率26%）のエボラ出血熱流行であり、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株によるエボラ出血熱。1,100確認患者、277死亡（致命率26%）。大統領レベルでの対応が開始され、3つの強化対策（検疫、移動制限、治療施設拡充）が宣言されている。キンシャサは現在アクティブケースなしだが、DRC全体で流行中。国際的な懸念が高い。

article.articleHeadline: СЗО предупреждава за риск от разпространение на ебола в Южен Судан - Новини от Dnes.bg
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO warns of the risk of Ebola spread in South Sudan - News from Dnes.bg
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has surpassed 1,000 confirmed cases and over 260 deaths, with spillover into Uganda reporting 20 confirmed cases, 2 confirmed deaths, and 1 probable death. A Lancet modeling study estimates a 70% probability that the Bundibugyo strain could reach South Sudan, which researchers deem to have one of the region’s weakest public health infrastructures, citing gaps in case management, contact tracing, safe burial, and border surveillance. No vaccine exists for Bundibugyo; neighboring countries are urged to implement immediate public health measures such as cross-border surveillance, enhanced contact tracing, and safe burial practices, along with stronger rapid-response capacity. The outbreak is described as spreading in communities within a conflict-displaced, access-limited region and remained undetected until early April 2026, about six weeks before WHO identified it and declared a public health emergency.

triage.headline_ja: WHOが南スーダンへのエボラ拡大リスクについて警告 - Dnes.bgのニュース
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（重篤な影響・異常・国際拡大リスク）。Bundibugyo Ebola は確認症例1,000例以上、260例以上の死亡を記録し、ウガンダへの流出が確認されている。南スーダンへの到達確率70%とされており、重大な公衆衛生上の脅威。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより、Bundibugyo Ebola の主要発生地はDRC。ウガンダへの流出も記載されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。南スーダンについてはLancet modeling studyによる予測であり、実際の発生地ではないため含めない。DRC のみ verified_locations に列挙。2026年6月のイベント日付が将来日付のため、演習シナリオまたはテスト記事の可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: Congo Ebola death toll hits 300 as cases surge
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of Congo confirms 1,155 Ebola virus disease cases and 304 deaths (case fatality rate 26.3%) from the Bundibugyo strain, with 138 recoveries and 16 newly recovered in Ituri after negative control tests. The outbreak spans 34 health zones and remains active in three provinces: Ituri (epicenter), North Kivu and South Kivu. Ituri accounts for much of the activity, and the epidemic was declared on May 15. A 21-day mandatory quarantine on travelers from Ebola-hit areas is in place to curb spread. Africa CDC says the continental response requires about $1.4 billion; AU meetings pledged $910 million, but only about 13% has been released to affected countries. The update highlights ongoing transmission and financing gaps in the Congo response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、エボラ死者数300人に達する　患者数が急増
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の大規模アウトブレイク（1,155症例、304死亡）で、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的な拡大リスク、および渡航制限の実施が確認されている。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病のBundibugyo株によるアウトブレイク。3州（Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu）34保健ゾーンに及んでおり、資金不足（$1.4B必要に対し13%のみ動員）も課題。渡航制限が実施されており国際的なコンテインメント対策が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Waspada Ebola! Arab Saudi Tangguhkan Perjalanan Warganya ke Tiga Negara Afrika
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Alert! Saudi Arabia Suspends Travel of Its Citizens to Three African Countries.
article.articleSummary: Saudi Arabia suspended travel for its citizens to the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), Uganda, and South Sudan, halted all visa issuance and inbound tourism from those countries, and blocked travelers who have stayed there in the prior 21 days. No confirmed or suspected Ebola cases have been reported in Saudi Arabia since these measures began. The DRC is contending with its 17th Ebola outbreak, declared in mid-May in its eastern regions and spreading to Uganda. As of June 24, the DRC reported 1,118 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases and 291 deaths, with the WHO warning that the outbreak continues to outpace response. A disinfection operation at an Ebola treatment center in Mombovalu, Ituri Province, DR Congo underscores ongoing containment efforts.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ警戒！サウジアラビア、アフリカの3ヶ国への国民の渡航を一時停止
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当。コンゴ民主共和国における第17次エボラ出血熱流行（5月中旬宣言、東部地域で発生、ウガンダへ拡大）で既に1,118件の確認症例と291件の死亡が報告されており、国際的な渡航制限措置が実施されている重大事象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づき、エボラ流行の主発生地はコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）であることが明確。ウガンダへの拡大も言及されているが、DRCが対象国リストに含まれる一方、ウガンダは含まれていない。南スーダンはスーダンとして発生地域に記載されているが、記事では言及なし。サウジアラビアは対象国リストに含まれていないため、渡航制限実施国として含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Επιδημία Έμπολα στη ΛΔ Κονγκό: 1.155 επιβεβαιωμένα κρούσματα, 304 θάνατοι
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola epidemic in the DR Congo: 1,155 confirmed cases, 304 deaths.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo reports 1,155 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases and 304 deaths in a current outbreak declared May 15, driven by the Bundibugyo strain, for which no specific treatment or vaccine exists. As of Wednesday, 37 new cases and 5 deaths were recorded in 24 hours, with health authorities noting improved epidemiological surveillance enabling earlier detection and a sustained weekly rise in transmission. This is the 17th Ebola outbreak in the country, which has about 100 million people. The most deadly previous outbreak (2018–2020) caused around 2,300 deaths from 3,500 cases. Globally, Ebola has claimed at least 15,000 lives in Africa over five decades, with case-fatality rates from 25% to 90% per WHO. Most earlier outbreaks were due to the Zaire strain, for which a vaccine exists; the current outbreak involves a different strain with limited treatment options.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ流行：1,155件の確定症例、304人の死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、かつWPRO基準も複数該当。エボラウイルス病の大規模流行で国内外での関心が極めて高い。
triage.notes: 現在のエボラ流行はBundibugyo株による第17次アウトブレイク（2026年5月15日宣言）。既存ワクチンが有効でないZaire株とは異なる株による流行であり、治療オプションが限定的。死亡率25～90%の致命的疾患であり、国際的な支援と関心が必要。WPROスクリーニング基準5項目すべてに該当。
