article.articleHeadline: UN Allocates $8 Million In Funding To Help Burundi, South Sudan Prepare For Potential Spread Of Ebola
article.articleSummary: UN allocates $8 million in CERF funding to Burundi and South Sudan to prepare for potential Ebola spread amid a Democratic Republic of the Congo outbreak. Emergency Relief Coordinator Tom Fletcher announced funding to bolster surveillance, laboratory capacity, case management, and infection prevention and control in Burundi and South Sudan, both at risk of cross-border transmission. The Congo outbreak, declared in May, has infected more than 1,000 people and caused nearly 300 deaths. UN agencies and partners continue response inside DRC, where over 51,000 people have received food assistance since the outbreak began; containment measures have disrupted trade, reduced food availability, and driven up prices in affected areas. WHO and Africa CDC have helped increase laboratory capacity; the UN urged donors to sustain support for life-saving humanitarian efforts.

triage.headline_ja: UN、ブルンジ及び南スーダンのエボラ出血熱の潜在的拡大対応のため800万ドルの資金配分を実施
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラ出血熱の国際的な拡大リスク、深刻な死亡・感染状況、国境を越えた感染の可能性があり、シグナルとして分類される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより、主要なエボラ出血熱発生地域はDRCであり、ブルンジと南スーダンは潜在的な国際的拡大防止を目的とした準備段階である。対象国リストにはDRCのみが含まれるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。同記事の発生地域にBurundiとSudanが含まれているが、サマリー上ではDRCが主たる発生国で、ブルンジと南スーダンは準備段階と記述されている。両国は対象国リストに含まれていないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Kwango : l'épidémie de choléra déclarée à Popokabaka avec 136 cas, dont 10 décès
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kwango: the cholera outbreak declared in Popokabaka with 136 cases, including 10 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Cholera outbreak declared in Popokabaka, Kwango Province, DRC, after INRB confirmed cases. On June 25, 2026, interim Governor Fidèle Caumba announced the outbreak following alerts from May 24. 136 cases have been recorded, including 10 deaths. Eleven samples were sent to Kinshasa's National Reference Laboratory; results confirmed three cholera-positive cases, enough to declare an outbreak per health norms. A medical team was deployed to bolster surveillance, investigations, and patient care with local health services. Authorities urge calm and adherence to prevention: handwashing with clean water and soap, drinking treated water, using latrines, environmental cleanliness, and thorough cooking of foods. Measures are in place to contain spread and protect Kwango residents.

triage.headline_ja: クワンゴ州：ポポカバカでコレラ流行宣言、136症例（死亡10人）
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（重大な公衆衛生影響・異常性・国際的拡大リスク）、WPRO基準複数該当（重症度・流行リスク）。コンゴ民主共和国のコレラ流行公式宣言は国境を越えた拡大リスクが高い。
triage.notes: クワンゴ州ポポカバカでのコレラ流行公式宣言。確認症例3例、総報告症例136例（死亡10人）。キンシャサの国立参照検査室で確認。DRCは既知のコレラ風土病地域で、隣接するザンビアへの国際的拡大リスクがある。現地当局が予防対策を強化中。

article.articleHeadline: Више од 300 преминулих од еболе
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 300 have died from Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo — Ebola outbreak toll updated by the Congolese Ministry of Communications and Media shows 304 deaths and 1,155 confirmed cases as of 26 June 2026. The case fatality rate rose by 1 percentage point to 26.3%. The ministry's statement provides the latest official figures for the ongoing outbreak, highlighting continued transmission and a substantial health burden. These figures are the latest official update from the ministry and underscore the persistent severity of Ebola in Kinshasa and across the DR Congo, stressing the need for sustained surveillance, improved patient care, and robust public health response. The report does not include symptom details or laboratory confirmation specifics.

triage.headline_ja: エボラで300人以上が死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全てに該当。エボラウイルス病の確認された集団感染事例であり、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的な拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限の可能性が明確。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーが明確にキンシャサ及びコンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ集団感染の確認を述べている。公式な死亡数304名、確認症例1,155名という深刻な状況。CFR 26.3%は高い。DRCはWHO東部アフリカ地域事務局（AFRO）の管轄だが、グローバルな脅威として優先度は極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Outbreak in Congo Spreads to Uganda, Study Warns South Sudan at High Risk | Outlook India
article.articleSummary: As of 26 June 2026, Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo are expanding to Uganda, with South Sudan at high risk. Congo reports an attack on an Ebola burial team as transmission grows across eastern provinces. A computer-based transmission-model study projects trajectories under low, medium and high transmission scenarios. Under the most likely scenario, cumulative confirmed infections are about 990 by late June 2026, with approximately 174 deaths. If transmission continues unchecked, cases could rise to about 8,210 by September. The findings highlight cross-border spillover risk toward Uganda and beyond, illustrating the potential for substantial escalation if containment measures falter.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行がウガンダに拡大、南スーダンが高リスクと警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WPRO基準4つ以上該当（異常性、重症度、長期曝露、流行しやすさ）。エボラウイルス病の国境を越えた拡大は国際的に重大な関心事項。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、エボラ流行は主にコンゴで発生し、ウガンダへの拡大が報告されており、南スーダンが高リスクとして警告されている。対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。UgandaとSudanは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsから除外。累積感染者数約990名（死亡174名）との報告があり、検査なされた場合は9月までに8,210名に達する可能性があるとの予測。境界を越えた伝播と封じ込め対策の失敗による大幅なエスカレーション可能性が強調されている。

article.articleHeadline: DSÖ: Ebola'nın Güney Sudan'a sıçrama riski ciddi boyutta
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: The risk of Ebola spillover to South Sudan is significant.
article.articleSummary: 70% probability that the Ebola spillover from the Democratic Republic of Congo will reach South Sudan, per WHO modeling published in The Lancet; South Sudan is identified as the next high-risk country due to weak health infrastructure, gaps in case management, contact tracing, safe burials, and border surveillance. The Congo outbreak has surpassed 1,000 confirmed cases and more than 260 deaths and has spilled over into Uganda, where Bundibugyo ebolavirus has caused 20 confirmed cases, 2 confirmed deaths, and 1 probable death. Rwanda and Burundi are at relatively lower risk. No vaccine exists for Bundibugyo; thus border monitoring, contact tracing, and safe burial practices should be implemented immediately, along with cross-border surveillance and rapid-response capacity strengthening. The outbreak began in early April 2026 in a conflict-affected, displacement-prone region and remained undetected for about six weeks before WHO formally identified and declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern.

triage.headline_ja: WHO：エボラウイルスの南スーダンへの流出リスクは重大な程度である
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つすべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、複数国への国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。複数のWPRO基準も満たし、WHO PHEIC宣言済みの重大事象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの地理的範囲：DRC（主な発生地）、ウガンダ（既に流出）、南スーダン（高リスク予測）、ルワンダ・ブルンジ（低リスク）。対象国リストに該当するのはDRCのみ。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。WHO PHEIC宣言済み、Zaire ebolavirus（DRCで1,000確定患者、260以上死亡）およびBundibugyo ebolavirus（ウガンダで確定患者あり）による複合アウトブレイク。紛争地域・避難民流出地域での検出遅延（6週間）により対応が複雑化。

article.articleHeadline: ΠΟΥ: Σε ποια χώρα προειδοποίησε ότι πιθανόν να φτάσει η επιδημία του Έμπολα
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: In which country did it warn that the Ebola epidemic could reach?
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak, first detected in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo in early April 2026, went undetected for six weeks before WHO identified it and declared a PHEIC. The outbreak has spread to Uganda, and a WHO modeling study in The Lancet Infectious Diseases projects a 70% chance the virus will reach South Sudan within the next twelve weeks. Rwanda and Burundi are rated lower-risk at 8.6% and 2%, respectively, with risk contingent on detection and response speed. In the absence of a vaccine, neighboring countries should immediately adopt health measures such as border surveillance, contact tracing, and safe burial practices. Congo's intensified response shows early signs of slowed transmission, but the undetected period allowed spread in areas already affected by conflict, displacement, and weak health systems.

triage.headline_ja: WHO：エボラ流行が到達する可能性がある国はどこか
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス感染症の多国間での流行拡大、WHO PHEIC宣言、国際的な拡大リスク（70%で南スーダンに到達予想）など、IHR基準3項目以上該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。国際的な公衆衛生上の深刻な脅威。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは東部DRC（4月初旬検出）を発生源として述べており、ウガンダ・ルワンダ・ブルンジへの拡大リスク、南スーダンへの到達予測を含んでいる。ただし、対象国リストに該当するのはDRCのみ。WHO PHEIC宣言済み。ワクチン不在の状況で国境監視・接触追跡・安全な埋葬慣行の採用が推奨されている。

article.articleHeadline: Africa's Rare Ebola Strain Has Reached Europe With First Case Confirmed In France
article.articleSummary: First imported case of a rare Ebola strain detected in France on 26 June 2026. The patient is a doctor who recently returned from a humanitarian mission in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo and is in stable condition after immediate isolation and transfer to a specialist infectious disease facility. Close contacts are under 21-day medical monitoring with advised self-isolation. The outbreak in parts of eastern DRC is described as one of the fastest-growing Ebola outbreaks at its early stage; no vaccine exists for this strain. WHO notes that imported Ebola infections outside Africa are exceptionally rare (fewer than 30 cases in five decades) and stresses the global risk remains low. The European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control also calls the risk to the general European population very low, saying rapid isolation and contact tracing can contain imported cases and that no broad lockdowns are warranted.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカの稀なエボラ株がヨーロッパに到達、フランスで初の確定患者が報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。稀なエボラ株の国際的な越境事例であり、ワクチンが存在しないという重大な特性を持つため、フルRRA進行が必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC内での発生地を「eastern DRC」と記述しており、フランスでの事例は輸入症例（imported case）として報告されている。対象国リストに基づき、実際に発生している国はDRCのみ。フランス（対象国リストに非掲載）での輸入症例は参考情報として扱われるが、verified_locationsには含めない。稀なエボラ株でワクチンが存在しない点、および急速な感染拡大（one of the fastest-growing）という記述が特に重大。

article.articleHeadline: Surto de tuberculose em macacos fecha o único centro de atendimento do Ibama a animais silvestres feridos no Rio
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tuberculosis outbreak in monkeys closes Ibama's only wildlife rehabilitation center for injured wild animals in Rio de Janeiro.
article.articleSummary: Tuberculosis outbreak detected at IBAMA’s Cetas-RJ wildlife rehabilitation center in Rio de Janeiro, prompting an absolute closure of the facility. Three capuchin monkeys died in quick succession; necropsy raised TB suspicion, which was confirmed by tests conducted with Fiocruz and the Federal Rural University. Approximately 50 health tests were performed on staff and remaining animals; one initial test suggested exposure but a follow-up test showed no illness, and no humans have been affected. A red emergency protocol was activated; the center was divided into zones and personnel employed N95 PPE. Further sampling tests are planned for monkeys across eight enclosures. The closure follows a prior 2026 restriction limiting admissions to animals from Inea-RJ or seized by authorities (April 29). A 2024 agreement between Ibama and Inea over funding and duties remains disputed, impacting wildlife intake and care options, with alternatives being sought (e.g., CRAS/Estácio).

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル・リオデジャネイロでサルの結核アウトブレイク発生、イバマの野生動物リハビリセンターが閉鎖
triage.triage_reason: 動物における結核アウトブレイクで、スクリーニング基準（異常性、重症度、管理可能性）に複数該当するが、ヒト感染は報告されておらず、現在のところ国際的拡大リスクが限定的。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 本イベントは動物における結核アウトブレイクであり、ヒト感染は報告されていない。スタッフ約50名に対する健康診断が実施され、初期テストで曝露が疑われた1名も経過観察で異常なしとなっている。野生動物リハビリセンターの絶対閉鎖と緊急プロトコルの発動により対応中。公式な政府関心と報道による社会的関心が存在するが、IHR通知基準には該当しないため。引き続き情報収集が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Dalam Beberapa Tahun Terakhir Kasus Leptospirosis di Pati Tunjukkan Peningkatan Signifikan - Suara Merdeka Banyumas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the Last Few Years, Leptospirosis Cases in Pati Have Shown a Significant Increase - Suara Merdeka Banyumas
article.articleSummary: Leptospirosis in Pati Regency, Banyumas, Indonesia has surged, prompting concern from local health authorities. The Pati Dinas Kesehatan reports rising infections caused by Leptospira, typically transmitted via rat urine. Yanti Purnomo, head of the Disease Prevention and Control Team, notes cases climbed from 7 in 2022 to 22 in 2023, 61 in 2025, and 172 by May 2026. Increases mainly occur early in the year during the rainy season when environmental conditions favor transmission. High-risk groups include farmers, fishermen, and pond workers who frequently contact water or soil potentially contaminated with urine. Transmission can occur through open wounds or via contaminated food or drinks. An illustrative case in Semarang involved consumption of a beverage from a can whose exterior was exposed to urine and not cleaned prior to drinking. Early symptoms include fever, nausea, vomiting, and influenza-like illness.

triage.headline_ja: ここ数年、パティ県のレプトスピラ症患者が大幅に増加 - スアラ・メルデカ・バニュマス
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア（対象国）でレプトスピラ症の急速な増加が報告されており、IHR基準の「異常性」「公衆衛生への影響」に該当。WPROスクリーニング基準でも異常性・重症度・流行しやすさが複数該当し、地域の保健当局が関心を示している。
triage.notes: 記事はインドネシア・パティ県でのレプトスピラ症の急速な増加を報告。2022年の7件から2026年5月には172件へと24倍以上の増加。雨季に流行が集中し、農民・漁民などの職業グループが高リスク。地元保健当局が既に関心を示しており、継続的な監視が必要。インフルエンザの言及もあるが記事の主題はレプトスピラ症。

article.articleHeadline: Число умерших от лихорадки Эбола в ДРК превысило 300, усилены меры контроля
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola virus disease death toll in the DRC has exceeded 300; control measures have been strengthened.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has surpassed 300 deaths as of 26 June 2026, with the Ministry of Information reporting 1,155 laboratory-confirmed cases and 304 fatalities. Of these cases, 138 people have recovered, while 326 remain in hospital or under quarantine. A laboratory-confirmed Ebola infection has been identified in a French physician participating in outbreak response in Ituri Province, the center of the outbreak, with health authorities in both countries closely monitoring the situation. In response, the DRC has imposed stricter entry rules for travelers returning from Ebola-affected areas to curb transmission and prevent cross-border spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラウイルス病の死亡者数が300を超過、制御措置が強化される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。公衆衛生への深刻な影響（300超の死亡者）、異常性（急速な流行拡大）、国際的拡大リスク（フランス人医療者の感染）、渡航制限措置の実施。フルRRAに進める必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの主要な感染症イベントはDRCでの発生。フランスの医療者感染は報告されているがサマリーではフランスでの二次的な流行は述べられていないため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを含める。DRCは対象国リストに含まれる。高い病原体力（CFR～26%程度）、既に国家レベルでの制御措置が実装されている。継続的なモニタリングが必要。

article.articleHeadline: Saudi Arabia imposes travel ban on 3 African countries, halts visas over Ebola concerns
article.articleSummary: As of 26 June 2026, Saudi Arabia barred travel to the Democratic Republic of Congo, Uganda and South Sudan and suspended visas for travelers arriving from these nations or transiting via third countries if they have been in any of the three within 21 days before entry, in a precaution to curb Ebola spread. The measures were announced by the Public Health Authority (Weqaya) as part of ongoing efforts to prevent Ebola entering the Kingdom amid an outbreak in parts of Africa. Weqaya said the health surveillance and response system operates around the clock and coordinates with national and international health agencies to protect public health. Previously, Saudi Arabia had intensified precautions for travelers from Rwanda, Burundi, Tanzania and the Republic of Congo (Brazzaville), including enhanced entry screening and stronger monitoring. The restrictions are routine precautionary steps to protect citizens, residents and visitors.

triage.headline_ja: サウジアラビアがエボラ懸念で3つのアフリカ諸国への渡航禁止令を発令、査証を停止
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の国際的拡大リスクがあり、複数国での発生が報告されている。サウジアラビアによる国際的な渡航制限措置の実施により、IHR基準2つ以上（国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限）に該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事は主にサウジアラビアの渡航禁止措置を報道しているが、実際のエボラ発生地はDRC、ウガンダ、南スーダン、ルワンダ、ブルンジ、タンザニア、コンゴ共和国など複数報告されている。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当するため verified_locations にはDRCのみ記載。サウジアラビアは発生地ではなく対応国である。

article.articleHeadline: Φόβοι για εξάπλωση του Έμπολα στο Νότιο Σουδάν τις επόμενες 12 εβδομάδες
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fears of Ebola spread in South Sudan over the next 12 weeks.
article.articleSummary: Ebola, Bundibugyo ebolavirus, has spread from eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) to Uganda, with cases now recorded in Uganda after an outbreak began in early April 2026. Six weeks of transmission in the DRC preceded WHO detection and a public health emergency declaration. A WHO modeling study published in The Lancet Infectious Diseases estimates a 70% chance the outbreak will reach South Sudan within 12 weeks. South Sudan’s health system is among the weakest in the region, with gaps in case management and contact tracing; Rwanda and Burundi have lower modeled risks of 8.6% and 2%, respectively, though these figures depend on detection and response speed. In the absence of a vaccine, experts urge immediate cross-border measures—surveillance at borders, contact tracing, and safe burial practices. The authors note these are risk estimates, not precise forecasts, and that intensified response in DRC shows early slowing of transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 南スーダンにおけるエボラ出血熱の拡大懸念（今後12週間）
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の国境を越えた拡大リスク、複数国への波及の可能性、WHOによる数理モデル予測、弱い保健システム、国際的対応の必要性が明確であり、IHR基準3項目以上に該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは南スーダン、ウガンダ、ルワンダ、ブルンジへの拡大リスク評価を述べているが、実際の確認症例はDRCおよびウガンダで報告されている。対象国リスト内では、DRCのみが検証済み発生地。スーダン、ルワンダ、ウガンダ、ブルンジは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: ΠΟΥ: Για κίνδυνο να φτάσει ο Έμπολα στο Νότιο Σουδάν, προειδοποιεί έρευνα
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: A study warns of the risk of Ebola reaching South Sudan.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola strain has spread from the Democratic Republic of Congo to Uganda, with WHO modeling published in The Lancet Infectious Diseases estimating a 70% probability that the outbreak could reach South Sudan within the next twelve weeks. A six-week detection delay in eastern DRC allowed transmission amid conflict, displacement, and health-system shortages. South Sudan faces weak public health infrastructure, with gaps in case management and contact tracing; Rwanda (8.6%) and Burundi (2%) are lower risk, though risk could rise with faster detection and response. In the absence of a vaccine, neighboring countries are urged to implement border surveillance, contact tracing, and safe burial practices. The DRC’s intensified response shows early slowing of transmission, and the findings serve as an early risk assessment to guide preventive actions.

triage.headline_ja: WHO: エボラがナイジェリアに到達するリスクについて研究が警告
triage.triage_reason: Bundibugyo Eボラ株がDRCからウガンダに拡大し、WHOの数理モデルが12週間以内に南スーダンに到達する確率70%と推定。IHR基準4項目全て該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常・予想外の拡大、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo Eボラ株はDRCで確認され、ウガンダへの拡大が報告されている。発生地域にはSudan、Rwanda、Burundi、Ugandaが含まれるが、記事サマリーの主題はDRC発のアウトブレイク拡大リスク評価であり、対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。ワクチン未承認、検出遅延（6週間）が感染拡大を助長した。公衆衛生インフラが脆弱な南スーダンへの拡大リスク評価が重要。

article.articleHeadline: Ο Έμπολα εκτός ελέγχου στην Αφρική: Υπάρχει 70% πιθανότητα εισόδου στο Νότιο Σουδάν, προειδοποιεί ο ΠΟΥ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola out of control in Africa: There is a 70% probability of entry into South Sudan, warns the WHO.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola detected in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo in early April 2026, remained undiagnosed for about six weeks, enabling community spread amid armed conflict and health-system strain. The presence of Ebola has reached Uganda, with modelling by WHO published in The Lancet Infectious Diseases indicating a 70% probability of introduction into South Sudan within three months. Rwanda and Burundi are estimated at 8.6% and 2% risk, respectively, but these figures depend on response speed and surveillance effectiveness. There is no approved vaccine for this strain. Neighbouring countries are urged to bolster public-health measures: border surveillance, active contact tracing, and safe burial practices. Congo's intensified interventions are beginning to slow transmission. Models are not exact predictions but risk-assessment tools to give time to prepare before potential escalation.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカでエボラが制御不能：南スーダンへの侵入確率は70％、WHOが警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当（重篤な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも全5項目に該当。エボラは高リスク病原体で、複数国への拡大リスクが科学的に評価されており、直ちにRRA（フルリスク評価）進行の対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRC東部での検出を主要なイベント、ウガンダへの拡大確認、南スーダン・ルワンダ・ブルンジへのリスク評価を述べている。Bluedot APIが指摘したスーダン・ルワンダ・ブルンジ・ウガンダは、記事上では『リスク評価対象国』として言及されているが、『実際の発生確認』は記述されていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ（対象国リストに含まれる）。他のアフリカ国は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ウガンダへの拡大は記事で言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : le Rwanda entame la réouverture progressive de sa frontière avec Goma
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Rwanda begins the gradual reopening of its border with Goma.
article.articleSummary: Ebola: Rwanda begins gradual reopening of its border with the Congolese city of Goma in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, after more than a week with no reports of new active Ebola cases in the area. The opening initially targets specific traveler groups, including merchants, humanitarian workers, and people with urgent travel needs. The move comes as cross-border trade between Goma and the Rwandan city of Gisenyi had stalled, impacting local economies and daily movement. Health authorities will maintain surveillance, contact tracing, and community outreach to prevent a resurgence, given Ebola's high mortality rate and historical concern in Central Africa. No new active cases reported for over a week; authorities emphasize continued vigilance even as restrictions ease for selected travellers.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱：ルワンダがゴマとの国境の段階的再開を開始
triage.triage_reason: エボラ熱は極めて高い重症度（致死率80%以上）と国際的拡大リスクを持つ。DRCでの発生後、ルワンダでの国境再開という公衆衛生上の重要な政策決定が報道されており、IHR基準（重症度、国際的拡大リスク、異常性）を複数満たし、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事ではDRC（ゴマ）でのエボラ熱発生が主題であり、ルワンダはそれへの対応国として位置づけられている。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。1週間以上新規症例報告なしとの記載があるが、公衆衛生対応（国境管理、接触者追跡）が進行中であり、感染症危機の継続を示唆。

article.articleHeadline: Elárulták: így törhet be a pusztító kórság Magyarországra
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Revealed: How the Deadly Disease Could Break into Hungary
article.articleSummary: Ebola could reach Hungary, according to virologist Miklós Rusvai, who argues entry would come directly from Congo or Central Africa rather than France, though France recently reported its first Ebola case after Congo. He notes that during major outbreaks, imported cases occur as health workers and missionaries carry the disease abroad; Hungarians are also present in affected regions, making direct import plausible. Ebola spreads via body fluids; while a sneeze is unlikely to cause transmission, the incubation is short and cases are often identified locally. The article cites five major past outbreaks. In a well-equipped hospital in a developed country, Ebola fatalities are well under 10%, whereas in Africa local mortality can reach 30–70%. The piece is dated 2026-06-26.

triage.headline_ja: 明かされた：破壊的な病気がハンガリーになだれ込む可能性がある方法
triage.triage_reason: エボラが中央アフリカ地域で発生し、フランスで初の輸入症例が確認されている。ハンガリーはスペキュレーション段階だが、国際的な拡大リスクと異常性は認められる。ただし、主要な実際の発生地が対象国のDRCに限定されるため、確認済みの地域流行ではなく仮説的な議論であり、情報不足により経過観察を優先する。
triage.notes: 記事は中央アフリカでのエボラ発生を背景に、ハンガリーへの到達リスクについてのスペキュレーション（専門家による予想シナリオ）である。実際のハンガリーにおける症例報告ではなく、仮説的な議論。フランスでの輸入症例確認は記事に言及されているが、フランスは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations に含めない。DRCにおける進行中の流行が存在することは確認されるため、フルRRAでの検討が推奨される可能性があるが、現段階では対象地域における実症例確認が不明確であり、続報の注視が妥当である。

article.articleHeadline: L'identification d'un cas d'Ebola en France, un risque sanitaire mondial majeur (directeur général du Centre africain de contrôle) - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Identification of an Ebola case in France, a major global health risk (Director-General of the African Centre for Control) - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease case identified in France, imported from the Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri region). A French anesthesiologist-intensivist tested positive on arrival in Paris after leaving Ituri on June 19 and transiting Kinshasa on June 22. Africa CDC Director-General Dr. Jean Kaseya warns that the outbreak’s scale means the world is broadly exposed and that zero risk does not exist; only solidarity and rapid resource mobilization with WHO and Africa CDC can prevent wider spread. He stresses that border closures are not the solution and warns that donor shortfalls could amplify alarm signals. The remarks follow an Ituri-focused outbreak that continues to drive global health concerns. The case underscores ongoing Ebola risk linked to Ituri and the urgent need for a swift, well-funded international response.

triage.headline_ja: フランスで確認されたエボラウイルス病患者、世界的な主要保健リスク（アフリカ疾病対策センター事務局長）
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の国際的な拡大リスク、重症度の高さ、コンゴ民主共和国からフランスへの輸入症例により、渡航・貿易制限のリスクが顕著。
triage.notes: フランスはWPRO対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations に含めない。本イベントの主要発生地はコンゴ民主共和国（イツリ地域）で、フランスは輸入症例の検出地。Africa CDC事務局長の声明により国際的な懸念が極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : Africa CDC salue l'installation d'un dispositif de contrôle dans les aéroports - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: Africa CDC welcomes the installation of screening devices at airports - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo prompts installation of screening devices at Bunia and Kinshasa airports to detect signs of Ebola, welcomed by Africa CDC Director General Dr. Jean Kaseya who noted no lapses and that symptoms appeared on arrival in Paris. The response includes growing community mobilization and recoveries, yet humanitarian conditions complicate efforts. The epicentre is Mongbwalu, Ituri, where nearly one million displaced people live in extreme poverty, and the peak has not yet been reached. A June 23 Kinshasa summit with Presidents Tshisekedi (DRC) and Ndayishimiye (Burundi) endorsed a 70% humanitarian and 30% sanitary intervention balance, underscoring that resolving the humanitarian crisis is essential to stopping the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ：アフリカCDCが空港での検査装置の導入を歓迎 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の発生は IHR 基準 4 項目すべてに該当し、国際的な公衆衛生上の重大な懸念である。DRC での流行が進行中で、パリでの症例報告と空港検査の必要性が国際的な拡大リスクを示している。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでのエボラ流行を主題としており、Ituri州Mongbwaluが震源地と記載。パリでの症例報告は渡航関連だが、DRCでの流行の進行中との記述が確認される。Bunia、Kinshasa空港での検査装置導入は国際的な懸念の表れ。2026年6月26日配信のため、フル RRA（Rapid Risk Assessment）への進行が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Semaine en bref: coup de chaud aux Urgences, 1er cas d'Ebola en France ...
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Week in Brief: Heatwave Hits Emergency Departments, First Ebola Case in France ....
article.articleSummary: As of 26 June 2026, France confirms its first Ebola virus disease case: a physician who returned from humanitarian work in the Democratic Republic of the Congo; laboratory-confirmed by the Ministry of Health, with Prof. Gilles Pialoux downplaying risk to French nationals. In Brazil, vaccination with the Butantan-DV dengue vaccine is temporarily suspended after about 42 preliminary signs of more severe dengue among roughly 500,000 vaccine recipients; three severe cases and two deaths are under investigation, underscoring vaccine safety vigilance. Meanwhile, the World Health Organization announced that Australia has eliminated trachoma, the leading infectious cause of preventable blindness, caused by Chlamydia trachomatis, with historical prevalence among Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander communities.

triage.headline_ja: 週間ブリーフ：救急部門での熱波、フランスで初のエボラ症例 ...
triage.triage_reason: フランスでのエボラ確認症例は国際的に重大な公衆衛生上の懸念であり、IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）。ブラジルのデングワクチン接種一時停止は安全性監視が必要な重要なシグナル。
triage.notes: フランスでのエボラ症例は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations に含めていない。しかし国際的な公衆衛生上の重要性は極めて高い。DRC発生のエボラがフランスに輸入された症例。ブラジルのデング ワクチン関連の安全性懸念（重症化42件、死亡2件）は継続的監視が必要。オーストラリアのトラコーマ排除は対象国外であり、肯定的成果のため医学的シグナルではない。

article.articleHeadline: Број потврђених случајева еболе у Конгу порастао на 1.155
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of confirmed Ebola cases in Congo has risen to 1,155.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has reached 1,155 confirmed cases and 304 deaths. Authorities report 37 new cases and 5 new deaths in the last 24 hours, with intensified surveillance confirming ongoing community transmission. The World Health Organization links the outbreak to the rare Bundibugyo strain, the largest number of confirmed cases in the first month of an Ebola outbreak to date. Historical references include West Africa’s 2014–2016 crisis and DR Congo’s 2018 outbreak. Funding discussions note a proposed amount aligned with response needs, though funding for a Kenyan quarantine center may spark controversy over preventing virus entry to the United States. The US CDC has pledged hundreds of millions, including 107 million for emergency response, and experimental antibody therapies are being trialed. France reports its first case tied to the outbreak; WHO says international risk remains low but monitoring continues.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ確認患者数が1,155人に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラアウトブレイク（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）であり、複数国への波及確認（フランスで輸入症例、米国への関心）、高い死亡率、大規模な国際支援が必要な状況。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは発生地域にUSA、France、Kenyaが列記されているが、実際のアウトブレイク発生地はDRCであり、フランスは輸入症例（1症例）、米国は支援国・関心国として言及されている。WPROスクリーニング対象国ではUSA、Franceは含まれないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。ケニアのための検疫センターについても、発生地ではなく予防措置としての言及であるため除外。対象国リストではDRCのみ該当。

article.articleHeadline: Protocolo identifica risco de contaminação entre viveiros de peixes de uma mesma bacia hidrográfica
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Protocol Identifies Risk of Contamination Between Fish Hatcheries in the Same Watershed
article.articleSummary: GIS-based Protocol Identifies Contamination Risk Across Fish Hatcheries Sharing a Watershed. A Brazilian study by Embrapa Pesca e Aquicultura (TO) and Italy's IZSVe validates a Geographic Information System (GIS) protocol to monitor aquatic animal diseases and enhance epidemiological surveillance in aquaculture. Applying the Italian framework to the acanthocephalan parasite affecting tambaqui (Colossoma macropomum), researchers built an early-warning map that classifies nearby nurseries within a defined watershed as high, medium, or low contamination risk. The approach underscores hydrological connectivity as a driver of disease spread beyond individual farms, including during past events such as a 2015 Rondônia outbreak. Life cycle: parasite eggs shed in fish feces infect intermediate ostracods, then fish ingest them; complete cycle ~2 months. Economic impact: parasitized fish may lose up to 20% weight. Data gaps from state sanitation agencies hinder comprehensive surveillance. Publication: Frontiers in Marine Science.

triage.headline_ja: 流域を共有する養魚場間の汚染リスクを特定するプロトコル
triage.triage_reason: 本イベントは養魚場における寄生虫（アカントセファラ）の監視に関するGISプロトコル開発の学術的研究報告であり、人間の健康への直接的な脅威ではない。水産動物疾病の技術的管理手法に関するものであり、IHR基準およびWPROスクリーニング基準のいずれにも該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は養魚産業向けの疾病監視技術に関する学術出版物である。2015年のロンドニア地域での小規模な発生歴に言及されているが、現在の新規の人獣共通感染症発生事例ではなく、感染症危機管理の対象外。影響カテゴリが『animals』『environment』に分類されており、ヒト感染のリスクを示唆する内容ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Rusvai Miklós: ha Magyarországra is bekerül az ebola, az egyenesen Közép-Afrikából érkezik
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Miklós Rusvai: If Ebola Enters Hungary as Well, It Would Arrive Directly from Central Africa
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease risk to Hungary as of 2026-06-26, discussed by virologist Miklós Rusvai (University professor). Central Africa, specifically the Democratic Republic of Congo, has reported over 1,000 Ebola infections with at least 260 deaths. The first case identified in Europe occurred in France. If Ebola appears in Hungary, it is most likely imported directly from Congo or an affected Central African region, not from France. Past outbreaks spread via health workers and missionaries who travel back home for care; Hungary has doctors and missionaries in the affected region, creating potential importation risk. Transmission via a single sneeze on a plane is unlikely; infections require near-direct contact with bodily fluids; isolation of infected patients when returning minimizes spread; incubation is short, so local detection occurs. Early symptoms are nonspecific (fever, malaria could be present), with the most telling sign being bleeding in urine, stool, or nasal discharge indicating severe disease.

triage.headline_ja: ミクロシュ・ルスヴァイ：ハンガリーにエボラが侵入した場合、中央アフリカから直接到来する
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。DRCで1,000件以上の感染と260人以上の死亡報告があり、ヨーロッパへの初例侵入（フランス）が既に発生している深刻なシグナルである。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCの進行中のエボラ流行と、ハンガリーへの潜在的な輸入リスクについて論じている。発生地域にはハンガリーとフランスも含まれているが、記事サマリーから確認される実際の患者発生は中央アフリカ（特にDRC）とフランスの初例侵入のみ。ハンガリーはリスク評価・警告の対象国であり、実際の発生地ではないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとしている。対象国リストにハンガリー・フランスが含まれていないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: "Cette épidémie risque d'être la plus meurtrière de l'histoire d'Ebola", alerte le médecin Denis Mukwege, Prix Nobel de la paix 2018
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "This outbreak could be the deadliest in the history of Ebola," warns Dr. Denis Mukwege, Nobel Peace Prize laureate 2018.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola virus in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), with Bundibugyo ebolavirus, is expanding amid ongoing armed conflict. WHO estimates 1,048 cases and 267 deaths, about 25% case fatality. Doctors warn this could be the deadliest Ebola outbreak in history; Nobel laureate Denis Mukwege notes that security measures are hard to implement in a country at war, with inaccessible areas and no vaccines or approved treatments. The article notes a record number of confirmed cases in a single month, unprecedented in prior crises. Since March 2026, the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in DRC has spread to neighboring Uganda. There is mention of a physician tested positive in France after returning from DRC; viral load described as very low by French authorities, indicating an imported case. The piece highlights lack of public trust and the critical health-system challenges.

triage.headline_ja: 「このエボラ流行は歴史上最も致命的になる可能性がある」と、2018年ノーベル平和賞受賞医師デニス・ムクウェゲ氏が警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。Bundibugyo ebolavirus（エボラウイルス）のDRC発生で、隣国ウガンダへの拡大、フランスへの輸入症例、25%の致死率、歴史上最悪の可能性と警告されており、国際的拡大リスク・公衆衛生への深刻な影響・異常性が明確。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではエボラ流行の主要発生地はDRCであり、ウガンダへの拡大、フランスへの輸入症例が記載されている。Bluedot APIではフランスが含まれているが、DRCとウガンダが対象国リストに含まれることから、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。配信日時が2026年であり未来日付だが、内容評価に影響しない。

article.articleHeadline: Đẩy mạnh tiêm phòng vật nuôi, ngăn nguy cơ bệnh dại lây sang người
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Step up vaccination of pets to prevent rabies transmission to humans.
article.articleSummary: Rabies control in Nghệ An Province, Vietnam, has intensified ahead of the hot season with mass vaccination of dogs and cats and guidance on pet management. In Thiên Nhẫn, 1,000 vaccine doses were allocated; Yên Hòa organized mobile vaccination and dog-restriction guidance; Xuân Lâm coordinated campaigns including muzzling in public and annual boosters. The drive follows an outbreak in bản Kẻ Trằng, xã Mậu Thạch, where a dog tested positive after biting five people; all five received post-exposure vaccination. A suspected rabies death in xã Bạch Hà—five months after a dog bite with no vaccination—highlights ongoing risk. Nghệ An CDC reports 15 animal rabies outbreaks in early 2026, all among dogs; 4,595 people received post-exposure vaccination, up 0.3% from 2025. Rabies is nearly always fatal after symptoms; prompt wound care and timely vaccination are essential.

triage.headline_ja: ペット接種を推進し、人への狂犬病感染を防止
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムにおける狂犬病の動物-人間への伝播リスク低減の公衆衛生対応事例。複数の動物アウトブレイクと人間への露出あり（15件の動物狂犬病アウトブレイク、4,595人が曝露後予防接種）が、死亡例は1件のみで大規模流行ではない。情報更新と流行の進展を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事は狂犬病の動物-人間伝播防止を目的とした予防接種キャンペーンに関するもの。ベトナム・Nghệ An Province（ゲオタグ確認）での複数アウトブレイク報告あり。死亡例は1件だが狂犬病は予防接種の遅延時に高い致死率。既存の対策体制が機能しており、国内対応可能と判断。IHR基準は1つのみ該当（重症度）。スクリーニング基準は3つ該当するが、情報不足（公開関心度、国際的広がり）があるため「WATCH」判定。

article.articleHeadline: Rritet në 304 numri i viktimave nga virusi Ebola në Kongo, 1155 raste të infektuara
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola virus death toll in Congo has risen to 304, with 1,155 infected cases.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus in the Democratic Republic of Congo has killed 304 people and infected 1,155 confirmed cases to date. In the past 24 hours, authorities recorded 37 new cases and 5 more deaths. The current outbreak, declared May 15, is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a rare strain with no specific treatment or vaccine. Most prior outbreaks in the region have been due to Zaire ebolavirus, for which a vaccine exists. The outbreak marks the 17th in Central Africa, a region of about 100 million people. Health authorities say improved epidemiological surveillance allowed earlier detection and ongoing transmission is being confirmed on a weekly basis. The region's deadliest outbreak (2018–2020) in the DRC killed nearly 2,300 people from about 3,500 cases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラウイルス死者数が304人に増加、1,155人の感染例
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、エボラウイルスによる継続的な人的被害（304人死亡、1,155人感染）と稀な株（Bundibugyo ebolavirus）による国際的拡大リスクが認識される。
triage.notes: コンゴ民主共和国で発生したエボラウイルス流行。Bundibugyo ebolavirus（ブンディブギョウエボラウイルス）という稀な株であり、既存ワクチン（Zaire株向け）が有効でない点が特に懸念される。2018-2020年のDRCアウトブレイク（約2,300人死亡）に次ぐ規模に達する可能性がある。24時間ごとに新規症例が報告されており、週次で感染確認が続いている状況。

article.articleHeadline: Ngất xỉu mới biết mắc sốt xuất huyết
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fainting Leads to Dengue Fever Diagnosis.
article.articleSummary: Three dengue fever cases in Vietnam illustrate ongoing transmission and risk of severe disease. Ngọc Ngân, 21, a student living in a mosquito-prone dorm, had three days of high fever, nausea and fatigue, then developed a widespread rash and fainted. Dengue required IV fluids and close monitoring for a week. Thanh Trang, 28, from Vĩnh Long, initially treated at home for suspected flu; after deterioration she developed shock and hypotension, and was admitted to Can Tho General Hospital for aggressive fluid therapy, stabilizing within 24 hours. Thanh Tuấn, 15, from Đồng Nai, presented with fever, dizziness, and shortness of breath, rapidly progressed to shock and coagulopathy, and required intensive care. Dengue has four serotypes; climate change and urbanization drive year-round transmission with earlier peaks. Vietnam's vaccination program uses a two-dose vaccine for ages 4 and up, spaced three months, with no pre-test required, protecting against four serotypes.

triage.headline_ja: 失神で新たにデング熱と判明
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムにおけるデング熱の複数重症例（ショック、出血傾向を含む）が報告されており、WPROスクリーニング基準の重症度および流行しやすさの基準に該当。継続的な伝播リスクが示唆されており、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: インフルエンザも疾患として登録されているが、記事サマリーではデング熱が主題。複数事例で重症化（ショック、凝固障害、集中治療が必要）が報告されており、気候変動と都市化による通年伝播が指摘されている。ベトナムの予防接種プログラムが存在することも記載されている。

article.articleHeadline: Meglepő dolog derült ki az eboláról: innen érkezhetne Magyarországra a halálos vírus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A surprising discovery about Ebola has come to light: the deadly virus could reach Hungary from here.
article.articleSummary: June 26, 2026 — Ebola is centered in Central Africa, mainly Congo, with over 1,000 confirmed infections and at least 260 deaths. The first European case has been identified in France; in Hungary, domestic spread is considered minimal and likely limited to imported infections from Central Africa. Hungarian virologist Rusvai Miklós says any Hungarian case would most likely be brought home by healthcare workers returning from the region. Transmission occurs via body fluids; airborne spread on a plane is virtually impossible. Early symptoms mimic malaria; a clear sign is blood in body fluids in advanced disease. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo strain (mutates, known since 2007); no approved vaccine, and a vaccine candidate would be too costly for widespread use in Central Africa. Without specific cures, supportive care—hydration, bleeding control, and pain relief—can lower mortality, which is 30-70% in Africa and under 10% in modern European hospitals.

triage.headline_ja: エボラに関する驚くべき事実が明らかに：この致命的ウイルスはハンガリーに到達する可能性がある
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイク（1,000以上の確認症例、260以上の死亡）がコンゴで発生しており、欧州への拡大（フランスで初症例確認）が確認されている。IHR基準3つ以上該当、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当し、国際的拡大リスクが高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、エボラアウトブレイクの主要発生地はコンゴ（DRC）であることが明確。フランスでの症例はヨーロッパでの確認例だが、対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ハンガリーは発生地域リストに含まれているが、サマリーではハンガリー国内での流行は最小限で「輸入症例に限定される可能性が高い」と述べられており、実際の発生地はDRCおよび中央アフリカ。対象国から見えるリスク地域はDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Angola não participa do fórum de Macau devido a epidemia de Ébola - organização
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Angola does not participate in the Macau Forum due to the Ebola epidemic - organization.
article.articleSummary: Angola’s Banda Duia will not participate in the 18th Week of the China–Portuguese-speaking Countries Cultural Forum due to Ebola-related health restrictions. Organized by the Forum for Economic and Commercial Cooperation between China and Lusophone Countries (Forum of Macau), the event runs June 27–July 10, 2026, across Macau, Qinghai province, and Beijing, under the theme 'Cultural Encounters Sino-Lusophone, Friendship Without Borders.' The program includes artistic performances, tours, a Lusophone gastronomy show, a crafts expo with 158 pieces from nine countries, and a short-video contest for Chinese and Lusophone youths. Confirmed participants include chefs and artists from Portugal, Brazil, Cape Verde, Guinea-Bissau, Mozambique, Equatorial Guinea, São Tomé and Príncipe, Timor-Leste; Angola is absent. Beijing events are at the Chaoyang Park Amphitheatre. Macau has imposed 21-day surveillance for travelers from ten African countries at risk due to the Ebola outbreak, which originated in the Democratic Republic of Congo and evolved into an epidemic.

triage.headline_ja: アンゴラがエボラ流行のため澳門フォーラムに参加せず - 組織発表
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス疾患の流行が確認され、複数国にまたがる国際的な影響が生じている。IHR基準で異常性・予想外性・国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限が該当し、公衆衛生上の懸念が明白である。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域には多数の国が含まれるが、記事サマリーの内容に基づき、実際にエボラ流行が発生している検証済み国はDRC（流行原点）、アンゴラを含むアフリカ地域、及び中国（澳門・北京での国際イベント開催地）である。対象国リストの制約により、Brazil（ポルトガル語話者フォーラムの参加国）のみ verified_locations に含める。中国は香港・マカオを含め China ID で対応。DRCは対象国リストに含まれているため追加。記事には明示的にアンゴラでのエボラ流行が記述されているが、対象国リストにアンゴラが含まれていないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Nuo Ebolos mirusių žmonių skaičius Konge perkopė 300
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The death toll from Ebola in Congo has surpassed 300.
article.articleSummary: Death toll from Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo has reached 304, with 1,155 confirmed infections reported as of June 26, 2026, according to Kinshasa's Ministry of Information. The outbreak in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu remains uncontrolled, with Ituri in the northeastern region particularly affected. Ebola virus disease is a life-threatening illness transmitted via direct contact and contact with bodily fluids. For the Bundibugyo strain causing the current outbreak, there is no vaccine or specific treatment yet; clinical drug trials are expected to begin next week. The antiviral Remdesivir has arrived in Congo for post-exposure use, per Africa CDC, and the US product MBP134 is slated for delivery in the coming days. Several companies are developing vaccines in parallel.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ感染による死者数が300人を超える
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病は致死性が高く、DRCの複数地域で急速に拡大する重大な公衆衛生上の脅威である。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病の大規模アウトブレイク。2026年6月26日時点で死者304名、確認感染者1,155名。Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu地域で複数の焦点があり、制御不可能な状態。ワクチン開発が進行中だがBundibugyo型に対する治療法はまだない。Remdesivirと実験段階の治療薬（MBP134）が到着している。国際的な公衆衛生対応と支援が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus TBC Indonesia Nomor Dua di Dunia, Wamenkes Tekankan Pengobatan Sampai Tuntas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Indonesia's TB cases are the second-highest in the world; Deputy Health Minister emphasizes completing treatment.
article.articleSummary: Indonesia ranks second globally in tuberculosis (TB) cases, according to Deputy Health Minister Benjamin Paulus Octavianus. He spoke during the 80th Bhayangkara Health Day at Pendopo Ki Gede Sebayu, Tegal, Central Java, on 23 June 2026. He stressed rapid case finding and ensuring patients complete treatment to cut TB transmission. The government backs the TOSS Presisi Berantas TB Paru program, launched with the Central Java Police, to strengthen public health services and advance TB elimination alongside non-communicable disease prevention. Local authorities in Central Java and the City of Tegal were praised for optimal active case finding and reporting. At the event, 975 residents used general treatment and free health checks; 139 received internal medicine services; 96 underwent neurological exams; 865 received free medications; and 54 under-fives received stunting services. The government aims to accelerate TB elimination through cross-sector collaboration and expanded health access.

triage.headline_ja: インドネシアのTBC症例は世界で2番目、ワメンケスが治療完了を強調
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアが結核患者数で世界2位という疫学的重要性が認識されているが、記事は既知の負担状況の確認と対策推進に関するものであり、新規の急性シグナル（アウトブレイク、異常な増加、新型菌株など）の報告ではない。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事は結核の継続的な負担と政府による既存対策プログラム（TOSS Presisi Berantas TB Paru）の推進について述べている。新規アウトブレイク、異常な上昇傾向、耐性菌の報告などの急性シグナルは含まれていない。結核は流行病学的に重要な疾患であり、インドネシアは疾病負担が高い地域であるため、情報収集価値は認める。

article.articleHeadline: Extremläufer lief 11.000 Kilometer durch Afrika - er begegnete Elefanten, Malaria und eigene Grenzen
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ultrarunner ran 11,000 kilometers across Africa — he encountered elephants, malaria, and his own limits.
article.articleSummary: Fritz Sitte, 29, walked about 11,000 kilometers on foot across Africa from Cape Town to Tangier, Morocco, with only his brother on a bicycle as support. The trek followed years of prior distance on roads totaling over 25,000 kilometers. He faced moments of both awe and danger, including an elephant encounter in Zambia and malaria symptoms in Nairobi, plus a parasitic stomach infection and a knee flare-up during the second attempt after a first abort at around 1,500 kilometers due to hip-joint inflammation diagnosed by MRI. He rehabilitated in Cape Town for five months before restarting the journey and finishing. Training combined running, cycling, and strength work, with mental strategies built from pushing through earlier pain. He now shares lessons in talks, emphasizing 'People are great' and the coexistence of joy and pain in sport and life, including his father's illness.

triage.headline_ja: ウルトラランナーがアフリカを11,000km走破 — ゾウ、マラリア、自らの限界と対面
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はアスリートの個人的な冒険旅行の報道であり、マラリア発生のアウトブレイク情報ではない。個人の健康問題の言及にすぎず、公衆衛生上の懸念事項を示していない。
triage.notes: 記事はドイツのスポーツメディアによるエクストリームアスリートの個人的な冒険譚。マラリアはランナーが個人的に遭遇した健康上の問題として言及されているのみであり、感染症発生・流行・アウトブレイクの報道ではない。ザンビアとナイロビ（ケニア）での個人的な病気報告は含まれているが、組織的な感染症監視・公衆衛生対応の文脈がない。スポーツイベント報道として分類されるべきコンテンツ。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola death toll in DRC tops 300 amid widening outbreak
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) caused by the Bundibugyo strain has surpassed 300 deaths, with 304 fatalities among 1,155 confirmed cases as of the latest update. The outbreak, declared on May 15, remains active across 34 health zones in three provinces—the epicentre Ituri, and North Kivu and South Kivu. Health authorities reported 16 new recoveries in Ituri after negative control tests, bringing total recoveries to 138. The case fatality rate stands at 26.3%. The Africa Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (Africa CDC) flagged that the continental response and preparedness plan requires about $1.4 billion to scale up measures. The situation highlights ongoing transmission in the Ituri epicentre with spillover across provinces.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ死者数が300人を超える、感染拡大が広がる中
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の大規模流行で、死亡率26.3%、1,155例の確定例、複数州への拡大、国際的支援の必要性が明確である。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株によるエボラウイルス病の大規模流行。304例の死亡、26.3%の致命率、3州34の保健ゾーンにおける継続的な伝播。Africa CDCが約14億ドルの国際的対応・準備経費を指摘。フルRRA実施の優先度は極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Awas, Virus Ebola Sudah Masuk Prancis, Dibawa Seorang Dokter
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Beware, the Ebola virus has entered France, carried by a doctor.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease has reached France via a doctor who returned from a humanitarian mission in the Democratic Republic of Congo. The French Health Ministry confirmed the first case on June 24, 2026, with the patient receiving care in a dedicated facility, in stable condition, and isolated as a precaution. A comprehensive epidemiological investigation is under way to identify exposed individuals, and five people seated near the doctor on the flight to France have already been identified and isolated. ALIMA, a medical relief NGO active in DR Congo, confirms the patient is a doctor who worked with its team. Public health authorities are tracing contacts and reinforcing infection-control measures to prevent secondary transmission from this imported Ebola case.

triage.headline_ja: 警告：エボラウイルスがフランスに入国、医師が持ち込み
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルスの国際的な人的移動による越境感染であり、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限のリスクが全て存在。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの主題はDRC由来のエボラウイルスがフランスに持ち込まれた事案である。Bluedot APIが「発生地域」としてFranceを含めているが、フランスは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRCは対象国であり、実際のイベント発生地でもあるため含める。患者は医療従事者で、接触者追跡が進行中という重大な状況である。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو الديمقراطية تسجل أكثر من 300 وفاة بسبب فيروس إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo records more than 300 deaths due to Ebola virus.
article.articleSummary: As of 26 June 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo reports an Ebola outbreak with 1,155 laboratory-confirmed infections, 304 deaths, 138 recoveries, and 326 patients under treatment or isolation. Kinshasa records the national totals, noting rapid spread since mid-May of the Bundibugyo lineage, a strain with no licensed vaccine or specific treatment. Health Minister Roger Kamba issued a decree imposing a strict 21-day quarantine for health workers and response teams returning from affected areas, and restricting internal and international travel during the period. The decree also bars travel for residents of affected provinces and requires all international travelers to complete a health declaration form checked by airlines. The outbreak’s trajectory remains linked to Bundibugyo lineage transmission, with ongoing containment measures.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国がエボラウイルスによる300人以上の死亡を記録
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。1,155例の確定患者、304人の死亡という深刻な影響、ワクチン・治療法のないBundibugyo系統の予想外な出現、国際的な拡大リスク、渡航制限措置の実施が確認される。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo系統はレアな変異株であり、ライセンス取得済みワクチンや特異的治療法がないため対応が困難。保健大臣による明確な隔離・渡航制限令が発出されており、政府の対応能力に懸念あり。国際的サポートが必要と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: La RDC annonce une augmentation du nombre de cas confirmés d'Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The DRC announces an increase in the number of confirmed Ebola cases.
article.articleSummary: DRC reports 1,155 confirmed Ebola cases and 304 deaths, with 138 recoveries and 326 patients still in treatment or isolation. The outbreak, centered in Ituri province, is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which there is no licensed vaccine or specific therapy. A French physician involved in Ebola response in Ituri has tested positive, with health authorities in both DRC and France monitoring the situation. To reinforce control, the DRC imposed stricter travel rules for people returning from Ebola-affected zones: 21 days of active health surveillance for health workers, laboratory staff, and emergency responders, during which travel is prohibited domestically and internationally. Anyone who has stayed in an affected province cannot travel abroad until 21 days outside the region. International travelers leaving the DRC must complete a border health declaration form, and airlines must ensure compliance. The outbreak was declared mid-May.

triage.headline_ja: DRC、エボラの確認症例数の増加を発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。確認症例1,155件・死亡304件の大規模流行、Bundibugyo ebolavirus（ワクチン・特異的治療なし）、フランス人医師の感染報告による国際的拡大リスク、DRCによる21日間の渡航制限措置。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCのIturi州での流行を主題としており、フランス人医師の感染は監視対象だが発生地はDRCに限定される。Franceは監視国として記載されているが、実際の流行地ではないため除外。Bundibugyo ebolavirus（BDBV）はZaire ebolavirus より死亡率は低いが、治療・ワクチン選択肢の欠如により国際的懸念は高い。

article.articleHeadline: اصابات الايبولا تتخطى الالف في الكونغو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola cases exceed one thousand in the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of Congo has surpassed 1,100 confirmed cases, reaching 1,155 with 304 deaths, according to government data cited by Reuters, reflecting confirmed infections up to Wednesday and ongoing transmission across multiple areas despite containment and surveillance. The World Health Organization says the global risk from this outbreak remains low, but notes that the situation in the DRC and neighboring Uganda is placing heavy demands on health-response capacities, with the Bundibugyo strain described as rare and requiring urgent interventions to curb spread. WHO calls for intensified surveillance, strengthened early-detection systems, and expanded medical response in the hardest-hit areas to contain the outbreak and prevent transmission to new regions. Global risk remains relatively controlled compared with past outbreaks, even amid concerns about emerging epidemics in Africa.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ患者数が1,000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラウイルス病の確認症例1,155件、死亡304件という重篤な状況であり、隣国ウガンダへの拡大も報告されている。フルRRA進行が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴ民主共和国でのエボラウイルス病の主要な発生を記述しており、ウガンダへの拡大言及もあるが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。WHO によるリスク評価では「グローバルリスクは低い」とされているが、確認症例1,155件、死亡304件という数字とBundibugyo株の稀少性および複数地域での継続的な感染伝播は、深刻な懸念を示している。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola ne jenjava: U Kongu više od 1.150 potvrđenih slučajeva, broj mrtvih raste
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola shows no signs of abating: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, more than 1,150 confirmed cases, death toll rising.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) persists, with 1,155 confirmed cases and 304 deaths reported by health authorities. In the latest 24 hours, 37 new cases and 5 new deaths were documented, indicating ongoing community transmission. The World Health Organization notes the outbreak is linked to the rare Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain. This marks the largest number of confirmed cases recorded in the first month of any Ebola outbreak to date, surpassing earlier West African epidemics (2014–2016) and the DRC’s 2018 outbreak. U.S. funding commitments include a CDC pledge of $107 million in additional emergency aid to strengthen domestic and international response, plus support for an experimental antibody-based therapy in affected areas. France reports its first confirmed case tied to the outbreak after a doctor returned from a humanitarian mission in the DRC. The WHO chief says risk remains low for now, but monitoring is required.

triage.headline_ja: エボラは衰える気配なし：コンゴで1,150件以上の確認症例、死者数が増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、エボラアウトブレイクとしての深刻性、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクが明白。フルRRAに進める。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはUSAとFranceも列挙されているが、記事サマリーの主題はDRCのアウトブレイク。USA・Franceは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCは対象国（GeoNames ID 203312）に該当し、verified_locationsに含める。1ヶ月時点での確認症例数が過去最大、月間死亡者数も増加傾向、Bundibugyo ebolavirus（希少株）により異常性が高い。国際的な支援（CDC資金、仏医療従事者の感染確認）が報告されており、PICKUP判定に値する。

article.articleHeadline: Saudi Arabia Tightens Ebola Precautions with Travel and Visa Restrictions
article.articleSummary: Saudi Arabia tightened Ebola precautions on 2026-06-26, suspending travel by Saudi citizens to the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda and South Sudan and halting issuance of all visas for travelers arriving from those countries. The restrictions also apply to arrivals via third countries if they have been in any of the three states within the prior 21 days. Health surveillance and emergency response systems remain active in coordination with domestic and international partners; no confirmed or suspected Ebola cases have been recorded since these measures were introduced. The government described the steps as preventive to limit transmission and protect citizens, residents and visitors. Enhanced screening is already in place for travelers from Rwanda, Burundi, Tanzania and the Republic of the Congo, with reinforced entry screening, surveillance and early response protocols.

triage.headline_ja: サウジアラビア、エボラ熱対策を強化し渡航およびビザ制限を実施
triage.triage_reason: エボラ熱の国際的拡大リスクが明示的に存在し、複数国での渡航制限実施という国際対応が発生している。IHR基準2つ以上（国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限）に該当し、シグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: サマリーに基づく実際の発生地域はDRCとウガンダおよび南スーダンだが、対象国リストではDRCのみ該当。サウジアラビアの制限措置は国際対応を示しており、IHR基準を複数満たすため、フルRRA進行は必須。

article.articleHeadline: Les Casques bleus vietnamiens engagés dans la prévention d'Ebola à Abyei
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Vietnamese UN Peacekeepers Engaged in Ebola Prevention in Abyei.
article.articleSummary: As of 26 June 2026, Vietnamese UN peacekeepers are conducting Ebola prevention work in Abyei, amid the rainy season that triggers floods and potable-water contamination. Prolonged humidity and stagnant water raise infection risks, with vulnerable groups such as children and the elderly most affected. Transport difficulties disrupt medical supply chains and create PPE shortages, complicating frontline response. The 4th Engineer Battalion’s Level-1 field hospital organized infection prevention and control trainings for all staff, covering symptom recognition, PPE use, and safe community contacts. The hospital also distributed hundreds of PPE kits to high-traffic sites—health centers, schools, and religious venues—addressing shortages and strengthening cooperation with local medical structures, praised by an Abyei hospital representative. At Abyei High School, military physicians demonstrated WHO-standard handwashing and shared prevention measures to reduce public-space contacts, fostering Ebola-protection practices among youths.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムの国連平和維持要員がアビエイでエボラ出血熱予防に従事
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱は重大な疾患だが、記事は予防活動と能力構築に焦点があり、アクティブな患者数や死亡者の報告がない。発生地域はスーダン（対象国外）であり、検証済みの対象国での発生確認がない。
triage.notes: 発生地域リストにはVietnam (1562822) が含まれているが、記事サマリーはベトナムの国連平和維持要員がスーダン領アビエイで実施する予防活動に関するもので、ベトナム国内でのエボラ出血熱の実際の発生やケースは報告されていない。したがって verified_locations は空配列。スーダンは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。記事は予防・能力構築活動に焦点があり、確認されたアクティブな患者発生やアウトブレイク宣言の報告がないため、WATCH判定。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, 304 morti in Repubblica democratica del Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: 304 deaths in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of June 24, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 1,155 confirmed Ebola cases, 304 deaths, 138 recoveries, and 326 patients in treatment. The outbreak is active in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu, with Ituri as the primary hotspot. The case fatality rate is 26.3%, and contact monitoring stands at 79.2%. Six new recoveries were recorded in Ituri after follow-up negative tests. In response, the DRC and Uganda launched a 90-day joint cross-border plan to strengthen laboratory and care capacities, particularly in the Aru area, aiming to curb cross-border transmission and bolster regional containment efforts.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：コンゴ民主共和国での304人の死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WPRO基準も5つすべて該当。エボラ出血熱の大規模流行であり、隣国ウガンダへの越境感染リスクを含む。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病の活動的な大規模流行。1,155確認患者、304死亡（致死率26.3%）を記録。Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu州が影響を受け、Ituriが主要なホットスポット。DRCとウガンダが90日間の越境合同計画を開始し、越境感染抑制と地域的封じ込めを強化。記事に基づきDRCのみを検証済み位置として記載（ウガンダは記事では言及されているが、実際の流行発生地はDRCが主体）。

article.articleHeadline: Kematian akibat Ebola di RD Kongo lampaui 300 kasus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola death toll in DR Congo surpasses 300.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreaks continue in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with active transmission across Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu. As of June 26, 2026, there are 1,155 laboratory-confirmed cases and 300 deaths, for a case-fatality rate of 26.3%. Earlier on June 23, government figures reported 1,048 cases and 267 deaths. The WHO said that the outbreak's first month includes the largest number of confirmed cases for an African Ebola outbreak. In May 2026, WHO declared the Ebola outbreaks in DR Congo and Uganda a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, citing high risk of further spread in the region. The report stresses ongoing active transmission in three provinces and international concern about containment.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ死亡数が300人を超える
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全てに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の大規模流行、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHOが公衆衛生上の国際的懸念事態（PHEIC）を宣言し、地域での活発な感染伝播が継続。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではウガンダの言及がありますが、本イベントの主題はコンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ流行です。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsには含めていません。2026年5月のWHO PHEIC宣言、1,155確定症例、26.3%の高い致命率、複数州での活発な感染伝播が確認されています。

article.articleHeadline: El brote de ébola puede que llegue a Sudán del Sur, según un estudio basado en modelos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak could reach South Sudan, according to a model-based study.
article.articleSummary: From the Democratic Republic of the Congo, 1,155 confirmed Ebola cases and 304 deaths were reported as of June 24, with 95% bed occupancy, prompting calls to build treatment centers and expand hospital capacity. A Lancet Infectious Diseases modeling study, with WHO input, estimates about a 70% probability the Bundibugyo-strain outbreak could reach South Sudan, and notes it has already spread to Uganda. Transmission appears to have started in early April; a six-week delay between first case and official confirmation suggests undetected spread in a conflict-affected region with displacement and limited health access. Uganda had 20 confirmed cases by June 22. South Sudan is the top preparedness priority (69.3% chance of at least one case within 12 weeks), while Rwanda (8.6%) and Burundi (2.0%) show lower risks. The study simulated low/medium/high transmission; most likely projections estimate ~990 cases and 174 deaths by end of June, rising to ~8,210 cases by September if transmission continues.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス流行がスーダン（南スーダン）に到達する可能性、モデルベースの研究によると
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（重篤な公衆衛生影響、予想外の多国間拡大、国際的な感染拡大リスク、渡航制限のリスク）。アフリカ複数国での確認事例と広範な流行予測モデルにより、フルRRA実施の必須条件を満たす。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは複数国（スーダン南部、ルワンダ、ブルンジ、ウガンダ）への拡大リスク評価を述べているが、確認された実際の流行発生地は DRC のみ。南スーダンはモデル予測の対象であり、現在のところ確認事例なし。ウガンダについても記事では「既にウガンダに拡大している」と述べているが、対象国リストに Uganda は含まれていない（GeoNames ID 226074）ため verified_locations には含めない。流行モデルの70%確率は高いリスク指標であり、多地域への拡大可能性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Mbi 300 viktima nga Ebola në Kongo, epidemia vazhdon të përhapet - GazetaBlic
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Over 300 Ebola victims in Congo, the epidemic continues to spread - GazetaBlic
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus. It spans Ituri (epicenter) and the provinces of North Kivu and South Kivu, remaining active in all three. Confirmed cases reach 1,155 with 304 deaths since the epidemic was declared on May 15, yielding a 26.3% case fatality rate. In Ituri, 16 patients have newly recovered after negative tests, elevating total recoveries to 138. Africa CDC notes a continental response and preparedness plan requires about $1.4 billion; African Union partners pledged $910 million, but only about 13% of promised funds have been disbursed. The Congolese government has imposed a mandatory 21-day quarantine for travelers from affected zones to curb spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ出血熱の犠牲者が300人を超え、流行が継続している
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5つ全て該当。エボラウイルス病は高い死亡率（26.3%）を示す重大な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、国際的な支援が必要な状況である。
triage.notes: 確認症例数1,155件、死亡者304人、致命率26.3%で深刻な状況。Ituri（震源）、North Kivu、South Kivu の3州で継続的に活動中。Bundibugyo ebolavirus による亜型での発症。コンゴ政府は感染地域からの旅行者に対して21日間の強制検疫を実施。アフリカ連合パートナーは承約資金のわずか13%しか拠出していない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Fälle im Kongo: Bereits über 300 Tote | Heute.at
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola cases in the Congo: More than 300 dead already.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues to claim lives, with 304 deaths reported among 1,155 confirmed infections. The current outbreak is driven by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which there is no approved vaccine or specific treatment at present. In the last 24 hours, 37 new infections and five additional deaths were recorded, underscoring rapid transmission. Authorities urge heightened vigilance and call for international support to contain spread, mobilize resources, and reinforce surveillance, case management, and infection-control measures. The report indicates ongoing transmission across affected areas, highlighting the lack of a licensed intervention for this strain. Public health agencies stress the need for expedited international assistance to augment response capacity and protect at-risk populations. No details on travel or cross-border cases are provided in the article.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱：既に300人以上が死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）を満たし、WPRO基準も全て該当。確認された1,155例、304人の死亡という重大な状況であり、国際支援の明確な必要性が指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: 中国援外血吸虫病哨点医院在坦桑尼亚桑给巴尔设立
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China-aided schistosomiasis sentinel hospital established in Zanzibar, Tanzania.
article.articleSummary: On June 25, 2026, a China-aided schistosomiasis sentinel hospital was inaugurated on Pemba Island, Zanzibar, Tanzania, as part of the Phase II Technical Assistance Project for schistosomiasis control. The ceremony at a district hospital included representatives from the project team, hospital management, and health authorities. The sentinel hospital will undertake case finding, diagnosis, treatment, epidemic surveillance, data reporting, and health education, establishing a local monitoring network to track transmission dynamics and inform control measures. Hospital leaders expressed gratitude for sustained technical support, noting that the facility will enhance diagnosis, treatment, and disease surveillance to improve public health services and advance elimination goals on the islands. After the unveiling, donations of microscopy equipment, diagnostic reagents, masks, medicines, and other supplies were provided to support routine care. The experts and clinicians discussed case management, laboratory testing, and surveillance reporting, with plans to deepen cooperation and capacity building to promote China–Tanzania health collaboration.

triage.notes: 記事はタンザニアのザンジバルにおける血吸虫病対策用の中国援外医療施設（哨点医院）の設立式典についての報道である。これは感染症の新規発生、流行、または異常な疾病パターンを報告するものではなく、医療インフラの拡充・支援活動である。対象国リストにはタンザニアが含まれていないため、verified_locationsは空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: Ronald Ross y el misterio de la malaria
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ronald Ross and the Mystery of Malaria
article.articleSummary: Malaria, once called the fever of swamps, killed millions in tropical regions; the miasma theory blamed swamp air until Alphonse Laveran identified the parasite in 1880. Ronald Ross, born 1857 in India and serving in the Indian Medical Service, was inspired by Patrick Manson to test the mosquito vector theory. Returning to Secunderabad in 1895, he dissected thousands of Anopheles mosquitoes fed on malaria patients. On August 20, 1897, he observed circular cells with black pigment granules in the mosquito gut, proving Anopheles mosquitoes transmit malaria. In 1898, in Calcutta, he showed the parasite migrates to the salivary glands, ready to infect a new host. This discovery shifted public health toward vector control—drainage, insecticides, and bed nets—saving countless lives. Ross won the 1902 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine, was knighted, and led the Liverpool School of Tropical Medicine; the World Mosquito Day on August 20 honors the breakthrough.

triage.headline_ja: ロナルド・ロスとマラリアの謎

triage.notes: 本記事は歴史的な回顧記事（Ronald Ross の業績紹介）であり、現在進行中の感染症イベントを報じていない。Bluedot APIが付与した地域情報（インド、英国など）は歴史的背景の説明に過ぎず、現在の発生地は記述されていない。したがって verified_locations は空配列とする。

article.articleHeadline: நாளை மறுநாள் போலியோ சொட்டு மருந்து முகாம்!! தஞ்சாவூர் கலெக்டர் முக்கிய சொன்ன முக்கிய தகவல்
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Polio Drops Campaign Tomorrow or the Day After!! Thanjavur District Collector's Important Information.
article.articleSummary: Polio vaccination drive announced in Tamil Nadu by the Thanjavur District Collector, scheduling a one-day administration of oral polio drops for all children under five, to be held tomorrow or the day after. The official cites the Tamil Nadu government’s intensified efforts and notes that there have been no polio cases in Tamil Nadu since 2004. The campaign aims to eradicate the poliovirus entirely by achieving universal coverage in the under-five cohort on a single day. The statement emphasizes vaccination as the central public-health measure to maintain a polio-free status, with ongoing surveillance and immunization activities across Thanjavur and the state.

triage.headline_ja: ポリオワクチン接種キャンペーン明日または明後日開催！！タンジャヴール地区コレクターからの重要情報
triage.triage_reason: タミルナドゥ州は2004年以来ポリオ患者がなく、本記事は予防的ワクチン接種キャンペーンの告知である。IHR基準およびWPRO基準の該当なし。
triage.notes: 本イベントはポリオ患者の発生ではなく、予防的ワクチン接種キャンペーンの行政通知である。タミルナドゥ州は2004年以来ポリオフリーを維持しており、維持活動の一環と考えられる。シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: La RDC annonce une augmentation du nombre de cas confirmés d'Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The DRC announces an increase in the number of confirmed Ebola cases.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) reports 1,155 confirmed Ebola cases and 304 deaths, with 138 recoveries and 326 patients still in treatment or isolation. The outbreak centers on Ituri province, where a French physician who aided the Ebola response has tested positive for Bundibugyo ebolavirus. In response, authorities tightened travel measures: health professionals, laboratory staff, and emergency-response teams returning from Ebola-affected areas must undergo 21 days of active health surveillance and are barred from domestic or international travel during that period. Anyone who has stayed in an affected province cannot travel abroad for 21 days outside the zone. Those leaving the country on international flights must complete a border health declaration form, with airlines enforcing it. Declared mid-May, this Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak currently has no licensed vaccine or specific treatment.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国がエボラ確認患者数の増加を発表
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の確認患者1,155名、死亡304名という深刻な公衆衛生影響。IHR基準では重症度・国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限が該当（3/4基準）。WPROスクリーニング基準では重症度・流行しやすさ・管理可能性が該当（3/5基準）。国際的関心も高く、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus（ブンディブギョエボラウイルス）の発生であり、ザイールエボラウイルスよりも致死率は低いが、ワクチンや特異的治療法がない状況。フランス人医療従事者の感染確認により、国際的な医療従事者への感染リスクも顕在化。渡航・移動制限措置が強化されている点から、国際的拡大懸念が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola cases jump as Congo tightens travel rules
article.articleSummary: 1,155 confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo as of Thursday, with ongoing community transmission concentrated in Ituri province. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo virus, which has no approved vaccines or treatments; the World Health Organization says experimental therapies will begin next week. More than 300 people have died and about 100 recovered. Enhanced epidemiological surveillance is aiding earlier detection, but contact tracing remains limited at 55% coverage, with over 35,000 identified contacts as of last week. Officials warn the peak of the outbreak may still be ahead. A doctor who flew from Kinshasa tested positive for Ebola on arrival in France, prompting tightened travel rules.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱感染者数が急増、コンゴが渡航規制を強化
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo）の大規模アウトブレイク（1,155例、300人以上の死亡）で深刻な公衆衛生影響があり、国際的な拡大リスク（フランスでの症例確認）も確認された。IHR基準3つ以上該当。
triage.notes: 記事の主要な感染症イベント（エボラアウトブレイク）はDRCで発生。Franceは関連情報として含まれるが、実際のウイルス発生地ではないため verified_locations から除外。Bundibugyo ebola virus、ワクチン/治療薬なし、進行中の社会的伝播、接触者追跡カバー率55%と管理能力に課題あり。実験的治療開始予定。

article.articleHeadline: WHO mora djelovati: Zaboravljeni parazit koji pogađa svku treću osobu na svijetu ozbiljan je rizik po ljudsko zdravlje
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO must act: The forgotten parasite that affects one in three people worldwide is a serious risk to human health.
article.articleSummary: About one-third of the global population is infected with Toxoplasma gondii, causing toxoplasmosis—the leading ocular infection and a major cause of vision loss. It spreads through undercooked meat, cat feces with oocysts, and vertical transmission from mother to fetus; congenital infection can cause abortion and severe neonatal complications. Most people are asymptomatic, but ocular toxoplasmosis can progress to blindness. The commentary argues toxoplasmosis is a neglected tropical disease, with far less funding, research, and prevention than similar illnesses, despite meeting WHO criteria: poverty, tropical/subtropical distribution, preventability, and policy neglect. About 190,000 children are born each year with congenital toxoplasmosis, with the heaviest burden in areas with limited healthcare. Authors from Flinders University (Australia) and the University of São Paulo (Brazil) urge WHO recognition to boost prenatal surveillance, safe food and water, and coordinated global action.

triage.headline_ja: WHO は行動すべき：世界中の3人に1人に影響を与える忘れられた寄生虫は、人間の健康に対する深刻なリスクである
triage.triage_reason: トキソプラズマ症は公衆衛生上の大きな負担（世界人口の約3分の1が感染、毎年19万人の先天性感染児）を示すが、記事は主に科学的指摘と政策提言であり、新規の急性感染症アウトブレイクではない。ただしスクリーニング基準複数該当のため継続観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は既知の慢性感染症（トキソプラズマ症）についての政策的な注意喚起であり、新規アウトブレイクではない。しかし世界的な公衆衛生負担の大きさ、先天性感染による重症度、および WHO の公認を求める国際的な呼びかけを含む。Australia は発生地域に含まれるが、サマリーでの主要な言及は Flinders University からの著者による提言であり、実際の発生や患者数の集中は記載されていないため、Brazil（サンパウロ大学の著者所属）のみを verified_locations に含める。

article.articleHeadline: Число умерших от лихорадки Эбола в ДРК превысило 300, усилены меры контроля
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The death toll from Ebola virus disease in the DRC has exceeded 300; control measures have been intensified.
article.articleSummary: Death toll from Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of Congo has surpassed 300 amid the ongoing outbreak. By 26 June 2026, 1155 laboratory-confirmed cases and 304 deaths have been reported; 138 patients have recovered and 326 remain hospitalized or in quarantine. A confirmed infection was reported in a French doctor involved in outbreak response in Ituri province, the outbreak epicenter, with authorities monitoring closely. On 20 June in Mongbvalu, medical workers accompanied an infected patient at an Ebola treatment center. In response, the DRC has introduced stricter entry requirements for travelers from Ebola-affected areas to curb transmission. The ministry bulletin posted on X confirmed the French doctor case and that authorities are intensifying control measures.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱の死亡者数が300人を超え、防御措置が強化される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の国際拡大、国際感染リスク、渡航制限実施）。エボラ出血熱の確認患者数1,155名、死亡者304名という大規模発生で、フランス人医療従事者の感染確認により国際的な関心も高い。

article.articleHeadline: Kematian Akibat Ebola di RD Kongo Lampaui 300 Kasus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola deaths in DR Congo exceed 300.
article.articleSummary: As of 26 June 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains active in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu. Confirmed cases total 1,155 with 304 deaths, a case fatality rate of 26.3%. Earlier mid-June reports from the DRC government counted 1,048 confirmed cases and 267 deaths (fatality over 25%). The World Health Organization, in May 2026, declared the DR Congo and Uganda Ebola outbreaks as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, citing high risk of further spread in the region. On 23 June, WHO officials said the current outbreak marked the largest number of confirmed cases in the first month for Ebola in Africa. The article does not specify infection sources or details on imported/exported cases. Ongoing surveillance is continuing in the three provinces.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラによる死亡数が300件を超える
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WHOが5月にPHEIC宣言済みで、確定症例1,155件、死亡304件、致命率26.3%。地域的拡大の継続リスクが高い。
