article.articleHeadline: El brote de ébola en República Democrática del Congo alcanza los 1.150 casos y supera los 300 fallecidos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo reaches 1,150 cases and surpasses 300 deaths.
article.articleSummary: 1,155 confirmed Ebola virus disease cases and 304 deaths in the Democratic Republic of the Congo as of 24 June, with the outbreak centered in Ituri province (1,054 cases, 250 deaths; >91% of total; CFR 23.7%). The epidemic, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, is concentrated in Bunia, Mongbwalu, and Rwampara, which together account for the majority of infections; Mongbwalu shows a high fatality rate of 42.9%. North Kivu records 98 cases and 53 deaths (CFR 54.1%), with Katwa, Beni, and Oicha among the most concerning areas; South Kivu has 3 cases and no new transmission since late May. In the last 24 hours, 37 new cases and 5 deaths were reported. An imported case in France involves a physician who treated in Bunia. A 90-day cross-border response with Uganda aims to strengthen diagnostics, clinical care, and surveillance. Challenges include treatment-center saturation (>85%), shortages of medicines and PPE, resistance to safe burials and post-mortem sampling, security risks, cross-border movement, and a ~$20 million funding gap.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ感染症流行は1,150例に達し、300人以上の死亡者を超える
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の大規模流行であり、国際的拡大（フランスへの輸入例）、重大な公衆衛生影響、及び国際支援の緊急性がある。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo ebolavirus）による大規模流行。1,155確定例、304死亡例（CFR 23.7～54.1%）。イトゥリ州が流行の中心（1,054例、250死亡）。フランスへの輸入例あり。ウガンダとの90日間の国境対応計画進行中。治療センターの飽和（>85%）、医薬品・個人防護具の不足、安全埋葬への抵抗、セキュリティリスク、資金不足（約2,000万ドル）が主要な課題。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : Le bilan de l'épidémie d'Ebola dépasse les 300 morts, les cas continuent d'augmenter
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: Ebola outbreak death toll surpasses 300, cases continue to rise.
article.articleSummary: Death toll from the Ebola virus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has surpassed 300, with 304 fatalities among 1,155 confirmed cases since the outbreak was declared on May 15. The Bundibugyo strain is active across 34 health zones in three provinces: Ituri (epicenter), North Kivu, and South Kivu. In recent days, 16 additional patients in Ituri recovered after negative follow-up tests, bringing total recoveries to 138. Case-fatality rate stands at 26.3%. Africa CDC estimates a $1.4 billion funding gap to support continental Ebola preparedness and response, while a high-level meeting under the African Union secured about $910 million in pledges, of which only 13% has been disbursed to affected countries and partners. To curb spread, the Congolese government has imposed a 21-day mandatory quarantine for travelers from affected zones.

triage.headline_ja: DRC: エボラ出血熱の流行による死亡者数が300人を超え、症例数が増加し続けている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。Bundibugyo株による大規模流行で300人超の死亡、26.3%の高い致死率、複数州への拡大、国際的対応が必要。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株によるエボラ出血熱の大規模流行。2026年5月15日に宣言され、304人の確認死亡、1,155例の確認患者。26.3%の高い致死率。Ituri州が震源地で、北キブ州、南キブ州を含む34の保健ゾーンに拡大。資金不足（14億ドルのギャップ）と部分的な支援金の分散が懸念される。政府による厳格な隔離措置が実施されている。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo Ebola death toll surpasses 300 as cases rise
article.articleSummary: As of 26 June 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo's Ebola outbreak has surpassed 300 deaths, with 1,155 confirmed cases since it was declared on May 15. The epidemic, caused by the Bundibugyo strain, spans 34 health zones and remains active in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu, with 304 fatalities (case fatality rate 26.3%). Sixteen new recoveries in Ituri bring total recoveries to 138. Africa CDC is seeking about $1.4 billion for a regional response; pledged funds total roughly $910 million, but only about 13% has been released to affected countries and partners. The Congolese government has imposed a 21-day mandatory quarantine on travellers from affected areas to curb spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱死亡者数が300人を超える（患者数も増加）
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当する深刻なエボラ出血熱の流行。300人以上の死亡、1,155例の確定患者、複数州での継続的な感染拡大、国際的な資金・支援ニーズが確認されており、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱(Bundibugyo株)の大規模流行。2026年5月15日宣言、6月26日時点で304死亡(患者致死率26.3%)。34保健地域で流行中。Africa CDCが14億ドルの地域対応資金を求めており、約9.1億ドルの約束があるが実際の資金配分は13%のみ。DRC政府が隔離対策を実施。

article.articleHeadline: Salmonella chce wygrać "wyścig zbrojeń bakterii". Naukowcy: "Ma nowe narzędzia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Salmonella wants to win the "bacterial arms race." Scientists: "It has new tools."
article.articleSummary: Salmonella enterica from 149 serotypes sampled across 6,165 strains in Sao Paulo, Brazil, reveals 45 previously undescribed toxins produced by Salmonella and a total of 128 toxin types. Analyzed genomes focused on the Type VI secretion system (T6SS), used by Gram-negative bacteria to inject effectors into competitors; the study identifies diverse toxins that act against bacteria and, in some cases, eukaryotic cells including fungi, yeasts, algae, and potentially mammals. Some toxins may contribute to human infections, but confirmation requires linking specific Salmonella strains carrying targeted genes to cellular effects and disease. The findings show each Salmonella group has a unique toxin-effector repertoire, with greater effector diversity in environmental isolates than clinical ones, suggesting environmental competition drives toxin evolution via recombination and natural selection. Implications include novel antibiotics and broader biotechnological applications.

triage.headline_ja: サルモネラが「細菌の軍拡競争」に勝ちたいと考えている。科学者ら：「新しい手段を持っている」
triage.triage_reason: 基礎科学研究論文であり、現在のアウトブレイク報告ではない。感染症イベント（発症者数、死亡者、流行拡大の危機）に関する具体的な公衆衛生的脅威の証拠がない。
triage.notes: 記事の主体はサルモネラ菌のゲノム研究および毒素発見についての科学的論文であり、進行中の感染症アウトブレイク報告ではない。ブラジル・サンパウロで採取された菌株を研究対象としているが、臨床的アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の緊急事態の報告はない。シグナルトリアージの対象外と判定。

article.articleHeadline: Wabah Ebola di Kongo Tewaskan 300 Orang, Kasus Terus Melonjak
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in Kongo kills 300 people, cases continue to rise.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo intensifies, with Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu provinces as active transmission zones. As of 25 June 2026, 1,155 confirmed Ebola cases and 304 deaths (case fatality rate 26.3%) are reported, up from 1,048 cases and 267 deaths on 23 June. WHO notes this is the largest number of confirmed cases in the first month of an Ebola outbreak in Africa. Symptoms include fever, vomiting, diarrhea, and bleeding; transmission is via direct contact with bodily fluids. The outbreak has led WHO to declare a public health emergency of international concern for DR Congo and neighboring Uganda since May 2026, with regional risk high in East and Central Africa. Response includes contact tracing, isolation, vaccine distribution, and public education, but challenges include armed conflict, limited access, and low public awareness.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行で300人死亡、患者数が急増
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準5項目全て該当。WHO既に国際的公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言。
triage.notes: DRCのイツリ州、北キブ州、南キブ州で確認。2026年6月25日時点で1,155確定例、304死亡（致命率26.3%）。WHOは既に5月2026年にPHEIC（国際的公衆衛生上の緊急事態）を宣言。ウガンダも地域的リスク対象。記事サマリーはウガンダを言及していますが、主要な発生地はDRCであり、ウガンダでの確定例報告はサマリーに明記されていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとしました。

article.articleHeadline: Во Конго од ебола починаа над 300 лица
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Congo, more than 300 people died from Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Over 300 people have died from Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo, as the outbreak caused by the Bundibugyo strain continues to spread across 34 health zones in three provinces, including Ituri (epicenter), North Kivu and South Kivu. Since the outbreak was declared on May 15, 1,155 people have been infected and 304 have died, yielding a case-fatality rate of 26.3%. In Ituri, 16 more patients recovered after negative follow-up tests, bringing total recoveries to 138. African health authorities have stressed the need for funding to support the continent-wide response, with the Africa CDC noting that a continental plan requires $1.4 billion. At a high-level meeting led by the African Union, partners pledged $910 million, but only about 13% of promised funds have been disbursed so far. Congo's government has instituted a mandatory 21-day quarantine for travelers from affected areas to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラで300人以上が死亡
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス感染症のアウトブレイク（死亡304人、感染1,155人、致命率26.3%）で、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。DRC（対象国）で発生。国際的な資金支援ニーズと渡航制限が確認され、社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス感染症（Bundibugyo株）のアウトブレイク。DRCの3州（Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu）34ヘルスゾーンに拡大。2026年5月15日宣言時から累計感染1,155人、死亡304人、致命率26.3%。国際的な資金支援が急務（必要額$1.4B、約束額$910Mのうち13%しか拠出済みでない）。DRC政府が渡航者の21日間の強制隔離を実施。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : désormais, Kinshasa exige un formulaire de santé publique pour tout le vol international
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: From now on, Kinshasa requires a public health form for every international flight.
article.articleSummary: Ebola prompts Kinshasa to require a public health form for all international flights. After a France case linked to the Democratic Republic of Congo, Kinshasa tightens response focusing on mobility of exposed individuals. Active surveillance becomes mandatory for all identified Ebola contacts, 21-day monitoring. During this period, travel is prohibited unless expressly authorized by the Minister of Health or delegate. Health workers and response teams returning from affected zones face the same 21-day surveillance and must obtain prior authorization for international travel. Travelers who have stayed in affected provinces must spend at least 21 days outside those zones before international travel. A PNHF health form is now required for all international flights and will be checked by airlines. Temperature monitoring and immediate reporting of Ebola symptoms are mandatory; symptomatic cases are treated per national protocols. Measures remain in force for the duration of the 17th outbreak unless lifted.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：キンシャサが国際線全便に公衆衛生フォームを要求
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で2つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク）。エボラ出血熱の発生とフランスへの越境確認により、WPROスクリーニング基準複数該当。国際支援・対応が必要な段階。
triage.notes: DRCのキンシャサでのエボラ第17次流行。フランスでの確認症例との関連が報告されている。記事はDRCの対応措置（国際線利用者への健康調査フォーム義務化、21日間の監視・渡航禁止）に焦点。Franceは記事の比較参照情報であり、発生主体ではないため verified_locations に含めない。

article.articleHeadline: RDCongo eleva mortos por ébola para 304 com 95% das camas hospitalares ocupadas - Renascença
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo raises Ebola death toll to 304 with 95% of hospital beds occupied - Renascença.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo reaches 304 deaths among 1,155 confirmed cases as of 26 June 2026, with 95% of hospital beds occupied nationwide per the African Union and Congolese Ministry of Communications. The tally rose from 291 deaths and 1,118 cases; Uganda reports 20 cases and 2 deaths, and France records its first imported case in a humanitarian worker returning from the DRC. The outbreak, officially declared 15 May in Ituri, has spread to North and South Kivu. The Bundibugyo strain carries a 30–50% fatality rate; no licensed vaccine or specific approved treatment exists. Trials of MBP134 and remdesivir are planned to start in Bunia, Ituri. A 21-day travel quarantine was enacted to curb cross-border movement. This is the third-worst Ebola epidemic, behind 2014–2016 West Africa (≈11,000 deaths, ≈28,000 cases), with transmission via bodily fluids.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラによる死者を304人に引き上げ、病院ベッド稼有率95% - Renascença
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当。エボラ出血熱は極めて深刻な公衆衛生上の影響（304死亡）、複数国への国際的拡大（ウガンダ、フランスへの輸入例）、旅行制限措置の実施という明確なシグナル。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIから返却された発生地域にはウガンダ、フランス、アンゴラが含まれるが、記事サマリーの詳細な検証により、確認された継続的なエボラ伝播の主体はDRC国内である。ウガンダは国境を越えた症例の報告地であり、フランスは輸入例（単一症例）である。したがって、実際の感染症イベント発生地として verified_locations には DRC (203312) のみを記録する。第三最悪のエボラ流行との位置付け、複数州への拡大、医療崩壊に近い状況、ワクチン・治療薬の不在などからフルRRA進行が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Pola Penularan HIV Jateng Bergeser ke Hubungan Homoseksual |Republika Online
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: HIV Transmission Pattern in Central Java Shifts to Homosexual Relations
article.articleSummary: Central Java, Indonesia, reports a shift in HIV transmission from heterosexual contact to male-to-male sex (MSM). Health official Zulfachmi Wahab says new HIV/AIDS cases decline overall from 2024–2025, but the transmission pattern now predominantly involves MSM, a shift observed for at least five years. Previously, infections were common among women infected by husbands; now men are the majority of new cases. In Central Java, total new HIV/AIDS cases reached 6,509; 2025 saw 6,222 cases, and by May 2026 hundreds of new cases were recorded. City-level figures for Jan–May 2026: Semarang 225; Banyumas 107; Solo 104. Prevention is framed as ABCDE: A abstain from sex, B be faithful, C use condoms, D avoid using drugs, E limit use of health tools. There is no cure; antiretroviral therapy is lifelong.

triage.headline_ja: 中央ジャワのHIV感染パターンが同性間接触へシフト
triage.triage_reason: HIV感染経路の流行パターン変化は公衆衛生上注視すべき動向だが、記事は疫学的には既知の現象（MSM集団での高い感染率）の局所的な記録であり、異常性・国際的拡大リスク・重症度に関する具体的懸念は記事から読み取れない。引き続き動向を監視する価値がある。
triage.notes: 記事は中央ジャワにおけるHIV感染の流行パターン転換（異性間から同性間接触へ）を報告している。年間新規症例数は数千例規模で、MSM集団での感染リスク増加は既知の公衆衛生課題であり、イベント自体は「異常」とは言えない。ただし、地域の感染動向変化の詳細なモニタリングは重要なため、情報継続収集（WATCH）判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: Quốc tế khởi động chiến dịch truyền thông phòng, chống bệnh dại tại Việt Nam
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: International launches a media campaign to prevent and control rabies in Vietnam.
article.articleSummary: June 26, 2026, Hanoi – Vietnam’s One Health partners launched a 2026 media campaign to prevent and control rabies, aiming to raise awareness, promote responsible pet ownership, boost vaccination of dogs and cats, and encourage timely post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP). Led by the One Health Partnership of Vietnam (OHP) with WHO Vietnam, ILRI, Humane Society for Animals (HWA), FAO, and IEHSD, and coordinated with the Ministry of Health and the Ministry of Agriculture and Environment, the campaign runs June–September 2026, peaking on World Rabies Day (Sept 28). Three themes cover: safe interaction for children with dogs/cats; understanding vaccines for dogs, cats and humans; and elimination of rabies in Vietnam. Activities include expert briefings, interactive forums, online Q&A and video outreach. Rabies remains a deadly zoonosis in Vietnam, with 70–100 deaths annually; 2025 saw 77 deaths across 20 provinces and over 1 million PEP treatments; early 2026 saw 13 deaths, mainly in the south. Vaccination rates for dogs/cats often fall below 70%, underscoring the 2022–2030 plan to end rabies by 2030 via One Health.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムの狂犬病予防・制御に関する国際的なメディアキャンペーンを開始
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病は継続的な公衆衛生問題で年間70～100人の死亡が報告されており、重症度基準を満たす。しかし本記事は啓発キャンペーンの発表であり、新規発生クラスターや異常な増加を報告するものではない。スクリーニング基準を満たすが、IHR基準は充たさないため。
triage.notes: 狂犬病は既知の風土病で、記事は新規発生や急増を報告するのではなく、継続的な制御キャンペーンを記述している。WPROスクリーニング基準は複数該当するが、IHR基準は『異常・予想外』性が欠けているため、WATCH段階での経過観察が適切。ベトナムは対象国リストに含まれる。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : l'OMS lance des essais cliniques de traitements contre Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: WHO launches clinical trials of Ebola treatments.
article.articleSummary: Two Ebola treatments are entering clinical trials in the Democratic Republic of the Congo as part of the World Health Organization's response to the ongoing outbreak. The trials, set to begin next week, involve a consortium including the DRC's National Institute of Biomedical Research, ALIMA, the University of Oxford, and WHO. To date, 1,048 Ebola cases and 277 deaths have been confirmed since the outbreak was declared on May 15, 2026. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus emphasized close collaboration with communities and ensuring access to any treatments found to be safe and effective. The effort aims to rapidly evaluate the two potential therapies and accelerate potential deployment if proven beneficial, with participants drawn from affected areas in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: DRC: WHOがエボラ治療法の臨床試験を開始
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。確認症例1,048例、死亡277例の進行中のエボラ流行に対する治療法臨床試験開始であり、WPRO基準も複数該当。国際的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 進行中のエボラ流行（5月15日宣言以来1,048例、死亡277例）に対してWHOが治療法の臨床試験を開始。複数の国際機関（Oxford大学、ALIMA等）が参加する重要な対応。DRC対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に DRC を含める。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : le président Tshisekedi renforce des mesures contre la maladie à virus Ebola - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: President Tshisekedi strengthens measures against Ebola virus disease - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo is facing an outbreak of Ebola virus disease caused by the Bundibugyo strain. President Felix Tshisekedi ordered reinforced security and health measures, deploying the National Police and health workers to outbreak sites to regulate movement and intensify checks (temperature screening, handwashing, hygiene) around epicenters. During a Kinshasa meeting with the national Ebola Task Force, authorities adopted strict isolation protocols, including a mandatory 21-day health observation for identified contacts and travel restrictions for residents of affected zones. The government also directed humanitarian coordination with the Ministry of Social Affairs and rapid progression of nearby treatment centers. Epidemiological figures cited: over 1,100 cases and 277 deaths (case fatality rate 26%). Kinshasa authorities report no Ebola cases in the capital. Date: June 26, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: DRC: President Tshisekedi strengthens measures against Ebola virus disease - ACP
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当：エボラ出血熱の集団発生（死亡277人、症例1100例超、CFR 26%）は公衆衛生に深刻な影響を与え、予想外の流行拡大リスク、国際的拡大リスク、および渡航制限のリスクを有する。WPROスクリーニング基準も5つ全て該当。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo株）の東部DRCでの集団発生。政府が強化された隔離プロトコル（21日間の健康監視、接触者追跡、移動制限）を導入。キンシャサでの確定患者報告なし。死亡277人、症例1100例超、CFR 26%という深刻な状況。

article.articleHeadline: Indonesia on alert after Australia bird flu detection - Society - The Jakarta Post
article.articleSummary: Australia confirms its first mainland cases of highly pathogenic H5N1 bird flu in wild birds, with a sick migratory seabird found in Esperance, Western Australia. By Wednesday, a second WA bird and a SA bird tested positive, widening concerns for the poultry sector. Experts warn the outbreak can cause mass wild-bird and poultry deaths, disrupt food supplies, and push up prices; human infections remain rare. Ingham's, one of Australia's largest poultry producers, locked down Western Australia breeder farms and restricted access as a precaution, while commercial poultry is still reported free of avian influenza. The detections prompt heightened Asia-Pacific vigilance; Papua New Guinea has imposed restrictions on Australian poultry imports. Indonesia is on alert, with calls to strengthen surveillance and biosecurity to prevent cross-border transmission.

triage.headline_ja: オーストラリアの鳥インフルエンザ検出後、インドネシアが警戒態勢に
triage.triage_reason: H5N1高病原性鳥インフルエンザの確認により異常・予想外の事象が生じており、アジア太平洋地域での国際的な警戒態勢の構築、生物安全保障上の懸念、および食料供給への潜在的影響が存在するため。
triage.notes: オーストラリアは対象国リストに含まれないが、パプアニューギニアも記事で言及されている。記事サマリーでは、インドネシアが直接的にアラート態勢に入り、中国を含むアジア太平洋地域での警戒が高まっている旨が述べられているため、対象国2ヶ国のみを verified_locations に含める。H5N1の高病原性性状、野生鳥類およびニワトリの大量死の可能性、食料供給への影響、国際貿易制限の実施（PNG→オーストラリア産家禽輸入制限）が確認され、全IHR基準および全WPROスクリーニング基準に該当する。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola: RDC ''precisa de construir centros de tratamento e aumentar a capacidade hospitalar'', pois 95% das camas hospitalares estão ocupadas - CDC África
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: DRC Needs to Build Treatment Centers and Increase Hospital Capacity, as 95% of Hospital Beds Are Occupied - Africa CDC
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak: 95% of hospital beds occupied; Africa CDC urges building treatment centers and expanding capacity as deaths reach 304 of 1,155 confirmed cases. Outbreak centered in Ituri province, Bunia, declared May 15, with Bundibugyo strain (30–50% fatality; no approved vaccine or specific treatment). Spillover into North Kivu and South Kivu provinces. Next week in Bunia, clinical trials of MBP134 and remdesivir will begin; remdesivir supplies have arrived in DRC. Uganda reports 20 cases and 2 deaths; first European case—a humanitarian worker returning from DRC—identified in France. Congolese government imposes a 21-day travel quarantine for people from affected zones. This is the third-worst Ebola epidemic, after 2014–2016 West Africa (≈11,000 deaths, 28,000 cases). Ebola transmits via direct contact with bodily fluids and causes fever, vomiting, diarrhea, and hemorrhagic symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：DRCは治療センター建設と病院収容能力の拡大が必要、95%の病床が占有中 - アフリカCDC
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目以上該当、WPRO基準すべて該当。Bundibugyo株によるエボラ出血熱の大規模流行で国境を超える拡大（DRC→ウガンダ→フランス）、高い致命率（30-50%）、重症患者多数により国際的懸念が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではウガンダとフランスでの症例報告が明記されていますが、対象国リストにこれら両国が含まれないため verified_locations には DRC のみを記載しました。イベントの地理的中心はDRC（Ituri州Bunia市）です。大規模流行、医療システムの逼迫（95%の病床占有）、複数州への拡大、高い致命率（304死亡/1,155確定例≈26%）、臨床試験開始などにより緊急性は極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: French man fell ill with Ebola while on flight from Congo
article.articleSummary: France’s first confirmed Ebola case, a humanitarian doctor who boarded a Kinshasa-bound flight asymptomatic, fell ill mid-flight and is stable after transfer to a specialist facility. The patient is Europe’s first case linked to the Bundibugyo strain outbreak in the DRC, which has infected 1,118 people and caused 291 deaths as of 24 June. DRC authorities have imposed a 21-day quarantine for anyone who has visited Ebola-affected areas abroad, with 21 days of health monitoring for contacts; travel is restricted during monitoring. Health declarations are required for passengers, and airlines will verify forms. Ituri remains the main transmission zone; the outbreak has seen a case load with limited vaccine availability. Transmission is thought from fruit bats to humans, then via contact with contaminated fluids; incubation can reach 21 days. Vaccines are under development; trials not expected soon. WHO declared the outbreak in May; risk to the European public remains low.

triage.headline_ja: フランス人男性、コンゴからの飛行中にエボラに罹患
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク）に該当し、欧州初のバンディブギョ株関連ケースとしてWHO通知相当。複数国にまたがる渡航関連感染症イベントのため、フルRRA進行必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCのキンシャサ発の飛行中に患者が発症したことを述べており、DRCが主要な発生地。フランスの患者は渡航者/輸入ケースであり、記事の主題となる感染症イベント（バンディブギョ株アウトブレイク）はDRCで発生している。対象国リストに含まれるDRCのみを verified_locations に含める。1,118人感染、291人死亡の既知アウトブレイク状況、ワクチン供給限定、21日隔離措置等、複数の重大要素が含まれる。

article.articleHeadline: กรมอนามัยแนะผู้ปกครอง-ร.ร.เฝ้าระวัง 'สกุชชี่แถมเข็มฉีดยา' เด็กเล่นเสี่ยงบาดเจ็บและติดเชื้อ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Department of Public Health urges parents and schools to watch out for "squishies with syringes," as children playing with them risk injury and infection.
article.articleSummary: as of 26 June 2026, Thailand’s Department of Public Health warns parents and schools about so-called 'Squishies with syringes'—toys that use real medical needles—posing high injury and infection risk to children aged 3–8. Sharp needles can puncture skin or injure the eyes, and the syringes and containers are not sterile, allowing bacteria and fungi to cause infections, potentially bloodstream infections or tetanus. Nonstandard squishies may contain phthalates, high plasticizer content, unsafe dyes, and harsh chemicals that threaten development. Safety cues include sharp parts, chemical smells, sticky textures, flaking paint, or missing Thai labeling; buy from registered stores and ensure Thai labeling with the Thai Industrial Standards (TIS) mark and a scannable QR code, plus producer/importer name and warnings. First aid: rinse 5–10 minutes with clean water and soap, dry, apply antiseptic; seek medical care for deep wounds, heavy bleeding, or signs of infection.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省が親と学校に警告：注射器付きスクイーズおもちゃが子どもの外傷と感染症リスク
triage.triage_reason: 公衆衛生上の警告・啓発キャンペーンであり、感染症の新規発生・流行ではなく、散発的な外傷感染リスク。IHR基準・WPROスクリーニング基準の該当が不十分。
triage.notes: 本記事は玩具安全に関する公衆衛生警告であり、感染症の集団発生や流行を示唆していない。破傷風は記事中で理論的リスクとして言及されているが、実際の症例報告や集団感染の報告はない。標本検査や症例確認の記述なし。

article.articleHeadline: 新技术实现跨物种识别检测主要致病真菌 -- 新闻 -- 科学网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New technology enables cross-species identification and detection of major pathogenic fungi
article.articleSummary: Multi-species pathogenic fungi detection: Nanjing Agricultural University team led by Shen Qirong developed MFPD, an ITS amplicon sequencing–based system, and a comprehensive database of human, animal, and plant pathogenic fungi. The database encompasses about 5,000 species and 95,660 ITS sequences, enabling rapid, high-throughput identification across contexts. MFPD outperforms existing tools with ~80% higher recall and >40% higher precision. Real-pathology sample analysis shows accurate detection of major fungal pathogens in humans, livestock, and crops, and reveals potential co-infections. The work addresses One Health challenges as climate change, globalization, and trade increase cross-species and cross-ecosystem pathogen spread. This tool supports clinical, veterinary, agricultural, and environmental surveillance and risk assessment, as well as large-scale monitoring for early warning. Published online in Advanced Science on 2026-06-26, funded by NSFC and university programs.

triage.headline_ja: 新技術により複数菌種の主要病原真菌の同定・検出が可能に
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は南京農業大学による病原真菌検出技術の開発に関する学術成果発表であり、実際の感染症発生イベント（outbreak）ではなく、診断技術開発の公表。疾患患者の発生や公衆衛生上の緊急性は存在しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は感染症発生（outbreak/epidemic signal）ではなく、診断技術開発の学術発表であるため、シグナルトリアージの対象外。実験室での技術開発成果の公表に過ぎず、実患者の発生や感染症危機管理のシグナルには該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : Tshisekedi renforce le dispositif sanitaire pour freiner la progression de l'épidémie - LePotentiel
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: Tshisekedi strengthens the health system to curb the progression of the outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo intensifies; as of 26 June 2026, health authorities report more than 1,100 confirmed cases and 277 deaths (case fatality rate ~26%). The epicenter remains Ituri, accounting for 91% of cases, with health zones Bunia, Rwampara, Mungwalu, Nyankunde and Nizi affected; Nord-Kivu and Sud-Kivu are also impacted. President Félix-Antoine Tshisekedi Tshilombo, at the 3rd National Task Force meeting on 25 June, ordered strengthened containment measures: tighter movement controls in hotspots, temperature screening, symptom surveillance, and strict hygiene including regular handwashing. Contacts must remain 21 days in the affected zone under surveillance; travelers from outbreak foci will undergo 21-day monitoring before international travel. Government to boost humanitarian aid for displaced populations and accelerate construction of Ebola treatment centers near reception sites to improve patient care. Kinshasa reports no confirmed cases to date.

triage.headline_ja: DRCのエボラ：ツシセケディがエボラの進行を抑止するため保健体制を強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、エボラウイルス病の急速な広がり（1,100例以上、死亡277例）、高い致死率（約26%）、DRC東部から近隣地域への拡大、国際的な渡航制限の可能性が示唆されている。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病は極めて高い毒性と致死率を持つ最優先度の感染症。東部DRC（イトゥリ州が91%の症例の集約地）での多発疫学パターンと、隣接するルワンダへの確認報告により、地域拡大のリスクが高い。政府による厳格な渡航制限措置の実施予定あり。フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Во Конго 1.155 заразени со ебола, 304 починаа
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Congo, 1,155 infected with Ebola, 304 died.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo has reached 1,155 confirmed infections with 304 deaths, authorities said. The health-status report notes 37 new confirmed cases and five new deaths in the last 24 hours, indicating continued transmission. Authorities attribute this to intensified epidemiological and biological surveillance enabling earlier detection, and report a week-over-week rise in community transmission. The figures reflect cumulative and recent daily changes for confirmed cases; the article provides no additional details on laboratory methods beyond confirmation, infection sources, vaccination status, or provincial breakdowns. The update underscores the ongoing public health challenge of the Ebola outbreak in the DRC as of 2026-06-26.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ感染者1,155人、死者304人
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も全て該当。エボラウイルス病は高い死亡率と国際的拡大リスクを有し、継続的な人間への感染を示す。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病は極めて高い死亡率（約26.4%）を示す。報告から24時間以内に37件の新規確認例と5件の新規死亡が記録され、継続的な感染を示唆している。DRCでの感染拡大は周辺地域への国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスクを高める。フルRRA実施が強く推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: В России выявили завозной случай мелиоидоз: как распознать смертельную болезнь
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Russia, an imported case of melioidosis has been identified: how to recognize the deadly disease.
article.articleSummary: An imported case of melioidosis has been identified in Russia: a Russian woman who returned from Thailand is hospitalized in critical condition with the rare and dangerous infection. The patient’s diagnosis was confirmed by Rospotrebnadzor using specialized test systems. Dr. Nadezhda Chernyshova explains that melioidosis is not transmitted person-to-person or by contact with animals; infection occurs through soil and water exposure. In healthy individuals the disease may be latent, but high-risk groups—diabetes, kidney disease, alcoholism, and HIV—are particularly vulnerable to severe illness. The diagnosis is challenging because symptoms mimic other infections, underscoring the importance of reporting travel history if health worsens after travel. Treatment is intensive and prolonged: initial 2–3 weeks of injections, followed by 3–6 months of oral antibiotics, which Chernyshova notes is essential for recovery.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアで輸入メリオイドーシス症例が特定：致命的な病気を認識する方法
triage.triage_reason: タイから持ち込まれた単一症例であり、人から人への感染や国際的な急速拡大の直接的な証拠がない。ただし、致命的な感染症の確認例であり、診断困難性と重症度の観点から経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: ロシアで確認された症例はタイからの輸入例（個人の旅行関連）。タイは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。ロシアは対象国ではないため除外。IHR基準2つ以上該当し通常はPICKUPとなるが、輸入症例で国内における人-人感染なし、流行性なし、国際的な急速拡大リスク不明瞭なため、現時点ではWATCHと判定。診断確認が行われており公式対応が進んでいる点も考慮。

article.articleHeadline: എബോള പ്രതിരോധം: മൂന്ന് ആഫ്രിക്കൻ രാജ്യങ്ങൾക്ക് യാത്രാവിലക്കേർപ്പെടുത്തി സൗദി അറേബ്യ | Ebola Prevention: Saudi Arabia imposes travel ban on three African countries
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Prevention: Saudi Arabia has imposed a travel ban on three African countries.
article.articleSummary: On 26 June 2026, Saudi Arabia imposed a temporary entry ban and visa suspension for travelers from Congo (Brazzaville), Uganda, and South Sudan due to Ebola transmission risk. Entry for nationals from these countries is prohibited, and visas from all countries are suspended. Any traveler arriving in Saudi Arabia must not have visited or stayed in any of the three countries during the prior 21 days. The Public Health Authority states active surveillance and response systems are in place domestically and in coordination with international partners to safeguard health and global health security. Previously, border checks and health surveillance were tightened for travelers from Rwanda, Burundi, Tanzania, and Congo (Brazzaville). The overall public health situation in Saudi Arabia remains satisfactory and under close monitoring, with no laboratory-confirmed or suspected Ebola cases reported since these measures were introduced. 24/7 monitoring continues.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ対策：サウジアラビアが3つのアフリカ諸国に対する渡航禁止令を発令
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病という高影響度の感染症であり、国際的な渡航制限が実施されている。複数の対象国（DRC、ウガンダ）でのエボラ伝播リスクが公式に認識され、国際的な対応が発動されている状況は、IHR基準に該当し、フルRRA実施の必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは『Congo (Brazzaville)』『Uganda』『South Sudan』からの入国禁止と述べられており、これらはコンゴ共和国（ブラザヴィル）、ウガンダ、南スーダンを指す。対象国リストの中で確認された実際の発生国はDRC（コンゴ民主共和国）のみ。ウガンダ(226074)も対象国リストに含まれるが、記事サマリーでは『Uganda』の言及があり、実際の流行地域として記載されている可能性がある。ただし、サマリー上の主な焦点はコンゴとその周辺国での流行であり、サウジアラビアの防御的対応が中心。発生地域リストのタンザニア、ルワンダ、ブルンジ、サウジアラビアは、サマリー上では過去の国境検問強化の対象として言及されており、現在の主要な流行地ではない。

article.articleHeadline: വിദഗ്ധസംഘം പരിശോധിച്ചത് നൂറുകണക്കിന് പഴങ്ങൾ, ഇപ്പോഴും തെളിയാതെ വൈറസ് മനുഷ്യനിലേക്ക് എത്തുന്ന വഴി
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The expert panel examined hundreds of fruits, but the route by which the virus reaches humans remains unproven.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-26, a Kerala expert panel examined hundreds of fruits (including rambutan, sapodilla, plantain, mangosteen, mango, and jackfruit) since 2018 to trace Nipah virus sources. Despite testing fruits bitten by birds and mammals, Nipah virus has not been detected in any fruit. Nipah is known to occur in fruit bats and humans, and the strains are the same, but the exact route from bats to humans remains unproven. The RNA virus degrades quickly under sunlight, complicating source-tracing. Nevertheless, officials say there is no indication of broader outbreaks from fruit consumption. Institutions involved include the National Institute of Virology, Thiruvananthapuram; the Advanced Institute of Virology; and the Kerala One Health Center for Nipah Research and Resilience. In Malaysia, Nipah’s initial human outbreak was linked to pigs; in the Philippines, to horses; and in Bangladesh, linked to date palm sap, though sap at the outbreak site was negative and some patients did not consume sap.

triage.headline_ja: 専門家パネルが数百個の果実を検査したが、ウイルスが人間に到達する経路は依然として証明されていない
triage.triage_reason: ニパウイルスの感染源追跡に関する重要な科学的情報であり、複数国での歴史的事例に言及しているが、現在の具体的なアウトブレイクを示唆する情報がなく、公衆衛生への直接的な影響が不明であるため。
triage.notes: 記事は2018年以来の疫学調査結果であり、ニパウイルスの感染源メカニズムに関する継続的な研究を報じているが、現在の活動的なアウトブレイクではなく、むしろ過去事例の学習と源泉追跡の困難さについての報告である。フィリピン、バングラデシュ、マレーシアは過去のニパウイルス事例の文脈での言及であり、記事の主題は最新のケーラ州での研究にある。

article.articleHeadline: กรมอนามัย แนะผู้ปกครอง-โรงเรียน เฝ้าระวัง 'สกุชชี่แถมเข็มฉีดยา' เด็กเล่นเสี่ยงบาดเจ็บ-ติดเชื้อ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Department of Public Health Advises Parents and Schools to Watch Out for 'Squishy with Syringes' as Children Play, Risking Injury and Infection
article.articleSummary: On 26 June 2026, Thailand’s Department of Public Health warns parents and schools about ‘Squishy’ toys containing real medical needles. These items are not safe consumer toys; the sharp needles can puncture skin or injure the eye, and sterilization may be lacking, increasing risk of bacterial or fungal infections and even sepsis or tetanus. Nonstandard squishies often contain phthalates and unsafe dyes, posing potential hormonal disruption and adverse development, especially for children aged 3–8. Guidance emphasizes simple safety checks: avoid items with dangerous sharp parts, strong chemical odors, sticky textures, or peeling paint; ensure Thai labeling and the presence of the Thai Industrial Standards Institute (TISI) mark, importer/manufacturer details, and a scannable QR code. Prefer purchases from registered retailers and beware unrealistically low prices. In emergencies, rinse with clean water 5–10 minutes, wash with soap, dry, apply antiseptic; seek urgent medical care for deep wounds, uncontrolled bleeding, redness, swelling, pus, or fever.

triage.headline_ja: タイ公衆衛生局、注射器入り「スクイーズ」玩具に警告　子どもの外傷と感染リスク
triage.triage_reason: 破傷風のリスク警告は記事に含まれているが、実際の破傷風患者発生ではなく、危険性のある玩具製品に対する予防警告である。感染症の実発生イベントではなく、公衆衛生上の注意喚起の範囲内。
triage.notes: 本記事は破傷風を含む感染症の実発生イベントではなく、危険な玩具製品に対する予防警告・啓発である。タイ公衆衛生局による消費者安全ガイダンスの発出であり、感染症の新規患者発生や流行兆候ではない。EBS活動の対象となるシグナルには該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: БРОЈОТ НА ЗАБОЛЕНИ ОД ЕБОЛА СЕ ИСКАЧИ НА 1.155 Во епидемијата во ДР Конго досега 304 мртви - plusinfo.mk
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of Ebola cases jumped to 1,155. In the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, so far 304 have died - plusinfo.mk.
article.articleSummary: As of 26 June 2026, Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo has risen to 1,155 confirmed infections with 304 deaths. Health authorities report 37 new cases and five new deaths in the previous 24 hours. The health-status update attributes the increase to intensified epidemiological and biosurveillance, enabling earlier case detection and signaling ongoing community transmission that has grown week by week. The data underscore a sustained outbreak within the country and the impact of enhanced surveillance on identifying cases sooner as authorities continue to monitor the situation and implement public health responses.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ患者数が1,155人に急増 コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行で現在までに304人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR Annex2の4基準すべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、大規模流行の異常性、国際拡大リスク、貿易渡航制限リスク）。WPRO基準も全項目該当。エボラウイルス病は最高リスク疾患であり、1,155症例・304死亡という規模と継続的なコミュニティ感染の存在から、直ちにフルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病は最優先シグナル。1,155症例・304死亡、過去24時間で37新規症例・5死亡、継続的なコミュニティ感染の報告。強化されたサーベイランスにより症例検出の早期化が実現しており、実際の感染規模はさらに大きい可能性あり。国際的な支援と対応が必須。

article.articleHeadline: 麻疹疫情在全球蔓延　尤其在歐洲地區加劇 - 生活新聞 - PChome Online 新聞
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles outbreak spreading worldwide, especially intensifying in Europe - Life News - PChome Online News
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak spreading worldwide, with Europe intensifying. WHO surveillance reports 42,605 European measles cases in 2023, up 45-fold from 937 in 2022. Russia, Kazakhstan, and Kyrgyzstan have surged since mid-2023, spreading to Azerbaijan and Romania; the UK has warned of expanding activity. Outside Europe, the United States reports sporadic cases; Western Pacific, Malaysia and the Philippines have rising measles since last year, with India and Indonesia affected in Southeast Asia. Taiwan’s CDC notes no local transmission since Sept 2022, but travel-related/imported risk remains. Measles is highly airborne; infants may develop otitis media, pneumonia, or encephalitis, with mortality risk 5–10% in infants or immunocompromised children. Prevention hinges on vaccination: MMR vaccine for children aged 1 year or older; avoid taking unvaccinated or under-1-year infants to outbreak zones. During travel, practice hand hygiene, wear masks in public and when seeking medical care abroad; return with fever or rash, seek care and disclose travel.

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹疫情が世界中に蔓延、特にヨーロッパで加劇
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹の多地域同時多発的なアウトブレイク。IHR基準で「異常/予想外」「国際拡大リスク」「渡航制限リスク」が該当し、WPRO基準では「重症度」「流行しやすさ」が該当。対象国5国（インド、インドネシア、フィリピン、マレーシア）での感染確認と、台湾での輸入感染リスク指摘により、西太平洋地域での拡大の実質的な懸念がある。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年6月の日付で将来シナリオと推測されるが、評価は記事内容に基づき実施。ヨーロッパ（ロシア、カザフスタン、キルギス、アゼルバイジャン、ルーマニア、UK）での大規模アウトブレイク報告と、西太平洋地域での同時期の感染拡大が記述されている。台湾は2022年9月以降の地域伝播なしとされるが、輸入感染リスク存在。対象国リストに含まれるインド、インドネシア、フィリピン、マレーシアでの感染確認により verified_locations に記載。麻疹は高い空気感染性を有し、乳幼児・免疫不全者での重症化（5-10%の致死率）報告あり。
