article.articleHeadline: 再錄一宗登革熱傳入　患者潛伏期曾到印尼
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Another imported dengue fever case; the patient had been to Indonesia during the incubation period.
article.articleSummary: June 26, 2026 — Hong Kong's Health Protection Centre reports another imported dengue fever case; the patient had been in Indonesia during the incubation period. Total dengue cases in the territory now 23 (21 imported, 2 locally transmitted). Global data from the World Health Organization show dengue incidence rising, with over 14 million cases in 2024. In January–July last year, 97 countries/territories reported more than 4 million dengue cases and over 3,000 deaths. Dengue remains common in nearby travel regions: Indonesia, India and Vietnam each reported over 100,000 cases last year; Malaysia, Sri Lanka and Thailand over 50,000; Singapore over 4,000. Guangdong Province reported locally acquired infections last year (>3,500) and 131 by May this year, including 46 in May.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱の輸入事例を再度確認　患者は潜伏期間中にインドネシアに滞在
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の輸入事例報告であり、アジア地域で流行中だが、個別事例の報告のみで新たな異常事態の指標は限定的。ただし域内での流行が背景にあり続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 香港は中国(1814991)に含めて処理。記事はデング熱の域内流行状況を報道しており、複数の対象国での流行が背景にある。ただし個別輸入事例報告であり、緊急度の高い新規シグナルではない。WHO統計上の地球規模での流行傾向が示されている点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: Phế cầu khuẩn tiếp tục là mối đe dọa với trẻ nhỏ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Streptococcus pneumoniae continues to be a threat to young children.
article.articleSummary: Streptococcus pneumoniae remains a leading cause of pneumonia, meningitis, and bacteremia in children, especially under 5 years old in Vietnam. Authorities warn of rising antimicrobial resistance and emphasize early prevention. The 2026-06-26 briefing, supported by Pfizer Vietnam and organized by the Vietnam Preventive Medicine Association, notes pneumococcal prevention is included in the Ministry of Health’s Expanded Immunization Program for 2026–2028. Infants and older children with underlying conditions—such as asthma, congenital heart disease, chronic lung disease, diabetes, liver or kidney disease, or immunodeficiency—are at highest risk of severe illness. A 2026 study found about one in three children carry pneumococcus in the oropharynx without symptoms, fueling household and community transmission. Serotype circulation fluctuates over time, underscoring the need for ongoing surveillance and updated data. Antibiotic resistance is rising, with multidrug resistance complicating treatment and, in severe cases, requiring ECMO. Parents should consult physicians for age- and risk-specific prevention.

triage.headline_ja: 肺炎球菌は依然として幼い子どもへの脅威である
triage.triage_reason: 肺炎球菌による小児感染症は既知の懸念事項であり、耐性菌の増加は重要だが、新規アウトブレイクまたは異常な発生パターンの報告ではない。情報がワクチン接種推進とサーベイランス強化の啓発的な内容であるため、シグナルのピックアップ基準には至らない。
triage.notes: 記事は肺炎球菌感染症の既知のリスクと2026年予防医学戦略についての啓発コンテンツである。新規アウトブレイク、症例数急増、または新規耐性パターンの報告ではなく、継続的な公衆衛生上の懸念事項の説明。耐性菌増加は問題だが、IHR基準の「異常/予想外」には該当しない。ワクチン推進と医療相談の呼びかけが主要メッセージ。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : 1 155 cas confirmés et 304 morts
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: 1,155 confirmed cases and 304 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), centered in Ituri province, worsens. As of 2026-06-26, 1,155 laboratory-confirmed cases and 304 deaths, with 138 recoveries and 326 patients in treatment or isolation. Declared mid-May, the epidemic is caused by Bundibugy o ebolavirus, for which there is no licensed vaccine or specific treatment. A French physician who aided response efforts in Ituri has tested positive. Kinshasa has imposed travel restrictions and health-safety measures, including 21 days of active surveillance for health workers returning from affected zones. The ongoing outbreak highlights the urgent need for containment, infection control, and supportive care while monitoring transmission dynamics. Keywords: outbreak, vaccination, public health measures, Ituri, Kinshasa, Bundibugyo ebolavirus.

triage.headline_ja: RDCのエボラ：1,155例の確定症例と304人の死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラウイルス病の進行中の大規模アウトブレイク（1,155例確定、304死亡）で、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的な拡大リスク（フランス人医療従事者の感染）、渡航制限の実施が確認される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは明確にDRC（イトゥリ州、キンシャサ）での進行中のエボラアウトブレイクを報告している。Bundibugyo ebolavirus（ワクチン及び特異的治療法なし）による既知のウイルスだが、大規模化している。フランス人医療従事者の感染により国際的な懸念あり。キンシャサは既に渡航制限と保健安全措置を実施中。

article.articleHeadline: Здравните власти очакват броят на смъртните случаи от ебола в Конго да надхвърли 300
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health authorities expect the death toll from Ebola in Congo to exceed 300.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-06-26, Africa CDC reports that the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo could surpass 300 deaths, with 291 fatalities and 1,188 confirmed infections to date. The rapid rise in cases marks a level not seen in the first five weeks of previous African Ebola outbreaks. Health authorities warn the epidemic is likely not peaked yet and that about 95% of Congo’s hospital beds are occupied. Officials urge rapid expansion of treatment centers and capacity-building to handle the surge. The Congo government has ordered a 21-day quarantine for individuals from Ebola-affected areas who intend to travel domestically or leave the country, after a French physician who worked in the country returned home infected, raising concerns about potential spread to Europe.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ保健当局、エボラ出血熱の死者数が300人を超えると予想
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱は極めて高い公衆衛生影響（死者291名、感染1,188名で急増中）、予期しない規模の流行、国際的拡大リスク（フランスの医師が感染帰国）、および渡航・貿易制限の実施が確認されている。フルRRA対象案件。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで主にコンゴでの流行が論述されており、フランスは患者の移入国として記載されているが、イベント発生地ではないため除外。Africa CDCの報告に基づく公式情報源。国際的拡大リスク（フランスへの感染輸出確認）と21日間検疫の実施により、IHR基準の渡航・貿易制限項目も明確に該当。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus Virus Nipah Kembali Muncul di India, WHO Ungkap Gejala dan Risiko Kematian hingga 75 Persen
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nipah virus cases re-emerge in India, WHO reveals symptoms and risk of death up to 75 percent.
article.articleSummary: Nipah virus re-emerged in India with one laboratory-confirmed case in Kozhikode district, Kerala, in June 2026, reported by WHO Disease Outbreak News on 25 June 2026. The adult patient developed symptoms on 30 May and was hospitalized on 10 June with neurological involvement, currently on ventilatory support in intensive care. Extensive contact tracing identified 104 contacts by 18 June, including healthcare workers, with no onward transmission detected to date. All hospital-isolated contacts have been discharged, and 14 symptomatic high-risk individuals tested negative; surveillance continues as some health workers remain under observation. Nipah is a zoonosis with fruit bats (Pteropus) as the natural reservoir; transmission can occur from animals or contaminated foods, and human-to-human spread through close contact. Incubation is 3–14 days (up to 45); symptoms range from fever and headache to encephalitis and severe respiratory illness, with case fatality historically 40–75%. There is no vaccine or specific antiviral; care is supportive. No travel or trade restrictions were issued; Kerala remains vigilant.

triage.headline_ja: ニパウイルス症例がインドで再発生、WHOが症状と75%までの死亡リスクを明らかに
triage.triage_reason: ニパウイルス（高病原性、致死率40-75%）の確定症例がインドで発生。IHR基準で深刻な公衆衛生影響と異常性に該当し、国際的な流行リスクがあるため、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: ニパウイルスはWHO高優先度病原体。2026年6月に確定症例が報告され、WHOが疾病流行ニュースで公表。104の接触者を特定し、現在まで二次感染なし。果実コウモリが自然宿主で、動物から人への感染リスク存在。104の接触者のうち14の症状ありハイリスク個人がネガティブ確認されたが、一部医療従事者は観察継続中。サーベイランス継続が重要。

article.articleHeadline: Multidimensional drivers of urban infectious diseases: a comparative longitudinal study informing planetary health governance - npj Urban Sustainability
article.articleSummary: Three major Chinese cities—Shanghai, Chongqing, and Hong Kong—were analyzed in a comparative longitudinal study linking climate, air quality, and socioeconomic exposures to infectious disease dynamics. Omicron non-pharmaceutical intervention (NPI) effectiveness was highest in Chongqing, moderate in Shanghai, and lowest in Hong Kong, with efficacy inversely related to population density. In Shanghai, hand, foot, and mouth disease correlated with passenger volume (ρ=0.64) and international tourists (ρ=0.45); these associations were weaker in Chongqing. Mutual information networks revealed city-specific hubs such as NO, SO and non-monotonic synergies missed by simple correlations, alongside shared drivers like passenger volume and containment. The crowd-gathering index aligned with scarlatina (ρ=0.37) and dengue (ρ=0.35). The study argues urban infection risks arise from complex, context-dependent systems and proposes a planetary health-based urban governance framework with six pillars: intelligent foresight, nature-based design, collaborative governance, medical preparedness, data integration, and global solidarity.

triage.headline_ja: 都市感染症の多次元的要因：惑星規模の健康ガバナンスを情報提供する比較縦断研究
triage.triage_reason: デング熱など複数の感染症を扱う学術研究論文であり、中国の複数都市での過去データの分析が対象。現在進行中の新規アウトブレイクではなく、歴史的データの疫学分析であるため、IHR基準該当性は低い。ただしデング熱の動態情報を含むため経過観察対象。
triage.notes: 本記事は Nature npj Urban Sustainability に掲載された学術論文であり、上海・重慶・香港の過去データを用いた比較研究。リアルタイムの新規感染症イベントではなく、歴史的疫学分析論文である。デング熱は言及されているが、現在の異常なアウトブレイクの報告ではなく、気候・大気質・社会経済的要因と感染症動態の関連性を分析した研究。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو الديمقراطية تسجل 1155 إصابة مؤكدة بإيبولا و304 وفيات - اخبار ليبيا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Democratic Republic of the Congo records 1,155 confirmed Ebola cases and 304 deaths - Libya News
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues, with 1,155 confirmed cases and 304 deaths reported by government data updated through Wednesday. In the last 24 hours, 37 new cases and 5 deaths were recorded, indicating ongoing transmission and a rise in infections. Health officials credit intensified epidemiological and biological surveillance for enabling early case detection, but also warn that transmission between people appears to be increasing on a weekly basis, fueling fears of a broader outbreak. The update underscores persistent monitoring and the continuing threat of expansion within the country, emphasizing the need for sustained public health response to contain transmission and prevent additional fatalities.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ感染者1,155人、死亡304人を記録
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準5つすべてに該当し、確認された多数の死亡例と継続的な人間同士の感染拡大が報告されている。
triage.notes: DRCでのエボラ感染者数1,155人、死亡者304人という多数の症例報告がある。過去24時間で37人の新規感染と5人の死亡が確認された。記事は人間同士の感染が週単位で増加していることを強調し、さらなる拡大の脅威を指摘している。公衆衛生対応の強化の必要性が強調されており、国際的な関心も高い。

article.articleHeadline: افتتاح المدرسة الوحيدة فى الصين لرعاية الأطفال المصابين بفيروس نقص المناعة - اليوم السابع
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Opening of China's only school to care for children infected with HIV - The Seventh Day
article.articleSummary: China’s only full-time school for HIV-infected children, Red Ribbon Primary School, began in Linfen, Shanxi, when Gu Xiaobing, a 63-year-old former infectious diseases hospital director, converted a ward in 2004 and formalized the school in 2006. It serves children born with HIV who faced stigma and loss of parents to AIDS, providing dormitories, classrooms, a cafeteria, medical care, and nursing; teachers oversee daily antiretroviral doses, with all students currently having undetectable viral loads and very low transmission risk. Early challenges included fear and recruitment hurdles, but local government funding started in 2011 and Gu later dedicated himself to the school. Attitudes have improved; local merchants now treat the students with respect. By 2025, 46 on-site students plus 16 supported, from 14 provinces, with 65 alumni employed full-time. Notable alumni include Kwai, who married in 2023 to an HIV-positive spouse, and Hogi, 17, who aspires to be a doctor. Gu retired in 2023; Wang Xia now leads the school.

triage.headline_ja: 中国唯一のHIV感染児童ケア学校がオープン - ザ・セブンス・デイ
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はHIV感染児童向けの既存学校（2006年開設）の紹介記事であり、新規の感染症アウトブレイク、集団発生、または公衆衛生上の緊急事態を報告するものではない。疾患管理施設の運営成功例に関する肯定的なニュースであり、IHR基準およびWPRO基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: この記事は感染症イベント（アウトブレイク）ではなく、HIV感染児童向けの社会福祉施設の紹介記事である。学校の設立（2006年）から2025年までの運営実績を報告する歴史的・社会的関心の記事であり、シグナルとしての価値は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en France : du premier cas à Paris à l'histoire terrifiante d'un virus qui tue 9 personnes sur 10
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in France: from the first case in Paris to the terrifying story of a virus that kills nine out of ten people.
article.articleSummary: June 2026 marks the first confirmed Ebola case in France after a French humanitarian doctor returning from the Democratic Republic of the Congo tests positive. Five close contacts are isolated under strict infection control, with negative-pressure rooms and full protective gear as authorities monitor a potential cross-border outbreak in a country where the WHO had declared its highest Ebola alert level. Ebola remains highly contagious in its active phase, with transmission possible through trace fluids, even sweat. The article traces Ebola to 1976 in Yambuku, northern Zaire (now DRC), where a reused syringe exposure led to an outbreak that infected 318 and killed 280 (about 88% fatality). Virologists Peter Piot and Karl Johnson identified the virus, named after the Ebola River. Subsequent outbreaks occurred in Sudan and central Africa, culminating in the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic of over 11,300 deaths and 28,600 cases, with US and Spain reporting imported/exported cases and triggering a massive international response.

triage.headline_ja: フランスのエボラ：パリの初症例から9人中9人を殺すウイルスの恐ろしい歴史まで
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、先進国での異常事象、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスク）。フランスにおけるエボラの初症例確認は極めて重大で、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はフランスでのエボラ初症例を主題としているが、実際の感染源はコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）からの帰国医師による輸入症例。発生地域リストにはフランス・スペイン・スーダン・アンゴラなど複数国が含まれているが、サマリーの文脈では患者の起源地であるDRCのみが confirmed case の発生地として該当。フランスは輸入症例の報告であるため検証地域には含めない。DRC内で継続的な community transmission のリスクがあるため、epidemiologically DRC が最優先の関心地域。

article.articleHeadline: فيروس إيبولا يفتك بمئات الأشخاص في الكونغو - العالم : الخبر
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola virus ravages hundreds of people in the Democratic Republic of the Congo - World: News
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 1,155 lab-confirmed infections and 304 deaths, with 138 recoveries and 326 patients currently undergoing treatment or isolation. The mid-May outbreak is attributed to the Bundibugyo lineage, and, at present, no licensed vaccine or specific treatment is available. In response, the government has imposed strict travel restrictions on returnees from affected areas. A decree by Health Minister Roger Kamba mandates a 21-day strict quarantine for health workers, laboratory staff, and response teams from affected zones, with prohibition on domestic and international travel during the period. Anyone who has resided in an affected province cannot travel abroad until 21 days outside the region. International travelers leaving must complete a health-declaration form at border checkpoints, with airlines responsible for verification.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスがコンゴ民主共和国で数百人に猛威を振るう
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱は公衆衛生上の深刻な影響、高い死亡率、国際的拡大リスク、行動制限の可能性があり、複数の基準を満たすためフルRRAが必須。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病の中期的なアウトブレイク。1,155例の実験室確認感染と304死亡が報告されている。Bundibugyo系統のウイルスであり、ワクチンや特異的治療法がない状況。政府が厳格な旅行制限（21日間の隔離）を実施しており、国内および国際的な移動制限が発令されている。これらの要素は全てWHO通知基準（IHR Annex2）の2つ以上の基準に該当し、国際的なアラートと詳細なRRAが必須である。

article.articleHeadline: इबोला के खतरे के बीच सऊदी अरब का बड़ा फैसला, तीन अफ्रीकी देशों से यात्रियों के वीजा पर रोक | Saudi Arabia Ebola Travel Ban Three African Countries
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Amid the Ebola threat, Saudi Arabia's bold decision: a visa ban on travelers from three African countries.
article.articleSummary: Ebola threat prompts Saudi Arabia to impose a visa ban on travelers from the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), Uganda, and South Sudan due to escalating outbreak risk and wider spread. The government has suspended all visa types for individuals originating from these three countries, with the policy also applying to travelers arriving via third-country routes. The measure is described as a public health precaution aimed at preventing importation of Ebola cases, though the article does not report any case counts, deaths, or laboratory confirmations. The move underscores growing concern over Ebola transmission in Central and East Africa and represents a stringent border-control response as of 2026-06-26.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱の脅威を受けサウジアラビアが大決断、3つのアフリカ諸国からの渡航者のビザを禁止
triage.triage_reason: エボラ熱という高い危険度の病原体で、IHR基準において深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクが認識されており、複数国での流行を背景にした国際的な対応が報告されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは DRC、ウガンダ、南スーダンからの流行が指摘されているが、対象国リストに含まれるのは DRC のみ。ウガンダは対象外、南スーダンはスーダンの一部だが独立国として対象外。エボラ熱は高危険度病原体で、ビザ禁止という国際的対応が既に実施されている点を重視。症例数や死亡数は不明だが、「流行拡大リスク」が記事全体で強調されており、PICKUP判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes Lebak ajak warga jaga kebersihan lingkungan guna cegah penyakit
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Lebak Health Office Urges Residents to Maintain Environmental Hygiene to Prevent Disease.
article.articleSummary: Lebak, Banten, Indonesia—The Lebak Health Office (Dinkes) urges residents to maintain environmental hygiene to prevent spread of infectious diseases. Authorities intensify outreach at health facilities (puskesmas, pustu, poskesdes, clinics) to raise awareness that unsanitary environments foster transmission. The campaign promotes PSN (vector breeding elimination) and the 3M movement—drain, cover, recycle—with every family asked to appoint two jumantik (larval monitors) for Aedes aegypti. These measures target dengue fever and chikungunya, and aim to reduce diarrheal diseases and respiratory infections (ISPA, pneumonia, influenza). Residents are advised not to defecate in public places, practice Clean and Healthy Living (PHBS), eat nutritious fruits and vegetables, and rest to maintain stamina. The article does not report specific case counts.

triage.headline_ja: レバック保健局、感染症予防のための環境衛生維持を住民に呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアにおける蚊媒介性疾患（デング熱、チクングニア）および呼吸器感染症の予防キャンペーン。具体的な患者数や異常な流行の報告がなく、当局による予防対策の強化が主題であるため、現段階では情報不足。
triage.notes: 記事は当局による予防キャンペーンの報告であり、実際の患者数や流行状況に関する具体的データが示されていない。デング熱とチクングニアは蚊媒介性でインドネシアで周年的に発生する疾患。引き続き発生状況のモニタリングが必要。

article.articleHeadline: Line of defence against Ebola
article.articleSummary: Uganda is contending with an ongoing Ebola outbreak caused by the Bundibugyo virus strain, which has crossed from the Democratic Republic of Congo into Uganda through cross-border movement. West Nile border districts—Arua, Koboko, Yumbe, Moyo, Obongi, and Adjumani—see daily cross-border travel for trade, education and family visits, heightening the risk of undetected transmission. The line of defence rests on strengthening surveillance that detects the first cases before they become epidemics, with cross-border surveillance at points of entry and in communities. Early detection relies on rapid identification of suspected cases, prompt investigations, and timely response, aided by community health workers, leaders, and families who notice unusual illnesses. Investments in community-based reporting, digital information sharing with neighboring countries, and regular preparedness exercises are essential, not reactive. Public trust, stigma-free reporting, and coordinated response are as crucial as laboratories and treatment units in preventing future outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: Ebola対策の防衛線
triage.triage_reason: DRCからウガンダへのエボラ越境感染が発生しており、IHR基準3項目（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の越境拡大、渡航制限リスク）を満たす。WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当（異常性、重症度、感染性、越境管理の課題）。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで「Bundibugyo virus strain」によるエボラアウトブレイクがDRCからウガンダへ越境感染したことが明記されている。ウガンダの国内GeoNames IDが記事情報に206074（Republic of Uganda）として提供されているが、対象国リストに直接該当するIDがないため、隣接国として実際の発生国情報から検証。アフリカ地域での重大感染症越境事例として国際的な関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ituri-Ebola : reprise des activités au Centre médical évangélique de Bunia après une vaste opération de décontamination
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ituri-Ebola: Activities resume at Bunia Evangelical Medical Center after a large-scale decontamination operation.
article.articleSummary: Bunia Evangelical Medical Center - Hospital Center of Bunia (CME CH-B) resumed full operations on June 13, 2026, after large-scale disinfection and decontamination to curb Ebola virus disease in Ituri. The facility had implemented a temporary minimum service from June 2–7, 2026 to complete the cleaning of buildings and medical equipment in line with biosafety standards. With the evolution of the Ebola outbreak in Ituri, all services are now back to normal, the administration stated in a communiqué signed by Medical Director Dr Ambitapio Musungufu Davin. The center thanks Bunia residents for patience and collaboration during the exceptional period intended to prevent virus transmission within the hospital. This complete resumption marks progress in strengthening healthcare provision in Ituri, which remains the epicenter of the 17th Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.

triage.headline_ja: イツリ地域エボラ出血熱：大規模消毒作業後、ブニア福音医療センターの活動再開
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱は高い死亡率を持つ異常な感染症で、DRC（対象国）で確認されており、国際的な拡大リスクと渡航制限のリスクが存在する。IHR基準3つ以上該当し、WPRO基準も複数該当するためシグナルとしてピックアップ。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年6月26日配信のDRC（Ituri地域、Bunia市）でのエボラ出血熱流行に関する進展情報。17番目のエボラアウトブレイクが継続中と述べられており、医療施設の消毒作業完了後の活動再開という段階的な対応が報告されている。エボラは極めて高い死亡率を持つ感染症であり、過去の流行で多くの国への国際的な拡大とWHO勧告による渡航制限が発生している。フルのRRA実施が必要。

article.articleHeadline: ارتفاع عدد ضحايا الإيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية إلى 304 وفيات
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola death toll in the Democratic Republic of the Congo rises to 304.
article.articleSummary: On June 26, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 1,155 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases and 304 deaths, with 138 recoveries and 326 patients in treatment or under isolation. The mid-May outbreak is attributed to the Bundibugyo lineage and currently has no licensed vaccine or specific treatment for this strain. To curb transmission, the government imposes strict travel measures: a 21-day mandatory quarantine for health workers, laboratory staff, and response teams returning from affected areas, prohibiting domestic and international travel during the period; residents who previously lived in affected provinces are barred from international travel until 21 days outside the region. International travelers departing must complete a health-declaration form, with airlines responsible for verification under a government decree. The actions accompany intensified efforts to contain the outbreak and protect public health.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ死者数が304人に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当し、WPRO基準も5つ全て該当。エボラウイルス病は極めて深刻な公衆衛生の脅威であり、国際的な懸念と対応が必要な事象である。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo系統のエボラウイルスで既存ワクチンが無効。政府による厳格な移動制限（21日間の隔離、国内外の渡航禁止など）が実施されている。フルのRRA（Rapid Risk Assessment）が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola: RDC Reforça Regras de Viagem Após Caso Confirmado em França
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: DRC Tightens Travel Rules After a Confirmed Case in France.
article.articleSummary: DRC Tightens travel rules after a confirmed Ebola case in France. The Democratic Republic of Congo issued a 21-day mandatory quarantine for anyone returning from Ebola-affected areas before traveling abroad, reinforcing surveillance after France confirmed its first imported case linked to the current outbreak. A June 24 decree by Health Minister Samuel-Roger Kamba requires contacts to Ebola to undergo 21 days of active health surveillance from the last exposure, during which all travel is prohibited unless explicitly authorized. The same rules apply to healthcare workers, lab staff, and response teams returning from affected zones. Border declarations are required for international travelers, with airlines verifying compliance. The imported case in France involves a humanitarian doctor who boarded a flight in Kinshasa without symptoms and fell ill mid-flight. The Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain, for which there is no vaccine or treatment, has infected 1,118 people and caused 291 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱：フランスで確認された症例後、DRCが渡航規則を強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ熱の国際的な確認例（フランス）、DRCでの対外的な渡航制限強化、重篤な死亡リスク（死亡率26%）、ワクチン未開発のBundibugyo株により国際的拡大リスクが明確に存在。
triage.notes: フランスでの輸入症例が報告されているが、フランスは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCが主要な発生地域であり、21日間の強制隔離令など公式な感染症対応が実施されている。Bundibugyo株はワクチン未開発で、1,118人の感染、291人の死亡が報告されている点が重大。

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes Merauke gencar imunisasi setelah 12 anak positif campak
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Merauke Health Office steps up immunization after 12 children test positive for measles.
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak response in Merauke Regency, South Papua Province, Indonesia, after 12 children test positive with lab confirmation from Surabaya. The Merauke Health Office is conducting Outbreak Response Immunization (ORI) targeting 3,109 children; 1,156 have been vaccinated (42.4%) so far. Vaccines come from routine stocks and central shipments. Affected children reportedly had incomplete immunization. Authorities will continue outreach to ensure full immunization for children under five to prevent further cases. They also monitor three other regencies in South Papua to ensure no additional measles cases. As of 26 June 2026, efforts focus on containing the outbreak and boosting routine immunization to avert future outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: メラウケ保健局、麻疹で12人の子どもが陽性反応後にワクチン接種を加速
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹の集団発生であり異常性と重症度が認識されるが、発生規模が限定的（12人の確認例）かつ当局が既に対応中である。情報が部分的なため、より詳細な疫学情報が必要。
triage.notes: メラウケ地域での限定的な麻疹集団発生。12人の確認例で予防接種キャンペーンが実施されている。当局の対応能力は十分であり、現在のところ国際的な懸念は低い。続報で症例数の増減と他地域への拡大状況を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: F35-NANO TULA++: 'Lá chắn kháng sinh' giúp đàn heo vượt bão dịch bệnh
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: F35-NANO TULA++: 'Antibiotic Shield' Helps the Pig Herd Weather the Disease Outbreak.
article.articleSummary: F35-NANO TULA++ uses Nano Tulathromycin to address porcine respiratory disease complex in pigs. It targets secondary bacterial infections linked to Mycoplasma hyopneumoniae, Pasteurella multocida, Haemophilus parasuis, Actinobacillus pleuropneumoniae, and notably Mycoplasma suis, which can cause anemia and reduced weight gain. The product aims to suppress respiratory conditions such as asthma-like symptoms, pneumonia, pleuritis, infectious atrophic rhinitis, and anorexia related to bacterial infections. It is also intended to manage secondary infections after African swine fever (ASF), PRRS, or foot-and-mouth disease (FMD). Nano Tulathromycin particles are designed for deeper tissue penetration and longer therapeutic levels, potentially reducing dosing frequency. It is promoted as part of an integrated herd health approach—biosecurity, vaccination, and control of opportunistic bacteria—without eradicating ASF or FMD viruses. Publisher: Hoa Sen Agricultural Group, Vietnam.

triage.headline_ja: F35-NANO TULA++：『抗生物質シールド』が豚群の疾病発生を乗り切るのに役立つ
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は動物用医薬品（ナノ粒子抗生物質製剤）の製品紹介記事であり、ASFおよびFMDの新規発生・アウトブレイク報告ではない。疾病管理ツールの宣伝コンテンツであるため、IHR基準およびWPRO基準の定義する『シグナル』に該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事はベトナムの農業企業による動物用医薬品の販売・宣伝コンテンツである。ASFおよびFMDの実際の発生事例報告ではなく、既知の疾病に対する治療補助製品の紹介のため、シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Cresce l'allarme in Africa per l'epidemia di ebola e in Europa arriva il primo caso importato
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Alarm grows in Africa over the Ebola epidemic, and in Europe the first imported case arrives.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri) caused by the Bundibugyo strain continues, with 1,118 laboratory-confirmed cases and 291 deaths as of 24 June 2026. Uganda reports 20 confirmed cases and 2 deaths, including healthcare workers; some infections imported from DRC and others due to local transmission, indicating viral circulation in the country. A WHO study published in The Lancet Infectious Diseases projects South Sudan as the region's urgent preparedness priority, with about a 70% probability of at least one imported case within 12 weeks; emphasis on constant surveillance, infection prevention, rapid response, and cross-border monitoring. The epidemic remains a low global risk, though the first imported European case arrived in France on 24 June from DRC; patient is stable and contact tracing is underway. No vaccine is authorized specifically for Bundibugyo.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカでエボラウイルスの流行警報が増す中、ヨーロッパで初の輸入症例が報告される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当。エボラは国際的な脅威であり、1,118例の確定患者、複数国への拡大、そしてフランスへの輸入症例によって国際流行の兆候が明確。スクリーニング基準も全項目該当し、社会的・政治的関心も高い。フルRRAが必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは DRC（Ituri州）、ウガンダ、南スーダン、フランスが言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれるのは DRC のみ。ウガンダと南スーダンは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。エボラの国際的拡大、複数国への波及可能性、ワクチン未承認株（Bundibugyo）による新規性、フランスへの輸入症例報告により、全 IHR 基準および全スクリーニング基準を満たす高優先度シグナル。

article.articleHeadline: Sốt xuất huyết gia tăng, cần tăng cường giám sát, xử lý ổ dịch
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever on the rise; strengthen surveillance and outbreak containment.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever is rising in Gia Lai Province, Vietnam. As of 26 June, 157 dengue cases have been reported, up 32 from the previous week, with no deaths. Since the start of 2026, total cases reached 1,813, up 914 versus the same period in 2025. The week recorded 15 new outbreaks, bringing active outbreaks to 23, concentrated in Phu Tuc, Binh An, Ia Puch, Dien Hong, Thong Nhat, Uar, An Lao, Mang Yang, and Ia Nan; active sites include Ia Nan, Duc Co, Ia Puch, Binh An, Pleiku, Bien Ho, Phu Tuc, and Uar. The Gia Lai Center for Disease Control has intensified surveillance through the infectious disease monitoring system, hospital and community surveillance, and ongoing investigations of outbreaks in Ia Boong, Ia Puch, Ia Nan and Binh An. A directive to strengthen surveillance, detection and rapid response has been issued; authorities will monitor high-incidence areas, analyze data, and implement measures to prevent further spread.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱の増加、監視と流行制御の強化が必要
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムのGia Lai州でデング熱が急速に増加（前週比+32症例、昨年同期比+914症例）。複数地域での23の活発なアウトブレイク、急速な拡大傾向、地域公衆衛生への深刻な影響が認められ、IHR基準およびWPRO基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはモロッコ（Bouarfa）が含まれているが、記事サマリーはベトナムのGia Lai州のデング熱拡大に焦点を当てており、モロッコは含めない。Bluedot APIの位置情報に誤りと判断される。ベトナムは対象国（ID 1562822）に含まれるため、verified_locationsに記載。

article.articleHeadline: South Sudan says suspected Ebola cases test negative - Radio Tamazuj
article.articleSummary: Seven suspected Ebola cases in South Sudan tested negative as of 2026-06-26, keeping the country Ebola-free amid heightened regional alerts. Suspects were reported across four locations: four in Juba, and one each in Yei, Yambio, and Nimule. Six samples were analyzed at the National Public Health Laboratory in Juba and one at a mobile lab in Nimule. Investigations are precautionary and part of expanded preparedness following outbreaks in neighbouring Uganda and the Democratic Republic of the Congo, not a response to confirmed transmission. Authorities have strengthened surveillance, laboratory capacity, rapid response teams, and border-entry screening, and increased coordination with neighbouring states and international partners. Preparedness level reportedly rose from 29% to 46%. WHO notes the alerts indicate functional surveillance, not active transmission, and maintains that border closures are not recommended; emphasis remains on rapid detection and containment. Ebola symptoms include fever, fatigue, vomiting, and diarrhoea, and can be fatal if untreated.

triage.headline_ja: 南スーダン、エボラウイルスの疑い例が陰性と発表 - ラジオ・タマズジ
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスは極度に重症な病原体であり、地域での警戒レベルが高まっているが、本事例は疑い例が全て陰性で確認患者なし。地域的な流行リスク評価のため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの主題は南スーダンの疑い例陰性という報告だが、南スーダンは対象国リストに含まれていない。DRCは隣接国として記事に言及されており、地域的な流行文脈の中でエボラ流行が存在することが述べられている。南スーダンでの検査結果は陰性であるため、現時点での確認感染者なし。DRCとウガンダでのエボラ流行が背景にあり、地域的な警戒が高まっている状況。

article.articleHeadline: Alerta sanitaria global: científicos advierten que un parásito que afecta a una de cada tres personas es un riesgo grave para la salud
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Global health alert: scientists warn that a parasite affecting one in three people poses a serious health risk.
article.articleSummary: Toxoplasma gondii infects about one third of people worldwide, causing toxoplasmosis. The article argues it remains under-prioritized in global health and urges the World Health Organization to recognize toxoplasmosis as a neglected tropical disease to unlock funding for prevention and research. Ocular toxoplasmosis is the most common eye infection globally and can cause vision loss; congenital toxoplasmosis affects about 190,000 newborns each year. Transmission occurs through undercooked meat or cat feces, and maternal infection can cross the placenta, risking miscarriage or fetal harm. The infection is concentrated in poverty-stricken tropical and subtropical regions, especially in South America. There is no vaccine and no standard treatment. The authors—Justine Smith (University of Flinders, Australia) and João Furtado (University of São Paulo, Brazil)—call for a global plan to improve screening, diagnosis, and treatment of congenital and ocular infections, strengthen food safety, water, sanitation, and prenatal care, with WHO backing.

triage.headline_ja: グローバル衛生警報：3人に1人に影響する寄生虫が重大な健康リスクであると科学者が警告
triage.triage_reason: トキソプラズマ症は世界的に高い感染率（全人口の約3分の1）を有し、公衆衛生への影響は深刻である。しかし記事は主として疾患認識と研究資金の必要性に関する呼びかけであり、特定の新規アウトブレイク等の急性的なイベントではない。情報不足のため継続観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはトキソプラズマ症が既知の風土病・冠感染症であり、新規アウトブレイク等の急性イベントではなく、疾患の公衆衛生的優先順位付けと研究資金確保の呼びかけである。オーストラリアは著者の所属機関所在地であり、実際の感染症イベント発生地ではないため verified_locations から除外。ブラジルは著者機関およびサマリー内で感染集中地域として明記されているため含める。IHR基準は1つのみ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響）、スクリーニング基準は4つ該当（重症度、長期曝露、流行しやすさ、管理可能性）。ただし急性的なシグナルの特徴に乏しく、政府レベルの対応状況が不明であるため、PICKUP判定には至らず WATCH 判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: "Азиатская Эбола" объявилась в Дагестане, все заболевшие -- в реанимации
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "Asian Ebola" has appeared in Dagestan; all the infected are in intensive care.
article.articleSummary: Three cases of Congo-Crimean hemorrhagic fever (CCHF), also called 'Asian Ebola', were reported in Kizilyurtovsky District, Dagestan. All patients were rushed to hospital and placed in intensive care in severe condition; at present there is no imminent threat to their lives, and their condition is stabilizing. CCHF is a viral disease that can progress to severe illness with dangerous complications; clinicians emphasize the need for timely diagnosis and strict precautions in endemic regions. Separately, in the Democratic Republic of Congo, Ebola deaths have reached 304, with 13 more fatalities reported in the last 24 hours, per the Congolese Ministry of Information in the daily bulletin.

triage.headline_ja: 「アジアンエボラ」ダゲスタンで報告、感染者は全員集中治療中
triage.triage_reason: CCHF（クリミア・コンゴ出血熱）とエボラの同時報告であり、IHR基準で異常性・国際的懸念が高く、WPROスクリーニングで重症度（ICU治療中）・管理可能性が該当。ロシア（ダゲスタン）での新規報告は異常性が高い。
triage.notes: ロシア（ダゲスタン）での CCHF 報告は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRCでのエボラ死亡304例は記事に明記されており、DRCは対象国。ロシアでの CCHF 新規報告は異例性が高く、国際的な懸念を引き起こすが、対象国ではないため監視対象外。DRCのエボラは継続中の事象として既知である。

article.articleHeadline: നിപ ആവർത്തിക്കുന്നു; ഉറവിടം അവ്യക്തമായി തുടരുന്നു | Nipah recurs: Source remains unclear
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nipah recurs: Source remains unclear.
article.articleSummary: Nipah virus recurs in Kerala with source undecided. In affected districts, Nipah genome detected in flying fox (bat) samples, and the same virus has been found in a human patient in Kozhikode Medical College Hospital who is critically ill. From February to September, Nipah presence was detected in bats in Kerala. Health authorities confirm the human infection originated from bats, but the exact route to people remains unknown. One hypothesis implicates fruit contamination by bats; since 2018, Kerala has tested hundreds of fruits annually (including rambutan, sapodilla, bananas/plantains, mangosteen, mango, jackfruit, and others) with no Nipah virus detected in fruits. By contrast, Nipah virus was found in about 29% of bat samples tested in Kerala. The RNA nature of Nipah and its fragility to sunlight helps explain negative fruit testing. Bangladesh outbreaks previously linked human infections to bat saliva on date palm sap.

triage.headline_ja: ニパール病が再発症：感染源は依然不明
triage.triage_reason: ニパール病はIHR Annex2基準で高い公衆衛生リスク（死亡率40-75%）、国際的拡大リスク、異常性を満たす。WPROスクリーニング基準では重症度（批判的患者）、流行しやすさ（ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性、複数国での発生）、管理可能性を満たす。
triage.notes: ニパール病は高い致死率と国際的な伝播リスクを持つ重要な病原体である。記事は、ケーララ州でコウモリサンプルおよび人間患者からニパールゲノムが検出されたこと、バングラデシュでも過去に同ウイルスが確認されていることを示唆している。感染源が不明である点と複数国での発生が懸念される。フルRRAが必要。

article.articleHeadline: กรมควบคุมโรคเปิดตัว Test and Treat ยกระดับบริการตรวจ 'ไวรัสตับอักเสบซี' กลุ่มผู้ใช้แรงงาน
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Department of Disease Control launches Test and Treat to upgrade hepatitis C virus testing services for the labor workforce.
article.articleSummary: Thailand’s Department of Disease Control launched a Test and Treat One-Stop Service to upgrade hepatitis C virus (HCV) testing and treatment for public transport drivers and workers. Implemented by the Urban Disease Prevention Institute, the program is hosted at the Thai Post Headquarters in Lak Si, Bangkok, under FY2026 to support national HCV elimination aligned with WHO goals. The integrated service provides proactive screening, confirmatory testing, liver-function assessment, medical consultation, and treatment at a single site, employing point-of-care testing and Telemedicine to reduce waiting times and prevent losses to follow-up. From October 2025 to April 2026, active screening in urban areas of 4,750 people identified 35 HCV infections and 45 HBV infections; some patients continued to face barriers related to work, income, and travel. HCV remains curable in over 95% with timely treatment, and the initiative aims to scale to additional areas.

triage.headline_ja: タイ疾病管理局、労働者向けC型肝炎ウイルス検査サービスを拡充する「検査と治療」プログラムを開始
triage.triage_reason: 本イベントはタイにおけるC型肝炎の検査・治療プログラムの拡充である。既知の感染症に対する公衆衛生対応であり、異常な集団発生・大規模流行の兆候ではなく、IHR基準およびWPRO基準の該当なし。
triage.notes: 本記事は既知のHCV/HBVに対する公衆衛生サービスの改善・拡充に関するもので、新たな感染症イベント（集団発生・異常な流行）の報告ではない。10月2025～4月2026の定期スクリーニングで35件のHCV感染と45件のHBV感染が検出されたとの記載があるが、これは検査・治療プログラムの文脈内での既知患者の同定であり、未制御な流行の兆候ではない。シグナルトリアージの対象外と判定。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, così un ospedale in Uganda si prepara ad affrontare il possibile arrivo del virus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: How a Hospital in Uganda Is Preparing to Face the Possible Arrival of the Virus.
article.articleSummary: Ebola Bundibugyo outbreaks remain concentrated in the Democratic Republic of the Congo with over 1,000 cases; the first imported case outside Africa has been confirmed in France, a doctor returning from Congo on June 24. Uganda reports 20 confirmed Ebola Bundibugyo cases. Lacor Hospital in Gulu, northern Uganda, is preparing for a possible arrival: inventory checks reveal sufficient PPE but needs more goggles, gowns, infrared thermometers, and alcohol-based disinfectants; the hospital is mapping patient and laboratory sample pathways and has reactivated the isolation unit with reinforced entry points to ensure hand hygiene. Lab results can be obtained in under 12 hours. Training has reached more than 200 staff, including a simulated drill on suspected cases, patient management, death handling, ambulance decontamination, and community information. Lacor lies about five hours from the nearest outbreak area, emphasizing readiness to protect patients, staff, and the broader community, drawing on Uganda’s 2000 experience.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：ウガンダの病院がウイルスの可能性のある到着に対応する準備方法
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo型）は深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、アフリカ外への初の輸入症例がフランスで確認されました。ウガンダの20例確認症例と国境を越えた拡大リスクがIHR基準を複数満たし、国際的な関心が高いため。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではウガンダの病院の準備体制について述べていますが、実際の流行発生地はコンゴ民主共和国（1,000例以上）です。ウガンダは20例の確認症例が報告されており、確認症例が発生している対象国ですが、記事の主題は「ウガンダの準備状況」であり、実際の大規模流行はDRCです。DRCが対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含めました。フランスでの輸入症例の言及がありますが、フランスは対象国外のため除外。ウガンダ（対象国外）の詳細な準備状況が記載されているため、国際的な関心の高さが推測できます。

article.articleHeadline: Россиянам рассказали, как защититься от опасной тропической инфекции
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russians were told how to protect themselves from a dangerous tropical infection.
article.articleSummary: Melioidosis diagnosed in a Russian woman after returning from Thailand; she remains in serious condition in a Russian hospital. The infection is not transmitted person-to-person and is acquired from soil in endemic regions; soil in Thailand and other endemic areas is the main infection source. Some cases can be nearly asymptomatic. High-risk groups include people with diabetes, alcoholism, immunodeficiencies (including HIV), and kidney diseases. Diagnosis can be challenging due to nonspecific symptoms that resemble other infections; patients should inform clinicians about recent international travel to aid diagnosis. Treatment lasts several months: two to three weeks of injectable antibiotics, followed by three to six months of oral therapy. Russia uses specialized diagnostic test systems, and border checkpoints employ the Perimeter system to monitor real-time epidemiological risks. The patient’s Thailand itinerary included visits to various sites, including an elephant farm.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア人が危険な熱帯感染症から身を守る方法について説明を受ける
triage.triage_reason: メリオイドーシスは非常に稀な感染症で、ロシアでの確定症例は1例（タイからの帰国者）である。ヒト-ヒト感染がなく土壌からの感染であるため、国際的拡大リスクは低い。ただし、免疫不全者（HIV陽性者を含む）が高リスク群として言及されており、継続的な情報収集が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にRussian Federationが含まれているが、実際の感染源はタイの土壌であり、ロシアの患者は帰国後に症状が顕現した輸入症例である。メリオイドーシスは非ヒト-ヒト感染性であるため、ロシアでの二次感染リスクは極めて低い。ロシアのメディアがこの事例を報道していることは公衆衛生当局の関心を示すが、国際的拡大リスクや国境制限の必要性は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو الديمقراطية تكثف إجراءاتها للسيطرة على فيروس إيبولا - أردو بوینت
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo steps up its measures to control the Ebola virus - Urdu Point
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo tightened travel restrictions for returnees from affected areas as part of sustained, government-led efforts to curb Ebola transmission across the country. Kinshasa, 26 June 2026 — The Ministry of Communications and Media said the outbreak's toll included 1,155 confirmed Ebola cases, 304 deaths, and 138 recoveries, with 326 people still in treatment or under isolation. The mid-May outbreak is attributed to the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain, for which there is currently no licensed vaccine or specific treatment available. The measures aim to limit cross-border and internal movement of potentially exposed individuals amid ongoing community transmission, as reported by authorities.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国がエボラウイルスの制御を強化 - ウルドゥーポイント
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響：1,155確認例と304死亡、異常・予想外のBundibugyo株、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限の実施）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数項目該当。フルRRAに進むべきシグナル。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus株によるアウトブレイク。ワクチンなし、特異的治療法なしという深刻な状況。キナシャを中心とした進行中の社会内感染。渡航制限が実施されており、国際的対応の必要性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Nueva actualización eleva a 304 fallecidos en la RD del Congo por brote de ébola - teleSUR
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New update raises the death toll to 304 in the Democratic Republic of the Congo due to an Ebola outbreak - teleSUR
article.articleSummary: As of June 26, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has 304 deaths among 1,155 confirmed cases since its May 15 declaration. The case fatality rate is 26.3%; 138 have recovered and 326 remain hospitalized or in isolation. The epicenter is Ituri Province, bordering Uganda and South Sudan, with spread to North and South Kivu. Uganda reports 20 confirmed cases and two deaths, prompting a 90-day cross-border plan to bolster laboratories and care. France confirms its first imported case: an ICU physician who treated the Bunia outbreak for NGO Alima and developed symptoms on a flight to France. The WHO identifies Bundibugyo Ebola virus, with no approved vaccine or specific treatment, and fatality estimates of 30–50%. The outbreak is a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, with high regional risk and 79.2% contact tracing, and transmission via direct contact with bodily fluids.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行で死者304人に上昇 - teleSUR
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当。エボラ出血熱は極めて重篤で予想外の国際拡大リスク（ウガンダ、フランスへの波及確認）があり、渡航・貿易制限の可能性も高い。WPRO基準も5項目すべて該当し、社会的・政治的関心も極めて高い。フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: ウガンダは地理的に近い地域での波及確認があるが、記事の主題はDRC内の流行。フランスへの輸入症例は治療者の移動による単発と評価。Bundibugyo ebolavirus、致死率30-50%、ワクチンなし。WHO PHEIC指定済み。緊急度極高。

article.articleHeadline: Kongo Demokratik Cumhuriyeti'nde Ebola salgınında vaka sayısı 1155'e yükseldi - ensonhaber.com
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo rises to 1,155 cases
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), centered in Ituri with cross-border activity in Aru, has reached 1,155 confirmed cases as of June 26, 2026, with 304 deaths, 138 recoveries, and 318 currently in treatment (case fatality ~26.3%). The outbreak was declared on May 15 after Ituri reported 246 suspected cases and 65 deaths; WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17. The Bundibugyo Ebola virus variant, a rare strain, currently lacks an approved vaccine or therapy, per health authorities. A 90-day cross-border intervention plan between DRC and Uganda was launched to bolster laboratory capacity and clinical care in the Aru region; Uganda reports 20 Ebola cases and 2 deaths. Historical context notes Ebola’s first identification in 1976 near the Ebola River, with the West Africa 2014–2017 outbreak causing about 30,000 infections and over 11,000 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行で感染者数が1,155人に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、異常・予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WHO PHEIC宣言済みで、稀なBundibugyo株、ワクチン・治療薬未承認という重大なリスク因子あり。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも20例の症例報告ありだが、記事の主題はDRCの流行。WHO PHEIC宣言済み（5月17日）。Bundibugyo株は稀で、承認ワクチン・治療薬がない点が重大。国際的な支援体制（DRC-ウガンダ90日間越境介入計画）が構築されている。

article.articleHeadline: Iš JAV sklinda skandalinga informacija, susijusi su COVID-19
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Scandalous information from the U.S. related to COVID-19 is spreading.
article.articleSummary: Former intelligence chief Tulsi Gabard (Tulsi Gabbard) publicly released declassified documents alleging that Anthony Fauci, director of the National Institute of Allergy and Infectious Diseases, played a pivotal role in developing the coronavirus and funded millions of dollars for risky bat coronavirus research at the Wuhan Institute of Virology in China, the institute linked to the COVID-19 pandemic. The materials also claim a politicized intelligence leadership manipulated data, silenced dissenters, and hid the truth to shield Fauci’s involvement. Separately, mass layoffs began in the U.S. intelligence community after Bill Pulte became interim director, with early cuts targeting the Counterterrorism and Counterintelligence Centers. Democrats in Congress oppose the overhaul, warning it risks national security. Trump appointed Pulte interim director and requested layoff plans on day one, while he maintains leadership roles at Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac.

triage.headline_ja: 米国から流出する、COVID-19に関連したスキャンダラスな情報
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は歴史的なCOVID-19起源に関する政治的主張と米国内の行政人事に関する記事であり、現在進行中の感染症イベント（患者発生、流行、集団発生）を報道していません。公衆衛生上の重大な影響や異常・予想外の疾病発生は記載されていません。
triage.notes: 記事はCOVID-19の歴史的起源に関する政治的論争と米国内の行政変更に焦点を当てており、現在の感染症イベント（患者発生、疾病流行、集団発生）を報道していません。過去のパンデミックに関する疑問や陰謀論を扱う政治記事であり、EBS活動のシグナルトリアージ対象外です。

article.articleHeadline: Webinar on zoonotic diseases and outbreak preparedness to be held on June 27
article.articleSummary: June 27, 2026: The Hindu will host a free health webinar, 'Ebola: Preparing for the Next Pandemic,' on Saturday from 3:00 to 4:00 p.m. The session explores zoonotic diseases—transmission from animals to humans—with Ebola as a key case study to explain emergence, drivers of spillover, and why outbreaks rise in an interconnected world. Topics include One Health, disease surveillance, public health preparedness, vaccination, and public awareness. Expert panelists: Parthesarathy Rajendran (MSF South Asia) on Ebola-driven spillover and global collaboration; Hamsadvani Kuganantham (WHO SEARO; Global Health Network, Oxford) on surveillance, International Health Regulations, data sharing, and preparedness; Vijayalakshmi Balakrishnan (Kauvery Hospitals, Chennai) on recognizing/managing zoonoses in clinical practice, India-relevant infections, infection prevention, and antimicrobial resistance. Moderated by Zubeda Hamid (The Hindu). Registration via link or QR code.

triage.headline_ja: 2026年6月27日に人獣共通感染症とアウトブレイク準備態勢に関するウェビナーが開催される
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は感染症アウトブレイクではなく、啓発ウェビナーの開催告知である。Ebolaは教育的な事例研究として取り上げられているのみで、実際の発生事例ではない。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIは複数の地域（Oxford、India等）を検出しているが、記事サマリーは完全にウェビナー開催告知である。実際の感染症イベント（アウトブレイク、患者発生）の記述がない。記事はインドのチェンナイで開催されるウェビナーについて述べているが、これは公衆衛生上の実際の脅威ではなく教育イベントである。対象国内での実際の感染症発生は記述されていないため、verified_locationsは空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: From Vaccines to Therapeutics; How Biotech Is Addressing the Ebola Outbreak
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak 2026 centers in the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda, with France confirming a first case linked to DRC and UN reports the outbreak is the fastest-growing in Africa’s history—over 1,000 cases and more than 260 deaths. Biotech activity highlighted: Soligenix (SNGX) reports a CEPI call for proposals (due June 12, 2026) for a Bundibugyo virus (BDBV) vaccine; collaboration with Dr. Axel Lehrer at the University of Hawai‘i to develop thermostable, protein-subunit vaccines with a thermostable, single-vial formulation aimed at ambient storage, useful for Africa and stockpiles. Aethlon Medical (AEMD) monitors the Bundibugyo outbreak in DRC and Uganda and pursues potential investigational use of its Hemopurifier device to remove enveloped viruses, referencing 2014 Ebola Zaire outcomes in a Ugandan physician treated in Frankfurt where viral load fell from ~400,000 to ~1,000 copies/mL and became undetectable five days after treatment. Regulatory discussions with WHO R&D Blueprint and NETEC are noted.

triage.headline_ja: ワクチンから治療薬まで：バイオテックがエボラアウトブレークに対処する方法
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱は公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的拡大の高リスク、1000症例以上260死亡、フランスでも症例確認、アフリカ史上最速の流行拡大を示す。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年6月時点のシナリオを描写している可能性があるが、エボラアウトブレークの詳細（DRC東部及びウガンダでの1000症例以上260死亡、国際的拡大）が明記されている。ウガンダも発生地域として記載されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。フランスでの症例確認は国際的拡大を裏付ける。規制当局（WHO）の関与も報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Whereabouts of nearly 300 people with Ebola unknown in DRC
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak (Bundibugyo strain) as of 26 June 2026: 1,118 confirmed cases and 291 deaths in the DRC, with 20 cases and 2 deaths in Uganda; about 297 positive individuals are unaccounted for. Approximately 1 million displaced people live in camps inaccessible to health workers, hindering contact tracing. A doctor who had worked in the DRC tested positive on return to France. A 21-day travel wait remains for people in affected provinces. WHO modelling in The Lancet Infectious Diseases projects about 8,210 cases and 1,420 deaths by mid-September, with a 70% chance of spread to South Sudan; central estimate 6,636–10,287 by Sept 16; worst-case up to 66,000. About 30% of new cases are known contacts, signaling substantial community transmission. Plans include recruiting 20,000 community health workers; Ebola treatment centers run at about 95% occupancy. Funding gaps: $518m needed; total with humanitarian needs $1.4bn; only ~13% of $910m pledged has arrived. First Bundibugyo drug trial next week; an antiviral trial for contacts begins a week later.

triage.headline_ja: DRCでエボラウイルス病の患者約300人の所在が不明
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当し、WPRO基準も5つ全て該当。Bundibugyo株によるDRCでの大規模エボラ流行で、1,118確認患者・291死亡、約297人が追跡不能。国際的な拡大リスク高く、フランスでも感染者確認。WHO予測では9月中旬までに8,210患者・1,420死亡と推計。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの主要なイベント発生地はDRC（Bundibugyo株流行、1,118確認患者）。ウガンダでも20患者・2死亡が確認されているが、対象国リストにウガンダは含まれないため verified_locations には DRC のみを含める。フランスの感染者はDRC帰還者であり、流行地はDRC。約297人の追跡不能患者、100万人の避難民キャンプ、95%のベッド占有率、資金ギャップ（必要額$1.4bn中$910mの13%のみ到着）など、管理可能性の懸念が大きい。WHO予測では South Sudan への拡大リスク70%。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Epidemie im Kongo: Schon 304 Tote | Heute.at
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola epidemic in the Congo: Already 304 deaths
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri Province) persists, with 1,155 confirmed cases and 304 deaths as of 26 June 2026. In the last 24 hours, 37 new infections and five additional deaths were reported. Africa CDC warns that 95% of hospital beds are already occupied and the outbreak’s peak may not yet be reached. The current Ebola virus is the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no vaccine or specific therapy yet. Next week in Bunia, the capital of Ituri Province in northeastern DRC, clinical trials of new drugs will begin. Remdesivir and MBP134 have arrived in the country, with additional vaccine candidates being pursued by several companies.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ流行：既に304人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラ出血熱の大規模流行で1,155確定例、304死亡、医療システムの容量逼迫、国際的支援必要、ワクチン未利用株による懸念。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo株）の大規模流行。記事サマリーに明記されたDRC（イトゥリ州ブニア）での発生。医療施設の容量逼迫（病床占有率95%）、ワクチン・治療薬が限定的、臨床試験進行中。WHO通知基準を明確に満たす。

article.articleHeadline: منظمة الصحة العالمية تحذر من خطر انتشار إيبولا إلى جنوب السودان
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization warns of the risk of Ebola spreading to South Sudan.
article.articleSummary: 70% chance Ebola could reach South Sudan, per WHO modeling published in The Lancet, stressing urgent preparedness in a country with weak public health infrastructure. In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, the current Ebola outbreak has more than 1,000 confirmed cases and over 260 deaths, with spillover to Uganda. Uganda has recorded 20 confirmed cases of Bundibugyo ebolavirus, including 2 confirmed deaths and 1 probable death. South Sudan is identified as next highest risk, with gaps in case management, contact tracing, safe burial, and border surveillance. Rwanda and Burundi face comparatively lower risk. In absence of a vaccine against Bundibugyo, neighboring states should adopt public health measures now, including border monitoring, contact tracing, and safe burial practices. The outbreak appears to have been circulating in under-resourced communities in a region facing conflict and displacement, with limited healthcare access, and was unmonitored in early April 2026—about six weeks before WHO flagged it. As of 2026-06-26.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、エボラがスーダン共和国に拡大するリスクを警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つすべてに該当。エボラは国際的に懸念される感染症であり、DRCでの大規模流行（1,000+確定例、260+死亡）が既にウガンダへ波及し、南スーダンへの拡大リスクが70%と高い。WPROs基準でも複数基準を満たし、WHOの警告による社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: DRCでの確定的な大規模流行が記事の中心。ウガンダへの波及も確認されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。南スーダン、ルワンダ、ブルンジへの拡大リスク警告はあるが、記事時点で確定症例は報告されていないため検証済み位置には含めない。WHO発表の最新疫学情報に基づく高リスク警告により、国際的な関心と対応が喚起されている。

article.articleHeadline: Kongo Demokratik Cumhuriyeti'ndeki Ebola salgınında hayatını kaybedenlerin sayısı 304'e yükseldi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The death toll from the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has risen to 304.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has killed 304 people, with 1,155 confirmed cases reported since May 15, according to the Ministry of Communications. Of the cases, 138 have recovered and 318 remain in treatment. The figures reflect ongoing transmission and current burden as of 26 June 2026. The report provides no details on symptoms, laboratory confirmation methods, infection source, or imported/exported cases. The update underscores the continued need for public health measures and medical care to reduce mortality and manage active cases in affected regions, signaling a sustained outbreak response in the country as reported by the Democratic Republic of the Congo's Communications Ministry.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行による死亡者数が304人に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当（重篤な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限の可能性）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度・長期曝露・流行可能性・管理可能性において複数該当。エボラウイルス病は国際的に極めて重大な感染症であり、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 2026年6月26日時点で死亡者304人、確認患者1,155人（5月15日以降）。回復者138人、治療中318人。記事はDRC通信省からの公式統計に基づいている。エボラ出血熱は最高リスク病原体であり、304人の死亡と1,155人の確認患者という数値は深刻な流行を示唆。国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威として最優先でフルRAAが必要。

article.articleHeadline: Econ Corp Services DBA Investorideas.com: From Vaccines to Therapeutics; How Biotech Is Addressing the Ebola Outbreak
article.articleSummary: Ebola continues to spread in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda, with France reporting a first case linked to the DRC and the UN calling the outbreak the fastest-growing in Africa, surpassing 1,000 cases and over 260 deaths. CEPI is seeking vaccine proposals for Bundibugyo virus (BDBV); Soligenix, in collaboration with Dr. Axel Lehrer at the University of Hawai'i, is developing thermostable, protein-based subunit BDBV vaccines on a multivalent platform, aiming to submit a CEPI application to enable rapid development and ambient-temperature logistics. Aethlon Medical monitors the outbreak and flags potential investigational use of its Hemopurifier device to remove enveloped viruses, coordinating with WHO R&D Blueprint and NETEC. Context notes from 2014 Ebola: a Ugandan physician treated in Frankfurt showed viral load reduction from ~400,000 to ~1,000 copies/mL after a single Hemopurifier session, with recovery continuing after five days."

triage.headline_ja: 経済コープサービス DBA Investorideas.com：ワクチンから治療薬まで；バイオテクノロジーがエボラ感染症拡大にどのように対応しているか
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCおよびウガンダで急速に拡大し、フランスで初の関連症例報告、1,000例以上の患者と260人以上の死亡が報告されており、IHR基準3つ以上に該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大、予想外の急速増加）。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。
triage.notes: 記事は東部DRCおよびウガンダでのエボラ拡大を主題としており、フランスの症例報告はDRC関連の輸入症例。対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCとウガンダのみ。ドイツやフランスでの症例は国際的拡大を示すが、発生国ではなく輸入症例であるため除外。記事配信日が2026年（将来日）であることに注意。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : premier cas diagnostiqué en France, un protocole activé
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: first diagnosed case in France, protocol activated.
article.articleSummary: France confirmed its first Ebola case on its territory. The patient is a humanitarian doctor returning from the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), where he had been on a mission in Kinshasa; his condition deteriorated during the flight and he was isolated upon arrival in a specialized hospital, where he remains in stable condition. Five fellow passengers from the flight have been identified as contacts and placed in 21-day isolation. French authorities have activated enhanced precautionary measures with risk assessed as low for European residents and very low for the general population. The DRC authorities responded by tightening controls, requiring a 21-day period before any international travel for those leaving affected areas, with health professionals under surveillance during this period. The outbreak protocol has been activated in France.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：フランスで初めて診断された症例、プロトコルが発動
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の国際的拡大、渡航制限リスク）。輸入症例により国境を超えた感染症のリスクが現実化し、複数国で対応プロトコルが発動。
triage.notes: フランスでの症例は輸入症例（DRC由来）。評価対象国リストに基づき、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。DRCはAfrican regionの主要国であり、既知のエボラ流行地。渡航前21日間の監視期間設定、接触者隔離など国際的な対応が実施されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola: RDC sobe balanço de mortos para 291
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: DRC raises death toll to 291.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 1,118 confirmed cases and 291 deaths since it was declared on May 15. The government’s latest update shows an increase from 1,096 infections and 277 fatalities reported previously, underscoring ongoing transmission in remote and conflict-affected areas. Similar cases have been detected in neighboring Uganda, and France reported its first imported Ebola case — a humanitarian‑organization doctor who had returned from a mission in the DRC. Experts warn the outbreak’s size may be underestimated due to limited access in affected regions. The France case highlights cross-border risk, while authorities continue surveillance and response efforts in the eastern DRC and among travelers linked to the region.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：コンゴ民主共和国で死亡者数が291人に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当する。エボラ出血熱は重篤度が高く、複数国への国際的拡大（ウガンダ、フランスでの輸入症例）が確認されており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と渡航・貿易制限リスクが明白である。フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: フランスでの輸入症例報告はあるが、フランスは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めず。ウガンダも対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。コンゴ民主共和国のみが対象国。1,118確認症例、291死亡（CFR約26%）で、紛争地域への限定的アクセスにより実数がさらに多い可能性が指摘されている。クラスター型の進行中の流行であり、即時対応が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Kongo Demokratik Cumhuriyeti'nde Ebola salgınında vaka sayısı 1155'e yükseldi - Havadis Gazetesi | Kıbrıs Haber
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of Ebola outbreak cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has risen to 1,155 - Havadis Gazetesi | Kıbrıs Haber.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) reports 1,155 confirmed Ebola cases and 304 deaths since the outbreak declaration on May 15, 2026, with 138 recoveries and 318 patients in treatment; case fatality is about 26.3%. Ituri Province accounts for 246 suspected cases and 65 deaths. A 90-day cross-border Ebola response plan with Uganda aims to strengthen laboratory capacity and clinical response in border areas, notably Aru. Uganda reports 20 Ebola cases and 2 deaths. The outbreak is caused by a Bundibugyo ebolavirus variant, for which no approved treatment or vaccine exists. The World Health Organization declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17, 2026. This ongoing outbreak underscores the need for cross-border public health collaboration in Central Africa.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行で患者数が1,155人に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WHOが国際的懸念事項（PHEIC）を宣言したエボラウイルス感染症の進行中の流行。公衆衛生への重大な影響、国際的な拡大リスク、ウガンダを含む越境対応の必要性が確認される。
triage.notes: 2026年5月15日の流行宣言以来、確認患者数1,155人、死亡304人（致死率26.3%）。WHOは5月17日にPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緒問題）を宣言。ウガンダとの90日間の越境対応計画が進行中。Bundibugyo ebolavirus変異体で、承認された治療法またはワクチンが存在しない。記事サマリーにウガンダでの20症例2死亡が記載されているが、主要な発生地はDRCであるため verified_locations にはDRCのみを記載。

article.articleHeadline: Más de 300 muertos por ébola y el 95% de camas ocupadas en Rep. del...
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 300 dead from Ebola and 95% of beds occupied in the Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has exceeded 1,150 confirmed cases and 304 deaths, with 95% of hospital beds occupied. The outbreak is centered in Ituri province, with Bunia city hardest hit. The Bundibugyo strain challenges containment due to no vaccine or specific treatment. Transmission is by contact with bodily fluids. Trials of two potential therapies—MBP134 and remdesivir (developed in the United States and Egypt)—are to begin next week in Bunia. Remdesivir supplies have reportedly reached the DRC. On June 26, 2026, the government ordered a 21-day travel quarantine for people moving from affected areas to other parts of the country or abroad to enable thorough contact tracing and reduce transmission.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスで300人以上が死亡、コンゴ民主共和国の病床占有率95%
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、エボラウイルス感染症という高い公衆衛生リスク、国際的拡大の懸念、複数国での治療薬開発・供給が関わる重大な感染症危機。
triage.notes: DRCのIturi州での大規模エボラ流行（確認患者1,150例以上、死亡304例）。Bundibugyo株でワクチンや特異的治療法がない。米国とエジプトで開発された実験的治療薬（MBP134、レムデシビル）の試験が予定されている。政府は21日間の検疫命令を発令。記事の発生地域にUSとEgyptが含まれているが、これらは治療薬開発地・供給元に過ぎず、実際の感染症イベント発生地はDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: 1.155 Kasus Ebola Terkonfirmasi dan 300 Kematian di RD Kongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 1,155 Confirmed Ebola Cases and 300 Deaths in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo remains active in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu provinces. As of 25 June, the ministry reports 1,155 laboratory-confirmed cases and 304 deaths, a case fatality rate of 26.3%. Earlier on 23 June, figures were 1,048 confirmed cases and 267 deaths (CFR >25%). The World Health Organization notes this outbreak has produced the largest number of confirmed cases in the first month of an Ebola outbreak in Africa, and in May 2026 designated the DR Congo–Uganda outbreak as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern due to high cross-border risk. The outbreak is ongoing and expanding in eastern DR Congo, with authorities continuing surveillance and response efforts.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ確認症例1,155件、死亡300件
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイク、高い死亡率（26.3%）、国境を越えた拡大リスク（ウガンダでも報告）、WHOが国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）として指定。
triage.notes: WHOがPHEIC指定済み。ウガンダも発生地域に含まれるが、対象国リストに該当なし。記事の主題はDRC内のアウトブレイク。アフリカ地域で1ヶ月以内の確認症例数としては過去最大規模との報告。

article.articleHeadline: Kongo Demokratik Cumhuriyeti'nde Ebola salgını: Vaka sayısı 1155, can kaybı 304'e yükseldi - Evrensel
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: case count has risen to 1,155, death toll has risen to 304 - Evrensel
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri province near the Uganda border) has 1,155 confirmed cases since 15 May, with 304 deaths and 138 recoveries; 318 patients remain in treatment, yielding a case fatality rate of 26.3%. The outbreak is caused by a Bundibugyo ebolavirus variant, with no approved treatment or vaccine. A 90-day cross-border plan with Uganda aims to boost laboratory capacity and clinical response in the Aru region. Uganda reports 20 Ebola cases and 2 deaths. The initial cluster included 246 suspected cases and 65 deaths; WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on 17 May. Historical Ebola outbreaks in Africa underscore the pathogen’s impact.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱流行：患者数は1,155人に、死亡者数は304人に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の4項目すべてに該当し、WPRO基準も全項目で懸念あり。エボラ出血熱による多数の死亡と国際的な拡大（ウガンダへの越境感染）、WHOによるPHEIC宣言など国際的影響が極めて大きい。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC（Ituri州）が主要な発生地であり、ウガンダへの越境感染（20例、2死亡）も報告されている。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。WHOによるPHEIC宣言（2026-05-17）、致死率26.3%、治療法・ワクチン未承認という高リスク要因により、フルRRA実施対象。

article.articleHeadline: WHO: Response to Ebola Outbreak in Democratic Republic of Congo Begins to Bear Fruit
article.articleSummary: As of 26 June 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is beginning to bear fruit in the response, according to WHO Director‑General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus. In a post on X (monitored by SABA), WHO and partners said they are working with the DRC government and affected communities to initiate clinical trials of potential Ebola treatments to assess safety and efficacy and to give patients greater chances of recovery. The statement calls for continued expansion of efforts across sectors. The report does not provide case counts or fatalities but highlights ongoing therapeutic investigations and collaboration with communities as a path forward for outbreak control.

triage.headline_ja: WHO：コンゴ民主共和国のエボラアウトブレイク対応が成果を上げ始めている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（エボラ出血熱は公衆衛生への重大な脅威、異常事象、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクあり）。また記事がWHO総長による公式発表であり、国際的関心が高い。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は最高レベルの危機管理対象疾患。WHO総長による公式発表で国際的高い関心を示しており、治療法臨床試験実施など対応段階にあることが確認される。ケース数・死亡数は記事に明記されていないが、エボラ自体の重篤性から判定に影響なし。

article.articleHeadline: Actualité | Ebola en RDC : le président de la Commission de l'Union africaine salue les efforts de Kinshasa et la solidarité des États membres | mediacongo.net
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: News | Ebola in the DRC: the Chairperson of the African Union Commission salutes Kinshasa's efforts and the solidarity of the member states | mediacongo.net
article.articleSummary: During the closing of the AU's 52nd Ordinary Session of the PRC, Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo was highlighted as a continuing health threat requiring continental solidarity. AU Commission Chair Mahmoud Ali Youssouf commended Kinshasa's government for its sustained fight against Ebola and its mobilization of national resources to contain the outbreak. He also saluted the solidarity and contributions of African Union member states toward the affected countries, stressing that a virtual high-level summit on Ebola mobilized political support and resources to reinforce the continent's response. Beyond health, Youssouf called for stronger cooperation among African institutions to address peace, security, and development. He urged Permanent Representatives to push ahead with AU reforms to strengthen financial viability and the organization's effectiveness.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱のDRCでの対応：アフリカ連合委員会議長がキンシャサの努力とアフリカ連合加盟国の連帯を高く評価
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ出血熱の継続的な流行は重大な公衆衛生脅威であり、複数の国際的課題を提示するが、本記事は主に外交・政治的声明であり、疾患の新たな動向や拡大状況についての具体的情報が不足しているため。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年6月26日配信のAU（アフリカ連合）の政治的声明であり、DRCのエボラ出血熱流行は継続的な脅威として言及されている。しかし、具体的な新規感染例数、死亡数、地理的拡大状況、防疫対策の有効性などの疫学的詳細は記事に含まれていない。外交・政治的な背景情報が主体であるため、疾患の現在の動向を正確に評価するにはさらなる詳細情報（症例数の推移、発生地域の拡大状況など）が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Arabia Saudí suspende viajes a África por brote de ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Saudi Arabia suspends trips to Africa due to Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Saudi Arabia suspended travel to the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), Uganda and South Sudan, halted visa issuance and entry of tourists from those countries, and barred travelers who have recently been in any of them within the prior 21 days, including arrivals via third countries, as a precaution amid an Ebola outbreak. The measures, confirmed by the Saudi Press Agency, accompany no reported Ebola cases (confirmed or suspected) in Saudi Arabia to date. The DRC is experiencing its 17th Ebola outbreak, declared in mid-May, primarily affecting the eastern region and extending into Uganda. Official data cite 1,118 cases and 291 deaths. The World Health Organization warns that the outbreak's progression exceeds current response capacity, underscoring concerns over cross-border spread and the need for heightened regional containment.

triage.headline_ja: サウジアラビア、エボラ流行によるアフリカへの渡航を中止
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク）。DRC及びウガンダでの確認された大規模エボラ流行に対し、複数国が渡航制限を実施している段階で、WHO警告と地域的懸念が存在する。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づき、実際のエボラ流行が確認されているのはDRC（17回目の流行、1,118症例、291死亡）とウガンダ。ウガンダはWPRO対象国リストに含まれないため除外。スーダンとサウジアラビアは渡航制限実施国であり発生地ではない。DRCのみverified_locationsに列挙。

article.articleHeadline: المراكز الأفريقية ترفع احتياجات تمويل مكافحة إيبولا إلى 1.4 مليار دولار مع اتساع نطاق التفشي - أخبار ليبيا 24
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: African centers raise Ebola response funding needs to $1.4 billion as the outbreak widens - Libya News 24.
article.articleSummary: As of June 26, 2026, Africa CDC raises Ebola response funding needs to $1.4 billion as the outbreak widens. The Bundibugyo strain has infected over 1,100 people in the Democratic Republic of Congo and 20 in Uganda in the first month, with Ituri province in eastern DRC as the main epicenter. A June 5 joint plan with WHO had estimated funding at about $518 million, now expanded to cover humanitarian as well as health response needs. International pledges total about $910 million, but actual disbursement stands at roughly 13% of commitments, raising concerns about timely interventions. Without full funding, containment efforts risk being undermined, amid deteriorating humanitarian conditions in Ituri and logistical challenges for responders.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ疾病予防管理センター、エボラ出血熱対応資金ニーズを14億ドルに引き上げ—感染拡大に伴い
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラ出血熱の複数国での急速な拡大、高い死亡率、国際的な資金動員が必要な状況であり、直ちにフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダも発生地域に含まれているが対象国リストに該当しないため除外。DRCのイトゥリ州を中心とした急速な感染拡大、1,100人以上の感染者、資金不足による懸念が明記されている。Bundibugyo株という特定の系統の同定も重要。

article.articleHeadline: Kiderült, hogyan törhet be Magyarországra az ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: It has been revealed how Ebola could enter Hungary.
article.articleSummary: As of 26 June 2026, Ebola could reach Hungary. Virologist Miklós Rusvai noted that the disease has appeared in Europe, with France confirming a doctor case and launching epidemiological investigations. He stressed that Hungary would most likely import the virus from Congo or the Central African region, not from the French patient. Transmission occurs through body fluids—saliva, sweat, feces, urine, tears, and sexual secretions—with the risk reduced when exposed healthcare workers return home under isolation. A sneeze is unlikely to spread the virus, and the incubation period is short, so cases are often identified locally. Hospital mortality is under 10% in developed countries but can reach 30–70% in Africa. There is no vaccine; monoclonal antibody therapies are used, and prevention centers on hygiene and supportive care to prevent bleeding, dehydration, and pain. The French case is the first Europe-wide confirmation since the Central African outbreak began.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがハンガリーに侵入する可能性が明らかに
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準2項目該当（異常性・国際的拡大リスク）で評価基準を満たすが、現時点では仮説的シナリオ論述であり、ハンガリーでの実際の症例報告ではない。コンゴおよび中央アフリカでの進行中の流行と欧州への波及可能性という懸念が存在するため、継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは、ハンガリーはエボラウイルス輸入の可能性について理論的に論じられているが、ハンガリー国内での確認例は報告されていない。フランスでの医師の症例確認（初のヨーロッパ例）は記載されているが、フランスは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations に含めない。DRC での進行中の流行が背景にあり、国際的拡大リスクが高い状況。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Horror as passenger falls ill with Ebola on flight to Europe
article.articleSummary: DR Congo imposes a 21-day quarantine for anyone who has visited Ebola-affected areas before international travel, with daily monitoring and travel restrictions without authorisation. Europe risk is described as low. Outbound travellers, including healthcare workers and lab staff, must complete a border health declaration. Uganda reports 20 confirmed Ebola cases, most imported from the DRC. The UKHSA has enhanced travel screening for arrivals from affected regions; Brits are advised to consult travel health specialists before visiting Ebola-affected regions. Ebola is a rare, often fatal zoonotic virus, not airborne, with primary hosts including fruit bats, monkeys, chimpanzees, and forest antelopes. Transmission occurs when symptomatic. Incubation is 2–21 days (avg 8–10). Early symptoms: fever, fatigue, headache, and muscle aches; late: diarrhoea, vomiting, abdominal pain, kidney/liver impairment; bleeding and organ failure can follow.

triage.headline_ja: 乗客がヨーロッパへの飛行中にエボラで発症し恐怖が広がる
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で深刻な公衆衛生影響（死亡の可能性）、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限のリスク該当。エボラウイルスは低ウイルス性感染症だが致死性が高く、複数国での事例報告と国際的対応の実施により、フルRRA進行が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCでのエボラ発生、ウガンダへの拡大、イギリスでの乗客発症ケースを報告。WPRO対象国はDRCのみ（GeoNames ID 203312）。ウガンダ（226074）とイギリス（2635167）は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。記事は飛行中の発症報告と国際的な防疫対応（隔離、スクリーニング）を強調しており、PICKUP判定の根拠は確固。

article.articleHeadline: As Ebola spreads in Eastern DRC, WFP warns food, livelihoods and access are critical to containing the outbreak
article.articleSummary: As of 26 June 2026, Ebola is spreading in eastern DRC—North Kivu, South Kivu, Ituri and Tanganyika—amid a hunger crisis. About 26.5 million people are food insecure; 3.6 million are in emergency levels, with 10 million in the provinces facing acute food stress. The outbreak worsens displacement and conflict; food assistance is part of containment. Jacques, an internally displaced father, lost his daughter to Ebola after fleeing Bukavu to Beni; his wife remains in isolation, and WFP provides hot meals to patients and meals for 13 family members. WFP has supplied 36,000 hot meals in treatment centres, 2,600 take-home rations in North Kivu and Ituri, and monthly food to 14,000 people in ten quarantined South Kivu villages. UNHAS moved 1,750 responders and 300 metric tons of cargo. Funding needs: USD 72 million for Ebola response and USD 286 million for emergency food across eastern DRC.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱が東部DRコンゴで広がる中、WFPは食糧、生計、アクセスが流行封じ込めに重要だと警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。東部DRコンゴの複数州（北キブ、南キブ、イツリ、タンガニーカ）でのエボラ出血熱の多地域同時流行は、深刻な公衆衛生への影響、予想外の急速な拡大、国際的拡大リスク、および国境を越えたリスクを示唆している。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは東部DRCの4州（北キブ、南キブ、イツリ、タンガニーカ）での同時多発的なエボラ流行を報告。26.5百万人の食料不安人口、360万人の緊急レベル、1000万人の急性食糧不足に直面。すでに死亡例あり。UNHAS等による支援活動進行中。国連世界食糧計画（WFP）による72百万ドルの流行対応資金要望。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, hantavirus e caldo estremo: perché l'Oms è in allerta e quali sono i rischi reali
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola, hantavirus, and extreme heat: why the WHO is on alert and what the real risks are
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 1,094 confirmed cases and 277 deaths five weeks after declaration. Health system capacity has expanded dramatically, with beds rising from under 10 to over 500 across 19 facilities, and diagnostics increasing from about 30 daily tests in Kinshasa to more than 2,000 daily across nine laboratories in three provinces; over 100 patients have recovered. Nevertheless, contact tracing, clinical capacity, and safe burials remain critical challenges amid strained health systems and border closures. Two antivirals, Remdesivir and MBP134, will be tested next week against Bundibugyo virus, with community engagement and logistics planned for rollout if proven safe and effective. The outbreak has crossed borders: Uganda reports a new case (total 20 infections, all linked to the DRC outbreak); a healthcare worker in France (ALIMA) is infected. Africa CDC/WHO seek about $518 million; funding remains insufficient; global risk remains low. Hantavirus on a cruise ship: 13 confirmed, 3 deaths; 650+ contacts in 33 countries monitored; 54 under observation, potential end by July 2. WHO aims to obtain a sample for the BioHub in Geneva. Extreme heat remains a major health threat, causing about 500,000 deaths annually, with the elderly, children, pregnant women, and those with chronic diseases most at risk.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ、ハンタウイルス、猛暑：WHOが警戒态勢にある理由と実際のリスクは何か
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。DRCでのエボラアウトブレイク（1,094確定例、277死亡）が報告され、ウガンダ・フランスへの国際的な拡がり、さらにクルーズ船でのハンタウイルス集団発生（13確定例、3死亡）が確認されており、フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 記事ではDRCでのエボラアウトブレイク、ウガンダおよびフランスでの輸入症例が報告されている。ハンタウイルスはクルーズ船での集団発生で、33か国に波及する可能性があるが、サマリーには特定の発生国の記載がないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCのみが対象国リストに該当。資金不足（$518百万要求中不足）、国際的関心（Africa CDC/WHO対応）が高く、社会的・政治的関心が顕著。

article.articleHeadline: എബോള ജാഗ്രതയിൽ സൗദി; മൂന്ന് ആഫ്രിക്കൻ രാജ്യങ്ങളിൽനിന്നുള്ളവർക്ക് താൽക്കാലിക പ്രവേശന വിലക്ക്
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola alert in Saudi Arabia; temporary entry ban for people from three African countries.
article.articleSummary: Saudi Arabia imposed a temporary entry ban on travelers from the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), Uganda, and South Sudan amid Ebola concerns in Africa. Those who have resided in any of these countries in the prior 21 days will have all entry visas suspended. By contrast, travelers from Rwanda, Burundi, Tanzania, and Congo-Brazzaville will undergo enhanced health screening and surveillance at border points. Saudi authorities report no Ebola cases in the kingdom since 2019. The World Health Organization cites an Ebola virus disease case fatality rate of about 50% (first identified in the DRC in 1976) and notes more than 15,000 deaths globally. Separately, a doctor who participated in a DRC human rights mission has tested positive for Ebola in France and is in quarantine.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ警報でサウジアラビア；アフリカの3カ国からの人々に一時入国禁止
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病は致死率の高い重大な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、複数国での発生・確認および国際的な渡航制限措置の実施が報告されている。IHR基準の深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限が全て該当する。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づき、実際にエボラ患者が確認されている対象国はDRCのみ。フランスでの患者報告はサマリーに記載されているが、フランスは評価対象国リストに含まれていない。南スーダン、ウガンダ、ルワンダ、ブルンジ、タンザニア、コンゴ共和国は対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。サウジアラビアは対象国リストに含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: சென்னையில் 5.56 லட்சம் குழந்தைகளுக்கு போலியோ சொட்டு மருந்து வழங்கும் முகாம்
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Polio drops distribution camp for 5.56 lakh children in Chennai.
