article.articleSummary: Polio drops distribution camp for 5.56 lakh children in Chennai: Greater Chennai Corporation Commissioner Dr. G. S. Sameeran inspected preparations for an intensive polio drops vaccination camp for 5.56 lakh children, scheduled for 28 June 2026 (Sunday) at Balavakkam Government Adi Dravidar Welfare Higher Secondary School campus. Western Zone Deputy Commissioner Athab Rasul and city public health officials accompanied the review. The visit focused on logistics and mobilization ahead of the campaign, reflecting coordinated municipal and health department efforts to ensure wide coverage of the polio immunization drive in Chennai.

triage.headline_ja: チェンナイで556万人の子どもへのポリオワクチン滴剤配布キャンプ
triage.triage_reason: 本イベントはポリオの予防接種キャンプの実施であり、ポリオの発生・流行事例ではない。疾患の異常な発生や集団発症がなく、公衆衛生への懸念はない。
triage.notes: 記事内容は定期的なポリオ予防接種キャンプの実施準備であり、ポリオの発生事例ではない。ポリオの感染症シグナルとしてのピックアップは不要。

article.articleHeadline: ВНА: Виетнамски миротворци подпомогнаха усилията за предотвратяване на разпространението на ебола в Абией
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: VNA: Vietnamese peacekeepers assisted efforts to prevent the spread of Ebola in Abyei.
article.articleSummary: Ebola prevention efforts in Abyei are led by Vietnamese engineers from the UN peacekeeping mission, organizing an information campaign to curb Ebola spread amid worsening outbreaks in Africa. Local residents received medical supplies and were informed on protective measures. The initiative, timed with June’s monsoon-driven floods that contaminated water sources, seeks to shield children and the elderly and support frontline health workers facing transport and supply challenges. The Vietnamese engineering platoon prioritized outbreak prevention, collaborating with local health authorities to boost preparedness. A Vietnamese field hospital in Abyei conducted infection-prevention trainings for all staff, including symptom recognition and safe communication with residents. The campaign “Together with the Community Against Ebola” donated essential items like masks and hand sanitizers to local health facilities and schools. Educational activities at Abyei secondary school demonstrated WHO-recommended handwashing and highlighted reducing close contact in crowded settings. Information shared under a BTA–VNA agreement.

triage.headline_ja: VNA: ベトナム人平和維持要員がアビエイでのエボラ拡散防止の取り組みを支援
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱は極めて高リスク疾患だが、記事の主要内容は予防キャンペーン・啓発活動であり、実際の感染事例や流行の深刻な拡大については明記されていない。対象国にスーダンが含まれておらず、確認できる対象国がないため情報不足の観点からWATCHとして継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にSudan（366755）が含まれるが、対象国リスト（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）に該当しない。記事はアビエイ（南スーダン内の地域）でのベトナムUNPKO要員による予防キャンペーンについて述べており、実際のエボラ患者数、死亡例、感染の深刻な拡大については明確に記載されていない。記事は予防啓発活動にフォーカスしており、リスクアセスメントには詳細情報が不足している。

article.articleHeadline: $1.4 bln needed to contain ongoing Ebola outbreak in DRC, Uganda
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda remains ongoing, with 1,138 confirmed cases and 293 deaths. Africa CDC says $1.4 billion is needed to contain the outbreak under a response and preparedness plan. While pledges totaling about $910 million were announced at an African Union high‑level meeting last week, only 13% has been released to affected countries and response partners. The Africa CDC initially appealed for $319 million after the May 15 outbreak declaration by the DRC, and as the outbreak expanded the financing requirement rose to $518 million to help African countries and partners rapidly detect and respond. Jean Kaseya emphasized that early financing is the most cost‑effective public health investment and urged immediate release of pledged funds to prevent a wider regional crisis.

triage.headline_ja: DRC、ウガンダの進行中のエボラ流行を封じ込めるために14億ドルが必要
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当。エボラは公衆衛生上の重大な脅威であり、複数国（DRC、ウガンダ）での確認事例、高い致死率、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限の可能性が全て該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCとウガンダの両国でのエボラ流行について述べているが、ウガンダ(ID不明)は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には DRC のみ記載。1,138確認症例、293死亡という高い死亡率。資金不足（現在13%のみ拠出）が対応能力に影響を与えている。

article.articleHeadline: Boletim mostra avanço do rinovírus, principal responsável pelo resfriado comum, no Acre
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bulletin shows rhinovirus progression, the main cause of the common cold, in the state of Acre.
article.articleSummary: Rhinovirus, the virus most associated with the common cold, is expanding in Acre, Brazil, now the second most circulating respiratory pathogen after RSV, according to Epidemiological Bulletin No. 21 on Respiratory Syndromes released June 24, 2026 by the Acre State Health Secretariat (Sesacre). Since 2024-2025, the rhinovirus has risen, with RSV remaining the leading pathogen. In 2026 Acre shows co-circulation of multiple respiratory viruses, including RSV, Rhinovirus, non-subtyped Influenza A, and Adenovirus; COVID-19 SARS-CoV-2 has declined, falling below 2024 levels and no longer prominent among Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SRAG) cases. Adenovirus and Metapneumovirus circulation rose modestly; Influenza B and other coronaviruses remained at low levels. The bulletin links this shift to increased SRAG hospitalizations. Sesacre recommends vaccination of priority groups, reinforced hand hygiene, respiratory etiquette, and ongoing epidemiological surveillance to reduce transmission and protect vulnerable populations.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル・アクレ州でライノウイルスが拡大、風邪の主な原因ウイルスとして2番目に循環する病原体に
triage.triage_reason: 複数の呼吸器ウイルスの同時流行を報告しており、公衆衛生上の関心はあるが、死亡・重症化の具体的な数値が記載されていない。季節的な呼吸器ウイルス流行の範囲内と判断される。
triage.notes: ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれているため verified_locations に Brazil を記載。記事は複数の呼吸器ウイルスの同時流行（RSV、ライノウイルス、インフルエンザA、アデノウイルスなど）を報告しており、SRAG入院の増加に言及している。ただし、死亡率や重症化率などの具体的な重症度指標が記載されていないため、IHR基準の「深刻な公衆衛生への影響」を確実に判断できない。地域的なブレイクアウトであり、国際的な拡大リスクは低いと判断される。

article.articleHeadline: El brote de ébola se extenderá a más países, según un modelo informático
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak will spread to more countries, according to a computer model.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), caused by the Bundibugyo strain, has spread to Uganda and carries a 69.3% probability of reaching another country, with South Sudan identified as the likely next destination within 12 weeks. A WHO computer-model study published in The Lancet Infectious Diseases uses data through June 22. The DRC has 1,048 laboratory-confirmed cases and 267 deaths. Retrospective analyses indicate transmission began in early April, with a six-week lag to official confirmation on May 15, allowing undetected spread in a conflict-affected region with limited healthcare access. The model examined low, medium, and high transmissibility scenarios. The central scenario, aligning with 837 cases confirmed by June 15, projects about 990 cases in the DRC by end of June (174 deaths) and 8,210 cases by September if current trends persist. Authors emphasize this is an initial assessment to guide prevention, not an exact forecast.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行はコンピュータモデルによればさらに多くの国に拡大するだろう
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の国際拡大、渡航制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当。エボラ出血熱の多国間拡大と高い死亡率は直ちにフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCにおけるエボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo株）の発生と、ウガンダへの既存感染を記述している。ただし対象国リストにはウガンダが含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。南スーダン拡大リスクも言及されているが、対象国リストに南スーダンは含まれていない。DRCは対象国（GeoNames ID 203312）に該当し、疾患の重症度（267死亡）、国際拡大の可能性（69.3%のリスク予測）、紛争地域での制御困難性が確認される。

article.articleHeadline: Justiça mantém prisão de Oruam após defesa citar caso gravíssimo de tuberculose
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The court keeps Oruam in custody after the defense cited an extremely serious case of tuberculosis.
article.articleSummary: Rio de Janeiro court kept rapper Oruam in preventive detention, denying the defense's bid to revoke custody. Mauro Davi dos Santos Nepomuceno, known as Oruam, faces pulmonary tuberculosis while remaining a fugitive. The defense said he lost about 5 kg in the last month, has a chronic cough, lung lesions, and muscle wasting; one medical report recommended isolation during treatment to prevent transmission. Judge Tula Corrêa de Mello ruled that the grounds for detention remained valid, especially because he is still at large. The defense's medical evidence was deemed insufficient since the documents were not issued by an official state body, and there was no proof the prison system could provide needed treatment. If he surrenders or is apprehended, he would be sent to the prison health system for evaluation and to assess treatment adequacy. Other arguments—witnesses heard; expert report not conclusive about ankle monitor—were rejected.

triage.headline_ja: 裁判所がOruamの収監を維持、弁護側が極めて深刻な結核症例を引き合いに出した後
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は個人の刑事事件における結核の医学的側面についての法廷報道であり、公衆衛生上の感染症イベント（集団発症、流行、新規疾患など）ではない。個別症例の報道であり、感染症危機管理の対象とはならない。
triage.notes: 本記事はブラジルのリオデジャネイロにおけるラッパーOruamの刑事事件の法廷判断に関する報道である。結核は言及されているが、これは個別患者の医学的状態であり、公衆衛生上の感染症イベント（発生状況）の報告ではない。感染症危機管理スキームの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Léčí se jen vyvolení. Americký lékař a tým Bulovky varují Západ před ebolou
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Only the chosen are treated. An American doctor and the Bulovka team warn the West about Ebola.
article.articleSummary: An American doctor, Patrick LaRochelle, who recently spent three weeks in isolation at Prague’s Bulovka hospital, recounts what he calls a futile fight against Ebola at the African epicenter of the outbreak, where entire families and colleagues die. Czech infectious disease specialists who treated him speak alongside him, warning that Western reluctance to fund fight against diseases in Africa will soon affect Europe and the United States. LaRochelle recalls that on May 15, just twenty minutes before he was due to fly from Congo to the United States, he received a message that abruptly halted his plane-bound departure. The account highlights Ebola’s devastation in Africa and the need for international commitment to outbreak response.

triage.headline_ja: 選ばれた者だけが治療される。米国人医師とブロヴァル隊がヨーロッパをエボラから警告している
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスという高危険病原体に関するシグナルで、IHR基準では国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限リスクが明らかにあり、WPROスクリーニング基準ではコンゴでのアウトブレイク継続（長期曝露・流行しやすさ）と国際的支援必要性が該当する。社会的・政治的関心も高く、フルRRAに進む必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴでのエボラアウトブレイク継続を主題としており、プラハはあくまで治療施設の所在地である。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。エボラウイルスはIHR通知義務対象病原体（Annex 1）であり、高い優先度を持つ。

article.articleHeadline: Air France suspend provisoirement ses vols vers Kinshasa après un cas d'Ebola détecté sur un passager - LePotentiel
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Air France temporarily suspends its flights to Kinshasa after an Ebola case was detected in a passenger
article.articleSummary: Air France suspended its Kinshasa–Paris flights after a passenger on a June 23 service tested positive for Ebola. The June 25 rotations in both directions were not operated as a precaution. Reinstatement will depend on strengthened health screenings before boarding at Ndjili International Airport in Kinshasa. Air France is coordinating with Congolese health authorities to implement the necessary procedures. If sanitary conditions are satisfied, operations on the Kinshasa–Paris route could resume as early as this weekend. Turkish Airlines had already paused Kinshasa service since May 6 for economic reasons, with the suspension expected to last until October 24 and not linked to the health situation.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ患者が乗客から検出された後、エア フランスはキンシャサへの便を一時停止
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの国際線での検出と確認により、IHR基準の「異常性」「国際拡大リスク」「渡航制限」を満たす。国際航空便での患者検出は重大な公衆衛生上の関心事項。
triage.notes: 記事ではキンシャサ（DRC内）での患者検出と、パリへの国際線での航空輸送を記述。パリはフランス領土だが、実際のエボラ患者発生地はDRCのキンシャサであり、対象国リストに基づきDRCのみを verified_locations に含める。フランスは患者の到着地であるため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : après un premier cas diagnostiqué en France chez un médecin de retour de RDC, la surveillance s'organise
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: after a first diagnosed case in France in a doctor who had returned from the DRC, surveillance is being organized.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease: France confirms the first diagnosed case in a humanitarian doctor who had returned from a mission in the Democratic Republic of Congo. In a communiqué published June 24, the Ministry of Health identified this imported case and said surveillance is being organized in France to detect and manage potential transmission. The event directly ties France to the ongoing Ebola outbreak that is centered in the DRC. No details were provided on symptoms, clinical course, contacts, or whether additional cases exist. This development triggers heightened alert and public health measures to monitor imported cases, coordinate surveillance, and prevent secondary infections while authorities watch the evolving situation linked to the DRC outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：コンゴ民主共和国から帰国した医師にフランスで初の診断例確認後、監視体制が整備される
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの国際的な輸入症例であり、IHR基準3項目以上該当。重症度が高く、国際的な拡大リスクと渡航制限のリスクが存在する。
triage.notes: フランスはWPRO対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。エボラの輸入症例により、発生源であるDRCがシグナルの対象。フランスの症例は対象国外での二次的な発生であるため、トリアージ上の主要な焦点はDRCでの流行状況の継続と国境を超えた伝播リスクに置かれる。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola v DR Kongo zahtevala več kot 300 življenj
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in DR Congo claimed more than 300 lives.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo. In Kinshasa, on June 26, 2026, authorities reported 1,155 confirmed Ebola cases and 304 deaths, a case fatality rate of 26.3%. About 326 patients are in hospital or in isolation. The figures come from the Ministry of Information via STA. The article provides no details on laboratory confirmation, transmission chains, or recovery counts; the remainder of the information is truncated. The data indicate an ongoing outbreak with a substantial current burden of active infections under care in health facilities. There is no mention of imported or exported cases or specific clinical symptoms in the provided excerpt.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがコンゴ民主共和国で300人以上の命を奪った
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度・流行しやすさ・管理可能性で該当。エボラウイルスによる大規模アウトブレイク（1,155確定例、304死亡、致命率26.3%）は国際的に極めて重大な公衆衛生上の脅威。
triage.notes: 2026年6月26日時点でキンシャサで1,155確定例、304死亡（致命率26.3%）、入院・隔離中326人が報告されている。エボラウイルスは高い伝播性と高い致命率を有し、国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限リスク共に極めて高い。詳細な検査室確認、感染伝播経路、回復者数は記事で不明だが、公式保健省統計であり信頼性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Лекарите започват да разбират по-добре редкия щам Бундибугио ебола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Doctors are starting to understand the rare Bundibugyo Ebola strain better.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo is the largest recorded for this strain. Recoveries have reached 138 by June 26, up from 67 on June 16, as the outbreak continues with dozens of admissions daily. Historically, Bundibugyo is linked to lower mortality than Zaïre and Sudan, but it is too early to determine if this pattern will hold, since hundreds remain hospitalized. A potentially slower disease progression could allow more time for hydration, electrolyte and glucose stabilization, and antiviral treatment, yet may keep patients in the community longer and delay diagnosis when early symptoms mimic malaria or cholera, increasing transmission risk. Laboratory data suggest slower viral replication, but clinical impact remains uncertain without early supportive care. Next week, trials will test Bundibugyo-targeted therapies, including remdesivir and MBP134 monoclonal antibodies. Children under 18 are about 15% of cases but over 25% of deaths, with UNICEF cautions on needing more data.

triage.headline_ja: 医師はバンディブギオ・エボラの希少株についての理解を深め始めています
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目すべて該当。コンゴ民主共和国での大規模バンディブギオエボラ発生であり、国際的な関心も高く、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: バンディブギオエボラの過去最大規模の発生で、6月16日から6月26日の10日間で回復者が67人から138人に倍増。毎日数十人の新規入院報告。児童（18歳以下）は症例の15%だが死亡の25%以上を占める。臨床試験準備中（remdesivir、MBP134単クローン抗体）。マラリアやコレラとの症状類似による診断遅延リスクと二次感染拡大リスクが指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: World News in Brief: Ebola prevention, Yemen child deaths, Colombia elections, Japan climate campaign
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), declared in May, has infected more than 1,000 people and caused nearly 300 deaths. The UN’s Emergency Relief Coordinator announced an $8 million CERF allocation to Burundi and South Sudan to prepare for possible cross-border spread, strengthening surveillance, laboratory capacity, case management, and infection prevention and control. In the DRC, containment measures and disruptions have affected food security, with more than 51,000 people receiving food assistance since the outbreak’s declaration and rising prices due to trade disruption. The WHO and Africa CDC have expanded laboratory capacity, but the UN renewed calls for donors to boost funding to sustain life-saving assistance. The response emphasizes border risk reduction and resilient health systems to manage current transmission and prevent exportation to neighboring countries.

triage.headline_ja: 世界ニュース速報：エボラ予防対策、イエメンの児童死亡、コロンビア選挙、日本の気候キャンペーン
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラ出血熱の国際的に重大なアウトブレイク（1000人以上感染、300人近い死亡、国境を越える拡大リスク）は明確にシグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは DRC 内でのエボラアウトブレイク主題。Burundi と South Sudan への言及は CERF資金配分による国境リスク対策（予防的措置）のコンテキストであり、これらの国での確定的なアウトブレイクではない。対象国リストに DRC のみ含まれるため verified_locations は DRC のみ。UN 資金配分や WHO/Africa CDC の対応強化は国際的関心と支援必要性を示唆。

article.articleHeadline: Khởi động Chiến dịch truyền thông số hướng tới mục tiêu loại trừ bệnh dại tại Việt Nam
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Launch of the digital media campaign aimed at eradicating rabies in Vietnam.
article.articleSummary: On June 26 in Hanoi, Vietnam launched a campaign under the One Health partnership to eradicate rabies, aiming to end human deaths from dog-mediated rabies by 2030. The campaign, led by WHO Vietnam, ILRI, HWA, FAO, and IEHSD with the Department of Disease Prevention (Ministry of Health) and the Department of Animal Husbandry and Veterinary (Ministry of Agriculture and Environment), centers on three activities: (1) a summer safety campaign for children interacting with dogs and cats; (2) in August, education on rabies vaccination for dogs, cats, and people with evidence on vaccine effectiveness; (3) in September, a message to accelerate nationwide rabies elimination. Community briefings, interactive discussions, Q&A, and video presentations will boost participation. Vietnam reports 70–100 rabies deaths per year; 2025 had 77 deaths across 20 provinces and over 1 million PEP treatments; 2026 Q1 saw 13 deaths, mostly in the south. Pet vaccination coverage often remains below 70%.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムにおける狂犬病撲滅を目指したデジタルメディアキャンペーンの開始
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病の継続的な人的影響（年間70～100人の死亡）とOne Health連携による国家戦略的対応が確認できるが、新規発生イベントではなくキャンペーン実施報道のため。情報充実度は高いが、シグナルとしての緊急性は相対的に低い。
triage.notes: 本イベントは新規発症報告ではなく、既存の狂犬病対策キャンペーン開始の報道。ただし、ベトナムの継続的な狂犬病負担（年間70～100人死亡、2025年77人死亡、2026年Q1で13人死亡）と多省での拡散、及びWHO・FAO等の国際機関が関与する公式なOne Health戦略の立ち上げが確認される。動物咬傷後予防（PEP）治療が100万件以上/年と高い受給状況にあることから、管理可能性の判定をYesとした。

article.articleHeadline: 最強聖嬰+疫病+戰禍　UN：全球22國飢荒熱點│TVBS新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Strongest Saint Infant + Epidemics + War: UN: 22 global hunger hotspots | TVBS News Network
article.articleSummary: El Niño–related heat dome forms by June 2026, with WMO/NOAA warning it could be the strongest since 1950 and temperatures exceeding 40°C in parts of Europe. FAO and WFP launch a $202 million disaster-management appeal to preempt hunger across 22 hotspots, including Sudan, South Sudan, Yemen, Palestine, Nigeria, Somalia, Afghanistan, DR Congo, Haiti, Lebanon, Madagascar, Mali, and Myanmar, focusing on drought-tolerant seeds, cash assistance, livestock protection, and flood defenses; a $1 preventive investment could avert over $7 in losses. In the Democratic Republic of Congo, a Ebola outbreak that began mid-May has reached 1,094 confirmed cases and 277 deaths as of June 24, with cross-border spread to Uganda and 19 Ugandan cases reported. Kenya’s plan to build a 50-bed quarantine facility for Americans sparks protests; authorities pause work after court orders, while some U.S. aid activities continue amid tensions over border controls.

triage.headline_ja: 最強聖嬰+疫病+戰禍　UN：全球22國飢荒熱點
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の活発な伝播（DRC 1,094確認例、277死亡）と国境越境拡大（ウガンダへの波及、19例）が確認され、IHR基準3つ（深刻な影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）およびWPRO基準複数（重症度、流行しやすさ、長期曝露）に該当。国際的な関心も高い。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域には多数の国が列挙されているが、記事サマリーに基づくエボラアウトブレイクの実際の発生地はDRCとウガンダ。その他の国々（スーダン、ソマリア、ナイジェリア等）は飢饉リスク評価の対象国として言及されているが、エボラの実際の発生地ではない。ただし対象国リストに含まれるミャンマーは飢饉ホットスポットとして記載されている。本シグナルの主要な懸念はDRCのエボラ流行である。

article.articleHeadline: إيبولا يتمدد.. ظهور حالات في فرنسا وإسرائيل يدق ناقوس الخطر.. غياب اللقاح يهدد العالم.. وتوصيات بتشديد مراقبة الحدود وتتبع المخالطين واتباع ممارسات الدفن الآمن
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola is spreading... cases have emerged in France and Israel, raising alarm bells... the absence of a vaccine threatens the world... and recommendations to tighten border controls, trace contacts, and follow safe burial practices.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease, caused by the Bundibugyo strain, is spreading with France and Israel reporting first imported cases, signaling cross-border transmission. Bundibugyo was first identified in Bundibugyo, Uganda (2007–2008 outbreak: 149 cases, 37 deaths). A Lancet Infectious Diseases study warns that the Uganda-linked outbreak raises regional risk, with about a 70% chance of reaching South Sudan within 12 weeks. As of 22 June 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo has 1,048 lab-confirmed cases and 267 deaths; the virus circulated undetected for roughly six weeks. Transmission occurs from fruit bats or primates to humans, then between people via direct contact with blood or bodily fluids of patients or the deceased. With no licensed vaccine for Bundibugyo, authorities urge immediate preparedness: border controls, contact tracing, and safe burial practices. Projections estimate up to 9,900 cases by end-June 2026, potentially 8,210 by September if unchecked; Rwanda importation risk 8.6%, Burundi 2%; South Sudan at highest risk.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスが拡大...フランスとイスラエルで患者が発生し危機感が高まる...ワクチンの不在が世界を脅かす...国境監視強化と接触者追跡、安全な埋葬慣行の遵守を勧告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPRO基準も5項目全てに該当。Bundibugyo株によるエボラウイルス感染症の多国間での発生報告、高い死亡率、国際的拡大リスク、ワクチン欠如により公衆衛生上の極めて深刻な脅威として評価される。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年6月26日配信の仮想シナリオ記事と思われる。Bluedot APIが複数国（フランス、イスラエル、スーダン、ルワンダ、ブルンジ、ウガンダ）を発生地域として付与しているが、記事サマリーに基づくと、ラボ確認症例とその詳細統計が報告されている実際の発生地はDRCのみである。フランスとイスラエルは「輸入症例」として言及されているが、具体的な確認例や詳細は提示されていない。対象国リスト内ではDRCのみが確実に該当する。ウガンダは2007-2008年の過去の流行地として参考情報として記載されているが、現在の発生地ではない。国境管理強化勧告とワクチン欠如による極めて高い国際拡大リスクが特筆される。

article.articleHeadline: السعودية تعلق السفر وتأشيرات الدخول لمواطنى 3 دول بسبب إيبولا.. تعرف عليهم - اليوم السابع
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Saudi Arabia suspends travel and entry visas for citizens of three countries due to Ebola... Find out who they are - The Seventh Day
article.articleSummary: Saudi Arabia suspended travel and entry visas for arrivals from Uganda, South Sudan, and the Republic of Congo (Brazzaville) to curb Ebola transmission, with all visa issuance and entry from these countries blocked. The measure aligns with ongoing precautions since July 2019 and stricter steps implemented in May 2026 for travelers from outbreak-adjacent regions and entry points. Additional precautions target arrivals from other nations who had resided in DR Congo, Uganda, or South Sudan within the 21 days before arrival, including enhanced screening at points of entry. The Saudi Public Health Authority (Weqaya) states the general health situation is reassuring and under close, continuous monitoring, with no confirmed or suspected Ebola cases in the Kingdom since these measures began. The response involves coordinated surveillance with internal and international partners to protect public health and global health security as of 26 June 2026.

triage.headline_ja: サウジアラビア、エボラのため3カ国の国民の渡航とビザ発行を停止...詳細はこちら - ザ・セブンス・デー
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常な事態、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限）。エボラウイルス病の複数国での流行拡大と国家レベルの渡航制限措置により、シグナルとして認識すべき案件。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはUganda、South Sudan、Saudi Arabiaが含まれていますが、対象国リストに該当するのはDRCのみです。サマリー上、エボラ流行の主要発生地はDRC、ウガンダ、南スーダンとされていますが、対象国リストに基づき、確認済み位置はDRCのみとなります。サウジアラビアの渡航制限措置は対応国（非対象国）の措置であり、信号の重要性は高まります。

article.articleHeadline: OMS anunţă că lansează săptămâna viitoare teste clinice ale unor tratamente împotriva ebola în RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO announces that it will launch clinical trials of some treatments against Ebola in the DRC next week.
article.articleSummary: WHO will launch clinical trials of two potential Ebola treatments in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) next week, as the ongoing outbreak reports 1,048 cases and 277 deaths since it began on May 15. The trials, conducted in partnership with communities to ensure informed involvement and access to any treatment if proven safe and effective, will be led by a consortium including the DRC's National Institute of Biomedical Research, ALIMA, the University of Oxford, and WHO. The current epidemic is caused by the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola, for which there is no vaccine or approved specific treatment. This initiative underscores immediate research efforts amid the outbreak, with a focus on translating findings into accessible options for affected communities in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがコンゴ民主共和国でエボラ熱治療薬の臨床試験を来週開始することを発表
triage.triage_reason: エボラ熱の継続的な流行（1,048例、277死亡）における新規臨床試験開始であり、IHR基準3項目該当（重篤な影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度、流行しやすさ、管理可能性が該当。即座にフルRRAを進める。
triage.notes: 記事は継続中のエボラ熱流行（Bundibugyo株、ワクチンなし）における新規臨床試験開始に焦点。WHOが複数国際パートナー（オックスフォード大学など）と連携した重要な研究イニシアティブ。死亡率の高さと未承認治療という要素があり、高い懸念度。

article.articleHeadline: Africa CDC seeks 1.4 bln USD as Ebola cases surpass 1,130 in DR Congo, Uganda
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyro Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda has reached 1,138 confirmed cases and 293 deaths (case fatality ~25.75%), with 136 recoveries. Uganda reports 20 cases and 2 deaths; Ituri Province in eastern DRC is the epicenter with 1,020 confirmed cases. Symptoms include fever, vomiting, diarrhea, malaise, and in severe cases bleeding. Five weeks after its declaration, Africa CDC warns the crisis could become the largest Ebola outbreak if it lasts two years, noting a rapid case rise. Therapeutics trials are set to start next week. Cross-border cooperation between DRC and Uganda is improving, though contact tracing remains a challenge, averaging eight contacts per case vs rural/urban targets of 20/40; about 8,000 of an expected 40,000 contacts have been identified. Africa CDC seeks 1.4 billion USD to fund a combined humanitarian-health response, noting 910 million USD pledged but only ~13% released.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカCDC、エボラ患者が1,130人を超えるコンゴ民主共和国とウガンダで14億米ドルを要請
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生上の影響、異常で予想外の大規模アウトブレイク、国際的な地域間拡大、国際的な懸念）。WPROスクリーニング基準5項目すべてに該当。確認された1,138症例と高い致死率（25.75%）、急速な症例増加、国際支援要請により、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではウガンダでの症例（20例、2死亡）も言及されているが、対象国リストにウガンダが含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。DRC東部のイトゥリ州が流行の中心地。接触者追跡の課題（期待される40,000人中8,000人しか特定されていない）が指摘されており、管理可能性に懸念あり。

article.articleHeadline: In Old City, BLOs caught between SIR, polio drive | Hyderabad News
article.articleSummary: Old City, Hyderabad BLOs struggle to distribute enumeration forms during Special Intensive Revision (SIR) as forms arrive by 3 pm on day one, risking delays ahead of Muharram and the National Pulse Polio Immunization Drive (June 27–July 1). ASHA workers (many BLOs) will administer polio drops; anganwadi teachers will conduct door-to-door campaigns June 29–July 1 to ensure all children under five receive oral polio drops. BLOs must distribute over 1,300 forms each within seven days; after distribution, they have another week to collect forms, leaving 15 days for revisits and other SIR tasks. Bundles were not serially ordered, complicating distribution. For SIR, BLOs use two identical voter forms; QR codes scanned via a designated app to track distribution. Activists urge prioritizing SIR for a month to avoid deletions amid competing duties and timetable conflicts.

triage.headline_ja: オールドシティで、BLOがSIRとポリオ対策に板挟み｜ハイデラバード ニュース
triage.triage_reason: ポリオワクチン接種キャンペーンの実施上の課題を報道した行政記事。新規患者発生やアウトブレイクではなく、予防接種キャンペーンの運営上の問題を扱っており、感染症危機管理シグナルの基準を満たさない。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはポリオワクチン接種キャンペーン（National Pulse Polio Immunization Drive）の運営上の課題に焦点を当てており、ポリオ患者の報告やアウトブレイク検出ではない。行政的な予防接種プログラムの実施課題として捉えられ、感染症シグナルトリアージの対象外と判断する。Yemenは記事の主題ではなく発生地域フィールドに含まれているが、サマリーに記載されていないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Tanzania's Zanzibar designates schistosomiasis sentinel hospital under China-aided project
article.articleSummary: Zanzibar's Pemba island designated Vitongoji District Hospital as a schistosomiasis sentinel hospital under the second phase of the China-aided technical assistance project for schistosomiasis control, strengthening the island's disease surveillance. The facility will handle case detection, diagnosis, treatment, epidemic monitoring, data reporting, and health education on schistosomiasis, providing a key basis for tracking disease trends and improving case management and evidence-based prevention strategies. Zanzibar's Ministry of Health official Marijani Msafiri said the designation enhances laboratory diagnosis, treatment, and monitoring capacities and supports community health. After the ceremony, the Chinese team donated microscopes, diagnostic reagents, face masks, and medicines to support diagnosis, monitoring, and daily services. Project experts also discussed case management, laboratory testing, and surveillance reporting with hospital staff.

triage.headline_ja: タンザニア・ザンジバルが中国援助プロジェクト下でシストソーマ症見張り病院を指定
triage.triage_reason: 本イベントは既存のシストソーマ症対策プロジェクトの一環として病院機能を強化する行政措置であり、新規の感染症流行や異常事態ではない。見張り病院の指定は疾病監視強化を目的とした制度的ステップであり、公衆衛生上の危機的な影響や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはタンザニア（対象国リストに非含）とChina (1814991)が付与されているが、記事サマリーはザンジバル（タンザニア領）での既存プロジェクトの進捗報告であり、タンザニアは対象国でなく、また新規の感染症イベントではなく行政措置の報告のため、verified_locationsは空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: Niuland DPDB reviews road connectivity, TB and ASF status
article.articleSummary: Niuland DPDB meeting on June 26, 2026, chaired by Deputy Commissioner T L Kiusumong Tikhir, reviewed road connectivity in the Aghunaqa area with eight villages; the Executive Engineer, Roads & Bridges, was instructed to draft a comprehensive plan for presentation at the next DPDB meeting. District TB Officer Dr. Benchilo Ngullie outlined the district’s tuberculosis status and centrally sponsored schemes, noting achievements and ongoing challenges. Kivitoli Sema, Census 2027 Field Trainer, explained enumerator and supervisor roles in the voluntary self-enumeration process, with field enumeration slated to commence July 1. Chief Veterinary Officer Hokato Yeptho reported concerns over African Swine Fever (ASF) in Niuland; samples from both dead and live pigs tested positive for ASF. He described the livestock insurance scheme in partnership with NICL, covering 85% of the premium while owners pay 15%.

triage.headline_ja: ニュランド DPDB が道路接続性、TB および ASF ステータスをレビュー
triage.triage_reason: African Swine Fever と Tuberculosis の両疾患が記載されているが、記事の主体は行政会議の議題レビューであり、具体的な流行規模・重症度・拡大リスクに関する情報が不足している。対象国はインドだが、詳細な疫学情報がないため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はニュランド地区の行政会議（DPDB）のレビュー会議に関するもので、疾患に関する具体的な患者数、死亡例、流行の広がりについての情報がない。ASF についてはブタからの検体陽性が報告されているが、詳細な流行状況は不明。TB についても具体的な新規患者数や死亡数が記載されていない。政府機関による対応は認識されているが、公開情報としては限定的。

locations.name: Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka

article.articleHeadline: В Роспотребнадзоре РТ рассказали, в каких странах можно заразиться мелиоидозом
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rospotrebnadzor RT explained in which countries melioidosis can be contracted.
article.articleSummary: Melioidosis is a tropical infectious disease found in Southeast Asia, Africa, and Central and South America, and is common among Russian travelers to Vietnam, China, Thailand, Indonesia, and Sri Lanka. Russia’s Rospotrebnadzor reports an imported case: a tourist who returned from Thailand, who visited activities including an elephant farm, is hospitalized in serious condition. Doctors note melioidosis is not present in Russia, but preventive measures are essential for travelers to endemic regions. Transmission occurs via skin contact with soil contaminated by bacteria, and the infection can affect multiple organ systems. The article emphasizes vigilance for returning travellers with compatible symptoms and ongoing import risk from these destinations. Published 2026-06-26.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア保健監視庁（Rospotrebnadzor）：メリオイドーシスが感染する国について説明
triage.triage_reason: タイからの輸入症例（重症患者1名が入院）が報告され、複数国での地域流行性が確認されている。IHR基準で「異常/予想外性」と「国際的拡大リスク」が該当し、WPROスクリーニングでも「重症度」「長期曝露」「流行しやすさ」が該当する。社会的関心（政府当局による公式発表）も認められる。
triage.notes: 記事はロシア当局が報告した輸入症例（タイからの帰国観光客）を中心に、東南アジアとアフリカでの地域流行を警告する内容。対象国のうちタイ、中国、ベトナム、インドネシアが記事の主要な流行地として言及されている。メリオイドーシスは重症化リスクが高く、土壌接触経由の感染であり、医療体制が限定的な地域では管理が困難である可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemija ebole v DR Kongo: Več kot 300 smrtnih žrtev
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola epidemic in DR Congo: more than 300 fatalities.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo reports 1,155 confirmed Ebola infections and 304 deaths (case fatality 26.3%), with 326 in hospitals or isolation and 138 recovered. In Ituri province’s Bunia, hospitals are stretched, about 95% of beds occupied; the outbreak, declared May 15, shows no sign of retreat. Next week Bunia will host clinical trials of MBP134 (experimental) and remdesivir. The outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no vaccine or approved treatment. Kinshasa has ordered a 21-day quarantine for travelers from affected areas to other parts of the country or abroad to curb spread and aid contact tracing. It has spread to Uganda with 20 cases and two deaths; France confirms a first imported case, a doctor who returned from DR Congo. WHO says global risk remains low.

triage.headline_ja: DR Congo のエボラ流行：300 人以上の死亡者
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つすべて該当。Ebola は国際的に懸念される感染症であり、既に複数国への拡大（Uganda、France）が確認されており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限の実施が明確である。
triage.notes: Ebola outbreak in DRC with 1,155 confirmed cases and 304 deaths (CFR 26.3%). Already spread to Uganda (20 cases, 2 deaths) and France (1 imported case). Bundibugyo strain with no approved vaccine or treatment. Kinshasa has implemented quarantine measures. WHO states global risk remains low but this is a significant regional emergency. Clinical trials of experimental therapeutics (MBP134, remdesivir) planned in Bunia.

article.articleHeadline: Alertas alimentarias al alza en la UE: de pepinillos con paracetamol a quesos con listeria
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rising food alerts in the EU: from paracetamol-containing pickles to Listeria-contaminated cheeses.
article.articleSummary: EU reports 10,490 food-alert notifications in 2025 through the Alert and Cooperation Network (ACN), up 11% from 2024, with RASFF as the core system. Notable episodes include December 2025 cereulide toxin contamination in infant formulas made with oil imported from China, affecting more than 60 countries and described as one of the most complex episodes in recent years. Slovenian authorities found paracetamol in pickle shipments from India, potentially arising from environmental sources or processing contamination. The report also notes a Listeria outbreak in French cheeses causing two deaths, and a Salmonella outbreak in Sicilian cherry tomatoes with over 400 cases since 2023; heavier metals migration from Chinese enameled cups is cited as well. Overall 2025: more alerts, fewer fraud suspicions; fraud suspicions fell 46% while fruit/vegetables accounted for 18% of alerts. New animal networks reported 594 notifications, and TraceMap was launched early 2026 to improve traceability and recalls.

triage.headline_ja: EUの食品警告増加：パラセタモール入りピクルスからリステリア汚染チーズまで
triage.triage_reason: 本イベントは食品安全性に関する多国間の統計報告であり、単一の急性感染症アウトブレイク（outbreak）ではない。複数の散発的事例の年間集計であり、IHR基準やWPRO基準での「異常」「国際的拡大リスク」に該当しない。対象国（インド、中国）での実際の発生状況の詳細が不明であり、監視優先度は低い。
triage.notes: 記事は主にEU域内の食品安全統計報告であり、感染症アウトブレイクの検知と異なる。中国（セレウリドトキシン汚染）とインド（ピクルルのパラセタモール汚染）での食品汚染事例に言及されているが、これらは食品汚染インシデントであり、病原体による感染症イベントの報告ではない。シグナルトリアージ対象外が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: ارتفاع حصيلة وفيات إيبولا في الكونغو إلى أكثر من 300 شخص
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola death toll in the Democratic Republic of the Congo rises to more than 300.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak update: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues as of June 26, 2026. The government reports 1,155 confirmed Ebola cases and 304 deaths, with 138 recovered and 326 patients still under treatment or in isolation. The death toll has risen to more than 300. In response, authorities have imposed strict travel restrictions on individuals returning from areas affected by the outbreak to curb transmission. The report indicates ongoing transmission and states that the country is intensifying the necessary measures to control the spread of the virus. Health authorities are coordinating containment efforts amid the sustained outbreak, with officials emphasizing the seriousness of the situation and the need for continued public health measures to prevent further deaths.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ死者数が300人を超える
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当。エボラアウトブレイクは継続中で1,155例の確認症例、304人の死亡、進行中の人間-人間感染、国際的な拡大リスク、渡航制限の実施が確認されている。
triage.notes: エボラウイルスは極めて高い致死率を持つ病原体。継続中の大規模アウトブレイク、高い死亡数、進行中の人間-人間感染、政府による渡航制限の実施、公開後の封じ込め対策が進行中。フルリスク評価（RRA）への即座な進行が必須。

article.articleHeadline: France confirms its first Ebola case as DRC outbreak continues to grow
article.articleSummary: 1 Ebola virus disease case confirmed in France, the first in a Western European country, involving a healthcare worker from ALIMA who contracted Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) before returning to France. WHO notes over 100 health workers infected; risk to the rest of the world remains low. The DRC outbreak, identified May 15, is caused by the Bundibugyo variant for which there is no approved treatment or vaccine. As of June 26, 2026, 1,048 confirmed cases and 267 deaths reported in the DRC. The traveller arrived in France at illness onset and was asymptomatic during flight; headaches developed on arrival and he was isolated. Five other passengers on the flight are contact cases under isolation. Transmission occurs via direct contact with bodily fluids; infection generally begins after symptom onset. Preparations are complete for a two-therapeutic trial expected to start in DRC next week.

triage.headline_ja: フランスが西ヨーロッパ初のエボラ症例を確認、DRC感染拡大継続中
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク）。西ヨーロッパへの初の確認症例と100以上の保健労働者感染、1,000件超の確定症例で明らかにシグナル該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づき、実際のエボラ発生地はDRCとフランス両国。ただし対象国リストではDRCのみ含まれる（203312）。フランス（3017382）は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCでの大規模発生（1,048確定症例、267死亡）と西ヨーロッパ初の症例確認、保健労働者への高い感染リスク、治療法・ワクチン未承認のBundibugyo変異株という点で、極めて重大なシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: شمار مبتلایان به ابولا در جمهوری دموکراتیک کنگو به 1155 نفر رسید
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of people infected with Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 1,155.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-26, the Democratic Republic of Congo has confirmed 1,155 Ebola cases and 304 deaths since the outbreak began on May 15, with 138 recoveries and 318 patients under treatment. The case fatality rate is about 26.3% based on cumulative data. A 90-day cross-border program between DRC and Uganda has been launched to strengthen laboratory capacity and treatment facilities, especially in the Aru region. Uganda had previously reported 20 cases and 2 deaths. In Ituri province, 246 suspected cases and 65 deaths have been recorded. The World Health Organization declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17 due to the spread. The current outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which no approved treatment or vaccine exists. Ebola was first identified in 1976 near the Ebola River, with historical outbreaks in Africa.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ感染者数が1,155人に達した
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の4項目すべてに該当し、WHO公衆衛生上の国際的懸念事象（PHEIC）として既に宣言されている。Bundibugyo ebolavirus による重症アウトブレイクで、ヒト-ヒト感染、致死率26.3%、国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダへの越境）が明確。
triage.notes: WHOはすでに2026年5月17日にPHEIC（Public Health Emergency of International Concern）を宣言。ウガンダへの越境感染（20例、2死亡）も確認。Bundibugyo ebolavirus は治療薬・ワクチンが存在しない。DRC-ウガンダ間での90日間の連携プログラム開始。記事の発生地域フィールドには Uganda も含まれているが、サマリーでウガンダの役割は越境支援・連携のみで、主要な発生地はDRCのIturi州であるため、verified_locations はDRCのみとした。

article.articleHeadline: RDC refuerza medidas para hacer frente a epidemia de ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC strengthens measures to tackle the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) strengthens measures to combat the Ebola outbreak. On June 25, under President Félix Tshisekedi, Ebola response group approved tighter security and health measures in affected areas, with deployment of the National Police and health workers to regulate movement and intensify temperature screening, hygiene, and handwashing. A new isolation protocol imposes a 21-day health observation for contacts and travel bans for residents of affected zones. Humanitarian and infrastructure support include directing the Ministry of Social Affairs to coordinate aid in internally displaced person camps and accelerate treatment centers. Ebola outbreak, declared May 15, has reached 1,155 confirmed cases, 304 deaths, 138 recoveries, and 326 hospitalized as of June 24, per the Ministry of Health. The WHO launched a trial on June 24 evaluating MBP134 and Remdesivir against Bundibugyo strain, with no vaccines or licensed therapies, led by INRB, ALIMA, University of Oxford, and WHO.

triage.headline_ja: DRC strengthens measures to tackle the Ebola outbreak.
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外性、国際的拡大リスク）。エボラウイルス病の大規模アウトブレイク（1,155確定例、304死亡）であり、WPROスクリーニング基準の全項目に該当。即フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病のアウトブレイクは常に高優先度。本記事ではDRC大統領下での対応強化、保健省発表の直近統計、WHO臨床試験の開始が記載されており、継続的な監視が必須。2026年5月15日宣言から1ヶ月以上経過した段階での大規模流行であり、国際的支援ニーズが明確。

article.articleHeadline: 践行实战练兵 严防蚊媒疾病
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Carrying Out Real-World Combat Training; Strictly Prevent Mosquito-Borne Diseases.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-06-26, Lushan County Health Bureau and the Center for Disease Control organized a full-chain emergency drill for a dengue fever outbreak, aligning with the 2026 dengue prevention plan and national multi-disease vector-control guidance. The exercise trained all emergency responders in a five-step framework: fast, precise, strict, clean, and public communication. It simulated the entire process—case diagnosis, reporting, escalation, assessment, and rapid team assembly—with the 'four early' targets and seamless linkages. Graded risk zones were applied (core, precaution, and surveillance areas) for targeted contact tracing, serologic sampling, zoned disinfection, and Aedes mosquito density monitoring. It stressed proper PPE donning/doffing, specimen collection and transport, and medical-waste handling, with clearly defined outbreak workflows. Environmental cleanup prioritized eliminating standing water; community health education ran concurrently to inform residents about symptoms and prevention. Deputy Director Zhang Mingyue praised the drill, calling for sustained import-control, routine drills, and integrated vector-control measures.

triage.headline_ja: 実戦訓練を実施し、蚊媒介疾病を厳格に防止
triage.triage_reason: 蚊媒介疾病（デング熱）に関する緊急時対応訓練の報道であり、実際の流行事例ではなく、予防・準備活動の記事。異常性は低いが、デング熱への継続的な警戒の必要性を示唆している。
triage.notes: 本記事はデング熱の実際の流行ではなく、ルーシャン県衛生局とCDCが実施した組織的な緊急時対応訓練の報道である。国家多疾患ベクター管理ガイドラインに沿った準備活動で、デング熱流行のリスク認識と対応能力の向上を示している。現時点では確認されたクラスターや患者データはサマリーに記載されていない。

article.articleHeadline: WOAH publishes new guidelines for African swine fever vaccines
article.articleSummary: WOAH published the Guidelines for African swine fever vaccines: field evaluation and post-vaccination monitoring, offering practical, field-oriented guidance for evidence-based vaccine use against African swine fever (ASF). Developed with The Pirbright Institute and City University of Hong Kong, the guidelines stress high-quality vaccines manufactured to international standards and decisions grounded in reliable local epidemiology. They cover design, implementation and evaluation of field studies, including sample-size calculations, data collection and validated laboratory testing, plus post-vaccination monitoring and pharmacovigilance. A three-step framework supports establishing expected side effects, reporting channels and periodic program review; genomic surveillance (including whole-genome sequencing where feasible) aims to detect reversion or recombination. Vaccination is a tool within integrated ASF control—alongside biosecurity, surveillance and movement controls—tailored to local conditions. The document emphasizes data sharing and transparency; a June 30 webinar will discuss applications.

triage.headline_ja: WOAHがアフリカ豚熱ワクチンの新しいガイドラインを公表
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はWOAHによるASFワクチンガイドラインの公表に関する技術的なお知らせであり、実際の感染症発生イベントではなく、ガイドライン自体が主題である。動物疾病に関する予防的ガイダンスの出版は公衆衛生上の直接的な危機を示さず、IHR基準およびWPROスクリーニング基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は技術ガイドラインの公表に関するニュースであり、実際のASF発生イベントの報告ではない。HK・中国の機関が関与しているため技術的には対象地域に関連するが、シグナル検出（感染症危機の初期探知）という目的に対しては不適切。

article.articleHeadline: Kepala YTR Korban Taufik Hidayat Infeksi Serius, Ada Belatungnya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: YTR Chief, a Victim of Taufik Hidayat, in a Serious Maggot Infestation
article.articleSummary: 29-year-old woman from Rancaekek, Bandung Regency, Indonesia (identified as YTR) was rushed to Bandung's RSHS with extensive head wounds after years of abuse by her partner, Taufik Hidayat. On arrival, the head injury showed a maggot infestation (myiasis) with a heavy bacterial infection. Immediate debridement and cleansing were performed; surgeons noted severe infection and continued management. By June 10, nearly a week after initial cleaning, infection control continued as clinicians worked to reduce the infection. Once the head infection stabilizes, staged facial reconstruction is planned to restore function and appearance. Prior treatment at RSUD Kota Bandung or RSUD Ujungberung occurred before referral, and the case was disclosed following hospital intervention. The report highlights a severe domestic abuse case resulting in life-threatening injuries requiring surgical care and planned reconstructive procedures.

triage.headline_ja: YTR首長（タウフィク・ヒダヤトの被害者）重度感染症、ウジ症を伴う
triage.triage_reason: ウジ症(myiasis)は外傷性続発感染であり、感染症イベント（集団発生）ではなく個別臨床症例。国際的拡大リスク、公衆衛生上の重大影響、流行可能性はいずれも認められない。
triage.notes: 本事例は国内暴力による外傷に続発したウジ症で、感染症イベント（集団感染症の流行）ではなく個別臨床症例。症例の重症度は高いが、感染症危機管理の観点からのシグナルとしては適切でない。メディア報道の関心は高いが公衆衛生上の脅威とは判断されない。

article.articleHeadline: برنامج الأغذية العالمي يدعو إلى تمويل المساعدات الغذائية في الكونغو الديمقراطية لاحتواء تفشي الإيبولا - أردو بوینت
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Food Programme calls for funding for food assistance in the Democratic Republic of the Congo to contain the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: World Food Programme warns that containing the Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo hinges on food security and sustained humanitarian access to affected areas, as a hunger crisis affects millions. The agency notes that without continued aid, transmission control and relief efforts risk being undermined. WFP has appealed for $72 million to fund direct Ebola response activities in the DRC, in addition to $286 million to provide food assistance to those in need. The combined appeal highlights the link between nutrition and outbreak containment in conflict-affected, resource-scarce settings, and calls for sustained humanitarian corridors. The situation, as of June 26, 2026, remains critical for affected populations.

triage.headline_ja: 世界食糧計画がエボラ拡大遏止のためコンゴ民主共和国への食糧支援資金を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準において深刻な公衆衛生への影響が認められ、エボラウイルスは国際的拡大リスクを持つ感染症であり、複数の基準を満たす。また、社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病は国際保健規則(IHR)において最高レベルの懸念対象。東部DRCでの発生は、紛争下での人道的アクセス制限と飢饉危機という複合的課題を抱えており、管理可能性に懸念がある。WFPからの具体的な資金呼びかけ（$72M+$286M）は国際的関心の高さを示唆している。

article.articleHeadline: Expertos internacionales piden a la OMS reconocer la toxoplasmosis como enfermedad tropical desatendida
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: International experts call on the WHO to recognize toxoplasmosis as a neglected tropical disease.
article.articleSummary: Global experts urge the World Health Organization to formally recognize toxoplasmosis as a neglected tropical disease (NTD). Toxoplasma infection affects about one-third of the world’s population and can cause ocular toxoplasmosis, a leading cause of vision loss. The call comes from a Brazil- and Australia-led global study, with researchers from the Americas, Europe, Africa and Asia. Transmission occurs through undercooked meat, contaminated produce or water, and exposure to cat feces; during pregnancy, infection can transmit to the fetus, potentially causing miscarriage or permanent brain and eye damage, with many affected children developing vision problems over time. Recognition as an NTD could unlock funding for research, prevention and treatment, and help integrate toxoplasmosis prevention into maternal–child health, food safety, water/sanitation, and primary care within a One Health framework. A practical action plan emphasizes improved prenatal testing, food and water safety, and coordinated global responses. Published 2026-06-26.

triage.headline_ja: 国際的な専門家がWHOに対し、トキソプラズマ症を顧みられない熱帯病として認識するよう求める
triage.triage_reason: トキソプラズマ症は公衆衛生上の重要性があり、妊娠中の感染による先天性感染のリスクがある。しかし、本記事は新規発生事例の報告ではなく、NTD認定を求める国際専門家からの提言であり、緊急の疾病流行警告ではない。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジルとオーストラリアが主導した国際的研究による提言であるが、具体的な新規流行事例の報告ではない。Bluedotのlocation_typeからオーストラリアはスペイン（カナリア諸島）と共に言及されているが、サマリーに基づくと実際のトキソプラズマ症発生イベントの地理的焦点はブラジルのみが対象国リストに該当。スペインおよびオーストラリアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。アフリカ大陸全体の参照もあるが、具体的な国名がないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: منظمة الصحة العالمية: احتمال بنسبة 70% وصول فيروس إيبولا إلى جنوب السودان
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: 70% chance of the Ebola virus reaching South Sudan.
article.articleSummary: WHO, in a Lancet study, estimates a 70% chance the current Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo could reach South Sudan. The Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain has caused more than 1,000 confirmed cases and over 260 deaths in DRC and has crossed into Uganda, with 20 confirmed infections, two deaths, and one probable death. With no licensed vaccine for Bundibugyo, the study urges immediate preparedness in South Sudan, citing weak public-health infrastructure, gaps in case management, contact tracing, safe-burial practices, and border surveillance. It notes Uganda’s cross-border risk, while Rwanda and Burundi are relatively lower risk. The authors call for strengthened infection prevention, rapid-response capacity, and strict cross-border monitoring. The outbreak began in unsettled, war-affected communities and went undetected until early April 2026, about six weeks before WHO declared a public health emergency.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関：70%の確率でエボラウイルスが南スーダンに到達する
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当。エボラ出血熱の国際的拡大リスク、深刻な公衆衛生への影響、異常性、渡航・貿易制限のリスクが明確である。スクリーニング基準も全て該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは南スーダンへのリスク評価について述べているが、実際の確認患者事例はDRC(1,000以上の確認例、260以上の死亡)とUganda(20確認、2死亡)で報告されている。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。Sudan、Rwanda、Burundi、Ugandaは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。非常に高いリスク事象であり、直ちにフルRRAが必要。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: OMS lansează noi teste clinice pentru tratamente pentru combaterea Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO launches new clinical trials for treatments to combat Ebola.
article.articleSummary: 1,048 confirmed Ebola virus disease cases and 277 deaths in the Democratic Republic of the Congo since the epidemic began on May 15. WHO will launch two experimental treatments in a consortium including the DRC's National Biomedical Research Institute, ALIMA, and University of Oxford; trials begin next week in the DRC. The outbreak is caused by Ebola virus strain Bundibugyo; there is currently no vaccine or specific treatment. Transmission occurs via close contact and bodily fluids, with Ebola causing severe hemorrhagic fever. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus emphasizes community engagement and ensuring access to treatments if proven safe and effective. WHO assesses the public health risk as very high in the DRC, high regionally, and low globally.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、エボラ出血熱との闘いのための治療法に関する新しい臨床試験を開始
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5つ全て該当。DRCでのエボラウイルス病の確認症例1,048件、死亡277件という深刻な状況、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、感染しやすさ、管理可能性が明確。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーにより、DRCでの発生が確認された。Bundibugyo株によるエボラウイルス病で1,048確認例277死亡。WHOが臨床試験を開始し、国際的な関心と支援が高い。UKはソース国であり、発生地ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Surto de tuberculose fecha principal centro de triagem de animais silvestres do Rio - Diário do Rio de Janeiro
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tuberculosis outbreak closes the main wildlife triage center in Rio de Janeiro - Diário do Rio de Janeiro
article.articleSummary: Tuberculosis outbreak at the Centro de Triagem de Animais Silvestres (Cetas) in Seropédica, Baixada Fluminense, Rio de Janeiro, led to a temporary closure to animal entry and exit from May 18, impacting Ibama’s main wildlife rehabilitation and release center in the state. Three capuchin monkeys died; TB was confirmed by Fiocruz and UFRRJ, with suspicion one infected animal arrived. Cetas houses 989 animals, including 51 primates, more than 500 birds, and two jaguars. All enclosures are monitored, and remaining animals will be tested by sampling. Containment includes emergency protocol, restricted zones, limited internal movement, and mandatory PPE (N95 masks); staff have been tested for TB, with no human cases confirmed. This follows a prior restriction in April tied to Ibama–Inea cost and resource issues. In 2025, the center received over 7,400 animals, many from trafficking or abuse, notably birds and jabutis.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル・リオデジャネイロの野生動物トリアージセンターが結核アウトブレイクで閉鎖
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルの野生動物施設における結核アウトブレイク（3頭のカピューシンモンキー死亡、確認済み）だが、ヒト感染なく動物のみに限定された発生。IHR基準の国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限リスクは低く、スクリーニング基準では異常性・重症度が該当するが、情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 野生動物施設での結核発生は獣医学的には重要だが、ヒト→ヒト感染のリスクは限定的。スタッフTB検査で陽性なしとの報告。国際的公衆衛生上の脅威レベルは低いと評価。動物からのヒト感染リスク、他施設への拡大可能性などが明らかになれば PICKUP 判定へ変更の余地あり。

article.articleHeadline: Congo-Kinshasa: Le Président de la République a conduit les travaux de la 3e réunion de la Task Force de lutte contre l'épidémie d'Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo-Kinshasa: The President of the Republic led the proceedings of the 3rd meeting of the Ebola Outbreak Task Force.
article.articleSummary: President Félix-Antoine Tshisekedi Tshilombo chaired the third meeting of the national Ebola Outbreak Task Force at the African Union HQ in Kinshasa. As of today, Congo reports over 1,100 Ebola virus disease cases and 277 deaths, a case fatality rate of about 26%. The outbreak, declared May 15, affects Ituri (epicenter with 91% of cases), Nord-Kivu, and Sud-Kivu, with five health zones: Bunia, Rwampara, Mungwalu, Nyankunde and Nizi—concentrating 85% of Ituri's cases. Measures include reinforced movement controls around the hardest-hit zones by the police and health services, with temperature checks, visual surveillance, and hand hygiene. Anyone who has been in contact with a patient cannot leave the affected zone for 21 days and will be closely monitored; travelers from affected zones must observe 21 days of surveillance before international travel. Authorities aim to accelerate the construction of Ebola treatment centers near displacement sites; Kinshasa reports no cases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：共和国大統領がエボラ流行対策タスクフォース第3回会合を主催
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の確認された集団発生（1,100例以上、死亡277例、致命率26%）であり、IHR基準の深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、および国際的な拡大リスクを満たす。DRCおよびRwandaで検出されており、WPROスクリーニング基準の複数項目に該当。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの地域リストにはRwanda（ID 49518）が含まれているが、記事サマリーではRwandaでの症例報告は明示されていない。確認された発生地域はDRC内のイトゥリ（91%の症例）、北キブ州、南キブ州のみ。大統領による公式タスクフォース会議開催、国際的な旅行制限措置の実施が確認され、政治的な関心と対応の高さを示す。

article.articleHeadline: اختفاء أثر نحو 300 مصاب بـ"إيبولا" في الكونغو يثير مخاوف من تفاقم الأزمة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: No trace of around 300 Ebola patients in Congo raises fears of a worsening crisis.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Ebola outbreak, the Bundibugyo strain, deepens as about 300 patients remain untraceable, hindering contact tracing amid humanitarian and security constraints. African CDC Director Jean Kasia says over a million people live in camps. WHO Africa projects up to 8,210 cases and 1,420 deaths by mid-September 2026, with a 70% chance of reaching South Sudan. Congo reports 1,118 confirmed cases and 291 deaths; Uganda has 20 cases and 2 deaths. France reports an infection in a doctor who worked in Congo, triggering investigations. About 297 patients are not under health follow-up. Travel from affected areas is restricted for 21 days. Ebola treatment centers are 95% full; funding needs are $518 million for health and up to $1.4 billion overall including humanitarian aid, with only 13% funded despite $910 million pledged. Next week, Congo will begin trials of candidate drugs, followed by an antiviral trial for contacts.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ感染者約300人の行方不明、危機悪化の懸念が高まる
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPRO基準も5項目全て該当。エボラ出血熱の大規模多国間流行であり、死亡者を含む深刻な公衆衛生危機。国際的拡大リスク（南スーダンへの70%の拡大確率予測）、渡航制限、フランスでの医師感染確認など複合的にハイリスク。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはUganda、Sudan、Franceも含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題はDRC中心。ウガンダは20例、2死亡と記載され二次的感染国。フランスは医師1名の感染のみ。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当し、verified_locationsに含める。情報の信頼度が高く、WHO公式予測を含むため妥当性高い。

article.articleHeadline: Sanofi Unit Wins European Medicines Agency Panel's Positive Opinion for Extension of Meningococcal Disease Vaccine's Indication
article.articleSummary: On 2026-06-26, a European Medicines Agency panel issued a positive opinion to extend the indication of Sanofi's meningococcal disease vaccine, signaling potential broader protection against meningitis. The decision centers on Sanofi’s meningitis vaccines, part of the company’s vaccines portfolio, within its broader drug-and-vaccine mix. Sanofi is described as Europe’s largest pharmaceutical group, with vaccines accounting for 18.2% of net sales and a global footprint of 37 production sites as of end-2025. Geographic net sales breakdown shows the United States contributing 50.8%, Europe 17.1%, China 6%, France 3.9%, and other regions 22.2%. The article does not provide any outbreak data, case or death counts, specific symptoms, laboratory confirmation details, infection sources, or information regarding imported or exported cases. No country-specific disease events are reported beyond the regulatory development.

triage.headline_ja: サノフィ傘下企業、髄膜菌感染症ワクチン適応拡大について欧州医薬品庁パネルからポジティブオピニオンを獲得
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は医薬品規制当局の承認決定に関するニュースであり、実際の感染症アウトブレイク、患者数、死亡例の報告ではない。疾患発生イベントではなく医療製品の商業・規制ニュースである。
triage.notes: 本記事は髄膜菌感染症ワクチンの規制当局承認拡大について記述しているが、実際の疾患アウトブレイク、患者事例、地域での疾患発生を報告していない。サマリーに明記されている通り『outbreak data, case or death counts, specific symptoms, laboratory confirmation details, infection sources, or information regarding imported or exported cases. No country-specific disease events are reported beyond the regulatory development』。中国は発生地域リストに含まれているが、記事本体では中国における感染症イベントの記述がないため、verified_locationsには含めるが、本件は疾患監視シグナルトリアージの対象外である。

article.articleHeadline: صحة البيئة تكثف حملات الرش الضبابي والرذاذي لمكافحة الامراض والاوبئة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Environmental Health intensifies fogging and spraying campaigns to combat diseases and epidemics.
article.articleSummary: On the early hours of 26 June 2026, environmental health authorities in Aden’s Seera District intensified fogging and mist-spraying campaigns to combat disease-carrying mosquitoes, focusing on dengue fever and malaria. The operation targeted multiple sites within Seera, including the Commercial Area, King Suleiman Street, Hassan Ali Street, Al-Sabil Street, Museum Street, Sheikh Abdullah Street, the Central Market area, the flood channel beneath the Central Market, and central shrines behind the Market. Dr. Mahmoud Najeeb Bin Jaradi, Director General of Seera District, directed the effort, with Muhammed Mubarak, head of the Environmental Health Department, confirming that spraying will continue under the approved field plan to bolster public health and reduce vector breeding. Citizens are urged to cooperate with spraying teams to help ensure optimal results.

triage.headline_ja: 環境保健局がデング熱とマラリア対策に向けて燻蒸・散布キャンペーンを強化
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアとイエメンでマラリアとデング熱の対策キャンペーンが実施されているが、記事サマリーは主に予防的対応（蚊の駆除キャンペーン）についてのみ記述しており、現在の感染症流行の規模・重症度・死亡数などの詳細情報が不足している。IHR基準の判定に必要な具体的データが欠けているため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 発生地域にインドネシア（Provinsi Maluku）とイエメン（Aden）が列挙されているが、記事サマリーはアデン市での蚊駆除キャンペーンを主に詳述している。インドネシアについては記事本文がないため、実際の流行状況が不明。イエメンは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。WPRO基準では「長期曝露」（蚊媒介感染症による継続的リスク）と「流行しやすさ」（デング熱・マラリアの伝播リスク）は該当するが、具体的な患者数・死亡数・流行の規模などの情報がないため総合判定はWATCHとした。

article.articleHeadline: Bella Hadid Ungkap Beratnya Dampak Fisik dan Mental Akibat Penyakit Lyme
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bella Hadid Reveals the Heavy Physical and Mental Toll of Lyme Disease
article.articleSummary: Lyme disease patient Bella Hadid, 29, outlines the severe mental toll of chronic Lyme in Instagram Stories on June 25, 2026, as reported by People (June 26) and summarized by Liputan6.com in Jakarta. Hadid describes relapsing symptoms—pain, fatigue, exhaustion, anxiety, concentration difficulties, infections, and trauma—that drive isolating, depressive states if the condition persists. Despite extensive self-education and attempts to find a treatment protocol, she notes flare-ups return, disrupting routines and decision-making amid daily, unpredictable health. She wakes with preexisting anxiety and physical pain before getting out of bed, requiring ongoing strength to face each day. The account underscores the ongoing, personal struggle of living with chronic Lyme disease and its substantial mental health impact, particularly for a high-profile patient.

triage.headline_ja: ベラ・ハディッド、ライム病による身体的・精神的負担の深刻さを明かす
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は著名人の個人的な疾患経験についての報道であり、公衆衛生上の異常な疾患集団発生や国際的拡大リスクを示すシグナルではない。ライム病は既知の確立した疾患であり、新規の感染症クラスターや流行を示唆していない。
triage.notes: 本記事はインドネシアで配信されたメディアにより、米国在住の著名人ベラ・ハディッドの個人的なライム病患者としての経験を報道したものである。ライム病は北米や欧州の既知風土病であり、インドネシアでの発生を報告するものではない。感染症監視対象イベントとしてのシグナル価値は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: US to provide new experimental Ebola drug
article.articleSummary: US will provide MBP134, an experimental Ebola drug cocktail from Mapp Biopharmaceutical in California, to DR Congo for a regional clinical trial. Washington had initially said the drug would be used only for Americans, but the trial could help with eventual US regulatory approval. The WHO said Remdesivir trials for Ebola patients would begin next week. There remains no known treatment or vaccine for the Bundibugyo Ebola strain. Scientists are racing to develop four vaccines, two of which could be ready for clinical trials in two months, according to a head of a global vaccine coalition. Disagreements over pathogen sharing have slowed lab testing to produce new treatments and vaccines.

triage.headline_ja: 米国が新しい実験的エボラ治療薬を提供
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（極めて高危険性）の治療薬開発・臨床試験開始に関するニュースであり、DRCでの地域臨床試験実施予定が確認される。ただし、現在のところ実際の患者発生や流行拡大の報告ではなく、医療介入・ワクチン開発段階の進捗報告であるため、スクリーニング基準の該当は限定的。続報での患者発生確認や試験進捗を注視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRCでの臨床試験実施予定に関する医療介入ニュースであり、Californiaはワクチン製造企業の所在地のため除外。現在のところエボラの患者発生または流行の報告ではなく、予防・治療開発段階。Bundibugyo株への対策不足が示唆されている点は注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Como nutrir o corpo para enfrentar o inverno mais rigoroso e o avanço de vírus respiratórios | Cliquef5 - Noticias de Primavera do Leste e Campo Verde
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: How to Nourish the Body to Endure the Harshest Winter and the Spread of Respiratory Viruses | Cliquef5 - News from Primavera do Leste and Campo Verde
article.articleSummary: Brazil faces an early winter surge of influenza, respiratory syncytial virus (RSV), and COVID-19, with over 70,000 Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SRAG) notifications before the season, according to the Ministry of Health and Fiocruz. Cold, dry weather and indoor crowding foster respiratory virus spread. Nutrition is highlighted as a key immunity pillar, with no supplement able to replace real foods. Seasonal produce rich in vitamin C (orange, tangerine, kiwi, acerola, guava) and vitamin A (orange vegetables and dark greens like carrot, pumpkin, spinach, kale) bolster defenses. High-quality proteins (lean meats, eggs, milk) and legumes (beans, lentils, chickpeas) are essential for immune cell formation. Gut immunity is central: most immune cells reside in the intestine; fiber from whole grains, seeds, fruits, and vegetables nourishes beneficial microbiota, reducing inflammation and improving nutrient absorption. Practical tips include balanced meals, updated vaccination, regular exercise, adequate sleep, and well-ventilated spaces.

triage.headline_ja: 最も厳しい冬に耐え、呼吸器ウイルスの蔓延に対抗するために体に栄養を与える方法｜Cliquef5 - プリマベーラ・ド・レステとカンポ・ヴェルデからのニュース
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでインフルエンザ、RSV、COVID-19による呼吸器感染症が早期に増加し、70,000件以上のSRAG報告があるという公衆衛生的な懸念が示されているが、記事は主に栄養・予防啓発記事であり、動向報告ではなく、詳細な流行状況や管理可能性に関する情報が不足しているため。
triage.notes: 記事は栄養・予防啓発記事であるため、実際の流行データ（70,000件以上のSRAG報告）はブラジル保健省およびFiocruzからの発表とされているが、記事本文は公開されておらず詳細不明。冬季の季節性呼吸器感染症の増加という予測可能な現象である可能性があるが、「早期」「厳しい」という表現から通常より深刻な状況が示唆される。フルRRAのための詳細な流行データ確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Primele teste pentru tratamente împotriva Ebola. OMS începe studiile clinice în Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The first tests for Ebola treatments. WHO begins clinical trials in Congo.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization launches clinical trials for two experimental Ebola treatments in the Democratic Republic of Congo, amid an outbreak driven by the Bundibugyo strain. Trials will begin the following week in the DRC, where 1,048 cases and 277 deaths have been reported since the outbreak’s May 15, 2026 declaration. A consortium of INRB (National Institute for Biomedical Research, DRC), ALIMA, the University of Oxford, and WHO will conduct the studies, with local communities informed and involved and guaranteed access to therapies if proven safe and effective. There is no approved vaccine or specific treatment for the Bundibugyo strain yet. If results are favorable, the therapies could become a crucial tool to curb the outbreak in the region.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ治療薬の第一段階試験開始。WHOがコンゴで臨床試験を開始
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。ブンディブギョ株による活発なエボラ流行（1,048症例、277死亡）が進行中であり、WHO主導の臨床試験開始という重大な公衆衛生対応が報告されている。国際的な支援体制と高い関心が示されており、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ株によるエボラ流行は2026年5月15日に宣言され、現在1,048症例277死亡が報告されている。INRB、ALIMA、オックスフォード大学、WHOによる国際的コンソーシアムによる臨床試験開始は、この地域の流行制御のための重要な対応である。新規治療法の臨床試験開始は、国際公衆衛生上の重大な進展を示している。

article.articleHeadline: Jharkhand malaria cases surge to 12,342 as five districts see spike
article.articleSummary: Malaria in Jharkhand totals 12,342 cases from January–May 2026, with May alone contributing 4,308; Jan–Apr accounted for 8,034. The surge is led by five districts: West Singhbhum (4,891 by May, up from 3,590 in April), East Singhbhum (4,822 by May, 2,820 in April), Godda (874 in May vs 553 April), Khunti (612 in May vs 355 April), and Seraikela-Kharsawan (514 by May vs 331 April). Historically high-burden districts include Khunti, Godda, West Singhbhum, East Singhbhum, Pakur and Sahibganj. Other districts report single cases Jan–May, such as Chatra, Deoghar, Bokaro, Gumla, Jamtara, Koderma and Lohardaga. Ranchi has 30 cases by May (vs 21 in April). Authorities attribute the rise to enhanced surveillance and monitoring, with mass fever surveys, sahiyas, ANMs, and district vector-borne officers, plus intensified larviciding and distribution of long-lasting insecticide-treated nets. NCVBDC has tasked NGO Child in Need India to monitor malaria in Khunti, Godda, Pakur and West Singhbhum, employing volunteers where sahiyas are absent.

triage.headline_ja: ジャールカンド州でマラリア患者が12,342人に急増、5地区で感染者急増
triage.triage_reason: インドのジャールカンド州でマラリア患者が季節的に増加しているが、国内の既知の流行地域での予想される疾病負荷増加と考えられる。疾病の重症度や国際的な拡大リスク、社会的・政治的関心の程度が明確でないため、情報収集段階での継続監視が適切。
triage.notes: ジャールカンド州は既知のマラリア高流行地域であり、5月の患者数増加は雨季に伴う季節的パターンと一致している可能性が高い。当局は監視強化と蚊対策を実施している。死亡率や重症度についての情報が記事には記載されていない。国内公衆衛生上の関心は高いが、国際的なリスクは低い。

article.articleHeadline: സംസ്ഥാനത്ത് തുടച്ചു നീക്കിയെന്ന് അവകാശപ്പെട്ട മലേറിയ പടര്‍ന്നുപിടിക്കുന്നു; ഒരൊറ്റ ദിവസം 17 പേര്‍ക്ക് രോഗം; ഈ മാസം ഇതുവരെ 91 പേര്‍ക്ക്; രക്തപരിശോധനയില്‍ രോഗം ഉറപ്പാക്കേണ്ട ജില്ലാ ലാബ് ഓഫീസര്‍മാരുടെ... | Malaria, once claimed to be completely eradicated, breaks out again in the state
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Malaria, once claimed to be eradicated, spreads again in the state; 17 people infected in a single day; 91 people so far this month; district lab officers to confirm the disease by blood tests.
article.articleSummary: Malaria, once declared eradicated, is resurging in Kerala. Yesterday 17 new cases were confirmed, with 91 cases this month and 401 this year, including 2 deaths. Diagnosis relies on district lab confirmations of blood-smear tests, but 14 districts lack district lab officers, including Thiruvananthapuram. In total, 21 Junior Scientific Officer posts and 45 Senior Lab Technician posts are vacant, leaving primary health centers that screen up to 400 people monthly and district labs understaffed. Funds since February have not been released, hindering sanitation, waste clearance, and chlorination, while mosquitos and contaminated water sources proliferate during the monsoon. The WHO’s new Director of Health Services is expected to drive changes. Public call for urgent intervention by Health Minister K. Muraleedharan to fill vacancies and restore testing and outbreak control.

triage.headline_ja: かつて根絶されたと主張されたマラリアが州で再び蔓延；1日で17人が感染；今月これまでで91人；保健当局が血液検査で疾病確認へ
triage.triage_reason: インドのケララ州でマラリアの再出現が確認され、IHR基準「深刻な公衆衛生への影響」および「異常・予想外の事象」に該当。既知感染症の再燃であるが、官僚的な対応不足（検査官職員の大量欠員、予算未執行）と蚊媒介環境（モンスーン期の不適切な衛生管理）が重複しており、スクリーニング基準の複数項目（異常性、管理可能性の課題）に合致し、州保健大臣への緊急対応要請がある社会的・政治的関心の高さから。
triage.notes: 記事はケララ州（特にティルヴァナンタプラム地区）でのマラリア再出現を扱っており、インドの対象国リストに該当。年間401例（死亡2例）、今月91例、昨日17例の新規確認例があり、検査体制の人員不足（21職と45職が欠員）と予算遅延による衛生管理の崩壊が背景にある。モンスーン期の媒介蚊増加と不潔な水源が継続的曝露のリスク要因。官僚対応の遅さが蔓延を助長する点で「管理可能性」に課題がある。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola kabusu büyüyor: Ölü sayısı 300'ü aştı
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Nightmare Grows: Death Toll Surpasses 300.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo intensifies, beginning May 15; as of 26 June 2026, 1,155 laboratory-confirmed cases and 304 deaths have been recorded. Health authorities report 138 patients have recovered and been discharged, while 318 are still undergoing intensive medical care in hospitals and quarantine centers. The virus’s high transmissibility and deadly outcomes continue to strain health systems and draw warnings from international health organizations. The update underscores the ongoing transmission since May. No further details are provided on infection source or on imported/exported cases, nor explicit laboratory confirmation procedures beyond the confirmed-case tally. The situation signals a severe, ongoing Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, necessitating continued surveillance and reinforced public health measures.

triage.headline_ja: エボラの悪夢が拡大：死亡者数が300人を超える
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラウイルスの確認された大規模アウトブレイク（1,155確認症例、304死亡）であり、深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスクの全てが明らかに該当する。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: エボラウイルスの大規模アウトブレイク。5月15日以来1,155件の確認症例、304死亡が記録されている。高い感染性と致命率により保健システムが著しく負荷を受けている。継続的な国際的監視と支援が必要な状況。

article.articleHeadline: Africa CDC commends China's timely solidarity, strong partnership in fight against Ebola
article.articleSummary: Africa CDC commends China’s timely solidarity and 2 million USD in emergency support for Africa’s Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak response, formalized via a handover certificate after a Addis Ababa meeting between Africa CDC Director General Jean Kaseya and China’s Jiang Feng. The collaboration, described as strong and ongoing, spans public health infrastructure, capacity building, emergency preparedness, and technical exchange. The AU agency urges intensified international solidarity as the outbreak widens in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Kinshasa) and Uganda, with mounting confirmed cases and deaths. A five-member Chinese expert team arrived in Kinshasa on June 2 for a three-month mission to bolster the fight against Ebola. The development highlights sustained China-Africa cooperation in public health and outbreak response.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカCDCが、エボラウイルス対策における中国のタイムリーな連帯と強いパートナーシップを称賛
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの確認された流行がDRC（キンシャサ）とウガンダで拡大中であり、確認症例と死亡数が増加している。IHR基準で「深刻な公衆衛生影響」「異常/予想外」「国際拡大リスク」に該当し、国際的な専門家派遣と財政支援が発動されているため、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はエボラウイルス（Bundibugyo型）のDRCキンシャサおよびウガンダでの流行拡大を報じている。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には DRC のみを列挙。中国からの専門家派遣（5名、3か月ミッション）と200万USD の緊急支援が実行されており、国際的エスカレーションの兆候あり。

article.articleHeadline: Ituri : réouverture d'un centre médical après sa décontamination contre Ebola à Bunia - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ituri: Reopening of a medical center after its decontamination from Ebola in Bunia - ACP
article.articleSummary: Reopening of the Evangelical Medical Center (CME) in Bunia, capital of Ituri province in northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, after decontamination tied to Ebola virus disease. In response to the Ebola context, the center operated a minimal service from June 2–7, 2026 to disinfect buildings and care equipment, strengthening biosafety. Management thanks the community for understanding during this containment phase. Activities resume as health authorities and partners maintain surveillance, prevention, and response measures to contain Ebola transmission in Ituri. The report emphasizes ongoing containment work rather than detailing case counts.

triage.headline_ja: イトゥリ：ブニアのエボラウイルス病の除染後、医療センターの再開
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病はIHR Annex2の全4基準（重篤な公衆衛生影響、予想外性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）に該当する高リスク感染症であり、コンゴ民主共和国での継続的な流行状況を示唆している。社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事は医療センターの再開という一見ポジティブなイベントを報道しているが、エボラウイルス病の活動が継続していることが明確に示されている。Ituri州での継続的なサーベイランスと対応措置が言及されており、流行が進行中であることを示唆している。DRCが対象国リストに含まれているため、フルRRA実施に値する。

article.articleHeadline: Как не заразиться смертельным мелиоидозом: советы врача
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: How not to contract fatal melioidosis: doctor's advice
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-26, a Russian woman who returned from Thailand was hospitalized with suspected melioidosis. Dr. Nadezhda Chernyshova notes melioidosis can remain latent or cause minimal symptoms, especially in people with diabetes, alcoholism, HIV, other immunodeficiencies, or kidney disease. It is not transmitted person-to-person and is typically linked to soil exposure in tropical climates. Diagnosis may be challenging, so travel history should be communicated to clinicians. Treatment requires hospitalization and a prolonged antibiotic regimen, beginning with injections and continuing with extended oral therapy for several months. Academician Gennady Onishchenko stated the case does not pose an epidemiological threat to Russia. The report underscores the importance of travel history and long, hospital-based treatment for melioidosis management.

triage.headline_ja: 致命的なメリオイドーシスに感染しないために：医師のアドバイス
triage.triage_reason: タイでの感染が疑われるメリオイドーシス輸入症例であり、WPROスクリーニング基準（異常性・重症度）に該当する可能性があるが、ロシア当局が「疫学的脅威なし」と判断しており、情報が限定的なため経過観察段階に留める。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはロシアとタイが含まれるが、記事サマリーの主題は『タイから帰国したロシア人女性のメリオイドーシス疑い症例』であり、実際の感染発生地はタイ。ロシア当局は疫学的脅威がないと明言しており、単一症例の輸入事例と判断される。メリオイドーシスは土壌由来でヒト-ヒト感染なし、治療対応確立されていることから、IHR基準は2項目該当するがWPRO基準での流行拡大性・管理可能性の懸念は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Health officials issue urgent funding warning over Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: To contain the Bundibugyo-ebola outbreak in the DR Congo and Uganda, Africa requires about $1.4 billion, three times the earlier $518 million estimate, per Africa CDC Director-General Jean Kaseya. The revised need covers surveillance, laboratory capacity, emergency stockpiles, and rapid-response teams. The outbreak has claimed more than 300 lives; DR Congo reports 1,155 confirmed cases and 304 deaths, while Uganda has 19 confirmed cases, 2 deaths, and 1 probable fatal case (as of June 18). The Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccines or specific treatments. About $910 million has been pledged, but only 13% disbursed. The risk of wider international spread remains low after France reported a case involving a doctor returning from DR Congo. Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu are affected with severe humanitarian strain and displacement; contact tracing is hampered. China provided $2 million in emergency support.

triage.headline_ja: 保健当局がエボラ流行に関する緊急資金警告を発令
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的拡大リスク、複数国での確認事例がある。Bundibugyo株による350例以上の死亡と急速な拡大がWPRO基準でも重症度および流行易易性において顕著。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC（南キブ州、イトゥリ州）でのBundibugyo株エボラ流行が主題。ウガンダも流行地域として言及されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。フランスの1事例は輸入症例であり、発生地はDRCである。現在350例超の死亡が報告され、深刻な人道支援危機と感染対策の困難が指摘されている。IHR基準・WPROスクリーニング基準ともに高リスク評価。

article.articleHeadline: Sarampo: Saúde pede reforço de vacinação de crianças em SP e Guarulhos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles: Health Department Seeks Booster Shots for Children in São Paulo and Guarulhos
article.articleSummary: On 2026-06-26, Brazil's Ministry of Health recommended a measles zero-dose for children 6–11 months 29 days to boost protection in São Paulo and Guarulhos, SP. Three measles cases in children under 2 in São Paulo's north zone prompted the measure; two attend the same daycare. Lab confirmation was provided by Instituto Adolfo Lutz and Fiocruz. About 100,000 doses will be distributed to the two cities. The cases are possibly linked to importation and do not affect Brazil's measles-free status. The zero-dose offers extra protection during outbreaks or travel, not a substitute for the routine schedule (two doses at 12 and 15 months). For travelers, the zero-dose is advised for 6–11 months 29 days. Routine vaccination remains unchanged. Surveillance includes active case finding, contact tracing, and targeted vaccination in risk areas. Measles activity is rising in FIFA World Cup 2026 host countries United States, Canada, and Mexico.

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹：サンパウロとグアルーリョスで子どもへのワクチン強化接種を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルで麻疹症例が確認され、公式な予防接種強化措置が実施されている。国際的な関心も高く（2026年FIFAワールドカップ開催国での流行上昇の背景），公衆衛生対応が開始されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから，ブラジル（特にサンパウロとグアルーリョス）で麻疹症例3件が確認されたことが明確。米国，カナダ，メキシコは同時流行背景として言及されているが，記事の主題はブラジルの事象。対象国リストではブラジル（ID: 3469034）のみ該当。麻疹は高い感染性を持つため，感受性人口への暴露リスクが継続している。

article.articleHeadline: As Ebola Spreads In Eastern DRC, WFP Warns Food Assistance Is Vital To Containing The Outbreak
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak continues in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, affecting Ituri, northern North Kivu and South Kivu across 34 health zones. IPC indicates 30 zones in crisis (IPC3+), seven in emergency (IPC4). More than 10 million people in eastern DRC are food insecure. WFP is scaling up food assistance, nutrition support, logistics and telecommunications for the response, reaching over 1.2 million people; since 28 May, more than 36,000 hot meals have helped 1,600 patients, caregivers and contacts across 14 treatment and isolation centres. Take‑home rations reach 2,600+ people in North Kivu and Ituri; monthly aid to 14,000 in 10 quarantined villages in South Kivu. WFP provides the logistics backbone: UNHAS completed 268 flights, moved 1,750 responders and 36 metric tons of cargo; dedicated helicopter to Mongbwalu and Nyakunde; C‑130 from Uganda delivering 150+ metric tons. Three Epishuttle isolation units are in Bunia. Expanded access to Butembo, Bambu, Kilo, Nizi, Tchomia, Kasenyi.
