Funding needs: USD 72 million for six months for Ebola response; USD 286 million across DRC to sustain food assistance. Insecurity and lean season threaten access and containment.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがDRC東部で拡大、WFPが食糧支援が発生流行を抑制するために重要であると警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つすべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常イベント、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）、WPRO基準でも5つすべてに該当し、社会的・政治的関心も高い。エボラは高優先度シグナル。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域にイタリア（Veneto州）が含まれているが、記事サマリーではDRC東部（Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu）での流行に焦点が当てられており、イタリアでの患者や感染は言及されていない。したがってverified_locationsからは除外した。ウガンダも発生地域に含まれるが、記事では主にDRCでの流行対応におけるウガンダからの支援（C-130輸送など）が述べられており、ウガンダでの実際の発生は確認されない。複数地域（34の健康地帯、1,000万人以上の食糧不安人口）での蔓延、治療センターでの患者数、複数省への拡大が確認されている。

article.articleHeadline: اختفاء 300 مصاب بـ"إيبولا" يثير المخاوف في الكونغو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The disappearance of 300 Ebola patients raises fears in Congo.
article.articleSummary: Health authorities warn of an escalating Ebola risk in the Democratic Republic of the Congo after about 300 people confirmed with the virus could no longer be traced, amid humanitarian and security conditions that hamper response efforts. Ján Kasia, Director-General of the Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention, said the humanitarian crisis, which has displaced over a million people into camps difficult for medical teams to access, limits contact tracing and raises transmission risk. The disruptions to surveillance and care threaten containment and could allow further spread within the country. Western media outlets cited the situation as creating a data gap that complicates outbreak management. The article underscores the urgent need to reach affected populations to resume tracing, isolation, and treatment activities to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ患者300人の行方不明、懸念の声
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準において深刻な公衆衛生影響（confirmed cases）、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限の可能性が明確であり、4基準すべてに該当。また接触追跡の喪失により管理可能性が著しく低下している。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病の確定患者300人が追跡不可となった状況は、公衆衛生上の重大な危機を示唆している。人道的危機（100万人以上が難民キャンプに流離）と治安悪化によって監視体制と接触追跡が機能不全に陥り、ウイルス伝播リスクが急速に高まっている。Africa CDCの警告により国際的な関心も高く、支援国の協力が急務である。

article.articleHeadline: 伊波拉疫情失控蔓延！川普急向美國國會爭取450億防疫 - 民視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak spiraling out of control! Trump urgently appeals to Congress for $45 billion in epidemic-prevention funding.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has reached 1,155 confirmed cases and 304 deaths, with Uganda reporting cases and France confirming its first imported case from the Congo. In response, the DRC government ordered a 21-day mandatory quarantine for all contacts from the outbreak zone and tightened border controls to prevent outward spread. The World Health Organization warns the epidemic is spreading rapidly and frontline health workers face mounting risks. U.S. President Trump has formally asked Congress for more than $1.4 billion in epidemic-prevention funding to combat Ebola, including $800 million for humanitarian relief; Africa CDC says Africa-wide funding needs have surged to about $1.4 billion, triple prior estimates. UNICEF and Gavi are calling on vaccine developers to accelerate creation of a vaccine against Bundibugyo Ebola. As of 2026-06-26.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行が制御不能に拡大！トランプ大統領が米国議会に450億ドルの防疫予算を緊急要請
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo型）がDRCで1,155確定症例・304死亡に達し、ウガンダ・フランスへの国際的拡大が確認されている。IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の急速拡大、国際拡大実績、渡航制限リスク）し、複数国への越境感染が既に発生しているためフルRRA進行が必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの主題はDRCでの当該流行。ウガンダとフランスへの拡大も記述されているが、これらは対象国リスト（GeoNames ID指定）に含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。配信日時が2026年となっているが、これは設定エラーと判断し評価は変更しない。WHOの警告と複数国の政府対応から国際的関心が極めて高い。DRCは対象国(203312)に該当するため本シグナルはピックアップ対象。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC dépasse les 300 morts et un cas vient d'être détecté en France
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC surpasses 300 deaths, and a case has just been detected in France.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), declared May 15, has reached 304 deaths and 1,115 cases as of 2026-06-26, a case fatality rate of 26.3%. The epicenter is Ituri province in the northeast, near the borders with South Sudan and Uganda, which reports 20 cases and 2 deaths on its soil. A transmission case was detected in France—a Congolese national, a humanitarian worker for NGO Alima, treated in a Paris hospital. French authorities and WHO say Europe’s risk is low and no travel restrictions are needed. In Ituri, healthcare teams struggle with limited resources; 78 health workers have been infected and 18 have died. Community mistrust and reluctance to permit post-mortem sampling contribute to undercounting. Incidents in hospitals have occurred as locals demand bodies. Experts warn the peak may be ahead, with the outbreak potentially lasting six months to a year.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱のRDCでの死亡者が300人を超え、フランスで症例が検出される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラ出血熱の国際的拡大（フランスでの症例）、高い致死率（26.3%）、国境を越えた複数国での発生、深刻な公衆衛生影響が確認される。
triage.notes: フランス（Paris）での症例報告が含まれるが、対象国リストに非該当のため verified_locations には含めない。DRCが主要発生地で、Ituri州が震源地。ウガンダ（対象国外）での20症例・2死亡も記事で言及されている。サマリーより実際の流行はDRCが中心であり、フランスはあくまで輸入症例。医療従事者への感染（78人感染、18人死亡）と社会的懸念（遺体処理での事件、検査拒否など）が管理を複雑化させている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : l'épidémie explose avec 1 155 cas, menace pour le Sahel ? - Mali Actu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: the outbreak has exploded to 1,155 cases, a threat to the Sahel?
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has surged to 1,155 confirmed cases and 304 deaths (case fatality ~26.3%), centered in Ituri. Authorities have implemented a 21-day isolation for suspected cases; the National Institute of Biomedical Research (INSP) has 34 teams deployed, with 365 patients hospitalized and as many in treatment. Cross-border movements to Uganda and the Central African Republic heighten regional transmission risks. Although the DRC is not a member of the Sahel Alliance, experts warn of potential spillover to Mali, Burkina Faso, and Niger, challenging already strained health systems. Africa CDC says the situation is serious but not out of control. With only about 30% of Africans having access to basic health care, international aid and regional cooperation are being called into question, as MSF notes dual threats from the virus and misinformation. The outbreak raises continental questions about health sovereignty and reliance on aid.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ：感染者1,155人に増加、サヘル地域への脅威か？
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の急速な増加、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限のリスク）。エボラ出血熱は対応優先度が極めて高い。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病は最高優先度の懸念疾患。1,155確定患者、304死亡（致命率26.3%）、Ituri州に集中。ウガンダ・中央アフリカ共和国への越境移動による地域感染リスク高。対象国はDRCのみだが、記事ではマリ・ブルキナファソ・ニジェールへの波及の可能性が論じられている。国際支援と地域協力の必要性が強調されている。

article.articleHeadline: Defesa alega que Oruam está com tuberculose e saúde debilitada, mas Justiça mantém prisão preventiva - CIC7 Notícias
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Defense claims that Oruam has tuberculosis and weakened health, but the court maintains pretrial detention - CIC7 News.
article.articleSummary: Rio de Janeiro, Brazil: A Rio de Janeiro court (3rd Criminal Court of the Capital) maintained the preventive detention of rapper Oruam, rejecting defense request to revoke the measure. Judge Tula Corrêa de Mello stated documentation of pulmonary tuberculosis, weight loss, and lung lesions presented by the defense were insufficient to justify release. Oruam has been a fugitive for nearly five months and faces two warrants: one for attempted homicide against civilian police during an operation, and another for money laundering linked to the Red Command (Comando Vermelho). The judge affirmed that fugitive status and existing indications justify detention to ensure enforcement of penal law; alternatives deemed insufficient. If he surrenders or is arrested, he would undergo medical evaluation within the prison system. No statement yet from the defense.

triage.headline_ja: 防衛側がオルアムが結核と健康悪化していると主張するも、裁判所は予防的拘禁を維持 - CIC7ニュース
triage.triage_reason: 個人の刑事事件における拘禁判断に関する報道であり、公衆衛生危機を示すシグナルではない。結核は個人の医学的状態に関する記述であり、新規感染症発生や流行の兆候ではない。
triage.notes: 本記事は刑事事件に関する法廷報道であり、個人の医学的状態に言及しているが、公衆衛生上の感染症イベント（集団発生、流行、新規患者検出など）の報告ではない。シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Le CDC Afrique salue la solidarité opportune de la Chine et son partenariat solide dans la lutte contre Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Africa CDC salutes China's timely solidarity and its strong partnership in the fight against Ebola.
article.articleSummary: On 26 June 2026, Africa CDC praised China's timely solidarity and strong partnership in the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak response, signing a two-million-dollar emergency support to back Africa’s response. DG Jean Kaseya and Jiang Feng, head of the Chinese Mission to the African Union, formalized aid at Africa CDC’s Addis Ababa headquarters. The accord underscores China–Africa health collaboration, including infrastructure, capacity building, emergency preparedness, and technical exchanges. As the Ebola outbreak expands in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda, Africa CDC called for intensified international solidarity. A five-member Chinese expert team arrived in Kinshasa on 2 June for a three-month mission to assist the DRC response.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカCDC、エボラ対策でのタイムリーな中国の連帯と強固なパートナーシップを称賛
triage.triage_reason: ブンディブギョエボラの集団発生がDRCおよびウガンダで拡大中であり、IHR基準の「国際的拡大リスク」および「公衆衛生への影響」に該当。WPRO基準では「重症度」「長期曝露」「流行しやすさ」「管理可能性（国際支援が進行中）」に該当し、シグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCおよびウガンダでのエボラ集団発生を明記しており、DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に追加。エチオピア（Addis Ababa会合の開催地）は会議場所であり、サマリーの主題の発生地ではないため除外。中国は支援提供国として記載されているが、エボラ発生地ではないため除外。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。2026年6月26日配信の記事で、ブンディブギョ株エボラウイルスによる複数国での集団発生が進行中であることが明示されている。

article.articleHeadline: WHO Tetapkan Ebola Sebagai Darurat Kesehatan Global, Pakar: Indonesia Harus Siaga |Republika Online
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Declares Ebola a Global Health Emergency, Expert: Indonesia Must Be On Alert | Republika Online
article.articleSummary: Outbreak: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo has reached 1,118 cases and over 291 deaths as of June 24, 2026, prompting the World Health Organization to declare a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC). The declaration signals a global alert and emphasizes the need for strengthened surveillance, rapid reporting, and tactically coordinated public health responses. Transmission occurs through direct contact with blood, bodily fluids, or the body of a deceased patient. While Indonesia reports no cases, experts warn that high international mobility raises cross-border risk and urge tightened detection at airports, seaports, and land crossings, especially for travelers from affected areas. Health facility readiness is urged. Dr. Farindira Vesti Rahmasari of Muhammadiyah University Yogyakarta calls for concrete border control measures and overall preparedness to mitigate potential importation.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、エボラをグローバルヘルスエマージェンシーに指定、専門家：インドネシアは警戒が必要
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当（深刻な影響、予想外の大規模集団発生、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHO が PHEIC 宣言し、インドネシアを含む対象地域に直接的な脅威がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーにより、DRC でのエボラ集団発生（1,118 症例、291 死亡）が WHO により PHEIC 宣言されたことが確認される。インドネシアは現在症例なしだが、専門家が警戒を呼びかけており、対象国として含める。Yogyakarta の地域参照は専門家のコンテキスト（大学所属）であり、発生地ではなく、インドネシア全国への警告と解釈される。

article.articleHeadline: Saúde pede reforço de vacinação contra o sarampo em crianças em Guarulhos e SP - Click Guarulhos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health department calls for measles booster vaccination for children in Guarulhos and the state of São Paulo - Click Guarulhos.
article.articleSummary: Three suspected measles cases in children under 2 in the north zone of São Paulo prompt SES-SP via CVE-SP to authorize a zero-dose of the measles-mumps-rubella (MMR) vaccine for infants aged 6 to 11 months 29 days in Guarulhos and São Paulo. The measure, aligned with the National Immunization Program, aims to strengthen protection of under-1s and interrupt transmission, complemented by outbreak-block vaccination, door-to-door surveys, and intensified vaccination in high-traffic areas such as airports and rail stations. About 100,000 doses will be dispatched to two cities. The three cases are thought to be imported; two involve travelers from Bolivia and Guatemala, and a third resides in the same area. All presented fever, rash and respiratory symptoms; lab confirmation by Instituto Adolfo Lutz and Fiocruz. Routine schedule remains: first MMR at 12 months, second at 15 months, tetraviral. State vaccination coverage: 85.32% first dose, 72.06% second.

triage.headline_ja: グアルーリョスとサンパウロ州の子どもに対する麻疹予防接種強化を保健局が要請
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹、ムンプス、風疹の複合信号イベント。3例の疑い例（輸入例含む）が報告され、ボリビアとグアテマラからの旅行者関連であり、国際的拡大リスク有。100,000用量の緊急ワクチン配備、接触追跡対応等の行政対応が実施されており、IHR基準2つ以上該当（異常性・国際的拡大リスク）。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはブラジル（サンパウロ州グアルーリョス）での麻疹疑い例3件（小児、2歳未満）を主題としている。ボリビア・グアテマラからの旅行者関連輸入例が含まれるが、イベント発生地はブラジルであり、対象国リストではブラジルのみ確定。ムンプス・風疹は同時検査疾患として含まれている。ワクチン接種キャンペーン、空港・駅などの高流量地点での対策、戸別訪問等の対応が実施中。予防接種率（第1回85.32%、第2回72.06%）は比較的良好。ラボ確認待ち。

article.articleHeadline: Ministério da Saúde recomenda reforço da vacinação contra o sarampo para crianças em São Paulo e Guarulhos - Ponta Porã Informa - Notícias de Ponta Porã - MS e Pedro Juan Caballero - PY
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health recommends a booster vaccination against measles for children in São Paulo and Guarulhos - Ponta Porã Informa - News from Ponta Porã - MS and Pedro Juan Caballero - PY
article.articleSummary: Three measles cases in children under two in the North Zone of São Paulo lead Brazil's Health Ministry to recommend a dose zero of the measles-mumps-rubella (MMR) vaccine for 6 months through 11 months 29 days, targeting São Paulo and Guarulhos due to high mobility and airport traffic. About 100,000 doses will be sent to the two cities. All three cases were laboratory-confirmed (IgM-reactive and RT-PCR) and linked to importation; two children attended the same daycare, and the third lives in the same area. The measure aims to reduce susceptibility and interrupt transmission in high-risk settings. Brazil remains endemic-measles free, with cases only imported or linked to importation. February 2026 saw a dose zero given to a six-month-old returning from Bolivia; more than 600 doses were given to contacts, and Bolivia received 640,000 donated doses. The report notes ongoing risk with global travel and urges vaccination verification for travelers.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル保健省、サンパウロとグアルーリョスの子どもたちへの麻疹ワクチン追加接種を推奨
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹・おたふく風邪・風疹の3疾患が確認され、ブラジル保健省が公式な予防接種強化勧告を発出している。ブラジルは麻疹排除国であり、輸入症例の発生と公式対応は異常・予想外である。
triage.notes: ブラジルは麻疹排除状態にあり、今回の3症例は全て輸入症例または輸入関連。ボリビアからの輸入症例、国際航行による輸入リスク、高リスク地域での感染鎖の検出により、IHR基準3項目以上に該当。保健省による公式な予防接種強化勧告（10万用量配分）が発出されており、政府関心は高い。対象国リストではBrazil(3469034)のみが当該国。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : une épidémie qui inquiète
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: An Outbreak That Raises Concerns.
article.articleSummary: June 26, 2026 — Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo's Ituri region has reached 1,155 confirmed cases and 304 deaths, a 26.3% case fatality rate. Authorities have imposed a 21-day isolation for suspected cases, with 34 medical teams deployed in critical zones. Experts fear spread to Mali, Burkina Faso, and Niger as health systems—already strained by security crises—face mounting challenges. The outbreak highlights the limits of local health structures; Africa CDC is coordinating a continental response. Doctors and humanitarian workers battle ongoing transmission and misinformation amid equipment shortages and harsh field conditions.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ：懸念を呼び起こす流行
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラウイルス病は極めて重大な公衆衛生上の影響を有し、1,155確認症例と304死亡（致命率26.3%）は異常かつ予想外、隣接国への国際的拡大リスクが高く、渡航・貿易制限の可能性がある。
triage.notes: 記事は主にコンゴ民主共和国（Ituri地域）でのエボラ流行を主題としている。Burkina Faso、Mali、Nigerは地域リスク評価としてのみ言及されており、実際の発生地は記載されていないため対象外。Africa CDCが大陸規模の対応を調整している。

article.articleHeadline: Brutális ebolajárvány: már több mint 1100 fertőzött, Európában is itt van
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brutal Ebola outbreak: over 1,100 infected, it's here in Europe as well.
article.articleSummary: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 1,100 infections and 300 deaths, driven by the Bundibugyo strain, the largest known outbreak of this rare variant. The epicenter is Ituri Province in eastern DRC, where conflict and displacement hinder response and many cases go undetected. Uganda has recorded 20 lab-confirmed infections and two deaths, mostly linked to cross-border spread from Congo with some local transmissions. Europe has seen an imported case in France involving a humanitarian worker who had been in Congo; authorities quarantined the patient and began contact tracing. There is no licensed vaccine or targeted therapy for Bundibugyo; care is supportive, with emphasis on rapid detection, isolation, and contact tracing. Africa CDC puts funding needs at $1.4 billion, nearly triple previous estimates, with current funds falling short. WHO has not advised travel restrictions but calls for enhanced health screening.

triage.headline_ja: 残酷なエボラ出血熱の流行：すでに1,100人以上が感染、ヨーロッパにも来た
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当、WPROスクリーニング基準5つ全て該当。エボラ出血熱の大規模流行で死亡例多数、国際的拡大、渡航・貿易制限のリスク、ワクチン・治療法の欠如により管理困難。
triage.notes: 記事は複数国の発生地域を記載しているが、サマリーから実際の感染イベントが主要に発生しているのはDRCのみ。ウガンダは越境感染の言及があるが、記事の主題はDRCの流行を中心としている。フランスの例は輸入症例1例で、流行地ではない。対象国リストからDRCのみが該当。Bundibugyo型エボラの過去最大規模流行、資金ギャップ（$1.4B必要）、ワクチン・特異的治療薬なし、紛争地域での対策困難という複合的なリスク要因あり。

article.articleHeadline: Заразившийся эболой прилетел во Францию регулярным рейсом Air France
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An Ebola-infected person arrived in France on a regular Air France flight.
article.articleSummary: France reports its first imported Ebola case: a doctor returning from a humanitarian mission in the Democratic Republic of Congo flew regular Air France from Kinshasa to Paris; symptoms emerged during the eight-hour trip, and the patient was isolated onboard with a low viral load. Five potentially exposed passengers are isolated as a precaution; contact tracing is under way. In the DRC, authorities require a 21-day quarantine for people arriving from outbreak areas before international travel. Ebola spreads via bodily fluids (feces, vomiting, saliva, sweat) and through contact with contaminated fluids or objects on broken skin or mucous membranes; incubation is 2-21 days. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain has no approved vaccine; treatment is supportive. The eastern DRC outbreak has infected over 1,100 and caused at least 291 deaths in DRC, with two confirmed cases in Uganda as of June 23. A May Air France Paris-Detroit incident prompted panic; no confirmed infection; crew wore masks. ECDC notes higher risk for nearby passengers, crew, and cleaners.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスに感染した人がエールフランスの定期便でフランスに到着
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの国際輸送事例であり、IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の国際拡大、渡航制限リスク）。複数国での確認事例と国際的な対応が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの主題はDRCからのエボラ症例のフランスへの国際輸送。フランス・米国での記載は症例報告または先行事例の言及であり、実際の発生地はDRCのみ。対象国リストのDRCのみが該当。東DRCでの進行中の流行（1,100以上感染、291死亡）とウガンダでの確定事例2件により、地域的に深刻な状況。

article.articleHeadline: Defesa de Oruam cita tuberculose em tentativa de revogar prisão, mas Justiça mantém decisão - Diário do Rio de Janeiro
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Oruam's defense cites tuberculosis in a bid to overturn detention, but the court upholds the decision.
article.articleSummary: Preventive detention of rapper Mauro Davi dos Santos Nepomuceno, known as Oruam, was upheld by the Rio de Janeiro court on June 26, 2026. The 3rd Criminal Court of the Capital, Judge Tula Corrêa de Mello, rejected the defense’s bid to revoke the measure. Oruam has been a fugitive for about five months and faces two open warrants: one for alleged attempted homicide against civil police during a Rio de Janeiro operation, and another for money laundering linked to the Comando Vermelho (Red Command). The defense cited grave health issues, including pulmonary tuberculosis with weight loss and lung lesions, and risk of transmission. The judge found the medical reports insufficient because they were not issued by an official state institution. Indications of authorship and materiality in the attempted homicide, plus breaches of electronic monitoring, justified continued detention. If located or surrenders, he should be sent to prison for specialized medical evaluation. The defense has not commented.

triage.headline_ja: オルアムの弁護側が結核を理由に投獄取り消しを試みるも、裁判所は決定を維持 - リオデジャネイロ日記
triage.triage_reason: 本イベントは個別刑事事件における被告人の健康状態言及であり、公衆衛生危機ではない。結核の疫学的情報、感染者数、感染拡大のリスク、地域での感染状況に関する記載がなく、公開健康上の脅威を示していない。
triage.notes: 記事は刑事司法上の拘留決定に関するニュースであり、結核は個別被疑者の健康状態に言及されているのみ。感染症のアウトブレイク、流行、公衆衛生上の脅威を示すいかなる証拠も含まれていない。EBS監視対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en Ituri : un second patient guéri quitte le centre de traitement d'Aru - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Ituri: a second recovered patient leaves the Aru treatment center - ACP
article.articleSummary: On 26 June 2026, in Aru, Ituri province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, a second Ebola patient officially discharged from the Aru Ebola Treatment Center (CTE) after testing negative, marking another recovery in Ituri’s 17th Ebola outbreak. The discharge occurred in a ceremony with response leads and partners, per the National Public Health Institute (INSP). The INSP cited early detection, quality patient care, and the commitment of health teams and partners as key to this recovery, signaling progress in outbreak control. The report frames the recovery as hopeful for communities, demonstrating that Ebola can be defeated when patients are rapidly managed and public health measures are followed. Each recovered patient represents a life saved, advancing efforts to curb the outbreak in Ituri amid its complex health landscape.

triage.headline_ja: イツリ州のエボラ：アル治療センターから回復した2番目の患者が退院
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスは国際的に非常に高い懸念対象疾患であり、DRCでの確認事例は IHR Annex2 基準（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）に複数該当する。患者回復報告は肯定的兆候だが、進行中の流行状況を示す重要なシグナルである。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは DRC イツリ州での進行中のエボラ流行（17番目の流行）を明確に述べている。患者の回復は肯定的な進展だが、アウトブレイク制御の過程にある状況を示している。エボラは国際保健上の懸念疾患であり、DRC での確認は自動的に高優先度のシグナルとなる。

article.articleHeadline: Francia conferma primo caso di Ebola mentre l'epidemia continua a crescere nella RDC.
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: France confirms first Ebola case as the epidemic continues to grow in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: Ebola case confirmed in France, the first in Western Europe, involving a healthcare worker from the NGO Alliance for International Medical Action (ALIMA) who contracted Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and returned to France. The World Health Organization, in a 24 June 2026 briefing, stated that about 80 frontline health workers have been infected to date, highlighting risks to healthcare staff. The WHO also noted that the risk to the rest of the world remains low. The outbreak remains centered in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with the epidemic continuing to grow there as of June 2026.

triage.headline_ja: フランスが西ヨーロッパ初のエボラ症例を確認、一方RDCではエボラの流行が継続して拡大中
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてが該当し、エボラウイルスの国境超越、複数国への拡大、国際的な渡航・貿易制限のリスクが明確である。また医療従事者への感染という職業的脆弱性も顕著。
triage.notes: フランスの症例は記事で言及されているが、フランスは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。RDCは対象国（203312）であり、記事の主要な流行地域として記載されている。医療従事者への感染率の高さ（約80名）と国際的な広がりを示す渡航関連輸入症例が重要な特徴。

article.articleHeadline: Piauí prorroga por mais 180 dias emergência zoossanitária por peste suína
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Piauí extends the zoosanitary emergency for another 180 days due to swine fever.
article.articleSummary: Classical Swine Fever persists in Piauí, Brazil, prompting a six-month extension of the zoosanitary emergency across the state. Governor Rafael Fonteles renewed the declaration for 180 days to bolster prevention and control after a focal outbreak was confirmed in the municipality of Porto, about 170 km from Teresina. The extension, requested by the State Agency of Agricultural Defense (Adapi), aims to intensify surveillance on swine-rearing properties and prevent disease spread between establishments and herds. The decree allows immediate adoption of measures to contain and eradicate the virus, reducing the risk of new foci. Classical Swine Fever is a highly contagious viral disease affecting domestic pigs and wild boars; it does not infect humans but harms production and animal trade. Movement restrictions for animals and risk-related products are now enforced under technical procedures by field teams.

triage.headline_ja: ピアウイ州、豚熱によるゾーサニタリー緊急事態をさらに180日間延長
triage.triage_reason: 動物疾病（古典的豚熱）の地域的発生で州レベルの対応が継続中だが、ヒト感染リスクなく国際的拡大の急迫性は不明。情報不足のため経過観察に値する。
triage.notes: ブラジル・ピアウイ州での古典的豚熱（CSF）の継続的な発生に対する州政府の正式な対応。動物のみに影響する疾病だがアニマルヘルスと畜産経済への影響がある。180日間の緊急事態延長は州が対応能力を有していることを示唆。国際的拡大リスク、他国への影響については不明な点が多い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : Air France suspend ses vols entre Paris et Kinshasa après un cas confirmé à bord
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Air France suspends its flights between Paris and Kinshasa after a confirmed case on board.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak continues in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with France confirming its first imported case in a passenger who traveled from Kinshasa. A laboratory-confirmed Ebola case in France was reported after the traveler boarded the Kinshasa–Paris flight on June 23. In response, Air France suspended all Paris–Kinshasa flights in both directions as a precaution, with passengers informed. Reopening depends on reinforced sanitary controls before boarding at Ndjili International Airport and ongoing coordination with Congolese authorities; if measures are satisfactory, services could resume this weekend. French epidemiological investigations have been launched, and preventive measures are being implemented. Turkish Airlines has an unrelated Kinshasa service suspension since May 6, 2026, due to economic reasons and not linked to Ebola, and will remain until October 24, 2026. Ongoing monitoring and border controls will determine the normalization of air links.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：パリとキンシャサ間でエボラ確定症例が搭乗機で報告されたため、エアフランスが便を一時停止
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、国際的な拡大リスク、渡航制限、公衆衛生への深刻な影響が明確。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当し、社会的・政治的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）でのエボラ流行を主な内容としており、フランスへの輸入症例はDRCの継続的な流行の結果として報告されている。Parisおよび Franceは発生地域フィールドに含まれるが、実際の疾患発生地はDRCであり、フランスはケースの検出地点である。DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。トルコの情報は経済的理由による航空会社のサービス停止であり、エボライベントとは無関連。

article.articleHeadline: Sarampo: Saúde pede reforço de vacinação de crianças em SP e Guarulhos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles: Health Department requests booster vaccination for children in São Paulo and Guarulhos.
article.articleSummary: Measles: On 2026-06-26, Brazil's Ministry of Health recommended a zero-dose of the measles-mumps-rubella (MMR) vaccine for children aged 6 to 11 months (29 days) to bolster protection against measles in this highly susceptible age group. The advisory follows three confirmed measles cases in children under two in the north zone of São Paulo, signaling an ongoing cluster. The strategy also extends to Guarulhos, São Paulo, due to high movement of people at the city's international airport, underscoring risk of spread in the region. The report focuses on vaccination timing and public health response; it does not provide clinical symptoms or laboratory confirmation details, but highlights measures to curb transmission amid the São Paulo area outbreak. Keywords: vaccination, outbreak, public health measures.

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹：サンパウロとグアルーリョスで子どもの追加予防接種を要請
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル（サンパウロ）で麻疹・おたふく風邪・風疹の3疾患による確認事例があり、小児クラスターが報告されている。IHR基準で異常性と公衆衛生への深刻な影響が認められ、スクリーニング基準で重症度（小児2歳未満）・流行性・管理可能性が該当するためピックアップが必要。
triage.notes: 記事はポルトガル語で2026年6月26日配信。サンパウロ北部で2歳未満の小児3例が確認されたクラスターが報告されており、ブラジル保健省がMMRワクチンの追加接種を勧告している。グアルーリョス国際空港を経由した人的移動による地域への拡大リスクも指摘されている。WPRO基準5項目すべてに該当し、既知のシグナルとして扱うべき。

article.articleHeadline: Sarampo: Saúde reforça vacinação de crianças em São Paulo e Guarulhos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles: Health reinforces vaccination of children in São Paulo and Guarulhos.
article.articleSummary: Three measles cases in children under 2 in São Paulo's northern zone prompted Brazil's Health Ministry to administer a dose-zero of the measles-mumps-rubella vaccine to 6–11-month-old infants in São Paulo and Guarulhos, with about 100,000 doses shipped. The aim is to curb transmission and prevent severe outcomes in the most vulnerable. Laboratory and epidemiological investigations by Instituto Adolfo Lutz and Fiocruz indicate the infections were imported, and Brazil remains free of endemic transmission. Symptoms included fever, exanthema (rash), and respiratory complications. The dose-zero supplements routine vaccination at 12 and 15 months; adults 29 and younger without vaccination history should receive two doses, while those 30–59 should have at least one. Global context shows measles activity in the United States, Canada, and Mexico in 2026, raising importation risk for travelers.

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹：サンパウロとグアルーリョスで小児向けワクチン接種を強化
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルで輸入麻疹3症例が報告され、予防的ワクチン接種キャンペーンが実施されている。IHR基準は2つ以上該当する可能性があるが、記事内で「ブラジルは地域流行のない状態を維持」と明記されており、情報を確認する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事は輸入麻疹ケースとそれに対する公衆衛生対応を報告しており、ブラジル国内での流行継続性は否定されている。米国、カナダ、メキシコでの麻疹活動が言及されているが、これらは対象国に含まれないため verified_locations に含めない。ワクチン接種キャンペーンの実施は公式な公衆衛生対応であり、政府および公開の関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak surpasses 1,000 cases in Congo: New study warns of high risk of spread to neighbouring countries
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has surpassed 1,000 cases; by June 22, 2026, 1,048 laboratory-confirmed cases and 267 deaths. The Bundibugyo strain is responsible; there is no approved vaccine specific to this strain, heightening emphasis on public health measures. The outbreak began around April 1 and was declared May 15. It has spilled into neighboring Uganda, with Uganda confirming linked cases including healthcare workers. A Lancet Infectious Diseases modelling study estimates 12-week importation risk: Uganda 94.2%, South Sudan 69.3%, Rwanda 8.6%, Burundi 2%. Ebola virus disease causes fever, weakness, vomiting, diarrhoea and sometimes bleeding; transmission is person-to-person via blood, body fluids or contaminated items, and is not airborne, contagious only after symptoms. The CDC issued travel notices; WHO emphasises surveillance and border screening. Early action and vigilant surveillance can prevent wider spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱感染者が1,000人を超過：新研究が近隣諸国への高い拡大リスクを警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の確認例1,048件と267人の死亡（深刻な影響）、ウガンダへのすでに拡大（国際的拡大リスク現実化）、疾患の性質上ヒト-ヒト感染の危険性が高く、CDC・WHOが既に対応を実施している状況。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで主題となっているエボラ出血熱イベントはコンゴ民主共和国での発生が中心。ウガンダへの拡大も言及されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。発生地域に列挙されたスーダン、ルワンダ、ブルンジ、ウガンダはいずれも対象国リストに含まれていないため、サマリー上での主題国DRCのみを verified_locations に記載。本イベントはエボラ出血熱という高い危険性と既に国境を越えた拡大があり、IHR基準およびWPRO基準をすべて満たすため、PICKUP判定が適切。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola - L'épidémie d'Ebola en RDC a fait plus de 300 morts, selon un dernier bilan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola - The Ebola outbreak in the DRC has killed more than 300 people, according to the latest figures.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) is its 17th, centered in Ituri in the northeast near the borders with South Sudan and Uganda, which has reported 20 cases and 2 deaths on Ugandan territory. The outbreak has killed more than 300 people as of 26 June 2026. A transmission case was detected in France on Wednesday: a Congolese physician humanitarian worker for NGO ALIMA, treated in Paris. French authorities and the WHO say the risk of spread in Europe is low and that travel restrictions are unnecessary. In Ituri, containment efforts have been stepped up, but health facilities remain under-equipped, lacking basic protections and chlorine. INSP reports 78 health workers infected and 18 dead. Communities show strong distrust toward responders. Experts warn the peak is not yet reached and fear the crisis could last six months to a year.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ - コンゴ民主共和国（DRC）のエボラ流行で300人以上が死亡、最新の集計による
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行（死亡300人以上）で、IHR基準3つ以上該当。また国際的拡大リスク（フランスで患者確認）、異常性・重症度・流行しやすさの複数スクリーニング基準に該当し、高い社会政治的関心がある。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはパリ・フランスも含まれているが、記事サマリーからは感染症イベントの主な発生地はDRCのイトゥリ州であり、フランスで確認された症例は渡航者（DRC出身の医療従事者）である。したがってverified_locationsはDRCのみとした。ウガンダとスーダンも境接し症例報告がある可能性があるが、記事サマリーではウガンダの20症例2死亡のみ明記されており、スーダンについては不明。対象国リストの確認により、UgandaはGeoNames IDが不在のため、DRCのみを記載した。

article.articleHeadline: L'épidémie d'Ebola continue de gagner du terrain : le bilan s'alourdit à 304 morts !
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak continues to gain ground: the death toll has risen to 304!
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) declared on May 15 in Ituri province, northeast near the borders with South Sudan and Uganda, continues to escalate with 1,115 infections and 304 deaths (case fatality 26.3%), marking the 17th Ebola outbreak in the country. Uganda has reported 20 cases with 2 deaths. One imported case was detected in France on Wednesday in Paris—a Congolese national humanitarian worker for NGO Alima; authorities and WHO deem Europe at low risk and no travel bans needed. In Ituri, response measures have been strengthened, but health systems remain under-resourced, lacking basic protections and chlorine; 78 health workers have been infected, 18 fatally. Community distrust complicates containment. Experts caution the epidemic’s peak has not yet been reached, with potential duration of six months to a year.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行が拡大を続け、死亡者は304人に増加！
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。スクリーニング基準も5つ全て該当。確認済みの対象国での発生（DRC、ウガンダ）。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCでの発生が主題。ウガンダでの症例報告と仏パリへの輸入症例も言及されているが、対象国リストにはウガンダが含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみに限定。フランスは対象国外のため除外。疫学的には重篤なシグナルであり、フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: പൾസ് പോളിയോ ഇമ്മ്യൂണൈസേഷൻ 28ന്; വയനാട് ജില്ലയിൽ 52,175 കുട്ടികൾക്ക് തുള്ളിമരുന്ന് നൽകും
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pulse Polio Immunization on the 28th; 52,175 children in Wayanad district will be given oral drops.
article.articleSummary: Pulse Polio Immunization on June 28 in Wayanad district, Kerala: 52,175 children under five will receive oral polio vaccine drops at 561 booths (523 fixed at health centers and anganwadis; 23 transit booths at bus stands and tourist sites; 15 mobile booths in hostels, difficult areas, and event venues). The district-level inauguration will be held at 9 am at Padinjarathara Bus Stand, with MP Priyanka Gandhi leading. If any children miss the day, vaccination will continue at home on June 29–30. Trained nurses, Anganwadi and Kudumbashree volunteers, and other social workers will conduct the drive. Parents are urged to ensure all eligible children are vaccinated. The program is led by the Health Department with partners including Health Kerala, LSGD, Women and Child Development, Education, Kudumbashree Mission, Literacy Mission, Rotary, Lions, and other NGOs. Although India was polio-free since 2014, poliovirus remains in some neighboring countries, warranting continued immunization.

triage.headline_ja: ポーリオパルス予防接種が6月28日に実施; ワイアナド地区の5歳未満の子ども52,175人が経口ポーリオワクチンの滴剤を受ける
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はポーリオ予防接種キャンペーンの実施予定に関する通常の公衆衛生活動であり、予期しない疾患発生を報告するものではない。インドは2014年以降ポーリオ撲滅状態にあり、新規症例発生の兆候はない。
triage.notes: 本記事は定期的なポーリオ予防接種キャンペーン（Pulse Polio）の実施案内であり、新規感染症シグナルではない。インドは2014年以降ポーリオ撲滅状態を維持しており、予防接種はリスク管理の一環として継続されている。記事内容は公衆衛生の通常活動に分類される。

article.articleHeadline: Doença de Lyme: além de Bella Hadid, veja outros famosos que foram diagnosticados com a infecção
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Lyme Disease: In Addition to Bella Hadid, See Other Celebrities Who Were Diagnosed with the Infection.
article.articleSummary: Lyme disease, transmitted by hematophagous Ixodes ticks infected with Borrelia burgdorferi, has drawn celebrity attention. Bella Hadid (29) shared posts illustrating a Lyme crisis; her mother Yolanda Hadid and brother Anwar Hadid are also diagnosed. American singer Justin Timberlake (44) disclosed after his world tour that he has Lyme disease, describing debilitating physical and mental effects. Canadian singer Avril Lavigne previously faced a prolonged recovery after infection in 2014, and Justin Bieber reportedly battled symptoms for two years (per 2020). Common symptoms include erythema migrans at the bite site, chills, fatigue, widespread muscle pain, neck stiffness, headaches and sore throat. Infection starts when the bacteria enter the skin and spread via the bloodstream, potentially causing joint and muscle pain, skin lesions, nervous system, brain, and heart involvement if untreated. Stages: early localized, early disseminated, late chronic; the Brazilian Lyme-like disease or Baggio-Yoshinari syndrome may be chronic despite prolonged treatment.

triage.headline_ja: ライム病：ベラ・ハディッド以外にも、この感染症と診断された有名人たちを見てみよう
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はライム病の有名人患者の紹介記事であり、新規感染症の爆発的流行や公衆衛生上の深刻な危機を報告するものではない。IHR基準・WPROs基準の該当がなく、社会的関心は高いが科学的根拠のある感染症危機信号ではない。
triage.notes: 記事はライム病（既知の感染症）の有名人患者紹介に焦点を当てており、新規患者発生・アウトブレーク・公衆衛生危機を報告していない。Bluedot APIが United States、Canada を含めているが、サマリーはこれら国での新規流行を述べておらず、芸能人の既知の診断事例に言及しているのみ。Brazil については Baggio-Yoshinari syndrome の医学的参照があるが、新規イベント報告ではない。対象国内での実際の感染症危機シグナルとしてはピックアップ不要。

article.articleHeadline: Casos de sarampo em SP alertam para importância da vacina 'dose zero'
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles cases in São Paulo highlight the importance of the 'dose zero' vaccine.
article.articleSummary: Three new measles cases were confirmed in São Paulo state on June 26, 2026, in the capital and Guarulhos, raising the 2026 total to five (the initial two cases in March–April were imported). The patients—two boys and one girl, aged 6 months to 1 year—had no recent travel history; two were unvaccinated; all have recovered. Infection source remains under investigation. The state intensified vaccination efforts, including a temporary ‘dose zero’ of the measles–mumps–rubella vaccine for infants 6–11 months 29 days in São Paulo and Guarulhos (effective June 25). This dose is additive and does not replace the routine schedule. Current vaccination coverage is 85.32% for the first dose and 72.06% for the second. Additional measures include house-to-house vaccination near confirmed cases and outreach at bus terminals, metro stations, trains, and airports. Guidance: check vaccination records and update at local health units; adhere to routine immunization timelines and age-specific recommendations for all groups.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州の麻疹患者が「ゼロ用量」ワクチンの重要性を警告
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・サンパウロ州で麻疹患者3名が確認され、2026年累計5名となっているが、患者は全員回復し、感染源は調査中。現在のところ深刻な公衆衛生危機を示す証拠に欠ける。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれていないため、本来的には verified_locations は空配列となるべきですが、記事で明確にブラジル（サンパウロ州）での麻疹発生が述べられています。患者は全員回復しており、現段階では深刻度は低いと判断されます。感染源が未特定であり、今後の情報展開を注視する必要があります。

article.articleHeadline: Epidémie d'Ebola en RDC: 304 morts et 1.115 cas, selon un dernier bilan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the DRC: 304 deaths and 1,115 cases, according to the latest figures.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) remains uncontrolled more than a month after its declaration on May 15. As of 2026-06-26, Congolese health authorities report 304 deaths and 1,115 cases. This outbreak marks the DRC’s 17th Ebola outbreak in its history. Transmission remains ongoing within affected areas, with the article not detailing specific regional localities, laboratory confirmations, or infection sources in the excerpt. The figures reflect the latest official tally from national health authorities, underscoring the ongoing public health challenge posed by the outbreak in the country as authorities continue surveillance and response efforts. Ongoing surveillance and response efforts are underway.

triage.headline_ja: RDCのエボラ流行：最新集計によると304人の死亡と1,115人の症例
triage.triage_reason: IHR Annex2基準4項目すべてに該当し、エボラウイルス病という高致死性感染症の継続的流行を示す。WPROスクリーニング基準でも異常性、重症度、流行の可能性、管理可能性の懸念が確認でき、国際的な関心も高まっている。フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、DRCが17回目のエボラ流行であることが確認された。5月15日の宣言から1ヶ月以上経過しても制御不能な状態が続いており、継続的な伝播が報告されている。死亡者304人、症例1,115人という数字は深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威を示唆している。国際支援の需要が高い可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: L'épidémie d'Ebola en RDC a fait 304 morts, selon le dernier bilan des autorités
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in the DRC has killed 304 people, according to the authorities' latest tally.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), declared May 15, 2026, remains uncontrolled more than a month into the response. According to INSP figures published June 25, 2026, the outbreak has caused 304 deaths among 1,115 people infected. The update confirms sustained transmission across affected regions of the DRC and ongoing public health efforts to trace contacts and contain spread. The report provides no laboratory confirmation details, infection sources, or information on imported or exported cases. This marks a continued burden for the country during a period of persistent transmission. No information on affected provinces or demographics is provided.

triage.headline_ja: RDC のエボラ出血熱流行が当局の最新集計で 304 人の死亡を引き起こした
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目中3項目以上に該当。エボラ出血熱は重大な公衆衛生上の影響（304人死亡、1,115人感染）を示し、DRCで異常/予想外の継続的な感染があり、国際的な拡大リスクと渡航/貿易制限のリスクが認められるため。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は高い感染性、高い致死率（27.2%：304/1,115）、及び国際的拡大リスクを特徴とする。記事は5月15日宣言後1ヶ月以上の継続的な感染を示す。検査確認の詳細や感染源、輸入/輸出症例に関する情報は不明。対象国リスト内のDRCが確認された。

article.articleHeadline: RD Congo : Une mystérieuse maladie dans le Kwilu fait une série de décès
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo: A mysterious disease in Kwilu is causing a string of deaths.
article.articleSummary: 12 deaths since late May in Bulungu territory, Kwilu province, western Democratic Republic of Congo, linked to a malaria cluster with symptoms of fever, headaches, abdominal pain and vomiting. First cases were reported May 31 in Mukulubiala village, Niadi-Nkara sector. Fears of Ebola were allayed after samples sent to Kinshasa's INRB tested negative for Ebola; malaria was confirmed by INRB director Professor Jean-Jacques Muyembe. Malaria is endemic in the region but often poorly diagnosed or treated. Some patients have recovered and been discharged from hospital. There is no current indication of a viral epidemic; authorities remain cautious and plan to deploy about ten specialists to re-sample and bolster surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：クウィル州の謎の病気が一連の死亡を引き起こしている
triage.triage_reason: マラリアクラスター（12件の死亡）が確認され、エボラは除外されたが、診断不確実性と地域の医療体制の弱さが存在。情報が限定的であり、継続的な監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはマラリアが最終確認診断であることを明記しており、エボラは検査により陰性が確認されている。ただし、DRC西部の医療体制が不十分であり、診断精度への懸念が残る。当該地域でのマラリア流行性、死亡数（12件）、継続的な曝露リスク、および当局が専門家派遣と監視強化を計画している点から、経過観察対象として適切。IHR基準は1つのみ（重症度）該当だが、スクリーニング基準で複数該当し、社会的・政治的関心も示されているため、WATCH判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: Eight more Shigella cases reported in Kerala; June tally rises to 180
article.articleSummary: Kerala on June 26 reported eight more Shigella cases, raising June’s tally to 180 and total confirmed Shigella cases in the year to 256; six Shigella deaths have been reported in June. Outbreaks are declared in Kozhikode (61 cases in June), Wayanad (25), Thrissur (13) and Alappuzha (5). Other June district tallies include Malappuram 25, Thiruvananthapuram 18, Kollam 12, Kannur 11, Ernakulam 4, Idukki 3, and Palakkad 3. Shigella spreads via contaminated food/water or poor hygiene, causing diarrhoea, fever and cramps. In Nipah, one high-risk contact completed a 21‑day quarantine and was released; no new Nipah contacts admitted. Four very high-risk and 13 high-risk individuals remain under quarantine; 75 low-risk are under observation. The Nipah patient remains ventilated at Kozhikode Government Medical College Hospital; 69 houses were visited in Ramanattukara, and 92 public calls were received. Nipah is zoonotic and can cause severe respiratory illness and encephalitis with a high fatality rate.

triage.headline_ja: ケーラム州で8件の赤痢患者が追加報告、6月の累計が180件に上昇
triage.triage_reason: 複数の人獣共通感染症（ニパウイルス、赤痢）が同時に発生し、赤痢は6月だけで180例、死亡6例の深刻な流行状況にある。IHR基準で異常性・重症度の懸念が明確であり、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主要疾患は赤痢（Shigella）だが、見出しではニパウイルス、重篤呼吸器疾患、原因不明脳炎も列記されている。ケーラム州の複数地区にわたる赤痢流行（6月180例、死亡6例）と並行してニパウイルス患者（人工呼吸中）の発生報告があり、複合感染症危機の懸念がある。赤痢は汚染食水・衛生不良による人-人感染リスクが高く、ニパウイルスも高い致死率を持つ人獣共通感染症として危機的。IHR基準2つ以上該当、WPROスクリーニング基準5つすべて該当。

article.articleHeadline: Voyageur atteint d'Ebola : Air France a interrompu ses vols Paris-Kinshasa, reprise samedi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Passenger infected with Ebola: Air France suspended its Paris–Kinshasa flights; service to resume on Saturday.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) continues, with 304 deaths and 1,115 confirmed cases, according to the Institut national de santé publique as of June 26, 2026. This marks the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC's history, declared May 15, and authorities warn counts may underestimate the true burden due to delayed detection. A positive Ebola case traveled on the Kinshasa–Paris flight (arrived June 23, 2026), prompting Air France to suspend service between Paris and Kinshasa and to plan a resumption on June 27, 2026. In Kinshasa, enhanced screening before boarding will be implemented in coordination with local authorities. The case underscores the ongoing risk of international travel spreading Ebola and the need for vigilant surveillance amid imperfect case ascertainment.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ感染者がフライトに搭乗：エールフランスがパリ-キンシャサ便を中断、土曜日に再開
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の活動的なアウトブレイク（304死亡、1,115確定症例）であり、国際航空旅客による越境感染の実装例が報告されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づき、実際の流行発生地はコンゴ民主共和国（キンシャサ）。パリはインシデント対応地点（航空便停止）として地図上に表示されているが、感染症イベント自体の発生地ではないため除外。フランス（対象国リスト外）も同様の理由で除外。対象国リストにはDRCのみが含まれる。

article.articleHeadline: Jedna z nejnakažlivějších nemocí se šíří mezi uprchlíky. Umírají malé děti
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: One of the most contagious diseases is spreading among refugees. Young children are dying.
article.articleSummary: Measles is spreading in Rohingya refugee camps in Cox’s Bazar, Bangladesh, where about 1.16 million people live in Ukhiya and Teknaf, and the country-wide outbreak has affected all 64 districts. Cramped bamboo-and-tarp shelters create crowding that hinders isolation and care. From March 15 to June 7, Bangladesh’s DGHS reported 79,012 suspected measles cases and 9,686 laboratory-confirmed infections, with total deaths from measles or related symptoms reaching 620; roughly 80% of deaths are among children under five. MSF has treated over 750 measles patients in the Cox’s Bazar area, opening a dedicated measles ward at the Jamtoli primary care center in April. Nurul Amin, five months old, could not yet be vaccinated during the campaign, highlighting infant vulnerability. Vaccine hesitancy persists due to fears of skin scars, while historical under-vaccination in Myanmar and limited health access continue transmission. Difficult monsoon travel and crowded conditions impede timely care and follow-up.

triage.headline_ja: 最も感染しやすい病気の一つが難民の間で広がっている。幼い子どもたちが死亡している
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹の大規模流行が複数地域で発生しており、バングラデシュ全64地区に影響、9,686例の確認症例と620例の死亡（80%が5歳未満）を報告。IHR基準4項目すべて該当し、WPRO基準5項目すべて該当。高度な社会的・政治的関心と国際支援の必要性がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではバングラデシュのロヒンギャ難民キャンプ（Cox's Bazar、UkhiyaおよびTeknaf地域）での麻疹流行が主題。ミャンマーは過去の低ワクチン接種率の背景要因として言及されているが、現在の流行地はバングラデシュ。発生地域リストにミャンマー（1327865）が含まれているが、サマリーの主題はバングラデシュの流行であるため、verified_locationsはバングラデシュのみとした。

article.articleHeadline: Sarampo: Ministério da Saúde confirma 3 casos em São Paulo - 26/06/2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles: Ministry of Health confirms 3 cases in São Paulo - June 26, 2026
article.articleSummary: Three measles cases in the northern zone of São Paulo city have been laboratory-confirmed. On June 26, the Ministry of Health recommended a zero-dose of the measles-mumps-rubella vaccine for infants aged 6 to 11 months 29 days in São Paulo and Guarulhos to protect under-one children; this dose does not replace the routine schedule. All three children had fever, red skin rash and respiratory symptoms, with IgM and RT-PCR confirmation by Instituto Adolfo Lutz and Fiocruz. Officials consider the infections imported, posing a risk to Brazil’s measles-elimination status, which was first certified in 2016 but lost in 2018 after reintroduction and outbreaks. In Guarulhos, vaccination was advised due to cross-city travel and airport traffic. Earlier in 2026, two imported cases were recorded in São Paulo: a 6-month-old from Bolivia and a 42-year-old resident of Guatemala. State vaccination coverage remains below targets: 85.32% first dose, 72.06% second. Measles spreads via airborne droplets; symptoms include high fever, cough, runny nose, conjunctivitis, rash.

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹：厚生労働省がサンパウロ州で3例を確認 - 2026年6月26日
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルの麻疹排除認証喪失のリスク、複数の輸入症例の確認、ワクチン接種率の低下により、IHR基準2つ以上（異常性・予想外性および国際的拡大リスク）に該当し、公衆衛生上の重大な懸念を示唆している。
triage.notes: サマリーはサンパウロ州での3例確認を主題としており、ブラジルが麻疹排除認証を喪失するリスク、輸入症例（ボリビア、グアテマラからの症例）、ワクチン接種率低下（第1回85.32%、第2回72.06%）が報告されている。Bluedot APIが示した発生地域にはグアテマラとボリビアが含まれているが、これらは輸入症例の出発地/感染源を示唆しており、記事の主題イベント（確認された3例）は全てサンパウロ州（ブラジル）で発生している。したがって verified_locations にはブラジルのみを記載する。麻疹はヒト-ヒト感染性が高く、空気飛沫を通じて拡散し、ワクチン接種率が目標値以下であるため管理可能性にも懸念がある。

article.articleHeadline: Thousands take national exams in Ebola-hit eastern DRC
article.articleSummary: Thousands of secondary school students in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo completed a four-day national examination in Bunia under strict Ebola prevention measures as authorities sought to balance public health concerns with educational needs. At exam centers, candidates washed their hands, underwent temperature checks, and sat apart with hand sanitizers and other hygiene protocols to prevent Ebola transmission. Despite anxiety about the outbreak and daily reports of deaths, most students viewed completing the exams as worth the risk. Nyota Mokili, a candidate, said she followed preventive measures and stayed focused on finishing her studies. The precautionary measures illustrate public health officials’ efforts to contain Ebola while continuing essential schooling amid the ongoing outbreak in eastern DRC.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行下の東部DRCで数千人が全国試験を受験
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の確認された流行地域での継続的な社会活動報告であり、IHR基準で公衆衛生影響（重篤）、国際拡大リスク、異常性が該当。WPRO基準でも重症度、流行しやすさ、長期曝露が該当する。
triage.notes: 東部DRC（ブニア）でのエボラ流行は既知の継続事案であるが、大規模集団活動（全国試験）が流行地で実施されている点は、感染拡大リスク、公衆衛生管理上の懸念がある。記事は日次死亡報告の継続を明示しており、流行が活動的であることを示唆している。

article.articleHeadline: Prefeitura cria comitê técnico para combater dengue em Teresina
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: City Hall creates a technical committee to combat dengue in Teresina.
article.articleSummary: City of Teresina, Brazil, established the Intersectoral Technical Committee on Arboviruses to coordinate dengue, chikungunya, and Zika responses. Decree 28,860, published June 18, 2026, assigns the two-year, non-remunerated committee to the Municipal Health Foundation (FMS). The FMS president will appoint members, forming positions including President, Vice-President, two Secretaries, and representatives from public bodies and civil society. Participating entities include Health Surveillance, Epidemiology, CIEVS, Zoonoses, Municipal Health Council, and the State Secretariats of Education and Health, along with the Sindicato dos Condomínios e Shoppings de Teresina. Core duties: mobilize communities, run ongoing educational campaigns, strengthen epidemiological and entomological surveillance, integrate arbovirus control with primary care and the Family Health Strategy, and promote school/university programs and media outreach. FMS President Leopoldina Cipriano highlights the measure as essential since Teresina’s ecology favors Aedes aegypti and most foci are household-based.

triage.headline_ja: テレシーナでデング熱に対抗するための技術委員会を市役所が設置
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルのテレシーナ市がデング熱、チクングニア、ジカへの対応調整のため技術委員会を設置した行政的対応の報告。複数のアルボウイルス感染症が対象であり対策の重要性が認識されているが、現在の患者数や重症度などの具体的な流行データが記事に含まれていない。
triage.notes: 記事は行政的な対応措置（委員会設置）の報告であり、実際の流行状況、患者数、死亡例、重症度についての具体的データが記載されていない。WPROスクリーニング基準では「長期曝露」（テレシーナの生態がAedes aegyptiに有利）と「流行しやすさ」（複数のアルボウイルス対応）の2基準に該当するが、流行規模や公衆衛生への影響の程度が不明なため、WATCH段階が適切。続報で患者数増加や重症例の報告があれば評価を上げる必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: ارتفاع الإصابات بفيروس إيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Increase in Ebola virus infections in the Democratic Republic of the Congo
article.articleSummary: As of June 26, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 1,155 laboratory-confirmed Ebola virus disease (EVD) cases and 304 deaths, per the Congolese Ministry of Communications and Media. Oxfam warned the true scale may be larger than official tallies. In France, health authorities confirmed an Ebola infection in a physician returning from a humanitarian mission in the DRC—the first case identified in France during this outbreak—who has been isolated and whose contacts are being traced; authorities say the risk to the general European population is low. The World Health Organization notes that the DRC has registered the most confirmed cases in the first month of any outbreak to date. Ebola is a severe viral hemorrhagic fever, transmitted via direct contact with bodily fluids; zoonotic spillovers from wildlife are possible. Symptoms include sudden fever and weakness; case fatality averages about 50%.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国におけるエボラウイルス感染者数の増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラ出血熱の多数確認例（1,155例、死亡304例）、初月での過去最多の確認例、高い致死率（約50%）、国際的な事例発生（フランスでの症例確認）、WHOが状況監視していることから、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではフランスでの1症例（帰国医師）が報告されているが、フランスは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCが主要な発生地である。Machupoの疾患IDが含まれているが、サマリーではEbolaのみが言及されている。WHOが過去最高の初月確認例と指摘していることは重大な関心事項である。

article.articleHeadline: Во Конго 1.155 заразени со ебола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Congo, 1,155 people infected with Ebola.
article.articleSummary: As of 26 June 2026, Congo reports 1,155 people infected with Ebola. The health status report records 37 new cases and 5 new deaths within the previous 24 hours. Health authorities credit intensified epidemiological and biological surveillance for earlier detection of cases, confirming ongoing community transmission with the rate of spread rising week over week. The report notes confirmed cases but provides no details on symptoms, laboratory confirmation procedures, infection source, or any imported or exported cases. The figures reflect the total of confirmed infections in the current outbreak, highlighting sustained transmission within communities.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴで1,155人がエボラに感染
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも5つ全て該当。エボラウイルス病の大規模アウトブレイク、高い死亡率、継続的な社会交流による伝播、国際的拡大リスクが明確。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病は高い致死率（現報告では5/37=13.5%の死亡率）を持つClass A病原体。1,155人の累積確認症例と継続的な社会交流による伝播が報告されている。24時間以内に37例の新規症例と5例の死亡が確認されており、感染ペースは週単位で加速している。WHOへの即時通知要件を満たす。

article.articleHeadline: Eight more shigellosis cases reported in Kerala
article.articleSummary: Eight more shigellosis cases in Kerala, raising June total to 180 this month and bringing the year's confirmed cases to 256; six shigellosis deaths reported in June. Outbreaks declared in Kozhikode (61 June cases), Wayanad (25), Thrissur (13) and Alappuzha (5). The eight new cases: Kozhikode 3, Wayanad 2, Ernakulam 1, Thrissur 1, Malappuram 1. Shigellosis is a highly contagious bacterial infection spreading through contaminated food, water or poor hygiene, causing diarrhoea, fever and stomach cramps. Nipah update: one high-risk contact completed 21-day quarantine and was released; no new contacts admitted. Four very high-risk and 13 high-risk contacts remain under quarantine; 75 low-risk under observation. The Nipah patient remains ventilated at Kozhikode Government Medical College Hospital. Public health teams visited 69 houses in Ramanattukara; the control room has received 92 calls. Nipah is a zoonotic virus with potential respiratory illness and encephalitis and high fatality rate.

triage.headline_ja: ケララ州でシゲラ菌症の新たな8症例が報告
triage.triage_reason: シゲラ菌症は高い伝播性を持つ細菌感染症で、ケララ州で6月の死亡者6名を含む180症例が報告されており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響が認められる。また、同時にニパウイルスの症例も報告されており、複数の懸念材料がある。
triage.notes: シゲラ菌症は6月に180症例、年間累計256症例と急増しており、複数の地域で発生宣言されている。同時にニパウイルス患者1名が人工呼吸器装着中で、濃厚接触者の監視下にある。両疾患とも記事で詳細に報告されており、社会的・行政的関心が高い。ニパウイルスは致死率が高い人獣共通感染症として報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola deaths exceed 300 in DR Congo - Heath authorities
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has reached 304 deaths from 1,115 confirmed infections since it was detected on May 15, 2026, a 26.3% case-fatality rate. The Bundibugyo strain drives the current outbreak, with no approved vaccines or treatments. The vast majority of cases (about 91%) and deaths (about 82%) are in Ituri province, especially Bunia; outbreaks also involve North Kivu and South Kivu. Transmission occurs through direct contact with bodily fluids; healthcare facilities are under-resourced, with PPE and chlorine shortages, and at least 78 health workers infected (18 deaths). The outbreak has spread to Uganda (20 cases, 2 deaths). A Congolese doctor working for NGO ALIMA was the first confirmed Ebola case in France; Air France suspended flights to Kinshasa. WHO says minimal Europe-wide risk; no travel restrictions. Community mistrust and post-mortem hesitancy hinder surveillance and may undercount cases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱死者が300人を超える - 保健当局
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全てに該当。エボラウイルス病は最高リスク病原体であり、304人の死亡、複数州での流行、ウガンダへの越境感染、フランスでの輸入例、航空便停止など国際的影響が明確。
triage.notes: DRCが主要発生地で対象国リストに含まれる。ウガンダとフランスへの越境感染・輸入例は記事に明記されているが、これらは対象国外（ウガンダ）またはEU（フランス）のため verified_locations には含めず。Bundibugyo株、高い致命率(26.3%)、医療施設の資源不足、医療従事者感染等から重症度・管理困難性共に極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola deaths exceed 300 in DR Congo: heath authorities
article.articleSummary: Ebola deaths exceed 300 in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with 304 confirmed deaths from 1,115 infections (26.3% case fatality) as of 26 June 2026. Declared May 15, the Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccines or treatments. Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu remain the epicenters, with the vast majority of cases detected in Ituri and Bunia, and over 82% of deaths occurring there. Health facilities face shortages of PPE and chlorine, and at least 78 healthcare workers are infected with 18 deaths. The outbreak’s cross-border dimension includes Uganda reporting 20 cases and 2 deaths since May 15, with most infections among Congolese nationals who travelled there. France confirmed a first case outside Africa—a Congolese doctor working for ALIMA—prompting Air France to suspend Kinshasa flights. WHO says Europe’s risk is minimal; community mistrust and reluctance to allow autopsies hinder surveillance and risk undercounting cases.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱によるコンゴ民主共和国での死亡者数が300人を超える：保健当局
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。Bundibugyo株による大規模エボラ出血熱流行（304死亡、1,115感染）、治療法・ワクチンなし、国際的拡大（ウガンダ、フランス確認例）、国際的関心と渡航制限の実施あり。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株（BDBV）は稀な株で、本来はウガンダで散発的に検出される。DRC初の大規模流行。2026年5月15日に宣言。治療法・ワクチン不在、医療従事者の感染・死亡、越境例（ウガンダ20例）、アフリカ外初例（フランス）、航空会社のキンシャサ便運航停止など、多角的なリスク要因が存在。

article.articleHeadline: KNUST joins global push for Dengue vaccine
article.articleSummary: Dengue vaccine DengiAll is being advanced under the four-year DENSTAR project, launched June 1, 2026, led by KNUST in Kumasi, Ghana, to pursue licensure and deployment across sub-Saharan Africa and beyond. Funded by GH EDCTP3 JU with over €11 million from the European Union, the initiative aims to develop and evaluate a single-dose tetravalent dengue vaccine protecting all four serotypes. The consortium comprises ten institutions from nine countries, including Panacea Biotec (India), University of Siena (Italy), Universitätsklinikum Heidelberg (Germany), Johns Hopkins University and NIAID (USA), International Vaccine Institute (Republic of Korea), Centre de Recherches Médicales de Lambaréné (Gabon), Instituto Nacional de Saúde (Mozambique), and Institut National de Recherche Biomédicale du Zaire (Democratic Republic of Congo). Phase I and III trials will enroll healthy African adults and children to assess safety and effectiveness in African populations. Public health leaders note dengue's rising threat in Africa and expect reduced disease burden and healthcare pressure.

triage.headline_ja: KNUSTがデングワクチンのグローバル推進に参加
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はデングワクチン開発プロジェクト（DENSTAR）の国際共同研究イニシアティブに関するもので、既存の感染症アウトブレイクではなく、ワクチン開発の進展状況を報道している。感染症の新規発生・拡大を示す疫学的シグナルではない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はガーナのKNUST（クマシ）を拠点とするデングワクチン開発プロジェクトの進展であり、アウトブレイク報告ではない。複数国の機関が参加する国際共同研究の推進に関するニュースである。Bluedot APIの発生地域フィールドには複数国が列挙されているが、これは研究コンソーシアム参加国を反映したものであり、デング熱の実際の発生地を示していない。シグナルトリアージ対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Philippines, Japan complete 4-year disease surveillance project
article.articleSummary: Philippines and Japan completed a four-year effort to strengthen the Philippines’ health laboratory network and infectious-disease surveillance. The Project for Strengthening the Philippine National Health Laboratory Network for Infectious Diseases (PHeLNIDs), July 2022–June 2026, advanced genomic surveillance, data analytics, and outbreak preparedness. Outputs include a tiered lab-network plan, quality-assurance tools, and guidance on supply chains and procurement; plus a national Whole Genome Sequencing (WGS) strategy and training program. Thirty-two regional and DOH personnel were trained in Japan on lab management, WGS, and analytics; the Philippines hosted 21 workshops for over 300 DOH staff and health workers on lab management, biosafety, biosecurity, and surveillance analytics. The program strengthens lab-based surveillance and testing for measles, rubella, cholera, dengue, diphtheria, pertussis, influenza-like illness, and severe acute respiratory illness. It coincides with the 70th anniversary of Japan-Philippines diplomatic ties; related projects include rapid rabies diagnosis and essential NCD interventions in primary care.

triage.headline_ja: フィリピンと日本が4年間の疾病監視プロジェクトを完了
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は感染症アウトブレイクを報じるものではなく、フィリピンの保健検査所ネットワークと感染症監視システムの強化に関する協力プロジェクトの完了報告である。新規の疾病発生やリスク増加を示す証拠がなく、IHR基準・WPROスクリーニング基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事はフィリピンと日本の技術協力プロジェクト完了の報告で、疾病監視能力の構築・強化を目的とした公衆衛生介入である。記事内に言及されている疾患（コレラ、ジフテリア、麻疹、狂犬病、百日咳、インフルエンザ、風疹、デング熱）は監視対象疾患として挙げられているが、新規の多発や重大なアウトブレイク報告は含まれていない。シグナル値しない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak tests global response systems - CNBC Africa
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) is the second-largest on record, with more than 1,100 confirmed cases and nearly 300 deaths. It is caused by the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no licensed vaccine or approved treatment. The outbreak is crossing borders as global health agencies race to contain transmission and mobilize financing for emergency response. The crisis raises fresh questions about pandemic preparedness and the adequacy of funding for rapid, cross-border responses. The CNBC Africa report features Dr. Emanuele Capobianco, Director of Global Health Security at Gavi, discussing the crisis. As of 2026-06-26, the piece underscores the imperative of strengthened international coordination and sustainable financing to manage ongoing transmission and future outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ感染症アウトブレイク、世界的対応システムを試す - CNBC Africa
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準において4つすべてに該当。確認症例1,100以上、死亡300近くの重大な公衆衛生上の影響、国境を超える拡大、ワクチン・治療法の欠如による国際的なリスク。
triage.notes: 過去2番目の規模のエボラアウトブレイク。Bundibugyo株によるもので、ライセンス取得済みワクチンがない。国際的な対応と資金調達が急務。Gavi等グローバルヘルス機関が言及されており、パンデミック準備態勢に関する国際的関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Air France приостановила полеты между Парижем и Киншасой после выявления вируса Эбола у пассажира
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Air France suspended flights between Paris and Kinshasa after the Ebola virus was detected in a passenger.
article.articleSummary: Air France temporarily suspended flights between Paris and Kinshasa after Ebola was detected in a passenger on the Kinshasa–Paris flight that arrived at Charles de Gaulle on 23 June 2026. The outbreak began in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo on 15 May 2026, with the Ituri province as the epicenter. As of 26 June 2026, DRC has 1,155 confirmed Ebola cases and 304 deaths; cases and deaths have also been reported in neighboring Uganda. France had previously confirmed its first Ebola case, in a humanitarian worker who returned from DRC and was hospitalized in a specialized facility. The suspension of Kinshasa–Paris flights is described as temporary. The incident involves an imported Ebola case linked to the DRC outbreak and affects international air travel.

triage.headline_ja: Air Franceがパリ-キンシャサ間のフライトを一時停止、乗客からエボラウイルスが検出
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、国際的拡大リスク、既に複数国への拡大、航空便停止による渡航制限）。重大な国際感染症シグナルとしてフルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス感染が確認された乗客がパリに到着済みで、既に国際的拡大が発生している。DRC国内での大規模アウトブレイク（1,155確定症例、304死亡）に加え、ウガンダへの波及、フランスでの輸入症例確認、航空便の運航停止という多層的な国際的影響が確認されている。既存のWHO緊急対応メカニズム（PHEIC該当可能性）との関連も検討が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Bundibugyo Ebola Outbreak Exceeds 1,000 Cases, With First Case Outside Africa And 70% Chance Of Spread To A New Country
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak centered in DR Congo’s Ituri Province has reached 1,048 lab-confirmed cases and 267 deaths as of June 22, with Uganda reporting 20 confirmed cases and a first imported case in Europe (a French doctor in France). This marks the first case outside Africa for the current outbreak; ECDC urges EU preparedness. Vaccines are not yet available for Bundibugyo; existing licensed Ebola vaccines target the Zaire (Orthoebolavirus zairense) strain. There was a six-week delay between initial cases and official confirmation. The outbreak’s setting—Ituri’s conflict-affected, weak health system with displacement—complicates response. WHO modeling projects a central scenario of up to 8,210 cases by September 2026, with a worst-case 66,000 if controls fail. There is a nearly 70% chance of at least one case in South Sudan, driven by cross-border movement from DRC and Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: ブンディブギョ・エボラ感染症の流行が1,000例を超過、アフリカ外初の事例とともに新規国への拡大リスク70%
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROs criteria5つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の越境・国際的拡大（フランスでも確認）、高い死亡率、管理困難な地理的・社会的背景を備える。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC（イトゥリ州）を震源地とするブンディブギョエボラの流行を主題としており、DRCが対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。発生地域にはウガンダ・スーダン・フランスも列挙されているが、記事サマリーではDRCが流行の中心であり、ウガンダは20例の確認例、フランスは輸入例として記述されている。ウガンダ（対象国リスト未掲載）およびスーダン（対象国リスト未掲載）、フランス（対象国リスト未掲載）は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。WHOモデリングで2026年9月までに最大8,210例、ワーストシナリオ66,000例の予測、南スーダンへの拡大可能性70%という深刻なリスク評価が示されている。ワクチン未利用可、確認の遅延（6週間）、紛争地帯での対応困難性など複合的リスク要因が指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: Sarampo em São Paulo: governo confirma novos casos e reforça vacinação de bebês
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles in São Paulo: Government confirms new cases and reinforces vaccination for infants.
article.articleSummary: Three new measles cases confirmed in São Paulo state on 2026-06-26, in the capital and Guarulhos, with the government recommending a dose-zero of the triple viral (measles-mumps-rubella) vaccine for 6–11‑month‑old infants. Patients are between 6 months and 1 year old; two had no vaccination history and no recent travel; origin under investigation. This brings 2026 total to five measles cases in São Paulo, after two imported cases in March and April (a 6‑month‑old infant and a 42‑year‑old man), both unvaccinated and recovered. Public health actions include house-to-house surveillance and expanded vaccination at bus terminals, metro stations, trains, and airports. Current coverage is 85.32% for the first dose and 72.06% for the second. Dose zero provides added protection but does not replace the routine schedule: first dose at 12 months, second at 15 months (preferably tetraviral). Guidance for age groups and healthcare workers and the Vacina 100 Dúvidas portal are provided.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州における麻疹：政府が新規症例を確認し、乳幼児のワクチン接種を強化
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルで麻疹、流行性耳下腺炎、風疹の3疾患が同時に検出され、国内での感染が確認された異常事例。IHR基準で「異常性・予想外性」が明確であり、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当（異常/予想外、重症度あり、流行感染のリスク）。フルRRA実施の必要性がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づき、ブラジル（サンパウロ州）での麻疹クラスターが確認される。2026年に5症例に達し、未接種者と部分的ワクチン接種者が含まれている。ただし、記事原文の本文が提供されていないため、詳細情報については後続の続報確認が推奨される。ワクチン接種率（第1回85.32%、第2回72.06%）は維持されているが、流行リスクは存在する。

article.articleHeadline: Число случаев заболевания лихорадкой Эбола в Демократической Республике Конго возросло до 1155
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of Ebola fever cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has risen to 1,155.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 1,155 confirmed cases and 304 deaths, with 138 recoveries and 318 patients still under treatment (case fatality rate ~26.3%). Since the outbreak was declared on May 15, a 90-day cross-border plan between DRC and Uganda aims to strengthen laboratory capacity and clinical intervention, especially in Ituri province around Aru. Uganda reports 20 cases and 2 deaths. No approved treatment or vaccine exists for this outbreak, which is caused by the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain. The initial cluster emerged in Ituri with 246 suspected cases and 65 deaths, and the WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17. Historical notes: Ebola first appeared in 1976 near the Ebola River (Nzara, Sudan; Yambuku, DRC), with later West Africa outbreaks (2014–2017) causing ~30,000 cases and ~11,000 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ熱患者数が1,155人に増加
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の確認患者1,155人、死亡304人という重大な公衆衛生影響。WHOが5月17日にPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）を宣言し、ウガンダへの越境拡大が確認されている。IHR基準4項目全て該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCを主要な発生地として記述。ウガンダでの20例、2死亡は越境拡大を示すが、DRCが流行の中心地。Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain（過去ほど致死率が高くない株）であっても、1,155確認例、304死亡、26.3%の致死率は深刻。WHOがPHEIC宣言済み。対象国リストのDRCのみ該当。

article.articleHeadline: Saiba o que é tuberculose, doença citada por defesa de Oruam | CNN Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Find out what tuberculosis is, the disease cited by Oruam's defense | CNN Brasil
article.articleSummary: Pulmonary tuberculosis (Mycobacterium tuberculosis) features in a Rio de Janeiro case in which rapper Oruam’s defense asserts he has TB and asks for release from preventive detention; the court denied due to lack of official medical documents. TB is an infectious, airborne disease, with more than 85% of cases occurring in the lungs. Transmission happens via droplets expelled when coughing, sneezing, talking or singing, especially in crowded closed settings such as prisons, homes, workplaces and shelters. Symptoms include a persistent cough for three weeks or more, weight loss, fever (late afternoon), night sweats, fatigue, loss of appetite and weakness; sputum can be blood-tinged. Diagnosis combines clinical assessment, chest X-ray, sputum bacilloscopy, rapid molecular test (DNA-based) and culture; early treatment can begin with a positive molecular result and compatible symptoms. The standard SUS regimen lasts six months, with two initial months of four drugs (rifampicin, isoniazid, pyrazinamide, ethambutol) in one tablet, followed by continuation. If diagnosed, treatment is delivered via the prison medical system.

triage.headline_ja: オルアムの弁護側が引用した疾患、結核について知る | CNN Brasil
triage.triage_reason: ラッパーの個別刑事事件における結核の医学的背景説明に過ぎず、公衆衛生上の異常な事象、流行、または新規の疾患クラスターではない。既知疾患の一般的な医学情報記事であり、感染症危機管理対象外。
triage.notes: 本記事は個別の刑事事件におけるラッパーの結核主張に関するニュースであり、ブラジルでの結核の新規流行、クラスター、または未制御の感染症事象を示していない。結核の一般的な医学情報と個別症例の背景説明に該当し、シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Cas d'Ebola en France : la compagnie Air France suspend ses vols Paris-Kinshasa jusqu'à samedi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Case in France: Air France Suspends Its Paris-Kinshasa Flights Until Saturday.
article.articleSummary: First Ebola case diagnosed in France, in a physician who had returned from the Democratic Republic of the Congo, a country currently experiencing a major outbreak. Air France suspended its Paris–Kinshasa flights following the identification of a positive case, with services due to resume on Saturday. The incident constitutes an imported Ebola infection in France, linked to travel from an outbreak zone in the DRC. No further patient details or outcomes are provided in the article. The Democratic Republic of the Congo continues to face a substantial Ebola epidemic, underscoring risks of international spread through travel. Public health authorities are monitoring the response.

triage.headline_ja: フランスでエボラ出血熱症例：エアフランス、パリ-キンシャサ便を土曜日まで運航停止
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。国際的な病原体移動（DRCからフランスへの輸入症例）、航空便の運航停止を含む国際的な影響、および世界的な懸念を生じる可能性のある事例。
triage.notes: 本記事は2026年6月26日配信で、フランスで初のエボラ症例が確認された事例。患者はDRCの大規模流行地域から帰国した医師。DRCが対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に追加。フランスはWHO通知対象国ではあるが、対象国リストに含まれないため除外した。航空便運航停止による渡航制限が具体的に実行されており、IHR基準の渡航・貿易制限項目に該当。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Oltre 100 casi di salmonella in Europa: scatta l'allerta sui germogli prodotti in Italia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 100 cases of Salmonella in Europe: alert issued for sprouts produced in Italy.
article.articleSummary: Salmonella Bovismorbificans outbreak linked to alfalfa sprouts produced in Italy, with India-sourced seeds, affecting 11 European countries plus the United Kingdom. By May 2026, 109 confirmed EU/UK cases; Finland (35), the United Kingdom (30), and the Netherlands (17) are most affected. Eighteen hospitalisations and two deaths (Finland) have occurred. About 50 suspected cases remain under investigation in four other Member States. Investigations identify alfalfa sprouts as the main vehicle; other sprouted seeds may be involved. The same Salmonella strain was found in production water in the Netherlands and the UK. The contamination likely entered Europe via two shipments from India in October 2025. Measures include recalls, product withdrawals, production suspensions, and destruction of suspect lots. Sprouts pose a microbiological risk since they are often eaten raw. Consumers, especially vulnerable groups, should seek medical care if symptoms arise. ECDC and EFSA continue monitoring; outbreak evolving.

triage.headline_ja: イタリア産もやしに関連した100件以上のサルモネラ菌がヨーロッパで発生：イタリア産発芽種子についてアラートが発令
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当（重症度、流行しやすさ、管理可能性）。対象国インドが関与し、マルチ国家の食品由来アウトブレイク。
triage.notes: 記事は主にヨーロッパ（イタリア、オランダ、フィンランド、イギリス）での発生を論じているが、対象国リストではインドのみに該当。インドがアルファルファ種子の汚染源とされている。109確認症例、2死亡、18入院。食品由来アウトブレイク（生食リスク）。ECDCとEFSAが監視中。

article.articleHeadline: Kerala reports 8 more Shigella cases; June tally climbs to 180
article.articleSummary: Kerala reported eight new Shigella infections in June, raising the monthly total to 180 and the year-to-date to 256; six deaths have been linked to the outbreak. The new cases were from Kozhikode (3), Wayanad (2), Ernakulam (1), Thrissur (1), and Malappuram (1). Outbreaks are declared in Kozhikode (61 in June), Wayanad (25), Thrissur (13), and Alappuzha (5). Other June counts include Malappuram 25, Thiruvananthapuram 18, Kollam 12, Kannur 11, Ernakulam 4, Idukki 3, and Palakkad 3. Nipah surveillance: one high-risk contact, a Nipah patient’s coworker, completed a 21-day quarantine without symptoms and was released. No new Nipah contacts admitted; four very high-risk, 13 high-risk, and 75 low-risk contacts remain under observation. The Nipah patient remains on ventilator at Kozhikode Government Medical College Hospital; 69 Ramanattukara households were visited and 92 public calls received.

triage.headline_ja: ケーラ州は6月にシガラ菌感染を8例報告。6月の累計は180例に増加
triage.triage_reason: ニパウイルスおよびシガラ菌の複合感染症イベントであり、ニパウイルス患者が人工呼吸器治療中で重症、複数地域での多数患者発生が報告されている。IHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、異常性）に該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準（重症度、流行しやすさ）も満たす。
triage.notes: 記事はシガラ菌の大規模発生（6月180例、累計256例、死者6名）を主題としているが、同時にニパウイルス患者の重症化（人工呼吸器治療中）と濃厚接触者の監視が継続中。ケーラ州内の10地区以上に及ぶ多地域発生であり、公衆衛生上の重要なシグナル。ニパウイルスは高い致死率を持つ新興感染症として国際的関心も高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola face ravagii în Republica Democratică Congo: peste 300 de morți și peste 1.100 de cazuri raportate
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola ravages the Democratic Republic of the Congo: more than 300 deaths and more than 1,100 cases reported.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), declared May 15 and still uncontrolled, reports 1,115 infections and 304 deaths per the National Institute of Public Health (INSP). This is the DRC’s 17th Ebola outbreak, concentrated in Ituri Province, with Bunia city accounting for 91.3% of infections and 82.2% of deaths. The hemorrhagic fever virus has spread to two other DRC provinces and neighbouring Uganda, where 20 infections (including 2 deaths) are reported. The current outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo strain, for which no vaccines or approved treatments exist; WHO notes clinical trials should begin next week. One imported case was detected in France in a Congolese doctor with NGO Anima after a mission in Ituri, prompting exposure among five contacts. Air France suspended Kinshasa–Paris flights briefly; authorities consider Europe’s risk low. DRC requires a 21-day quarantine for travelers from affected zones.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがコンゴ民主共和国で猛威：300人以上の死亡と1,100人以上の感染が報告される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、Bundibugyo株による制御不能なエボラ出血熱の多国間拡大（DRC、ウガンダ、フランス）が確認される。死亡数多数、国際的懸念が高い。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株によるエボラ出血熱の制御不能な多国間拡大。ウガンダやフランスへの輸入症例も報告されているが、記事サマリーの主題はDRCでのアウトブレークである。DRCの17番目のエボラアウトブレークであり、Ituri州が最も影響を受けている。ワクチンと承認された治療法がないことが重大な懸念要因。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Is Devastating Congo. Uganda Found a Way to Stop It.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-26, Ebola is devastating the Democratic Republic of Congo, with spillover into neighboring Uganda. Uganda has largely contained the cross-border outbreak, reporting 20 confirmed cases and two deaths. Ugandan authorities credit aggressive virus-control methods with achieving containment. The cross-border transmission from DR Congo highlights ongoing risk to Uganda and other neighbors even as Uganda's case and death counts remain far lower than the Congo outbreak’s toll. The article underscores the border spillover as a key feature of the current Ebola dynamics in the region. As of 2026-06-26, the cross-border spread from DR Congo underscores ongoing regional risk while Uganda's response has kept case and death counts comparatively low.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがコンゴを壊滅させている。ウガンダがそれを止める方法を見つけた。
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、異常/予想外な国際的拡大、国際的蔓延リスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスク）。エボラウイルス病は高い致死性、国境を越えた拡大、複数国での確認が特徴。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRコンゴとウガンダの両国が明記されているが、対象国リストではDRコンゴ（203312）のみ含まれる。ウガンダは対象国リストに該当しないため verified_locations から除外。エボラの国際的拡大と両国への影響が述べられているにもかかわらず、対象国基準に基づき DRC のみリスト化。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola essai clinique Oms en République démocratique du Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola WHO clinical trial in the Democratic Republic of the Congo
article.articleSummary: WHO will launch next week in the DRC a trial to evaluate two experimental therapies—MBP134 and remdesivir—given separately or together to reduce mortality from Ebola Bundibugyo. The study is led by INRB (DRC), Alima, Oxford, and WHO, announced by Tedros in Geneva; preparations are complete. Medications were donated by the United States and Gilead Sciences. EU has mobilized about 167 million euros to accelerate Ebola vaccines and therapies via EDCTP, though no EU funding is publicly allocated to this trial. France has confirmed its first Ebola case, a physician who contracted it during a mission in DRC with Alima; he is stable. Bundibugyo causes hemorrhagic fever transmitted by contact with infected fluids.
