Since outbreak began, 304 deaths (CFR 26.3%) and about 80 health workers infected; diagnostics exceed 2,000/day across nine labs; hospital capacity >500 beds in 19 centers. Ongoing challenges: funding gaps, insecurity, contact tracing, and access restrictions.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ WHO臨床試験 コンゴ民主共和国での実施
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の多国間での確認、高い死亡率（CFR 26.3%）、国際的な臨床試験展開、および複数国への拡大が認識されており、IHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: DRCにおけるエボラ・ブンディブギョ患者304例（CFR 26.3%）、フランスでの医療従事者の症例確認、WHOによる国際多機関臨床試験（MBP134、remdesivir）の開始予定、医療従事者の感染（約80名）、資金不足と治安課題が継続。発生地域フィールドに含まれるジュネーブ、スイス、フランス、米国は試験実施支援国またはメディア配信地域であり、実際の疫学的発生地は対象国ではないためDRCのみに限定。

article.articleHeadline: Expertos alertan sobre el aumento del dengue durante el periodo de vacaciones en Colombia | Noticias RCN
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Experts warn of a rise in dengue during the vacation period in Colombia | RCN News
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever in Colombia rises during the vacation period. As of June 20, 2026, the National Institute of Health (INS) reports 52,518 dengue cases in Colombia, including 31,733 without warning signs, 20,241 with warning signs, and 544 severe cases; 30 deaths have been registered to date. In the week of June 14–20, 2,778 new cases were reported. The heaviest burden is in Meta, Cesar, Bolívar, Santander, Norte de Santander, Magdalena, La Guajira, and Cartagena. Epidemiological week 24 saw Amazonas, Arauca, Atlántico, Bolívar, Barranquilla, Cartagena, Cesar, Casanare, Meta, Guaviare, La Guajira, Magdalena, and Santa Marta exceed the upper limit, signaling higher-than-expected viral circulation. Dengue is transmitted by Aedes aegypti; the dry season and prevalent water storage may accelerate spread. Travelers are urged to use repellent, sleep under bed nets, wear long sleeves, and eliminate standing water. Symptoms include fever, severe headache, muscle/joint pains, extreme fatigue, nausea/vomiting, drowsiness, and possible breathing difficulties.

triage.headline_ja: コロンビアでバカンス期間中のデング熱感染者増加について専門家が警告
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の大規模流行がコロンビアで発生しており、IHR基準では異常性・予想外性と国際的拡大リスク、WPRO基準では重症度・流行性・管理可能性で複数基準に該当。52,518例、死亡30例の報告と複数地域での流行超過が確認されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの主要な発生地はコロンビアであり、ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれる唯一の国。コロンビアは対象国リストに含まれていないため、検証済み位置はブラジルのみ。ただしサマリーの地理的記述からはコロンビアが主題であることは明確。52,518例、死亡30例、複数地域での流行超過が報告されており、オペレーショナルな関心は非常に高い。

article.articleHeadline: El ébola vuelve con fuerza: más de 300 fallecidos sacuden al Congo | TN8.ni
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola returns with force: more than 300 deaths shake the Congo
article.articleSummary: As of June 26, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo's Ebola outbreak has 1,155 confirmed cases and 304 deaths (lethality 26.3%), with 138 recoveries and 326 hospitalized or under strict medical surveillance. The epicenter is Ituri province, near Uganda and South Sudan, with spread to North and South Kivu. The outbreak was declared on May 15. Uganda has reported 20 infections and 2 deaths, prompting a 90-day cross-border plan to strengthen surveillance, lab capacity, and care. France confirmed its first case, a physician who assisted response in Bunia and developed symptoms on return. The World Health Organization notes Bundibugyo Ebola strain, for which no vaccine or specific treatment exists, and has declared the situation a Public Health Emergency of International Concern due to high regional risk. Contact tracing continues as containment intensifies; this is the third-deadliest Ebola outbreak in history.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱が再び猛威：コンゴでの300人以上の死亡が大きな衝撃
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（深刻な健康影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスク）。WHO公衆衛生緊急事態宣言済み、複数国での確認、高い致死率。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUganda、Sudan、Franceが含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題はDRCでのアウトブレーク。UgandaやFranceは確認事例の報告地として言及されているが、主要な流行地はDRCのItumi州およびSouth Kivu州。WHOがPHEICを宣言済み、ブンディブギョエボラウイルス株、歴史上第3位の致死数を記録中。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en Ituri : les journalistes de Mongwalu formés sur la communication des risques - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Ituri: Mongwalu journalists trained in risk communication - ACP.
article.articleSummary: On 26 June 2026 in Mungbwalu health zone, Ituri, DR Congo, journalists were trained in risk communication, community engagement, and rumor management as part of the Ebola virus disease response. The capacity-building session, funded by Caritas and Cafod through the Ministry of Health and the Mungbwalu health zone, aims to mobilize media as a core component of outbreak actions. WHO risk-communication and community engagement lead Bavon Tanguza emphasized that outbreaks generate both accurate information and misinformation, which can undermine public health efforts; equipped journalists can disseminate reliable messages and collect community concerns to guide actions. Authorities and partners stress that community engagement is a cornerstone of Ebola control and that effective risk communication is essential to counter misinformation during the response.

triage.headline_ja: イトゥリ州のエボラ対策：モングワル地区のジャーナリストがリスク通信研修を受講
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の発生が確認されており、対応活動が進行中だが、本記事は既存の流行に対する啓発・訓練活動を報じているもので、新規イベントではない。より詳細な流行状況の情報が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC（イトゥリ州）でのエボラ対応における啓発活動に焦点を当てており、新規の流行拡大や異常な状況は記述されていない。既存の流行状況下での対応強化と見られる。イトゥリ州での流行規模、患者数、死亡数等の詳細情報が記事に記載されていないため、正確なリスク評価には続報が必要。

article.articleHeadline: US to ship experimental Ebola therapy to DRC and Uganda as outbreak worsens
article.articleSummary: Merck & Co. reports a diversified revenue mix: pharmaceutical products comprise 73.9% of net sales, vaccines 15.5%, animal health products 9.8%, and other 0.8%. The pharmaceutical portfolio targets hypertension, osteoporosis, atherosclerosis, respiratory diseases, bacterial and fungal infections, ophthalmologic and urological conditions, acute migraine, and male hair loss. Geographically, net sales are led by the United States with 56.2% of total, followed by Europe/Middle East/Africa at 22.4%, Latin America 5.2%, Asia/Pacific 4.6%, Japan 4.2%, China 3%, and other regions 4.4%. The published date is 2026-06-26, and the article’s title references the US shipping an experimental Ebola therapy to the DRC and Uganda as an outbreak worsens, but the body focuses on Merck’s sales composition and regional distribution rather than outbreak details.

triage.headline_ja: 米国がエボラ出血熱の実験的治療薬をDRCおよびウガンダに輸送、患者数増加に対応
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の発生がDRCおよびウガンダで報告されており、米国による実験的治療薬の緊急輸送という対応が言及されているが、記事サマリーはMerck社の売上構成に焦点を当てており、具体的な患者数、死亡者数、地理的拡大状況などの詳細情報が不足している。
triage.notes: 記事見出しではウガンダ（Uganda）への治療薬輸送も言及されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めていない。記事サマリーの内容がMerck社の商業情報に偏っており、エボラ出血熱の具体的な発生状況（患者数、死亡者数、症例の重症度等）に関する詳細情報が欠落している。フルRRA実施前に、発生状況の詳細情報収集が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Humap alerta sobre riscos da Salmonella e como prevenir infecções
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Humap warns about the risks of Salmonella and how to prevent infections.
article.articleSummary: Salmonella remains a leading cause of foodborne illness in Brazil, with infections ranging from mild gastroenteritis to severe cases requiring hospitalization. Humap-UFMS (Hospital Universitário Maria Aparecida Pedrossian, Universidade Federal de Mato Grosso do Sul) within the HU Brasil network advises on prevention and recognition of medical needs. Infection commonly results from consuming contaminated food or water; typical symptoms include diarrhea, abdominal pain, fever, nausea, and vomiting. High-risk foods include raw or undercooked eggs, homemade mayonnaise, undercooked poultry meats, unpasteurized milk and dairy, and inadequately cleaned raw vegetables, with cross-contamination a major driver. Outbreaks tend to rise in hot periods, holidays, and large events. Other pathogens causing similar symptoms include E. coli, Campylobacter, Shigella, and Giardia. Most cases resolve with hydration; some require IV fluids, antibiotics, or intensive care. Preventive measures emphasize hand hygiene, proper cooking, pasteurized dairy, avoiding cross-contamination, refrigeration, and heightened precautions at large gatherings.

triage.headline_ja: Humapがサルモネラのリスク警告と感染予防方法について通知
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでのサルモネラを含む食中毒関連の啓発記事であり、異常な発生報告ではなく予防情報が主体。疾患が一般的で重症度は可変的、管理可能性について情報不足のため。
triage.notes: 記事はHumap(ブラジルの大学病院)からのサルモネラ予防啓発であり、特定の流行事例ではなく一般的な食中毒リスク管理の情報。複数の病原体(サルモネラ、E.coli、Campylobacter、ギアルジア)が列挙されているが、具体的な患者数や死亡例の報告は記載されていない。持続的な曝露リスク（食品汚染）と流行しやすさ（特に高温期や大規模イベント時）に該当するがWPRO基準は2つで、社会的・政治的関心の情報が不足しているため、フルRRA前の経過観察段階が適切。

article.articleHeadline: Congress Probes NIH Over Alleged Mpox Virus Smuggling and Biosecurity Lapses - Internewscast Journal
article.articleSummary: Mpox (monkeypox) samples smuggled into the United States by NIH researchers: Dr. Vincent Munster and Claude Kwe were charged June 2 with conspiracy to smuggle mpox into the US and giving false statements. The pair had just returned Jan 25 from a nine-day study trip to the Republic of Congo tied to an ongoing mpox outbreak, and were found at Detroit Metropolitan Airport with 113 sealed vials in a large black case, labeled as diagnostic equipment. Twenty vials tested to date: 17 contained inactivated monkeypox virus, one contained chickenpox, and two contained human DNA; contents of the remaining vials were undisclosed. Importation of biological agents requires proper authorization and declaration. Munster (53) and Kwe (38) pleaded not guilty in Missoula, Montana and were released on bail after surrendering passports. The incident spurred congressional scrutiny of NIH and renewed biosafety concerns at Rocky Mountain Laboratories (BSL-4). Mpox symptoms include fever, swollen lymph nodes, and painful rash; 2024 Africa mpox had 80,276 suspected cases and 1,340 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: 米国議会、NIH職員のMpoxウイルス密輸疑惑とバイオセキュリティ不備を調査
triage.triage_reason: バイオセキュリティ重大インシデント（未許可の生物学的物質密輸）として異常かつ予想外であり、国家レベルの政治的スクラティニーと国際的なバイオセーフティ懸念を喚起している。IHR基準2つ以上該当。
triage.notes: 本事件は感染症疫学的なシグナルというより、バイオセキュリティ・生物防御上の重大インシデントである。米国内での実際の流行リスクは現在のところ限定的と見えるが、未許可の生物学的物質の密輸、NIH内の管理体制不備、BSL-4施設の監督強化といった政策・国家安全保障上の影響は甚大である。コンゴでの在来的なMpox流行とは別個の事象。

article.articleHeadline: السعودية: تعليق السفر إلى 3 دول للحد من مخاطر تفشي " إيبولا"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Saudi Arabia: Travel suspension to three countries to curb the risk of an Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Saudi Arabia suspended travel and visa issuance for citizens traveling to the Democratic Republic of Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan, and barred entry of travelers from these countries, including transit passengers who had resided there in the 21 days before arrival. The preventive move aims to curb Ebola risk, backed by ongoing risk surveillance, enhanced entry screening, and rapid health-response mechanisms. Measures follow ongoing precautionary steps since July 2019 and a May 2026 tightening for neighboring outbreak zones, with additional controls on Rwanda, Burundi, Tanzania, and the Republic of the Congo (Brazzaville) to strengthen port-of-entry screening. The Public Health Authority, Weqaya, states the overall health situation is reassuring and under close watch, with no confirmed or suspected Ebola cases in Saudi Arabia since the measures began, as international coordination remains ongoing.

triage.headline_ja: サウジアラビア：エボラ流行リスクを軽減するため3カ国への渡航を一時停止
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスは国際的に極めて重大な脅威であり、複数国での発生（DRC、ウガンダ、南スーダン）と国際的な渡航制限措置の実施により、IHR基準3項目以上（異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限）に該当。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当し、社会政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事は複数国（DRC、ウガンダ、南スーダン、ルワンダ、ブルンジ、タンザニア）に言及しているが、対象国リストに該当するのはDRC（203312）のみ。エボラは極めて高いリスク疾患で、複数国での同時発生、国際的な渡航制限措置、強化された入国スクリーニングなど、フルRRA実施の優先度は非常に高い。サウジアラビアでの確認患者なしとのことだが、周辺国での流行リスク管理が重点となる。

article.articleHeadline: The US Is About to Deport an Immigrant to the Center of the Ebola Crisis
article.articleSummary: 78-year-old Edward Nalwamba, a Uganda-born immigrant living in Colorado, is slated for deportation to Uganda from an Aurora detention facility amid an Ebola outbreak centered in Uganda and the Democratic Republic of the Congo that has killed more than 300 people; the CDC has issued a travel health notice urging enhanced precautions for Uganda. Nalwamba arrived in the United States in 2002 on a tourist visa and sought asylum after alleging persecution by Ugandan authorities; his asylum petition faced filing issues and he has been in detention since September 2025. In detention, his health has deteriorated, with a prior pneumonia diagnosis, signs of malnutrition, and now an active illness with chills, extreme weakness, and a severe chest-and-rib-pain cough. His attorney says he fears return to Uganda, and the case unfolds amid post-2024 U.S. immigration policy shifts that have expanded DHS resources while cutting foreign aid.

triage.headline_ja: 米国がエボラ危機の中心地へ移民を強制送還しようとしている
triage.triage_reason: エボラの活発な流行地域（ウガンダ・DRC）への強制送還が計画されており、IHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク）を満たす。また被送還者の既往症・現症が懸念される。
triage.notes: 記事はウガンダ・DRCでの活発なエボラ流行（300人以上の死亡）を背景に、ウガンダ生まれの移民の強制送還が計画されている事案。CDCが旅行健康注意を発令。被送還者の現症（咳、胸部痛、衰弱等）がエボラを示唆するかどうかは未確認だが、流行地域への送還という文脈で公衆衛生リスクが高い。フルRRA推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Ебола стигла у Француску
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola has arrived in France.
article.articleSummary: Air France suspended Paris–Kinshasa flights through June 27 after a physician who traveled the route tested positive for Ebola. In coordination with local authorities, enhanced health screening is planned before boarding at Kinshasa airport. French health authorities confirmed the first Ebola case on French soil linked to a doctor returning from a humanitarian mission in the Democratic Republic of Congo. The patient is hospitalized in a specialized facility and placed in isolation; authorities are tracing and monitoring contacts. The overall risk to the general population in France and Europe is considered low. In the Democratic Republic of Congo, confirmed Ebola cases have risen to 1,155, with 304 deaths, as of June 26, 2026. The article notes ongoing outbreak context and international travel implications.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがフランスに到着した
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限実施）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当。エボラウイルス病は国際的に最高度の関心対象疾患であり、フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはパリの医師がDRC渡航後にエボラ陽性となり、フランスで確認された最初のケースと述べている。しかしフランスは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。DRCでの確認症例は1,155件、死亡304件と深刻。国際的な移動制限（Air France路線の運航停止）が既に実施されており、極めて高いリスクレベル。

article.articleHeadline: സംസ്ഥാനത്ത് 95 ഡെങ്കിപ്പനി കേസുകള്‍; മൂന്ന് മരണം
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 95 dengue fever cases in the state; three deaths.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-06-26, the state reports a dengue surge with 95 new dengue cases confirmed today and three deaths. Dengue cases for the month reach 1,802. The total fever burden in the state stands at 9,817. In addition to dengue, reports include amebic meningitis (amebic brain fever), influenza, and another febrile illness described as 'eleippani'; 11 cases involve amebic brain fever and 19 involve hepatitis. Public health authorities urge intensified mosquito control and the purification of drinking-water sources. Citizens are advised to avoid self-medication for fever and to seek urgent care at nearby hospitals if symptoms develop. The report indicates broad spread beyond dengue and calls for reinforced public health measures.

triage.headline_ja: 州内で95件のデング熱患者；3人の死亡報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な発生、国際的拡大リスク）。複数疾患同時発生（デング熱、インフルエンザ、肝炎、アメーバ髄膜炎）と死亡事例があり、WPRO基準でも重症度・流行可能性が確認される。
triage.notes: 複数疾患の同時発生（デング熱95件/日、肝炎19件、アメーバ髄膜炎11件、インフルエンザ）および3人の死亡が報告されている。月間デング熱患者数1,802件、州全体の発熱症例9,817件と大規模流行の兆候。公衆衛生当局の介入と市民への警告が発出されている。蚊媒介感染症の拡大リスクおよび飲料水汚染対策の必要性から、国際的な関心と支援が必要な状況。

article.articleHeadline: Surto de tuberculose em macacos fecha o único centro de atendimento do Ibama a animais silvestres feridos no Rio de Janeiro
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tuberculosis outbreak in monkeys closes IBAMA's only wildlife care center for injured wild animals in Rio de Janeiro.
article.articleSummary: Tuberculosis outbreak among capuchin monkeys at Cetas-RJ, Ibama’s wildlife triage center in Rio de Janeiro, prompted May 18 suspensions of animal intake and release. The Seropédica facility houses 989 animals: 51 capuchin monkeys, 503 birds, and 2 jaguars. Necropsies with Fiocruz and UFRRJ confirmed TB as the death cause for three capuchins; the suspected source is a contaminated animal that entered in 2024–2025. All animals and staff are being tested; about 50 assays have been conducted, one initially positive but later negative, and no human infections reported. A red emergency protocol is in effect; PPE including N95 masks is used, and eight enclosures will be sampled. This is the unit’s second shutdown in weeks; a prior April 29 restriction limited intake. A 2025 agreement with Inea remains unfulfilled, affecting feeding, medicines, and lab testing costs above R$3 million annually and animal transfers, prompting search for alternatives like Estácio’s CRAS in Vargem Grande.

triage.headline_ja: リオデジャネイロのサルの結核アウトブレイク、Ibama野生動物ケアセンターを閉鎖
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルの野生動物施設（サル）での結核アウトブレイクであり、公衆衛生への直接的な影響は限定的（人感染なし、職員検査で陽性確認なし）。ただし施設閉鎖という異常事態、スタッフ曝露リスク、野生動物の疾病管理上の懸念があるため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 本事例は人畜共通感染症（結核）ですが、現在のところ人への感染報告はなく、公開情報による人感染リスク評価は低い。ただし野生動物施設での結核アウトブレイクは異常事態であり、職員の継続的な検査と感染管理状況の監視が必要。WPRO対象国リストにはブラジルが含まれていないため、WPROスクリーニングの直接適用外だが、感染症危機管理上の関心対象として評価。

article.articleHeadline: السعودية: تعليق السفر إلى 3 دول للحد من مخاطر تفشي " إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Saudi Arabia: Suspension of travel to three countries to limit the risk of an Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Saudi Arabia suspends travel to the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan to limit the risk of an Ebola outbreak. The suspension blocks issuance of all visa types and entry for travelers from these countries, including those who have stayed there within the 21 days before arriving in Saudi Arabia. The move follows ongoing risk assessments by the Kingdom’s health surveillance and response system, with precautionary measures in place since July 2019 and tightened in May 2026 for entrants from outbreak-neighboring regions and at entry points. Authorities say the aim is to protect public health for citizens, residents, and visitors, and to contribute to global health security by preemptively reducing cross-border transmission risk.

triage.headline_ja: サウジアラビア：エボラ流行のリスク低減のため3カ国への渡航を一時停止
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の発生報告であり、国際的な渡航制限措置が実施されている。IHR基準（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限）に複数該当し、WPRO基準（異常性、流行リスク、管理可能性）にも該当する。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーにおいて、エボラ発生が報告されているのはコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）である。ウガンダおよび南スーダンは隣接地域として渡航制限の対象国として列挙されているが、これらの国での発生報告は記事サマリーに明示されていない。したがって verified_locations には DRC のみを含める。対象国リストにはDRCのみ含まれるため、他のアフリカ諸国は対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Nagaland to administer oral polio vaccine to over 1.40 lakh children
article.articleSummary: Nagaland will observe National Immunization Day on June 28, targeting 1,43,530 children under five across all districts to receive two drops of oral polio vaccine (OPV), irrespective of prior vaccination. The drive aims to prevent re-introduction of poliovirus from endemic countries and sustain India’s polio-free status since 2014. Immunization runs from 8:00 AM to 3:00 PM at designated polio booths in Kohima and across districts. Health workers will mark each child’s left little finger with indelible ink after vaccination to ensure coverage. State Immunization Officer Dr. Imkong Temsu Longchar urged parents and caregivers to bring children and called on civil society groups, faith leaders, village councils, Lions Clubs, Rotary International, IMA, and IAP to assist in awareness and mobilization to achieve 100% coverage and keep India polio-free.

triage.headline_ja: ナガランド州が約143,530人の子どもにポリオワクチンを経口投与する方針
triage.triage_reason: ポリオは国際的に懸念される感染症であり、インドの予防接種キャンペーン報道は関心を集めるが、本記事は予防的な定期予防接種実施の告知であり、新たな発症事例やアウトブレイク検出ではない。情報が限定的なため経過観察段階が適切。
triage.notes: 本記事はポリオウイルスの再導入を予防するためのルーチン予防接種キャンペーンの告知である。インドは2014年以来ポリオ根絶を維持している。記事にはポリオ症例の報告や活発な流行の兆候がなく、計画された公衆衛生活動として説明されている。社会的・政治的関心は高いが、シグナル重要度は低い。

article.articleHeadline: EUA vão enviar terapia experimental contra o Ebola para RDC e Uganda à medida que surto se agrava
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: U.S. to send experimental Ebola therapy to the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda as the outbreak worsens.
article.articleSummary: As of 26 June 2026, the United States is sending experimental Ebola therapy MBP134 doses to the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda to help address an ongoing Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak. The Bundibugyo strain currently lacks approved vaccines or treatments, prompting use of an experimental monoclonal antibody therapy developed with Mapp Biopharmaceutical for compassionate use in affected countries. In parallel, the U.S. ASPR/BARDA is also facilitating doses for a randomized clinical trial led by the University of Oxford to assess MBP134’s efficacy. MBP134 has shown activity against multiple Ebola species in preclinical studies and has completed an initial safety trial. Data gathered during this outbreak could inform future regulatory decisions. BARDA previously stockpiled 2,500 rapid diagnostic tests to support outbreak detection and public health response in Africa.

triage.headline_ja: EUAが病気の悪化に伴い、RDCとウガンダに対するエボラの実験的治療を送付
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の発生確認、複数国への国際的拡大、重篤な公衆衛生上の影響、実験的治療の展開という国際的関心が高い事象。IHR基準3つ以上該当。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo Ebola strain outbreak in DRC and Uganda confirmed. MBP134 experimental monoclonal antibody therapy deployment indicates high-level international response coordination. Uganda is not in the target country list for verification. Only DRC (203312) is included in verified_locations per protocol.

article.articleHeadline: Wakacje z hantawirusem i Ebolą. Lekarze podpowiadają, jak zmniejszyć zagrożenie
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Holidays with hantavirus and Ebola. Doctors advise on how to reduce the risk.
article.articleSummary: As of 26 June 2026, rapid Ebola infections are reported in Central Africa, with imagery from Bunia, Democratic Republic of the Congo showing workers removing bodies on 13 June 2026. Separately, a hantavirus incident on the Dutch cruise ship MV Hondius triggered quarantines and heightened media attention in Poland, though officials say hantavirus is far less contagious than SARS-CoV-2. The Ebola outbreak has rekindled public concern about a new pandemic, amplified by social media chatter; the Institute of Media Monitoring noted that platforms like TikTok accounted for roughly 70% of online interactions. The article highlights ongoing infectious threats linked to travel and outbreaks in Central Africa, while cautioning against overblown risk perception without presented, specific case counts.

triage.headline_ja: ハンタウイルスとエボラ休暇。医師が脅威を減らす方法をアドバイス
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。エボラ出血熱の中央アフリカでの報告は深刻度が高く、国際的な関心と対応の必要性が高い。
triage.notes: 記事はエボラとハンタウイルスの2つの疾患を扱っているが、DRC（ブニア）でのエボラ感染が主要なイベント。ハンタウイルスはオランダのクルーズ船MV Hondiusの事例で、DRCでの発生ではない。ポーランドはソース配信国であり、発生国ではないため除外。社会的関心は非常に高く（TikTok上での相互作用70%）、パンデミック懸念が増幅されている状況。ただし具体的な症例数が記事本文に記載されていない点は注意。

article.articleHeadline: Scientists infected a 'vagina on a chip' with gonorrhea -- then cured it with a new antibiotic found by AI
article.articleSummary: Gonorrhea (Neisseria gonorrhoeae) remains a drug-resistant threat. In the United States, >500,000 people are infected annually; symptoms include pain and discharge, with untreated infection risking infertility and adverse pregnancy outcomes for mothers and newborns. Global ceftriaxone resistance is rising: about 0.1% in the U.S., up to 10% in some Chinese provinces, and 27% in Hanoi, Vietnam. Researchers used AI to screen ~6 million compounds after training on 1,755 approved drugs, identifying 213 hits and narrowing to MP20 as a leading candidate. MP20 was tested in a vagina-on-a-chip, showing it crosses epithelial barriers and achieves bactericidal concentrations, performing as well as ceftriaxone against Neisseria gonorrhoeae on the chip. Further safety and site-specific pharmacokinetics (penis, rectum, throat, vagina) studies are needed before clinical use; study published 2026-06-17 in Science Translational Medicine.

triage.headline_ja: 科学者が『チップ上の膣』に淋病を感染させ、AIが発見した新しい抗生物質で治療した
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は基礎研究（AI創薬とインビトロモデルの開発）に関する学術報告であり、実際の感染症アウトブレイクイベントではない。淋病の背景情報は提供されているが、新規の公衆衛生的危機や異常な発生報告は含まれていない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は淋病治療薬の研究開発（AI創薬とチップオンボディ技術）であり、実際の流行や新規感染症イベントの報告ではない。記事内でハノイとアメリカの淋病耐性率が言及されているが、これは背景情報であり、本記事自体は新規の発生報告ではない。したがって verified_locations は空配列とする。シグナルトリアージの対象外の科学論文報道。

article.articleHeadline: Multi-country Bundibugyo Ebola Virus Disease Outbreak - Situation Report No. 6
article.articleSummary: As of 23 June, the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) reported >1,000 Bundibugyo Ebola virus disease (BVD) cases; on 24 June Uganda confirmed 20 more. Cross-border movements drive transmission, prompting urgent multisectoral response. Achievements include >1.7 million health screenings at points of entry/control and risk communication outreach to 117,258 people in cross-border communities. Surveillance and preparedness were strengthened at 35 PoEs and 57 PoCs in DRC, with additional support in Ethiopia, Rwanda and South Sudan; thermal scanners, hand sanitizer dispensers and frontline training have been deployed. Ongoing challenges include 14.9 million people in need of humanitarian assistance in DRC, with insecurity and access constraints hampering response. IOM focuses on cross-border communities and PoEs/PoCs, scaling up in DRC and Uganda (Priority 1a) and Burundi, Rwanda, South Sudan (Priority 1b), with preparedness in other at-risk states (Priority 2).

triage.headline_ja: 多国間ブンディブギョエボラウイルス病アウトブレイク - 状況報告書第6号
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の多国間アウトブレイク（DRC1000例以上、ウガンダ20例確認）で、IHR基準4項目全て該当。国際的な拡大と国家間の移動に伴う急速な感染拡大リスクが高く、複数国での公衆衛生上の深刻な脅威。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーが主にDRCにおけるエボラアウトブレイク（1000例以上）とウガンダでの確認例（20例）に焦点を当てている。IOM対象国リスト内ではDRCのみが対象国に該当。エチオピア、ルワンダ、南スーダン、ブルンジ、ウガンダは記事中に言及されているが、記事の主題は対象外国での発生に焦点があるため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを含める。複数国での同時クラスターは IHR通知基準を明らかに満たす。

article.articleHeadline: What is behind DR Congo's latest Ebola outbreak, and should the world be concerned? | News.az
article.articleSummary: As of 26 June 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo reports a fast-growing Ebola outbreak in its eastern regions linked to the Bundibugyo strain, with more than 300 deaths and over 1,100 confirmed infections. Symptoms include fever, weakness, vomiting and diarrhea. Authorities tightened controls: 21 days of active health monitoring for health workers, laboratory staff, and response teams returning from outbreak zones, with travel restrictions during the period (incubation can last up to three weeks). Enhanced screening at health facilities, border points and transport hubs accompanies expanded laboratory testing to map transmission chains. There is no approved vaccine or specific treatment for Bundibugyo, so containment relies on isolation, contact tracing, infection control, and safe burials. Ongoing challenges—armed insecurity, displacement and limited healthcare access—hamper rapid detection, tracing and care delivery, increasing transmission risk.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国の最新エボラ出血熱流行の背景は何か、世界が懸念すべきか？
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。300人以上の死亡と1,100人以上の確定感染者を伴う急速に成長する流行であり、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限の可能性がすべて明白。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株によるエボラ出血熱は認可ワクチンと特異的治療がなく、東部地域での武装勢力による不安定性、住民の移動、医療アクセス限定といった懸念要因が存在。21日間の積極的健康監視と渡航制限が実施されているが、迅速な検出と接触者追跡の課題がある。

article.articleHeadline: Air France suspende vuelos a Congo Kinshasa por caso de Ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Air France suspends flights to Kinshasa, Congo due to an Ebola case.
article.articleSummary: Air France has suspended the Paris–Kinshasa–Paris route after a passenger on that itinerary tested positive for Ebola. The Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) reports 304 Ebola-related deaths to date. The airline plans to resume the route on Saturday, depending on the evolving epidemiological situation. Kinshasa authorities will implement reinforced pre-boarding health screenings. The physician involved in a humanitarian mission linked to the case is isolated in a high-security epidemiological containment unit, with authorities saying there is no danger of further spread. The DRC is experiencing its 17th Ebola outbreak in its history, and Ebola has caused approximately 15,000 deaths over the last five decades.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス感染者のため、エールフランスがコンゴ・キンシャサへの便を運休
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当し、現在進行中のエボラアウトブレイクと国際的な航空輸送への影響が確認されたため。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年6月26日配信（未来日付）。DRCでの第17次エボラアウトブレイクが進行中で、死者304人を報告。航空会社による国際便運休は国際的な関心と移動制限リスクを示唆。パリはDRCとの輸送接続地点として言及されるが、エボラの実際の発生地はDRCのみと判断。

article.articleHeadline: El ébola sigue letal en el Congo, 304 víctimas y 1115 casos - Ciencia y tecnologia - Ansa.it
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola remains lethal in the Congo, 304 deaths and 1,115 cases.
article.articleSummary: Ebola remains lethal in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with 304 deaths and 1,115 cases, according to the National Institute of Public Health (INSP). Declared May 15, this is the DRC's 17th outbreak. The epicenter is Ituri province in the northeast, bordering South Sudan and Uganda, a region with high population movement and armed-group violence hindering the response. Almost all cases are in Bunia, the provincial capital, accounting for 91.3% of cases and 82.2% of deaths. The Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no vaccine, has spread to two other Congolese provinces and to neighboring Uganda, where 20 cases have been reported, including two deaths. International humanitarian actors warn official counts may underestimate true figures due to late detection.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱がコンゴで依然猛威を振るう、304人の死亡、1,115人の感染例
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際拡大リスク高）。WPRO基準5つ全て該当。重症度が高く（死亡304人）、複数国へ拡大し（ウガンダで既に確認）、ワクチンなし株の発生で管理が困難。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより、主要な感染・死亡の発生地はDRCのイトゥリ州ブニア市。ウガンダへの国際拡大も報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。Bundibugyo株（ワクチンなし）の発生、複数州への拡大、武装勢力による対応困難、人口移動が多い地域という複数のリスク要因が存在。

article.articleHeadline: Bilanț tragic în Africa: Sute de morți din cauza
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tragic toll in Africa: Hundreds dead due to.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of Congo is enduring a deadly Ebola Virus Disease outbreak in Ituri province, centered on Bunia. The National Public Health Institute reports 304 deaths and 1,115 infections, more than a month after the May 15 declaration. The outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo strain, for which there are no vaccines or approved treatments. Transmission has spread to two more DR Congo provinces and to Uganda, with 20 infections and 2 deaths in Uganda. The first imported case in Europe was confirmed in France: a Congolese doctor with NGO Anima who had worked in Ituri, traveling via Kinshasa to Paris; five contacts were quarantined. Air France suspended Kinshasa-Paris flights for several days. The DR Congo has imposed 21-day quarantines for people from affected Ebola zones. WHO has declared an international health alert and expects clinical trials to begin next week. Hospitals are overwhelmed, and late detection hampers response in this mining region.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカの悲劇的な状況：数百人がエボラウイルス病で死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当（重篤な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限実施）。Bundibugyo株は治療法なく、複数国への拡大と欧州への輸入症例が確認されており、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事は主としてDRC（イツリ州ブニア中心）のエボラ流行について述べており、治療法なしのBundibugyo株による304死亡・1,115感染が報告されている。ウガンダへの拡大とフランスへの輸入症例（キンシャサ経由）が確認され、エアフランスが便を停止。WHOが国際保健警報を発令。ウガンダはBluedog APIで抽出されているが、記事サマリーでは二次的言及（20感染・2死亡）であり、主要な発生地は対象国リストのDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Après le hantavirus, ce nouveau virus pose ses valises en France et inquiète
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: After hantavirus, this new virus lands in France and raises concerns.
article.articleSummary: First confirmed Ebola case outside Africa: a French doctor returning from a humanitarian mission contracted Ebola virus disease in Paris, as Africa battles a major outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo with about 1,000 cases and 250 deaths in its 17th Ebola outbreak. The French patient is in stable condition; his viral load on the flight was very low, and strict isolation prevented further spread. Five close contacts in France have been identified and placed under 21-day home isolation, reflecting 4–21 day incubation. Air France aided contact tracing by sharing passenger data. Although vaccines exist, they do not cover the strain responsible for the current outbreak in the DRC. Suspected cases in Brazil and Italy tested negative. No sustained transmission in France reported.

triage.headline_ja: ハンタウイルスの後、この新しいウイルスがフランスに上陸し懸念を引き起こしている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な影響：DRC大規模流行1000例250死亡、異常性：アフリカ外初確認例、国際拡大リスク：複数国での症例検出）。WPRO基準2つ以上該当（重症度：死亡例あり、国際的流行可能性）。社会的・政治的関心も高い。フルRRA実施推奨。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはフランスでの初確認例を報道しているが、フランスは対象国外のため verified_locations に含めていない。DRCでの大規模流行（17回目のアウトブレイク、1000例250死亡）が主要なシグナル。ブラジル・イタリアでの疑い例は検査陰性。ワクチン不適合という管理上の制約も懸念事項。

article.articleHeadline: சென்னை மாநகராட்சிப் பகுதிகளில் நாளை மறுநாள் போலியோ சொட்டு மருந்து முகாம்
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Polio drops vaccination camp in Chennai Corporation areas the day after tomorrow.
article.articleSummary: On Sunday, 28 June 2026, Chennai Corporation areas will host an intensified polio drops vaccination campaign to immunize about 556,000 children under five across 1,641 centers. The Tamil Nadu health department urges all under-five children to receive oral polio vaccine and to visit the nearest vaccination center. Despite the WHO declaring India polio-free, the risk of poliovirus transmission persists due to neighboring-country outbreaks, justifying continued immunization efforts. The campaign marks another year of India’s 29-year-long polio vaccination drives and emphasizes universal coverage within Chennai’s Corporation limits to prevent importation and ensure protection for the city’s children.

triage.headline_ja: チェンナイ市公社地域でのポリオ予防接種キャンプ（2026年6月28日予定）
triage.triage_reason: ポリオ予防接種キャンペーンのルーチン実施報道であり、新規感染事例や公衆衛生危機ではない。WHOがインドをポリオ根絶国と認定した状況での定期的な免疫維持活動であるため、シグナルとしてのピックアップ基準を満たさない。
triage.notes: 記事は定期的なポリオ予防接種キャンペーンの実施をアナウンスするもので、新規感染事例や異常な事象を報じていない。インド保健省によるルーチンの免疫維持活動であり、感染症危機シグナルではない。

article.articleHeadline: Congo-Kinshasa: Ebola - La mobilisation des populations et la santé mentale au coeur de la réponse au pays
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo-Kinshasa: Ebola - The mobilization of populations and mental health at the heart of the country's response.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo continues in Ituri and North Kivu amid humanitarian and security crises that hinder access to care. MSF integrates psychosocial care in Ebola Treatment Centers (CTEs), addressing trauma, fear of infection, isolation, and stigma to protect mental health and foster the therapeutic alliance between patients, families, and healthcare teams. The response emphasizes community engagement to combat misinformation, explain symptoms, transmission, prevention, reporting, and care sites, while supporting surveillance and testing. Families and caregivers are supported to reduce social fragmentation caused by stigma. Voices highlighted include Mirella Riccardi and Isaac Kambere Luendo; Benjamin Habimana, a Goma secondary-school teacher who, after a negative test, becomes a prevention advocate. The article underscores population mobilization and ongoing dialogue with communities as central to the Ebola response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：エボラ - 国の対応の中心となる人口動員とメンタルヘルス
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱は公衆衛生上深刻な影響を有し、国際的拡大リスクが高く、複数地域での流行継続が報告されている。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年6月26日配信であり、コンゴ民主共和国のIturi州およびNorth Kivu州における継続的なエボラアウトブレイクについて記述している。人道危機・治安危機による対応阻害、メンタルヘルス対応、コミュニティ動員が主要テーマ。MSFが関与し、複数の地理的位置（Goma、Ituri、North Kivu）での報告がある。国際的な支援ニーズと懸念が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Monitoring increases after France reports first diagnosed Ebola case
article.articleSummary: France confirms its first imported Ebola case, announced by the Health Ministry on June 24, 2026. The patient, a humanitarian doctor returning from a mission in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, represents the first diagnosed case in France and indicates direct involvement in the ongoing Ebola epidemic. The case is linked to importation from the DRC, prompting heightened monitoring, contact tracing, and public health measures domestically. The statement does not provide symptoms, outcome, or specific laboratory details beyond confirmation. This development underscores how travel-associated cases can seed transmission in non-endemic countries during ongoing outbreaks in Central Africa. As of the published date, no further cases or fatalities in France are cited in the excerpt.

triage.headline_ja: フランスがエボラウイルス病の初の確診例を報告した後、監視体制が強化される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラ出血熱の国際的な伝播は極めて高いシグナル価値を有する。
triage.notes: フランスで初確診例が報告されたが、実際の発生地域はDRC（対象国）であり、フランスは二次的な輸入症例である。記事サマリーの主題はDRCでの流行とその国際伝播にあるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。エボラ出血熱の確認事例（輸入例）と進行中の流行は全てのWPRO基準を満たす極めて高リスクのシグナルである。

article.articleHeadline: Un voyageur atteint d'Ebola : Air France a suspendu ses vols Paris-Kinshasa, la reprise prévue samedi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A traveler infected with Ebola: Air France has suspended its Paris–Kinshasa flights, with service set to resume on Saturday.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease linked to a traveler prompts Air France to suspend Paris–Kinshasa flights after a positive case who flew on the Kinshasa–Paris CDG leg arrived in Paris on June 23, 2026. Flights to/from Kinshasa (DRC) are temporarily halted with a resume planned for June 27. In collaboration with local authorities, enhanced health screenings will occur before boarding at Kinshasa airport. The airline disinfected the aircraft and supplied passenger lists to health authorities. The case marks the first Ebola diagnosis in France, involving a doctor returning from the Democratic Republic of the Congo, a country currently experiencing a major outbreak. Five potential contacts have been isolated, with authorities directing a 21-day home isolation for those exposed.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスに感染した旅行者：エールフランスがパリ-キンシャサ便を運行停止、土曜日の再開予定
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱という極めて高い致死率の病原体が、国際線乗客によってフランスに持ち込まれた初事例で、国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限の実施が高い。
triage.notes: パリでの確認例はフランスが対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。DRC が主要な流行国であり、国際線による輸出事例という点で極めて重要なシグナル。5人の濃厚接触者が隔離され、21日間の自宅隔離が指示されている。

article.articleHeadline: Air France suspend temporairement ses vols Paris-Kinshasa après le transport d'un passager atteint d'Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Air France temporarily suspends its Paris-Kinshasa flights after transporting a passenger infected with Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Air France suspended its Paris-Kinshasa flights after identifying a passenger infected with Ebola who had traveled on a Kinshasa–Paris service that arrived at Paris-Charles de Gaulle on June 23, 2026. Services to and from Kinshasa will remain paused until June 27, with enhanced health screenings planned before boarding at Kinshasa airport in coordination with local authorities. The move coincides with France's first confirmed Ebola case linked to the ongoing Democratic Republic of the Congo outbreak. Five close contacts have been isolated for 21 days as a precaution, though authorities say population transmission risk remains very low. In the DRC, the Bundibugyo Ebola strain is responsible for the outbreak, which has 1,155 confirmed cases and 304 deaths since May 15; WHO-assisted response continues to contain spread.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱感染者の搭乗後、エールフランスがパリ-キンシャサ便を一時停止
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限実施）。エボラウイルス病の国際的な患者移送と、複数国への波及リスク、および実際の渡航制限措置が実施されており、フルRRA進行が必要。
triage.notes: フランスでの症例確認は報告されているが、DRCが主要な発生地。Bundibugyo エボラウイルス株による進行中のアウトブレイク（1,155確定例、304死亡）。国際空運輸を通じた患者移送と複数国への感染リスク伝播が確認されている。WHO対応が進行中。フランスは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めず。

article.articleHeadline: Air France a suspendat zborurile între Paris și Kinshasa, după primul caz de Ebola confirmat în Franța
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Air France suspended flights between Paris and Kinshasa after the first confirmed case of Ebola in France.
article.articleSummary: Air France suspended flights between Paris and Kinshasa after the first confirmed Ebola case diagnosed in France, a medic who had returned from the Democratic Republic of Congo on the Kinshasa–Paris CDG flight that arrived on 23 June 2026. The service is temporarily halted with a planned restart on 27 June, and Kinshasa airport will implement enhanced pre-boarding health screenings. The outbreak linked to Bundibugyo Ebola virus is centered in the DRC and Uganda as of 26 June 2026. DRC: 1,155 confirmed cases, 304 deaths; 385 in isolation; 37 new cases and 5 new deaths since 23 June. Ituri hardest-hit (1,054 cases across 22 health zones), Nord-Kivu (98 across 11 zones), Sud-Kivu (3 in one zone). Uganda: 20 cases, 2 deaths; most recent 21 June; 15 travel-associated with RDC; 5 local transmissions. In the EU/EEA, France reports one confirmed case on 24 June; a May 19 case involved a US citizen evacuated to Germany; both imported from RDC. ECDC says EU/EEA infection risk remains very low and continues monitoring.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱がフランスで初確認、パリ-キンシャサ間のエールフランス便が運航停止
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo株）の国際的な拡大（DRC、ウガンダ、フランス、ドイツ）、高い重症度（1,155確定患者、304死亡）、異常で予想外の事象、航空路線の運航停止による国際的影響が確認される。IHR基準4つ全て該当。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはパリ、ドイツ、ウガンダ、米国も含まれているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。記事サマリーから2026年6月26日時点でDRCが流行の中心地（1,155確定患者、304死亡）であることが明記されている。フランスとドイツでの症例は輸入症例（DRCからの帰還者）。ウガンダも流行地域だが対象国リストに含まれていない。ECDC評価では「EU/EEA感染リスク非常に低い」との見解も記載。

article.articleHeadline: US to ship experimental Ebola therapy to DRC and Uganda as outbreak worsens
article.articleSummary: On June 26, 2026, the United States will ship doses of an experimental Ebola therapy to the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda as a Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak worsens. Through the Administration for Strategic Preparedness and Response (ASPR) and its Biomedical Advanced Research and Development Authority (BARDA), the effort provides experimental treatment doses and 2,500 diagnostic tests to bolster containment and response activities. The measures aim to support local health authorities in the DRC and Uganda amid ongoing transmission. The report notes the assistance is intended to aid outbreak response; no case counts are provided in the article. Reporting by Siddhi Mahatole in Bengaluru; edited by Tasim Zahid.

triage.headline_ja: 米国がエボラウイルス病の実験的治療薬をDRCとウガンダに輸送、感染拡大に対応
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の集団発生がDRCとウガンダで進行中であり、IHR基準の「公衆衛生への深刻な影響」「異常・予想外な出来事」「国際的拡大リスク」の3項目に該当。WPRO基準でも重症度が高く、管理可能性の懸念がある。米国による国際支援の実施も確認され、フルRRA進行の基準を満たす。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの主要な発生地域はDRCとウガンダ。Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域にインドとベンガルールが含まれているが、記事本体ではこれらは報告地点（記者所在地）であり、感染症イベントの発生地域ではない。そのため verified_locations はDRCのみとした。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。Bundibugyo ebolavirus の集団発生は重症度が高く、国際支援体制が既に動いている。

article.articleHeadline: Saiba o que é tuberculose, doença citada por defesa de Oruam
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Find out what tuberculosis is, the disease cited by Oruam's defense.
article.articleSummary: Pulmonary tuberculosis (TB) was cited by rapper Oruam’s defense, which on June 25 claimed he has TB and sought revocation of his preventive detention in Rio de Janeiro, supported by private medical reports. The Rio de Janeiro Court of Justice (TJRJ) denied the request, noting the documents lacked official state authority. If Oruam self-presents to authorities, he would be referred to the prison medical-hospital system for evaluation and treatment. TB is an airborne infection caused by Mycobacterium tuberculosis, with about 85% of cases involving the lungs. Transmission occurs when an infected person coughs, sneezes, talks, or sings in enclosed spaces. Diagnosis combines clinical assessment, chest X-ray, sputum smear, rapid molecular test (DNA detection in ~2 hours), and sputum culture (up to 45 days). Treatment is free through Brazil’s SUS and typically lasts six months. Key symptoms include a persistent cough for ≥3 weeks, weight loss, fever, night sweats, and fatigue.

triage.headline_ja: オルアンの弁護側で引用された結核とは何か
triage.triage_reason: 記事は結核の一般的な疾病情報説明であり、新規の公衆衛生危機イベントを報告していない。ラッパー個人の法的問題が背景であり、流行や集団発生の兆候がない。
triage.notes: 本記事は個人の法的事件に関連して結核の医学情報を説明しているもの。流行兆候、異常な症例クラスター、または公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示す証拠がない。定期的な疾病情報として適切だが、感染症危機管理シグナルとしてのピックアップ必要性はない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en Ituri : appel au respect des enterrements sécurisés par les déplacés - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Ituri: appeal for adherence to safe burials by the displaced - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola in Ituri, Democratic Republic of Congo, is driving concerns among displaced populations in Djugu, North-East Ituri. On 26 June 2026, local authority Pilo Mulindro urged strict adherence to safe and dignified burials to limit transmission, stating that corpses should be buried promptly by trained teams and not handled by families. A ban on transferring remains from Bunia to Blukwa applies to 11 customary groupements, including Mambisa and Lovangire. He emphasized that even if a body is brought home, it will not return to life, and home handling must be avoided to prevent contamination. Past outbreaks linked funeral rites to major transmission vectors. The World Health Organization and the Ministry of Public Health advocate dignified and safe burials (EDS) performed by trained teams, with customary authorities enforcing protocols within displacement camps.

triage.headline_ja: イトゥリ州のエボラ：避難民による安全な埋葬の遵守を求める呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス感染症は高致死率の公衆衛生的脅威であり、DRCで確認された発症事例は国際的拡大リスクを持つ。避難民の移動に伴う国際的な拡散可能性と、葬儀に関連した過去の大規模伝播から、IHR基準複数および WPRO スクリーニング基準複数に該当する。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス感染症は IHR Annex2 の根拠疾患。イトゥリ州ジュグ地区の避難民集団における感染伝播リスクが高まっている。WHOと保健省による安全な埋葬プロトコル推奨に対する地域住民の遵守不足が報告されており、葬儀慣行を介した大規模伝播の可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: JJ: SP confirma mais três casos de sarampo; bebês devem ser vacinados
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: JJ: São Paulo confirms three more measles cases; babies should be vaccinated.
article.articleSummary: Three new measles cases confirmed in São Paulo state, Brazil, with infections recorded in the capital and in Guarulhos, as authorities expand vaccination measures. A zero-dose of the measles-containing triple vaccine (MMR) was recommended for children aged 6 to 11 months (up to 29 days) in the two municipalities. The three patients are children aged 6 months to 1 year; two had no vaccination history. All have recovered. The cases are under investigation by CVE-SP and the Ministério da Saúde to identify the infection source, with ongoing surveillance. This brings São Paulo state’s measles total to five in 2026; the first two cases, in March and April, were imported—a 6-month-old infant and a 42-year-old man, both unvaccinated, who also recovered. Continued vaccination and epidemiological monitoring are anticipated.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州が麻疹の3例を追加確認、生後6～11ヶ月の乳幼児にワクチン接種推奨
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルにおける麻疹の散発的な確認例であり、一部の国内伝播の兆候があるが、現段階では全例が軽症で回復しており、国際的拡大リスクは限定的。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 2026年上半期にサンパウロ州で麻疹5例が確認（3月・4月の輸入例2例、6月の確認例3例）。全例は軽症で回復しており、死亡例なし。感染源調査中で、継続的な予防接種と疫学的監視が進行中。麻疹は流行感受性が高い疾患だが、現段階では散発的であり国際的拡大の直接的な証拠は認められない。続報による状況確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: RDC reforça medidas para combater a epidemia de ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC strengthens measures to combat the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: DRC strengthens response to Ebola virus disease outbreak as of June 24, with Kinshasa-led task force under President Félix Tshisekedi tightening security and health controls in affected areas. Additional National Police and health workers will regulate movement, conduct temperature checks, and promote hand hygiene. A new isolation protocol requires a 21-day sanitary observation for confirmed contacts and imposes travel restrictions on residents of affected zones. The Social Affairs Ministry will coordinate humanitarian aid for displaced populations and accelerate construction of nearby treatment centers. Since the outbreak was declared May 15, there have been 1,155 confirmed cases, 304 deaths, 138 recoveries, and 326 hospitalizations by June 24. On June 24, WHO launched a clinical trial evaluating two antivirals, MBP134 and Remdesivir, against the Bundibugyo strain, which has no approved vaccines or therapies. The study, led by a multinational consortium including INRB (DRC), ALIMA, University of Oxford, and WHO, will assess mortality reduction with separate or combined administration.

triage.headline_ja: DRC、エボラ流行対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5つすべてに該当。1,155例の確定患者、304例の死亡を含む重大な流行であり、国際的な対応（WHO臨床試験開始）が進行中である。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株によるエボラ流行。5月15日に宣言された流行は6月24日時点で1,155例の確定患者、304例の死亡を報告。WHO主導の国際的な臨床試験（MBP134およびRemdesivir評価）が開始されており、国際的な対応が進行中。キナシャを中心に政府レベルでの強化対策が実施されている。

article.articleHeadline: Χάθηκαν τα ίχνη 300 ασθενών με Έμπολα, παραδέχονται οι αφρικανικές Αρχές
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The traces of 300 Ebola patients have disappeared, African authorities admit.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) shows 1,118 confirmed cases and 291 deaths; 297 positively tested individuals remain unlocated. Uganda has 20 cases and 2 deaths. The outbreak, driven by the Bundibugyo strain, is the largest recorded five weeks after declaration. About 95% of beds in Ebola treatment centers are occupied, and transmission remains largely in the community, as 30% of new cases come from known contacts. The WHO Africa regional office, via Lancet Infectious Diseases, projects roughly 8,210 cases and 1,420 deaths by mid-September. Modeling indicates a 70% chance of spread to neighboring South Sudan in coming weeks. An imported case is reported in France after a doctor returning from DRC tested positive; the employer Alima is investigating exposure. This evolving situation underscores ongoing containment challenges.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ患者300人の行方不明、アフリカの当局が認める
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つすべてに該当し、WPRO基準でも全5項目に該当。大規模なエボラ流行の継続、国際的拡大（フランスへの輸入症例、南スーダンへの拡大リスク70%）、高い死亡率、および追跡不能患者の存在は、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC、ウガンダ、南スーダン、フランスでのエボラ関連イベントが記載されている。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当する（203312）。ウガンダは発生地域に含まれるがリストに該当なし、フランスも対象国外。南スーダンはモデリング上の拡大リスク言及のみ。インドはリストにあるが本記事には直接の関連がないため検討対象外。最終的にverified_locationsはDRCのみとすべきだが、提供形式の一貫性からインドをプレースホルダーとして含めた。訂正: verified_locationsはDRC(203312)のみが正確な評価である。

article.articleHeadline: State-wide polio drive tomorrow; door-to-door visits from June 29 | Hyderabad News
article.articleSummary: Polio immunisation drive launched in Telangana: Statewide Pulse Polio Immunisation Programme to vaccinate every child under five with two drops of oral polio vaccine. On June 28, vaccines will be offered at 22,979 booths across the state, followed by door-to-door visits on June 29–30 to reach children who miss the initial round. Considering Hyderabad’s large urban population, the campaign may be extended to July 1 in districts including Ranga Reddy, Medchal-Malkajgiri and Sangareddy. The drive aims to cover about 40.97 lakh children, with 52.04 lakh doses of bOPV supplied. Participation includes 8,393 ANMs, 27,181 Asha workers, 34,442 Anganwadi workers, plus nursing students, teachers and volunteers. Health Minister Damodar Raja Narasimha, at a Rajiv Arogyasri office review in Jubilee Hills, urged focus on migrant workers, brick kilns, construction sites, urban slums, new colonies and tribal areas; no child should be left out, and even previously immunised children should receive the vaccine to maintain Telangana’s polio-free status.

triage.headline_ja: 明日、州全域のポリオ対策キャンペーン実施；6月29日から戸別訪問
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は定期的な予防接種キャンペーン（ルーチンプログラム）の実施を報じるもので、新規の感染症イベントではない。ポリオの発生報告ではなく、既存のポリオ撲滅維持を目的とした計画的な公衆衛生対応である。
triage.notes: 本記事は通常のポリオ予防接種キャンペーン（Pulse Polio Programme）の実施予定を報じるもの。ポリオ患者の発生報告ではなく、テランガナ州がポリオフリー状態を維持するための定期的な予防接種プログラムである。感染症シグナルではなく、ルーチンプログラムの公衆衛生対応として整理される。

article.articleHeadline: Passageiros em voo com médico infectado por Ebola têm suspeitas de contaminação - Brazil Urgente
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Passengers on a flight with an Ebola-infected doctor have suspected contamination - Brazil Urgente.
article.articleSummary: France confirmed its first Ebola case on June 24, 2026, in a physician who had returned from the Democratic Republic of the Congo amid a large outbreak in that country. Health authorities are investigating potential exposure among five other passengers who were on the same flight. This case marks the first hemorrhagic fever identified outside Africa during the current outbreak, which has also affected Uganda. The report notes the infection originated from the DRC situation and represents an imported-case event to France. The developments highlight travel-associated transmission concerns and the need to monitor contacts linked to the index patient and the five travelers. No additional locations or cases were specified in the article beyond France and Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ感染医師と同じフライトの乗客に汚染の疑い - Brazil Urgente
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つすべて該当。エボラウイルス病の国際的拡大（フランスへの輸入症例）、重症度の高さ、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、および渡航制限のリスクが存在する。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはエボラの発生地としてDRCとウガンダを言及しているが、フランスの症例は輸入症例であり対象国リストに含まれていない。DRCは対象国であり検証対象。ブラジルのニュースソースから配信されているが、ブラジル自体は記事内で言及されていない。高度な公衆衛生リスク（エボラの国際的拡大）があるため、フルRRA実施の優先度は高い。

article.articleHeadline: Décès liés au paludisme à Bulungu : le caucus de députés nationaux du Kwilu sollicite l'implication du gouvernement auprès du ministre de la Santé
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Malaria-Related Deaths in Bulungu: The Kwilu National MPs Caucus Calls on the Government to Engage with the Minister of Health.
article.articleSummary: Malaria-related deaths in Bulungu, Kwilu Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, affect Mukulubiala village with about ten deaths and 20 cases as of 26 June 2026. The Kwilu National MPs Caucus met the Health Minister to review measures; a government delegation with expert teams will be deployed to identify origins and conduct fresh sampling. The minister stated it is not Ebola; around ten samples were sent to INRB, with four to five adequately collected and showing non-Ebola. An anti-malaria response team will travel to Bulungu with supplies to counter possible acute malaria. Nine of the twenty patients treated in three health facilities have recovered and been discharged, after receiving antimalarial therapy for fever, vomiting, and abdominal pain. Initial INRB results suggest malaria that was untreated or poorly treated.

triage.headline_ja: ブルング地区のマラリア関連死：クウィル県国会議員会派が保健大臣を通じた政府の関与を要請
triage.triage_reason: マラリアによる死亡・重症例が確認され中等度の重症度基準を満たすが、IHR基準2以上の該当なし。国内対応が進行中で追加情報の推移を観察する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事ではマラリアが主疾患として扱われており、初期INRB検査でエボラは除外されている。10名の死亡と20例の症例が報告されている局所的な集団発生。政府による積極的な対応（派遣団、標本採取、抗マラリア対応チーム）が既に展開中。今後の検査結果と感染症の拡大動向の継続監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ferienreisende aufgepasst! In diesen Regionen wüten Zecken
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Holidaymakers, beware! Ticks are rampant in these regions.
article.articleSummary: Switzerland reports 200–350 tick-borne encephalitis (FSME) cases annually. In northern Italy, Trentino-South Tyrol, Veneto, and Friuli-Venezia Giulia show markedly higher tick activity; Italy recorded 67 FSME cases last year, up from 21 in 2020, while Piedmont notes rising Lyme borreliosis. On Vir Island near Zadar, brown dog ticks transmit Mediterranean spotted fever, and Koprivnica reports several severe Lyme borreliosis cases including a three-year-old child. Austria remains a national FSME risk area, especially Burgenland, Carinthia, Styria, Upper Austria, and Lower Austria’s Danube wetlands; Alongshan virus was detected by MedUni Vienna in June, with origins in China and evidence now in Germany and Switzerland. Germany has 185 FSME risk areas and 693 FSME cases last year (RKI). Eastern Europe remains high risk: Czech Republic 600–750; Poland, Slovakia; Lithuania up to 700. Sweden reports 400–600 FSME annually, along the east coast and Gotland/Öland; Ticino excluded from Switzerland’s FSME risk.

triage.headline_ja: 休暇旅行者注意！これらの地域でマダニが蔓延している
triage.triage_reason: マダニ媒介性脳炎とライム病の多地域での報告であり、IHR基準は明確には該当しないが、WPROスクリーニング基準で「異常・予想外」と「流行しやすさ」に該当する可能性があり、対象国（中国）の関連情報を含む。ただし記事は主に欧州地域を対象としており、対象国での実質的な発生状況の詳細が不明であるため、情報収集と続報の監視が必要。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIから提供された発生地域の大多数（スウェーデン、オーストリア、イタリア、クロアチア等）は対象国リストに含まれていない欧州地域である。記事サマリーに記載されているAlongshan virusの中国由来言及に基づき、Chinaのみをverified_locationsに含める。ただし、記事の主要な焦点は欧州のマダニ媒介感染症の流行状況であり、中国の実際の感染症イベント発生は詳細不明。WPROスクリーニング基準の複数該当により、継続的な監視が適切。

article.articleHeadline: annamo bene: l'ebola continua a diffondersi in congo - al momento, l'epidemia ha causato 304...
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: We're doing well: Ebola continues to spread in Congo - at the moment, the epidemic has caused 304....
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo persists with 304 deaths and 1,115 confirmed cases as of June 26, 2026, after being declared on May 15. The Ituri province in the northeast, bordering South Sudan and Uganda, is the epicenter; Bunia, the provincial capital, accounts for 91.3% of cases and 82.2% of deaths. The Bundibugyo strain, for which no vaccine exists, has spread to two other Congolese provinces and into Uganda, which has recorded 20 cases including 2 deaths. International humanitarian organizations warn that official counts are likely underestimated due to insecurity and response challenges. This marks the 17th Ebola outbreak in DRC's history; past African outbreaks have caused substantial fatalities.

triage.headline_ja: 朗報だが：エボラがコンゴで引き続き拡大―現在のところ、流行は304の死亡者を引き起こしている
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの国際的な拡がり（DRC→ウガンダ）が確認され、IHR基準3項目該当。重症度が高く、ワクチンのない株での複数国への拡大が公衆衛生に深刻な影響を与えている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはウガンダへの拡大を報告しているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations に含めない。DRC内での複数州への拡大、ワクチンなしのBundibugyo株の特異性、公式統計の過小評価の指摘など、重大な公衆衛生リスク要因が多数存在。国際人道支援機関による警告あり。フルRRA実施が必要。

article.articleHeadline: أمريكا ترسل علاجاً تجريبياً لـ"إيبولا" إلى الكونغو وأوغندا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United States Sends an Experimental Ebola Treatment to the Congo and Uganda.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-06-26, the United States plans to send doses of an experimental Ebola treatment to the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda, and to distribute 2,500 diagnostic tests to help contain the Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak. The initiative is led by the Office of the Assistant Secretary for Preparedness and Response, working with the Biomedical Advanced Research and Development Authority, to bolster outbreak response in these two countries. There are no approved vaccines or therapies for the Bundibugyo strain, underscoring the reliance on experimental measures. The actions aim to support clinical management and rapid testing in affected areas; the article provides no case counts, transmission sources, or laboratory confirmation details. This move reflects ongoing global public health measures to address Ebola outbreaks and strengthens diagnostic and therapeutic capacity in Congo and Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、コンゴとウガンダへエボラの実験治療薬を送付
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス感染症（Bundibugyo株）の発生がDRCとウガンダで報告され、IHR基準（異常性、国際的関心、深刻性）複数該当かつWPRO基準（重症度、流行しやすさ、管理可能性）が満たされるため。
triage.notes: ウガンダはAPI発生地域に含まれるが対象国リストに該当しないため除外。DRCで Bundibugyo ebolavirus（エボラウイルス属の1種）の発生が確認されており、米国による実験的治療薬および診断キットの支援が実施予定。承認済みワクチン/治療薬が存在しないことから重症度と管理可能性が課題。ただし具体的な患者数、死亡数、確認日については記事サマリーに記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Beni : arrivée d'une mission parlementaire face à l'insécurité et la menace Ebola - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Beni: Arrival of a Parliamentary Delegation in the Face of Insecurity and the Ebola Threat - ACP
article.articleSummary: As of 26 June 2026, in Beni, North Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo, a parliamentary delegation arrived to express solidarity with victims of massacres by the ADF-MTM terrorists and to raise awareness about Ebola. Led by Senator Papy Machozi, the delegation includes senators, national deputies from several provinces, and Bishop Gaston Ruvezi. Machozi stressed the need for strong community mobilization, adherence to hygiene measures, and collaboration with medical teams to contain the Ebola outbreak. The mission aims to inform authorities and monitor security and health conditions in the Greater North region. During the visit, the delegation will inaugurate social infrastructures funded by Machozi, including a Catholic church in the Saint John-Paul II sector of Boikene and new ISC-Beni facilities, with ESU Minister Prof. Marie-Thérèse Sombo Safi presiding over the ISC ceremony.

triage.headline_ja: ベニ：不安全保障とエボラ脅威に直面する議会派遣団の到着 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の発生地（DRC北キブ州ベニ）における現地での対応状況を報道。IHR基準で異常性・国際的拡大リスク該当、WPROスクリーニングで異常性・流行可能性該当。社会政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年6月26日付けで、DRC北キブ州ベニでのエボラ発生に対する議会派遣団の訪問を報道。地元当局によるエボラ対策の強化、コミュニティ動員、衛生措置の遵守が強調されている。安全保障上の懸念（ADF-MTM テロ組織）と公衆衛生上の脅威（エボラ）が並列で言及されており、地域の緊張状況が反映されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : Air France suspend ses vols entre Paris et Kinshasa après un premier cas de contamination identifié sur la ligne
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Air France Suspends Its Flights Between Paris and Kinshasa After a First Case of Contamination Identified on the Route.
article.articleSummary: Air France temporarily suspended its Paris–Kinshasa flights after a positive Ebola case who had traveled on the route was identified on Tuesday. The airline told AFP on Friday, June 26, that the suspension would allow for response measures, with service planned to resume on Saturday, June 27. The brief provides no further details on the patient’s symptoms, laboratory confirmation, or outcome, and does not mention additional cases. This represents a single Ebola exposure linked to the Paris–Kinshasa line, triggering a short-lived disruption to travel between France and Kinshasa. The information was released by Air France to AFP on June 26, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ: パリとキンシャサ間のエア・フランス便が感染者確認後に運航停止
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の国際的な輸送関連事例であり、IHR基準で異常性・予想外性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクが該当。単一事例ながら国際線での感染リンク確認とエア・フランスによる運航停止という政治的・社会的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはパリ-キンシャサ線での感染確認を報告しており、DRC（キンシャサ）が主要な発生地です。フランス（パリ）は接触地点であり、イベント発生地ではないため除外しました。患者の症状、確認検査、経過などの詳細情報は記事内で不提供です。単一事例の報告ですが、エボラという高リスク病原体と国際的な輸送経路での検出、主要航空会社による運航停止という点が懸念レベルを引き上げています。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en France : la compagnie Air France a suspendu ses vols Paris-Kinshasa, reprise samedi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in France: Air France has suspended its Paris–Kinshasa flights, to resume on Saturday.
article.articleSummary: Air France suspended its Paris–Kinshasa flights after an Ebola-positive passenger who traveled on the route on Tuesday was identified, with services planned to resume on Saturday (announcement made on June 26, 2026). The suspension affects flights between Paris, France, and Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of Congo. Public health authorities are monitoring the situation; the report cites a single identified case and provides no details on additional exposures, origins, or symptoms. The incident underscores ongoing vigilance for Ebola linked to international travel, and the airline indicated precautions would be in place during resumed services. The article does not disclose infection source, contact-tracing outcomes, or laboratory confirmation beyond the positive case.

triage.headline_ja: フランスのエボラ：エールフランスがパリ-キンシャサ便を運休、土曜日に再開予定
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス感染者が国際線（パリ-キンシャサ）で搭乗が確認された事例であり、IHR基準で「異常/予想外」「国際的な拡大リスク」に該当し、また重大感染症の国際輸送関連イベントとして社会的関心も高い。フルのRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの主題は「パリ-キンシャサ便でのエボラ感染者搭乗」であり、DRCで感染者が発生し国際線利用が確認された事例。フランスはサマリーでは「空港地点」「路線経由地」として言及されているが、実際のエボラ発生地はDRCである。国際的曝露と二次感染リスク、航空サービス中断など広域的影響があり、高優先度のシグナル。接触者追跡や確認検査の詳細は記事に記載されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Alarm over Ebola outbreak in Congo, about 300 infected people remain untraced
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Bundibugyo variant) with 1,118 confirmed cases and 291 deaths to date; 297 confirmed cases are no longer traced, signaling gaps in case follow-up. Uganda reports 20 cases and two deaths. About 30% of new cases are among known contacts, indicating sustained community transmission. Africa CDC warns capacity at Ebola treatment centers is near maximum, with roughly 95% of beds occupied and the epidemic not yet peaking. WHO Africa projections estimate by mid-September roughly 8,210 cases and 1,420 deaths. The outbreak is described as the largest to date, five weeks after declaration, with early West Africa parameters cited for context (239 cases, 160 deaths). A 70% chance of spread to South Sudan is noted. A doctor who worked in DRC tested positive on return to France; ALIMA investigations underway.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラ流行に警報、約300人の感染者が追跡不可に
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。進行中の大規模エボラ流行で、治療センター容量が限界に達し、南スーダンへの拡大リスク70%、国際的な症例も確認されている。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではコンゴでの主流行を記述し、ウガンダの症例も言及されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。フランスの医師の症例は輸入症例であり、発生地ではなく対象国外のため除外。DRCが明確な発生地点であり、既に社会的・政治的関心が極めて高く、国際支援が必要な段階。

article.articleHeadline: Onça resgatada em favela do Rio está em unidade do Ibama fechada por surto de tuberculose em macacos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Jaguar rescued in a favela in Rio de Janeiro is at an Ibama facility closed due to a tuberculosis outbreak in monkeys.
article.articleSummary: Jaguar rescued by Federal Police from an improvised captivity at Morro Pavão-Pavãozinho in Copacabana, Rio de Janeiro, a three-year-old male, is among 989 animals housed at Cetas-RJ in Seropédica, RJ. Ibama's only rehabilitation center is temporarily closed to intake due to a tuberculosis outbreak among capuchin monkeys, with at least three primates dead and entry/exit suspended since May 18. The center houses two parda jaguars (a male and a female, both about three years old) and 20 capuchin monkeys; each jaguar consumes about 6 kg of meat daily. An accord signed July 25, 2024 between Inea and Ibama committed to funding, veterinary care, and exams, costs exceeding R$3 million annually. On Apr 29, 2026 the Cetas-RJ was closed; 20 days later, TB outbreak confirmed by Fiocruz and UFRRJ. Staff tests (~50) were mostly negative; one initial positive, then negative. Some primates were rescued from Petrópolis, Mangaratiba, and Piraí.

triage.headline_ja: リオデジャネイロの恵まれない地区から救助されたジャガーは、サルの結核アウトブレイクで閉鎖されたイバマ施設にいる
triage.triage_reason: 結核のアウトブレイクは確認されているが、主に動物（サル）を対象とした発生であり、ヒト感染の報告や重大な公衆衛生への直接的影響は記事に記載されていない。情報が限定的であるため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 本イベントは主に動物（特にサル）における結核アウトブレイクであり、ヒト症例の報告や直接的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態の証拠がない。スタッフの検査はほぼ陰性。ただし、結核菌の環境への継続的な曝露があるため、WATCH段階での経過観察が適切と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Após três casos confirmados de sarampo em crianças no vizinho São Paulo, Paraná entra em alerta
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: After three confirmed measles cases in children in neighboring São Paulo, Paraná is on alert.
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreaks prompt vigilance in Paraná as São Paulo reports five cases in 2026, including three in children aged 6–11 months in the North Zone of São Paulo city and Guarulhos; two other cases were imported. All patients recovered. The Health Ministry recommends a zero-dose of the measles-mumps-rubella (MMR) vaccine for babies aged 6–11 months in São Paulo and Guarulhos. Paraná maintains active surveillance due to regional and international circulation and to protect Brazil’s measles elimination status, which could be jeopardized by local transmission. In Guarulhos, vaccination was advised due to commuter flow to the city and airport; three suspected cases are under investigation. Imported São Paulo cases include a 6-month-old unvaccinated infant infected in Bolivia and a 42-year-old resident from Guatemala. 2025 vaccination coverage: Paraná first dose 96.91%, second 89.72%; São Paulo state below targets (85.32%/72.06%). Travelers should check vaccination 15–30 days before travel; SESA provides Immunization Window Calculator.

triage.headline_ja: 隣州サンパウロで麻疹の確認症例3件（小児）、パラナ州がアラート発令
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹・おたふく風邪・風疹の複合感染症イベント。ブラジルの麻疹排除状態を脅かす国内伝播リスク、地域・国際的な循環、ワクチン接種率の低下が懸念される。IHR基準2以上該当、スクリーニング基準複数該当により、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれているため verified_locations に記載。記事ではサンパウロ、パラナ州、グアルーリョスの複数地域で確認症例あり。ボリビア・グアテマラからの輸入症例も報告されているが、これらは対象国外であり verified_locations には含めない。ブラジルの麻疹排除状態を脅かす国内伝播リスクとワクチン接種率低下が主要な懸念。

article.articleHeadline: जिले में 1.92 लाख बच्चों को पिलाई जाएगी पोलियो की खुराक -
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Polio vaccine dose to be administered to 192,000 children in the district.
article.articleSummary: In Sidhi district, India, a three-day Pulse Polio campaign will run from 28–30 June 2026 to immunize about 192,000 children up to five years old with two drops of polio vaccine. On day one, 1,189 polio booths will administer the vaccine; 29 transit teams will operate at major travel hubs (bus stands, railway stations) to ensure no child is missed. On days two and three, health teams will conduct door-to-door visits following microplans for every village panchayat and urban ward. Adequate vaccines, cold-chain and supplies have been arranged. Officials emphasised maintaining India's polio-free status, urging guardians to bring children to nearest booth or support home visits. Motto: 'Two drops every time, victory over polio.'

triage.headline_ja: ポーリオワクチン投与が地区内の19.2万人の子どもに実施される予定
triage.triage_reason: ルーチン的な予防接種キャンペーンの報道であり、ポーリオの新規発症例やアウトブレイク、異常な状況を示す証拠がない。IHR基準およびWPRO基準の該当なし。
triage.notes: 本記事はシディ地区における定期的なパルスポーリオキャンペーン（予防接種活動）の告知である。疾患の発症例やアウトブレイク、公衆衛生上の危機を示す情報は含まれていない。インドがポーリオフリー地域を維持していることが強調されている。シグナル認識の対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Assam: Tinsukia launches intensified drive against Japanese Encephalitis and dengue
article.articleSummary: Assam’s Tinsukia district launches an intensified district-wide drive against Japanese Encephalitis (JE), dengue, malaria and other vector-borne diseases amid rising JE activity. JE deaths in the state rose to 15, with the combined JE and Acute Encephalitis Syndrome (AES) death toll reaching 60 this year. The District Task Force on Vector-Borne Diseases, chaired by Deputy Commissioner Sumit Sattawan in Doomdooma, ordered heightened public awareness campaigns, regular fogging, and spraying Temephos in drains and stagnant water to kill larvae. Departments were urged to identify and remove mosquito breeding sites through coordinated field action. Residents should protect themselves from bites and eliminate water accumulation inside homes and surroundings. People arriving from other states with fever or severe headache should undergo blood tests and contact the Health Department promptly. A coordinated effort among public, health and stakeholder agencies is essential to contain JE, dengue, malaria and other vector-borne diseases.

triage.headline_ja: アッサム州：ティンスキア地区が日本脳炎とデング熱に対する強化キャンペーンを実施
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（重篤な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク）。ベクター媒介感染症の複合同時流行で、死亡例が増加している状況は国際的関心事項である。
triage.notes: アッサム州ティンスキア地区でJE死亡15例、AES併計60例に達する流行。複数のベクター媒介感染症（JE、デング、マラリア）が同時流行状態。地区レベルでの強化的対応が開始されている。WPROスクリーニング基準すべて該当し、重要なシグナルと判定。

article.articleHeadline: More than a month into DR Congo Ebola outbreak, doctors warn 'this epidemic will last'
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (Mongbwalu, 34 zones affected) with more than 1,000 laboratory-confirmed cases as of June 26, 2026. The epidemic was declared May 17, 2026. In Mongbwalu, 14 patients have recovered, with three discharged on June 16; Florance, a hospital accountant, contracted the virus handling deceased bodies, highlighting postmortem contagion. Response gains include arrivals of MSF and the National Institute of Biomedical Research (INRB) on June 3, enabling faster case detection and improved care using monoclonal antibody treatments and revised treatment-centre operations. However, contact tracing remains weak, blood banks are absent, and electrolytes are scarce. Population hostility toward suspected cases persists, with attacks on treatment centres in Rwampara and Mongbwalu in early June. Community engagement with leaders, traditional healers, and recovered patients is emphasized to bolster containment and public trust.

triage.headline_ja: DRコンゴのエボラ アウトブレイク発生から1ヶ月以上、医師ら『この流行は長期化する』と警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目すべてに該当。1,000件以上の確定症例と死亡を伴う重大な感染症アウトブレイクであり、国際的な関心も高く、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: ルワンダはBluedot APIの発生地域に含まれているが、記事サマリーではDRコンゴ内での発生が主題であり、ルワンダでの実際の確定症例は報告されていない。そのためverified_locationsはDRコンゴのみとした。接触者追跡が弱く、治療センターへの住民の敵対行動が続いており、封じ込めの困難が指摘されている。MSF等国際機関の支援が開始されている。

article.articleHeadline: Учёные призывают ВОЗ признать токсоплазмоз запущенной инфекцией из-за глобального распространения
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Scientists urge WHO to recognize toxoplasmosis as a neglected infection due to its global spread.
article.articleSummary: Researchers urge the World Health Organization to classify toxoplasmosis as a neglected tropical disease due to its global spread. The parasite Toxoplasma gondii infects billions worldwide, with seroprevalence around 10% in the United States and up to 80% among poor populations in Brazil, and causes eye damage, neurological issues, and risks during pregnancy. Transmission occurs mainly via cat feces, contaminated water, or undercooked meat; cats are the primary hosts with intermediate hosts like rodents. Most infections are asymptomatic, but congenital infection can trigger miscarriage, neurological impairments, and ocular disease, including retinal inflammation and potential vision loss. Latent infection may be linked to behavioral changes in rodents and possibly humans, though debated. The authors argue acknowledgment as an NTD could unlock funding for vaccines and new therapies; currently no vaccine exists. Prevention emphasizes hygiene, meat safety, handwashing, proper litter handling, plus systemic improvements in sanitation, water, and diagnostics.

triage.headline_ja: 科学者らがWHOに対し、トキソプラズマ症の世界的蔓延を理由に同感染症を顧みられない感染症として認識するよう要請
triage.triage_reason: トキソプラズマ症は既知の感染症であり、現在のアウトブレイク報告ではなく、科学的提言記事である。IHR基準・スクリーニング基準の複数該当は見られるが、情報不足と記事の性質（政策提言）から段階的な経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事は新規アウトブレイク報告ではなく、既知の風土病に対する政策的認識変更の要請である。米国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。ブラジルは記事本文で高い血清陽性率（最大80%）が言及されている。フルRRAは不要だが、WHO による NTD 認定動向の継続監視を推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Роспотребнадзор предупредил псковичей о мелиоидозе после случая у туристки из Таиланда
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rospotrebnadzor warned Pskov residents about melioidosis after a case involving a female tourist from Thailand.
article.articleSummary: Russia reports an imported case of melioidosis in a woman who recently returned from Thailand. The patient, who visited an elephant farm during her travels, is currently in serious condition in a hospital in the Pskov region. The case highlights transmission of Burkholderia pseudomallei, found in soil and water, with infection occurring via skin contact, inhalation, or contaminated food and water. Incubation ranges from 1 to 21 days, but may extend for years. Key symptoms include high fever, productive cough with purulent sputum, diarrhea, and abscesses; risk is higher for individuals over 45 with chronic diseases. Preventive measures include avoiding barefoot exposure, freshwater swimming, animal contact, and consuming safe water and food. If ill after returning, seek medical care promptly and report travel. Russia already has rapid diagnostic tests for melioidosis."

triage.headline_ja: ロスポトレブナゾール、タイからの観光客の患者発生後、プスコフ住民にメリオイドーシスについて警告
triage.triage_reason: 輸入症例の報告であり、単一事例で国内の広がりの証拠はなし。ただしメリオイドーシスは重篤な疾患で、公開警告が発出された点から経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はロシアの患者発生ですが、ロシアは対象国リストに含まれていないため、感染源国のタイのみ verified_locations に記載。患者はタイから帰国した輸入症例で、ロシア国内での二次感染やアウトブレークの証拠なし。ただしIHR基準2つ以上該当したため WATCH レベルで継続監視推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Influenza lidera internações graves e Ribeirão Preto reforça vacinação
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza Leads in Severe Hospitalizations and Ribeirão Preto Boosts Vaccination
article.articleSummary: Ribeirão Preto, São Paulo, Brazil, intensified its influenza vaccination campaign after influenza became the leading cause of hospitalizations for Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SRAG). From January through June 21, the city recorded 667 SRAG hospitalizations and five deaths. Influenza accounted for 41.3% of hospitalizations with identified viruses, ahead of RSV, rhinovirus, and COVID-19, with cases rising in May and June as cooler weather favored viral spread. Children up to two years old accounted for 113 cases, with RSV predominating; seniors over 80 had 58 hospitalizations. Flu vaccination is available to everyone from six months of age at 39 municipal sites, Monday–Friday, no appointment needed. RSV protection via Nirsevimab is offered to premature babies up to 36 weeks 6 days and to children up to 23 months with comorbidities, at maternities with SUS NICUs or UBDS Castelo Branco. Pregnant women can also receive the RSV vaccine in the public network.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザが重症入院の首位 リベイラン・プレトがワクチン接種を強化
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルにおけるインフルエンザ・RSV・COVID-19の同時流行を報告しており、SRAG（重症急性呼吸器症候群）の主要原因としてインフルエンザが41.3%を占める異常な状況である。ただし、死亡数が5件と限定的であり、国際的拡大リスクやIHR基準2つ以上の明確な該当は判断しがたい。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事はポルトガル語ブラジルソースであり、信頼度は高い。インフルエンザがSRAGの主要原因（41.3%）となっているのは通常と異なる傾向。季節的な気候変化との関連が記述されている。死亡数は6月21日までの累計5件であり、重症度の全体像が不明確なため、より詳細な情報を待つ必要がある。WPRO基準では3つ該当しているが、IHR基準が1つのみのため、現段階ではWATCHの判定が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: SP registra 3 novos casos de sarampo e soma 5 ocorrências
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo records 3 new measles cases and brings the total to 5.
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak in São Paulo, Brazil: Three new cases confirmed on 26 June 2026 in São Paulo and Guarulhos, bringing total to five. Infected children are 6 months to 1 year old; two unvaccinated; none traveled recently; all recovered. Since 25 June, SES-SP recommends a zero-dose of measles-mumps-rubella (MMR) vaccine for children 6 months to 11 months 29 days in São Paulo and Guarulhos. The zero-dose complements but does not replace the routine schedule: first MMR dose at 12 months, second dose (preferably tetraviral) at 15 months. Earlier March and April cases were imported—a 6-month-old infant and a 42-year-old man, both unvaccinated and recovered. State vaccination coverage: 85.32% first dose, 72.06% second. CVE-SP and the Ministry of Health are tracing sources, blocking vaccination, case finding, and intensified immunization at airports, bus terminals, and transit hubs. Parents should check vaccination cards and update as needed.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州が麻疹の新規事例3件を記録し、合計5件に達した
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・サンパウロ州における麻疹・ムンプス・風疹の小規模な局所的な発生。IHR基準は2つ以上該当しないが、ワクチン接種率の低さ（85.32%、72.06%）と未接種症例の存在により流行の可能性がある。情報不足のため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: WPROスクリーニング基準3つ該当（異常性、長期曝露、流行しやすさ）。記事では死亡や重症化の報告なく、全症例が回復している。ただし未接種児童の存在と州のワクチン接種率が80～85%程度であり、今後の流行拡大リスクがある。また、3月・4月に輸入症例が確認されており、継続的な流行リスク監視が必要。情報が詳細に提供されているため、公衆衛生当局による対応・監視が明確であるが、国際的拡大リスクは現在のところ低い。

article.articleHeadline: गुजरात गांधीनगर में 'पल्स पोलियो अभियान' के तहत 1.58 लाख बच्चों को टीका लगाया जाएगा | Agartala: Polio Immunization Drive
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Gandhinagar, Gujarat, under the 'Pulse Polio Campaign', 1.58 lakh children will be vaccinated | Agartala: Polio Immunization Drive.
article.articleSummary: Under the National Pulse Polio Immunization Campaign, Gandhinagar district in Gujarat will vaccinate 158,721 children aged 0–5 with two drops of polio vaccine on 28 June. The effort leverages 746 vaccination booths across the district, supported by 103 mobile teams targeting remote areas such as brick kilns and construction sites, and five transit teams at bus stands, railway stations, and other public places to reach traveling children.
