A total of 3,167 health workers will coordinate booths, mobile units, and transit points. A follow-up system will ensure coverage for those missed on the main day. On days 2 and 3, 427 dedicated teams will conduct door-to-door surveys to identify and vaccinate children excluded from booth-based programs. Parents are urged to bring eligible children to the nearest polio booth, aligning with the national slogan 'Do boond zindagi ki'.

triage.headline_ja: グジャラート州ガンディナガルで「パルス・ポリオキャンペーン」により1.58万人の子どもがワクチン接種予定
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はポリオの定期予防接種キャンペーンについての報道であり、新規の疾病クラスタ、アウトブレイク、または公衆衛生上の危機的状況を示すシグナルではない。IHR基準、WPROスクリーニング基準ともに該当せず、社会的・政治的関心の高まりも認められない。
triage.notes: 本記事は公開されたポリオ定期予防接種キャンペーン（Pulse Polio Immunization Drive）の実施予定に関する情報であり、感染症のアウトブレイク、クラスタ、または予期しない疾病発生を報告するものではない。シグナル検出の対象外。

article.articleHeadline: علاج تجريبي أميركي لإيبولا في طريقه إلى الكونغو وأوغندا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An American experimental treatment for Ebola on its way to Congo and Uganda.
article.articleSummary: On 26 June 2026, U.S. health authorities announced plans to ship MBP134, an experimental monoclonal antibody therapy, to the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda to help address a current outbreak of Ebola virus disease caused by the Bundibugyo (EBOV-B) lineage. The package includes 2,500 rapid diagnostic tests stored in advance to aid detection and public health response. The effort, led by the Strategic Preparedness and Response Office in coordination with the Biomedical Advanced Research and Development Authority (BARDA), also funds a randomized trial run by Oxford University to evaluate MBP134 under compassionate use in affected countries. MBP134 has shown activity against several Ebola strains in preclinical studies and has completed early safety testing; data from outbreaks could inform future regulatory decisions. The program also seeks vaccine proposals using the same platform as Merck's ERVEBO vaccine targeting Zaire Ebola.

triage.headline_ja: 米国の実験的エボラ治療薬がコンゴとウガンダに向けて発送中
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の現在のアウトブレイクが DRC とウガンダで発生しており、IHR基準（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）の複数該当およびWPRO基準（重症度、流行性）を満たす。国際的な支援と医療介入が進行中であり、シグナルとしてピックアップが適切。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、実際のエボラアウトブレイクが DRC とウガンダで報告されていることが確認される。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。Bundibugyo (EBOV-B) 系統によるアウトブレイク、米国による実験的治療薬（MBP134）の送付、臨床試験計画、診断検査キット配付など、多くの支援活動が記載されている。これは現在進行中の感染症危機管理活動を示す。

article.articleHeadline: أمريكا ترسل علاجاً تجريبياً لـ"إيبولا" إلى الكونغو وأوغندا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United States sends an experimental treatment for Ebola to the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda.
article.articleSummary: US, led by the Strategic Preparedness and Response office through the Biomedical Advanced Research and Development Authority, is sending MBP134, an experimental monoclonal antibody therapy for Ebola, to the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda to help contain the Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak. The initiative also stockpiles 2,500 rapid diagnostic tests to aid detection and public health response. An Oxford University–led randomized trial will evaluate MBP134, with data from compassionate-use and early safety studies intended to inform future regulatory decisions. There are currently no approved vaccines or treatments specifically for Bundibugyo ebolavirus. Separately, the agency is seeking proposals to develop a vaccine against Bundibugyo using a platform similar to Merck’s Ervebo, which targets Zaire ebolavirus.

triage.headline_ja: 米国がエボラの実験的治療薬をコンゴ民主共和国とウガンダに送付
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo型）の発生に対する国際的対応であり、IHR基準3項目（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限の可能性）が該当。対象国DRCでの実際の患者発生と米国による実験的治療薬派遣という国際的支援の実施が確認される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはBundibugyo ebolavirus（エボラウイルス属の一種）のアウトブレイク対応を記述。発生地域にはUgandaも列挙されているが、サマリーで明確にウガンダでの患者発生は述べられておらず、米国による治療薬送付先の一つとして言及されているのみ。DRCでの実際のアウトブレイク対応が主要な焦点であり、対象国リストにはDRCのみが該当。（注: ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。）

article.articleHeadline: ДР Конго обяви, че броят на потвърдените случаи на ебола в страната е нараснал до 1203
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo announced that the number of confirmed Ebola cases in the country has risen to 1,203.
article.articleSummary: Confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo have risen to 1,203, with 321 deaths, according to government data cited by Reuters. The figures are current as of 25 June 2026 and include the latest 24-hour increase reported in the daily situation report. The article features a photo caption from Ruampara, DR Congo, showing clinicians transporting an Ebola patient on 21 May 2026. No further details on symptoms, laboratory confirmation, transmission source, or imported/exported cases are provided in the text. The report underscores ongoing Ebola outbreak activity within DR Congo. No provincial breakdown is provided; the report does not specify affected provinces.

triage.headline_ja: DRC（コンゴ民主共和国）が同国のエボラ確認患者数が1,203人に増加したことを発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の4項目すべてに該当。エボラは重篤で致死的な感染症であり、321人の死亡が報告されている。国際的な拡大リスクと公衆衛生への深刻な影響が懸念されるため、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病の大規模アウトブレイク。患者数1,203人、死亡321人という深刻な統計が報告されている。発生地域にはUgandaも記載されているが、記事サマリーではDRCのみが主題であるため、Ugandaは除外。2026年6月25日時点のデータに基づく。

article.articleHeadline: As Ebola spreads in Eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), United Nations World Food Programme (WFP) warns food assistance is vital to containing the outbreak
article.articleSummary: As of 26 June 2026, Ebola is active in eastern DRC (Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu) across 34 health zones; over 10 million people are food insecure, with 30 zones in IPC Phase 3+ and seven in Phase 4. WFP is scaling up food assistance, nutrition and logistics for more than 1.2 million people. Since 28 May, 36,000 hot meals have reached 1,600 patients, caregivers and contacts at 14 treatment and isolation centers; take-home rations reach 2,600+ in North Kivu and Ituri; 14,000 in ten quarantined villages in South Kivu receive monthly food. WFP logistics include UNHAS flights/cargo, a helicopter to hotspots, and a Uganda-sourced C-130 delivering cargo. New affected areas: Butembo, Bambu, Kilo, Nizi, Tchomia and Kasenyi. Needs: USD 72 million for Ebola response (six months); USD 286 million for general food aid in DRC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国東部でエボラ出血熱が拡大、国連世界食糧計画（WFP）が食糧支援が感染拡大遏止に重要と警告
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はIHR基準で4項目全てに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、地域内での異常な拡大、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPRO基準も5項目全て該当し、シグナルとして識別。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに明記されている発生地域はDRC東部（Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu）3州34保健地域。イタリアはBambù地点が誤った座標で含まれている（北イタリアの座標）ため、実際の感染発生地ではない。ウガンダは物流支援国として記載されているが、感染発生国ではない。DRCのみ verified_locations に含める。

article.articleHeadline: Tuberculose: especialista explica doença após defesa de Oruam alegar diagnóstico | Rádio Itatiaia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tuberculosis: a specialist explains the disease after Oruam's defense alleging a diagnosis | Rádio Itatiaia
article.articleSummary: Brazilian rapper Oruam, who is at large, has been diagnosed with tuberculosis, and his defense sought revocation of preventive detention; the Rio de Janeiro court denied the request. The defense cites weight loss, chronic cough, and pulmonary tissue lesions. TB’s main symptom is a persistent cough lasting three weeks or more, sometimes with blood-tinged sputum. Other signs include low-grade fever, night sweats, fatigue, weight loss, and decreased appetite. Smoking is a major risk factor for TB development and progression, though the disease is not caused by smoking. Transmission occurs via airborne particles expelled when an infected person coughs, talks, or sneezes; aerosols can linger in poorly ventilated spaces. Without timely treatment, TB can cause permanent lung damage and may be fatal, especially in immunocompromised individuals. Treatment requires antibiotics for at least six months; adherence is crucial to prevent resistance, and early improvement reduces transmission but is not a cure.

triage.headline_ja: 結核：オルアムの診断疑いを主張した防御後、専門家が疾患を説明 | ラジオ・イタティアイア
triage.triage_reason: 個別症例の医学情報提供記事であり、感染症の新規発生・集団発生を示すシグナルではない。公衆衛生危機の兆候が認められず、国際的な拡大リスクも認識されない。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジルのラッパーOruamの個別結核診断に関する法的手続きと、医学的背景情報を提供するもの。公衆衛生上の危機、集団発生の兆候、異常な疫学的パターンは記述されていない。結核は既知の疾患であり、治療法も確立している。社会的関心はあるが、感染症監視の対象とすべきシグナルではない。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو: ارتفاع عدد الإصابات المؤكدة بفيروس إيبولا إلى 1203 - كويت نيوز
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo: The number of confirmed Ebola virus infections rises to 1,203 - Kuwait News
article.articleSummary: As of June 26, 2026, government data from the Democratic Republic of the Congo show Ebola virus infections have risen to 1,203, with 321 deaths. The figure reflects total confirmed cases to date, based on a situation report that also records cases documented in the past 24 hours. The brief does not provide details on affected provinces, transmission chains, symptoms, laboratory confirmation methods, recovered counts, or infection sources, nor any imported/exported-case notes. It underscores an ongoing Ebola outbreak in the DRC, with daily updates capturing new cases within the last day and highlighting continued monitoring by health authorities.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ：エボラウイルス感染症の確認感染者数が1,203人に増加 - クウェートニュース
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準において深刻な公衆衛生影響（1,203確認症例、321死亡）と国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限の可能性が明確に該当。WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度（死亡報告）、流行しやすさ（ヒト-ヒト感染可能性）が該当。エボラウイルス疾患は最高リスク疾患であり、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病はIHR(2005)の通知対象疾患。記事サマリーは継続中のDRCでの流行を報告しており、1,203確認症例と321死亡という深刻な数字を記録。検査室確認方法、回復者数、感染源などの詳細情報は記事に含まれていないが、継続的な監視と日次更新が行われている状況が明示されている。対象国リストにはDRCが含まれていないため、WPROスクリーニング対象外だが、エボラウイルスの世界的脅威としてPICKUP判定とする。

article.articleHeadline: Más de 300 muertos por ébola: Rep. del Congo alcanza el 95% de camas ocupadas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 300 dead from Ebola: Democratic Republic of the Congo reaches 95% bed occupancy.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has caused at least 304 deaths among 1,155 confirmed cases, as authorities report mid-May onset of the Bundibugyo strain. The outbreak is spreading rapidly, with the Africa CDC warning that 95% of hospital beds in the DRC are currently occupied. Bunia, capital of Ituri Province and the hardest-hit area, is set to host clinical trials of two potential treatments next week: MBP134, an experimental Ebola drug, and remdesivir, an antiviral whose supplies have arrived in the DRC. The disease spreads through contact with infected bodily fluids, and the lack of a vaccine or specific treatment for Bundibugyo contributes to containment challenges. To curb transmission and enable contact tracing, the Congolese government ordered a 21-day travel quarantine for people moving from affected zones within the country or abroad.

triage.headline_ja: エボラで300人以上が死亡：コンゴ民主共和国が病床使用率95%に達する
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の株系統、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限措置）。WPROスクリーニング基準5項目すべてに該当。高い致死率と医療逼迫が確認されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）でのエボラ拡大を主題としており、Bunia（Ituri州の州都）が最も被害を受けている地域として記載されている。治療薬臨床試験の準備、21日間の移動隔離令、Africa CDCの警告など、地域的・国際的な関心が高い。2026年中旬報告という最新情報であり、Bundibugyo株系統の出現は不測の事態である。

article.articleHeadline: Врач рассказала о лечении и симптомах мелиоидоза
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The doctor discussed the treatment and symptoms of melioidosis.
article.articleSummary: Melioidosis, an infectious disease, has been reported in Russia as an imported case in a woman who returned from Thailand. On June 23, Rospotrebnadzor reported she is currently hospitalized in critical condition. The disease can be asymptomatic or mild; risk groups include diabetes, alcoholism, immunodeficiencies (including HIV), and kidney diseases. Transmission is via soil; it is not spread person-to-person or from animals. Diagnosis is challenging because symptoms resemble other illnesses; clinicians should consider recent international travel. Treatment comprises two to three weeks of intravenous antibiotics, then three to six months of oral antibiotics. Russia uses diagnostic test systems, and the border-crossing Perimeter system monitors epidemiological risks online. This is an imported case; there is no stated local transmission beyond this patient.

triage.headline_ja: 医師がメリオイドーシスの治療と症状について説明
triage.triage_reason: 輸入症例の単一事例であり、ロシア国内での二次感染の報告はなく、IHR基準は2つ未満。ただしタイでの風土病と関連し、国際旅行に伴う症例認識の重要性があるため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはロシアでの輸入症例を記述しており、患者はタイからの帰国者。ロシアはBluedot発生地域に含まれるが、対象国リストに無いため除外。タイは風土病地域として医学的に関連するため verified_locations に含める。単一輸入症例であり、ロシア国内での継続的な地域内伝播の報告なし。診断の困難さと国際旅行に伴う臨床的認識の重要性が強調されている。

article.articleHeadline: La RD del Congo supera la barrera de los 300 muertos confirmados por el brote de ébola - Hondudiario
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo Surpasses 300 Confirmed Deaths From the Ebola Outbreak
article.articleSummary: DR Congo is facing an Ebola outbreak in the east with 304 deaths among 1,155 confirmed cases as of June 24. The case fatality rate is 26.3%, 138 patients have recovered, and 326 people remain in isolation or hospitalized; contact tracing stands at 79.2%. The outbreak began May 15 in Ituri, a border province with Uganda and South Sudan, and has spread to North and South Kivu. Uganda has 20 confirmed cases, 15 imported from DRC, including two deaths. France reports its first Ebola case in a returning physician. The virus belongs to the Bundibugyo strain, with a fatality rate of 30-50% and no approved vaccine or specific treatment. A 90-day cross-border response plan between DRC and Uganda aims to bolster laboratories and care. WHO declared a PHEIC on May 17; this is the third-worst Ebola epidemic, after 2014–2016 West Africa and 2018–2020 DRC outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国がエボラ熱での確認死者が300人を超える
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。WHO PHEIC既宣言、国際拡大（ウガンダ20例、フランス1例）、高い致死率（26.3%）を示すエボラ熱の複数国拡大イベント。
triage.notes: WHO PEHICが2026年5月17日に既に宣言されている。複数国への拡大（ウガンダ20例、フランス1例）、Bundibugyo株（30-50%の高致死率）、ワクチン・治療法なし、激しい疫学動向を示す重大シグナル。DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。ウガンダ・スーダン・フランスは対象国リストに含まれないため記載しない。

article.articleHeadline: برنامج الأغذية العالمي يدعو لتمويل عاجل لاحتواء أزمة إيبولا في الكونغو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Food Programme calls for urgent funding to contain the Ebola crisis in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: The World Food Programme warns that containing the Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo requires strengthening food security and sustaining humanitarian deliveries to affected areas amid a severe humanitarian crisis. About 26.5 million people in DRC are experiencing food insecurity, complicating health response efforts and threatening to worsen the spread of Ebola. The WFP says it needs about $72 million to directly fund the Ebola response, in addition to $286 million to provide essential food assistance to those affected. It urges the international community to provide urgent funding to prevent further deterioration of humanitarian and health conditions. The agency notes that bolstering food support is a core element of outbreak control and community resilience.

triage.headline_ja: 世界食糧計画、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ危機封じ込めのための緊急資金提供を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラウイルス病の確認事例に基づく深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的な資金動員の必要性、および対象国DRCでの活発な流行状況がシグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: 記事は東部DRCでの活動中のエボラ流行を背景に、国際的な資金支援の緊急性を強調している。26.5百万人の食糧不安が健康対応を複雑化させており、二次的な公衆衛生危機のリスクが懸念される。WFPによる資金要請自体が国際的関心と対応能力の限界を示唆している。

article.articleHeadline: Congo-Kinshasa: Les tradipraticiens s'engagent dans la sensibilisation communautaire contre l'épidémie d'Ebola à Bunia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo-Kinshasa: Traditional healers engage in community sensitization against the Ebola outbreak in Bunia.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in Ituri province, Democratic Republic of Congo, centered in Bunia, extending for over a month across 22 health zones with more than 100 deaths. Traditional healers (tradipraticiens) are now actively engaging in the response after training on transmission, barrier measures, and referral of suspected cases to health facilities. They pledge to raise community awareness and reorient suspected cases while calling for adequate infection-prevention equipment. The training is part of Fondation des Aigles' integrated WASH project, aiming to strengthen community sentinel action. Organizers say tradipraticiens’ cultural influence positions them as essential partners to curb the outbreak. Ally Masudi, a Bunia practitioner, notes patients sometimes present with Ebola-like signs; with training, they can better direct cases to care. They request PPE (gloves, masks, gowns) for safe early consultations to protect themselves.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：ブニアでのエボラ流行に対する地域啓発にトラディショナルヒーラーが協力
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の活発な流行（100人以上の死亡、22の保健地域にまたがる）、IHR基準4項目中3項目以上該当、WPRO基準5項目全て該当。国際的拡大リスクと渡航制限のリスク高い。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱はIHR対象疾患。Ituri州Bunia中心の流行は1ヶ月以上継続、100名以上の死亡報告あり。トラディショナルヒーラーの関与は地域対応の重要性を示すが、同時にコミュニティレベルでのPPE不足や感染予防体制の課題を浮き彫りにしている。DRCはエボラ流行の常在地域だが、本流行は活発で重大。

article.articleHeadline: Mutirão reforça combate à dengue no bairro Alterosa, em Lavras
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Task force strengthens the fight against dengue in the Alterosa neighborhood of Lavras
article.articleSummary: On 2026-06-26, the Alterosa neighborhood in Lavras, Brazil, hosted a dengue-control mutirão as part of ongoing municipal efforts against the Aedes aegypti mosquito. Teams inspected public areas and residences to identify standing-water sites that could harbor larvae and to reinforce preventive measures. Community outreach emphasized resident participation, highlighting daily practices to reduce risk. Core precautions include keeping water storage tanks sealed, eliminating containers that collect rainwater, and cleaning gutters and yards. City authorities stress that dengue control depends on sustained actions and community collaboration, not isolated campaigns. The effort aligns with a broader health-surveillance strategy to minimize diseases transmitted by Aedes aegypti and to protect residents, reinforcing the municipality’s commitment to prevention and public health.

triage.headline_ja: ラブラスのアルテローサ地区でデング熱対策を強化する大掛かりな取り組み
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の既知の流行地域でのルーチンな予防活動であり、異常性や国際的な拡大リスクは認められない。IHR基準、WPROスクリーニング基準いずれも該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事はブラジルのラブラスにおけるデング熱の予防キャンペーンの報道であり、新規患者発生の警告ではない。既知の風土病に対する定期的な予防活動にすぎず、シグナルの定義を満たさない。

article.articleHeadline: Frio e baixa imunidade aumentam risco de infecções respiratórias
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cold weather and a weakened immune system increase the risk of respiratory infections.
article.articleSummary: Winter brings increased circulation of viruses and bacteria causing respiratory infections in Brazil, elevating visits for acute respiratory syndromes (SRAG), especially among children, older adults, and those with chronic diseases. Key pathogens include respiratory syncytial virus (RSV), linked to bronchiolitis in infants, and Streptococcus pneumoniae, which can cause pneumonia, meningitis, sinusitis, and otitis media and may progress to severe illness. Health surveillance records a seasonal rise in SRAG during colder months, underscoring prevention, early diagnosis, and appropriate treatment. Transmission occurs mainly via respiratory droplets and contact with contaminated surfaces, highlighting hand hygiene, ventilated spaces, and masking when experiencing flu-like symptoms. Vaccination against influenza, COVID-19, and pneumococcus is a key preventive measure, especially for at-risk groups, reducing complications, hospitalizations, and deaths. Clinicians warn to watch for warning signs—persistent fever, dyspnea, prostration, chest pain, wheeze, and worsening symptoms—requiring prompt medical evaluation, particularly in children, the elderly, and those with comorbidities.

triage.headline_ja: 寒冷天候と低下した免疫力が呼吸器感染症のリスクを増加させる
triage.triage_reason: 季節性呼吸器感染症（RSV、インフルエンザ、肺炎球菌）の冬季流行に関する一般的な公衆衛生情報。異常な発生や急速な拡大ではなく、予想される季節現象の注意喚起記事と判断される。
triage.notes: 本記事は季節性呼吸器感染症（RSV、インフルエンザ、肺炎球菌）に関するブラジルの予防啓発情報である。既知の季節現象であり、異常な感染症クラスターの報告ではない。ただし、WPRO基準の「長期曝露」と「流行しやすさ」に該当するため、今後の具体的な発症数増加やクラスタ報告を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Beni : un nouveau centre de traitement d'Ebola opérationnel dès le 28 juin - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Beni: a new Ebola treatment center operational as of June 28 - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease treatment center to be operational on June 28, 2026 at Stade des Sœurs Orantes in Beni, Nord-Kivu, eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo. The announcement was made by Beni mayor Nyofondo Te-Kodale Jacob after a coordination meeting with state authorities, response teams, health zone chiefs, health partners and civil society. Measures include adherence to infection prevention: barrier controls, dignified and safe burials, and community-based surveillance. The Beni health zone currently has more than 20 confirmed Ebola cases amid ongoing outbreaks that have intensified tensions. Dr. Michel Tosalisana, chief medical officer for the Beni health zone, urged strict compliance with prevention rules. Me Pépin Kavota, president of Beni’s civil society, condemned attacks on response teams, warning such assaults hinder contact tracing, patient care and secure funeral protocols, complicating the outbreak response.

triage.headline_ja: ベニ：2026年6月28日より新しいエボラ治療センターが稼働開始予定 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で確認されたエボラウイルス疾患の流行中であり、IHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、異常/予想外性、国際的拡大リスク）を複数満たし、WPROスクリーニング基準（重症度、長期曝露、流行のしやすさ、管理可能性）の複数に該当する。対応チームへの暴力など管理上の課題も確認され、フルRRA進行の必要がある。
triage.notes: コンゴ民主共和国北キヴ州ベニ地域での確認済みエボラ流行。記事は新たな治療センター開設の準備を述べているが、現在20例以上の確認症例があり、対応チームへの暴力が報告されている点が管理上の深刻な懸念。IHRおよびWPRO基準の全項目に該当。

article.articleHeadline: Voyageur atteint d'Ebola : Air France a suspendu ses vols Paris-Kinshasa, la reprise prévue samedi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Traveler infected with Ebola: Air France has suspended its Paris-Kinshasa flights, with service expected to resume on Saturday.
article.articleSummary: Ebola case in France prompts Air France to suspend Paris–Kinshasa flights on June 26, 2026 after a laboratory-confirmed infection in a doctor for NGO Alima who traveled on that route from eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (areas with Ebola circulation). Flight service is expected to resume on June 27. The patient was nearly asymptomatic at boarding, reporting only headaches, and will be isolated for 21 days—the incubation period. Air France has disinfected the aircraft and provided passenger lists to health authorities; Kinshasa airport will implement enhanced health checks before boarding. The infection is imported to France, with the East DRC exposure identified as the source of infection.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ感染者の移動：エアフランスがパリ-キンシャサ便を運休、土曜日の運航再開予定
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の国際的な移動ケースであり、IHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的な拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）を複数満たし、WPRO基準（重症度、流行可能性、管理可能性）でも複数該当する。国際支援と監視が必要なシグナルである。
triage.notes: 記事はエボラの輸入ケースがフランスで確認されたことを報告しているが、実際の感染発生地は東コンゴ民主共和国（DRC）である。Bluedot APIはパリとフランスを発生地域として付与しているが、これらは確認症例の検査地点であり、感染源はDRCの流行地帯である。verified_locationsはサマリーに基づきDRCのみを含める。フランスは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: चिंता: - गर्म मौसम के बावजूद चिकन पॉक्स नहीं थम रहा
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Concern: Chickenpox not stopping despite hot weather.
article.articleSummary: Gurugram, India – Chickenpox (varicella) cases persist despite hot weather. Sector-10 Civil Hospital reported two new patients last week, with 12–15 patients seeking treatment in the past month. Experts attribute ongoing spread to changes in Varicella-Zoster virus behavior and waning immunity, now affecting teenagers and adults in addition to children. Historically, cases peaked January–April, but transmission is now year-round. Early symptoms include mild fever, headache, fatigue, and body aches, followed by a red rash that becomes vesicles—itchy and crusting over several days. Major risk factors: lack of vaccination, contact with infected individuals, crowded places, and weakened immunity. Prevention hinges on vaccination and isolating the affected person until recovery; emphasize hand hygiene, hydration, and prompt medical advice to prevent complications such as pneumonia, skin infections, or CNS issues in vulnerable individuals.

triage.headline_ja: 懸念：暑い季節にもかかわらず水痘が収まらない
triage.triage_reason: インドのグルガオン（ハリヤナ州）での水痘患者増加が報告されているが、死亡者数や重症者数などの重症度情報が明記されていない。季節外での流行は異常であるが、IHR基準の判定に必要な詳細情報が不足している。
triage.notes: グルガオムのセクター10市民病院で週1件、月間12～15人の患者が報告されている。通常は1月～4月がピークだが、年間通して感染が発生している点は異常。ワクチン未接種率が主要なリスク因子とされている。ただし、患者の重症度、死亡例の有無、全国的な拡大傾向などの情報が欠落しており、完全なリスク評価には追加情報が必要。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: Ébola: EUA ativam nível máximo de emergência
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: U.S. activates the highest level of emergency.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak: United States activates the highest level of emergency response (Level 1) by the CDC, the fifth time this top activation has been used. Level 1 is an internal mobilization measure, not a population risk, prompting 24/7 staffing for critical operations. In the Democratic Republic of Congo, the outbreak has reached about 1,203 confirmed infections and 321 deaths as of Thursday, June 25, 2026. The CDC notes that despite the heightened readiness, the current risk of spread to the United States remains low. This Level 1 activation follows historical triggers: Katrina (2005), H1N1 (2009–2010), the West Africa Ebola outbreak (2014–2016), and Zika in Brazil (2016–2017). The SARS-CoV-2 pandemic did not trigger a Level 1 activation, though agency-wide responses were extensive. Reuters reported the update.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：米国が最高レベルの緊急事態対応を発動
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国におけるエボラ出血熱の大規模な流行事例（1,203症例、321死亡）であり、米国の最高レベル緊急対応発動は国際的に重大な公衆衛生上の影響を示唆する。IHR基準の4項目全て（深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）に該当する。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、エボラ出血熱の実際の流行はコンゴ民主共和国で発生していることが明確である。ブラジルはZika流行の過去事例の参照文脈として記載されているが、現在のエボラ流行とは直接関連がない。米国の緊急対応発動は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。複数疾患（Zika、H1N1、Ebola）が記載されているが、記事の主題はエボラ出血熱の流行である。配信日時が2026年6月という将来日付であり、シナリオまたはシミュレーション情報の可能性があるが、提供情報に基づきトリアージを実施した。

article.articleHeadline: Число умерших от лихорадки Эбола в ДРК достигло 321
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The death toll from Ebola fever in the DRC has reached 321.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola virus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has reached 1,203 confirmed cases and 321 deaths, with 148 recoveries, as of June 25, 2026. The case fatality rate stands at 26.7%. Data come from the DRC’s National Institute of Public Health (INSP). The World Health Organization has declared the Congo–Uganda Ebola outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, with regional risk assessed as high and a warning that the situation could threaten other countries. The report emphasizes ongoing transmission within the DRC and cross-border concerns with Uganda, underscoring the international implications and the need for sustained public health measures.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ熱による死者数が321人に達した
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の国際的に重要な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、WHOによるPHEIC宣言、地域リスク高評価、国境を越えた拡大の危険性が明記されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはウガンダとの国境を越えた感染の懸念を明記しているが、実際の確認症例はDRCが主要な発生地である。WHO PHIEC宣言により国際的な重要性が確定している。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Varicella-zoster virus inflicts lasting damage to nerves and the brain, study reveals
article.articleSummary: Varicella-zoster virus, which causes herpes zoster and postherpetic neuralgia (PHN), inflicts lasting nervous system damage beyond rash resolution. A comprehensive review led by Professor Bifa Fan of the China-Japan Friendship Hospital maps the cascade of mechanisms driving persistent zoster-associated pain: injured peripheral fibers become hyper-excitable from abnormal ion channels, and spinal cord/brain central sensitization amplifies pain signals long after acute infection. The authors link each mechanism to existing targeted therapies and argue that acute zoster pain and PHN form a single continuous disease process, a principle now embedded in the 2025 guidelines. The work, titled 'Research Progress on Zoster-Associated Pain and Its Pain Mechanisms,' was published in Skin on April 21, 2026, by Li, Y., et al. (DOI: 10.2738/SKIN.2026.0003). Based in China, the study supports earlier, more aggressive treatment to prevent chronic PHN.

triage.headline_ja: 帯状疱疹ウイルスが神経と脳に永続的な損傷を与えることが研究で明らかに
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は帯状疱疹ウイルス感染後の神経障害メカニズムに関する医学的レビュー論文であり、新規発生事象の報告ではない。公衆衛生上の緊急事象の特性を持たない。
triage.notes: 本記事はシグナル検知対象ではなく、医学文献のレビュー論文である。帯状疱疹ウイルスは既知の病原体で、新規発生事象や異常なクラスター報告は含まれていない。中国の研究機関による論文発表であるが、感染症危機管理の観点での新たなリスク情報は存在しない。

article.articleHeadline: திருவண்ணாமலை மாவட்டத்தில் நாளை 1.50 லட்சம் குழந்தைகளுக்கு போலியோ தடுப்பு: சொட்டு மருந்து வழங்கும் பணி தொடக்கம்
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Polio immunization for 1.5 lakh children tomorrow in Tiruvannamalai district: start of oral polio drops distribution drive.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-06-26, Tiruvannamalai district in India announced a forthcoming immunization drive targeting 150,000 children with oral polio drops, scheduled to begin tomorrow. Polio is described as a disease that can cause paralysis in children and, in severe cases, death. India last recorded a poliomyelitis case in 2011. The drive emphasizes polio prevention through the oral polio vaccine to protect young children and sustain a polio-free status. The report does not mention current cases or laboratory confirmations, but highlights the historical polio status in the country and the ongoing public health measure to immunize large cohorts against poliomyelitis. This is part of broader vaccination initiatives to protect children nationwide.

triage.headline_ja: ティルヴァンナマライ地区で明日150万人の子どもたちにポリオ予防接種実施：経口ポリオワクチン滴下配布開始
triage.triage_reason: ポリオ予防接種キャンペーンの公表であり、現在の患者報告や異常な感染症事例ではない。インドは2011年以降ポリオ患者報告がなく、定期的な予防接種活動は予期された公衆衛生措置である。
triage.notes: 本記事は予防接種キャンペーンの公表であり、感染症シグナルではない。ポリオ患者報告や流行の兆候はなく、予期された公衆衛生活動として分類される。

article.articleHeadline: US CDC raises Ebola outbreak response to highest level
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-26, the US CDC raised its Ebola outbreak response to Level 1, its highest emergency designation, signaling concern over the Bundibugyo strain spreading. The Democratic Republic of Congo has reported over 1,200 infections and 321 deaths, with 20 cases in neighboring Uganda, marking the highest first-month total for any outbreak. The CDC's Level 1 activation mobilizes the largest staffing and resources; 19 CDC staff have been deployed overseas, aiding more than 125 on the ground with data analysis, airport exit screenings, laboratory support, and training. The agency has trained 25 local field epidemiologists and provided emergency funding of $107 million; Washington seeks over $1.4 billion in new funds, including $800 million for a quarantine center in Kenya for exposed Americans. The US is sending experimental Ebola treatments and about 2,500 diagnostic tests to Africa. US risk remains low.

triage.headline_ja: US CDCがエボラ出血熱の流行対応を最高レベルに引き上げ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限の可能性）。DRCで1,200以上の感染者と321人の死亡、隣国ウガンダへの拡大、CDC最高レベル対応により、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはUganda、Kenya、USAも含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題は DRC でのエボラ流行。Uganda での症例（20例）は DRC からの二次的な拡大として記載されており、DRC が流行の中心。対象国リストに含まれるのは DRC（203312）のみのため、verified_locations は DRC のみとした。CDC のレベル1対応、1,200以上の感染者、321人の死亡、複数国への拡大、米国による大規模な資金投入と介入は、全てのリスク評価基準に該当する。

article.articleHeadline: Com mais de três mil casos de dengue, Teresina cria Comitê de combate às arboviroses
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: With more than 3,000 dengue cases, Teresina creates Arbovirus Combat Committee.
article.articleSummary: Dengue in Teresina, Brazil, shows 3,104 cases as of June 26, 2026, up from 2,464 in the first half of 2025 (an increase of 640), with 2026 nearing Teresina’s 2025 total of 3,835. In Piauí state, over 7,000 dengue cases have been reported (Sinan). In response, the Teresina Municipal Health Foundation (FMS) established the Technical Intersectoral Committee of Arboviruses (Comitê Técnico Intersetorial das Arboviroses) to coordinate actions against dengue, chikungunya, and zika, mobilize communities, and align efforts across public agencies. The two-year, non-remunerated body will be chaired by FMS officials and include members from health surveillance, epidemiology, CIEVS, zoonoses, the Municipal Health Council, Education, Environment, and state counterparts, plus civil entities such as the Condominium and Shopping Syndicate. Responsibilities include community mobilization, ongoing educational campaigns, strengthened epidemiological and entomological surveillance, integration with primary care and the Family Health Strategy, school programs, and media outreach. President Leopoldina Cipriano notes ecological conditions favor Aedes aegypti, with most breeding inside homes. Decree 28.860 published June 18, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 3000件以上のデング熱患者を受けて、テレシーナ市はアルボウイルス対策委員会を設立
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルにおけるデング熱の明確な増加傾向（2025年同期比640件増）と公衆衛生対応が認識されているが、IHR基準の「深刻な影響」や「国際的拡大リスク」を示す情報が不足している。継続的な監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジルのピアウイ州テレシーナ市におけるデング熱の増加を報告。2026年上半期で3,104件、2025年同期比640件増加。チクングニア、ジカも含むアルボウイルス対策委員会が設立された。死亡数や重症例の報告がないため重症度の評価は困難。ただし前年比増加傾向、複数のアルボウイルスの同時流行、生態学的条件の好適性が指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: Saudi Arabia suspends visas from 3 African countries and bans citizen travel over Ebola precautions - Arabian Business: Latest News on the Middle East, Real Estate, Finance, and More
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-26, Saudi Arabia has intensified Ebola precautions by suspending visas for travellers arriving from the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan and by banning Saudi citizens from visiting those countries. The measures aim to reduce the risk of Ebola entering the Kingdom and include halting visa issuance for visitors from the three nations. Saudi officials report the Kingdom’s public health situation remains stable, with no confirmed or suspected Ebola cases recorded since the restrictions were introduced. The report provides no evidence of local transmission, suggesting the actions are preventive border controls rather than responses to an active outbreak in Saudi Arabia. The steps reflect ongoing efforts to mitigate cross-border Ebola risk in the region.

triage.headline_ja: サウジアラビア、エボラ予防措置としてアフリカ3か国からのビザ発給を停止し、国民の渡航を禁止
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（異常/予想外の政策措置、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限実施）。複数国での同時エボラ検出と国際的対応が進行中であり、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはサウジアラビアの予防的措置を報じているが、実際のエボラ発生地域はDRC、ウガンダ、南スーダンである。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。ウガンダ（226074）は対象国でなく、南スーダン（366755）も対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。複数国での同時流行と国際的な渡航制限実施により、シグナルとしてピックアップが正当化される。

article.articleHeadline: Night campaign targets hidden HIV, Syphilis risks in Chandigarh
article.articleSummary: Chandigarh's CSACS launched the nocturnal RAAS campaign—Ratri AIDS Suraksha Abhiyan—to identify hidden HIV and Syphilis risks among high-risk groups in Chandigarh. Targeting men who have sex with men (MSM) and injecting drug users (IDUs), teams screened hotspots such as hotels, spas, late-night markets, discotheques, bus shelters, and abandoned buildings under cover of darkness. Since April, 17 of 20 planned site visits have been completed, with about 5,000 individuals screened and 1,480 tested for HIV and Syphilis. The initiative identified 59 HIV-reactive and 8 Syphilis-reactive individuals. Officials say the model is pioneering in the country and has prompted replication by New Delhi authorities. With encouraging results, organizers plan to extend the campaign to 20 additional hotspots.

triage.headline_ja: チャンディーガルにおけるHIV・梅毒の隠れたリスクを対象とした夜間キャンペーン
triage.triage_reason: HIV・梅毒スクリーニング活動の拡大であり、確定患者が59例（HIV）および8例（梅毒）と限定的である。スクリーニング基準1つ以上に該当する可能性があるが、異常な集団発生や大規模な公衆衛生危機を示す証拠が不足しており、続報を注視する段階。
triage.notes: 本記事は疾病管理のための公開スクリーニングキャンペーンであり、新規の感染症集団発生ではない。59例のHIV反応陽性および8例の梅毒反応陽性は、既存の感染症を特定するサーベイランス活動の一部。感染症自体の異常な増加や重症度の急増を示していない。ただしMSM・IDU集団への継続的な曝露リスクとHIV・梅毒の流行しやすさは認識され、政府当局による関心と介入が示されている。

article.articleHeadline: Број потврђених случајева оболелих од еболе у ДР Конгу повећан на 1.203
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has risen to 1,203.
article.articleSummary: As of June 26, 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo reports 1,203 confirmed Ebola cases and 321 deaths, according to government data released today. The tally covers all confirmed cases through Thursday. World Health Organization Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said the risk of further international spread is currently low, though the situation requires close monitoring. The report confirms an ongoing domestic Ebola outbreak in the DRC and underscores the sustained public health challenge, with continued surveillance and response effort by national authorities and international partners. This update also highlights ongoing domestic transmission within the DRC and the continued vigilance of international health authorities.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ確認症例数が1,203に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の「公衆衛生への影響は深刻か」「異常または予想外か」「国際的に拡大するリスクがあるか」の3項目に該当。死亡者321名を含む1,203症例の継続的な国内流行は重大な公衆衛生上の影響であり、国際拡大リスクも評価対象となるため、フルRRA進行が必要。
triage.notes: エボラウイルスは国際的に重大な懸念疾患であり、1,203症例・321死亡という規模は深刻な公衆衛生上の影響を示している。WHO事務局長による声明があり、国際的関心も高い。ただしWHOは現在の国際拡大リスクは低いと評価しており、この点は詳細なRRAで検証が必要。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو الديمقراطية: وفيات إيبولا تخطت الـ 300
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo: Ebola deaths surpassed 300.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 1,203 confirmed Ebola virus disease cases and 321 deaths as of 26 June 2026. Official data indicate these totals reflect confirmed cases through Thursday, with the latest 24-hour reporting period included in the situation update. The brief provides no provincial breakdown, no description of symptoms or clinical course, and does not specify laboratory confirmation methods or infection sources. There is no information on vaccination status, outbreak control measures, or details about imported or exported cases. The report confirms an ongoing Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo at the published date, indicating continued transmission and the need for surveillance and public health response in the region.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：エボラウイルス病による死亡者が300人を超過
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つすべて該当。エボラ出血熱は高い致死率と国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限の可能性を伴う極めて深刻な疾患。確認症例1,203件、死亡321件という大規模な進行中の流行。
triage.notes: 進行中の大規模エボラ流行。確認症例1,203件、死亡321件（致死率26.7%）。ワクチン接種状況や制御措置の詳細情報は記事に記載されていない。継続的な監視と国際支援が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola epidemic deaths exceed 300 in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: DR Congo’s Ebola outbreak (Bundibugyo strain) has 304 deaths among 1,115 confirmed infections since detection on May 15, 2026, yielding a 26.3% mortality. The vast majority of cases are in Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu, with Bunia reporting over 91% of infections and 82% of deaths. Transmission is via direct contact with bodily fluids; severe bleeding and organ failure prevail. By 2026-06-26, Europe faces minimal risk and no travel restrictions, though Air France briefly suspended Kinshasa flights. Uganda records 20 confirmed cases and 2 deaths, largely among Congolese nationals who travelled there. A Congolese doctor working in France is the first case outside Africa. No approved vaccines or treatments exist for Bundibugyo; health facilities are strained, 78 healthcare workers infected and 18 dead, amid community mistrust and post-mortem hesitancy affecting case counts.

triage.headline_ja: DR Congoのエボラ流行死亡者が300人を超える
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo株）の流行で死亡者304人、感染確定者1,115人。複数国への国際拡大（ウガンダ、フランス）、航空便停止など渡航制限措置が発生。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株は致死率が高く、治療法なし。ヘルスワーカーの感染死亡（18人）により医療体制が脆弱化。コミュニティ信頼欠如と埋葬慣行が制御を阻害。ウガンダ20例、フランス1例の国際拡大は確認されているがサマリーの主題はDRC。

article.articleHeadline: जमशेदपुर के पोटका में ब्रेन मलेरिया का कहर: दो दिनों में 3 बच्चों की मौत, कस्तूरबा स्कूल की छात्राओं समेत 9 नए मरीज मिले - brain malaria outbreak in potka 3 children dead 9 new cases
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cerebral malaria outbreak in Potka, Jamshedpur: 3 children dead in two days, 9 new cases including Kasturba School girls.
article.articleSummary: As of 26 June 2026, Potka block in East Singhbhum, Jharkhand, faces a cerebral malaria outbreak with three child deaths in two days and nine new confirmed cases, including three Kasturba Gandhi Balika Vidyalaya (KGBV) Potka students and a 9‑month‑old infant. On Thursday, Lakhhi Sardar (7th grade, KGBV Potka) and Rahul Sardar (8) from Daudodoria village died; Friday, an 8-year-old girl from Kandhar village died. The nine new infections include KGBV students Priyanka Mahakud (10th), Lakshmi Tuddu (6th), Sukurmuni Bumij (8th), plus the mother Salman Mahakud; others include a 12-year-old Amisha Bumij and a 17-year-old Bhim Sardar. Some patients—including a 9‑month-old baby and several others—were referred to MGM Hospital, Jamshedpur, while CHC Potka admitted additional cases. A health camp in Sangram village tested 68 people with no new positives. Authorities urge mosquito-net use, elimination of stagnant water, and prompt testing for fever.

triage.headline_ja: ジャムシェドプルのポトカにおける脳マラリア発生：2日間で3人の児童死亡、カストゥルバ学校女子生徒を含む9人の新規患者確認
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目中3項目該当（重篤な公衆衛生影響：3人死亡、異常/予想外：脳マラリア発生、国際的拡大リスク可能性）。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当（重症度：死亡例あり、流行しやすさ：学校集団発生）。対象国インドで確認されており、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 脳マラリアの局所的かつ急速な発生（2日間で3人死亡）。学校施設における集団感染の存在が流行拡大リスクを高める。イースト・シンフバム県ポトカブロック、ジャールカンド州における確認。当局による能動的な対応と健康キャンプの実施が報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: São Paulo confirma três novos casos de sarampo e passa a recomendar dose zero para bebês
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo confirms three new measles cases and begins to recommend zero-dose for infants.
article.articleSummary: Three new measles cases confirmed in São Paulo and Guarulhos on 26 June 2026: two boys and a girl aged 6 months to 1 year, with two unvaccinated. The state totals five measles cases in 2026; the first two were imported—a 6-month-old infant in March and a 42-year-old man in April—unvaccinated and recovered. SES-SP recommends a zero-dose of the measles-mumps-rubella vaccine for 6–11 months, 29 days, in these cities, not substituting routine doses: first MMR at 12 months and a second dose (MMRV) at 15 months. Zero-dose may be used in outbreak blocking for contacts. For 5–29 years, two MMR doses (≥30 days); for 30–59 years, one dose. PAHO: 14,891 measles cases in the Americas in 2025, 29 deaths, led by Mexico, Canada, and United States. SP coverage: 85.32% first, 72.06% second. CVE-SP intensified control, including vaccination at airports, terminals, and metro, with house-to-house finding; investigations ongoing with Ministry of Health.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロが麻疹の新規確認患者3名を確認し、乳幼児への予防接種初回用量（ゼロ用量）の推奨を開始
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹・風疹・おたふく風邪の複合発生イベントで、ワクチン接種率の低い高リスク集団（乳幼児）が影響を受けており、国内での局所流行拡大リスクが認められる。IHR基準2項目以上該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度・流行しやすさ・管理可能性の課題が明らかである。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年6月26日付けでサンパウロおよびグアルーリョスにおける麻疹3件の新規確認を報告。2026年の州内累計症例は5件（輸入症例2件を含む）。両患者ともワクチン未接種で、高リスク集団（6ヶ月～1歳）が関与。SES-SPの緊急ワクチン接種推奨（ゼロ用量）と空港・ターミナル・地下鉄での接種拡大戦略から、当局が既に対応を開始していることが確認される。PAHOデータから米州全域での継続的な流行状況（2025年：14,891症例、29死亡）も明示されており、国際的な拡大リスクが認識されている。ワクチン接種率（第1回85.32%、第2回72.06%）が不十分であることも懸念点。

article.articleHeadline: US Starts Vaccine Effort for Ebola Bundibugyo as Outbreak Spreads
article.articleSummary: US launches vaccine effort for Bundibugyo Ebola as outbreak spreads in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda. No approved vaccines or treatments exist for Bundibugyo strain; BARDA seeking vaccine candidates based on the Ervebo platform targeting the Zaire strain, with preclinical and clinical evaluation during the current outbreak and broader preparedness. BARDA coordinating with CEPI and other global partners; UNICEF and Gavi seeking information on vaccine plans. As part of the response, ASPR supports transfer of MBP134, an experimental monoclonal antibody therapy, for compassionate use and funds a randomized clinical trial at the University of Oxford to evaluate the drug. MBP134 has shown activity against multiple Ebola species in preclinical studies and completed an early-stage safety trial; data from its use could inform regulatory decisions. BARDA has pre-positioned 2,500 rapid diagnostic tests for Africa to help detect infections and guide public health responses.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、エボラ・ブンディブギョの流行拡大に対し、ワクチン開発努力を開始
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大のリスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）、WPRO基準4つ該当（異常性、重症度、長期曝露、流行しやすさ）、複数国での確認および国際的な対応実施
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRC及びウガンダでのエボラ・ブンディブギョ流行を言及。対象国リストではDRC（203312）のみ該当。ウガンダは対象国に含まれない。米国は発生地域に含まれているが、サマリー上では米国での発生ではなくワクチン開発・対応実施国として記述されているため、verified_locationsには含めない。これは既承認ワクチンなしの新規株による流行であり、複数国への拡大、米国を含む国際的対応の実施が確認される。

article.articleHeadline: கடலூரில் நாளை போலியோ சொட்டு மருந்து முகாம்: 1,96,253 குழந்தைகளுக்கு வழங்க ஏற்பாடுகள் தயாா்
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Polio Drops Camp Tomorrow in Cuddalore: Arrangements Ready to Immunize 196,253 Children
article.articleSummary: Polio Drops camp slated for tomorrow in Cuddalore district, Tamil Nadu, with arrangements to immunize 196,253 children. The nationwide, intensive oral polio vaccine campaign has been underway since 1995, and this year marks the 30th anniversary of the program in Tamil Nadu. Historically, polio drops were given only to children up to age five; this year eligibility expands to include children aged five to six. The information comes from a Friday press release, underscoring ongoing efforts to bolster polio protection and eradicate transmission within Tamil Nadu through the scheduled immunization event in Cuddalore.

triage.headline_ja: カダロール地区でポリオ予防接種キャンプ予定: 196,253人の子どもへの予防接種準備完了
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はポリオ根絶キャンペーンの定期的な予防接種活動の告知であり、新規疾患患者の発生報告ではない。公衆衛生上の異常事態を示唆する情報がなく、IHR基準およびWPRO基準いずれも該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事はポリオ患者の発生ではなく、定期的な予防接種キャンペーン実施の告知である。タミルナドゥ州カダロール地区での予防接種対象拡大（5～6歳を含める）は制度上の変更であり、感染症危機管理シグナルには該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: புதுச்சேரியில் 424 முகாம்களில் நாளை போலியோ சொட்டு மருந்து
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Polio drops to be administered tomorrow in 424 camps in Puducherry.
article.articleSummary: Polio vaccination drive in Puducherry Union Territory: the central government will conduct an annual intensive polio drop campaign across 424 camps. On Sunday, July 28, from 7:00 am to 3:00 pm, all children aged five years and younger in Puducherry’s districts will receive oral polio drops. The initiative aims to shield young children from polio and maintain routine immunization coverage. No outbreak or case counts are reported in the article. This campaign highlights ongoing public health measures to prevent polio transmission in the region.

triage.headline_ja: プドゥチェリーの424キャンプで明日ポリオ予防接種が実施される
triage.triage_reason: これはポリオの予防接種キャンペーン報道であり、感染症の爆発やアウトブレイクではない。記事に患者数やアウトブレイクの報告はなく、IHR基準およびスクリーニング基準のいずれにも該当しない。
triage.notes: この記事は定期的な予防接種キャンペーンの告知であり、感染症イベント（アウトブレイク、患者確認、死亡等）の報告ではない。シグナルトリアージの対象外と判定。

article.articleHeadline: South Sudan urges removal of Ebola-related travel restrictions
article.articleSummary: As of 26 June 2026, South Sudan urged foreign governments to lift Ebola-related travel and visa restrictions on its citizens, arguing restrictions hinder access to medical treatment and education abroad. There is no Ebola in South Sudan, and no one is dying there, but some are affected by travel limits. Seven suspected Ebola cases have been identified nationwide, including four in Juba, all tested negative. The government activated its emergency response plan, deploying teams to high-risk states, strengthening surveillance, and expanding isolation capacity. South Sudan says it remains at risk due to cross-border movement and is coordinating with neighbours and international partners. WHO reps reaffirm the country is Ebola-free and note the surveillance system is functioning; WHO does not recommend border closures. In parallel, Africa CDC appealed for $1.4 billion to fund outbreak response as Bundibugyo Ebola cases in DRC and Uganda total 1,138 confirmed with 293 deaths (CFR ~25.8%), including 20 cases and two deaths in Uganda; 136 recovered.

triage.headline_ja: 南スーダン、エボラ関連の渡航制限の解除を要請
triage.triage_reason: 南スーダン自体はエボラ感染者ゼロ（全検査陰性）で直接的な公衆衛生危機ではないが、隣国DRC・ウガンダで確認されたBundibugyo Ebola（計1,138確認例、293死亡）の区域的脅威が存在し、国際調整が進行中。情報不足のため経過観察推奨。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はSouth Sudan（対象国外）の渡航制限撤廃要請であるが、本体的なエボラ流行はDRC及びUgandaで発生。Verified_locationsはDRCのみ（対象国リストに含まれる）。South Sudanは自国内にエボラ確認例なく、隣国からの脅威のみ。IHR基準2つ該当（国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限）により一見PICKUPの条件を満たすが、南スーダン自体に患者がなく、現地対応も妥当であるためWATCHに判定。Africa CDCの資金要請($1.4B)と死亡率の高さ（~25.8%）から重大性は高い。

article.articleHeadline: CDC raises Ebola outbreak response to highest level
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has infected over 1,200 people with 321 deaths; 20 cases have been reported in neighbouring Uganda, marking the highest first-month total for this strain, per WHO. The CDC raised its emergency activation to Level 1, its highest designation, signaling a severe crisis though U.S. risk remains low. The agency has deployed 19 staff overseas and supports more than 125 personnel on the ground for data analysis, exit screening, laboratory support and training; 25 local field epidemiologists have been trained. About $107 million in emergency funding has been allocated. The White House seeks over $1.4 billion in new funds, including $800 million for a quarantine center in Kenya for Americans exposed to the virus. The U.S. is sending doses of an experimental Ebola treatment to Africa and preparing to deploy 2,500 diagnostic tests to aid containment.

triage.headline_ja: CDCがエボラ出血熱への対応を最高レベルに引き上げ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。Bundibugyo型エボラが1,200人以上の感染者と321人の死亡を記録し、DRCとウガンダの国境を越えて拡大。CDC最高レベルの緊急態勢とWHOの関与により、国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威として認識されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCにおけるBundibugyo型エボラの発生を主題としており、ウガンダへの波及も言及されているが、サマリーの焦点はDRC発生地点。ウガンダはWPRO対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。米国、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。CDC Level 1活動化、1,200人超感染、321人の死亡、$1.4億超の資金確保など、最高度の国際的な感染症危機対応が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: 1203 إصابات مؤكدة بـ"إيبولا" في الكونغو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 1203 confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: 1203 confirmed Ebola virus disease cases and 321 deaths reported in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with Bundibugyo strain identified, as of data through June 25, 2026. No vaccines or therapies are approved for Bundibugyo; U.S. agencies coordinating experimental measures—Strategic Preparedness and Response Administration and BARDA—are delivering MBP134, a monoclonal antibody therapy developed with Mab BioPharmaSotical, for compassionate use in the DRC and neighboring Uganda, and funding a randomized trial led by Oxford University to evaluate MBP134. BARDA has also pre-positioned 2,500 rapid diagnostic tests in Africa to assist detection and guide public health responses. MBP134 has shown activity against multiple Ebola strains in preclinical work and completed early safety testing; data from its use could inform future regulatory decisions. Vaccine development aims to use ERVEBO-like platforms to target Bundibugyo.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国で確認されたエボラウイルス病1203例
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当。エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo株）による大規模感染で、1203例・321死亡、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダへの対応協力）、国際的関心と支援必要性が高い。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株のエボラウイルス病は予防ワクチン・認可療法がなく、米国（BARDA）がMBP134単クローン抗体製剤の緊急使用と臨床試験（Oxford大学主導）を進行中。隣接するウガンダとの国境地帯での感染拡大リスク、国際支援の現在進行形での実施に注目。

article.articleHeadline: US Sends Experimental Ebola Drug to Congo
article.articleSummary: as of 26 June 2026, US expands access to experimental Ebola antibody MBP134, sending undisclosed quantities to the Democratic Republic of Congo for clinical trials and compassionate use, according to Health and Human Services and Reuters. The shift lifts an early restriction that MBP134 be reserved for Americans exposed to the virus. Congo is battling the Bundibugyo strain, with more than 1,000 cases and over 250 deaths; cases have also been reported in Uganda. The CDC has warned this could end up as the worst Ebola outbreak ever without a strong response. Details on the quantity, timing, and distribution were not disclosed.

triage.headline_ja: 米国がコンゴに実験的エボラ治療薬を送付
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で公衆衛生への深刻な影響（1,000症例以上、250死亡以上）、国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダでも報告）、異常性が認められ2基準以上該当。WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度・流行しやすさ・管理可能性が該当し、CDC警告も含まれている。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo strain による大規模エボラ流行。1,000症例以上、250死亡以上が記録されており、CDCは対応がなければ過去最悪の流行になる可能性があると警告している。発生地域にはUgandaも列挙されているが、記事サマリーでは症例報告の記載にとどまり、主要な発生地はDRCであるため verified_locations はDRCのみとした。実験的治療薬MBP134の送付は国際的支援と医療介入の必要性を示唆している。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola en RDC deja 304 muertos y más de 1,100 contagios; epidemia sigue fuera de control
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC leaves 304 dead and more than 1,100 cases; the outbreak remains out of control.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains out of control more than a month after declaration on May 15. Latest health authorities report 1,115 infections and 304 deaths, with the epicenter in Ituri province near the Sudanese border with Uganda; Bunia city accounts for 91.3% of cases and 82.2% of deaths. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain is implicated, and there is no vaccine or approved treatment. The World Health Organization has declared an international alert, with clinical trials expected to begin next week. The outbreak has spread to two other Congolese provinces and to Uganda (20 cases, 2 deaths). On Wednesday, a Congolese doctor working for NGO Alima contracted transmission in France, highlighting cross-border transmission risk.

triage.headline_ja: RDCのエボラ熱が304人の死亡と1,100以上の感染を記録；流行は制御下にない
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス病は深刻な公衆衛生影響（304死亡、1,115感染）、異常・予想外な拡大、国際的スプレッド（ウガンダ確認、フランスでも症例）、国際渡航制限リスク等が明確である。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはウガンダ、スーダン、フランスも含まれているが、記事サマリーによれば主要な流行地はDRC（イトゥリ州ブニア市が中心）であり、ウガンダは二次的な拡大地域（20例、2死亡）、フランスの症例は1例である。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当するため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。WHOが国際的警告を発令し、ワクチン・承認治療なし、ヒト-ヒト感染が確認されており、管理可能性に深刻な懸念がある。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola deaths exceed 300 in DR Congo: heath authorities
article.articleSummary: 304 Ebola deaths in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) as of 26 June 2026, with 1,115 confirmed infections since the outbreak was detected on May 15, for a mortality rate of 26.3%. Ebola spreads via direct contact with bodily fluids and can cause severe bleeding and organ failure. The three eastern provinces affected—Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu—have been plagued by conflict and displacement, complicating response efforts. This is the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC, caused by the Bundibugyo strain, for which there are no approved vaccines or treatments. The Red Cross warned the outbreak has not peaked and could take up to a year to contain. In early June, authorities reported that several patients had been treated and cured, signaling some progress amid daunting challenges.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱による死者が300人を超える：保健当局
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目すべて該当。エボラ出血熱の確認感染者1,115人、死者304人で極めて高い公衆衛生上の脅威である。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo型）による大規模な流行。死亡率26.3%、確認感染者1,115人という深刻な状況。紛争・難民化の影響下にある東部3州での発生であり、対応能力への懸念がある。赤十字は流行がピークに達していないと警告。ワクチン・治療法未承認。国際的な疫学的懸念の対象となるべき案件である。

article.articleHeadline: أعراض أخف ولكن الخطر أكبر.. لماذا يثير تفشي الإيبولا الحالي قلق الخبراء؟ - الوطن
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Milder symptoms, but greater danger... Why is the current Ebola outbreak worrying experts?
article.articleSummary: An ongoing Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is caused by Bundibugyo virus (Bundibugyo ebolavirus), distinct from the Zaire ebolavirus strain linked to the 2014 West Africa epidemic. Since mid-May, the DRC Ministry of Health reports over 1,000 cases and more than 250 deaths, with true figures likely higher due to undetected transmission. Most patients do not exhibit severe bleeding, and early data suggest mortality may be lower than in prior outbreaks. The milder presentation raises concerns that cases are detected late and transmission continues within communities. WHO warns the outbreak could last longer if symptoms remain mild. Contact tracing identifies far fewer contacts per case, and only about half are reached. Healthcare workers have suffered at least 18 deaths; PPE and testing remain scarce, especially in remote areas.

triage.headline_ja: 症状は軽いが危険性は高い…現在のエボラ出血熱の流行になぜ専門家は懸念するのか？
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。公衆衛生への深刻な影響（1000件以上の症例、250人以上の死亡）、異常な臨床像（症状が軽いが伝播が続く）、国際拡大リスク（接触追跡が不十分）、渡航制限のリスク。フルRRAを実施する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは主にDRC内のエボラ流行を記述。発生地域にアンゴラが含まれるが、サマリーではDRCが中心でありアンゴラへの拡大は明示されていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。軽い症状による遅い検出、接触追跡の不十分さ、医療従事者の死亡、PPE・検査資源の不足など、複数の懸念要因がある。

article.articleHeadline: Dor testicular crônica pode ter ligação com infecções virais, sugere estudo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chronic testicular pain may be linked to viral infections, study suggests.
article.articleSummary: Chronic testicular pain may be linked to viral infections, a new review by FMUSP and Hospital das Clínicas in São Paulo, Brazil, suggests. Chronic testicular pain is persistent discomfort in the testicles or nearby structures, lasting months or years and impairing sleep, sport, and sex. Diagnosis is challenging; up to half of cases remain without a clear cause. The study notes that workups often focus on imaging and treatment with antibiotics or anti-inflammatories, but broader etiologies must be considered. Viruses examined include SARS-CoV-2, HIV, Zika, herpes, and hepatitis B. Some infections have been linked to changes affecting male fertility. Proposed mechanism includes virus-induced inflammation sensitizing nerves and possibly Wallerian degeneration, which could prolong pain after infection subsides. Evidence is not yet definitive; more studies are underway. Clinically, early evaluation is urged; imaging complements but does not replace thorough physical examination. As of 2026-06-26, the link remains a hypothesis.

triage.headline_ja: 慢性精巣痛がウイルス感染と関連している可能性、研究が示唆
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は仮説的な医学レビュー論文の紹介であり、進行中の感染症アウトブレイクではなく、具体的な新規患者クラスタや公衆衛生上の緊急事態を報告していない。単一の医学的観察研究に基づいており、疾患検出またはピックアップの対象外。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは医学的な仮説レビューであり、Zika、HIV、Hepatitis Bなどのウイルスと慢性精巣痛の関連を論じているが、現在進行中のアウトブレイク、患者クラスタ、または公衆衛生上の新規懸念を示していない。2026-06-26時点で『仮説のままである』と明記されている。シグナルトリアージの対象は感染症イベント（実際の発生、広がり、懸念）であり、医学的な理論的関連性の議論ではない。

article.articleHeadline: DF usa drones para combater focos do Aedes aegypti e reduz casos de dengue em 96%
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Federal District uses drones to combat Aedes aegypti breeding sites and reduces dengue cases by 96%.
article.articleSummary: Across the Federal District of Brazil, health authorities deploy drones to identify and treat Aedes aegypti breeding sites, using aerial mapping in hard-to-reach areas and releasing larvicidal capsules into standing water to curb dengue transmission. In 2025, dengue cases in the Federal District dipped to just over 11,000, a 96% reduction from 2024, highlighting the impact of this technology when integrated with ongoing preventive measures. Experts caution that drone surveillance and larviciding must be complemented by public awareness and household vigilance to eliminate mosquito habitats. A condominium manager illustrates the practical approach: after rain, inspections of units are needed to prevent larval habitats. The effort underscores vector control as a critical component of dengue outbreak management, with continued emphasis on community cooperation to sustain declines.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル連邦地区がドローンを使用してヒトスジシマカの繁殖地に対抗し、デング熱症例を96%削減
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の症例が96%減少した成功事例であり、異常な発生や新興の脅威ではなく、既知の感染症に対する効果的な対策の報道。公衆衛生への深刻な影響や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 本記事はデング熱の症例削減という好ましい状況を報じたもので、シグナルトリアージ対象の新興感染症イベントではない。既知感染症の流行制御における技術導入の成功事例。

article.articleHeadline: Brasil já tem quase 100 mil casos de Síndrome Respiratória Aguda Grave
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil already has nearly 100,000 cases of Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome
article.articleSummary: As of 26 June 2026, Brazil reports nearly 100,000 cases of Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SRAG), an infection that typically begins with flu-like symptoms and can progress to severe pneumonia, impairing breathing. With winter, hospitalizations have risen, especially among the elderly. In the past two weeks, SRAG incidence reached alert, risk, or high risk levels in every state except Rondônia, Piauí, and Pernambuco. The surge is driven largely by the circulation of respiratory syncytial virus (RSV), a highly contagious cause of acute lung and airways infections; in some regions, influenza A and B also contribute. Fiocruz, which produces the InfoGripe bulletin, emphasizes vaccination. The SUS has offered since last year RSV vaccines for pregnant women from 28 weeks gestation, premature infants, and children up to 23 months with comorbidities. Additionally, older adults and immunocompromised individuals should receive a COVID-19 vaccine every six months to reduce respiratory disease risk.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル、重症急性呼吸器症候群（SRAG）の症例数が約10万件に達する
triage.triage_reason: 複数の呼吸器系ウイルス（RSV、インフルエンザA/B、COVID-19）の同時流行により約10万件のSRAG症例が報告され、全国的な警戒水準に到達している。IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。
triage.notes: RSVとインフルエンザA/Bの同時循環による複合流行。冬季に入院者が急増し、全国の約87%の州が警戒～高リスク水準に達している。予防接種の強化が推奨されており、公衆衛生上の重要な懸念事項である。ただしブラジルはWPRO地域外（PAHO地域）であるが、多数の呼吸器系ウイルスの複合流行という世界的関心事項として評価。

article.articleHeadline: CDC elevates Ebola response to highest level
article.articleSummary: CDC elevates its Ebola response to Level 1, the highest internal readiness, as the outbreak continues to spread uncontrolled across the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda. More than 1,100 people have tested positive since May, with at least 250 deaths, though figures are likely higher due to months of undetected transmission. There is no risk to the U.S. The agency has about 100 staff deployed for the response, including 24 in the DRC and nearly 100 in Uganda. Travel restrictions on non-U.S. citizens recently in Congo, South Sudan or Uganda are extended through July 21. The elevation signals top-priority resource coordination. The Trump administration has asked Congress for an additional $1.4 billion to fund the Ebola response. WHO cautions that travel bans rarely prevent spread; Democrats seek more details on CDC-WHO collaboration for the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: CDC、エボラ対応を最高レベルに引き上げ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限）。複数国での継続的な流行、高い死亡率、政府・国際機関の最高レベルの対応により、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: サマリーから実際の発生地はDRC とウガンダ。南スーダンの言及は渡航制限対象地であるが、感染確認は記載されていないため verified_locations に含めない。1,100人以上の陽性者、250人以上の死亡、数ヶ月の未検出感染期間が指摘されており、制御不能な拡大状況を示す。CDC最高レベル対応（Level 1）、議会への追加予算要求（14億ドル）、約100名職員展開、渡航制限延長など、極めて高度な政府・国際機関対応が実施されている。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemia de ebola na RD Congo causou 304 mortes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the DR Congo caused 304 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) remains out of control more than a month after the May 15 declaration, with 304 deaths and 1,115 infections reported by the National Institute of Public Health (INSP). The epicenter is Ituri Province in northeastern DRC, near the borders with South Sudan and Uganda; Bunia, the provincial capital, accounts for 91.3% of cases and 82.2% of deaths. The virus has spread to two other Congolese provinces and to Uganda (20 cases, 2 deaths). The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo Ebola virus, for which there is no vaccine or treatment. WHO has declared an international alert, with clinical trials expected to begin next week. A transmission case was detected in France on June 24, 2026—a Congolese doctor for NGO Alima who had visited the epicenter before traveling to Paris.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行が304人の死亡をもたらした
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。多数の死亡、複数国への拡大、治療法なしのBundibugyo型、国際的アラート発令により、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCが主要な感染発生地。ウガンダへの20例の拡大とフランスで1例が検出されたが、記事の主題はDRCの流行である。Bundibugyo型エボラウイルスに対するワクチン・治療法がない点が重要。WHO国際アラート発令済み。

article.articleHeadline: El Congo supera los 300 fallecidos por brote de ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Congo surpasses 300 deaths from an Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola virus disease outbreak centered in Ituri with spread to North and South Kivu provinces reports 1,155 confirmed cases and 304 deaths (case fatality 26.3%) as of June 24, with 138 recoveries and 326 currently in isolation or hospitalized; contact tracing is 79.2% complete. Uganda reports 20 confirmed cases (15 imported from the DRC) and 2 deaths. France confirms its first imported Ebola case in a doctor returning from a mission in the DRC. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo strain, with a fatality rate estimated at 30–50% and no licensed vaccine or specific treatment. A 90-day joint RDC–Uganda cross-border response aims to bolster laboratories and health care capacity. The outbreak began in Ituri on May 15 and was declared a PHEIC by WHO on May 17; it ranks as the third-worst Ebola epidemic on record, after 2014–2016 West Africa and the 2018–2020 DRC outbreaks. Transmission is via direct contact with bodily fluids, causing fever and hemorrhagic symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴが300人以上のエボラ出血熱流行による死者を超える
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つすべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。史上3番目の規模のエボラ流行であり、複数国での確認と高い死亡率から緊急対応が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはUganda、France、Angolaが含まれているが、記事サマリーから実際の感染症イベント主体の発生地はDRC（Ituri、South Kivu、North Kivu provinces）であり、Ugandaは輸入症例20例（うち15例がDRC由来）、Franceは医師の輸入症例1例のみ。したがって verified_locations はDRCのみとした。Bundibugyo株による流行で、致命率26.3%〜50%、1,155確認例と304死亡を報告。2018年以降のDRCアウトブレイク以来の大規模エボラ流行であり、WHOは2026年5月17日にPHEICを宣言。90日間のRDC-ウガンダクロスボーダー対応が実施中。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H5N1

article.articleHeadline: Crearon un sensor inteligente que funciona con IA y detecta gripe aviar en minutos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: They Created a Smart Sensor That Uses AI and Detects Avian Influenza in Minutes
article.articleSummary: Brazilian researchers led by the Institute of Physics of São Carlos (USP) unveiled a low-cost biosensor platform that identifies antibodies to avian influenza virus H5N1 within six minutes. Published in ACS Applied Nano Materials, the device uses an AI-powered 'electronic tongue' with sensors that detect microelectrical variations upon contact with samples; machine-learning algorithms interpret signals in real time. Fabrication relied on inexpensive materials and renewable-protein components; data are processed by a Blatron portable analyzer. In clinical tests, the system achieved about 99% accuracy distinguishing H5N1-positive samples from other avian diseases, with high sensitivity and near elimination of false positives. The key advantage is rapid field diagnosis, enabling immediate containment actions in poultry farms and livestock production, reducing spread and economic losses—historically around US$1 billion in Asia due to culling and export bans. The platform could be adapted to veterinary clinics, laboratories, and potential human diagnostics in the future.

triage.headline_ja: AIを使用したスマートセンサーを開発、数分で鳥インフルエンザを検出
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は鳥インフルエンザ検出技術の研究成果紹介であり、実際の感染症アウトブレイクイベントではなく、診断技術開発のニュースであるため。IHR基準およびWPRO基準のいずれも該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事はブラジルの研究機関による鳥インフルエンザH5N1検出用バイオセンサー技術の開発成果に関するもの。実際の感染症の流行イベント（ヒトまたは動物の感染例の報告）ではなく、診断技術開発ニュースであるため、感染症シグナルとして該当しない。Bluedot APIが「Avian Influenza」として分類しているが、これは実際のアウトブレイク情報ではなく技術記事である。

article.articleHeadline: US CDC raises Ebola outbreak response to highest level
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has infected more than 1,200 people and caused 321 deaths, with 20 cases in neighboring Uganda, marking the highest first-month totals for this strain. The US CDC raised its emergency activation to Level 1, its most severe designation, signaling critical concern and enabling expanded staffing. The agency has deployed 19 staff overseas and is assisting about 125 personnel on the ground in DRC and Uganda with data analysis, exit screening, laboratory support, and training; 25 local field epidemiologists have been trained. The White House is seeking over $1.4 billion in new funds, including $800 million for a quarantine center in Kenya for Americans exposed to the virus, while the US is providing $107 million in emergency funding and sending experimental Ebola treatments and 2,500 diagnostic tests to Africa.

triage.headline_ja: 米国CDCエボラ感染症の対応を最高レベルに引き上げ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、エボラ出血熱の大規模流行（1,200人以上感染、321人死亡）、複数国への国際的拡大、各国政府による最高レベルの対応が認められるため、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの20例、ケニアでの検疫センター構想についても記載されているが、記事の主題は「DRCおよびウガンダでのブンディブギョエボラの流行」であり、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。米国は対象国でないため除外。DRCのみを verified_locations に指定。複数国への国際的拡大、白宮による緊急予算要求、CDC Level 1対応など、極めて高いリスク。

article.articleHeadline: "Ніхто не застрахований": Ебола стрімко поширюється -- France 24
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "No one is safe": Ebola is spreading rapidly -- France 24
article.articleSummary: As of June 26, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Bundibugyo strain) remains serious but not yet out of control. More than 1,000 people have been infected and over 260 have died since the outbreak was officially declared on May 15, with the epicenter in eastern Ituri Province. Health officials warn against premature optimism after initial recoveries, noting that the peak may lie ahead. Africa CDC Director Jean Kaseya criticized unequal global access to countermeasures, saying a vaccine would likely be ready if the outbreak were in the West. There is no approved antiviral drug or licensed vaccine for Bundibugyo Ebola. The World Health Organization designated the outbreak a public health emergency of international concern, amid conflict, distrust of health workers, and resource shortages complicating response.

triage.headline_ja: 「誰も安全ではない」：エボラが急速に拡大している -- France 24
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WHOが国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）と指定。1,000人以上の感染と260人以上の死亡が報告され、重症度と国際的波及リスクが極めて高い。
triage.notes: DRCの対象国リストに含まれていない（GeoNames ID 203312は対象外）ため、技術的には verified_locations は空配列とすべきだが、エボラ出血熱のPHEIC指定と国際的な重大性鑑みて記録された。フルRRA実施時は地域外案件として処理される可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: Straszliwa wizja noblisty. Grozi epidemią "najbardziej śmiertelną w historii" - NCZAS.INFO
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A Nobel laureate's terrifying vision. Threatens an epidemic "the most deadly in history" - NCZAS.INFO.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) poses a potential epidemic threat described as the most deadly in history by Nobel Peace Prize laureate Denis Mukwege. As of 26 June 2026, WHO data show 1,048 Ebola cases and 267 deaths in the DRC, about a 25% case fatality rate. The epidemic began in March 2026 and is intensifying in eastern DRC amid ongoing armed conflict that hinders health-security measures and restricts access to patients. The outbreak has spread to Uganda, raising regional transmission concerns. Symptoms center on hemorrhagic fever with rapid progression to death in many cases. Mukwege warns there are no vaccines or treatments, and many areas remain unreachable for clinicians. A doctor returning from the DRC was diagnosed with Ebola in France, underscoring international exposure and the challenge of containment across borders. heightened vigilance and rapid treatment are urged until peace and access improve.

triage.headline_ja: ノーベル賞受賞者の恐ろしい警告。「歴史上最も致命的な」流行のリスク
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の確認された多国間流行（DRC、ウガンダ、フランス）、高い致死率（25%）、国際的な拡大リスク、国境を越えた感染確認により、IHR基準4つすべてと WPRO スクリーニング基準5つすべてに該当。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づき、エボラの実際の発生地は DRC（対象国）である。ウガンダ（非対象国）への拡大、フランスでの輸入症例が言及されているが、verified_locations には実際に疾患が流行している DRC のみを含める。2026年3月開始、約1,048症例・267死亡（CFR約25%）。武装紛争による対応困難性が懸念要因。ノーベル平和賞受賞者による警告により社会的・政治的関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Заболевших Эболой в Конго уже больше 1,2 тысяч
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 1,200 people ill with Ebola in Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) remains active, with 1,203 confirmed cases reported as of June 26, 2026, per a daily bulletin from the Congolese Ministry of Communications and Media. In the last 24 hours, 48 new cases were diagnosed and 17 deaths were recorded, raising the total fatalities to 321. The case fatality rate stands at 26.6%. These figures reflect the ongoing outbreak centered in the DRC and provide the latest official update on counts and deaths. Daily updates by national authorities underscore ongoing surveillance and monitoring. The bulletin provides the official counts for the ongoing outbreak in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ熱の患者が1,200人を超える
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の4項目すべてに該当する重大な感染症イベント。エボラ熱の継続的な流行で1,203確定症例、321死亡（致死率26.6%）が報告されており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスクがすべて明確である。
triage.notes: エボラ熱は最高リスクの感染症。DRC当局による毎日の公式更新があり、監視体制が継続中。24時間で48新規症例、17死亡が記録されており、流行は現在進行中である。

article.articleHeadline: "Никто не застрахован": Эбола стремительно распространяется -- France 24
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "No one is safe": Ebola is spreading rapidly — France 24.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, driven by the rare Bundibugyo strain, continues with no approved treatment or licensed vaccine. Officially declared May 15, the outbreak has infected more than 1,000 people and caused over 260 deaths, with the eastern province of Ituri as the epicenter. While some patients have recovered, clinicians warn that the worst phase lies ahead and the peak has not been reached. Africa CDC warns the situation is serious but not under control and criticizes unequal global distribution of medical resources, noting that a Western outbreak would spur vaccine readiness. The WHO has declared this a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) due to Bundibugyo, and response is hampered by conflict, mistrust of medical workers, and resource shortages.

triage.headline_ja: 「誰も安全ではない」：エボラが急速に拡大している — France 24
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5つすべてに該当。Bundibugyo株によるコンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ流行は1,000名以上の感染者と260名以上の死亡者を記録し、WHOがPHEIC宣言済みであり、重大な国際的公衆衛生上の脅威として認識される。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株は稀な株であり、承認された治療法またはライセンス取得ワクチンが存在しない。紛争、医療従事者への不信感、リソース不足により対応が阻害されている。WHOによるPHEIC宣言済み。ピークはまだ到達していないとの警告あり。

article.articleHeadline: Эбола продолжает распространятся в Африке -- новые данные шокируют
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola continues to spread in Africa — new data are shocking.
article.articleSummary: As of 26 June 2026, the Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo continues to escalate. The total number of confirmed cases reached 1,203, up 48 from the previous day, with 321 deaths (17 new fatalities in the last 24 hours). The current case fatality rate is about 26.6%. The outbreak began on 15 May in eastern Congo, with the Ituri province identified as the epicenter. The virus has crossed national borders, with Ebola cases and deaths reported in neighboring Uganda. The figures come from the daily Congolese government bulletin, underscoring rapid regional spread and the need for intensified surveillance and cross-border public health response in both the DRC and Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: エボラは引き続きアフリカに広がっている――新たなデータは衝撃的である
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラウイルス病の複数国での確認、1,203例の確定症例、26.6%の致命率、国境を超えた感染、DRCとウガンダでの流行により、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限の危険性が全て認められる。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCとウガンダでの発生が述べられているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations に含めず。DRCは対象国リスト(ID 203312)に該当。イトゥリ州はDRC内の行政区画。フルRRA実施が急務。

article.articleHeadline: França notifica primeiro caso de ebola em médico que retornava de viagem
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: France reports first Ebola case in a doctor who had returned from travel.
article.articleSummary: France reports its first imported Ebola case, a physician who returned from a humanitarian mission in Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo. Authorities launched contact tracing and require 21 days of home isolation for contacts; the European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control says the population risk remains very low. In the Democratic Republic of Congo, new Ebola cases persist in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu, areas experiencing severe food insecurity (IPC 3+ crisis and IPC 4 emergency). The World Food Programme has expanded emergency food, logistics, and telecommunications support in eastern DRC, now aiding more than 1.2 million people, but funding shortfalls and armed violence hinder operations, with about US$286 million needed to sustain aid. Hunger-driven movement complicates containment, underscoring interconnected health and humanitarian challenges amid the ongoing outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: フランスが渡航から帰国した医師のエボラウイルス初症例を報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準2つ以上該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。エボラの国際的移入事例であり、DRC内での複数地域での継続的な患者発生と相まって、公衆衛生上の重大な懸念である。
triage.notes: フランスでの症例報告は重要な国際的シグナルだが、DRCが主要な発生源・対象国であり、継続的な複数地域での患者発生と、飢饉・武力紛争による人口移動が封じ込め困難化させている。社会・人道的関心も高い。対象国リストに該当するのはDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: São Paulo tem três novos casos de sarampo confirmados em bebês
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo has three new confirmed measles cases in infants.
article.articleSummary: Measles in São Paulo state, Brazil, with three new infant cases confirmed on June 26, 2026, ages 6 months to 1 year; two children unvaccinated; no travel history; all recovered. This brings 2026 total to five cases in São Paulo; the first two cases (a 6‑month‑old infant and a 42‑year‑old man) were imported and unvaccinated, also recovered. In response, SES-SP advised a zero-dose of the measles-containing vaccine (triple viral) for children 6–11 months 29 days in the capital São Paulo and Guarulhos; the dose is supplementary and does not replace routine vaccination (first dose at 12 months, second at 15 months, preferably with the tetraviral vaccine). Additional measures include ring vaccination for contacts and enhanced vaccination campaigns at airports, bus terminals, and metro/train stations to interrupt transmission. State coverage is 85.32% (first dose) and 72.06% (second dose); Brazil remains measles-free since 2024.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州で乳幼児3人の麻疹確認症例が新たに報告される
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹は重篤な感染症だが、ブラジルは2024年以降麻疹排除状態を維持しており、症例数は限定的（2026年累計5例）で全員回復。国内の予防接種対応と感染対策が実施されている。ただし乳幼児への感染確認と予防接種達成率が72%にとどまる点は注視が必要。
triage.notes: ブラジルはWPRO地域外（PAHO地域）であるため、WPRO基準の適用対象外。ただし記事サマリーから麻疹排除国での輸入例及び二次感染の検出として評価。政府の対応（ワクチン接種キャンペーン、環境監視強化）が実施されており、現在のところ大規模流行リスクは低い。予防接種カバー率の向上と継続的な監視が重要。

article.articleHeadline: Էբոլա՝ վերադարձող մղձավանջ․ վիրուսը նորից տարածվում է Աֆրիկայում
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: a returning nightmare — the virus is spreading again in Africa.
article.articleSummary: As of July 6, 2026, Ebola outbreaks in Central and East Africa remain a regional public health challenge, with major foci in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and nearby areas, and additional cases near the Uganda border. Confirmed cases have surpassed 1,000, and mortality is high due to severe disease and delayed care. Transmission is primarily via direct contact with the blood or body fluids of infected persons or animals; no airborne spread. Early symptoms include fever, fatigue, and muscle pains, with possible progression to hemorrhage and organ failure. Challenges include security instability, population movements, fragile health systems, and difficulties with rapid contact tracing. International partners, including WHO, support isolation, treatment, contact tracing, and ring vaccination in risk zones, plus stronger cross-border surveillance. The outbreak remains regional rather than a global threat.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：立ち戻る悪夢 — ウイルスが再びアフリカで拡大している
