triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、深刻な公衆衛生影響（1,000例超、高い致命率）、異常なエボラの再流行、地域での国際的拡大リスク、国際支援による対応が必要とされている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで明確に報告されているのはコンゴ民主共和国とウガンダ国境近くの症例。ウガンダ（226074）はサマリーに言及されるが、確認症例の主要な発生地はDRCとされており、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。モザンビークも発生地域リストに含まれるが、記事サマリーには明示的な言及がないため除外。「地域的課題」とされており、現時点では「グローバル脅威」ではないと記事自体が記載。

article.articleHeadline: RT-Duits: Gesundheitsfunktionäre warnen vor Geldmangel bei Ebola-Ausbruch
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: RT-Duits: Health officials warn of funding shortages during the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: As of June 26, 2026, Africa CDC warns that responding to the Bundibugyo-type Ebola outbreak requires about €1.2 billion, roughly triple earlier estimates (initial ~€454 million). The adjusted funding reflects sharply rising needs in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda. Since the outbreak began on May 15, more than 300 deaths have occurred in the two central African neighbors. DR Congo reports over 1,155 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases and 304 fatalities, with the Ituri province bearing the brunt as the epicenter. Uganda has 19 confirmed cases, including two deaths, and one probable fatal case, reported up to June 18. There is currently no licensed vaccine or specific treatment for Bundibugyo ebolavirus. The WHO sees the international spread risk as low, despite a reported Ebola case in France tied to a medical mission from DR Congo. Health systems in DR Congo remain severely strained.

triage.headline_ja: RT-Duits: ドイツの保健当局者がエボラ出血熱の流行中の資金不足について警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当。Bundibugyo型エボラウイルスの多国間流行、300人以上の死亡、国際的拡大（フランスへの波及）、深刻な公衆衛生影響が認識される。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus(ブンディブギョ型)の流行。DRC(Ituri province)が震源地で1,155例以上の確定例と304死亡。ウガンダへの波及(19例、2死亡)も報告。フランスでの輸入症例も言及されているが、フランスはWPRO対象国でないため verified_locations には含めない。ワクチンおよび特異的治療が存在しない深刻な状況。資金不足による対応困難が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola death toll in DR Congo exceeds 320 -- authorities
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo continues, with 1,203 confirmed cases and 321 deaths reported as of June 25, after 48 new cases and 17 new deaths in the past day. The current outbreak began on May 15 in eastern DR Congo; cases and deaths have also been reported in neighboring Uganda. WHO describes Ebola as a severe, often fatal illness; prominent symptoms include sudden fever, weakness, muscle pain, headache and sore throat, followed by vomiting, diarrhoea, rash, kidney and liver dysfunction, and sometimes bleeding. Transmission occurs through direct contact with blood, body fluids, or tissues of infected people or animals, with infectiousness persisting as long as the virus is present in secretions. Incubation ranges from 2 to 21 days; health workers, family members, and others in close contact with sick or deceased patients are at highest risk.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ死亡者数が320人を超える――当局
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病は重篤で高い死亡率を示し、複数国での確認、国際的な拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限の可能性が認められる。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC東部での発生が主要な主題であり、ウガンダでの事例報告も言及されているが、ウガンダ（GeoNames ID 226074）は対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。DRCは対象国リストの203312に該当。エボラは高病原性、高死亡率、人間-人間感染、複数国への拡大リスク、公衆衛生上の深刻な脅威を示す典型的なPHEIC候補疾患。

article.articleHeadline: Mind The Gap On Ebola: It's The People, Not Just The Virus - Health Policy Watch
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola strain drives the outbreak in Ituri Province, eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, where there is no approved vaccine or treatment. With limited countermeasures, communities resist: treatment tents burn, burial teams face hostility, and suspected patients flee quarantine centers. Ituri is amid decades of conflict and displacement; nearly five million people are displaced, and more than 21 million require humanitarian aid, with about 8 million displaced from home. Half of Fataki Health Zone’s centers are closed, and routine surveillance funding ended in March 2025. Malaria remains deadly, with the DRC accounting for about 11% of global malaria deaths and under-fives most affected. Resistance is a rational response to neglect; trust rests on authenticity, empathy, and logic. The article urges empowering local leaders and families with training and PPE to carry out burials and care, and to treat malaria, malnutrition, and maternal health with equal urgency.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ対策の課題：ウイルスだけでなく人的要因が重要 - ヘルスポリシーウォッチ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外、国際的拡大リスク）。ワクチン・治療薬がない未承認ワクチンのBundibugyo株によるアウトブレイク、コミュニティの対策への抵抗、マラリア重複感染による複合危機が認識される。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo Ebola株はまれな株であり、承認済みワクチンがない点が特に懸念される。Ituri Province東部での複数年にわたる紛争・避難民状況下での発生で、ワクチン接種や治療キャンペーンへのコミュニティ抵抗が著しい。マラリアとの重複感染も顕著。国際的な支援体制強化が必須と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Após 3 casos confirmados de sarampo em SP, Saúde recomenda vacina a bebês em dois municípios
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: After three confirmed measles cases in São Paulo, Health Department recommends vaccination for infants in two municipalities.
article.articleSummary: As of 26 June 2026, three laboratory-confirmed measles cases were reported in Vila Medeiros, São Paulo, prompting a Health Ministry recommendation for a zero-dose of the measles-mumps-rubella vaccine for infants 6–11 months in São Paulo and Guarulhos. Cases: a 1-year-1-month unvaccinated boy (symptoms began 1 June), a 7-month-old unvaccinated infant (symptoms began 29 May), and a 1-year-1-month vaccinated girl (symptoms began 4 June). All recovered; lab confirmation by IgM and RT‑PCR at Instituto Adolfo Lutz and Fiocruz. The measure also covers Guarulhos due to proximity and daily flows to the capital and to Guarulhos Airport. Officials consider the infections imported; autochthonous transmission could threaten Brazil’s measles-free status (recertified in 2024). Earlier in 2026, two imported cases were reported in São Paulo (Bolivia for a 6‑month‑old, Guatemala for a 42‑year‑old). State vaccination coverage: 85.32% first dose, 72.06% second; city near 100% for both doses. Symptoms include fever, cough, coryza, conjunctivitis, and rash 7–14 days post-exposure.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロで麻疹3例確認後、保健当局は2市町村の乳幼児へのワクチン接種を推奨
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。ブラジルの麻疹フリーステータス再認定（2024年）が脅かされる可能性があり、公衆衛生上の重大な関心事項。
triage.notes: 3件の検査確定麻疹症例がサンパウロで報告され、うち2件は輸入例（ボリビア、グアテマラ）。ブラジルは2024年に麻疹排除を再認定されたため、国内感染の発生はPHEIC関連性が高い。乳幼児の予防接種キャンペーンが実施されており、当局が積極的対応中。

article.articleHeadline: В ДР Конго число заболевших Эболой достигло 1 203
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, the number of Ebola cases has reached 1,203.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-26, Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) have reached 1,203 confirmed infections, with 321 fatalities and a case fatality rate of 26.6%. In the last 24 hours, 48 new confirmed cases were recorded and 17 additional deaths. The outbreak was first identified on May 15 in eastern DRC, with the epicenter in Ituri Province; cross-border transmission has occurred, with cases and deaths also reported in neighboring Uganda. The figures are taken from the daily bulletin of the DRC Ministry of Communications and Media, as reported by Report. This reflects ongoing transmission in eastern provinces.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ感染者数が1,203人に達した
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも5項目すべてに該当する。エボラウイルス病は極度に深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、国際的な拡大リスク、高い死亡率、国境を越えた拡大がすでに確認されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではウガンダへの越境感染が言及されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCのみを列挙。エボラ感染者1,203人、死亡者321人、致死率26.6%は極度に深刻。過去24時間で新規確認症例48人、新規死亡17人の継続的な伝播が示唆されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Arrives in France: Infected Aid Doctor Flew Commercial as 1,118 DRC Cases Mount
article.articleSummary: France confirmed its first Ebola case detected on national soil on June 24, 2026: an ALIMA physician who treated patients in DRC’s Ituri Province and flew Kinshasa–Paris on a commercial flight with only headaches. Isolated on arrival; five passengers are named as possible contacts. The case underscores exit-screening gaps: prodromal Bundibugyo infection can be below fever thresholds, there is no antigen rapid test for Bundibugyo, and lab confirmation requires PCR. ECDC guidance notes exit screening reduces risk but cannot guarantee clearance. In the DRC, 1,118 confirmed cases and 291 deaths; Ituri has 1,020 cases in 22 zones, North Kivu 95, South Kivu 3. Uganda reports 20 cases and 1 death linked to travelers from DRC. Hospitalizations in isolation total 408; nearly 80 healthcare workers infected. This is the EU’s second Ebola importation after Dr. Peter Stafford’s May evacuation to Berlin; five contacts identified; risk to wider EU deemed low.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがフランスに到達：感染した医療支援者が商用便で渡航、DRC症例数が1,118件に達する
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大、渡航制限リスク）。エボラの国際的な越境と複数国への拡散が確認されており、フルRRAが必須。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが検出した地域にはBerlin（ドイツ）やFrance、Ugandaが含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題は「DRCでのエボラ流行とフランスへの輸入例」である。DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に追加。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。ドイツ・フランスは対象国外。エボラの国際的越境、商用便での運搬、スクリーニング回避の懸念、計1,118例の大規模流行は、IHR基準4つ全て満たす重篤なシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: 米ＣＤＣ、エボラ対応を最高レベルに引き上げ　保健福祉省はワクチン開発着手へ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: U.S. CDC raises Ebola response to the highest level; the Department of Health and Human Services to begin vaccine development.
article.articleSummary: June 26, 2026 – The U.S. CDC raises Ebola response to Level 1, the highest alert, amid rapid spread of the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo. Domestic risk remains low. Level 1 triggers maximum staffing and resources. The U.S. Department of Health and Human Services will accelerate vaccine development targeting Bundibugyo, deliver experimental therapeutics, and ready diagnostic tests. Actions are led by the ASPR and executed through BARDA to support response activities in the Democratic Republic of Congo and neighboring Uganda. The emphasis is on international outbreak containment and preparedness for potential importation or exportation of cases, with no specific U.S. case counts cited.

triage.headline_ja: 米CDC、エボラ対応を最高レベルに引き上げ　保健福祉省はワクチン開発着手へ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当。エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo株）の急速な拡大、米国の最高レベル対応、ワクチン開発の緊急化、国際的な封じ込め・準備活動により、シグナルピックアップの条件を満たす。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株のエボラは高い致死率を持つ病原体。記事ではコンゴ民主共和国での発生と急速な拡大が主題であり、ウガンダへの拡大リスクも言及されている。米国はレベル1対応を発動し、国際的な行動を主導している。ウガンダ（対象国外）での確認言及があるが、サマリーではDRCが主たる発生地とされているため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。

article.articleHeadline: Nord-Kivu : sénateurs et députés pour une lutte collective contre Ebola à Beni - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: North Kivu: Senators and MPs call for a collective fight against Ebola in Beni - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease is being addressed in North Kivu, DRC, as senators and MPs arrived in Beni to mobilize civil-society groups against the ongoing outbreak. The visit to Beni and nearby Butembo aims to rally community leaders to deter transmission and end the epidemic through collective action. Senator Papy Machozi warned of Ebola’s danger and urged not to let ignorance kill brothers and sisters, while Carly Nzanzu Kasivita, a national deputy and former North Kivu governor, stressed that inaction could decimate the community. Lawmakers urged civil-society participation as essential to breaking the death cycle. Delegates acknowledged their role but raised concerns about violence toward affected individuals, citing reports of militia removing bodies or burning treatment centers. They pledged to mobilize courageously to deter the disease’s spread.

triage.headline_ja: 北キブ州：ベニでのエボラ対策に向けた集団的闘いを呼びかける上院議員と国会議員
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の進行中の流行が報告されており、IHR基準において深刻な公衆衛生影響（死亡リスク）、異常性・予想外性が認識される。DRCは対象国であり、フルRRA実施の必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは北キブ州（ベニおよびブテンボ）でのエボラ流行継続を明確に示している。上院議員・国会議員の動員、市民社会の参加呼びかけ、武装勢力による治療施設焼却報告など、管理性の課題も指摘されており、フルRRAの優先度は高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ебола не відступає: кількість заражених уже перевищила тисячу
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola does not retreat: the number of infected has already surpassed one thousand.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo remains far from over, more than a month after the May 17 declaration, with confirmed cases surpassing 1,000 and spreading to 34 administrative zones. France confirmed its first Ebola case on French soil, in a doctor who returned from a humanitarian mission in the DRC. In Mongbvalu, the epicenter, 14 patients have recovered, including Florence, a hospital worker infected while handling bodies. International aid and a local laboratory at the National Institute of Biomedical Research cut diagnostic turnaround from two weeks to hours, and monoclonal antibodies are among treatments. MSF epidemiologist Gigi Manangama notes earlier signals in May (possibly April), with access hindered by security in mining and cross-border areas. Resource gaps persist: no steady blood bank at Mongbvalu hospital; voluntary donations only; electrolyte shortages. Contact tracing covers about 40% of contacts, far below the 90–95% target. Attacks on two treatment centers in early June and distrust complicate response; community engagement and involvement of local leaders and recovered patients are emphasized.

triage.headline_ja: エボラは後退しない：感染者数が1000人を超えた
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響・国際的拡大・異常性）。スクリーニング基準も複数該当し、国際的関心が高い。フルRRAに進むべきシグナル。
triage.notes: フランスでの確認例は渡航関連の輸入症例。DRCでの発生が主題。1000人超の確認症例、34の行政区域への拡大、セキュリティ上の課題、接触追跡率の不足（40%）など、複数の懸念要素あり。MSFなどの国際機関が関与し、国際支援の必要性が明確。

article.articleHeadline: Der Tag: US-Behörde CDC ruft höchste Alarmstufe für Ebola aus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Day: U.S. CDC declares the highest alert level for Ebola.
article.articleSummary: On 26 June 2026, the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention raised the Ebola response in the Democratic Republic of Congo to Emergency Level 1, its highest alert. The outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo strain, a rare form, with over 1,200 infections and 321 deaths in the DRC, and 20 additional cases reported in Uganda—the highest first-month toll on record. The risk of domestic spread to the United States remains low. In response, the CDC has deployed 19 staff to support on‑the‑ground teams and will provide about $107 million in emergency funds, with doses of an experimental Ebola medicine and 2,500 diagnostic tests dispatched to Africa. The White House is seeking more than $1.4 billion in new funding, including roughly $800 million for a quarantine center in Kenya for exposed U.S. citizens.

triage.headline_ja: 米国CDC、エボラに最高警戒レベルを発令
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、稀なBundibugyo株による異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限の可能性）。WPRO基準も5項目中5項目該当し、米国CDC最高警戒レベル発令による極めて高い社会的・政治的関心がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーにおいて、主要な感染症イベントはDRC（1,200感染、321死亡）とウガンダ（20症例）で発生。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。米国CDCの最高警戒レベル発令、Bundibugyo株という稀な株の出現、初月としては記録的な死亡数、国際的な資金配分（14億ドル超、ケニアの隔離センター整備検討）などが判定を支持。

article.articleHeadline: ECDC: 5 άτομα σε καραντίνα μετά από κρούσμα Έμπολα - SBC TV
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: ECDC: 5 people in quarantine after an Ebola case - SBC TV
article.articleSummary: Ebola detected in a French doctor who returned from humanitarian work in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Kinshasa); five nearby passengers from the same flight are in preventive isolation. France’s Health Ministry confirmed the first Ebola case in a European healthcare worker who had been in an affected Congo region; the patient is in full isolation in a high-security biocontainment unit. Contact tracing has begun, and the flight’s passenger list has been shared with health authorities; EU bodies including the European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control are monitoring the situation. The risk to Europe is considered very low for non-travelers, and low even for those in affected regions if basic protective measures are followed. Departure screening (fever checks, symptom review, exposure questions) is prioritized, though it cannot entirely prevent imported cases due to incubation. Guidance emphasizes clear traveler information on symptoms (fever, fatigue, headache, myalgias, vomiting, diarrhea) and transmission (blood or bodily fluids). For Greece, the practical risk is negligible unless traveling to Africa; no additional routine measures needed, but readiness reinforced.

triage.headline_ja: ECDC: エボラ症例後、5人が検疫隔離 - SBC TV
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラウイルス病という高リスク病原体の輸入症例であり、国際的なサーベイランスと対応が必要。
triage.notes: フランスで確認された症例は、DRコンゴでの人道支援活動からの帰国医療従事者であり、DRコンゴが原発地。フランスとギリシャは二次的な言及で、感染症の実発生地ではない（対象国に含まれないため verified_locations から除外）。エボラ症例の国際的輸入は高い警戒が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Эбола не отступает: число заразившихся уже превысило тысячу
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola persists: the number of infected has already exceeded one thousand.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo persists, with more than 1,000 confirmed cases and spread to 34 districts, over a month after the May 17 declaration. France confirms the first imported case on its soil, a doctor returning from humanitarian work in the DRC. In Mongbwalu, 14 patients have recovered, including a nurse infected caring for the deceased; prompt care aided outcomes. International aid and a new local laboratory cut diagnostic turnaround from two weeks to hours. MSF epidemiologist Gigi Manangama says the response was too slow; signals may have appeared in early May, possibly April. Access is constrained by security issues in mining areas; contact tracing remains about 40% of contacts, vs. 90–95% target. Distrust and burial-restriction disputes persist; calls for community engagement and involvement of recovered patients. Monoclonal antibody therapies used, but resources remain scarce, including lack of a blood bank and electrolyte shortages.

triage.headline_ja: エボラは退かず：感染者数はすでに1000人を超えた
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、異常性、国際的拡大のリスク、渡航制限のリスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも全項目該当。確認済み1000人超の大規模アウトブレイク、フランスへの輸入症例確認、複数国への波及。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: フランスへの輸入症例の報告があるが、実際の発生地はDRCに限定される。セキュリティ上の課題によるアクセス制限、接触者追跡率40%（目標90-95%）、コミュニティ信頼問題など管理上の課題が多数存在。MSF流行病学者の指摘により、早期段階での対応遅延の可能性あり。モノクローナル抗体療法の使用、血液銀行不在、電解質不足など医療リソース制約が深刻。

article.articleHeadline: São Paulo tem três novos casos de sarampo confirmados em bebês | Brasil | O Dia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo has three new confirmed measles cases in babies | Brazil | O Dia
article.articleSummary: Three new measles cases in São Paulo state, Brazil, involve babies aged 6 months to 1 year; two were unvaccinated and none had travel history; all recovered. This brings 2026’s total to five cases, with the first two being imported—a 6‑month‑old infant and a 42‑year‑old man—also unvaccinated and recovered. In response, SES‑SP authorized a zero‑dose of the measles‑mumps‑rubella vaccine for children aged 6 to 11 months and 29 days in São Paulo city and Guarulhos. The zero‑dose supplements, not substitutes for routine vaccination (first dose at 12 months, second at 15 months, preferably tetraviral). Additional measures include ring vaccination for contacts and intensified vaccination in high‑traffic areas such as airports, bus terminals, and metro/train stations to interrupt transmission and reduce reintroduction risk. State vaccination coverage stands at 85.32% (first dose) and 72.06% (second dose). Tatiana Lang, CVE‑SP director, underscored vaccination as the main preventive tool.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州で乳幼児の麻しん新規確認3例 | ブラジル
triage.triage_reason: 麻しん事例は小児を中心に確認されているが、5例すべてが回復済みで致命的転帰なし。国内で散発的に発生しているものの、現在のところ深刻な公衆衛生上の影響の兆候は限定的。情報が進展する可能性を踏まえ経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより、2026年にサンパウロ州で麻しん5例が確認されたことが明記されている。うち3例は6ヶ月～1歳の乳幼児、2例は輸入症例（6ヶ月児と42歳男性）。すべて回復済みで死亡例はない。予防接種カバー率（第1回85.32%、第2回72.06%）は比較的良好だが、6～11ヶ月29日の乳幼児を対象とした追加予防接種実施と環状予防接種が当局により承認されている。ブラジルは対象国に含まれるため verified_locations に含める。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemia de ebola na RD Congo causou 304 mortes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola epidemic in the DRC caused 304 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (Bundibugyo strain) is ongoing in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with the epicenter in Ituri province near the South Sudan and Uganda border. Bunia, the provincial capital, accounts for 91.3% of cases and 82.2% of deaths among 1,115 infections and 304 fatalities reported by INSP as of late June. The outbreak, declared May 15, has been described as out of control. The Bundibugyo strain has no vaccine or approved treatment; WHO has declared an international alert and clinical trials are set to begin next week. The virus has spread to two other Congolese provinces and to Uganda (20 cases, 2 deaths). An imported case was detected in France: a Congolese physician with NGO Alima who had worked at the epicenter before traveling to Paris.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ流行が304人の死亡をもたらした
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラ出血熱の多数死亡例、国際的拡大（ウガンダ、フランスへの伝播）、WHO国際アラート発令、ワクチン・治療法なしの株による流行で、シグナル特性が極めて高い。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが検出した発生地域にパリ（フランス）が含まれているが、記事サマリーではフランスはインポートケース1例の検出国であり、主要な流行地ではないため verified_locations から除外。Ituri州（ブニア）がDRC内の流行中心地と明記されているため、DRCのみを記載。ウガンダへの伝播（20例、2死）も報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。流行制御不能との記載あり、ワクチン・承認治療法なしのBundibugyo株による大規模流行で、国際的な懸念極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: SP confirma cinco casos de sarampo em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo confirms five measles cases in 2026.
article.articleSummary: Five measles cases confirmed in 2026 in São Paulo and Guarulhos; on June 26, three infections were reported among infants 6 months to 1 year, all recovered. Two had no prior vaccination; none traveled recently. A zero-dose of the MMR vaccine is now recommended for residents aged 6–11 months 29 days in São Paulo and Guarulhos, providing protection and not replacing routine immunization. Children receiving zero-dose should still complete the standard schedule: first MMR at 12 months and a second dose (preferably tetraviral) at 15 months. Earlier 2026 cases, in March and April, involved a 6-month-old and a 42-year-old, both unvaccinated and imported; they recovered. CVE-SP has implemented vaccination blocks and home visits around cases and intensified vaccination at airports, bus terminals, and transit stations. Tatiana Lang warns of risk of measles reintroduction due to cases in the Americas and international travel. State vaccination coverage: 85.32% first dose, 72.06% second.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロが2026年の麻疹5例を確認
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル（対象国）でMMR接種カバー率の低下（85.32%）に伴う麻疹確認例が複数発生しており、国際的な感染リスク（米州での症例、国際旅行）が指摘されている。IHR基準で異常性・重症度に該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準で予想外の発生、公衆衛生上の懸念が明確。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはサンパウロ州とグアルーリョス市に限定された確認例を述べており、スペイン（カナリア諸島）は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ブラジルの麻疹は2026年複数回の輸入感染であり、2度の接種カバー率が72.06%と低下している点が懸念される。国境検疫強化が実施されているが、米州全体での流行リスクが指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemia de ebola já causou mais de 300 mortes na República Democrática do Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak has already caused more than 300 deaths in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) continues unabated more than a month after declaration on May 15; up to 304 deaths and 1,115 infections per INSP as of latest tally. The epicenter is Ituri province in DRC's northeast, near the border with South Sudan and Uganda; Bunia town accounts for about 91.3% of cases and 82.2% of deaths. The virus has spread to two other Congolese provinces and to Uganda (20 cases, 2 deaths). The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no vaccine or treatment. The World Health Organization has issued an international alert; clinical trials are expected to begin next week. A French-imported case was reported, involving a Congolese doctor with ONG Alima who had visited the epicenter before traveling to Paris. The late detection has complicated response efforts amid insecurity and armed group violence in the area.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行により、コンゴ民主共和国ですでに300人以上の死亡者が発生
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、エボラウイルス病の国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダおよびフランスへの海外伝播）、重大な公衆衛生影響（300人以上の死亡）、治療法・ワクチンなし、および高い社会的・政治的関心を示す。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが報告した発生地域にはパリ、フランスが含まれているが、サマリーでは欧州での二次症例は単発の輸入症例（コンゴ人医師1名）であり、DRC内でのエボラ流行が主題である。WPROスクリーニングの対象国リストにDRCが含まれるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。ウガンダへの越境感染（20症例、2死亡）も報告されているがウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。エボラウイルス病は致命的で高い感染リスクを持つため、単一の確認感染でもシグナルとして扱うべき疾患である。

article.articleHeadline: Chikungunya não termina quando a febre passa - Artigo - Saúde
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chikungunya does not end when the fever passes - Article - Health.
article.articleSummary: Bahia, Brazil records a 92% rise in chikungunya cases in 2026 according to the Bahia State Health Secretariat (Sesab). From January to mid-June, 3,191 probable cases were reported across 141 municipalities. Beyond the acute fever and malaise phase, joint pain can persist for months or years, with about 30%–60% of patients experiencing persistent arthralgia that can impair mobility, work capacity, physical activity, and daily tasks. In some individuals, these inflammatory manifestations resemble inflammatory rheumatic diseases and require specialized evaluation and targeted treatment. A key challenge is the belief that post-acute pain is normal recovery, leading to delayed medical care. If symptoms do not improve, or if there is joint swelling, morning stiffness, or difficulty performing routine activities, evaluation for an ongoing inflammatory process is essential.

triage.headline_ja: チクングニアは熱が引いても終わらない - 記事 - 健康
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル（対象国リストに含まれない）での発生であり、verified_locationsは空となる。IHR基準の該当判定は困難だが、社会的・政治的関心の情報が不足しており、対象外地域での発生のため優先度は低い。
triage.notes: 記事の発生地域はブラジル（バイア州）であり、スクリーニング対象国リストに含まれていない。チクングニアの症例増加（92%増）および後遺症としての関節痛の慢性化が言及されており、WPRO基準では複数該当するが、監視対象地域外のため シグナルピックアップの対象外とした。

article.articleHeadline: São Paulo tem três novos casos de sarampo confirmados em bebês
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo has three new confirmed measles cases among babies.
article.articleSummary: Three more confirmed measles cases among babies in São Paulo state, bringing the 2026 total to five. The three new cases follow two earlier imported infections—a 6‑month‑old infant and a 42‑year‑old man—both unvaccinated and recovered. In response, the São Paulo State Health Secretariat (SES‑SP) recommends a zero‑dose of the measles‑mumps‑rubella (MMR) vaccine for infants aged 6 to 11 months 29 days in the city of São Paulo and Guarulhos. The zero‑dose adds protection but does not replace routine vaccination; children should still begin the regular schedule at 12 months (first dose) and complete a second dose at 15 months, preferably with tetraviral (MMRV). Additional measures include ring vaccination for contacts and intensified vaccination at airports, bus terminals, and metro/train stations to interrupt transmission and reduce reintroduction risk.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロで乳幼児の麻疹（はしか）確定症例3件が新たに報告される
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹の集団発生（2026年累計5件）であり、乳幼児を含む複数症例が確認されている。公衆衛生影響は深刻であり、国家レベルの対応（ワクチン接種勧告、環境監視強化）が既に実施されており、IHR基準およびWPRO基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 麻疹は高い感染性を持つ予防可能疾患であり、乳幼児（6-11ヶ月児）への接種戦略が実施されている。記事サマリーから、これは継続的な感染リスク（輸入例からの二次感染の可能性）を示唆している。ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に追加した。国際的な拡大リスクと渡航制限リスクについては現サマリーでは不明だが、空港・駅などでの強化監視が導入されている点は懸念を示唆している。

article.articleHeadline: Ексочільниця USAID: Ліквідація агентства завадила боротьбі зі спалахом Еболи в
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Former head of USAID: Abolishing the agency hindered the fight against the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Former USAID administrator Samantha Power argues that Donald Trump's administration closed USAID and dissolved its missions in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, shuttered laboratories, and cut funding, hindering the Ebola response. She claims the U.S. also exited WHO and reduced emergency‑response support, eroding Ebola expertise due to abrupt staff departures. European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control data show Ebola infections in the DRC and neighboring Uganda surpassing 1,100 with more than 300 deaths. In May, the World Health Organization declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. State Department spokesperson Tommy Pigott rejected the charge, saying the United States mobilized medical and humanitarian resources within a day of the first confirmed case. The article centers on the outbreak's location, scale, and containment challenges linked to the agency’s closure.

triage.headline_ja: USAID元長官：エージェンシーの廃止がエボラ感染症との闘いを阻害した
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、1,100例超＋300死亡、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHO PHEIC宣言済み。フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: サマリー主題はDRCとウガンダでのエボラ感染症発生。対象国リストではDRCのみ該当。ウガンダは対象国外のため除外。WHO PHEIC宣言（2026年5月）済みで、既に国際的に認識されたシグナル。DRCでの1,100例超＋300死亡の重症化。政治的・国際的関心も高い。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemia de ébola en el Congo deja 304 muertos y más de mil contagios
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in Congo leaves 304 dead and more than a thousand infections.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) remains out of control over a month after it was declared on May 15. The balance reports 304 deaths among 1,115 infections. The epicenter is Ituri province in northeastern DRC, near the border with South Sudan and Uganda, with Bunia city concentrating 91.3% of cases and 82.2% of deaths. The virus has spread to two other provinces and to Uganda, which has 20 cases and 2 deaths. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no vaccine or treatment. WHO has declared an international alert and says clinical trials should begin next week. A related transmission case was detected in France in a Congolese doctor working for NGO Alima. US is sending doses of an experimental therapy and about 2,500 diagnostic tests to aid response in DRC and Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラ流行、304人の死者と1000人以上の感染者
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。エボラウイルス病の国際的な多発生地・高死亡率イベントであり、複数国への拡大と国際的対応が発生している。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは、エボラの主要発生地がDRC（イトゥリ州）であることが明記されている。ウガンダでの症例も報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsに含めない。フランスおよび米国への輸出検体・関連ケースは報告サポート活動であり、発生地ではない。IHR基準およびWPRO基準ともに全て該当する極めてハイリスクのシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: Američki CDC podigao odgovor na epidemiju ebole na najvišu razinu - Novi list
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The American CDC raised the Ebola epidemic response to the highest level.
article.articleSummary: CDC raises Ebola response in the Democratic Republic of Congo to the highest level (Level 1 activation) amid growing concern over rapid spread of the rare Bundibugyo strain. In the DRC, the outbreak has infected more than 1,200 people and caused 321 deaths, while neighboring Uganda reports 20 cases. The maneuver reflects the most intensive ongoing response, with the CDC deploying the largest available workforce to coordinate control, surveillance, and care. Officials say the risk of spread to the United States remains low at present. The World Health Organization notes this is the highest number of cases in the first month of an Ebola outbreak to date. The situation underscores the need for rapid containment measures across Central Africa.

triage.headline_ja: 米国CDCがエボラ流行対応を最高レベルに引き上げ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、DRCでの大規模エボラ流行（1,200人以上感染、321人死亡）と急速な拡大（ウガンダへの越境）が確認される。WHOが過去最高の初月感染数を記録と報告。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCとウガンダでのエボラ流行を述べているが、対象国リストではDRCのみに該当。ウガンダは対象国に含まれていないため、verified_locationsから除外。Bundibugyo strain（稀なエボラウイルス株）による大規模流行とCDCレベル1対応の最高度の国際的関心が示されている。

article.articleHeadline: Američki CDC proglasio najviši, nivo 1 za opasnost od ebole
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: U.S. CDC declares Level 1 the highest level for Ebola risk.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-06-26, the US CDC raised the Ebola outbreak response in the Democratic Republic of the Congo to Level 1, the highest emergency designation, signaling a critical situation and enabling maximum staffing for response in affected countries. The agency noted that the risk of exportation to the United States remains low. CDC has deployed 19 staff overseas to support teams in the DRC and Uganda, joining more than 125 personnel already on the ground and working with ministries of health in both countries. The CDC is also providing funding to partners and has trained 25 local field epidemiologists to operate where CDC personnel have limited access. Since the outbreak began, over 1,200 people in the DRC have been infected and 321 have died; in Uganda, 20 deaths have been reported.

triage.headline_ja: 米国CDCがエボラ熱の最高リスクレベル1を宣言
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当する。エボラ出血熱は重篤な感染症であり、複数国での流行、高い死亡率、国際的対応動員を示している。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCとウガンダでのエボラ流行を述べているが、対象国リストではDRCのみに該当。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。米国CDCのレベル1宣言は国際的な公衆衛生上の重大懸念を示唆。1,200名以上の感染者、321名の死亡（DRC）という深刻な重症度。複数国での展開と125名以上の現地スタッフ配置から、管理能力も課題と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: دراسة: احتمال 69% لوصول إيبولا إلى جنوب السودان خلال 12 أسبوعاً | سبق
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Study: 69% probability of Ebola reaching South Sudan within 12 weeks.
article.articleSummary: Ebola Bundibugyo outbreak in eastern Congo continues, with transmission detected in Uganda. By June 22, 2026, Congo reports 1,048 lab-confirmed infections and 267 deaths; Uganda has 20 confirmed cases and 2 deaths. The World Health Organization declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17, 2026, after formal recognition on May 15. Transmission seems to have begun in early April, enabling spread in conflict zones with weak health systems. The Bundibugyo strain is less transmissible and deadly than the Zaire lineage, but still causes severe hemorrhagic fever and has no licensed vaccine; isolation, contact tracing, and safe burial remain essential. Models project about 8,210 cases by September 2026 under current containment; worst-case could exceed 66,000. South Sudan carries the highest risk (69.3% chance of at least one case within 12 weeks); Rwanda and Burundi risk remains low. This is an early, adjustable risk assessment to guide preparedness.

triage.headline_ja: 研究：エボラがイボーラ南スーダンに到達する可能性は12週間以内に69%
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラウイルス病の国際的多国家流行で、WHO PHEIC宣言済み、複数国での確定症例・死亡あり、地域内拡大リスク高く、国際的な感染拡大の懸念あり。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはエボラアウトブレイクの東部コンゴでの継続的な流行を主題としており、ウガンダでの伝播確認、南スーダンへの拡大リスク評価を含む。ただし、詳細なイベント発生の確認は東部コンゴ（DRC）が主要であり、ウガンダの20例、南スーダンのリスク評価は対象国外。Bluedotが列挙した発生地域（スーダン、ルワンダ、ブルンジ、ウガンダ）のうち、記事サマリー上で実際に確定症例が報告されているのはコンゴとウガンダのみだが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。WHOによるPHEIC宣言、高い死亡率、複数国への伝播、予防策の不十分性により、全スクリーニング基準に該当する高リスク案件。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: The UK has committed up to $26 million to support the Ebola response in the DRC: UK statement at the UN Security Council
article.articleSummary: UK commits up to $26 million to support the Ebola response in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, as the outbreak worsens the humanitarian situation. The funding aims to bolster surveillance, containment, and preparedness in coordination with the DRC, World Health Organization, Africa CDC, MONUSCO, and regional governments. The UK urges unhindered humanitarian access in line with international law to enable the public health response and calls for continued delivery of critical supplies. Commitments by the DRC and Rwanda at the 24 June Joint Oversight Committee Meeting in London are noted, with emphasis on de-escalation, progress toward the Doha Process, rapid deployment of the Enhanced Joint Verification Mechanism, and MONUSCO freedom of movement to support ceasefire monitoring. The UK also voices deep concern over human rights violations in eastern DRC, including conflict-related sexual violence and violence against children, and calls for adherence to international humanitarian law, protections for civilians, and civilian space.

triage.headline_ja: 英国がコンゴ民主共和国におけるエボラ出血熱対応を支援するため最大2,600万ドルを拠出：国連安全保障理事会での英国声明
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準2つ以上該当（重篤な公衆衛生影響、国際的関心の高さ）。WPRO基準複数該当（重症度、長期曝露、流行しやすさ、管理可能性）。対象国DRCでの確認されたエボラ出血熱事例であり、フルリスク評価の対象となる。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCにおけるエボラ出血熱の流行に対する英国の財政的支援を発表するもの。RwandaはJoint Oversight Committee Meetingの文脈で言及されているが、記事の主題はDRC東部でのエボラ出血熱対応。英国はドナー国として登場し、WHO、Africa CDC、MONUSCO等との国際協調が報告されている。人道的アクセス、感染監視強化、準備態勢構築が優先事項として示唆されている。

article.articleHeadline: Američki CDC upalio 'crveni alarm' zbog smrtonosnog virusa: Odgovor na epidemiju digli na najvišu razinu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The U.S. CDC Has Triggered a Red Alert Due to a Deadly Virus: The Response to the Outbreak Has Been Raised to the Highest Level.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-06-26, the U.S. CDC elevated its Emergency Operations Center (EOC) activation for the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo to Level 1, the highest level. The outbreak involves the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain. In the DRC, more than 1,200 people have been infected and 321 have died; neighboring Uganda reports 20 infections. The World Health Organization this week noted this is the largest number of cases in the first month of an Ebola outbreak to date. Despite the escalation, the CDC states the risk of spread to the United States remains low.

triage.headline_ja: 米国CDCが致命的ウイルスに対して「赤色警報」を発令：エボラ流行への対応が最高レベルに引き上げられた
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響：1,200以上の感染者、321死亡；異常/予想外：1ヶ月間での過去最多；国際的拡大リスク：ウガンダへの既存拡大確認）。WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目全て該当。国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念が明確。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCでのエボラ流行を主題としており、ウガンダでの20感染例の言及は二次的。対象国リスト内ではDRCのみが該当。米国CDCの対応エスカレーションは国際的な懸念を示す明確な指標。Bundibugyo ebolavirus株の確認、および1ヶ月間での過去最多ケース数は、異常性と重症度の強い根拠。

article.articleHeadline: A más de un mes del brote de ébola en la RDC, los médicos advierten que "la epidemia va a durar"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than a month after the Ebola outbreak in the DRC, doctors warn that "the epidemic will last."
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo persists more than a month after its May 17, 2026 declaration. By mid-June, confirmed cases exceed 1,000 across 34 zones, with at least 304 deaths reported in later updates; earlier figures cited 837 cases and 196 deaths (as of June 15). In Mongbwalu, health workers celebrated recovery of three patients; Florance, a hospital accountant, contracted Ebola handling deceased bodies, underscoring transmission from the dead. Monoclonal antibody therapies are used, and treatment centers were redesigned to allow visibility of patients and safe family visits. Laboratory capacity improved when INRB installed a local Mongbwalu lab on June 3, speeding testing (no longer sending samples to Bunia or Kinshasa). Surveillance remains weak in mining areas and across borders; 36 zones in Uganda and DRC are affected, with cross-border movement hindering contact tracing and ongoing supply gaps, including no hospital blood bank.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ発生から1ヶ月以上が経過、医師らは「この流行は長引く」と警告
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイク。確認患者1,000人以上、死者304人以上、34地域に拡大、ウガンダとの越境感染リスク、医療システムの脆弱性が報告されており、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当する。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は最高リスクのRespiratory Pathogenであり、DRCでの大規模流行は国際的に極めて高い懸念。越境感染リスク（ウガンダ関連）、医療従事者の感染、弱い監視体制、境界地域での対策困難など重大なリスク要因が複数存在。フルRRA実施は急務。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: UK Pledges $26M for DRC Ebola Fight at UN Council
article.articleSummary: Eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo faces an Ebola outbreak, prompting the United Kingdom to pledge up to $26 million to support the response. UK Minister Counsellor Jennifer MacNaughtan commends Congo’s response and MONUSCO’s efforts to deliver supplies, and urges coordinated action with DRC, WHO, Africa CDC, and partners to strengthen surveillance, containment and preparedness. The UK calls for full, unhindered humanitarian access under international law. The UK also welcomes commitments by DRC and Rwanda from the 24 June London Joint Oversight Committee meeting, urging de-escalation per UN Security Council resolution 2773, progress toward the Doha Process, and swift deployment of the Enhanced Joint Verification Mechanism, enabling MONUSCO freedom of movement to monitor ceasefires and implement its mandate. The UK expresses grave concern over human rights violations in eastern DRC, including sexual violence and violence against children, and reports of drone strikes and shelling, urging respect for international humanitarian law.

triage.headline_ja: UK Pledges $26M for DRC Ebola Fight at UN Council
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の発生（DRC東部）は IHR 基準を複数満たし、国際的支援承認による高い社会的・政治的関心があるため PICKUP。
triage.notes: DRC東部でのエボラ爆発流行（PHEIC相当）。英国が UN Security Council で資金支援を誓約し、WHO・Africa CDC・MONUSCO等を含む国際的対応が協調進行中。Rwanda（ジャネイロ発生地として記載）は記事サマリーでは具体的な症例・流行が記述されていないため verified_locations から除外。英国は資金提供国・政治的支援国であり、実際の流行地ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: What CDC said about Ebola
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-26, France reports one confirmed Bundibugyo Ebola case—the first outside the Democratic Republic of Congo or Uganda since the outbreak began in May. The patient, a physician who treated patients in Congo, returned to France, notified authorities, and is in isolation with public health investigations and contact tracing underway; there is no evidence of community transmission or U.S. exposures. In Africa, more than 1,100 cases have been confirmed across the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda, with the CDC warning the total is likely to rise. The agency has about 24 staff permanently in DRC and roughly 100 in Uganda, with ongoing deployments. In the United States, risk remains low due to robust capacity to rapidly identify cases, triage, isolate, confirm Ebola by laboratory testing, and conduct contact tracing; U.S. authorities are preparing for potential domestic cases.

triage.headline_ja: CDCがエボラについて発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。Bundibugyo Ebolaの多国間拡大と1,100件以上の確定患者という重篤な状況。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではフランスで1例確認されているが、フランスは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations に含めない。DRCが主要な発生地で、ウガンダでの患者発生も記載されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。Bundibugyo Ebolaの国際的拡大、高い死亡率、および複数国での同時流行という重篤な状況。

article.articleHeadline: World News in Brief: Violence displaces thousands in Haiti and Lebanon, Gaza updates, UN food agency delivers in Ebola-stricken DR Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola continues to spread in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), across Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu; 34 health zones affected; WFP scales up aid: more than 1.2 million people supported with nutrition and logistics; 30 of the affected health zones are in crisis or worse hunger; since late May, over 36,000 hot meals delivered to Ebola treatment centres, caregivers, and people under observation; food rations distributed to quarantined communities to support public health measures; WFP also transporting medical supplies and personnel to hotspots; ongoing insecurity and funding shortfalls threaten the response; WFP seeks $72 million over the next six months to sustain food assistance, air services, and logistics as the outbreak grows.

triage.headline_ja: ハイチとレバノンの暴力で数千人が避難、ガザ最新情報、国連食糧機関がエボラ流行地域のコンゴ民主共和国に食糧配給
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（重篤な公衆衛生影響、国際的な懸念、予想外の拡大）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当（異常性、重症度、長期曝露、流行性）。DRCでのエボラウイルス病の流行は明確なシグナルであり、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づき、エボラウイルス病の発生は明確にDRCの東部地域（Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu）で確認されている。34の保健地域が影響を受けており、120万人以上が支援対象。資金不足と継続的な不安定性が対応を脅かしている。フルRRA実施時には、症例数、致命率、治療キャパシティ、地域的な紛争との相互作用などの詳細情報を収集すること。

article.articleHeadline: Dourados vistoria mais 1.288 imóveis e encontra 4 focos do Aedes aegypti
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dourados inspects more than 1,288 properties and finds 4 foci of Aedes aegypti.
article.articleSummary: Dourados, Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, conducted inspections of 1,288 properties on June 23 with 91 endemic-control agents and found 4 Aedes aegypti foci, the vector for Chikungunya, Dengue, and Zika. The operation, reported by the COE on June 24, closed 117 properties, issued 11 notifications, and treated 37 with potential mosquito habitats. Inspections covered neighborhoods including Vila Industrial, Jardim Santa Hermínia, Parque do Lago and Habitacional Canaã III. In addition to surveillance, 7 properties received hand-spraying with a costal spray. The city maintains 1,008 Larvicidal Dissemination Stations installed to trap Aedes larvae; first maintenance has occurred at over 500 traps, with larvicide replacement every 30–60 days. Residents are urged to avoid water accumulation and may contact CCZ at 2222-2074 for EDL support. Ongoing efforts aim to reduce Chikungunya, dengue, and Zika transmission.

triage.headline_ja: ドゥラードス市が1,288件の物件検査を実施し、ネッタイシマカ（Aedes aegypti）の4つの発生源を発見
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルで媒介蚊（ネッタイシマカ）に対する定期的な surveillance・制御活動が報告されている。個別の発見事例であり、異常な流行兆候や国際的拡大リスクの明確な証拠は記事に記載されていない。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事は日常的な媒介蚊制御活動（surveillance、larvicide、手動噴霧）を報告している。Zika、Chikungunya、Denguueはいずれも風土病で、通常はこれらの蚊制御活動が継続されている。現在の症例数、患者の重症度、流行の増加傾向に関する情報は記事に含まれていない。ブラジルの地域的な蚊制御プログラムの一環と見られるため、フルRRAの段階まで進める必要性は低いと判断される。

article.articleHeadline: CDC increases response level to Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: CDC raises Ebola outbreak response to Level 1 in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda as of 2026-06-26. WHO-confirmed figures exceed 1,000 cases and 260 deaths since the outbreak began in May, with most cases in eastern DRC and some spread into Uganda. The outbreak is linked to the Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain, for which there are no approved therapeutics or vaccines. Incubation is 2–21 days; symptoms include fever, fatigue, muscle pain, headache, sore throat, vomiting, diarrhea, rash, and sometimes internal/external bleeding. Transmission occurs from animals to humans and via human-to-human contact, including sexual transmission. The CDC’s Level 1 designation signals top priority, enabling additional resources for coordination, surveillance, and operations in response to the outbreak’s urgency, scale, and geographic spread.

triage.headline_ja: CDCがエボラウイルス感染症の流行に対応レベルをレベル1に引き上げ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も全項目該当。1,000件超の確認症例、260人の死亡、国際的拡大（DRCからウガンダへ）、治療法・ワクチンなし、ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性があり、CDCが最高対応レベルを指定した国際的に重要な感染症危機。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーによると、主要な発生地はDRCの東部であり、ウガンダへの限定的な拡大が報告されている。ただし、ウガンダ（226074）は対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain に対する治療薬およびワクチンが存在しないことが、この流行の脅威レベルを著しく高めている。

article.articleHeadline: Više od 1200 zaraženih ebolom u Kongu, SAD pojačao pripravnost
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 1,200 people infected with Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo; the United States has stepped up its preparedness.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-26, the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) has elevated its Ebola response in the Democratic Republic of the Congo to its highest emergency activation (Level 1), though officials say the risk of domestic spread remains low. The Ebola Bundibugyo strain has infected more than 1,200 people in the DRC and caused 321 deaths, with 20 cases reported in neighboring Uganda. The World Health Organization notes this is the highest first-month case count of any Ebola outbreak to date. In response, the CDC has deployed the maximum staffing for outbreak response, reflecting growing concerns about rapid transmission of this rare strain.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴで1200人以上がエボラに感染、米国が警戒態勢を強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限のリスク）、またWPRO基準でも全項目該当。CDC最高レベルの緊急対応、WHO史上最高の初月患者数、複数国への拡大という多層的な懸念があり、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではウガンダでも20症例が報告されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。CDC最高レベル（Level 1）の緊急対応は極めて異例。Bundibugyo株による初月患者数がWHO史上最高という点は極めて懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemia de ebola na República Democrática do Congo causou 304 mortes, aponta novo balanço
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola epidemic in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has caused 304 deaths, according to a new tally.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 1,115 infections and 304 deaths. The epicenter is Ituri, a mining region in the northeast, where the outbreak began and was detected late, complicating containment. Ongoing security challenges and high population movement hinder response efforts. The World Health Organization has declared an international alert and plans to begin clinical trials soon. The Bundibugyo strain, which currently lacks a licensed vaccine or treatment, has also spread to Uganda, signaling cross-border transmission. The combination of delayed detection, conflict-related barriers, and cross-border spread underscores the need for intensified surveillance, international support, and coordinated interventions to curb transmission and protect affected communities.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ流行が304人の死亡を引き起こしたことが新しい統計で判明
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）し、WPROスクリーニング基準も全て該当。ワクチンなし株の国境越え伝播とWHOの国際警報発出により、フルリスク評価が必須。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの国境越え伝播が確認されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めず。DRCは対象国（203312）であり、Ituri州は北東部の採鉱地域で初期探知の遅れが指摘されている。ワクチン・治療法がない株（Bundibugyo系統）の流行、武装勢力による安全保障上の課題、及びWHOによる国際警報発出がシグナルの重要性を示唆。

article.articleHeadline: First-ever Vaccine Could Treat Growing Tropical Disease in U.S.
article.articleSummary: Leishmaniasis transmitted by sand fly bites is the focus of a CRISPR-edited, skin-only parasite vaccine that trains the immune system without causing disease. In animal studies, the vaccine was 100% effective; the FDA has approved it as an investigational new drug, with first human trials planned for 2026 in Brazil and Kenya, and a U.S. site planned. Leishmaniasis has three forms: cutaneous (skin sores), mucosal (lesions), and visceral (fever, weight loss, enlarged spleen/liver; can be fatal). Historically tropical (Africa, Middle East, South America) but now endemic in Europe and the U.S. due to deforestation and climate change. WHO lists it as a top neglected tropical disease; about 6 million infected at any time, up to 1 million new cases annually, and over 1 billion at risk in 99 territories. Ohio State has seen 2–4 cases annually recently; a skin test for detection is being developed.

triage.headline_ja: 米国で増加する熱帯病に対する初のワクチンが治療の可能性
triage.triage_reason: リーシュマニア症は顧みられない熱帯病として WHO に認識されており、グローバルな負担が大きい（年間100万件の新規感染、99領土で危険）。ただし、本記事はワクチン開発の進展（前臨床段階）に焦点があり、新規の流行事象ではなく、記事配信時点では米国での公衆衛生の急性クライシスではない。
triage.notes: 記事は Leishmaniasis の世界的負担（WHO 認識、年間100万件新規感染、99領土で風土病化）と気候変動・森林破壊による米国への拡大を述べている。ただし Kenya は対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。記事の主要焦点はワクチン開発の進展であり、検出された「発生地域」フィールド内の Ohio（米国）は試験実施予定地であり、既存の患者サーベイランス（2-4例/年）の流行ではない。IHR 基準は2つ該当（重症度、国際拡大リスク）しているが、社会的関心が高くても急性の流行事象ではなく、ワクチン試験段階の報道であるため WATCH。

article.articleHeadline: แพทย์เตือน 'ไข้หวัดใหญ่ในเด็ก' เสี่ยงลุกลามถึงปอดอักเสบ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Doctors warn that 'influenza in children' could progress to pneumonia.
article.articleSummary: Thailand faces seasonal influenza risk that can progress to pneumonia in children. Annual influenza vaccination reduces disease severity and the risk of pneumonia and complications. The rainy season, with cooler temperatures and higher humidity, facilitates respiratory virus spread, especially in crowded settings like schools. Influenza is caused by influenza A and B viruses and spreads via droplets and contaminated surfaces. Symptoms begin within 1–4 days and include fever of 38°C or higher, chills, headache, muscle pains, fatigue, cough, sore throat, congestion, and runny nose; some children experience nausea, vomiting, or diarrhea. High-risk groups include children under 5, the elderly, pregnant women, and those with chronic diseases; complications may include pneumonia, respiratory failure, myocarditis, and encephalitis, potentially fatal without prompt care. Prevention emphasizes masks, hand hygiene, and annual vaccination. Thailand offers two main vaccine forms; nasal spray may be unsuitable for pregnant women, the immunocompromised, and those with poorly controlled asthma.

triage.headline_ja: 医師らが警告：『小児インフルエンザ』が肺炎に進行するリスク
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザの通常発生であり、複数の基準は該当するが、深刻度や国際拡大のリスク、管理可能性の懸念が明確でない。情報不足のため経過観察段階が適切。
triage.notes: 記事はタイの季節性インフルエンザリスクについての予防啓発であり、実際の流行規模、症例数、死亡事例などの具体的な数値情報がない。重症度（肺炎進行リスク）、長期曝露（雨期の継続）、流行しやすさ（飛沫感染、学校等の密集）の基準に該当するが、いずれも予想された季節現象である。政府の対応状況や国際的な支援必要性について情報なし。

article.articleHeadline: CDC increases response level to Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: CDC raises response to Level 1 for Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda as of 2026-06-26. WHO confirms more than 1,000 cases and more than 260 deaths since the outbreak began in May, with most cases in eastern DRC and a smaller number crossing into Uganda. The outbreak is linked to Bundibugyo Ebola virus, a strain with no approved therapeutics or vaccines. Incubation is 2–21 days. Symptoms include fever, fatigue, muscle pain, headache, sore throat, vomiting, diarrhea, rash, and sometimes bleeding. Transmission occurs animal-to-human and human-to-human, including sexual transmission. There is no proven specific treatment; care is primarily supportive, with fluids and symptom management, and experimental immune/drug therapies may be used. The elevated CDC response enables additional resources for coordination and operations.

triage.headline_ja: CDC、エボラ感染症の対応レベルを引き上げ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。1,000例以上・260死亡の大規模流行、国際拡大（DRCからウガンダへ）、治療法なしの高リスク株、ヒト-ヒト感染で高い流行可能性により、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは「DRCおよびウガンダにおけるエボラ流行」と述べているが、対象国リストにはDRCのみが含まれるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。ウガンダは対象国ではないため除外。Bundibugyo Ebola virusは承認されたワクチン・治療薬がなく、致命率が高く、ヒト-ヒト感染能があるため公衆衛生上の脅威は極めて深刻。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: واشنطن تفعّل أعلى مستويات الاستجابة لإيبولا وترسل علاجات تجريبية للكونغو الديموقراطية وأوغندا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Washington activates the highest levels of the Ebola response and sends experimental therapies to the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-06-26, the United States CDC raised its Ebola response to Level 1, the highest, in response to the Democratic Republic of Congo outbreak, signaling heightened internal priority and faster mobilization of staff and resources. Washington is shipping experimental MBP134 monoclonal antibody therapy doses to the DRC and Uganda, with additional doses routed to the University of Oxford in the United Kingdom for a clinical trial. After more than a month of transmission, the DRC outbreak remains uncontrolled, with at least 304 deaths among 1,115 cases; Uganda reports 20 infections, including two deaths. The outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo variant of Ebola, for which there is currently no licensed vaccine or approved treatment. U.S. risk to the homeland is described as low, despite the intensified response.

triage.headline_ja: ワシントンはエボラ対応の最高レベルを発動し、実験的治療法をコンゴ民主共和国とウガンダに送付
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当。深刻な公衆衛生影響（304死亡、1,115症例）、国際的拡大（DRC、ウガンダ、英国での臨床試験）、コントロール不可能な流行（Bundibugyo変異体、治療法なし）があり、米国が最高度対応を発動。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域にはワシントンDC、米国、ウガンダ、英国も含まれているが、これらは対応・支援地点で、実際の感染症イベント発生地はDRCおよびウガンダである。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当するため verified_locations に含める。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。エボラウイルス病（最高リスク感染症）、Bundibugyo変異体（ワクチンなし）、1ヶ月以上のコントロール不可能な流行、米国CDC Level 1対応という点で極めて深刻。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en Ituri : l'épidémie a pris racine dans le pays de l'or
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Ituri: the outbreak has taken root in the land of gold.
article.articleSummary: Ebola has taken root in Ituri’s gold country, centered in Mongbwalu, where open-pit mining and crowded pits bring people into close contact with the forest reservoir believed to host frugivorous bats. The 17th Ebola outbreak is active within a few kilometers of mines; preventive measures are difficult to sustain when livelihoods depend on daily ore yields. As of June 24, the DRC reported 1,155 confirmed cases and 304 deaths, with Mongbwalu alone at 209 cases and 89 deaths. The outbreak’s spillover is linked to deforestation and mining, which push populations from Ituri toward cross-border routes to Uganda, especially via Aru. A 90-day cross-border response plan by Kinshasa and Kampala prioritizes Aru, aiming to bolster laboratories and sanitary controls to curb cross-border transmission and linked gold-smuggling networks that finance militias. Historical context: 2018–2020 Ebola in North Kivu/Ituri caused 3,481 cases and 2,299 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: Ebola in Ituri: the outbreak has taken root in the land of gold.
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当。エボラウイルス病は重症度が高く（致命率26.3%）、国際的な拡大リスク（ウガンダへの越境感染）があり、渡航・貿易制限の対象となる。
triage.notes: 記事は主にDRC（イトゥリ州）でのエボラ流行を扱っており、ウガンダとの越境感染リスクについても言及している。ただし、実際のウガンダでのケースが確認されているかは記事サマリーには明記されていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみに限定した。2026年6月26日現在、DRCで1,155確定例・304死亡例が報告されており、鉱業活動と関連した流行が進行中。90日の越境対応計画が立案されている点から、国際的な懸念の高さが伺える。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola deja más de 300 muertos y ya llega a Europa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola leaves more than 300 dead and has already reached Europe.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has reached 1,115 cases and 304 deaths, as of 26 June 2026, with the epicenter in Ituri province and Bunia city. The outbreak, declared just over a month ago, has also spread to Uganda, reporting 20 infections and 2 deaths;France reports a single imported case in a Congolese-trained physician who worked in the affected area and is now in Paris. The WHO keeps an international alert active; no vaccine or approved specific treatment exists for the Bundibugyo strain. Clinically, experimental therapies are slated for early trials in the coming days. The United States will send an experimental treatment and 2,500 diagnostic tests to reinforce detection and containment efforts in DRC and Uganda amid ongoing cross-border transmission and humanitarian challenges due to mining, mobility, and armed conflict.

triage.headline_ja: エボラが300人以上の死者を出し、既にヨーロッパに到達
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響：1,115例304死亡、Bundibugyo株は予想外、国際的拡大：ウガンダ・フランスへの波及、渡航制限リスク）。WPRO基準も全5項目該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、主要な感染イベントはDRC（Ituri州Bunia市）で発生している。ウガンダへの波及、フランスへの輸入症例も報告されているが、対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。Bundibugyo Ebola株は稀な系統であり、ワクチン・特異的治療不存在による懸念が顕著。武装紛争・採掘活動による制御困難性が指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: Beni : Papy Machozi conduit une délégation d'élus en mission de solidarité et de sensibilisation contre Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Beni: Papy Machozi leads a delegation of elected officials on a solidarity and awareness-raising mission against Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Two new Ebola cases were confirmed in the Beni health zone, North Kivu, DRC, bringing cumulative confirmed cases to 24 as of June 25, 2026, per the provincial Ebola response bulletin. A parliamentary delegation led by Senator Papy Machozi arrived in Beni on June 26 to express solidarity with communities affected by ADF attacks, assess the situation, and promote Ebola prevention in the Greater North region. The visit also inaugurated social infrastructures funded by the senator, including the Catholic church in the Saint-Jean-Paul II sector of Boikene and new buildings for the ISC Beni; the ISC ceremony was to be presided over by Higher Education Minister Marie-Thérèse Sombo Safi. The delegation includes national deputies, senators from several provinces and the bishop of Sakania-Kipushi, underscoring community mobilization and strict adherence to prevention measures to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: ベニ：パピ・マショジ議員が、エボラに対抗するための連帯と啓発活動の使節団を率いる
triage.triage_reason: DRCのノースキブ州ベニ地域で確認されたエボラウイルス病の新規症例（2例、累計24例）は、IHR基準2項目（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、国際拡大リスク）に該当し、WPRO基準でも重症度、流行性、長期曝露の複数基準に該当するため、フルRRA実施対象となる。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年6月26日のベニ地域での新規エボラ症例確認（2例、累計24例）と議会使節団の訪問について報じている。DRCのノースキブ州での継続的なエボラ発生を示す事例であり、公的機関による対応・啓発活動が実施されている状況が示されている。ADF攻撃による治安不安定要因も記載されており、感染症対応環境が複雑である可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: The Ebola outbreak is bigger now and the US is paying attention
article.articleSummary: CDC upgrades Ebola response to Level 1 as the Bundibugyo strain spreads from the Democratic Republic of the Congo into Uganda, with over 1,100 confirmed cases and more than 260 deaths since May. France reports the outbreak’s first case outside Africa—a physician who treated in Congo and was isolated on return; no community transmission and no US exposures identified. Bundibugyo presents challenges: there are no approved therapeutics or vaccines, so care relies on fluids and supportive/immune therapies; incubation is 2–21 days and transmission occurs through direct contact with bodily fluids. The virus was first identified in 1976. The CDC has 24 staff in the DRC and about 100 in Uganda, with more as needed; the US risk remains low due to rapid identification, isolation, lab confirmation, and contact tracing. WHO/Africa CDC coordinate a joint response; experimental vaccines are in development but scale remains uncertain; cases are expected to rise.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行がさらに拡大し、米国が注視し始める
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo株）は重篤な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大（コンゴ→ウガンダ→フランス）、治療法・ワクチンの欠如による管理困難性を示す。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴ民主共和国での主要な流行を記述し、ウガンダへの拡大とフランスでの輸入症例を報告している。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。CDCがLevel 1対応に引き上げ、WHOおよびAfrica CDCが共同対応を調整中。Bundibugyo株は治療薬・ワクチンが承認されていない点が管理可能性を大きく低下させている。

article.articleHeadline: 美疾控中心將應對埃博拉疫情列為首要任務
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: U.S. CDC to make addressing the Ebola outbreak a top priority.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Africa prompts the U.S. CDC to elevate response to top priority. Since May, the DRC and Uganda have reported over 1,100 positive Ebola tests and more than 250 deaths, with numbers expected to rise. CDC official Satish Pillai said the higher level reflects urgency and enables more resources and coordination. There is currently no direct Ebola risk to the United States. A French Ebola case is imported from a humanitarian aid worker in the DRC; the patient reported symptoms on arrival, was isolated, and tracing is underway, with no evidence of community transmission or U.S. exposure. The CDC has deployed over 100 staff, including 24 in the DRC and nearly 100 in Uganda, with offices in the DRC and South Sudan. The White House seeks $1.4 billion; travel restrictions for non-U.S. citizens who recently visited Congo, South Sudan, or Uganda were extended to July 21.

triage.headline_ja: 米疾病対策センター、エボラウイルス感染症対応を最優先課題とする
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つすべてに該当。アフリカ（DRC、ウガンダ）でのエボラ流行は深刻な公衆衛生影響（250以上の死亡、1,100以上の陽性例）、異常性、国際的拡大リスク（フランスへの輸入例、渡航制限実施）を示しており、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUgandaが含まれているが、対象国リストにないため除外。記事サマリーではDRCとウガンダでの流行が明記されており、DRCのみが対象国に該当。フランスでの輸入例は報告されているが、フランスは対象国リストに含まれず、また検査陽性者が発生国ではなく二次的な輸入例であるため主題ではない。米国への直接的なリスクはないと記載。

article.articleHeadline: Число заболевших Эболой в Конго превысило 1 200
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 1,200.
article.articleSummary: 1,203 laboratory-confirmed Ebola virus disease cases have been recorded in the Democratic Republic of the Congo as of 26 June 2026, up 48 cases over the previous day. Ebola-related deaths total 321, up 17 in the same period, yielding a case-fatality ratio of 26.6%. Figures come from a daily bulletin of the Congolese Ministry of Communications and Media, reported via TASS and cited by Oxu.Az. The article does not provide details on infection sources or imported/exported cases. The outbreak remains ongoing in the DRC, indicating sustained transmission and ongoing public health surveillance and response needs.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴにおけるエボラ患者数が1,200人を超える
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）。1,200人超の確認症例と26.6%の高い致命率を伴う急速な流行拡大は、全国的対応と国際支援の必要性を示唆。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づき、DRCでの確認症例数1,203件、死亡321件との具体的統計が記載されている。日次報告による継続的な追跡監視が進行中。記事では感染源やケース輸出入の詳細は未提供。エボラウイルス疾患は極めて高い致死性と拡大リスクを持つため、国際的な懸念は必然的に高い。

article.articleHeadline: Confirman nuevos casos de sarampión en niños brasileños
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New Cases of Measles Confirmed in Brazilian Children.
article.articleSummary: Measles cases rise in Brazil: São Paulo state reports three new infant cases, bringing this year’s total to five. The three patients, aged 6 months to 1 year (two boys, one girl), had no recent international travel; two were unvaccinated. All recovered. In response, the São Paulo Health Secretariat authorized a one-time zero-dose MMR vaccine for residents aged 6–11 months in the capital São Paulo and Guarulhos. The dose is supplementary and does not replace the regular schedule; children must complete the routine immunizations. The outbreak occurs amid renewed measles concern across the Americas, with international virus circulation and insufficient vaccination coverage raising reintroduction risks. Brazil’s Health Ministry has intensified surveillance since a March case in a 6-month-old traveler to Bolivia, reiterating vaccination as the key preventive measure.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルの子どもたちにおいて麻疹の新規症例が確認される
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹の再発症例が確認されており、WPROスクリーニング基準（異常性、流行しやすさ）に該当する可能性があるが、症例数が限定的（年間計5件）で重症度が低く（全員回復）、詳細な流行状況把握には続報が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは南米全体での麻疹再発の懸念に言及しており、ブラジルでの症例増加は地域的な関心を集めている。ただし現時点での症例数は限定的で、重症度も低い。ワクチン接種キャンペーンの開始を示すなど、管理可能な状況と判断される。ボリビアとスペイン（カナリア諸島）が地理的に関連しているが、記事の主題はブラジルに限定されている。

article.articleHeadline: Brote de ébola por virus Bundibugyo supera los 1000 casos confirmados y la OMS mantiene la emergencia internacional
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo virus surpasses 1,000 confirmed cases and the WHO maintains the international emergency.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo caused by Bundibugyo virus exceeds 1,000 confirmed cases, with Uganda reporting 20 cases and France one imported case; total deaths at least 291 as of June 22, 2026. The World Health Organization maintains the Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Bundibugyo is one of six Ebola strains and has no licensed vaccine or approved treatment; FDA-approved therapies target the Zaire strain and are not applicable. Patients receive supportive care. Historical case fatality for Bundibugyo ranges 25–55%; the current outbreak CFR is about 26% due to early detection and supportive care. Travel restrictions: CDC alerts travelers to DRC and Uganda; avoid nonessential travel to Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu; returnees monitored for 21 days. US DHS and CDC screen at four airports (IAD, ATL, IAH, JFK), redirecting travelers from DRC, Uganda, and South Sudan. Relevance to Cuban travelers and medical missions noted.

triage.headline_ja: ブンディブギョウイボラウイルスによるアウトブレイクが1,000例を超え、WHOが国際的な緊急事態を維持
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、複数国での国際的拡大、深刻な死亡率、国際的渡航制限が実施されているため、フルRRA実施対象。
triage.notes: DRCは評価対象国リストに含まれているため verified_locations に含める。Ugandaはサマリーで言及されているが評価対象国リストに含まれないため除外。Bundibugyo型エボラの1,000例超過、複数国への国際拡大、WHO PHEIC維持、ワクチン・治療薬不在、治療法が限定的（支持療法のみ）、FAD承認医薬品が適用外、CFR約26%、国際的な渡航制限と空港スクリーニング実施などにより、全項目で深刻度が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Impulso a nivel mundial para advertir de la amenaza de la toxoplasmosis y reconocerla como una ETD por la OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Global push to warn of the threat of toxoplasmosis and recognize it as an ETD by the WHO.
article.articleSummary: Global group of experts from the Americas, Europe, Africa, and Asia, led by João Furtado (University of São Paulo) and Justine Smith (University of Flinders), urge the World Health Organization to recognize Toxoplasma gondii–induced toxoplasmosis as a neglected tropical disease (NTD). Transmission occurs mainly via undercooked meat containing tissue cysts and contaminated produce or water with oocysts shed by cats; congenital infection during pregnancy can cause lifelong visual and neurological impairments. Despite a global burden, data remain uncertain and many high-prevalence regions lack updated statistics, leaving toxoplasmosis outside formal NTD programs and health plans. Recognition would unlock funding for research, prevention, and treatment and integrate the disease into One Health across human, animal, agricultural, and environmental sectors. The authors present a practical roadmap: improved prenatal screening, stronger food- and water-safety measures, and coordinated global responses.

triage.headline_ja: トキソプラズマ症の脅威を警告し、WHOによる顧みられない熱帯病（NTD）としての認識を求める世界的な推進
triage.triage_reason: トキソプラズマ症は重大な公衆衛生上の懸念であり、複数地域に関連するが、記事は既存の感染症イベント発生ではなく、WHOへの認識要求に関するポジション・ペーパーであり、実際の流行・アウトブレイクの報告ではない。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、実際の感染症イベント（流行やアウトブレイク）の報告ではなく、複数地域の専門家グループ（特にブラジルとオーストラリアの大学が主導）がWHOにトキソプラズマ症をNTDとして認識するよう求める提唱であることが明確。オーストラリア・スペイン・アフリカは言及されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれていないか、または記事の主要な発生地域ではない。ブラジルが明示されているため verified_locations に含める。実際の新たなアウトブレイク報告がないため WATCH 判定。

article.articleHeadline: С 2027 года младенцев в России будут проверять на шесть новых заболеваний
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: From 2027, infants in Russia will be tested for six new diseases.
article.articleSummary: Russia plans to expand newborn screening from 2027 by adding six diseases: Duchenne muscular dystrophy, Krabbe disease, Pompe disease, mucopolysaccharidosis type I, Gaucher disease, and Niemann-Pick disease types A/B, according to RIA Novosti citing the Health Ministry. The move would raise the screening panel from 42 to as many as 48 conditions. Earlier this year the program broadened tests to include X-linked adrenoleukodystrophy and aromatic L-amino acid decarboxylase deficiency. Separately, officials described melioidosis, noting a recently hospitalized woman who arrived from Thailand. Melioidosis can present with minimal symptoms; identified risk factors include diabetes, HIV, kidney disease, and alcoholism. No further case counts are provided. The announcements reflect ongoing public health measures in Russia to broaden early-detection capabilities for inherited and infectious diseases.

triage.headline_ja: 2027年からロシアの新生児は6つの新しい疾患について検査を受けることになる
triage.triage_reason: メリオイドーシスの1症例（タイからの輸入例）が記事に含まれているが、詳細情報が限定的（症例数不明、明確な死亡や重症化の報告なし）。主要記事はロシアの新生児スクリーニング拡大計画に関するもので、感染症アウトブレイクのシグナルとしては弱い。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はロシアの新生児スクリーニング計画拡大であり、メリオイドーシスは補足情報として単一症例（タイからの輸入例）が言及されているのみ。症例数、重症度、感染源の詳細が不足しており、集団発生の証拠がない。ロシアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations にはタイのみを記載。

article.articleHeadline: Amerikanci zbog ebole povukli drastičan potez: Ovo se nije dogodilo ni u jednoj epidemiji
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Americans pulled a drastic move because of Ebola: This hasn't happened in any epidemic.
article.articleSummary: Ebola Bundibugyo outbreak drives unprecedented early-case burden: Congo reports over 1,200 cases and 321 deaths in the first month, while neighboring Uganda has 20 infections. The World Health Organization says this is the highest number of Ebola cases in the first month of an outbreak ever, documented this week. The United States CDC elevated its emergency activation to Level 1, the highest category for grave public health events, and allocated the maximum staff to outbreak response. The report highlights ongoing transmission primarily in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with cross-border risk to Uganda. No additional details on clinical symptoms, laboratory confirmation, infection sources, or imported/exported case movements are provided in the article. Published 2026-06-26.

triage.headline_ja: 米国がエボラ対策で劇的な措置を実施：どの流行でも起こらなかったことが発生
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイク（初月1,200例以上、321死亡）で国際的拡大リスクが高く、米国CDCがレベル1（最高度）の緊急対応を発動している重要なシグナル。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの主要な感染症イベントはコンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ・ブンディブギオアウトブレイク。ウガンダへの国際的拡大（20例）も記載されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsに含めない。米国はCDC対応の報告地であるため含めない。初月の症例数がエボラ史上最高という異例性、高い致命率、米国CDCの最高レベル対応があり、フルRRA対象のシグナルとして識別される。

article.articleHeadline: நாளை, தமிழகம் முழுவதும் போலியோ சொட்டு மருந்து முகாம்; பாலவாக்கத்தில் முதல்-அமைச்சர் விஜய் தொடங்கி வைக்கிறார்
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tomorrow, polio drops vaccination camps across Tamil Nadu; Chief Minister Vijay to inaugurate in Palavakkam.
article.articleSummary: India is moving toward a polio-free status, with free oral polio drops annually for children under five. On 28 June 2026, vaccination camps will be conducted across Tamil Nadu to immunize youngsters with OPV. In Chennai, the campaign will be inaugurated by Chief Minister Vijay at the Adi Dravidar Welfare Higher Secondary School premises in Palavakkam. Tamil Nadu aims to cover 52.91 lakh children in this drive. The event marks ongoing national efforts to eradicate polio through routine immunization and mass campaigns, reinforcing India's push toward eliminating poliomyelitis. The initiative aligns with the broader goal of sustaining polio-free status through continuous vaccination coverage.

triage.headline_ja: 明日、タミル・ナドゥ州全域でポリオ予防接種キャンプ実施；チェンナイではムッティヤル首相がパラヴァッカムで開会
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は予防接種キャンプの実施告知であり、ポリオ患者の発生や疾病の蔓延を報じたものではない。公衆衛生上の肯定的な取り組みであり、感染症危機をトリアージするシグナルに該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事はポリオ根絶に向けた公式な予防接種キャンプの開始告知である。患者発生、疾病の異常な増加、または危機的状況は報告されていない。インドはポリオフリー状態の維持を目指しており、この記事は疾病制御上の肯定的なアクションであり、感染症危機シグナルではない。

article.articleHeadline: Le Maroc fait don à la RDC, de neuf tonnes d'équipements médicaux destinés à la lutte contre Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Morocco donates nine metric tons of medical equipment to the DRC to fight Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Ituri Province, eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), prompts a nine-ton donation from Morocco to MONUSCO. A Royal Moroccan Air Force C-130H landed at Bunia airport, delivering the first batch of medicines, pharmaceuticals, personal protective equipment, and other medical supplies to support MONUSCO’s Ebola response. The equipment is for MONUSCO personnel (Congolese and international, civilian and military) to strengthen a Level 2 hospital run by the Moroccan contingent and to bolster prevention, treatment, and protection of staff amid a sensitive health environment. MONUSCO emphasizes protecting staff to ensure the mission’s civilian-protection mandate continues. A second rotation is planned in coming days to deliver additional gear and deploy a Moroccan medical team to reinforce the Ebola response. The Congolese government expressed gratitude for the support.

triage.headline_ja: モロッコが、エボラ出血熱との闘いを目的とした医療機器9トンをコンゴ民主共和国に寄贈
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の発生がコンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州で確認されており、IHR基準における深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、および国際支援要件を満たす。WPROスクリーニング基準における重症度、流行可能性、管理可能性の複数項目に該当する。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴ民主共和国東部イトゥリ州でのエボラ出血熱発生を主題としており、モロッコからの医療支援寄贈はこの発生への対応として位置付けられている。モロッコは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。国際支援の受け入れと複数国間の協力（MONUSCO、モロッコ医療チーム派遣予定）が明記されている。

article.articleHeadline: Trump to Request Over $1.4 Billion in Ebola Funding from Congress
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak centered in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda has 1,114 confirmed cases and 279 deaths (CDC). There are no licensed vaccines, and diagnostics or monoclonal antibodies developed for Zaire do not reliably work against Bundibugyo; treatment is primarily supportive. Trials of MBP134 and remdesivir are slated to begin next week in the DRC’s Ituri province, aiming to enroll 500–1,000 patients to assess mortality reduction. The United States seeks over $1.4 billion in new funding, including $800 million for humanitarian crisis responses including a Kenyan quarantine center for exposed Americans, supplies, contact tracing, and infection control; $500 million for health security; and $90 million for diplomacy and evacuations. Kenya’s high court has suspended U.S. quarantine plans amid demonstrations. France reports its first Ebola case, in a doctor who traveled to the DRC; patient is stable and under 21-day isolation with ALIMA personnel tracing contacts.

triage.headline_ja: トランプ大統領、議会にエボラ出血熱対策費として14億ドル以上の予算要求
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。Bundibugyo Ebolaの多国間にまたがる流行（DRC・ウガンダ中心、フランスでも症例報告）、高い致死率（1,114確定例、279死亡）、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスクが認められ、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はBundibugyo Ebolasの流行がDRC（Ituri州）とウガンダを中心としていることを述べているが、対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。フランスの症例はDRCからの輸入症例であり、発生地はDRCである。ケニアは検疫センター計画の対象国だが、実際の患者発生地ではないため除外。米国・フランスも同様に対象国外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Alerta por ébola: sin fármacos ni vacunas ante un brote "fuera de control" y tan peligroso como el que llegó a España hace 12 años
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola alert: no drugs or vaccines amid an out-of-control outbreak, as dangerous as the one that reached Spain twelve years ago.
article.articleSummary: A Congo Ebola outbreak is driven by a rare Bundibugyo variant, with no approved treatments or vaccines. By June 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo reported 1,155 confirmed cases and 304 deaths. Suspected initial infections may have begun in February 2026 in Mongbwalu, Ituri province (eastern DRC). The World Health Organization did not receive alerts about an unknown high-mortality illness until early May, and days later authorities confirmed the Bundibugyo variant and declared Ebola in the country. The strain has crossed borders, with France reporting the first imported confirmed case—a health professional who participated in a medical mission in the DRC. MSF epidemiologist Manuel Albela warns that spillover and export risks may continue. No targeted therapeutics or vaccines exist for this variant.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ警戒：制御不能なアウトブレイク、12年前にスペインに到達した時と同じくらい危険で、医薬品もワクチンもない状況
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）、致死率の高いエボラウイルス、既に国際的な波及を確認、管理可能性の懸念があるため。
triage.notes: 発生地域にFranceが含まれているが、フランスは輸入症例1件の報告のみで、主たる発生地はDRCのイトゥリ州。対象国リストに該当する発生国はDRCのみ。Bundibugyo変異体でワクチンや治療薬がない状態での大規模流行（1,155確認患者、304死亡）、国際的な波及確認、及びMSF流行学者による継続的なリスク警告により、極めて高い懸念がある。

article.articleHeadline: Sarampo: Saúde pede dose extra de vacina em crianças de SP e Guarulhos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles: Health Department Requests an Extra Vaccine Dose for Children in São Paulo and Guarulhos.
article.articleSummary: June 26, 2026, Brazil’s Health Ministry urged an extra measles vaccine dose (dose zero) for children under 1 in São Paulo and Guarulhos after new cases in North Zone of São Paulo. Dose zero for 6–11 months up to 1 year supplements routine MMR schedule (first dose at 12 months; second at 15 months). Surveillance, contact tracing, vaccination campaigns, and community outreach were activated to curb transmission. Brazil has six confirmed measles cases: one in Rio de Janeiro and five in São Paulo; 6‑month‑old who returned from Bolivia received dose zero in February, and a 42‑year‑old man is another imported case. The three cases: two boys and a girl (6 months–1 year), two in the same daycare and the third in the same area, with ties to travelers. Endemic circulation has been absent since 2024; 2023 saw 38 import‑related cases. Measles remains highly contagious; vaccination protects individuals and the community.

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹：サンパウロとグアルーリョスの子どもたちへの追加ワクチン接種をブラジル保健省が要請
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルで麻疹の複数確認症例（6例）と追加ワクチン接種キャンペーン展開が報告されており、IHR基準の異常性（予想外の流行復活）と重症度（乳幼児への影響）を満たす。国家レベルの対応が開始されている。
triage.notes: 2024年以降の風土病循環が報告されていない中での6例の確認は例外的。ボリビアからの輸入症例と国内での局所的なクラスタリング（同一保育施設）を示唆。保健省による積極的な監視・接種キャンペーン展開により管理可能と評価される。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: US activates highest-level response to Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: On June 26, the US CDC activated Level 1, the highest level of response, to the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, signaling top priority and mobilizing staff and resources. The risk to the United States remains low. The outbreak has caused 304 deaths among 1,115 laboratory-confirmed infections, with spread to Uganda, where Kampala reports 20 confirmed cases and two deaths since May 15. The Bundibugyo strain, originating in Guinea and responsible for this outbreak, has no approved vaccines or treatments.
