U.S. health authorities are shipping experimental MBP134 treatments to the DRC and Uganda, with additional doses planned for the University of Oxford for a clinical trial. Washington is prepared to send 2,500 diagnostic tests to screen deceased victims to identify strains. If unchecked, the outbreak could reach or exceed the scale of the 2014-2016 West Africa Ebola epidemic, which killed over 11,000 people.

triage.headline_ja: 米国がエボラ流行に対する最高レベルの対応を発動
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当。コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ流行が深刻（304死亡、1,115確定例）で、ウガンダへの国際的拡大、米国を含む渡航制限リスク、ワクチン・治療法なしの未知株による高い懸念。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはウガンダ（Kampala）も含まれているが、記事サマリー上でウガンダは「拡大先」として言及されており、主要な流行地はDRCである。ウガンダはWPRO対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを含める。2014-2016西アフリカエボラ流行（11,000以上死亡）との比較により、深刻な国際的懸念が明示されている。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: UK commits up to $26 million to support the Ebola response in the DRC
article.articleSummary: As of 27 June 2026, the United Kingdom commits up to $26 million to support the Ebola response in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). The announcement, by UK minister counsellor Jennifer MacNaughtan, accompanies a coordinated effort with the DRC, World Health Organisation, Africa CDC, MONUSCO, and regional governments to bolster surveillance, containment, and preparedness. The statement urges unhindered humanitarian access under international law to accelerate the public health response. It also references commitments from the DRC and Rwanda at a 24 June Joint Oversight Committee Meeting in London, and calls for de-escalation per Security Council resolution 2773, swift deployment of the Enhanced Joint Verification Mechanism, and full MONUSCO freedom of movement for ceasefire monitoring. The UK highlights grave human rights violations in eastern DRC, including conflict-related sexual violence and attacks on civilians, urging adherence to international humanitarian law.

triage.headline_ja: 英国、DRCのエボラ対応支援に最大2600万ドルを拠出
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス疾患の進行中の流行対応における国際的な公衆衛生関与であり、IHR基準の複数項目（深刻な影響、国際的対応、異常性）に該当。DRC東部での流行は重要なシグナル事象である。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC東部でのエボラ流行への国際的対応を報道している。Bluedot APIが英国とルワンダを発生地域として挙げているが、これらは対応・支援国であり、実際の流行地はDRCのみ。対象国リストに含まれるDRCのみをverified_locationsに列挙。流行の継続、人道的アクセス阻害、紛争との関連が述べられており、複数のWPRO基準に該当。

article.articleHeadline: Doctors See Chance to Decode Ebola Disease as Survivors Rise (1)
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is the world's largest recorded outbreak of this rare Bundibugyo strain. As of June 27, Congolese health authorities report 148 recoveries, nearly doubling from 80 on June 18, while treatment centers continue to admit dozens of patients daily. Doctors say the rising number of survivors offers the clearest picture yet of how this low-profile Ebola strain behaves, contrasting with the more common Zaire and Sudan species whose outbreaks have higher fatality signals. The report highlights ongoing transmission and recovery trends but does not provide detailed laboratory confirmation data or infection-source information in the excerpt. The development emphasizes gathering clinical insights from survivors to understand progression, potential determinants of outcome, and implications for outbreak response.

triage.headline_ja: 医師が生存者の増加に伴いエボラ病を解き明かすチャンスを見る
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（重篤な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）。Bundibugyo Ebolastrain（希少株）の世界最大規模の発生であり、感染者数増加傾向を示す。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus（希少株）の世界最大規模発生。6月18日から27日の9日間で回復者が80人から148人にほぼ倍増し、治療施設が毎日数十人の患者を受け入れている。継続的な伝播を示唆。検査室確認データと感染源情報の詳細は提供されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Fièvre jaune en Afrique de l'Ouest : 16 cas confirmés, un risque sous-estimé pour le Sahel ? - Mali Actu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Yellow fever in West Africa: 16 confirmed cases, an underestimated risk for the Sahel? - Mali Actu.
article.articleSummary: Yellow fever in West Africa: 16 confirmed cases from January to May 2026, with 32 additional suspected cases under investigation across five countries, including Nigeria and Ghana. Confirmed infections are mainly in Burkina Faso, Cameroon, and the Republic of the Congo. The WHO warns of an underestimated risk for the Sahel, where vaccination access is hampered by conflict and insecurity, hindering preventive campaigns. Burkina Faso, a member of the Sahel Alliance, exemplifies vulnerability as armed conflict and political instability limit vaccination activities. The WHO’s EYE strategy to eliminate epidemics by 2030 faces major logistical and security barriers; vaccination remains the only effective protection, yet coverage is insufficient for rural and forest communities. The article questions whether AES cooperation could strengthen cross-border surveillance and campaigns amid displacement and weak health systems, and recalls 2025 outbreaks in Angola and Congo that prompted emergency vaccination efforts.

triage.headline_ja: 西アフリカの黄熱病：16例が確認、サハラの過小評価されたリスク？ - Mali Actu
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）、WPRO基準でも複数該当（重症度、流行しやすさ、管理可能性）。マルチカントリー発生かつWHOが懸念を表明しており、対象国（DRC、Ghana）が含まれている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではナイジェリア、カメルーン、ブルキナファソでも確認が述べられているが、対象国リストに含まれていない。DRCとGhanaのみ対象国として verified_locations に含める。WHOが2030年までの撲滅戦略（EYE）に対して安全保障上の課題があることを警告しており、予防接種体制が脆弱である点が管理可能性の問題を示唆している。2025年のアンゴラ・コンゴでの発生に続く状況。

article.articleHeadline: T7News | Taubaté confirma 9ª morte por dengue e lidera número de óbitos no Vale do Paraíba
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: T7News | Taubaté confirms 9th dengue death and leads the death toll in the Paraíba Valley.
article.articleSummary: As of June 27, 2026, Taubaté, Brazil, reports its ninth dengue death in 2026, a 66-year-old woman from Jardim América who died June 12; lab confirmation attributed death to dengue. The Vale do Paraíba region now records 14 dengue-related fatalities this year, with Taubaté accounting for the vast majority (9). Jacareí and Tremembé each have two deaths, and São Luiz do Paraitinga one. The region has been in a dengue epidemic since April, with authorities expanding Aedes aegypti control efforts. Earlier cases include an 81-year-old man from Jaraguá (died April 13) and a 64-year-old man from Parque das Flores (died May 16), both with comorbidities. Prevention emphasizes eliminating mosquito breeding sites, especially containers that collect standing water.

triage.headline_ja: タウバテ、デング熱による9番目の死亡を確認、パライーバ渓谷の死亡者数でトップ
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルのパライーバ渓谷地域でデング熱の深刻な流行が継続中であり、死亡者数が増加している（地域内14名、タウバテ9名）。公衆衛生への深刻な影響と異常な状況が認められ、WPROスクリーニング基準の重症度および流行しやすさの基準を満たしている。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域フィールドにはサンパウロ州、パライーバ州、およびジャカレイ、トレメンベなどの市町村が含まれているが、記事の主題はブラジル全体（特にパライーバ渓谷地域）のデング熱流行である。対象国リストに含まれるのはブラジル（3469034）のみ。4月以来の継続的な流行、複数の死亡者、当局による対策実施が報告されており、地域内での人間-蚊-人間サイクルの継続を示唆している。

article.articleHeadline: Cộng hòa Dân chủ Congo mất dấu gần 300 bệnh nhân Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo loses track of nearly 300 Ebola patients.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has entered week 6 since declaration, with 297 patients now untraceable, according to Africa CDC chief Dr. Jean Kaseya, citing The Guardian (June 26). By end of week 5, the DRC reported 1,118 cases and 291 deaths; Uganda had 20 cases and 2 deaths. This is the largest outbreak in five weeks post-declaration, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus. The 2014-2016 West Africa outbreak remains the deadliest, with over 28,000 infections and over 11,000 deaths; that outbreak had 239 cases and 160 deaths by week 5. About 30% of new infections are close contacts, signaling high community transmission. Ebola treatment centers run at 95% bed occupancy and have not yet peaked. Modelling suggests possible spread to South Sudan. Access to refugee camps is hindered by social upheaval and humanitarian crisis, hindering contact tracing.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国がエボラ患者約300人の所在を失う
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準5項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱は極めて高い重症度と死亡率を持つ指定感染症であり、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク、多数の患者追跡喪失による管理可能性の課題が存在する。フルRRAへの進行が必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで主要イベント発生地はDRCであり、297人の患者追跡喪失は重大な公衆衛生上の脅威。ウガンダでの伝播確認、南スーダンへの拡大可能性の言及があるが、サマリー上で実際に確認されているのはDRCとウガンダのみ。ただし対象国リストにウガンダが含まれないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。治療施設の高い占有率（95%）と接触追跡の困難さがリスクを増加させている。

article.articleHeadline: Após casos de sarampo em SP, Saúde recomenda vacinar bebê
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Following measles cases in São Paulo, Health recommends vaccinating the baby.
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreaks prompted vaccination action in São Paulo and Guarulhos. Three cases confirmed in Vila Medeiros, São Paulo: a 1-year-1-month unvaccinated boy (symptoms began June 1), a 7-month-old unvaccinated infant (symptoms began May 29), and a 1-year-1-month girl who was vaccinated and symptomatic June 4. All recovered. Laboratory confirmation used IgM and RT-PCR by Instituto Adolfo Lutz and Fiocruz. Two children attend daycare; the third lives nearby. The Ministry of Health recommended a zero-dose of the MMR vaccine for residents 6–11 months 29 days in São Paulo and Guarulhos to protect infants under 1 year, not replacing routine vaccination. Authorities consider cases imported; local transmission could threaten Brazil’s measles-free status. State vaccination coverage is below target (85.32% first dose, 72.06% second); São Paulo city near 100% for both doses. Measles is airborne with fever, cough, coryza, conjunctivitis, and rash. Canada, the United States, and Mexico are experiencing outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロの麻疹患者発生を受けて、保健当局が乳幼児へのワクチン接種を推奨
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目に該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。ブラジルの麻疹排除状態への脅威と複数国での同時流行により、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル（サンパウロ州・グアルーリョス）での麻疹患者を主題としており、発生地域に列挙されている米国・カナダ・メキシコの流行は背景情報。対象国リストに該当するのはブラジルのみ。ブラジルの麻疹排除状態への脅威、予防接種率の低さ（第1期85.32%、第2期72.06%）、保育施設での接触による局所伝播リスクが懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Fungo transmitido por gatos aparece em 11 animais selvagens e amplia alerta de saúde no Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cat-transmitted fungus detected in 11 wild animals, expanding Brazil's public health alert.
article.articleSummary: DNA of Sporothrix, the fungus causing sporotrichosis, was detected in 11 of 81 road-killed wild animals analyzed in Paraná, Brazil (2017–2023), expanding the known circulation beyond urban areas. Positive cases included birds, a cutia (agouti-like rodent), a false coral snake, a white-eared opossum, an European hare, and a southern wildcat, indicating cross-species presence. While DNA evidence confirms exposure, not all cases imply active infection; histopathology would be needed for confirmation. The finding broadens surveillance at the human–animal–environment interface, where wildlife, domestic animals (notably cats), and people share borders. Urban trends are concerning: Curitiba, in a separate study (2011–May 2022), saw incidence rise from 0.3 to 21.4 cases per 100,000 outpatients, with 58% of cases from 2019–2021. The study advocates One Health sentinel use of roadkill to monitor emerging pathogens.

triage.headline_ja: ネコから感染するキノコが11頭の野生動物から検出され、ブラジルの公衆衛生警戒態勢が拡大
triage.triage_reason: スポロトリコーシスは既知の感染症であり、本事象は主に野生動物への病原体循環の拡大を示唆しているが、人間への臨床的影響の急速な増加（Curitiba市での発症率上昇）と複数種への曝露の可能性から注視が必要。ただし国際的拡大リスクやIHR基準の複数該当が明確でないため、情報の発展を待つべき。
triage.notes: 記事の主要な懸念はParanáとCuritiba地域における野生動物でのSporothrix DNA検出の拡大と、都市部（Curitiba）での人間への発症率上昇（2011-2022年に0.3から21.4/10万へ増加）である。ただし野生動物からのDNA検出は必ずしも活動的感染を意味せず、Brazilは対象国リストに含まれるが、WPROスクリーニング基準の3項目該当により WATCH判定とした。引き続き人間への臨床症例増加の推移と、人-動物-環境インターフェースでの監視体制を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: பெரம்பலூரில் நாளை 387 மையங்களில் போலியோ சொட்டு மருந்து முகாம்
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Polio drops vaccination camps at 387 centers in Perambalur tomorrow.
article.articleSummary: Polio vaccination camps are to be held tomorrow across Perambalur district, Tamil Nadu, at 387 centers. The facilities include 27 urban pockets and 360 rural sites, spanning primary health centers, sub-health centers, schools, and nutrition centers. Four mobile medical teams will administer the oral polio vaccine (OPV) at additional locations such as bus stands, border checkpoints, and other public gathering spots. Special centers have been established to reach children of migrant workers who have moved from other districts and states. The drive aims for comprehensive coverage of both resident and migrant children, emphasizing administration of polio drops to prevent poliomyelitis and leveraging accessible locations to maximize immunization reach.

triage.headline_ja: ペラムバルール地区のポリオ予防接種キャンプ：387ヶ所でのポリオドロップ接種
triage.triage_reason: これはポリオワクチン予防接種キャンプの定期的な実施告知であり、ポリオの発生や感染症危機を示すシグナルではない。公衆衛生上の懸念、異常性、国際的リスク、管理上の課題は認められない。
triage.notes: 本記事は予防接種キャンプの計画告知であり、ポリオの発生報告ではない。定期的な予防衛生活動の実施情報のため、シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: கரூா் மாவட்டத்தில் ஜூலை 1 முதல் கோமாரி நோய் தடுப்பூசி முகாம்
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Gomari Disease Vaccination Camp in Karur District from July 1.
article.articleSummary: Gomari disease vaccination drive in Karur district, Tamil Nadu, India, will run free of charge for all cattle and buffaloes from July 1–31, 2026, under the National Livestock Disease Control Programme. Organized by the Department of Animal Husbandry and the Milk Producers’ Cooperative Federation, this marks the 9th round of Gomari disease vaccination. Cattle and buffaloes not covered in the initial window can receive the vaccine from August 1–10, 2026. The camp focuses on preventive immunization to protect livestock, with no case counts, deaths, or laboratory-confirmation details provided in the article. This initiative aims to safeguard dairy production in Karur district through widescale vaccination.

triage.headline_ja: カルール地区における2026年7月1日からのゴマリ病予防接種キャンプ
triage.triage_reason: 本イベントは動物疾病の定期予防接種キャンプであり、人獣共通感染症の人間への急性発生ではない。IHR基準・WPROスクリーニング基準ともに該当せず、公衆衛生危機の要素がない。
triage.notes: 本記事は動物疾病（ゴマリ病）の定期的な予防接種キャンプに関するもの。患者数、重症例、死亡報告はなく、感染症の急性発生ではなく予防的な公衆衛生対応である。シグナルトリアージの対象外と判定。

article.articleHeadline: エボラ熱の警戒最高水準に 米ＣＤＣが引き上げ｜全国のニュース｜Web東奥
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: U.S. CDC raises Ebola alert to the highest level
article.articleSummary: On June 26, 2026, the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention raised the Ebola virus disease alert for eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo to the highest level (Level 1), prioritizing frontline health workers and resources and initiating a 24/7 response. The elevated status signals intensified readiness and mobilization in the face of the ongoing outbreak in the region. The Level 1 designation has been used during major past outbreaks, notably the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic that killed more than 11,000 people. In the current Congo outbreak, authorities report over 1,200 infections and more than 320 deaths. The move underscores the severity of the situation in eastern Congo and the need for rapid case management, surveillance, and international support.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱の警戒最高水準に 米ＣＤＣが引き上げ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準において深刻な公衆衛生影響（1,200感染、320死亡）、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクが明確。WPROスクリーニングでも重症度・管理可能性基準に該当し、米CDCによる最高警戒引き上げという国際的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの主題はコンゴ民主共和国での進行中のエボラ流行に関する米CDCの警戒引き上げ。米国は政策決定者として記載されているが、実際の感染症イベント発生地ではないため除外。アンゴラも発生地域リストに含まれるが、サマリーに明記されていないため除外。対象国リストの中ではDRCのみが該当。

article.articleHeadline: Surto de ebola passa de 300 mortes no Congo e chega à França
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak surpasses 300 deaths in Congo and reaches France.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo surpasses 300 deaths, with AFP reporting 1,115 infections and 304 deaths (later Reuters updates cite 1,203 cases and 321 deaths). The epicenter is Ituri province in northeast DRC near the South Sudan and Uganda borders, with Bunia city containing about 91.3% of cases and 82.2% of deaths. Transmission is complicated by mining-driven population movement and armed groups, hindering contact tracing, isolation, and access to care. The virus has spread to two other Congolese provinces and Uganda; on June 24 France detected a case in a Congolese doctor who worked for NGO Alima and had been at the epicenter before traveling to Paris. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo strain. WHO notes progress in vaccines and treatments but logistics, security, and access barriers persist. Ebola spreads via bodily fluids and contaminated surfaces; African deaths exceed 15,000 in 50 years. WHO issued an international alert due to cross-border risk and control challenges. The crisis is among the world’s gravest currently.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ熱アウトブレイク、死者が300人を超え、フランスに到達
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全てに該当。エボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイク（300以上の死亡、1000以上の感染）で、国境を越えた感染例（フランスでの検出）、複数国への拡大リスク、WHO国際警報発出により、フルRRAが必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、実際の感染症イベントの発生地はDRCが主要地（Ituri州、Bunia市）であることが明確。ウガンダでの2次症例言及および南スーダン・ウガンダ国境での拡大リスク記載あるが、これらの国での確定症例記載なし。フランスでの症例は輸入例（DRC由来の医療従事者）であり、フランスは発生地域ではなく「到達地」。対象国リストにはDRCのみが含まれるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 看好文：顾名思医｜骨痛热症逾3万宗病例 别以为是普通感冒 | 中國報 China Press
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Recommended Article: Gu Ming Si Yi | Dengue Fever Cases Over 30,000 — Don’t Think It’s Just a Common Cold | China Press
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever cases in Malaysia reached 33,367 as of June 13, 2026, up 20.7% year-on-year, ranking Malaysia as the third-highest dengue burden in ASEAN behind Indonesia and Vietnam. The report emphasizes that dengue in Malaysia and across Southeast Asia is widely known yet seriously underestimated, with many treating it as a common cold or assuming fever will resolve in a few days. It warns that dengue can rapidly progress from initial fever to plasma leakage, organ failure, and death, echoed by the headline question: ‘From fever to shock in 24 hours?’ The piece highlights ongoing concerns about dengue outbreaks in the region and urges public awareness of the disease’s potential severity beyond mild symptoms, underscoring the need for vigilance and timely medical evaluation.

triage.headline_ja: 推奨記事：顾名思医｜デング熱症例が3万件超—普通の風邪だと思うな
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で「異常/予想外」「国際的拡大リスク」の2基準に該当。ASEAN地域での大規模なデング熱流行の報告であり、複数国での同時多発的増加が確認されている。
triage.notes: マレーシアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。記事サマリーより、インドネシアとベトナムがASEAN内でのデング熱負担が最も高い国として言及されている。2026年6月27日配信の比較的新しい情報。ASEAN地域全体での流行状況の警告報道であり、フルRRA実施の優先度は高い。

article.articleHeadline: Tin tức thế giới 27-6: Số người chết ở Venezuela lên gần 1.000; Mỹ nâng mức đối phó Ebola lên cao nhất
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World News June 27: Death toll in Venezuela rises to nearly 1,000; U.S. raises Ebola alert level to the highest.
article.articleSummary: Venezuela’s 24 June double earthquake leaves at least 920 dead, 3,300+ injured, and 172 trapped, with direct damages projected at up to USD 6.7 billion and nearly 7 million affected. International search‑and‑rescue teams arrive, including US and Swiss teams, plus teams from Chile, Mexico. Oil production remains about 1.2 million barrels per day. Crimea’s energy crisis eases as Sevastopol reports most outages resolved; residents urged to conserve electricity amid fuel shortages and Ukrainian strikes, with some areas on backup power and transport restrictions. CDC raises Ebola alert to Level 1 for the Congo outbreak; US risk remains low, with 19 staff deployed and USD 107 million in emergency funding. WHO reports Bundibugyo Ebola: over 1,200 cases and 321 deaths in DRC, plus 20 cases in Uganda. Trump threatens 100% tariffs on any country taxing digital services; EU and France push back. US approves Anthropic Claude Mythos 5 access for partners.

triage.headline_ja: 世界ニュース6月27日：ベネズエラの死者数が約1,000人に上昇；米国がエボラ警戒レベルを最高に引き上げ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目中3項目該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。DRCおよびウガンダでのブンディブギョエボラの確認と、米国がLevel 1警戒を発令した事実は、国際的な公衆衛生上の関心事。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域フィールドに多数の国が列挙されているが、記事サマリーの詳細分析により、実際のエボラウイルス病イベントが確認されているのはDRC（1,200以上の症例、321死亡）およびウガンダ（20症例）。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。ベネズエラの地震はエボラとは別イベントであり、見出しに「Ebola alert level」との並記があるが、実質的なエボラ発生地はDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: ارتفاع إصابات "إيبولا" في الكونغو إلى 1203 حالات والسلطات تشدد إجراءات الاحتواء
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo rise to 1,203 as authorities tighten containment measures.
article.articleSummary: Kinshasa — As of June 27, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo has 1,203 confirmed Ebola virus disease cases and 321 deaths. The outbreak, first publicly declared in mid-May, is caused by the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola, for which no licensed vaccine or specific effective treatment exists. In a bid to contain spread, authorities tightened containment measures and imposed travel restrictions on returnees from affected areas, according to the Ministry of Communications and Media. The report underscores ongoing efforts to strengthen surveillance, isolation of cases, and contact tracing, while public health messaging is amplified to reduce transmission. Health authorities are coordinating with partners to monitor borders and reinforce case management.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ患者数が1,203例に増加し、当局は封じ込め対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響：321人の死亡、確認症例1,203例；異常性：新規アウトブレイク；国際拡大リスク：隣接国への拡大懸念；渡航制限実施）。WPRO基準5つすべてに該当。国際的な支援・監視が必要な状況。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は最重症レベルの感染症。Bundibugyo株であり、ワクチンや特異的治療法が存在しない。死亡率26.8%（321/1,203）。キンシャサはコンゴ民主共和国の首都であり、商業・輸送の中枢。周辺国への拡大リスクが顕著。WHO、国際支援機関による対応が必須。

article.articleHeadline: ارتفاع إصابات إيبولا في الكونغو إلى 1203 حالات والسلطات تشدد إجراءات الاحتواء - أردو بوینت
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola infections in the Congo rise to 1,203 cases as authorities tighten containment measures - Urdu Point
article.articleSummary: Ebola infections in the Democratic Republic of the Congo have risen to 1,203 confirmed cases with 321 deaths, according to government data released on Friday, June 27, 2026. To curb spread, authorities tightened containment measures, including travel restrictions for people returning from affected areas, the Ministry of Communications and Information said. The outbreak, first announced in mid-May 2026, is linked to the Bundibugyo ebolavirus lineage, for which there is no licensed vaccine or specific, widely available treatment. The report underscores ongoing transmission and the public health response in the DRC, with authorities enforcing movement controls and other containment steps as part of efforts to limit further cases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱感染者が1,203例に増加、当局が封じ込め措置を強化
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の確定症例1,203例および321人の死亡が報告されており、IHR基準（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常/予想外性、国際的拡大リスク）を複数満たす。WPROスクリーニングでも重症度、流行しやすさ、管理可能性が該当し、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年6月27日のDRC政府発表に基づく。Bundibugyo ebolavirus系統はワクチンやアクセス可能な特異的治療がなく、継続的な感染と対策が報告されている。旅行制限を含む複数の封じ込め措置が講じられている。

article.articleHeadline: Boletim da Secretaria de Saúde aponta que cidade tem 151 casos de dengue confirmados
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health Department bulletin indicates that the city has 151 confirmed dengue cases.
article.articleSummary: Uberaba, Minas Gerais, Brazil, reports 151 confirmed dengue cases, 5,933 notifications, and zero deaths; two dengue cases are under investigation (as of 2026-06-26). Chikungunya shows 235 probable cases in Uberaba, with one death confirmed and one under investigation; no Zika cases in the city. Among confirmed dengue cases, 54% are female and 56% male; the largest age group is 20–29, and 53.5% are pardo (mixed race). In the same period last year, there were 20,408 dengue symptoms, 3,370 confirmed, and 15 deaths; 2025 ended with 25,012 dengue notifications, 5,358 confirmed, and 19 deaths. In Minas Gerais state, 64,304 dengue probable cases, 36,517 confirmed, 39 deaths under investigation, and 32 confirmed dengue deaths. For chikungunya in the state: 13,894 probable, 10,634 confirmed, 5 under investigation, 3 confirmed. Zika: 35 probable, 9 confirmed, no deaths.

triage.headline_ja: 保健局通知によると、市内に151件のデング熱確診例がある
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルにおけるデング熱、チクングニア、ジカの同時流行報告。地域的には確定症例が相当数存在し、チクングニアでは死亡例も確認されている。WPRO基準の重症度・流行易易性に該当し、社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: ウベラバ市（ミナスジェライス州）でデング熱151確診例、チクングニア235疑似例（死亡1件確認）が報告されている。ミナス・ジェライス州全体ではデング熱36,517確診例、32例の死亡が確認されており、重要な公衆衛生上の懸念。記事タイトルはデング熱に焦点を当てているが、複数の蚊媒介ウイルスが流行中である。

article.articleHeadline: தமிழகம் முழுவதும் நாளை போலியோ சொட்டுமருந்து முகாம்: 52.91 லட்சம் குழந்தைகளுக்கு இலவச தடுப்பு மருந்து
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Polio drops vaccination drive across Tamil Nadu tomorrow: Free vaccine for 52.91 lakh children.
article.articleSummary: Tamil Nadu will host the annual National Polio Vaccination Campaign tomorrow, offering free oral polio vaccine (OPV) drops to about 52.91 lakh children under five. The drive, part of India’s polio-eradication efforts, is scheduled for Sunday, 28 June 2026, across 43,051 OPV centres statewide. Centers include government PHCs and hospitals, Anganwadi centres, schools, transport hubs (bus stands, railway stations, airports), checkposts, screening posts, and other crowded locations. Mobile teams will reach remote hill and rural areas, delivering OPV door-to-door where access is difficult. The campaign underscores India’s polio-free status, with parents urged to bring their five-year-old children to nearby centres. In Chennai, the Pallavakkam Adi Dravidar Nal Higher Secondary School premises will host the event, inaugurated by Chief Minister Vijay, while Municipal Commissioner G.S. Sameeran is supervising arrangements and issuing guidance to officials.

triage.headline_ja: タミルナドゥ州全域で明日ポリオワクチン接種キャンペーン：529.1万人の子どもたちに無料予防接種
triage.triage_reason: これはポリオ根絶を目的とした計画的な定期予防接種キャンペーンであり、新規疾患イベント（感染症の発生）ではない。IHRスクリーニング基準に該当せず、社会的懸念も低い。
triage.notes: 記事は感染症イベント（疾患の発生・流行）ではなく、インド政府が実施するポリオ根絶の公式ワクチン接種キャンペーンである。このキャンペーンはインドがポリオ非流行国として継続する定期的な予防接種活動であり、EBSのシグナル検出の対象外である。

article.articleHeadline: ಮಳೆಗಾಲದಲ್ಲಿ ಕಾಡುವ ಮಾರಕ ಕಾಯಿಲೆಗಳು: ಸುರಕ್ಷತೆಗೆ ಇಲ್ಲಿವೆ ಸಲಹೆ!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Deadly diseases that spread during the monsoon: Here are safety tips!
article.articleSummary: June 27, 2026 — In Delhi, health authorities warn monsoon season elevates transmission of dengue, malaria, chikungunya, typhoid, and cholera. WHO cautions that rain and humidity boost mosquito-borne and waterborne diseases, necessitating early precautions. Dengue and chikungunya spread by Aedes aegypti mosquitoes breeding in standing water; malaria by Anopheles in outdoor rainwater. Typhoid and cholera transmit via contaminated food and water, with cholera caused by Vibrio cholerae; rainfall accelerates contamination. Symptoms include fever and severe joint pain for chikungunya; bleeding or shock in dengue; anemia and organ dysfunction in malaria; and gastroenteritis in typhoid/cholera. Urban areas with stagnant water face highest risk. The piece urges rapid symptom recognition, timely treatment, and preventing water stagnation and consuming safe-food/water.

triage.headline_ja: モンスーン時期に蔓延する致命的な疾病：安全対策のアドバイス
triage.triage_reason: 複数の水媒介性・媒介動物感染症の同時警告であり、スクリーニング基準複数に該当するが、具体的な新規発生事例や患者数が記載されておらず、教育的・予防警告的な性質が強いため。
triage.notes: 記事はデリーの保健当局による季節性疾病警告であり、確実な新規アウトブレイク報告ではなく予防啓発的な内容。スクリーニング基準では「長期曝露」（モンスーン季の継続的曝露）と「流行しやすさ」（蚊媒介・水媒介性、都市部での好適環境）に該当するが、具体的な患者数、死亡数、拡大の急速性に関する情報が欠落している。続報で実際の症例増加が報告された場合はPICKUPに昇格させるべき。

article.articleHeadline: ارتفاع إصابات "إيبولا" في الكونغو إلى 1203 حالات
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola cases in Congo rise to 1,203.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has risen to 1,203 confirmed cases and 321 deaths, according to government data released Friday. To curb transmission, authorities tightened public health measures and imposed travel restrictions on travelers returning from affected areas, the Ministry of Communications and Information said. The outbreak, first announced in mid-May, is linked to the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain, for which there is currently no licensed vaccine or specific treatment. Health officials continue surveillance, testing, and case isolation as part of containment, while urging communities to report suspected cases. The evolving situation underscores the absence of a strain-specific vaccine and reliance on non-pharmaceutical interventions to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の患者数がコンゴで1,203人に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病は深刻な公衆衛生影響を持ち、予想外の発生、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限の実施が確認されている。ワクチン未開発の株による大規模致死的アウトブレイクはシグナルとして優先度が高い。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus株による大規模アウトブレイク。既存ワクチン無効な株であり、ケース数1,203件、死亡321件と高い致死率を示す。当該株に対するワクチンが存在しないため、公衆衛生上の重大な懸念事項。国際的な支援と協調が必要な状況。

article.articleHeadline: Un hongo en gatos pone en alerta a Sudamérica
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A fungus in cats puts South America on alert.
article.articleSummary: Sporothrix brasiliensis, a fungal pathogen in the Sporothrix genus, is the most aggressive cause of sporotrichosis and shows efficient mammal-to-mammal transmission, especially among cats. Originating in Brazil in the 1990s, it now affects multiple South American countries; Brazil accounts for the majority of cases, with over 11,000 human infections reported in the last decade, per WHO. Cats develop ulcers, cutaneous nodules, lymphadenopathy, and facial/paw lesions; stray cats facilitate wide environmental dissemination through bites, scratches, and contact with contaminated secretions. Humans acquire infection mainly via scratches, bites, or contact with lesion secretions; initial lesion appears 1–12 weeks after exposure, then sporotrichoid lymphatic spread. Skin and subcutaneous tissue are most affected, but joints, lungs, and CNS can be involved. Immunocompromised individuals may develop severe disease, including meningitis or pneumonia. At ASM Microbe, CDC’s Shawn Lockhart warned introduction to the United States is imminent, signaling regional spread to Chile, Uruguay, Paraguay, and Argentina.

triage.headline_ja: 猫にいるカビが南米に警戒を促す
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。南米での急速な地理的拡大、ヒト感染数千件以上の報告、免疫低下患者の重症化リスク、および米国への侵入が差し迫っているとの警告があり、フルRRAに進める必要がある。
triage.notes: Sporothrix brasiliensisは1990年代にブラジルで出現し、過去10年間でブラジルのみで11,000人以上の感染者を報告。チリ、ウルグアイ、パラグアイ、アルゼンチンへの地域的拡大が確認されており、米国への侵入が差し迫っているとCDCが警告。対象国リストではブラジルのみが該当。記事は南米全域の拡大を論じているが、具体的な他国の患者数据据を含まない。哺乳動物間（特に猫）での効率的な感染伝播と人獣共通感染症の特性が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: As recoveries rise, doctors are finally learning how Bundibugyo Ebola behaves
article.articleSummary: DR Congo’s Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak—the largest on record for this rare strain—has recoveries up to 148 as of June 26, 2026, from 80 on June 18, with dozens still hospitalized. Bundibugyo previously caused only 193 confirmed cases total and tended toward lower fatality than Zaire or Sudan Ebola; outcomes remain uncertain. A NEJM study of the first 505 lab-confirmed patients describes fever, vomiting, diarrhea, headache, abdominal pain and loss of appetite, with bleeding uncommon early; deaths correlated with higher viral loads. The outbreak is six times larger than prior Bundibugyo totals. A Ugandan case illustrates surveillance gaps: the patient sought care at multiple facilities for more than two weeks before Bundibugyo recognition after death. Lab and animal data suggest slower replication than Zaire, and trials of remdesivir and MBP134 monoclonal antibody therapy are planned. Children (~15% of cases) account for >25% of deaths, with under-18 fatality nearly twice that of adults.

triage.headline_ja: 回復者数が増加する中、医師たちはついにブンディブギョエボラの振る舞いを学び始めている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、国際的拡大リスク、異常性）。ブンディブギョエボラの過去最大規模の流行であり、DRC・ウガンダにおける確認された複数患者と死亡事例により、WPRO基準も複数項目で該当。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（Republic of Uganda）は発生地域に記載されているが、記事サマリーでは過去のケース事例の言及に留まり、同国での現在の流行の詳細な報告はない。verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。本イベントはブンディブギョエボラの過去最大規模（前例の6倍規模）の流行であり、NEJM研究による臨床特性の解明、治療薬トライアル計画、および小児での高い致命率（成人の約2倍）が報告されている点で公衆衛生上の重要性は高い。

article.articleHeadline: Profissionais de saúde de Jaru recebem capacitação sobre malária
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health professionals from Jaru receive malaria training.
article.articleSummary: On Thursday, June 25, 2026, health professionals in Jaru's municipal health network participated in a training titled 'Updates in Malaria Treatment' held at the OAB - Jaru Subsection auditorium. The session gathered physicians, nurses, community health workers, and vector-control agents working in primary care. Promoted by the State Health Surveillance Agency (Agevisa) in partnership with the Jaru City Hall and the Municipal Health Secretariat (Semusa), the training updated protocols for malaria treatment, clarified medication choices, and aligned field practices with current guidelines. Municipal Health Secretary Jaíne Barboza underscored continued professional qualification as essential to improving service quality and ensuring care follows contemporary technical standards. The program reinforces the role of primary care teams in rapid malaria diagnosis and appropriate treatment to prevent complications, and the city said it will continue investing in staff development to strengthen the health system's response to malaria cases.

triage.headline_ja: ジャル市の保健専門家がマラリア治療研修を受講
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はマラリア対策のための定期的な医療専門家向け研修実施の報道であり、感染症の新規発生・異常事態・重症化の報告ではない。トレーニング実施は通常の公衆衛生活動であり、シグナル基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれない（対象国はZambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, Indiaのみ）。記事内容は能力強化の研修実施であり、感染症イベント（患者発生、アウトブレイク、異常疫学）ではない。

article.articleHeadline: برنامج الأغذية العالمي يحذر من تفاقم أزمة "إيبولا" في الكونغو ويدعو لتمويل عاجل
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Food Programme warns of worsening Ebola crisis in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and calls for urgent funding.
article.articleSummary: World Food Programme warns that containing the Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo requires stronger food security and sustained humanitarian access. About 26.5 million people are in acute food insecurity, hampering outbreak response. The WFP seeks $358 million to fund Ebola control measures and provide food assistance, urging the international community to deliver urgent support to prevent further deterioration of humanitarian and health conditions. As of June 27, 2026, the report does not provide Ebola case or death counts. It emphasizes the link between hunger and outbreak response and calls for enhanced security to ensure aid reaches affected areas and supports containment efforts.

triage.headline_ja: 国連世界食糧計画、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ危機の悪化を警告し緊急資金を要請
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスは高い公衆衛生影響を持ち、深刻な人道危機と結びついている。国際的関心と資金支援の必要性が明確であり、複数のIHR基準およびスクリーニング基準に該当する。
triage.notes: エボラ発生は既知の脅威だが、報告日時が2026年6月であり、具体的な症例数・死亡数が不明な点に注意。ただし、食糧不安(2,650万人)と人道危機が制御困難化を示唆しており、国際支援の必要性が強調されている。WFPの3億5,800万ドル資金要請は国際的な関心の高さを反映している。

article.articleHeadline: برنامج الأغذية العالمي يحذر من تفاقم أزمة إيبولا في الكونغو ويدعو لتمويل عاجل - أردو بوینت
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Food Programme warns of a worsening Ebola crisis in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and calls for urgent funding - Urdu Point
article.articleSummary: As of June 27, 2026, the World Food Programme warns that containing the Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo requires strengthened food security and uninterrupted humanitarian access to affected areas. WFP notes about 26.5 million people are affected by severe food insecurity, complicating outbreak response efforts and risking further health deterioration. The agency is seeking $358 million to finance Ebola control activities and to sustain life-saving food assistance, with a call for urgent international support to prevent a deeper humanitarian crisis and to ensure aid and health supplies reach the most affected communities. No Ebola case or death counts are cited in the report.

triage.headline_ja: 世界食糧計画がコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ危機の悪化を警告し、緊急資金を要請
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）、かつWPRO基準で複数該当。エボラウイルス病は最高リスク病原体であり、進行中の人道危機と国際的支援要請がある。
triage.notes: エボラは最高リスク病原体。記事では具体的な症例数・死亡数は報告されていないが、WFPによる緊急資金要請（3億5,800万ドル）と2,650万人の食糧不安の言及から、相当規模の人道危機が進行中と判断される。東部DRCでの流行継続と国際的な支援体制の脆弱性が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya set to benefit as Gavi speeds up Ebola vaccine search
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebolavirus disease outbreaks in eastern DRC and Uganda prompt Kenya to benefit from accelerated vaccine development. As of now, at least 1,094 Ebola cases have been confirmed and 277 deaths in eastern DRC, with some victims children. No vaccine exists for Bundibugyo; a global stockpile covers Ebola Zaire. UNICEF and Gavi launched a Call for Expression of Interest to fast-track vaccine development and production, supported by up to $50 million from Gavi’s First Response Fund (including up to $40 million for vaccine access). Special priority will go to Africa-based manufacturing. Kenya has not recorded Ebola cases but activated its national Ebola Incident Management System on May 20, with enhanced border screening (over 140,000 travellers), surveillance, expanded lab capacity, isolation facilities, PPE stockpiles, and public awareness efforts. The initiative aims to identify promising vaccine candidates and enable rapid access to doses when available.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア、Gavi がエボラワクチン開発を加速するにつれて恩恵を受ける見込み
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外、国際的拡大リスク）、WPRO基準で複数該当（重症度、流行しやすさ、管理可能性）。東部DRCとウガンダでのブンディブギョエボラウイルス発生による確認症例1,094例・死亡277例は著しく、ケニアの国境管理とワクチン開発急速化は国際的な懸念を示す。
triage.notes: ケニアは確認症例がないが、国境スクリーニング強化（14万人以上）と国家エボラインシデント管理システムの発動により、地域的な懸念が高い。DRCとウガンダで確認されているブンディブギョエボラウイルスは既存ワクチンで対応不可能であり、緊急ワクチン開発が推進されている。対象国リストではDRC、ウガンダのみが該当。

article.articleHeadline: Phòng ngừa viêm não Nhật Bản - Bệnh truyền nhiễm nguy hiểm hàng đầu ở trẻ em
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Preventing Japanese encephalitis - one of the most dangerous infectious diseases in children.
article.articleSummary: Vietnam reports a fatal Japanese encephalitis (JE) case in Thanh Hóa Province: a 14-year-old girl presented with high fever, headache, nausea and fatigue, then developed slurred speech, impaired consciousness and increased muscle tone. Despite aggressive care, mechanical ventilation and vasopressors, she died; JE laboratory testing confirmed infection. She had not been vaccinated against JE. JE is a mosquito-borne disease that often presents like influenza early, followed by central nervous system involvement, and is a leading pediatric infection with high mortality and frequent long-term neurological sequelae. Globally, JE causes about 67,900 cases annually, with mortality up to 30% and long-term neurologic or cognitive impairments in many survivors. The WHO notes roughly 3 billion people live in at-risk areas across 24 Asian countries, including about 700 million under 15. In Vietnam, officials urge complete vaccination, mosquito-bite prevention (May–September), and strengthened preventive health measures and vaccination programs under Resolution 72-NQ/TW (Sept 2025).

triage.headline_ja: 日本脳炎の予防 - 小児における最も危険な感染症の一つ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク）、WPRO基準4つ該当（重症度・高死亡率、長期曝露・蚊媒介性、流行しやすさ、管理可能性）。ベトナムでの致死的JE症例と国家的予防対策の強化が報告されており、フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: ベトナムの14歳少女による日本脳炎致死例が報道され、WHO推定では年約67,900症例・死亡率30%、アジア24カ国30億人が高リスク地域に在住。ベトナム政府がResolution 72-NQ/TW（2025年9月）に基づき予防措置・ワクチン接種プログラムを強化中。インフルエンザとの共変動も記事で言及されている。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo: Ebola death toll surpasses 300 as outbreak worsens - Blueprint Newspapers Limited
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Ebola outbreak has 304 deaths and 1,155 confirmed infections since its May 15 declaration, a 26.3% case-fatality rate. The Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccine or specific treatment, so containment relies on surveillance, isolation, contact tracing and infection prevention. This is the 17th Ebola outbreak in DRC, principally in Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu; Ituri accounts for over 91% of cases and over 82% of deaths, Bunia being the provincial capital. At least 78 health workers are infected, 18 dead; shortages of PPE and chlorine and near-capacity treatment centers hinder response. Community mistrust and traditional burial practices risk undercounting infections. Uganda reports 20 cases (2 deaths) linked to cross-border movement; France confirms an imported case in a Congolese doctor with ALIMA. No travel restrictions; Air France suspended Kinshasa flights.

triage.headline_ja: DR Congo: Ebola death toll surpasses 300 as outbreak worsens - Blueprint Newspapers Limited
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予期しない発生、国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダ・フランス）、渡航制限実施）。WPROスクリーニング基準も全て該当。エボラウイルス病は最高リスク疾患。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo株）は最優先対象疾患。死亡数304名、確定感染者1,155名、CFR 26.3%。複数州で発生（Ituri地域が91%の症例を占める）。隣国ウガンダへの越境感染20例、フランスへの輸入症例1例確認。医療従事者78名感染（18名死亡）、PPE不足、コミュニティ不信など対応課題多数。フランス企業による航空路運休など経済的影響も発生。

article.articleHeadline: エボラ熱の警戒最高水準に　コンゴ東部で拡大　米CDCが引き上げ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola at the highest alert level as the outbreak expands in eastern Congo; U.S. CDC raises its alert.
article.articleSummary: As of June 27, 2026, the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) raised the Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo to Level 1, the highest of a three-tier alert system, directing prioritized deployment of healthcare workers and resources with around‑the‑clock response. The escalation aligns with expanding transmission, and Level 1 has been used in major outbreaks, including the 2014–2016 West Africa Ebola epidemic that killed more than 11,000. Reuters reports Congo’s current outbreak has more than 1,200 infections and over 320 deaths. The move signals intensified public health attention and ongoing containment and surveillance efforts in the affected region.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱の警戒最高水準に　コンゴ東部で拡大　米CDCが引き上げ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも5つ全て該当。エボラ出血熱は深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、国際的な対応が必要とされている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴ東部でのエボラ拡大とUSA CDCの警戒レベル引き上げが主題。1,200人以上の感染者と320人以上の死亡者が報告されており、過去の2014-2016年西アフリカエボラ流行との比較も記載。米国はBluedot APIの発生地域に含まれているが、記事サマリーでは米国内での発生は報告されていないため、verified_locationsから除外。アンゴラについても発生地域リストに含まれているが、記事サマリーで言及されていないため除外。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。

article.articleHeadline: Goleiro do Fluminense, Vitor Eudes é internado por infecção grave
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fluminense's goalkeeper Vitor Eudes is hospitalized for a serious infection.
article.articleSummary: Fluminense, a Rio de Janeiro, Brazil club, reports reserve goalkeeper Vitor Eudes, 27, hospitalized with viral meningoencephalitis—a non-contagious inflammation of the meninges and brain tissue. He remains in hospital at CT Carlos Castilho with a stable clinical course as doctors conduct tests to identify the causative virus; typical agents include dengue, Zika, or influenza. Symptoms include high fever, malaise, and severe muscle pains, prompting absolute rest for weeks. Eudes had rejoined the squad after 22 days of collective vacation, trained through June 24, then developed symptoms and was withdrawn from daily activities. He joined Fluminense in December 2022 (formerly with Cruzeiro and Portugal’s Marítimo) and has 13 official appearances, including 2 in the 2026 season; contract through December 2027. The club has publicly supported him, while younger goalkeepers may receive more opportunities during his absence.

triage.headline_ja: フルミネンセのゴールキーパー、ヴィトル・ウエデスが重度感染症で入院
triage.triage_reason: 個人の医療事例（競技選手1名の入院）であり、公衆衛生上の集団発生イベントではない。感染症の種類は疑い段階で確定していない。
triage.notes: 本記事はスポーツクラブの選手個人の入院事例に関する情報であり、感染症の集団発生や公衆衛生上の懸念を示さない。ウイルス性髄膜脳炎の原因病原体は検査中であり、診断が確定していない。個々の重症患者事例は通常、シグナルとして識別されない。

article.articleHeadline: Amid shortage of rabies vaccine in Delhi, 1.27L vials undelivered, government agency told
article.articleSummary: Rabies vaccine shortage plagues Delhi’s government hospitals as Serum Institute of India reports 1,27,223 vials prepared under a DGHS supply order (March 27) remain undelivered due to the Central Warehouse at Janakpuri Super Speciality Hospital lacking cold storage. The institute asked the CPA to identify an alternate delivery point and granted a 20-day extension to complete delivery. Rabies vaccine is crucial for post-exposure prophylaxis and requires strict cold-chain storage. In January, Delhi declared human rabies notifiable under the Epidemic Diseases Act to strengthen surveillance and response to dog-mediated rabies. Delhi’s exposure risk is underscored by dog-bite data: 51,773 cases in 2023 and 44,995 by August 2025. The delay intensifies concerns about vaccine availability in public facilities.

triage.headline_ja: デリー州でのワクチン不足の中、狂犬病ワクチン127万本が未配送、政府機関に指示
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病ワクチンの供給チェーン問題は公衆衛生上の懸念があるが、実際の患者発生や病気の蔓延ではなく、ワクチン配送遅延が主要問題。IHR基準の該当数が少なく情報不足のため、引き続き動向を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事の主要な懸念はワクチン配送遅延であり、実際の狂犬病患者の発生拡大ではない。犬咬傷による曝露リスクは存在（2023年：51,773件、2025年8月までに44,995件）し、ワクチン不足が長期的な公衆衛生リスクを構成する。デリー州が2026年1月に狂犬病を通知対象疾患に指定した点も考慮すると、監視体制の強化と並行した供給チェーン問題のため情報収集継続が必要。

article.articleHeadline: república democrática del congo reporta más de 300 muertos por ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo reports more than 300 deaths from Ebola
article.articleSummary: DR Congo reports 304 Ebola deaths among 1,155 confirmed cases as of June 24, 2026, with a 26.3% case fatality rate. Of the patients, 138 have recovered; 326 are in isolation or hospitalized; contact tracing stands at 79.2%. A 90-day cross-border plan with Uganda aims to boost laboratories and healthcare capacity. The outbreak began May 15 in Ituri, on the Uganda and South Sudan border, and has spread to North and South Kivu. Uganda confirms 20 cases (15 imported from DRC) and two deaths. France also reports its first Ebola case in a medical worker who returned from the DRC. The virus is Bundibugyo, with a 30–50% fatality rate and no approved vaccine or specific treatment. WHO has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern; transmission is via direct contact with bodily fluids, causing fever, vomiting, diarrhea, and bleeding.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国がエボラで300人以上の死亡を報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、エボラウイルス病の国際的な拡大（ウガンダ、フランスでも確認）、WHO による国際的公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言がされている重大事象であり、フルRRAが必須。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo種、CFR 30-50%）の大規模多国籍アウトブレイク。DRコンゴ（304死亡、1,155確認例）からウガンダ（20例、2死亡）へ拡大、さらにフランスで医療従事者の輸入症例1例。WHO PHEIC宣言済み。cross-border plan（DRC-Uganda）実施中。国際感染症危機管理上の最高優先度。

article.articleHeadline: Alembic gets USFDA nod for influenza drug
article.articleSummary: On 2026-06-27, Alembic Pharmaceuticals Ltd, New Delhi, said it has received final US FDA approval for its generic oseltamivir phosphate for oral suspension, 6 mg/ml, indicated for the treatment of influenza. The approval, granted via the Abbreviated New Drug Application (ANDA), confirms the product is therapeutically equivalent to the reference listed drug Tamiflu oral suspension, 6 mg/ml, from Hoffmann-La Roche, Inc. This clearance enables Alembic to market a US-approved generic oseltamivir phosphate for oral suspension in the United States, providing a therapeutically equivalent alternative to Tamiflu for influenza treatment.

triage.headline_ja: アレンビックがインフルエンザ薬でUSFDA承認を取得
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は医薬品承認ニュースであり、インフルエンザの感染症クラスター・アウトブレイク・公衆衛生危機を報告するものではない。疾患監視シグナルには該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事はインフルエンザの医薬品（オセルタミビルジェネリック）のUSFDA承認に関するニュースである。感染症イベント（症例増加、アウトブレイク、公衆衛生上の懸念）を報告していないため、EBSシグナルトリアージの対象外。発生地域フィールドにはインド・デリーと米国が含まれているが、記事本体には感染症イベント情報は存在しない。

article.articleHeadline: சென்னையில் நாளை 1,641 இடங்களில் போலியோ சொட்டு மருந்து முகாம்
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Polio vaccination camps at 1,641 locations in Chennai tomorrow.
article.articleSummary: Polio vaccination camps will be held at 1,641 drop centers in Chennai tomorrow, June 28, as part of a nationwide intensified polio immunization drive. The public is urged to visit a nearby drop center to vaccinate children with the oral polio vaccine. The drive targets about 556,000 children under age 5 in Chennai. Officials stress that polio drops are safe. The operation underscores Chennai's readiness, with 1,641 centers established to reach the target population and protect young children from poliomyelitis. Campaign organizers emphasize accessibility, enabling families to receive vaccination close to home. Local health authorities will supervise the drive to ensure coverage across the city.

triage.headline_ja: チェンナイで明日1,641か所でポリオ予防接種キャンプを実施
triage.triage_reason: ポリオワクチン接種キャンペーンは公衆衛生対策であり、疾病の異常な発生を示していない。記事にはポリオ患者の発生報告がなく、予防接種活動の日程告知に過ぎない。
triage.notes: 本記事はポリオ感染症イベントではなく、定期的な予防接種キャンペーン告知である。疾病の異常な発生や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示す情報は含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Parazitul ascuns în carne care infectează 1 din 3 oameni din lume: riscul tăcut care poate duce la orbire
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The hidden parasite in meat that infects one in three people worldwide: the silent risk that can lead to blindness.
article.articleSummary: Global Toxoplasma gondii infection (toxoplasmosis) affects about one in three people, with ocular toxoplasmosis the most common intraocular infection worldwide and a major infectious cause of vision loss. Transmission mainly through undercooked meat contaminated with parasites and accidental ingestion of cat feces; vertical transmission via placenta can cause miscarriage or severe congenital disease. The burden is highest in South America and other low-resource tropical/subtropical regions. An estimated 190,000 children are born each year with congenital toxoplasmosis, disproportionately affecting vulnerable communities with limited access to healthcare and sanitation. The disease is under-recognized, lacks a vaccine and a standard treatment protocol, and meets criteria for a neglected tropical disease. Advocates urge World Health Organization recognition to drive prevention and management, including improved food safety, clean water, sanitation, and expanded prenatal care. Experts cited: Dr. Justine Smith (Australia) and Dr. João Furtado (Brazil).

triage.headline_ja: 食肉に潜む寄生虫で世界人口の3人に1人が感染：失明につながる可能性のある沈黙のリスク
triage.triage_reason: トキソプラズマ症は既知の疾患であり、記事は全世界的な情報提供型の記事。特定国での急性アウトブレイク兆候は明確ではないが、南米での負担が高いことが言及されており、新規な政策提言（WHO認識の必要性）がある。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが示す発生地域にはAustraliaとBrazilが含まれるが、記事サマリーでは南米地域の負担が高いことと、ブラジルの専門家（Dr. João Furtado）が引用されている。オーストラリアは対象国リストに含まれず。トキソプラズマ症は既知の感染症で現在のアウトブレイク報告ではなく、世界的な認知向上キャンペーン型の記事である。ただし、新規政策提言の側面（WHO認識）と南米での疾病負担の強調があるため、ブラジルをverified_locationsに含める。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola bùng phát nghiêm trọng ở CHDC Congo, Mỹ nâng mức ứng phó cao nhất
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak serious in the Democratic Republic of the Congo; the United States raises its highest alert level.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) is serious, with the United States CDC elevating its response to Activation Level 1 on June 26, 2026. The effort aims to marshal maximum resources as eastern provinces Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu bear the brunt. DRC health authorities report 1,115 laboratory-confirmed cases and 304 deaths since the outbreak began on May 15, yielding a 26.3% fatality rate; earlier figures were 875 cases and 202 deaths. World Health Organization data indicate the Bundibugyo strain has infected over 1,200 people in the DRC (321 deaths) and 20 cases in neighboring Uganda, marking the month with the highest total cases of any outbreak. Health facilities are strained, with at least 78 health workers infected and 18 fatalities. The U.S. is dispatching experimental therapeutics and preparing 2,500 diagnostic tests; Saudi Arabia has banned entry from three affected African countries.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラが深刻に流行、米国が最高警戒レベルを引き上げ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当し、WPRO基準5つすべて該当。エボラウイルス病は致命的で国際的な懸念が極めて高い。フルRRAが必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで確認される重要な懸念事項：(1) DRC内での急速な症例増加（875→1,115確定例、死亡304名、26.3%致命率）；(2) 隣国ウガンダへの国境を越えた拡大（20例）；(3)Bundibugyo株による感染；(4)医療従事者78名感染・18名死亡による医療システムへのダメージ；(5)米国CDCによるActivation Level 1（最高レベル）への引き上げ；(6)サウジアラビアを含む国際的な入国禁止措置の開始。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。ウガンダの事例は記事で言及されているが、発生の主舞台はDRCである。

article.articleHeadline: Polio Vaccination: நாளை காலை 7 மணி முதல்... ராமநாதபுரத்தில் போலியோ சொட்டு மருந்து முகாம்
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Polio Vaccination: Starting from 7 a.m. tomorrow... Polio oral drops vaccination camp in Ramanathapuram.
article.articleSummary: Polio vaccination drive conducted in Ramanathapuram district, Tamil Nadu, to protect children up to five years from polio. A special oral polio drops camp will be held on June 28 (Sunday) from 7:00 AM to 5:00 PM. The drive, announced by District Collector Sivaguru Prabakaran, targets all children up to age five in the district and offers free polio drops. Camps are located at government hospitals, primary health centres, Anganwadi centres, and other crowded public venues across Tamil Nadu to curb transmission. Officials emphasize the vaccine is safe and has no side effects. Parents are urged to ensure their children receive the drops during the camp.

triage.headline_ja: ポリオワクチン接種：明日午前7時から開始...ラマナタプラムでポリオ経口ワクチン接種キャンプ
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はポリオ症例の報告ではなく、定期的なポリオ予防接種キャンプの告知である。異常・予想外性がなく、公衆衛生への深刻な影響や国際的拡大リスクもない。
triage.notes: 本記事は感染症イベント（ポリオ症例の発生）ではなく、定期予防接種活動の行政告知である。タミルナドゥ州ラマナタプラム地区における予防接種キャンプの開催日時と対象者の案内に過ぎず、シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: France reports first Ebola patient as cases in Africa surge above 1000
article.articleSummary: Ebola continues to spread in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with new cases reported in Beni and outbreaks centered in Ituri province’s towns of Bunia, Mongbwalu, and the displacement camp at Kigonze. By late May, 30 people with Ebola-like symptoms died at the Kigonze camp hosting families displaced by regional conflict; two aid workers confirmed 13 deaths in 48 hours there, with about 30 total deaths reportedly expected. Residents described resistance to testing, and burials in which relatives washed bodies persisted, while distancing guidelines were ignored; conditions in camps were abysmal—no water or latrines—facilitating spread. In Bunia, some health workers faced hostility as locals accused authorities of fabricating the disease for material gain. The onset of violence from the ISIS-affiliated Allied Democratic Forces near a local hospital drove further displacement and complicates surveillance and response; a malaria patient feared Ebola upon admission.

triage.headline_ja: フランスが初のエボラ患者を報告、アフリカでの症例が1000件を超える
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス病は重篤な公衆衛生上の影響を伴い、DRC での継続的な流行、フランスでの初患者報告は異常かつ国際的拡大を示唆し、渡航・貿易制限リスクがある。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC（Ituri州のBunia、Mongbwalu、Kigonzeキャンプ）でのエボラ流行を主題としており、フランスでの患者報告は二次的な言及。DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含めた。社会的・政治的関心が極めて高く、国際的な疾病流行として認識されている。複数の危機要因（紛争による避難民、不十分な水・衛生設備、医療従事者への敵意、ISISテロ脅威）が存在し、対応能力の課題が明確。

article.articleHeadline: Is South Sudan at High Risk of an Ebola Outbreak?
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the DRC (Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu) has 1,155 confirmed cases and 304 deaths as of 24 June 2026. WHO data up to 17 June report 896 confirmed cases and 232 deaths in DRC; Uganda has 19 cases (2 deaths) linked to cross-border transmission. Over 6,300 contacts identified; tracing incomplete. Conflict, displacement and limited healthcare complicate control. Transmission via direct contact with blood or body fluids, contaminated objects, or unsafe burials; incubation 2–21 days; early symptoms include fever, headache, fatigue, sore throat; progression to vomiting, diarrhea, organ failure and bleeding. No approved vaccine or specific Bundibugyo treatment; response relies on testing, isolation, contact tracing, safe burials, community engagement. Lancet Infectious Diseases model estimates ~70% importation risk for South Sudan over 12 weeks; spillover hinges on controlling the DRC outbreak. WHO does not currently advise travel restrictions.

triage.headline_ja: 南スーダンはエボラ出血熱の大規模流行のリスクが高いか？
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限の可能性）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも全5項目該当。既に複数国での確認事例があり、死亡者を伴う。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはSouth Sudan、Uganda、Sudanが列挙されているが、記事サマリーの主題は『DRC内での進行中の流行』であり、South SudanはLancet Infectious Diseases模型による将来的リスク推定の対象として言及されているのみである。したがってverified_locationsはDRCのみとした。ウガンダの19例は『越境感染に関連した』ケースとして報告されているが、同国も対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。Bundibugyo型エボラウイルスの流行は確実な人道的危機を呈しており、複数国への波及リスク、不完全な接触者追跡（6,300人以上）、紛争・変位・医療リソース不足という複合要因がある。

article.articleHeadline: Ditemukan Kasus DBD di Sungai Rengas Merangin, Dinkes Selidiki Epidemologi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever case detected in the Rengas River, Merangin; Department of Health investigates epidemiology.
article.articleSummary: Three dengue fever (DHF) cases were detected in Pulau Rengas village, Bangko Barat District, Merangin Regency, Jambi Province, Indonesia. Health authorities confirmed the diagnoses via an Epidemiological Investigation (PE) after reports that patients were being treated for dengue, with hospital verification of active cases. The Merangin Health Department and Bangko Barat Community Health Center will conduct PSN (mosquito breeding site cleanup) and fogging, alongside socialization campaigns to prevent transmission. Authorities warn that changing weather increases vector risk and urge residents to maintain environmental hygiene to reduce Aedes breeding sites. The response includes public education and vector-control measures to interrupt local transmission, with three dengue cases identified in Pulau Rengas and ongoing epidemiological monitoring.

triage.headline_ja: メランギン県スンガイ レンガス地区でデング熱患者を検出、保健当局が疫学調査を実施
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアではデング熱は風土病であり、3症例の報告は異常ではない。ただし公式な疫学調査が実施されており、地域の対応が進行中であるため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: インドネシアは年間を通じてデング熱の風土病地域である。3症例の検出と公式な疫学調査が実施されているが、死亡や重症例の報告はない。蚊の媒介による流行の可能性があるため、WPRO基準の長期曝露リスクと流行しやすさで2項目該当。保健当局による対応（PSN、fogging、公衆教育）が実施されており、管理可能と判断される。国際的拡大リスクは低い。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: اخبارك نت | واشنطن ترفع استجابتها لمواجهة إيبولا.. وتشحن علاجات تجريبية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Akhbarak Net | Washington steps up its response to combat Ebola and ships experimental treatments.
article.articleSummary: US health authorities raised the Ebola response in the Democratic Republic of Congo to Level 1, the highest, more than a month after the outbreak was declared, signaling top-priority and enabling faster mobilization of personnel and resources. Despite assessments that U.S. risk remains low, the CDC announced shipments of MBP134, a monoclonal antibody-based experimental therapy, to the DRC and neighboring Uganda. Additional doses will also be sent to the University of Oxford in the United Kingdom for a clinical trial. The current outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, has killed at least 304 people and sickened 1,115 in the DRC, with Uganda reporting 20 cases, including 2 deaths. The strain has no licensed vaccine or approved treatment at present.

triage.headline_ja: ワシントンがエボラ対策を強化、試験的な治療薬を配送
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響：304人死亡・1,115人患者、異常/予想外のアウトブレイク、複数国への国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。加えてWPRO基準も全て該当し、社会的・政治的関心も高い。フルRRAに進める必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは主にDRCでのエボラアウトブレイク（Bundibugyo ebolavirus、304人死亡）に焦点を当てており、米国の対応強化と実験治療薬の配送について述べている。ウガンダでも症例報告（20例、2人死亡）があるが、記事の主題はDRCのアウトブレイク対応である。英国（オックスフォード大学での臨床試験）は治療薬の臨床試験実施地であり、アウトブレイク発生地ではないため除外。対象国リストにはDRCのみが該当する。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: 暑假將至 衞生署提醒市民外遊慎防麻疹、登革熱及埃博拉等傳染病 - 香港商報
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Summer vacation is approaching: The Department of Health reminds the public to take precautions against infectious diseases such as measles, dengue fever, and Ebola when traveling abroad.
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreaks persist globally: US >2,100 cases; UK 736 and Spain 136 since January; Japan 529 by mid‑June; Singapore 39; Australia 106. Travellers should verify vaccination records and consider two MMR doses at least two weeks before departure; pregnant or planning pregnancies should avoid destinations with outbreaks if not immune. Hand, foot and mouth disease rising in Guangdong, Japan, and Korea since May; symptoms include fever, mouth ulcers, throat pain; typically resolves in 7–10 days. Dengue and other mosquito‑borne diseases remain high: global dengue cases exceeded 14 million in 2024 and 4 million in early 2025; Indonesia and Vietnam >120,000; Singapore >4,000. Chikungunya: about 500,000 cases with 186 deaths in 2025; HK has 23 dengue cases (21 imported, 2 local) and 2 imported chikungunya. Ebola in DRC and Uganda (Bundibugyo virus) prompted HK preparedness; by June 23, 1,094 confirmed cases and 277 deaths; no approved vaccine or specific treatment. Prevention: hand hygiene, avoid animals and sick people, fully cooked food, and declare travel history on arrival.

triage.headline_ja: 暑假將至 衞生署提醒市民外遊慎防麻疹、登革熱及埃博拉等傳染病 - 香港商報（夏休みが近づいています：保健局が海外旅行時の麻疹、デング熱、エボラなどの感染症予防を呼びかけ）
triage.triage_reason: 複数の深刻な感染症（エボラ、麻疹、デング熱、チクングニア）が同時に世界的に発生しており、IHR基準の深刻な影響と異常性を満たす。対象国（中国、インドネシア、ベトナム、DRC）での確認病例と高い国際的拡大リスクがある。
triage.notes: 記事は香港の保健当局による旅行警告であり、複数の致死的感染症（エボラ1,094確認例、277死亡；デング1,400万例以上）の世界的流行を報告している。対象国内ではインドネシア・ベトナムのデング >120,000例、DRCのエボラ outbreak、中国広東でのHFMD上昇が確認されている。エボラはワクチン・特異的治療なし、麻疹は米国2,100例以上。国際的な旅行関連感染症リスクが極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: 女子身体不适就医确诊肝泡型虫病 巨大"虫癌"成功根治
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A woman with discomfort goes to hospital and is diagnosed with hepatic alveolar echinococcosis; giant "worm cancer" successfully cured.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-27, a 62-year-old woman, Ms. Wan, was diagnosed with giant hepatic alveolar echinococcosis at Fujian Medical University Mengchao Hepatobiliary Hospital. The liver lesion measured 8.6 cm at its largest diameter, is invasive and adjacent to major vessels, risking rapid progression and complications if untreated. Traditional open surgery could cause massive bleeding and liver failure, with high risk of residual disease and recurrence. A multidisciplinary team—infectious/immunology, hepatobiliary and pancreatic surgery, anesthesia, nutrition, and radiology—developed a tailored plan under Director Li Haitao and President Zeng Yongyi. They performed robot-assisted laparoscopic left hemihepatectomy plus microwave ablation of the right-liver lesion, enabling radical resection while preserving healthy liver tissue. This case highlights an advanced, minimally invasive approach to complex hepatic alveolar echinococcosis, sometimes referred to as “worm cancer.”

triage.headline_ja: 女性が身体不調で受診し肝泡型包虫症と診断される　巨大な「虫癌」の根治に成功
triage.triage_reason: 個別の臨床症例報告であり、流行・多発事例ではない。異常性・重症度は限定的で、感染症危機の国際的拡大リスクもない。社会的・政治的関心は高くない。
triage.notes: 本記事は単一の臨床症例（62歳女性）の診断・治療成功を報じた医療ニュースであり、感染症流行の兆候ではない。肝泡型包虫症は福建省で散発例が報告される疾患であるが、集団発生や新興脅威の指標はない。フルRRA進行の必要性はない。

article.articleHeadline: Kenali Gejala Difteri Sejak Dini, Jangan Abaikan Selaput Abu-Abu di Tenggorokan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Recognize the early symptoms of diphtheria; do not ignore the gray pseudomembrane in the throat.
article.articleSummary: As of 27 June 2026, diphtheria is caused by Corynebacterium diphtheriae and targets the upper respiratory tract, with toxin potentially damaging the heart, kidneys, and brain if untreated. Transmission is mainly via respiratory droplets from coughing or sneezing, and by contact with contaminated objects. The hallmark early sign is a grayish membrane on the throat and tonsils; other symptoms include sore throat, hoarseness, cough, runny nose, fever, weakness, and swollen neck lymph nodes. Symptoms typically appear 2–5 days after exposure, though some infections are asymptomatic yet contagious. High-risk groups include the unvaccinated, crowded areas with poor sanitation, travelers to outbreak regions, and the immunocompromised. Severe cases require emergency care for breathing difficulties or pale/blue skin. Prevention relies on the DPT vaccine (diphtheria, pertussis, tetanus); Indonesia uses this vaccine with hygiene measures.

triage.headline_ja: ジフテリアの早期症状を認識する。喉の灰色の偽膜を無視しないこと。
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアでジフテリア、百日咳、破傷風に関する公衆衛生情報が報道されているが、記事は症状認識と予防に関する啓発記事であり、具体的な患者数、死亡例、流行状況の詳細情報が不足している。
triage.notes: 記事はメディアインドネシアの啓発記事で、具体的な患者発生の報告ではなく、ジフテリアの症状と予防方法に関する情報提供が主体。IHR基準には該当しないが、ジフテリア、百日咳、破傷風はいずれもWPRO地域で懸念される疾患であり、人口密集地での伝播リスク（prolonged_exposure）と流行性（epidemic_prone）から最低限のWATCH評価が妥当。患者数、死亡例、流行規模に関する情報がないため、より詳細な情報が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Brain Malaria Outbreak in Potka, Three Children Die
article.articleSummary: Cerebral malaria outbreak in Potka block of East Singhbhum near Jamshedpur, India, has claimed three lives in two days: eight-year-olds Lakhi Sardar and Rahul Sardar, and Subola Sardar; Subola’s one-year-old sister Khushbu Sardar remains critical. Health Department confirmed nine new cerebral malaria cases on Friday, including Kasturba Vidyalaya students Priyanka Mahakud (Class X), Laxmi Tudu (Class VI) and Sukurmuni Bhumij (Class VIII), with Priyanka’s mother Salma Mahakud also testing positive. Other patients under treatment include a M. Sabar, Minki Sabar, and a nine-month-old infant from Pitidiri referred to MGM Hospital in Jamshedpur; Sampriya Singh and daughter Kartik Singh are positive; 12-year-old Amisha Bhumij and 17-year-old Bhim Sardar are being treated. Authorities have intensified surveillance, fever screening, and mosquito-control across affected villages; a health camp in Sangram screened 68 residents with no new positives. Officials urge use of mosquito nets, elimination of stagnant water, and prompt care for fever.

triage.headline_ja: ポトカでの脳マラリア発生、3人の子どもが死亡
triage.triage_reason: インドのジャルカンド州ポトカでの脳マラリアアウトブレイク。3人の死亡（うち2人が8歳児）、9件の新規確定患者が報告され、重症度が高く、公衆衛生への深刻な影響が認められる。IHR基準2項目（重症度・異常性）に該当。
triage.notes: 脳マラリア（Cerebral malaria）は重症度が高い。短期間（2日間）での3人の死亡、学校生徒を含む多数患者発生、乳幼児の重症例を含むため、WPROスクリーニング基準の4項目に該当。ジャルカンド州当局による積極的な監視強化・蚊制御対策が報告されており、対応体制がある程度整備されている。

article.articleHeadline: "الأغذية العالمي" يحذر من تفاقم "إيبولا" في الكونغو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Food Programme warns of worsening Ebola in the Congo
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-27, the World Food Programme warns that containing the Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo depends on improving food security and ensuring uninterrupted humanitarian access to affected areas. The agency notes that about 26.5 million people are food insecure, a factor that compounds outbreak response efforts. It is seeking 358 million USD to fund Ebola control activities and sustain food assistance, urging the international community to provide urgent support to prevent a further deterioration of humanitarian and health conditions in the region. The appeal emphasizes the linkage between nutrition, aid delivery, and epidemic response in eastern DRC as authorities continue to confront Ebola.

triage.headline_ja: 世界食糧計画がコンゴでのエボラ悪化に警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。エボラ出血熱は高い致死率と国際的関心を有する疾患であり、フルRRA実施の必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでコンゴ東部でのエボラ流行が確認されており、発生地域の検証と一致。食糧不安が複合要因として機能し、26.5百万人が食糧不安に直面している。国際的支援要請（3.58億USD）がなされており、社会政治的関心が高い。ただしイベント発生日が2026年6月27日と未来であり、配信時点での実際の流行状況の検証が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Broj potvrđenih slučajeva obolelih od ebole u DR Kongu povećan na 1.203
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of confirmed Ebola cases in DR Congo has risen to 1,203.
article.articleSummary: Confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo have risen to 1,203, with 321 deaths, while neighboring Uganda has reported 20 deaths. The totals are as of Thursday, June 25, 2026. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned that the international risk remains low but requires careful monitoring. The U.S. CDC has raised its Ebola response to its highest level, Level 1, enabling rapid deployment of responders in affected countries. CDC officials said 19 staff have been deployed abroad, supplementing more than 125 personnel on the ground in Congo and Uganda, with financial support to partners and training of 25 local field epidemiologists. Prior Level 1 activations have occurred after Hurricane Katrina (2005), the H1N1 pandemic (2009–2010), the West Africa Ebola outbreak (2014–2016), and the Zika outbreak (2016–2017).

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ確認患者数が1,203人に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルスによる大規模アウトブレイク（1,203確認患者、321死亡）で、深刻な公衆衛生影響と国際的拡大リスクが存在し、米国CDCが最高レベル（Level 1）の対応を発動している。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはコンゴ民主共和国、米国、ウガンダが含まれているが、サマリーの主題はコンゴ民主共和国のエボラアウトブレイクであり、対象国リストではコンゴ民主共和国（203312）のみが該当。ウガンダ（死亡20例）は隣接国での限定的な影響として言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。米国も対象国外のため除外。CDC Level 1対応の発動は国際的な危機管理への高い関心を示唆。
